tei:div.tei:p: / rte//ṭwāXshaṃXdzñodrug / mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang /
dkar chagango mtshar sprul pa'i glegs bam bzhugs so/ / (1)rgyal sras sprul pa'i glegs bam bzhugs so/ / (235)ya mtshan sprul pa'i glegs bam bzhugs so// (510)

༄ / /ngo mtshar sprul pa'i glegs bam bzhugs so//༄༅/ /na mo gu ru mañdzu sgo ṣa ya/ /dang po byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed nas/ /bar du bskal chen grangs med tshogs gnyis bsags/ /tha mar mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i/ /ston pa thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgu tshe 'di yi gong la dga' ldan du/ /dam pa tog dkar zhes byar skye ba bzhes/ /gzigs pa lnga yis gzigs nas dga' ldan gyi/ /gnas nas 'pho bar mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sa lug lo yi sa ga zla ba'i tshes/ /bco lnga'i mtshan mo glang chen thal dkar gye/ /rnam pas rab mdzes sgyu 'phrul lha mo yi/ /lhums su zhugs par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lcags pho spre'u lo dbo zla'i tshes pa bcu'i/ /nyin par bkra shis lum bi'i nags tshal du/ /sgyu 'phrul lha mo'i rtsib logs g.yas pa nas/ /gzugs sku bltams par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lang tsho rab rgyas sgu na gzhon pa'i dus/ /stobs ldan dregs can skye bo kun 'dus nas/ /yig rtsis stobs sogs sgyu rtsal 'gran pa'i tshe/ /kun las mchog gyur 1

mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dgung lo nyer dgu'i bar du rgyal sa bzung / /rgyal srid skyong tshe yid 'ong sa 'tsho dang / /grags 'dzin ma sogs rab mdzes btsun mo yi/ /'khor gyes bskor bar mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /na rga 'chi ba gzigs pas thugs skyo nas/ /sa pho byi ba'i lo la rgyal srid spangs/ /mchod rten rnam dag drung nas dbu skra bsil/ /rab tu byung bar mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chu bo nee rañdza na'i 'gram du byon/ /mkha' khyab ting nge 'dzin la snyems par zhugs/ /g.yo ba med par dgung lo drug gi bar/ /dka' spyad drag po mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdud kyi sde rnams pham par bya phyir dang / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas go 'phang thob bya'i phyir/ /rdo rje gdan gye byang chub shing dbang gi /drung du gshegs par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /las can rtswa 'tshong khye'u bkra shis kyis/ /phul ba'i rtswa yi gdan la skyil krung byas/ /byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis nam srod la/ /bdud sde pham par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dgung lo so lnga shing pho rta yi lo/ /sa ga zla ba'i tshes pa bco lnga yi/ /tho rangs mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i/ /rmad byung mdzad pa bstan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshangs dang dbang pos gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ /chu stod zla ba'i tshes pa bzhi yi nyin/ /wā rā ṇa sī'i gnas su 2

bden pa bzhi'i/ /chos 'khor bskor bar mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dgung lo brgyad cu gya gcig lcags 'brug lo/ /dpyid tha'i tshes pa bco lnga'i nang bar la/ /rtswa mchog grong du rdo rje sku zhig nas/ /mya ngan 'da' bar mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos su 'byor pa'i mchod pa'i tshogs rnams dang / /'jig rten khams dang sangs rgyas zhing kun na/ /mchod pa ci mchis blo yis blangs nas 'bul/ /bdag gzhan tshogs gnyis rdzogs phyir bzhes su gsol/ /bdag dang 'gro ba sems can thams cad kyis/ /thog med dus nas tha ma da lta'i bar/ /mi dge sdig pa'i las rnams ci bgyis pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag nyid gcig pus bshag /khyed kyi sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan dang / /rang gzhan sgye 'phags rnams kyi dge ba'i tshogs/ /mthong thos dran dang mi dran thams cad la/ /rab tu dga' bas rjes su yi rang bya/ /ston pas gtso byas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas la/ /gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong ldan pa dang / /gser gye maṇḍal dung dkar g.yas 'khrul sogs/ /phul nas 'gro la chos 'khor bskor bar bskul/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi sku dngos thugs sprul gyi/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa/ /kun la rin chen khri dang dar zab gdan/ /phul nas zhabs pad brtan phyir 3

gsol ba 'debs/ /'dis mtshon dus gsum bsags pa'i dge tshogs rnams/ /ston pas bdag gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa dang / /bstan pa dar zhing bstan 'dzin sku tshe brtan/ /'gro kun bde zhing skyid pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa khyed sku ji 'dra dang / /'khor dang sku tshe'i tshad dang zhing khams dang / /khyed kyi mtshan mchog bzang po ji 'dra ba/ /de 'dra kho nar bdag kyang 'gyur bar shog /'gro ba yongs kyi sngon nas ma 'dris pa'i/ /mdza' bshes chen po ston pa sangs rgyas kyi/ /ngo mtshar skyes rabs rnam par thar pa dang / /gsung rab bzhin du byas na da nas bzung / /tshe rabs kun tu ma nor lam la zhugs/ /bde nas bde bar mtho nas mtho ru 'gro/ /mthar thug rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas go 'phang thob/ /lhar bcas 'gro kun gtsug gi rgyan du 'gyur/ /de phyir ston pa'i skyes rabs rnam thar dang / /gsung bzhin lha chos byed tshul bdag gis bshad/ /tshe rabs kun tu bde zhing skyid 'dod pa'i/ /skal bzang skye bo'i tshogs rnams gus pas nyon/ /zhes bdag cag gi ston pa thugs rje can la/ nyid kyi mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul dang mthun pa'i rnar snyan yid 'bab bstod tshig gi sgra dbyangs sgogs bzhin du rab tu gus pas lha phyag grangs med byas/ yan lag bdun pa 4

zhig sngon du btang nas/ 'gro ba yongs kyi sngon nas ma 'dris pa'i mdza' bshes chen po 'dren pa mnyam med ston pa sangs rgyas thugs rje can gyi skyes rabs rnam par thar pa dang / gsung bzhin byas na lam la nor gyes dogs pa med par da nas bzung ste tshe rabs thams cad du/ bde nas bde bar mngon mtho lha mi'i go 'phang nges legs thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang mthon por rim gyis son par 'gyur bas na/ de'i phyir 'dir skal bzang gi sgye bo pho mo rnams kyis ston pa thugs rje can gye skyes rabs rnam thar dang / gsung bzhin du dam pa'i lha chos byed tshul gsal bar bshad par bya ste/ de yang bdag cag snyigs dus kyi 'gro ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' gzhan thams cad kyis 'dul ba'i spyod yul du ma gyur pa/ ma rungs shin tu gdul dka' ba/ sdug bsngal gyis ches cher mnar ba rnams kyi mgon dang skyabs dang dpung gnyen gcig pu/ ston pa bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa thugs rje can de ni/ sku tshe snga ma'i snga ma sngon yun ring po bas kyang ches ring ba/ bskal pa brjod kyis mi lang ba'i ches brjod kyis mi lang ba'i sngon rol na/ bdag cag rnams dang 5

skal ba mnyam par spyod pa zhig las nam zhig na phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams dang / 'phags pa 'jam dpal la sogs pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang pos rjes su bzung zhing bsgul ba'i mthus/ sems can sdug bsngal gyis nyam thag pa la bzod glags med pa'i snying rje dang / sangs rgyas rnams kyi mthu stobs gzi brjid mdzad pa 'phrin las bsam gyes mi khyab pa'i tshul rnams thos shing mthong ba'i rkyen gyis/ dang po byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed tshul ni/ ston pa thugs rje can 'di/ sngon dmyal ba'i shing rta 'dren par gyur pa'i tshe/ grogs zla bo zhig dang gnyis kyis lcags bsregs kyi sa gzhir/ gshin rje a glang gi shing rta 'dren pa las/ zla bo de nyam chung bas 'dren ma nus pa na/ gshin rje a glang khros nas lcags kyi mdung rtse gsum pa brang la bsnun pas khrag gi char ba 'bab cing / sdug bsngal gyes nyam thag nas smre sngags 'don pa na/ de la bzod glags med pa'i snying rje sgyes nas/ zla bo 'di sdug bsngal las thar par byas te/ dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal 'di bdag gcig pus bzod par bya'o snyam du thugs bskyed de/ gshin rje a glang la zla bo nyam thag 'di thongs la/ 'di'i thag pa'ang nga'i ma go la skon cig nga gcig pus drang bar bya'o zhes gsungs pas/ a glang khros nas 6

lcags kyi mdung rtse gsum pa bsnun pas/ bskal pa brgyar bsags pa'i sdig pa dag cing / de nas tshe 'phos nas sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lhar skyes par gsungs/ 'di ni bcom ldan 'das kyis byams pa'i thugs bskyed mdzad pa'i thog ma yin pas/ de nas bzung ste mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas kyi bar du/sems can thams cad la byams pa dang snying rje'i sems rgyun mi 'chad du bskyed par mdzangs blun las gsungs/yang rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis/ ston pas thog mar gang du thugs bskyed lags zhus pas/ bka' stsal pa/ sngon nga rgyal po 'od ldan du gyur tshe/ glang chen 'dul mkhan gyi kha nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi brtson 'grus dang stobs thos nas dad de/ /sbyin pa dag byen bsod nams dag byas te/ /sbyin pa rgya chen gyur pa 'di yi su/ /'gro ba rang byung sangs rgyas gyur nas ni/ /sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams kyis ma bsgral ba'i/ /skye bo'i tshogs rnams bdag gis bsgral bar bya/ /zhes byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed par gsungs/ yang sngon rdza mkhan gyi khye'u snang byed du gyur pa'i tshe/ de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub chen la/rdza'i bum pa 'jam gyis bkang ba/ me long gis kha brgyan pa sogs mchod pa'i yo byad ci yod phul te/ de bzhin gshegs pa 7

khyed sku ci 'dra dang / /'khor dang sku tshe'i tshad dang zhing khams dang / /khyed kyi mtshan mchog bzang po ci 'dra ba / /de 'dra kho nar bdag kyang 'gyur bar shog /ces brjod nas byang chub tu thugs bskyed par gsungs/ yang sngon tshong dpon gyi bu dri ma med pa'i dpung ba zhes bya bar gyur tshe/ de bzhin gshegs pa mi thub zla ba'i rgyal mtshan la/ bsod snyoms phul nas spyan sngar bsdad pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa mi thub zla ba'i rgyal mtshan gyis khye'u de la/ byang chub kyi lam bstan pa na/ phyir mi ldog pa'i dad pa chen pos skyabs su song zhing / byang chub tu thugs bskyed par gsungs/ yang sngon chos kyi rgyal po tshe rnam rgyal zhes bya ba'i bu gzhon nu brtson 'grus spyod pa zhes bya bar gyur tshe/ de bzhin gshegs pa phung po chen po zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byon pa dang mjal te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i dzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa dang chos bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa la dad pa brtan po thob nas/ sangs rgyas phung po chen po 'khor bcas lo bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa drug gi bar du/ mchod pa'i dngos po thams cad kyis mchod cing bsnyen bkur nas/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu thugs bskyed par gsungs/ yang sngon tshong dpon shes rab bzang po zhes bya bar gyur pa'i tshe de 8

bzhin gshegs pa dkon mchog yan lag ces bya ba 'jig rten du byon pa dang mjal te/ byang chub kyi lam rgyas par bstan cing / rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa du ma bstan pa la dad de/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog yan lag 'khor bcas la lo stong du mchod cing bsnyen bkur nas/ byang chub tu thugs bskyed par gsungs/ yang sngon bram ze'i khye'u gzhon nu sprin du gyur pa'i tshe/de bzhin gshegs pa mar me mdzad 'jig rten du byon pa dang mjal te/ ral pa gser gyi kha dog lta bu gdan du bting / utpa la'i me tog snyim pa gang gtor nas sems bskyed pas/ sangs rgyas mar me mdzad kyis bram ze'i khye'u sprin 'di ma 'ongs pa na/lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa bcom ldan 'das su 'gyur zhes lung bstan par gsungs/ yang sngon bram ze rgya mtsho'i rdul du gyur tshe/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen snying po zhes bya ba/'jig rten du byon pa dang mjal rte/ lo brgya phrag mang po'i bar du mchod cing / rgyal po rtsibs kyi mu khyud dang rang gi slob ma bram ze rig byed klog pa stong la sogs srog chags bye ba phrag mang po/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen snying po'i drung du khrid nas/ byang chub tu sems bskyed du bcug de rnams kyis sems bskyed nas/ rang rang gis zhing bzung ba na/ rgyal po rtsibs kyi 9

mu khyud kyis bde ba can gyi zhing bzung / gzhan rnams kyis kyang zhing bzang po gdul bya dag pa 'ba' zhig bzung / khyad par bskal bzang 'dir 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ba'i byang chub sems dpa' skar ma skyong la sogs byang sems dgu brgya dang dgu bcu go dgu po thams cad kyis 'jig rten rgyas shing longs spyod che ba/ gdul bya tshe ring zhing rgyud dag pa sha stag bzung nas/ rtsod ldan tshe lo brgya ba'i dus kyi gdul bya ma rungs tshe thung longs spyod chung ba/ dmu rgod bsam pa ngan pa/ 'khrug rtsod can de dag sus gdul bar nus zhes yal bar dor ba na/bram ze rgya mtsho'i rdul bzod glags med pa'i snying rje skyes nas/snyigs dus kyi gdul bya sems can nyam thag rnams kyi don du smon lam chen po lnga brgya btab ste/ dus ngan 'dir 'byon par dam bcas pa na/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad g.yos shing /me tog gi char babs/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang sems thams cad kyis 'gran zla med par pad dkar lta bur bsngags shing / de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen snying pos bram ze rgya mtsho'i rdul khyod ma 'ongs pa na/ 'jig rten gye khams mi mjed der/ skye dgu rnams tshe lo brgya nyi shu thub pa na/ de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa zhes bya bar gyur te/ sangs rgyas kyi 10

mdzad pa mtha' dag byed par 'gyur la/ khyod 'das nas kyang dam pa'i chos lo stong gnas par 'gyur zhing / chos nub nas kyang lus las skyes pa'i sku gdung rnams kyis kyang yun ring por sems can 'dul bar 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan/gzhan yang ston pa thugs rje can gyis sngon 'das pa'i dus su sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa la mnyes pa'i mchod pa rgya chen po phul nas yang dang yang du thugs bskyed par gsungs/ de bzhin du 'o skol ston pa'i rjes 'jug rnams kyis kyang / bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang / sku gsung thugs rten gyi drung dang / rang gi yang mdun gye nam mkhar tshogs zhing gi lha tshogs dpag tu med pa bzhugs par dmigs nas/ dngos 'byor yid sprul gyi mchod pas mchod nas 'di ltar sems bskyed par bya ste/ rang gi tshe 'khor ba thog ma ma mchis pas na/ sems can thams cad kyis tshe sngon rang gi pha ma ma byas pa ni gcig kyang med la/ pha ma nam byas res kyi tshe 'di'i pha mas bskyangs pa bzhin du/ drin gyis bskyangs pa sha stag yin pas/ drin can gyi pha mas sems can bde ba med pa rnams bde ba dang ldan na ci ma rung snyam pa'i byams pa dang /sdug bsngal can rnams sdug bsngal dang bral na ci ma rung snyam 11

pa'i snying rje rgyun ring la shugs drag pa bsgoms nas/ snying thag pas da nas bzung ste bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal bsal nas bde la 'god par bya snyam pa'i gzhan don don gnyer gyi blo bcos ma ma yin pa bskyed/ gzhan don byed pa la sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob na yon tan yod tshul bsams nas skom pa chu 'dod pa ltar 'gro kun don du skyon kun zad yon tan kun ldan sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob na ci ma rung thob par gyur cig thob pa zhig ci nas kyang bya'o snyam pa'i bla na med pa'i byang chub don gnyer gyi blo/ smon pe byang chub kyi sems dang / sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa la/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la slob dgos pa shes nas/ sdig pa spong ba/ dge ba sgrub pa/ sems can gye don byed pa'i rgyal sras kyi spyod pa la 'jug par bya snyam pa'i 'jug pa byang chub kyi sems dang / de ltar rgyal sras kyi spyod pa spyad pa'i mthus sangs rgyas nas/ sprul pa bye ba phrag brgya bkyed nas/ sems can thams cad kyi don byed pa'i dus skabs shig na ma 'ongs na/myur du 'ong na ci ma rung / 'ong bar gyur cig 'ong tshe zhi bar skad cig tsam yang mi gnas par ji srid 'khor ba na sems can gcig kyang ma lus pa de srid du 'gro ba'i don la brtson 12

par bya'o snyam du/ bla ma dngos su yod na/ de'i rjes zlos bya/med na tshogs zhing gtso bo'i rjes su zlos par mos pa/ gtan gyi skyabs gnas bla ma dkon mchog la/ /bdag dang 'gro kun gus pas skyabs su mchi/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing gi rgyal ba sras bcas dang / /rtsa ba'i bla ma bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /pha ma sems can thams cad bde dang ldan/ /sdug bsngal kun dang bral na ci ma rung / /da nas bzung ste bdag gis sems can gyi/ /sdug bsngal bsal nas bde la 'god par bya/ /'god phyir sangs rgyas go 'phang thob par bya/ /thob phyir dam pa'i lha chos sgrub par bgyi/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas go 'phang myur thob nas/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba sgol bar sems bskyed do/ /zhes gser sbyangs btso ma lta bu'i byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems rin po che nyin re bzhin du yang yang bskyed par bya'o/ /de nas ston pa thugs rje can gyis/ bar du bskal chen grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags tshul ni/ grangs med dang po la/ de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub chen nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa yul 'khor skyong gi bar/ sangs rgyas bdun khri lnga stong la bsnyen bkur zhing mchod pas mnyes par mdzad/grangs med gnyis pa la/ de bzhin gshegs pa legs mdzad 13

nas bzung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa dbang po'i rgyal mtshan gyi bar sangs rgyas bdun khri drug stong la bsnyen bkur zhing mchod pas mnyes par mdzad/ grangs med gsum pa la/ de bzhin gshegs pa mar me mdzad nas bzung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'od srungs kyi bar sangs rgyas bdun khri bdun stong la/ bsnyen bkur zhing mchod pas mnyes par mdzad nas tshogs gnyis bsags par gsungs/ de ni theg pa thun mong ba'i dbang du byas nas gsungs pa yin gyis/ theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i dbang du byas na/ ston pas sngon slob pa lam gye gnas skabs na/bya rgod phung po'i ri gcig pur sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed la/ bkur sti byas zhes zla ba sgron me'i mdo las gsungs/ de bzhin du 'o skol ston pa'i rjes 'jug rnams kyis kyang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i rnam 'phrul bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan dang ldan pa thams cad la/ zang zing nor dang /lus ngag gi zhabs tog bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i mchod pas mnyes par byed pa la bslab par bya/ gzhan yang bskal chen grangs med gsum gye bar la/ ston pa thugs rje can sngon rgyal po kha dog dam pa zhes bya bar gyur tshe/ gnod sbyin zhig la/ 'dus 14

byas thams cad mi rtag ste/ /ci tsam skyes pa sdug bsngal bcas/ /lnga phung mtshan ma med pas stong / /bdag dang bdag gi ba yang med/ /ces pa'i tshigs bcad 'di gsan pa'i phyir du/ btsun mo yid du 'ong ba dang / sras gces pa gnod sbyin la byin te zar bcug pa dang / rgyal po chen po ga na sha ni ba li zhes bya bar gyur tshe/ bram ze le'u du cha zhes bgyi ba la/ zag pa thams cad zad par 'gyur/ /mtho ba de yang mthar ltung ngo / /'du ba yod na 'bral bar 'ong / /skye ba yod na 'chi bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i tshigs bcad 'di gsan pa'i phyir du sku lus la mar me stong btsugs te me sbar bar mdzad pa dang / rgyal po chen po bye ling gar ling zhes bya bar gyur tshe/ bram ze khye'u du na zhes bgyi ba la/ 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag ste/ /skye ba thams cad sdug bsngal bcas/ /chos kun stong pas bdag po med/ /bdag gi ba yang yod ma yin/ /zhes tshigs bcad 'di gsan pa'i phyir du sku la lcags gzer stong gis btab pa dang / rgyal tshab da ma ge zhes bya bar gyur tshe/ bram ze zhig la/ byams pa'i sems ni goms par bya/ /zhe sdang khro ba'i 'du shes spang / /snying rje chen pos sems can skyobs/ /kun la brtse zhing mchi ma zag /dga' ba chen po goms par bya/ /gzhan la bdag dang mthun pa'i 15

chos/ /byang chub sems kyis bskyabs pa ni/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod par ldan/ /zhes pa'i tshigs bcad 'di gnyis gsan pa'i phyir du me'i dong zabs su khru bcu pa me ma mur gyis bkang ba'i nang du mchongs pa dang / drang srong ur ta la zhes bya bar gyur tshe/ bram ze zhig la/ lus kyi spyod pa rab bsdams shing / /srog gcod rku dang g.yom mi bya/ /phra ma dzun dang tshig rtsub dang / /bkyal ba smra bar mi bya 'o/ /'dod pa rnams la mi chags shing / /zhe sdang sems kyang med par bya/ /ngan par lta ba kun spangs na/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa 'o/ /zhes pa'i tshigs bcad 'di gnyis gsan pa'i phyir du sku lus kyi pags pa bshus nas/ rus pas sgyu gu byas/ khrag snag tshar sbyar te/tshigs bcad 'di dag 'bri bar mdzad pa sogs/ chos tshigs bcad re'i phyir du'ang dka' ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyad do/ /de bzhin du 'o skol rnams kyis kyang bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyi drung nas chos nyan pa'i phyir/ lus longs spyod rnams phangs pa med par btang nas/ dka' ba ci nus su spyod pa la bslab par bya/ gzhan yang skyes rabs so bzhi pa las/sangs rgyas thugs rje can/ sngon bram ze chen po zhig tu gyur pa'i tshe/ stag mo phru gu dang bcas pa ltogs nas nyam thag pa zhig 16

mthong nas/ snying rjes ma bzod par/ rang lus sbyin par btang nas/ stag mo ma bu rnams kyi lus gsos pa dang / sngon yul shi bi'i rgyal por gyur tshe/ nor longs spyod thams cad sbyin par btang / tha na rang gi spyan yang bram ze long ba zhig la byen nas/long ba mig dang ldan par mdzad pa dang / sngon ko sa la yi rgyal por gyur tshe/ tshe sngon gla mi zhig tu gyur tshe/ gzhan la zan dron tsam zhig byin pa'i 'bras bus tshe der rgyal por gyur pa dran te/'khor rnams la/ rgyu chung ngus 'bras bu rgya chen po thob pa 'di la ltos/ zhes chos bstan cing sbyin pa rgya chen po mdzad pa dang /sngon tshong dpon sbyin la dpa' bar gyur tshe/ bdud kyis me 'obs sprul kyang / snying stobs chen pos 'obs brgal nas 'phags pa mchod pa dang / sngon tshong dpon zil gyes mi non par gyur tshe/ lha yis nyams sad nas nor kun mi snang bar byas kyang / rtswa sngon po brngas te btsongs pa'i rin gyes phongs pa rnams gsos pa dang / sngon ri bong gi gtso bor gyur tshe/ 'khor rnams la chos bstan/ bram ze bkres pa zhig gso ba'i phyir rang lus me nang du mchongs pa lha dbang gis blangs te/ kun la ngo mtshar zhes bstan pa dang / sngon bram ze a ga ta ru gyur nas dka' thub kyi nags na gnas tshe/ lha yis nyi ma gsum dka' 17

thub kyi zas bslangs kyang / ma chags par phangs pa med par byen nas ting nge 'dzin gyi dga' ba des 'tsho bar mdzad pa dang / sngon rgyal po byams pa'i stobs su gyur pa'i tshe/ 'gro kun byams dang brtse bas bskyangs shing khyad par gnod sbyin lnga lus kyi khrag gis gsos nas/ nam zhig sangs rgyas pa'i tshe chos kyi bdud rtsi ster zhes gsungs pa dang / sngon rgyal bu thams cad sgol du gyur pa'i tshe/ bu dang bu mo nor dang glang chen sogs gces dgu kun btang zhing mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pas 'gro kun bde bar mdzad pa dang / sngon mchod sbyin byed pa'i sa skyong rgyal por gyur tshe/ gzhan dbang du ma btang bar dud 'gro bgrang las 'das pa'i srog bskyabs/ 'gro kun dge bcu'i khrims la bkod nas sbyin pa mthar phyin pa ltar/ 'o skol rnams kyis kyang sbyin pa gtong ba la bslab par bya/sngon lha'i dbang por gyur tshe/ lha ma yin dang g.yul 'gyed pa'i dus/ bya yi tshang zhig gzigs nas/ rang srog yal bar btang nas bya phrug gi srog bskyabs pa dang / sngon bram ze zhig tu gyur tshe/ slob dpon gyi bram ze rgud tshe rku ba rung zhes bskul yang / ma byin pa len pa nam yang mi rung zhes ma blangs pa dang /sngon shi bi'i rgyal por gyur tshe/ blon pos myos byed ma zhes bya 18

ba'i bud med mdzes ma zhig phul yang / srog la babs kyang log g.yem mi bya zhes ma byas pa dang / sngon ded dpon chen por gyur tshe/ bden tshig brjod pas don mthun rgya mtsho'i klong las mthar phyin par mdzad cing / rin chen sna tshogs 'dod dgu'i char gyis tshim par mdzad pa dang / sngon nya yi rgyal por gyur tshe/nya phran rnams mtsho bskams nas bya sna tshogs kyis gtses pa na/bden pa'i tshig gis char phab nas nya rnams gsos pa dang /sngon bya sreg par gyur tshe/ nags mes mtha' bskor yang /bden tshig brjod pas me phyir log ste/ 'gro ba grangs med pa'i srog bskyabs pa dang / sngon lha'i dbang po brgya byin du gyur pa'i tshe/ myos byed chang gis rgyal blon sde dang bcas pa phung bar gzigs nas sprul pa zhig btang ste chos bstan nas thams cad bde ba la bkod pa dang / sngon rgyal rigs phyug por gyur tshe/'dod pa'i nyes dmigs rig nas nges 'byung gis bskul te/'khor ba'i longs spyod thams cad spangs nas rab tu byung ba dang / sngon grags ldan bram ze'i rigs su 'khrungs tshe/ longs spyod kun spangs nas dben par bsam gtan mdzad cing rkyen ngan lam du bsgyur/ gnod 'tshe'i sems spangs te/ 'khor rnams la chos bstan pa dang / sngon rgyal po'i tshong dpon du gyur 19

tshe/ gzhan gyis bsgrags pa'i yon tan thos pas/ dga' bzhin du tshe blos btang nas rab tu byung / tshul khrims mthar phyin par mdzad pa ltar/ 'o skol rnams kyis kyang tshul khrims bsrungs pa la bslab par bya/ sngon bram ze'i rigs chen po gtsug phud byang chub ces bya bar gyur tshe/ rgyal pos brnyas kyang khro ba med par bzod pa bsgoms/ rjes su bzung nas dam chos bstan pa dang /sngon ngang pa'i rgyal por gyur tshe/ rnyi nang du bzung yang / khro ba dang 'jigs pa med par thabs mkhas kyis rgyal po tshangs byin 'khor bcas la chos bstan pa dang / sngon kun tu rgyu rab bzang du gyur tshe/ mang pos brnyas kyang khro ba med par bzod pa bsgoms nas lta ba ngan pa'i rgyal po 'khor bcas la yang dag pa'i gnas lugs bstan pa dang / sngon byang chub sems dpa' spre'ur gyur tshe/ g.yang du lhung ba'i mi zhig rgyab tu khur nas drangs kyang / mi ngan des spre'u ngal dub nas gnyid yod dus rdo brgyab nas gsod grabs byas kyang / bzod pa bsgoms nas slar yang phan thogs mdzad pa dang / sngon ri dwags sha ra bhar gyur tshe/ rang la gnod pa'i rgyal po g.yang du lhung ba rang lus la bskyon nas g.yang las drangs pa dang / sngon ri dwags ru rur gyur tshe chus khyer ba'i nyam thag mi zhig chu las bsgral nas nga 20

'dra ba'i ri dwags yod pa su la ma smra bshad kyang rgyal po la zhus nas/ dmag gis mtha' bskor nas gsod la thug kyang bzod pa bsgoms nas rgyal blon 'khor bcas la chos bstan pa dang / sngon spre'u'i rgyal por gyur tshe/ rgyal po'i dmag gis spre'u'i tshogs rnams nyam thag par byas pa la thugs brtse bas rang lus zam pa ltar byas/ lus bsnad nas shi la thug rung spre'u'i tshogs mang po chu las bsgral ba dang / sngon drang srong bzod pa smra bar gyur tshe/ rgyal pos lus dum bur gtubs kyang /de la khro ba med par slar yang thugs brtse bas gnod lan du phan pa mdzad pa dang / sngon tshangs pa'i rgyal por gyur tshe/ yan lag sbyin par btang nas/ lta ba ngan pa 'dzin la thugs brtse bas las rgyu 'bras bden pa'i chos bstan pa dang / sngon dgon pa nyam nga'i glang chen du gyur tshe/ rgyal pos spyugs pa'i skye bo bdun brgya tsam la/ thugs brtse bas ma bzod par ri zhig gi rtse nas g.yang la mchongs nas lus zar bcug nas mi kun gsos te/ bzod pa mthar phyin par mdzad pa ltar/'o skol rnams kyis kyang bzod pa bsgom pa la bslab par bya/ sngon rgyal bu zla bar gyur tshe/ rkang khra la chos bstan te/ des kyang btson du bzung ba'i mi rnams btang / lam bzang sgrub cing gzhan la yang 21

bstan nas brtson 'grus mthar phyin par mdzad pa ltar/ 'o skol rnams kyis kyang brtson 'grus rtsom pa la bslab par bya sngon lcags khyem na gnas pa'i rgyal por gyur tshe/ 'khor bar zhen log nges 'byung skyes nas/ byang sems ting 'dzin bsgoms nas bsam gtan mthar phyin par mdzad pa ltar/ 'o skol rnams kyis kyang bsam gtan bsgom pa la yang bslab par bya/ sngon ma he rgod kyi khyu mchog tu gyur tshe/ spre'u zhig nyin re bzhin mgo la zhon/ mig bkab/ rna ba dkrugs/ lam bkag sogs byas pa bzod cing / gzhan gnod sbyin zhig la chos bstan pa dang / sngon bya shing rta mor gyur tshe/ seng ge'i gre bar rus pa zug pa bton nas/ lha la rgyal ba dgyes pa'i lam bzang bstan nas shes rab mthar phyin par mdzad pa ltar/ 'o skol rnams kyis kyang shes rab la yang bslab par bya'o/ /mdor na ston pa thugs rje can gyes/ sngon slob pa lam gyi gnas skabs su/rgyal blon bram ze khyem bdag sogs sems can dpag tu med pa'i lus blangs tshe/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa mchod cing / bu dang bu mo/ 'khor dang longs spyod thams cad phangs pa med par 'gro la btang zhing / tha na sdong po gcig gi rtsa nas gzhan la dbu gcig pu bcad nas 22

kyang stong phrag cig sbyin par btang bar gsungs/ de bzhin du sha dang khrag dang rkang lag sogs lus kyi sbyin pa kho na yang lan grangs dpag tu med par btang nas/ 'gro la phan tshad med pa btags/ gnod pa tshad med las bskyabs te/ sgo sna tshogs nas tshogs gnyis bar ma chad du bsags par gsungs so/ /de bzhin du 'o skol rnams kyis kyang yar bla ma dkon mchog la mchod 'bul/ mar dbul po ngan slong la sbyin gtong /bar dge 'dun pa dang drin can gye pha ma la zhabs tog gzhan yang lus kyis phyag dang skor ba/ ngag gis kha ton/ bzlas brjod/ sems kyis dad gus dag snang zab rgyas gdams pa bsgoms pa sogs lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas/ rang gis dge ba byed pa dang /gzhan la byed du 'jug pa dang / gzhan gyis byas pa la rjes su yi rang ba la sogs sgo sna tshogs nas tshogs gnyis bsog pa la bslab par bya'o/ /de nas ston pa thugs rje can/ tha ma myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas/ 'gro la chos 'khor bskor tshul ni/sgu tshe 'di nyid kyi gong du/ steng phyogs dga' ldan lha'i yul du lha'i bu dam pa tog dkar zhes bya ba'i sku'i skye ba bzhes nas lha rnams la chos bstan/ de nas lha'i rol mo'i sgra las/ 'dzam bu 23

gling du phebs par bskul ba'i tshe/ mi'i gdul bya rnams 'dul ba'i dus la bab par dgongs nas/ lha rnams la nga ni mi sdod 'dzam bu gling du 'gro/ khyed rnams dus rgyun du bag yod bsten zhes gsungs/ nyid kyi cod pan byams pa'i dbu la bcings/rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur/ de nas rigs dang / yul dang /dus dang / brgyud dang / bud med de gzigs pa lnga la gzigs nas/ dga' ldan lha yul nas babs te/ nam mkha' thams cad 'od kyis 'gengs bzhin glang chen thal dkar mche ba drug ldan gye rnam par gshegs nas/ sa lug lo sa ga zla ba'i tshes pa bco lnga'i dus su/ zas gtsang gi btsun mo sgyu 'phrul lha mo gso sbyong la gnas pa'i lhums su zhugs/ zla ba bcu phal cher lon pa na legs sbyar lha'i skad mang po brjod cing / btsas pa'i dus la bab tshe/ yum sgyu 'phrul lha mo lum ba'i nags tshal du byon/ lha tshangs pa dang dbang po gnyis kyis zhabs phyi byas/ lha'i bu dang bu mo mang pos nam mkha' nas mchod/ yum gyis spang sha'i sdong po'i yal ga phyag g.yas kyis bzung nas rtsib logs g.yas nas/lcags pho spre'u lo dbo zla'i tshes pa bcu'i nyin sku bltams pa dang / tshangs pa dang dbang pos blangs nas dri med spos chus bkrus te me tog gtor/ de'i tshe sa la padma brdol zhing / mkha' 24

la rin po che'i gdugs byung / sa chen drug la gom pa bdun bor nas/ /nga ni 'jig rten 'di na mchog yin zhes/ /stong gsum kun tu dbyangs kyis go bar mdzad/ /yab kyi don kun grub pas gzhon nu don grub ces mtshan gsol/ tshangs pa dang mngon shes ldan pa'i drang srong gis 'khor los bsgyur pa'am/yang na sangs rgyas su 'gyur zhes lung yang bstan pa byung / de nas gzhon nu lang tsho rgyas nas nyin gcig lhas sbyin gyis bsad pa'i glang chen gye ro sras gzhon nu don grub kyis zhabs kyi mthe thong gi rtse la blangs nas phyi rol rgyang grags gcig tu 'phangs pa'i sa phyogs de gshongs chen po zhig tu gyur/ de nas shākya rnams dang skye bo phal mo che 'dus nas yi ge 'gran pas/sras gzhon nu don grub kyis tshangs pa'i yi ge sogs yig rigs mi 'dra ba drug cu rtsa bzhi bstan/ rtsis 'gran pas sras gzhon nus 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rdul phran ji snyed kyang dbugs thengs gcig rang la brtsis/ stobs 'gran pas gzhon nu thams cad sku la dus gcig rub kyang phyag reg pa tsam gyis thams cad sa la 'gyel bar gyur/ gzhan gyis bdung ba tsam yang mi nus pa'i mes kyi gnam ru zhes bya ba'i gzhu de bdungs nas mda' 'phangs pas/ lcags kyi sla nga lnga/ shing ta la'i sdong 25

po bdun/ lcags kyi phag pa'i gzugs rnams dus gcig la phug nas mda' sa 'og tu thim pa'i shul nas mda' chu khron pa zhes bya ba'i chu byung / de bzhin du sgyu rtsal drug cu rtsa bzhi 'gran pas/ gzhan kun las sras gzhon nu don grub rab dang phul dang mchog tu gyur pas lha mi thams cad ngo mtshar bar gyur to/ /de nas dgung lo nyi shu nas nyer dgu'i bar du/ sa 'tsho ma dang grags 'dzin ma sogs btsun mo'i 'khor gyis bskor nas rgyal srid chos bzhin bskyangs/ de nas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis rab tu byung bar bskul zhing / skyed mos tshal du zhugs pa na/ mi rgas pa dang / na ba dang / shi ba'i ro rnams mthong nas thugs skyo/ dge slong zhig mthong bas thugs spro/ de dag gi rkyen gyes sa pho byi ba'i lo la/ rgyal po'i khab nas byung ste/mchod rten rnam dag drung du byon nas dbu skra bsil nas nam mkha' la gtor ba lha rnams kyis mchod pa'i rten du khyer/ ka shi'i gos byen nas lha zhig gi lag nas ngur sprig gi gos blangs nas rab byung mdzad/ chu bo nairañdzana'i 'gram du mkha' khyab kyi ting nge 'dzin la zhugs nas lo drug gi bar du dka' ba spyad pa'i mthar/ dga' mo dang dga' stobs ma gnyis kyis ba stong 26

gi 'o ma lan bcu drug gi bar du nying khur byas pa'i 'o thug sbrang rtsi dang sbyar ba drangs pas/ sku lus gser btso ma'i mdog lta bur gyur/ de nas rdo rje gdan gyi byang chub shing drung du gshegs nas rtswa 'tshong khye'u bkra shis kyis phul ba'i rtswa'i gdan la bzhugs te/ dgung lo so lnga shing pho rta'i lo sa ga zla ba'i tshes bco lnga'i nam srod la bdud kyi sde'i dmag dpung byung tshe/byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin la zhugs pas bdud kyis mtshon cha 'phangs pa rnams me tog tu gyur/ bdud kyi bu mo rnams byung nas gzugs mdzes pa bstan nas bslu khrid byas kyang bslu ma nus par bdud kyi dpung rnams thams cad btul/ de nas nam gyi gung la mnyam par bzhag tho rangs skya rengs shar ba dang dus mnyam du rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin mngon du byas nas mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i mdzad pa rmad du byung ba bstan/ de nas thun mong gdul bya'i snang ngor/ zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas/ /bdud rtsi lta bu'i chos shig kho bos rnyed/ /su la bstan kyang go bar mi nus pas/ /mi smra nags kyi tshal du gnas par bya/ /zhes zhag bzhi bcu zhe dgu'i bar du chos mi gsung ba'i tshul mdzad pa na/ tshangs pas gser gye 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa phul te gsol ba btab 27

kyang chos kyi 'khor lo ma bskor bas/ brgya byin rogs su sbran pa na des kyang gser gyi maṇḍal dpag tshad lnga bcu pa dang / dung dkar g.yas su 'khyil ba rnams phyag tu phul te gsol ba btab pa la brten nas/ sku yi 'od kyis rab 'byams zhing kun 'gengs bzhin du yul wā rā ṇa sī'i drang srong lhung ba ri dwags kyi gnas su chu stod zla ba'i tshes bzhi yi nyin/ 'khor lnga sde bzang po la/ dang po bden bzhi'i chos 'khor bskor/ rim gyis dgung lo nga brgyad par bya rgod phung po'i rir 'khor rnam bzhi byang chub sems dpa'i 'dus pa dang bcas bsam gyis mi khyab par yum sras bcu bdun la sogs bar ba mtshan nyid med pa'i chos 'khor bskor zhing / ma la ya dang yangs pa can sogs gnas tha dad pa du mar/ byang chub sems dpa' don dam yang dag 'phags la sogs par/ tha ma legs par rnam par phye ba'i chos 'khor bskor bar gsungs/ gzhan yang ngo mtshar sku yi bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab par ston bzhin du/ gdul bya mchog dman bar ba rang rang so so'i blo kha dang 'tshams pa'i zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas/ 'gro ba grangs med pa mngon mtho lha mi'i go 'phang / nges legs thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang la bkod pa'i mthar/28

gdul bya rtag 'dzin can rnams chos la bskul phyir/ dgung lo brgyad cu gya gcig pa lcags 'brug dpyid tha'i tshes pa bco lnga'i nang bar gyad kyi yul/ rtswa mchog grong gi sa gzhi gtsang ma ru/ seng ge'i nyal stangs kyis byang phyogs bod la bstan pa dar ba'i rten 'brel du dbu byang du bstan nas bzhugs tshe/ rgya gar gye rtsi shing nags tshal ri dang bcas pa mgo byang phyogs su gugaganam sa bar snang thams cad 'ja' 'od kyis gang zhing nam mkha' nas sprin kha dog lnga ldan byung ba'i gseb na lha'i bu dang bu mo mang po'i lus kyi phyed tsam thon nas/ gdugs rgyal mtshan ba dan du ma bsgrengs/ bkra shis pa'i me tog dang bdud rtsi la sogs 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs shing / bstod dbyangs dang rol mo'i sgra sgrogs pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang cho 'phrul dpag tu med pa dang bcas te/ gzugs sku mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan to/ /de bzhin du 'o skol ston pa'i rjes 'jug rnams kyis kyang bsod nams ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pas tha mar mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas sprul pa bye ba phrag brgya 'gyed/ mdzad pa bcu gnyis la sogs pa bstan nas 'gro ba'i don mdzad cing / gzhan yang nam mkha' la 'phur ba dang /ri brag la 'dzul ba dang / lus las me 'bar ba dang chu 'khrug 29

pa dang / 'dod dgur bsgyur pa/ lus lha'i dkyil 'khor du sprul nas skye bo gzhan la ston pa sogs dzu 'phrul ya ma zung sna tshogs pa ston bzhin du/ zab mo stong pa nyid dang / rgya chen spyod pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas/ ma dad log lta the tshom can gyi snang ba yang dam pa'i chos la bsgyur nas/ mthong thos dran reg bzang ngan 'brel thogs thams cad mngon mtho lha mi'i go 'phang nges legs thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang la bkod nas 'brel tshad thams cad don dang ldan par byed nus par 'gyur ro/ /smras pa/ ston pa thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag gzhan rjes 'jug yongs la thugs rjes gzigs/ /mgon po khyed kyi rnam thar zin pa dang / /gsung bzhin lha chos nus par byin gyes rlobs/ /rnam 'dren bzhi pa ston pa thugs rje can/ /bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol tu/ /sangs rgyas tshar kyang gdul bya'i snang ngo ru/ /tha mal so skye zhig gi tshul 'dzin pa/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas 'phags pa 'jam dpal sogs/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang pos legs par bskul/ /sems can rnams kyi sdug bsngal tshul mthong nas/ /byams dang snying rje gzhan don don gnyer skyes/ /sangs rgyas byang sems 30

rnams kyi mthu stobs mthong / /'gro don byed la de 'dra 'thob dgos dgongs/ /bcom ldan thub pa chen po la sogs pa'i/ /sangs rgyas byang sems dpag tu med pa yi/ /drung du byon nas mnyes pas mchod sprin phul/ /dang po byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed nas/ /bar du bskal chen grangs med dang po la/ /de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub chen nas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yul 'khor skyong gi bar/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bdun khri lnga stong la/ /rtag tu bsnyen bkur mchod pas mnyes par mdzad/ /de nas bskal chen grangs med gnyis pa la/ /de bzhin gshegs pa legs mdzad nas bzung ste/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dbang po'i rgyal mtshan bar/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bdun khri drug stong la/ /rtag tu bsnyen bkur mchod pas mnyes par mdzad/ /de nas bskal chen grangs med gsum pa la/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mar me nadzad nas bzung / /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od srungs gnyis kyi bar/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bdun khri bdun stong la/ /rtag tu bsnyen bkur mchod pas mnyes par mdzad/ /gzhan yang sangs rgyas dpag med mchod pa dang / /sems can yongs la phan yang tshad med btags/ /tha ma mi rnams tshe lo brgya pa'i dus/ /zas gtsang sras po gzhon nu don grub tu/ /gyur 31

tshe rgyal srid spangs nas rab tu byung / /nee rañdza na'i 'gram du dka' ba spyad/ /rdo rje gdan gyi byang chub shing drung du/ /srod la bdud btul gung la mnyam par bzhag /tho rangs mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas/ /lha mi yongs la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /da lta 'o skol gtan gyi skyabs su gyur/ /ston pa thugs rje can gyi rnam thar bzhin/ /'o skol ston pa'i rjes 'jug rnams kyis kyang / /mar gyur 'gro la byams dang snying rje bsgoms/ /bdag pas gzhan gces byang chub sems bskyed nas/ /deng nas bzung ste bskal chen grangs med par/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs/ /sangs rgyas byang sems mang po bsnyen bkur mchod/ /lus dang longs spyod thams cad phangs med du/ /mar gyur 'gro ba yongs la gtong bar bya/ /de ltar ston pa thugs rje chen po yi/ /ngo mtshar rmad byung skyes rabs rnam thar bzhin/ /theg pa chen po'i chos la slob pa'i tshul/ /go sla'i ngag gis legs par bshad zin nas/ /da ni ston pa'i gsung la yid ches phyir/ /ston pa mkhyen brtse yon tan mnga' tshul dang / /phyi mar phan pa'i lha chos don gnyer phyir/ /shi nas phyi mar 'gro tshul bshad kyis nyon//de yang ston pa thugs rje can gyi zhal gyi bum bzang las 32

thon pa'i dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi 'jung ba la/ thog mar gsung la yid ches kyi dad pa skye ba dang 'jig rten phyi ma don gnyer gyi blo skye ba'i phyir 'dir ston pa sangs rgyas la mkhyen brtse'i yon tan mnga' tshul dang / las bzang ngan gnyis kyi dbang gis phyi mar yar mar la 'gro tshul bshad par bya ste/ de yang sngon mgon med zas sbyin gyi bu mo ma ga dha bzang mo zhes bya ba/ yul lho phyogs kyi khyim bdag bya mkhan zhes bya ba phyi rol pa zhig gi khyem du bag mar song nas/ bsod nams kyi zhing sa med pa la sems ma dga' bar gdong gnag pas/ khyem bdag gis khyod ci la ma dga' byas pas/ khyed la zhing mi gda' smra bas/ kho na re/ zhing yod nyin lam re yod pa'i zhing chen po yang yod byas pas/ des ci bya/ zhing de ma yin/ sbyin pa'i zhing mi gda' smra bas/ de yang yod/ drang srong 'di rnyed do/ /byas pas/phug ron gyi spu btogs nas btang ba 'dra ba de tshos ci yong smras pas/'o na ci 'dra dgos zer/ mo na re/ ston pa sangs rgyas 'dra ba dgos so smras pas/ der thams cad kyis 'o na spyan 'dren byas pas/ mo dga' nas/ 'o na 'tsho ba sbyor dang kho mos spyan 'dren zhes khang thog tu song / lag par spos thogs nas/rab tu gus pas/ tshul khrims rnam dag shes rab shin tu zab/ /33

dad ldan snying po nyan thos che rnams kyis/ /mgon med gyur pa bdag la rjes bzung zhing / /don mdzad thugs rjes gshegs par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes spyan 'dren byas tshe/ yul de dang sangs rgyas bzhugs gnas gnyis kyi bar la nyin lam mang po yod kyang / sangs rgyas kyis mkhyen nas/ 'khor rnams la gsungs/ 'khor rdzu 'phrul can kha cig ni glang po che sa srung gi bu la zhon/ kha cig sprin gye shugs la/ kha cig ri bo spos ngad ldan la/ kha cig ri bo ma la ya/ kha cig ni gang 'dus pa la sogs zhon pa du ma dang bcas te/ nam mkha'i mthongs su 'phags nas rim bzhin yul lho phyogs su byon pas/ rgyang nas mthong tshe thams cad dad cing dpa' zhum nas/ bu mo la 'di khyod kyi ston pa yin nam zhes/ re re nas dris pas/ mo na re/'di ni bdag gi ston pa'i sras shes rab can gyi mchog gyur shā ri'i bu zhes bya ba yin no zhes re re nas bsnyad do/ /de nas rjes su ston pa nyid kyi 'og nas 'dod pa'i lha/ steng nas gzugs kyi lha/ g.yas g.yon nas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs/ sku'i g.yon zur na lha dang mi bsam gyis mi khyab pas mchod pa'i bye brag du mas mchod pa'i dbus na/ sku gser gyi mchod sdong 'bar ba ltar lhang nge lham me/ lhan ner byon pa'i tshe/ gyos sgyug 34

la sogs pa na re/'di khyod kyi ston pa yin nam dris pas/ bu mo na re/ 'di bdag gi ston pa lags so/ /zhes smras pas/ skye bo mang po dad cing btud/ de rnams la ston pas chos bstan pas/dkon mchog gsum la dad cing 'dun par gyur to/ /yang sngon gcer bu pa nye thung gis/ khyem bdag dpal sbas la/ khyod kyi phyi sgor dong chen po rkos la/ du ba med pa'i me 'bar bas khong steng du phyag dar srab mo khobs/ nang nas zas dug can sbyor la/ sangs rgyas 'khor bcas bos dang / thams cad mkhyen pa yin min gsal bar 'gyur ro byas pas/ de ltar byas/ sangs rgyas spyan drangs pas mkhyen bzhin du phebs so /phyi sgo'i them pa la zhabs bzhag pa na/ sems can mig long ba rnams kyi mig gis mthong / 'on pa rnams kyis sgra thos/ smyon pa rnams kyis dran pa rnyed pa sogs byung / de nas byon te me'i khar zhabs bzhag pa na/ me rang zhi ste padma'i tshal du gyur/ de'i steng du sangs rgyas 'khor bcas byon pas/ skye bo thams cad ngo mtshar te ca co'i sgra byung ngo / /khyem bdag dpal sbas dang nye thung gnyis kyis mthong nas bshag pa byas so/ /khyem du byon pas khyim bdag na re/ bdag gis mi dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi ngag la nyan nas zas kyang 'dren tshul med/ gzhan gcig sbyor zhus 35

pas/ sangs rgyas kyis khyim bdag la/'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum/ /de dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste/ /bcom ldan sangs rgyas dug mi mnga'/ /sangs rgyas bden pas dug bcom mo/ /de bzhin du chos dang dge 'dun la yang sbyor la tshig 'di rnams bzlas la drongs dang skyon mi yong gsungs pas/ khyem bdag gis kyang tshigs bcad de gsum bton nas drangs pas sangs rgyas 'khor bcas kyis gsol bas/ rma byas btsan dug zos pa bzhin du sgu la ma gnod pa tsam du ma zad/ sngar bas sku'i gzi mdangs cher 'bar bar gyur to/ /khyem bdag de yang rab tu dad de chos zhus pas/ stan bde ba de la 'dug bzhin du/ chos kyi mig rdul med cing dri ma dang bral bar skyes so/ /sngon khyem bdag dpal skyes la thar pa'i sa bon yod pa dgra bcom pa sus kyang ma mkhyen par rab tu ma phyung ba la/ sangs rgyas kyis khyem bdag dpal skyes kyi sgye ba bdun gyi gong rol tu khye zhig tu skyes pa/ phag rgod kyis bdas nas mchod rten zhig la skor ba byas pa'i dge ba'i sa bon yod pa mkhyen nas rab tu phyung / khyim bdag dpal skyes lo brgya yin rung brtson 'grus byas pas dgra bcom pa'i go 'phang thob nas nam mkha' la 'phur ba byung / sngon rgyal po 'phags skyes po dang / blon po ma 36

la gnod gnyis kyis nyes pa med bzhin du shākya lnga brgya bsad pa'i tshe/ ston pa'i dbu yang smyung bar gyur/ de'i rgyu gang lags zhus pas/ sngon nya pa lnga brgyas nya chen po gnyis kyi steng nas gson por sha bcad pa'i tshe/ nya gnyis kyis 'o dod bos pas/nya pa'i khye'u zhig gis go nas dga' bar gyur to/ /de'i dus kyi nya gnyis ni da lta'i rgyal blon gnyis yin/ nya pa lnga brgya ni shākya lnga brgya/ rṣa de nga yin pas/ da lta nga'i dbu smyung bar gyur gsungs/ sngon mo'u 'gal gye bu la nyes pa med bzhin du mu stegs kun tu rgyu rnams kyis bzung nas rkang lag 'dam bu'i tshal ltar bcom mo/ /de'i rgyu gang yin zhus pas/ sngon bram ze bza' mi gnyis kyi bu pha ma la khros nas/ 'di gnyis kyi rkang lag 'dam bu bzhin bcom na 'gal ba med ces tshig ngan smras pas/ tshe rabs lnga brgya ru rkang lag bcom nas shi/ da lta yang las kyi lhag mas de ltar bcom gsungs/ sngon ston pas lha klu mkha' lding sogs 'gro ba yongs la chos gsungs pa'i skabs shig la zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas/ rgya gar shar phyogs kyi rgyal po gcig gi sras mo dang / nub phyogs kyi rigs ngan rngon pa gcig gi bu dang gnyis bza' mir gyur par gda' zhes ma 'ongs lung bstan gsungs so/ /de nas nyin gcig mkha' lding shar 37

phyogs su song tshe/ rgyal po'i sras mo gcig nags su song nas shing gi rtse mo na dug sbrul yod pa ma mthong bar shing 'bras yod pa mthong nas shing khar 'dzeg sa nas 'bras bu blangs so/ /mkha' lding gis steng nas bltas pas bu mo yod pa ma mthong bar/ shing sdong chen po de'i rtse mo na dug sbrul yod pa mthong nas/ shing dang bcas khyer 'ongs pas bu mo zhig kyang byung ba snying rje nas gsos so/ /yang nyin gcig mkha' lding nub phyogs su song tshe rngon pa'i bu gcig gis ri dwags chen po zhig bsad nas khog pa kha phye yod pa'i steng du song tshe rngon pa 'jigs nas sha'i khog par zhugs so/ /de khyung chen gyes blangs nas tshang du khyer 'ongs pas nang nas mi zhig kyang thon pa gsos so/ /de gnyis ka bza' mir gyur nas bu zhig kyang byung ngo / /de nas mkha' lding de sangs rgyas kyi drung du song chos nyan pa'i skabs shig la/ sngar gsungs pa'i mi de gnyis da 'phrad 'dug gam zhus pas/ 'phrad pa tsam du ma zad bu yang byung 'dug gsungs/de yul gang na gda' zhus pas/ khyed rang gi rtsa na gda' gsungs pas/ mkha' lding gis ngo shes nas/ dad par gyur skad/yang sngon sangs rgyas kyis ma 'ongs pa na/ shan pa me ri tses seng ge'i phru gu gsod pa/ bya rgod kyi tshang du 'gro ba/ rgyal po'i 38

bu mo len pa mkhyen nas/ shan pa'i rtsar byon nas/ khyod kyis sdom pa longs gsungs pas/ ngas bsrung mi nus zer/ nus pa zhig gnang gsungs pas/ 'o na sngon du gsungs dang nus sam mi nus blta zer/ sangs rgyas kyi zhal nas/ seng ge'i phru gu mi gsod pa/ bya rgod kyi tshang du mi 'gro ba/ rgyal po'i bu mo bag mar mi len pa gsum gyi sdom pa longs la bsrung byas pas/ shan pa'i bsam pa la de 'dra tshe 'dir byed 'dod kyang 'ong ba dka'/ de bsrung nus snyam/ de ltar bya zhes khas blangs so/ /phyis yul de'i rgyal po'i spyan snyung bas/ rgya mtsho'i mtha' ru sman len du 'gro dgos pa byung / de la gzhan su 'gro ma nus par shan pa btang nas/ lam nas ltogs te seng ge'i phru gu nyal yod pa mthong nas gsod snyam/ lag tu blangs nas sdom pa dran nas ma bsad par bzung yod tshe/ seng ge ma byung tshe/ 'jigs nas bros te brag khung zhig bsnyegs pas bya rgod kyi tshang yin tshe/ sngar gyi sdom pa dran/ nang du ma song bar bsdad tshe/ seng ge ma byung ba'i sngon du phru gu btang bas/ seng ge ma de dga' nas sman blangs nas byin pa khyer 'ongs nas rgyal po la phul bas mnyes te/ bu mo byin pas/ yang sngar gyi sdom pa dran nas ma blangs tshe/rgyal pos de ci yin dris pas/ sngar gyi rgyu mtshan zhus pas rgyal 39

po yang dgyes nas/ gzhan nor sna mang po byin nas mgu bar byas skad/ de bzhin du sangs rgyas kyis 'das ma 'ongs da lta dus gsum po sa ler mkhyen/sngon sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na bzhugs dus/ sangs rgyas 'khor bcas la cham rims drag po byung tshe/sman pa'i rgyal po 'tsho byed bos nas/ sman mar drug cu rtsa bzhi pa sbyar nas/ sman pas kun dga' bo la gdams pa/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje'i sku sra brtan mi chod pa yin pas sman mar srang bcu gnyis drongs/ dge slong gzhan rnams la/ srang re las mang ba ma 'dren cig smras pas/ kun dga' bos kyang de bzhin byas pas/ lhas sbyin na re/ nga la'ang srang bcu gnyis drongs/go'u ta ma dang nga gnyis la rigs la sogs pa mi mnyam pa ci yod byas pas/ kun dga' bos kyang / 'o na yong zhes srang bcu gnyis byin pa zos pas sman ma zhu bar shi la thug pa'i tshe/ kun dga' bos 'tsho byed la bcos thabs 'dra yod dam zhus pas/sman ma zhu ba dug tu song ba la bcos thabs med zer/ de nas sangs rgyas la zhus pas/ thabs yod kyis gsungs/ lhas sbyin gyi mgo la phyag bzhag nas/ nga la lus las skyes pa'i bu sgra gcan 'dzin dang / dgra bzhin sems pa'i lhas sbyin gnyis la khyad 40

med snyam pa'i sems yod na/ bden pa'i tshig des tshe dang ldan pa lhas sbyin gyi nad 'di zhi bar gyur cig ces brjod pas/lhas sbyin nad dang bral tshe kho na re/ dge sbyong go'u ta ma 'dis sman zhig kyang shes tshod na 'dug ste/ rgas khar ltogs grir ma shi na 'ong ngo zer nas/ bden pa'i tshig khyad du gsod cing smod pa dang bcas te rang gnas su log song ngo / /de bzhin du ston pa thugs rje can 'di la dgra gnyen la khyad med pas/ g.yas nas mi gcig gis tsan dan gye lde gu 'jam pos sku la byug pa dang /g.yon nas sta re rnon pos gshags pa gnyis byung yang nye ring chags sdang mi 'byung bar gnyis ka la khyad par spu tsam yang med par/ mas bu gcig la brtse ba ltar rtag tu brtse ba rgyun mi 'chad du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /mdor na ston pa sangs rgyas la mkhyen pa dang brtse ba'i yon tan de lta bu mnga' bas/ gang gsungs la nor 'khrul dang rdzun gyi bsres slad 'ong ba'i rgyu rkyen gang yang med pas/ des na 'o skol rnams kyis ston pa sangs rgyas kyis sdig pa spongs dge ba sgrubs zhes gang gsungs pa rnams la yid ches kyi dad pa bskyed cing tshad mar bzung nas bka' bzhin sgrub pa gal che/ sngon yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas skye 'chi la rang dbang thob pa 'chi med rdo rje'i 41

sku brnyes pa'i rgyal ba shākya thub pa zhes mtshan snyan nyi ma dang zla ba ltar yongs la grags pa de nyid 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir lan cig byon nas 'gro ba yongs la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i mthar gdul bya rtag 'dzin can rnams chos la bskul phyir rtswa mchog grong gi sa gzhi gtsang ma ru byon nas/ gzhogs g.yas phab/ dbu byang du bstan seng ge'i nyal stabs kyis mya ngan las 'da' bar dgongs tshe/ 'jig rten khams kyi rtsi shing nags tshal thams cad kyi mgo yang de'i phyogs su btud cing gzhol/sa 'di yang rnam pa drug tu g.yo ba sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang cho 'phrul dpag tu med pa dang bcas te sgu gshegs pa'i tshe/ skye 'chi la rang dbang thob pa'i dge slong khri brgyad stong yang mya ngan las 'das so/ /des na mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i rdo rje'i sku de lta bu yang mi rtag par 'jig pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan song na/ chu shing snying po lta bu'i 'o skol mi rnams kyi sgyu lus 'jig pa smos ci dgos/sngon sangs rgyas kyi 'khor dgra bcom dzu 'phrul can kun gye mchog gyur 'phags pa mo'u 'gal gyi bu yang / mthar grong khyer shing thog can du byon nas sku gshegs dus/ skye 'chi gnyis la rang dbang thob pa'i dgra bcom pa bdun khri bdun stong mya 42

ngan las 'das so/ /sangs rgyas kyi 'khor shes rab can kun gyi mchog tu gyur pa 'phags pa shā ri'i bu yang / rgyal po'i khab ga la ba der byon nas sku gshegs dus skye 'chi la dbang thob pa'i dgra bcom pa brgyad khri mya ngan las 'das so/ /'phags pa ba glang bdag sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha gnas na bzhugs pas/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mya ngan las 'das pa gsan nas/thugs las me byung nas bsregs te mya ngan las 'das tshe me'i nang nas tshigs su bcad pa gnyis byung ste/ 'dus byas bsags pa skad cig 'jig 'gyur te/ /srog dang bcas pa'i dpal ni g.yo bar 'gyur/ /mkhas rnams rtag tu dge la bag yod cing / /bsod nams las kyi bya ba de brtson bya/ /zhes pa dang / thub pa de la sgo gsum dang bas btud//rang gi dgos pa gang yin thams cad byas/ /gus shing rab tu dad pas bla ma de'i/ /phyi bzhin ba glang bdag kyang de ltar song / /zhes bya ba'i sgra byung ngo / /de bzhin du drang srong chen po mngon shes lnga thob cing mkha' la rgyang ring 'gro ba rnams kyis kyang mi 'chi ba'i gnas dang thabs ma rnyed par gshegs/ sngon rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi rgyan drug mchog gnyis grub chen brgyad cu dang /gangs can ljongs kyi mkhan slob chos gsum/ rje 'bangs nyer 43

lnga/ mar mi dwags gsum/ khu rngog 'brom gsum/ rje bdag nyid chen po yab sras sogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen sangs rgyas gnyis pa lta bu de thams cad gshegs/ de bzhin du lha'i nang gi tshangs pa brgya byin mi'i nang gi 'khor los sgyur rgyal/ rgyal blon byang chub sems dpa'/ mi skya btsan btsun/ nyi ma dang zla ba rgyu skar 'dra ba thams cad sdod dbang ma byung bar gshegs pa de lags/ de bzhin du da lta sa thog 'di na gnas tshad sgyes nas 'gro ba thams cad 'chi ba ma gtogs/ 'di rnams kyi nang na mi 'chi bar sdod mkhan gyi mi gcig kyang med/ 'chi ba tsam du ma zad nam 'chi la nges pa med de/ sngon mi gcig gis nas rdza ma gang yod pa sbas nas phyir 'ong tsa na za snyam nas sprang du phyin pas lam du shi ba byung nas sngar gyi de yang za long ma byung / de bzhin du sngar 'chi bdag bdud pos las kyi 'phro yang 'thud du ma bcug par glo bur du bsad nas tshe phyi mar khrid pa mang /sngon 'brom lo rdeng gi gtso bo klu bstan bya ba 'chi khar kho na re/spyir 'brom lo rdeng gi che thabs kyis nga la ci phan/ de'i nang nas kyang bstod ra ba'i che thabs kyis nga la ci phan zer shi skad/sngon 'phags pa nye dga' zhes bya bar gser mang du yod kyang shi nas gser srang bdun khri tsam byung ba dge slong rnams 44

'dus bgos te khyer/ de bzhin du 'chi tshe 'khor nor longs spyod ci tsam yod kyang phan pa spu tsam med pas/ des na 'o skol rnams kyang nges par 'chi zhing nam 'chi cha med 'chi tshe chos ma gtogs gzhan gang gis mi phan pa'i tshul bsams nas chos byed pa gal che/ sngon mo'u 'gal gyi bu'i pha 'jig rten 'dir sdod dus lag pa mdo sde dang mi 'bral/ dkon mchog la mchod pa/ dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur/ pha ma la zhabs tog ngan slong la sbyin pa gtong ba sogs/ dge ba'i las la 'bad pas/ shi nas lha tshangs pa'i gnas su skyes nas bde skyid tshad med pa myangs so/ /ma de 'jig rten 'dir sdod dus/ pha ma la tshig ngan/dge 'dun la gshe skur/ dkon mchog la dad log ngan slong la 'phrog bcom/ khyem mtshes la 'khon 'dzing / g.yog po la sdang ba sogs sdig pa mi dge ba'i las sna tshogs pa byas pas/shi nas dmyal bar skyes nas sdug bsngal tshad med pa myangs so/ /bu ston pa'i drung nas rab tu byung / chos byas pas dgra bcom pa'i go 'phang thob nas/ sangs rgyas kyi 'khor dzu 'phrul can kun gyi mchog tu gyur nas/ dzu 'phrul gyis dmyal ba'i yul du ma len du byon tshe/ sdig can gyi mi gcig 'dre dmag mang pos bzung nas ske la thag pa nag po brgyab nas khrid/ mtshon cha 45

rnon po mang po thogs nas/ rgyob cig gtubs shig sod cig sogs mi snyan pa 'jigs pa'i sgra mang po sgogs shing 'gro ba mthong nas/ mi 'dis sdig pa ci byas dris pas/ 'dre dmag rnams na re/ mi 'di'i ming la gcan gzan wa zer/ 'di 'jig rten khams na sdod dus/ 'khor g.yog mang pos bskor zhing lug tshon po mang po bsad nas khyim sha yis 'gengs/ chang zhim po nyin mtshan med par 'thungs nas/ dge ba til 'bru tsam yang mi byed/ sdig pa'i las rnam pa sna tshogs pa byed de/des kyang khyi mang po btang nas ri dwags mang po bsad/ khra yang lnga tsam gsos pa btang nas byi'u mang po rtswa phung gi nang du 'bebs su bcug tshe rtswa la me bcug nas bsad/ mi ngan mang po bsdus thams cad song nas btsan po la brkus/ snyom chung la 'phrog bcom nas ma byin pa mang po blangs/ rta mang po gsos nas 'gran rogs med rung rta rgyug byed pa'i mi ya bo bsod zad cig yin/ mkhan po/ da 'di ltar 'khrid dus dam pa'i lha chos ma gtogs/ gzhan bu chung ma gnyen nye 'brel nor longs spyod mang po yod kyang rjes na ra mda' rgyug mkhan dang phan mkhan gcig kyang mi 'dug gzigs dang zer/ ded nas song ngo / /de nas mar phyin pas/ lcang ma'i sdong po zhig gi ltag na/46

mi gzhon nu pho mo nyi shu tsam zhig dal bar 'dug pa la 'dir ci la bsdad dris pas/ de dag rnams na re/'o skol mi yul na mi ming rus gcig pa mang po yod pa gshin rje pho nya rnams kyis ngo ma shes bdag cag khyer nas/ ming rus bsdur nas min tshe yar btang ste/ de'i bar la ro dbyar rul dgun 'khyags pas 'dug sa ma rnyed par 'dir cung zad bshed pa lags/ khyed yar phebs na nged tsho'i nye 'brel rnams la/ bdag cag gi don du dmigs nas mchod sbyin chos sgogs pa sogs dge ba re gyis dang phan thogs che'o zer ro/ /de nas mar phyin pas/ sdig can gyi mi mang po'i gos phud nas/ shing gi yal ga la bkal nas/ gcer bur 'dug pas chu chen po zhig la brgal zhing 'dug pas/ khyed rnams kyi gseb na mo'u 'gal gyi ma zer ba yod dam dris pas/ ci yang mi smra bar chu la brgal zhing 'dugade'i tshe gshin rje'i ming yig pa byung nas/ sdig can de dag grangs su rtsis/ ming yig bris nas khyer song / sdig can de dag na re/ sdig pa'i rnam smin gyes ngan song du skye zhing / dge ba'i 'bras bus mtho ris su 'gro ba'i cha yod na/ sngon bsod nams ci'i phyir mi bsog 'o skol gyi yul na bu chung ma gnyen nye 'brel zas nor longs spyod ci tsam yod kyang / mi gzhan gye longs spyod/47

'o skol rnams 'di na sdug bsngal lo zer zhing mchi ma sha ra ra 'dzag pa mthong / de nas mar phyin pas/ sdig can grangs med pa 'gro ba la/ khyed rnams kyi gseb na mo'u 'gal gyi ma zer ba'i rgan mo 'dra med dam dris pas/ de rnams kyis de 'dra ma mchis/ mkhan po slar gshegs na bdag cag gi nye 'brel rnams la/ nged rnams la dmigs nas bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen la bsngo 'brel zhog dge 'dun la 'tsho ba zhabs tog gyes la theg pa chen po'i chos sgogs shig dang phan thogs che bar 'dug gyis zer/ de nas mar phyin pas/ gshin rje chos rgyal gyi sgo drung du slebs pas/ gshin rje'i pho nya rkang pa rang yang khru bcu dgu yod pa zhig gis sgo bsrungs shing 'dug pa la/sgo 'di bsrungs nas yun ci tsam lon dris pas/ de na re/bskal pa bzhi bcu tham pa lon zer/ bskal pa'i yun ci tsam la zer dris pas/ sgo sngon 'di ru pha bong shin tu mkhregs pa dpangs su dpag tshad stong phrag bzhi bcu tham pa yod pa zhig gi steng na pha rol sdig can gyi mi rnams lo re jengs re phyin pas rdo de brdol ba la bskal pa gcig lags/ mkhan po ci la phebs zer/ma la sri zhu byed pa'i phyir 'ongs byas pas gtam de la sgo srung yang dga' mgu yi rangs te zhu sna byas/ gshin rje 48

chos kyi rgyal po'i drung du phyin pas/ gshin rje chos rgyal gyis kyang bzhengs nas bsu ba byas/ gsung gleng mdzad pas/ chos kyi rgyal pos mkhan po ci'i phyir phebs dris pas/ ma la sri zhu byed du 'ongs sdig can rnams khyed dang ma mjal bar gzhan du 'gro ba'i go skabs med pa bdag gis thos pas/ bdag gi ma mo'u 'gal bya ba'i bud med de gang na 'dug zhus pas/ gshin rje chos rgyal gyis yig mkhan rnams la ming yig tshol gsungs/yig mdzod bslogs pas mi 'dug zer/ chos rgyal gyes/ 'dir mi 'ong ba gnyis yod/ dge ba mang po byas sdig pa med pa'i mi shi ba dang mnyam du mtho ris su song nas 'dir mi 'ong yang sdig pa mang po byas dge ba med pa'i mi shi ma thag dmyal bar song nas 'dir mi 'ong ste/ 'on kyang da dung tshol gsungs/btsal bas rnyed de/ yi ge'i nang na mo'u 'gal bya ba'i bud med cig mnar med dmyal ba'i gnas su skyes nas/ lo gsum tsam lon zer byung bas/ mo'u 'gal gyi bu ma'i rtsa la phyin/ ma dmyal ba nas bton te/ rim gyis yar gyi lha tshangs pa'i gnas su bskyal nas pha dang skal ba mnyam pa byas so/ /de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis kun dga' bo la/ mo'u 'gal gye bu 'di lta bu'i pha ma la sri zhu byed pa 'jig rten gyi khams gang na yang med 49

gsungs/yang sngon rgyal ba'i blo gros zhes bya ba gshin rje gshed kyi sgo nas grub pa brnyes pa gcig yod/ ma de sgo na thags 'thag pa thags kyi steng nas sa la 'bab dbang yang ma byung bar shi nas gshin rje'i pho nya zhig gis khrid nas/ gshin rje chos rgyal gyi drung du khyer/ dge sdig gi shan phye bas/ sdig pa che ba byung / khang pa nag po zhig gi nang du khrid nas/ khye chen po gnyis nyal ba'i bar la bzhag pas/ rgan mo g.yas su cung zad yo/ g.yas na yod pa'i khye des mgo btegs te mche ba bsnyer nas za grabs byas/ g.yon du yo ba byung na/ g.yon na yod pa'i khye des mgo btegs te mche ba bsnyer nas za grabs byas pa'i bar na 'jigs yer re yod pa'i dus/bu rgyal ba'i blo gros kyi bsam pa la/ gshin rje chos rgyal dbang che ba bden kyang / nged ma smad gnyis la 'chi khar gtam tshig gcig tsam yang gtong du ma bcug tha na thags kyi steng nas 'bab dbang tsam yang ma byung bar khrid nas song ba 'di dpe mi srid pa zhig byung snyam/ ma'i ro rtsa nas/ gshin rje gshed kyi bskyed rim la zhugs nas/ sngon la gshin rje'i yul du gtsang ris kyi dpal mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga'i dmag drangs/ de'i rjes su snang srid kyi lha ma srin sde 50

brgyad kyi dmag drangs/ de'i rjes su gshin ji ya manta ga'i dmag drangs tshe/ gshin rje'i pho nya rnams na re/ gnas 'dir nam yang dmag 'ong mi srid pa/ da lan dmag ri dang brag 'dra ba gnam sa bar snang gang nas byung ba 'di su zhig gi dmag yin ci'i phyir 'ongs pa yin nam zer 'jigs pa'i tshe/ ma khrid pa'i gshin rje de na re/ de rang rgan mo khrid 'ongs pa de la bu 'jigs pa zhig gda'/ de ma yin nam zer ba dang mnyam du thag nyer slebs byung / dmag rnams kyis rgyal ba'i blo gros kyi ma phyir thongs/ mi gtong na gshin rje'i yul khams 'di thams cad brlag pa yin no zhes/ gshin rje'i 'khor rnams la g.yul bkyed nas gshin rje mang po pham tshe/ khye de gnyis kyang shi ba bzhin nyal nas mgo ma btegs tshe/ ma yang khang pa de nas phyir thon bros nas dmag gi nang du song ba dmag rnams kyis khyer nas 'jig rten khams su slebs/ slar ro'i nang du 'dzul nas sngar ltar sos pa byung skad/yang sngon mi rnams kyi tshe lo 'bum thub pa'i dus 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir dbang phyug brgyad thob pa'i rgyal po 'jigs thul zhes bya ba zhig byung ngo / /de'i 'bangs rgan mo zhig la bu gcig yod pa glo bur du shi bas/ ma de rgyal po'i drung 51

du song nas/ ma rgan mo 'chi ran pa de bzhag nga'i bu 'chi ma ran pa de khyer nas/ gshin rje chos rgyal zhes bya ba des da lan khrims med kyi bya ba byas pa 'di rgan mo nga la brnyas pa ma yin/rgyal po khyod la brnyas smod khyad gsod byas pa yin pas/ rgyal po la khyad par ci yod/ khyod kyang mi yi rgyal po yin/ kho yang gshin rje'i rgyal po red/ da lan rgyal po khyed byon nas/ nga'i bu slar ma lon na/ khyed la yang rgyal po'i tha snyad ci yod/ nga yang khyed kyi sgo nas lcebs nas 'chi ba yin no zhes mya ngan dang smre sngags du ma bton pas/ rgyal po'i thugs bsam la yang rgan mos bshad pa de cha gcig na bden par 'dug snyam/ khyod re zhig ma lceb dang / ngas e lon cig blta zer/ dmag bsdu ba'i rnga chen po de brdungs pas dmag kun 'dus pas gang du 'gro ba yin dris pas/ rgyal po na re/ rgan mo'i bu yi don du/ gshin rje'i yul du 'gro dgos byas rdzu 'phrul gyis gshin rje'i yul du dmag lam chen po btod dmag thams cad khrid de gshin rje'i yul du song / dmag rnams bzhag ste rgyal po gcig pu gshin rje chos rgyal gye drung du song / gus pas phyag dang zhe sa mang du byas nas/ khyed kyi pho nya ba zhig gis khrims med kyi lugs byas/ nga'i 'bangs mi rgan mo 'chi ran pa de bzhag nas/ bu 'chi ma ran 52

pa gzhon nu zhig yod pa khrid song 'dug pas/ de phyir log rogs gyis zhus pas/ gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po na re/ bu de la tshe tshad de min med pas khyer byung / sngon las yin pas slar log tu mi yong gsungs/ lan gsum zhus pas kyang de skad gsungs tshe/ de yin na nga yang mi yi rgyal po yin pas don de ma grub par mi yul du log na ngo yang tsha/ da nga yang 'chi ba yin byas slar song / rang gi dmag rnams la gshin rje chos rgyal gyi 'khor rnams la g.yul 'gyed du bcug rgyal pos lha tshangs pas byin pa'i bde chen zho 'thung gi rus pa las grub pa'i mdung phog tshad sgol nus pa zhig yod pa khyer nas gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po'i steng du yar mchongs tshe/ srid pa gsum po 'di yom yom yar 'gul ba byung / gshin rje chos rgyal yang thugs khros yar bzhengs/ phog tshad 'chi ba'i thod dbyug cig yod pa bsnams nas khri thog nas mar mchongs tshe/ srid pa gsum po 'di mar yom yom 'gul ba byung tshe/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis/ gang gi ltas yin nam gzigs pas/ rgyal po 'jigs thul dang gshin rje chos rgyal gnyis 'dzing grabs yod par mthong /skad cig yud tsam la dzu 'phrul gyis bar la byon nas/ yar mar du bzhugs su bcug bar nas gzu byas/ gshin rje chos rgyal la 53

bu thongs byas pas/ sngon las yin pas gtong rgyu med/nga gsod du chug zer/ rgyal po la sngon gyi las la bcos pa'i thabs med pas/ gshin rje chos rgyal la rgol ba ma zhu bar slar log byas pas/ rgyal po na re/ de yin yang nga 'jig rten khams su ldog pa ngo tsha bas 'dir 'chi ba yin zer/ der lha'i dbang pos gzhan bya thabs ma byung bar/ 'o na khyed kyi bu de ji 'dra zhig yod dris pas/ rgyal pos gzugs kyi ri mo bris nas/ 'di 'dra zhig yod byas pas/ brgya byen gyes lha'i bu gzhon nu de 'dra ba zhig sprad nas/ da 'di khyer la 'khrug pa ma rgyag sngar gshin rje chos rgyal la rgol ba zhus par bzod gsol gyis la da slar log byas nas/rgyal pos kyang de bzhin du gshin rje chos rgyal la bzod gsol byas/ lha'i bu khyer nas mi yul du log nas rgan mo la sprad pas dga' bar gyur to/ /yang sngon rgya gar shar phyogs kyi bi khya ta de ba zhes bya bas/chos kyi snying po ma ṇi yi ge drug ma'i bsgom bzlas byas nas lo gsum tsam song ba dang nad cig gis jebs nas grongs pas/gshin rje'i mi shin tu 'jigs pa bzhis khrid nas thag ring por khyer te/ ri zhig gi rtse la slebs pa dang / 'od dkar po zla ba'i 'od las lhag pa zhig nam mkha' nas byung ba'i rjes la/54

thugs rje chen po rta mgrin sogs lha lnga tsam byon/ de mthong tshe gshin rje'i mi rnams bros pa rta mgrin gyis dbyug thos brdungs pas/ thugs rje chen po'i zhal nas/ snying rje/ ma byed gsungs/rta mgrin gyes 'o skol gyi mi la bar chad byed pa mi rigs gsungs/ de nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis/ gshin rje'i mi bzhi po de la da ro ma bsregs pa'i gong la myur du slar skyol cig gsungs/ gshin rje'i mi de bzhis bskyal bas/ nye 'khor rnams kyis ro shing gseb tu bcug nas mtha' nas me sbar ba'i tshe slar sos nas steng du thon pa byung / de nas bzung ste paṇḍi ta grub thob tu grags so/ /yang shar phyogs st+waṃ ga la'i lam ga'i grong gi shing bzo ba zhig gis rab byung ba zhig la bsnyen bkur byas/ rab byung des kyang shing bzo la/ thugs rje chen po'i bsgom bzlas phog nas nyams su blangs dus yun ring song ba'i skabs shig nad kyis btab/ shi nas gshin rje skyes bu shin tu 'jigs pa bzhis khyer nas dmyal ba'i gnas su song /kum pa na ra sha'i nang mes gang ba'i nang du 'jug grabs byas pa'i tshe kum pa na ra ka kha zum nas ma chud/ phyir bkyed pa dang kha phyes nas byung / yang yang byas pas de bzhin du byung / gshin rje skyes bu bzhi po 'jigs nas/ gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po la 55

zhus pas/ khong na re/ mi de 'dir skye ba'i rgyu zad/ thugs rje chen po'i bu yin/ da myur du phyir skyol gsungs/ bskyal bas nye 'khor rnams kyis dur khrod du shing brtsigs pa'i dkyil du bcug mtha' nas me sbar ba dang slar sos nas phyir thon pa byung / sngon kun dga' bo'i tsha bo gnyis rab tu byung nas chos klog tu bcug pas/ nyung shas re bklags nas klog tu ma nyan pas/ mo'u 'gal gyi bus rdzu 'phrul gyes dmyal ba'i gnas su khrid nas/ khong gnyis la dmyal ba blta ru bcug pas/ dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal 'tshod pa dang / gcod pa dang / gshag pa dang rdeg pa sogs sdug bsngal ba mang po mthong / phyogs gcig na lcags slang chen po gnyis kyi nang na khro chu khol ba mthong nas/'dir mi su 'jug gam dris pas/ 'dir kun dga' bo'i tsha bo gnyis rab tu byung nas le los dus 'da' ba de gnyis shi na 'dir 'jug go smras pas/ khong gnyis kyi bsam pa la ngo shes 'dra song na da lta rang bcug yong snyam shin tu 'jigs skrag ste bros nas mo'u 'gal gyi bu'i rtsar 'ongs nas/ mo'u 'gal gyi bus de gnyis la/ le lo byas na nyes dmigs 'di dang gzhan yang yod pas/ brtson 'grus rtsoms shig gsungs/ de nas lha'i gnas su khrid nas/ khong gnyis la lha yul blta ru bcug pas/56

lha pho mo mang pos pi wang la sogs pa'i sgra snyan sgrogs shing /lha'i skyid dga' longs spyod dpag tu med pa myong ba mthong /phyogs gcig na lha'i bu med pa'i gzhal med khang lha'i bu mo mang pos gang ba mthong nas/ lha'i bu mi 'dug pa'i rgyu mtshan dris pas/ kun dga' bo'i tsha bo gnyis rab tu byung nas/brtson 'grus brtsams pas de gnyis shi 'phos nas 'dir skye'o/ /zhes smras pas/ de gnyis dga' nas mo'u 'gal gye bu la smras/ mo'u 'gal gyi bus de gnyis la/ brtson 'grus brtsams na phan yon 'di dang gzhan yang yod pas brtson 'grus rtsoms shig gsungs pas/ de gnyis kyis brtson 'grus byas pas/ ring po ma lon par myur du dgra bcom pa'i go 'phang thob nas nam mkha' la 'phur nas 'gro ba byung /yang sngon sangs rgyas kyi gcung dga' bo rab tu byung yang /da dung bzang mo la ha cang chags pa mkhyen nas/ ri bo spos ngad ldan du khrid nas/ spre'u mo zhar ma zhig bstan te/ bzang mo dang 'di gnyis la gzugs gang bzang gsungs pas/ dga' bo na re/ spre'u mo bzang mo'i brgya'i char yang mi mchi zer de nas sum cu rtsa gsum lha gnas su khrid nas/ lha mo rnams la ltos gsungs/ bltas pas phyogs gcig na khang pa zhig na lha'i 57

bu mo mang po 'dug pa mthong nas/ lha'i bu med pa'i rgyu mtshan dris pas/ mi yul na gcung dga' bo zhes bya ba ston pa'i spyan sngar rab tu byung tshangs spyod bsrungs nas/ shi na 'dir 'ong bas/ de'i phyir 'dir sdod do zer ba thos pas dga' nas ston pa'i drung du 'ongs pas ston pas gcung dga' bo la/ lha mo de dag dang bzang mo gnyis gzugs gang bzang dris pas/dga' bo na re/ bzang mo lha mo de dag gi brgya'i char yang mi mchi zer/ sangs rgyas kyis tshangs spyod bsrungs na phan yon 'di dang gzhan yang yod pas srungs shig gsungs pas/dga' bo yang bzang mo la ma chags par lha mo de dag la chags nas/ lha'i gnas su skye bar 'dod nas tshangs spyod bsrungs so/ /de nas yang nyin gcig sangs rgyas kyis dga' bo khrid nas dmyal ba bltar bcug pas/ dmyal ba'i chu bo rab med dang /sog les gshag pa dang / sta res gcod pa la sogs pa mthong ngo / /phyogs gcig na sla nga gcig gi nang du khro chu bskol nas nang du sems can su yang mi 'jug pa zhig mthong nas/ rgyu mtshan dris pas/ mi yul na gcung dga' bos lha'i gnas su sgye ba'i phyir tshangs spyod bsrungs pa shi nas lhar skyes/ de nas tshe 'phos nas 'dir 'ongs pas de nang du 'jug pa'i phyir bzhag 58

go zer ba thos nas 'jigs nas phyir 'ongs pa la ston pa'i zhal nas/ lha'i 'jig rten la smon nas tshangs spyod bsrungs na nyes dmigs 'di dang gzhan yang yod pas/ khyod myang 'das thob pa la dga' bar gyes/ lha'i 'jig rten du yang dga' bar ma byed cig gsungs pas/ gcung dga' bo 'khor ba mtha' dag la zhen pa log nas/ myang 'das thob phyir tshangs spyod bsrungs brtson 'grus brtsams pas dgra bcom pa'i go 'phang thob par gsungs so/ /de bzhin du tshe phyi mar dge ba byas pa rnams/ lam dkar po gyen du bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha du mas lam sna drangs te mtho ris dang thar pa'i gnas su yar yar song nas bde skyid tshad med pa myong zhing / sdig pa mi dge ba byas pa rnams lam nag po thur du gshin rje'i pho nya mdog mi sdug pa du mas khrid nas/ ngan song gsum gye gnas su mar mar song nas sdug bsngal tshad med pa myong nges/ des na/ yar lha'i bdud rtsi dang / mar dmyal ba'i khro chu 'thung ba dang / mdun ma gtan legs dang / gtan nyes yar 'gro mar 'gro'i sa mtshams 'byed pa'i dus da res yin pas/ da lta yar mar gang la 'gro ba'i dbang rang gi lag na yod pa'i dus skabs su/ 'o skol rnams kyis blang dor skyid sdug legs nyes kyi 'dam ka ma 59

nor ba byas/ mar 'gro mi dge sdig pa spangs nas yar 'gro dge ba'i las la ston pa thugs rje can gyi gsung bzhin nyin mtshan med par 'bad par bya'o/ /smras pa/ sems can skyid sdug legs nyes sa ler gzigs/ /dgra dang gnyen la khyad par spu tsam med/ /'gro ba yongs la bu gcig ltar brtse ba/ /ston pa sangs rgyas ma gtogs gzhan na gang / /nam mkha' 'di la 'dom gyis bcal nas ni/ /'di tsam 'dug ces tshad gzung mi nus bzhin/ /ston pa'i yon tan rig pas dpyad nas ni/ /'di tsam 'dug ces tshad gzung ga la nus/ /'on kyang ston pa'i yon tan rgya mtsho nas/ /mkhyen brtse'i yon tan mnga' tshul chu thigs tsam/ /rnam dpyod ku sha'i rtse la bdag gis blangs/ /'di 'dra'i yon tan kun ldan ston pa spangs/ /phyi rol ston pa gzhan la gus pa rnams/ /yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i mtsho 'gram nas/ /ba tshwa'i khron pa brko dang cis mi mtshungs/ /skyon zad yon tan ldan pa'i ston pa yi/ /rnam thar bsams na sems yod cis mi dad/ /kun gyis phyi rol ston pa gzhan spangs nas/ /bcom ldan 'das la skyabs su 'gro bar rigs/ /'das dang ma 'ongs da lta dus gsum po/ /lag pa'i mthil la bltas ltar sa ler gzigs/ /kha dang lag pa gnyis ka 60

sprad pa ltar/ /'chugs med mngon shes mnga' ba'i sangs rgyas la/ /dzun gye tshig gcig gsungs pa'i rgyu med na/ /ston pa'i gsung la su zhig yid mi ches/ /ston pa thugs rje can gyi gsung rab la/ /yid ches tshad mar bzung nas sgrub par rigs/ /grogs gzhan 'chi ba mngon sum mthong bzhin du/ /da dung rang nyid mi 'chi snyam pa 'khrul/ /phyi mar chos med 'gro ba mthong bzhin du/ /'gro grabs lha chos mi byed de bas 'khrul/ /mi rnams 'ga' res dgun rgyags ston gyi dus/ /mi sgrub sdod pa'i mi la blun zer na/ /phyi ma'i rgyags phye lha chos da lta'i dus/ /mi sgrub sdod rnams de bas shin tu blun/ /mi rtag 'chi ba ring min myur du 'ong / /shi na bar dor lag stong gcer bur 'gro/ /tshe 'di'i gnyen grogs nor gyis phan pa med/ /de dus phan pa dam pa'i lha chos dang / /'dren mkhan bla ma lha dang dkon mchog yin/ /tshe 'dir dkar po dge ba byas pa'i mi/ /phyi mar bla ma lha yis sngon nas bsus/ /mtho ris thar lam dkar po yar la 'gro/ /tshe 'dir nag po sdig pa byas pa'i mi/ /phyi mar gshin rje'i pho nyas mdun nas khrid/ /ngan song lam ngan nag por mar la 'gro/ /da lta yar mar gang la 'gro ba'i dbang / /'o skol mi yi lag na yod thog 'dir/ /mar 'gro mi dge sdig pa'i las rnams spangs/ /61

yar 'gro dge ba'i las la 'bad par rigs/ /rtag tu blo ldan rnams kyis 'chi ba dang / /shi na phyi mar 'gro ba'i tshul bsams nas/ /ston thog phyir du sos ka 'bad pa bzhin/ /phyi ma'i don la tshe 'dir 'bad par mdzod/ /da ni ston pa sangs rgyas gsung bzhin du/ /mtho ris thar pa'i bde skyid srog 'phrog pa'i/ /mi dge sdig pa'i reg 'phung dug gi chu/ /spong tshul bdag gis bshad la da yang nyon/ /de yang ston pa thugs rje can gyis mi dge ba spong tshul gsungs pa 'dir kun gyes go sla zhing yid ches pa'i phyir sngon gye gtam rgyud dang sbyar nas bshad par bya ste/ sngon khyim bdag phyug po gcig la chen chun gnyis yod pas/ chen ma la bu med chun ma la bu yod pas/ khyim bdag des chen ma la mi byams chun ma la byams so/ /de'i tshe nor thams cad kyi bdag mor yang chun mar gyur to/ /der chen ma des 'di snyam du sems te/bdag la bu gcig yod na nor zas thams cad kyi bdag mo yang bdag yin/ khyo bo yang bdag la brtsi ba la/ da bdag la bu med pas nor rdzas kyi bdag mor yang ma gyur/ khyo bos kyang mi brtsi'o snyam nas/ chun ma'i bu bsnyal nas 'dug pa'i mtshog ma khab kyis dkrugs nas rma mi snang bar byas so/ /de nas dus 62

ring po ma lon par chun ma'i bu shi bas/ chun ma na re/ chen ma la khyed kyis nga'i bu bsad do byas pas/ chen mas khyed kyi bu bsad na bdag gang du skyes kyang khyo bo dug sbrul gyis gsod par gyur cig bu che ba chus 'khyer bar gyur cig chung ba gcan gzan gyis za bar gyur cig pha ma dang khyim 'khor mes 'tshig par gyur cig bdag rang gi bu sha rang gis za bar gyur cigabadag rang gson por dur du sbed par gyur cig ces mna' log pa bor ro/ /de shi nas dmyal ba sogs ngan song du yun ring skyes/ thar nas dge slong ma ud pa la zhes bya bar gyur pa'i tshe stod/ phas bram ze zhig la bag mar btang bas/ bu zhig btsas pa dang mnyam du gyos sgyug gnyis po shi'o/ /yang bu gcig btsa' khar khyo bo dang gnyis ka pha ma'i khyim du 'gro snyam lam du song ba'i lam gye brag rtsa zhig tu so sor nyal nas bsdad pas/nub mo bu btsa' ba'i dus la bab nas/ khyo bo bos pas skad ma byung / snga mo bltas pas dug sbrul gyis rmugs nas shi yod pa mthong nas ngus pas brgyal lo/ /bu che ba ma la 'jus nas ngus pas brgyal ba sangs so/ /de nas bu che ba khur chung ba pang du bzung nas grogs med par gcig pur phyin pas/ lam na chu chen po zhig yod pa bu gnyis ka ma theg ste/ bu che ba chu 'gram du 63

bzhag bu chung ba chu'i pha khar bskyal nas/ bu che ba len du 'ongs pas bus ma bsu ru 'ongs pas bu chus khyer ba'i rjes su mas ma slebs so/ /de nas phar log nas phyin pa dang / bu chung ba yang gcan gzan gyis zos nas/ khrag tsam las med par gyur to/ /de nas ngu zhing lam du zhugs nas song bas/ pha'i nye ba bram ze kun tu rgyu zhig dang phrad pas bdag gi pha ma khams bde'am dris pas/ khyod kyi pha ma ni shin tu ma bde/ khyem mes tshig nas mi nor bcas mes tshig byas pas/ ngus nas brgyal bas bram ze des brgyal ba sangs par byas/ kho rang gi khyem du khrid nas bu mo bzhin du byas so/ /bram ze des kyang gzhan khyem bdag cig la bag mar btang / de nas sems can dang ldan par gyur nas bu btsa' khar khyo bo grong gzhan zhig tu chang 'thung du song ngo / /mas bu btsa' ba'i dus la bab ste/ sgo mnan nas bu btsas pas/ khyo bo yong nas sgo phye byas pas/ bu btsas pa dang kha thug pas sgo 'byed mi nus par gda' smras pas/ khyo bo khros nas sgo bcag nang du 'ongs/ shi la thug pa brdungs/ bu de yang bsad nas bud med kyi khar brdzangs so/ /ma zos pas sha myag phyog bzos khar brdzangs nas 'di mi za na khyod kyang gsod pa yin byas pas 'jigs nas rang gi bu'i sha 64

yang zos so/ /der khyem thab de la skyo ba skyes nas/ grong khyer wā rā ṇa sīr phyin nas byang chub shing gi bsil grib la bsdad pa'i tshe/ khyem bdag gzhon nu zhig gi chung ma shi ba zhig der 'ongs nas gtam dris so/ /rgyu mtshan bshad pas/ khyem bdag gzhon nu des nga'i khyem du 'gro zer nas phyin pas/ khyem bdag de'i chung ma byas so/ /yang dus ring po ma lon par khyim bdag de shi bas/ bu tsha med na khyim thab gang 'dza' ba de'i khyo bo sbed na 'og tu sbed/ bsreg na 'og tu bzhag nas sreg pa'i lugs srol yod pas/ khyo bo dur du sbas pa dang /mo yang gson por dur du sbas so/ /de'i nub mo dur rkun byung nas rkun ma'i dpon po zhig gi bag mar blangs so/ /de nas yun ring ma lon par rkun po de la rgyal pos chad pa bcad nas bsad pas/ yang de'i 'og tu gson por dur du sbas so/ /de'i nub mo gcan gzan gyes dur bslogs nas mo gos med par gcer bur steng du bton nas 'di snyam du bsam ste/ bdag sdug bsngal 'di lta bu dpag tu med pas nyen pas da ni sangs rgyas la skyabs su 'gro snyam nas bcom ldan 'das kyi ga la ba der song bas/ kun dga' bo sngon du 'ongs pa la/ gcer bu ngo tsha nas brla bsgril 'doms mi snang bar byas/ nu ma gnyis lag pas bkab nas mi snang bar 65

byas so/ /de nas sangs rgyas kyis 'phags pa kun dga' bo la chos gos skon du bcug nas rab tu byung / bden bzhi'i chos gsungs sems rnam par grol te dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu thob kyang las kyi lhag mas lcags kyi khab cig gis spyi gtsug nas rkang mthil gyi bar thal mar phug par gsungs so/ /yang sngon rkun po sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis glang gcig brkus nas rgan mo gcig gi nang du bsad nas/ rgan mo de la sha byin pas mo dga' mgu yi rangs te/ khyed rnams gang du skyes kyang nga'i bur skye bar gyur cig ces smon lam btab bo/ /de rnams shi nas skye ba lnga brgya'i bar du ma bur gyur nas bu rnams gzhan gyis dus gcig la bsad pas mas mya ngan byas nas shi'o/ /de'i rjes su rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi blon po ri dwags chen po zhes bya ba la bu bdun yod pa'i bu chung shos kyi chung ma lha mtshams ma zhes bya bar gyur tshe/ bu btsas dus sgo nga sum cu rtsa gnyis btsas so/ /sgo nga rnams brdol ba'i nang nas khye'u gser gye mdog can skra mthon mthing du 'dug pa mdzes shing lta na sdug pa sum cu rtsa gnyis byung ngo / /khye'u de rnams cher gyur nas stobs rtsal gzhan las che ba byung ba blon po gzhan zhig la phrag dog skyes/ rgyal po gsal rgyal la/ 'di rnams ma bsad na khyed 66

la yang rgol lo zhes phra ma zhus pas/ rgyal pos bden snyam nyes pa med bzhin du lha mtshams ma'i bu rnams kyi mgo dus gcig la bcad nas sgom du bcug nas lha mtshams ma sangs rgyas kyi drung nas chos nyan pa'i sar bskyal bas/ sangs rgyas kyis mkhyen nas lha mtshams ma kha ma 'byed par chos nyon gsungs/bden bzhi'i chos gsungs pas lha mtshams ma sems rnam par grol te dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu thob par gyur to/ /de nas lha mtshams mas sgrom gye kha phye bas/ bu sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi mgo byung ngo / /sems rnam par grol ba'i gnad kyis sems la sdug bsngal ma byung ngo / /de'i tshe blon pos dmag chen po bsags nas rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi pho brang la bskor nas gsod grabs byas tshe rgyal po 'jigs nas blon po'i tshogs kyis 'di ltar byas sangs rgyas ma gtogs gzhan sus kyang skyob mi nus snyam nas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du skyabs btsal lo/ /der lha mtshams ma'i nang gi blon po'i dmag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du rgyal po gsal rgyal la bskor ro/ /der sangs rgyas kyis las rgyu 'bras kyi chos gsungs pas rgyal po gsal rgyal ma bsad par tshe thar ro/ /yang sngon rgyal po zla 'od kyis sbyin pa rgya chen po btang bas/67

snyan pa dang grags pa chen po byung tshe/ rgyal po ku ca zhes bya ba'i bsam pa la/ rgyal po zla 'od 'di yod na/ bdag la dpal dang grags pa mi 'ong bar gda'/ 'di med pa zhig bya dgos snyam/gros byas bram ze le'u du cha zhes bya ba dbu slong du btang nas rgyal po zla 'od kyis dbu bcad nas byen tshe sa g.yos sgra chen po byung ngo / /bram ze des rgyal po'i dbu khyer ba mthong nas/ gzhan gyis slong mo ster mkhan gcig kyang ma byung bas zhag bdun ltogs par lus so/ /rgyal bo ku cas rgyal po zla 'od bkrongs pa thos pas dga' drags nas brnangs nas shi'o/ /bram ze yul du slebs pas rgyal po ku ca shi bas don ma grub sems ma dga'/zhag mang po rtsam pa ster mkhan ma byung ba'i stabs kyis ltogs grir shi ba byung ngo / /sngon khye ra ba zhig gis ri dwags mang po bsad pas shi nas rgya mtsho'i mtha' ru/ mi yi lus la gcan gzan gye mgo bo yod pa zhig tu skyes/ las dbang gis yi dwags mang po byung nas mtshon cha brgyab tshe lus me 'bar nas sdug bsngal myang ngo / /yang blon po sdig can zhig gis mi mang po bsad pas shi nas rgya mtsho'i mtha' ru mi zhig tu skyes pas las dbang gis ral gri gcig sa la btsugs nas/ mi de ri'i rtser song nas mar rgyugs 68
