nas 'ong / ral gri de'i steng du rgyugs pas lus dum bu dum bur yang nas yang du byas te sdug bsngal myang ngo / /sngon mi 'ga' zhig gis shig sen mo'i bar du bcar/ la las me dang bye tshan gyi nang du 'phangs/ la las 'khyags sgang du 'phangs nas 'chi ru bcug pa'i rnam smin gyis shi nas/ dmyal bar skye sa nas brag bar du bcar/ la la mer bsregs/ la la 'khyags pa'i sbubs kha ba bu yug gi nang du gos med gcer bur 'phangs nas tsha grang gi sdug bsngal chen po myang ngo / /de bzhin du srog gcod byas na nyes dmigs de dang de 'dra ba gzhan yang mang po 'byung bas/ 'o skol rnams kyis zhe sdang gi dbang gis mi gsod pa dang / gsod mkhan de yang gsod pa sogs phan tshun gsod res byed pa dang / 'dod chags kyi dbang gis sha'i ched du ra lug dang / pags pa'i ched du stag gzig sogs gsod pa dang / gti mug gi dbang gis/ don med bzhin du ri la me sbar ba dang / mig gis gang mthong gsod pa sogs srog gcod byed mi rung / sngon sangs rgyas rnam gzigs 'jig rten du byon nas sems can dpag tu med pa'i don mdzad nas mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'og tu/ nags khrod dben pa zhig na/ dge 'dun stong phrag lnga tsam zhig yod pa/ tshong ba lnga brgyas mthong nas dad 69

de/ dge 'dun spyi la nor bu rin po che zhig phul lo/ /de dge 'dun kun gye spyi dpon la bcol lo/ /nyin gcig dge 'dun kun gyis spyi dpon de la khyer shog 'tshong byas pas spyi dpon na re/ khyed rnams la phul ba min nga rang la phul ba yin byas pas/dge 'dun rnams kyis khyed gcig pu ma yin spyi la phul ba yin smras pas spyi dpon de tshig pa zos nas/ skyag pa za ba tsho khyed rnams la phul ba ga la yin/ nga rang la phul ba lags/ khyed rnams skyag pa zo zhes tshig ngan smras tshe/ dge 'dun pa rnams so sor gyes so/ /de nas spyi dpon de shi nas/ dmyal ba mnar med du skyes so/ /dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal yun ring myangs nas thar te/rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer chen por skyes pa dang bud med khye'u dang / bu mo la sogs pa'i mi gtsang ba'i ljan ljin thams cad bskyil zhing 'bab pa'i sa phyogs shig na/ bshang gci'i dzing bu zhig 'dug pa'i nang du srin bu chen po rkang lag drug yod pa zhig tu skyes nas/ skabs 'gar ni 'gre ldog byed cing dzing bu'i steng du 'byung ngo / /skabs 'gar ni 'gre ldog byed cing dzing bu'i gting du 'gro'o/ /der sangs rgyas gtsug tor can nas shākya thub pa'i bar du sdug bsngal myang zhing / da dung yang bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas stong rdzogs reg gi bar du/ der yang nas 70

yang du skyes nas sdug bsngal myang dgos par gsungs so/ /yang sngon grong khyer mnyan yod kyi dge bsnyen ma gcig gis dge slong zhig la dbyar zla gsum du 'tsho ba sbyor bar khas blangs te/ dge slong de dben pa gcig tu bzhag nas/ g.yog mo gcig nyin re bzhin 'tsho ba skyel du btang bas/ g.yog mo dben par slebs pa dang / dge slong gi zan nas bcad kyin zos so/ /de nas g.yog mo de zo mdog bzang por song tshe/ dge bsnyen mas g.yog mo la/ khyod kyis dge slong gi zan brkus nas ma zos sam dris pas/ g.yog mo na re/ bdag la yang dad pa cung zad cig yod kyi/ dge slong gi zan ci'i phyir za/ gal te zos na bdag gang du skyes kyang rang sha rang gis za bar gyur cig ces mna' bor ro/ /de nas g.yog mo de shi nas/ rgya mtsho'i mtha' ru bud med cig tu gyur thab cig tu sla nga chen po zhig btsugs nas nang du chu blugs ske sbar nas chu khol ba dang /nang du mo rang zhugs nas 'tshod cing tshos nas rus pa sla phyir byung ba dang rlung gis bus pa dang bud med snga ma 'dra ba zhig tu gyur te/ mo rang gi sha mo rang gis zos so/ /de bzhin du skye ba lnga brgyar rang sha rang gis za bar skyes/ de nas tshe 'phos nas dmyal ba'i gnas su skyes par gsungs/71

sngon gshin rje gshed kyi rnal 'byor pa zhig gis/ yi dam lha'i zhal mthong bas/ da 'di la ltos na skyon mi 'ong gi snyam nas/ dge 'dun pa'i spyi rdzas nang nas yo byad cung zad cig blangs nas spyad pas/ yi dwags gshin rje gshed kyi gzugs can zhig tu skyes/ bri ka ma la shī la'i lag bde ba zhig gis/dge 'dun gyi de ring gi bsnyen bkur nang bar du bsgyur bas/de'i nub mo yi dwags shig tu skyes/ yang dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan zhig gis/ dge 'dun rnams la dbang po che byas te/'bras bre phyed tsam blangs nas zos pas/ yi dwags shin tu dbang chung ba zhig tu skyes par gsungs/ de bzhin du gzhan gyis ma byen pa blangs na nyes dmigs de dang de 'dra ba mang po 'byung bas/ des na 'o skol rnams kyis stobs kyis gzhan gyi nor longs spyod 'phrog pa dang / thabs kyis rku ba dang / g.yo sgyu'i sgo nas tshong byed dus bre rgya la skyon bzos nas/ rang ci rgyal gzhan ci pham byed pa sogs byas/ ma byen pa len mi rung /sngon bram ze gcig gis/'phags pa kā tyā ya na'i gsung bzhin/nyin par mi tshangs ma spyad/ mtshan mo spyad pas/ shi nas dmyal ba'i gnas su skyes/ nyin par gzhal med khang zhig tu bud med mdzes ma zhig dang lhan du dga' mgur spyod cing / mtshan mo 72

lon tshe bud med mdzes ma de mi snang bar/ srin gyi bud med 'jigs su rung ba zhig lus la 'khril nas gson por sha bcad nas zos te sdug bsngal myangs par gyur/ yang sngon smad 'tshong ma zhig gis mi nag pa mang po'i mgo bskor nas nor mang po blangs/ rab byung mang po bslus nas sdom pa nyams su bcug pas/ shi nas dmyal bar skyes/ gshin rje skyes bu rnams kyis bzung nas gan rkyal du bsgyel/ gsang gnas su lcags kyi gtun bu me 'bar ba bcug khro chu khol ma blugs nas bsreg cing / gsal shing 'bar ba gsang gnas nas btsugs te spyi bor thal ba sogs byas sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa yun ring myong dgos byung / yang sngon bud med gcig gis nyin par gyi dus su lha la mar me 'bul ba sogs dge ba byas/ mtshan mo skyes pa mang po dang lhan du 'dod log spyod pa sogs mi dge ba byas pas/ shi nas bud med cig tu skyes dus nyin mo mdzes shing lta na sdug pa la/ mtshan mo lon tshe khye mo zhig tu gyur nas mi sdug par gyur/ yang sngon bud med cig gis rang la khyo bo bzang po zhig yod pa la dug btab nas bsad de khyo ga gzhan zhig blangs nas lhan du bsdad/ skabs shig de yang bzhag nas khyo ga gzhan zhig btsal/ ma btsal bshad kyang kha la ma nyan tshe kho tshig 73

pa gting nas zos te/ bud med de bzung nas sna dang nu ma bcad kha nang du bzhag zar bcug nas ngan gsod byas skad/sngon dge slong bzod pa smra ba'i drung du/ rgyal po 'thab mo skyes kyi/ btsun mo gnyis song chos nyan nas bsdad yod pa la/rgyal pos dge slong gis btsun mo la mi tshangs pa spyad snyam khros nas ral gri phyung nas dge slong bzod pa smra ba lus gtubs nas bzhag go /yang sngon rkun po'i dmag dpon dang gtum mo'i mna' ma gnyis kyis/ mi tshangs pa spyad pa/ dge slong 'char gas bshad kyis dogs nas nyes pa med bzhin du dge slong 'char ka bzung nas mgo bcad/ ro phyag dar khrod du sbas pas/ rjes nas rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis tshor nas/ rkun po'i dmag dpon bzung nas rgya skyegs kyi khang par bcug nas gson por me la bsregs/ mna' ma rte'u dmu rgod kyi rkang lag la btags nas bsad do/ /sngon rgyal po zhig la bla mchod drang srong zhig yod pa la btsun mo bzhis chos zhus pa yin kyang /gzhan gyis drang srong gis btsun mo rnams la mi tshangs pa spyad do zhes rgyal po la zhus pas/ rgyal pos bden par bzung nas/drang srong bzung nas me la bsregs pas/ btsun mo bzhis kyang slob dpon me la bsregs pa ma bzod par me nang du mchongs 74

nas shi ba byung / de'i rnam smin gyis rgyal po de shi nas dmyal ba mnar med kyi me nang du skyes nas bskal pa du ma'i bar du sdug bsngal bzod glags med pa myangs/ sngon btsun mo dmar rgyan ma/ slob dpon bai ro tsa na gzugs mdzes pa la chags nas nyin gcig rgyal po med shul nas slob dpon gyi drung du song 'dod chags kyi gtam mang po lab sku la 'jus pas/ slob dpon bai ros/ mi yis tshor na bstan pa nub nas 'gro/ nga yis phyi sgo bcad nas 'ong / zhes gsungs/ phyir thon nas bros song bas rjes su rgyal po song tshe/ slob dpon gyis/ bud med zer ba btsan dug ha la ste/ /sems can gang gis zos kyang 'chi ba yin/ /sogs bud med bsten pa'i nyes dmigs mang po gsungs nas phebs song ba'i shul du btsun mo mdze nad kyis thebs pas slar slob dpon bai ro tsa na gdan drangs/ bshag pa byas pas drag pa byung / sngon rgyal po 'char byed kyi btsun mo sngo bsangs mas/ sangs rgyas 'khor bcas dad pas bsnyen bkur mchod pa byed du skabs re 'gro ba la/ btsun mo dpe med mas phrag dog byas/ rgyal po la/ btsun mo sngo bsangs ma dang /sangs rgyas gnyis lhan cig skyon chags par bgyid do zhus pas/rgyal pos bden snyam mda' gzhu khyer btsun mo sngo bsangs ma 75

sangs rgyas kyi drung nas tshur log dus mda' 'phangs so /sngo bsangs mas sangs rgyas la phyag byas byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin la zhugs pas/ mda' phyir log nas rgyal po'i mdun du gnas so/ /lan gsum 'phangs pa sngar bzhin phyir log nas mdun du gnas tshe/ rgyal po na re/ gzhan gyi tshig la nyan nas kyang / /nga ni khyod la gsod 'dod na/ /da ni khyod la skyabs su 'gro/ /sdug bsngal gyur pa nga la skyobs/ /smras pas/ btsun mo sngo bsangs mas rgyal po la/ yid 'ong bka' mchid bgyis pa dang / /bltas pas kyang ni 'ching byed cing / /mi zad dmyal bar ltung bas na/ /khyod ni bud med tshig ma gsan/ /zhes smras/ de nas rgyal po btsun mo sngo bsangs mas bskul nas sangs rgyas kyi drung du song / rab tu dad pas chos zhus/ sangs rgyas kyis bud med kyi nyes dmigs rgya chen po gsungs pas rgyal po yang dge bsnyen byas chos byas so/ /de bzhin du mi tshangs spyod byas na nyes dmigs de dang de 'dra gzhan yang mang po 'byung bas/ 'o skol rab byung dang btsun mo rnams kyis mi tshangs pa gtan nas spyod mi rung / khyim pa pho mo yin kyang pho skyes rnams kyis rigs gcig pa dang / tshul khrims can gyi btsun ma dang / bdag po yod pa'i bud med la spyod mi rung / rang gi chung ma yin yang 76

mang po mi spyod cing / khyad par na ba dang / sbrum ma'i dus dang /bsnyen gnas dang smyung gnas bsrung dus/ pha ma dang bla ma'i thag nye/ sgu gsung thugs rten gye drung du spyod mi rung / bud med rnams kyis kyang rang gi khyo bo ma gtogs gzhan gyi khyo ga mang po spyod du 'jug mi rung / khyad par rab byung dge slong sdom pa dang ldan pa la gtan nas spyod du 'jug mi rung /sngon wā rā ṇa sī'i rgyal po tshangs byen gyi mdun na/ khyem bdag phyug po gcig la bu gnyis yod pas/ phu bo la sbyin pa dang / nu bo la tshul khrims zer/ de gnyis mkhas shing blo dang ldan pa drang la g.yo sgyu med pas/ rgyal pos zhal lce bar bskos so/ /de'i tshe tshong dpon zhig rgya mtshor rin po che len du 'gro ba la nu bo tshul khrims kyis nor mang po bskyis nas tshong dpon dang tshul khrims/ de'i bu dang bcas pa phu bo sbyin pa'i drung du phyin te/ nu bo tshul khrims na re/ ngas nor 'di snyed cig tshong dpon la bskyis yod/ mi yi sgye 'chi la nges pa med/ nga shi 'dra song na bu 'di chung bas na/ phu bo khyod kyis dpang po gyes smras so/ /de nas tshul khrims shi song / tshong dpon gyis rgya mtsho 'khor nas/ tshul khrims kyi bu yis nor gye skyin pa dgos byas pas/tshong dpon gye bsam pa la/ byin na skyin pa 'khor dka' da ster 77

mi dgos pa'i thabs shig bya snyam/ sbyin pa'i chung ma la/ nor bu rin po che srang khri phrag gcig ri ba zhig byen te/ khyod kyis khyo bo la dzun zhig smra ru chug byas pas chung mas khyo bor bshad pas rdzun smrar mi 'dod pas/ yang tshong dpon gyis nor bu rin po che khri phrag gnyis ri ba cig khyer 'ongs nas chung ma de la sprad de cis kyang sbyin pa la dzun zhig smra ru chug khyod shes zer nan tan byas pas/ chung mas sbyin pa la bshad pas ma nyan tshe/ chung ma na re/ gzhan gyi chung mas gang bshad la khyo bos nyan/ khyo bos gang bshad la chung mas nyan pa la/ khyod ni nga'i kha la lan cig tsam yang mi nyan na ngas bu 'di bsad nas sha yang zos nga yang lceb bo byas pas/ sbyin pa skrag ste rdzun smra bar khas blangs so/ /de nas tshong dpon la tshul khrims kyi bus nor gyi skyin pa dgos zhes ded pas/ tshong dpon gyis/ khyod kyi phas nga la nor bskyis pa med do byas pas/ bu na re/ lo zla tshes grangs 'di lta bu la bskyis/ dpang po a khu sbyin pa yang yod byas pas/ 'o na sbyin pa la 'dri byas/ gnyis ka 'ongs nas dris pas/ sbyin pas/ ngas nu bo tshul khrims kyis tshong dpon la nor mang po skyi ru btang ba ni mi dran no zhes dzun smras pas/ yul mi thams cad kyis kyang da res bshag log byas so zhes gtam ngan byung ngo / /de nas sbyin 78

pa shi nas bskal pa dpag tu med par dmyal bar skyes so/ /de las thar nas skye ba dpag tu med par yi dwags su skyes so/ /de las thar nas byol song gi gnas su skyes so/ /de las thar nas/mi'i nang du skyes kyang skye ba lnga brgya'i bar du mig dang rna ba dang sna dang lce dang rkang lag gang yang med pa'i sha'i ril bu lta bur gyur nas sdug bsngal bar gyur to/ /yang sngon wa mo zhig zas 'tshol du phyin pas/ rus sbal zhig dang 'phrad pas bzung tshe/ rus sbal na re/ nga ma gsod dang /ngas khyod phun sum tshogs pa zhig bya'o zer/was btang tshe/ rus sbal gyis seng ge ma bu nyal ba'i brag phug cig bstan nas/ yul pha gi'i brag phug na/ skyin gor ma smad brgyad gnyid du log 'dug pas/ de rnams khyod kyis sod la zo zhig ces dzun smras pas/ was bden snyam/ brag phug gi sgo rtsar song ba'i wa gzhan gcig dang 'phrad pas/ wa de na re/ nyin par skyin gor ma smad brgyad gnyid nas sdod mi srid/ gcan gzan gdug pa can nyal nas sdod pa yin pas ma 'gro byas pas/ wa des/ bdag ni stobs dang brtson 'grus che/ /bdag dang mtshungs pa gzhan na med/ /glang chen gyang la bab pa bzhin/ /skyin gor ma smad 'dir gzhom bya/ /zer/brag phug tu phyin pas/ seng ge ma gcig la phru 79

gu gnyis skyes nas 'dug pas phru gu gnyis kyis wa bzung nas gsod grabs byas tshe/ seng ge ma na re/ bu bu de 'dra ba lag 'bab rin mi 'dug pas ma gsod thongs shig byas pas/ phru gu gnyis kyis wa ma bsad par rtsed ma 'thab la gcig gis wa'i rna ba bcad/ gcig gis rnga ma bcad nas phyir btang bas/ wa de phyi rol tu thon pas wa snga ma des mthong nas/ khyod ni stobs dang brtson 'grus che/ /khyod dang mtshungs pa gzhan med na/ /de ring lus mdzes mi sdug gyur/ /kha pho don dang ldan ma gyur/ /smras pas/ kho na re/ byams pa'i tshig la ma nyan par/ /rus sbal tshig la nyan pas phung / /khyod bden bdag 'khrul dgos pa chung / /mi shes mkhas pas smad par rigs/ /zer ro/ /de nas rus sbal de shi nas bram ze zhig gi bur sgyes/ sangs rgyas kyi drung nas dge slong byas/ bsod snyoms la song bas/ 'phags pa nye dgas dge slong gsar ba de la/ bram ze shin tu gtum la sangs rgyas kyi bstan la gnag pa zhig gi sgo bstan nas/ der song dang bsod snyoms phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan no zhes rdzun smras pa bden snyam song bas/ bram ze de dang 'phrad ma thag tu dbyug pa sogs kyis brdungs nas/ dge slong de'i mgo bo zhom/ lhung bzed bcag chos gos ral nas ma shi ba tsam byas 80

btang ngo / /yang sngon rab 'jigs kyis gser bum pa gang rnyed pa rdzun pham gyi nang du bzhag yod pa/ rdzun pham gyis gser bton nas/ bum par shing phye blugs nas/ rab 'jigs la gser de lha 'dre'i nor zhig yin nam/ shing phye ru gyur 'dug ces rdzun cig smras pas/ skye ba lnga brgya'i bar du shing phye'i nang gi srin bur skyes pa dang / de bzhin du rdzun smras na nyes dmigs de dang de 'dra gzhan yang mang po 'byung bas/ des na 'o skol rnams kyis 'dre ma mthong ba la mthong / 'dre mi gnod pa la gnod/ dgra mi 'ong ba la yong / gtam ma thos pa la thos mi shes pa thams cad ngas shes zer ba sogs rdzun gye rigs su gyur pa smra mi rung / sngon wā rā ṇa sī'i rgyal po tshang sa byen gyi mdun na drang srong zhig yod pa la slob ma khye'u lnga brgya tsam yod la/ de'i tshe lho phyogs kyi rgyud nas bram ze rig pa dang ldan pa zhig byung ste/ drang srong de'i khang pa'i nye 'dabs shig tu gnas bcas te bsdad/ de'i tshe drang srong des slob ma bram ze khye'u lnga brgya po la chos gos dang bsod snyoms kyi phan 'dogs nus kyang tshigs su bcad pas phan 'dogs par mi nus pas khye'u rnams kyis bram ze rig pa dang ldan pa de la zhus pas/ bram ze 81

rig pa can de na re/ tshigs su bcad pa mi shes pa'i slob dpon des ci bya/ 'dir shog dang kho bos khyed rnams la tshigs su bcad pas phan gdags zhes dpon slob kyi bar du dbyen byas pas/ khye'u lnga brgya pos sngar gyi slob dpon drang srong de bor te bram ze de'i drung du song ngo / /de'i dus kyi bram ze mkhas pa de sangs rgyas yin pas/ de'i rnam smin gyis phyis sangs rgyas pa'i tshe yang / bdud lhas sbyin gyis sangs rgyas dang 'khor dge 'dun rnams kyi bar du phra ma mang po bcug nas dge 'dun gyi dbyen chen po byas/ dge 'dun pa mang po'i thos bsam sgom gsum la bar chad chen po byung / lhas sbyin kyang tshe 'phos nas dmyal bar skyes nas sdug bsngal yun ring myangs so/ /sngon rgyal po zla ba seng ge dang / btsun mo gzugs kyi nyi ma gnyis shin tu mthun tshe/ rigs ngan gyi btsun mo phrag dog skyes/rgyal po dang gzugs kyi nyi ma gnyis kyi bar la/ g.yog mo ya ma gandhe zer ba phra ma mang po byed du bcug pas/ glang chen bsad/sras kyang bkrongs/ gzugs kyi nyi ma yul bton/ phung krol chen po byas pa phyis shes nas/blon po rnams kyis rigs ngan gyi bu mo dang g.yog mo gadhe gnyis bzung / gson snying la dmar 'don brgyab nas gsod snyam kyang / gzugs kyi nyi mas snying rje 82

nas bkab pas gsod du ma bcug 'on kyang blon po rnams kyis ma nyan par rigs ngan gyi bu mo'i mig bton/ ya ma gandhe'i rkang pa bregs nas sdug bsngal myangs/ shi nas dmyal bar skyes pa byung / de bzhin du phra ma byas na nyes dmigs de dang de 'dra gzhan yang mang po 'byung bas/ 'o skol rnams kyis/ mngon sum du khyod la khos 'di lta bu zer bar 'dug ces smra ba dang /'di ltar byed cing 'dug go zer dkrugs pa dang / yang lkog nas khyod la che ge mo zhig gis 'di skad zer te/ khyod kyis bzod pa sgoms shig 'on kyang cung zhig smra dgos so zhes snying nas 'thab na dga' ba dang / yang gcig gi drung du phyin nas/khyod la 'di skad zer bar 'dug pas de mi 'os 'thab dgos zer/ yang gcig gi sar phyin/ khyod la 'di skad zer bar gda'/ 'on kyang ngas smras zhes ma bshad/ khyod kyang rang ma sdod ces mi gnyis re'am/ yang na mi mang po 'khon 'dzing byed du 'jug pa ste/ de lta bu'i phra ma'i rigs byed mi rung /sngon wā rā ṇa sī'i rgyal po tshangs byin gyi mdun na khyim bdag phyug po gcig yod pas/ dge slong stong phrag gnyis la/lo bcu gnyis kyi bar du 'tsho ba sbyar bas/ g.yog lnga brgya yod pa sun nas dge 'dun rnams la sprang po mu lto ba 'di rnams 83

kyis/ 'o skol nyon mongs su bcug go zhes tshig rtsub po smras pas/shi nas skye ba lnga brgya'i bar du rigs ngan dbul zhing phongs pa'i sprang po mu lto bar skyes par gyur/ sngon sangs rgyas 'od srungs kyi dus bram ze phyug po zhig gi bu gnyis rab tu byung nas/phu bos sgrub pa byas pas dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu thob/ nu bos dge 'dun pa'i zhal ta byas nas phu bo la khyod kyis kyang skabs re dge 'dun gye zhal ta re gyes zhes yang yang bskul yang ma byas tshe/ tshig pa zos nas khyod rtag tu 'gro mi shes pa'i 'phye bo zhig 'dod dam zhes tshig rtsub smra bas phyis bshag pa byas kyang / shi nas skye ba lnga brgyar 'phye bo ru gyur to/ /sngon sangs rgyas 'od srungs kyi dus dge slong spong ba po zhig klog pa rnams kyi rtsar 'ongs nas/ bsam gtan ma btub pas tshig pa zos nas dge slong 'di rnams kyis mtshan gang bo sbal ba ltar skad 'byin to zhes tshig rtsub smra bas/ skye ba lnga brgyar sbal bar skyes so/ /sngon bya thams cad 'dus nas rgyal po 'tshol ba na/'ug pa la bltas te bya kha cig na re/ 'dir tshogs kyi dbus su brjid che/ mtshan mo 'gro na mig gsal/ mgo la rwa yod pas 'di yis rgyal po bya'o zer ba na/ khwa ta na re/ khyod ci zer/'di'i rkang pa ser ka gas pas bran rkang / ma yar mo la sha 84

brkus nas zos pas mo'i zhag mig tu blugs pas mig ser por song bas zhag mig 'ug pas sgra 'byin pas skad mi snyan/mgo la rwa yod pas ltas ngan gyi bya ngan 'di yin pas bdag der ma gtogs so zhes kho langs song /bya gzhan rnams kyis rgyu mtshan thams cad tshang 'dug pas/ khwa ta bden zer/ 'ug pa gcig pu sa der bzhag nas bya kun gyes so/ /der 'ug pa la khwa ta'i tshig ngan gyes rma phab de nas bzung ste 'ug pas khwa ta nam mthong yang bdas nas gnod pa rang byas pas/ khwa ta bskal pa'i bar du 'ug pa la 'bro dgos pa byung ba yin no/ /de bzhin du tshig rtsub smras na nyes dmigs de dang de 'dra ba gzhan yang mang po 'byung bas/ 'o skol rnams kyis rang la dngos su gzhan gyis tshur la lus kyi gnod pa byas pa la tshig rtsub smra ba dang /yang rang la gzhan gyis lus kyi gnod pa ma byas kyang / ngag gis mi snyan pa smra ba'i lan du tshig rtsub smra ba dang / gzhan gyis lus ngag gi gnod pa byas rung ma byas rung / de dang de'i gnyen tshan nam mdza' bshes la smad ra gtong ba sogs tshig rtsub kyi rigs smra mi rung /sngon rgyal po chen po zhig la/mchod gnas dge slong skra rta'i rngog ma dang / pags pa rta'i pags pa ltar gyong zhing rtsub pa/ mi 85

sdug pa'i mtshan rtags bco brgyad dang ldan pa zhig yod do/ /de'i tshe rgyal po'i bu mo rdo rje zhes bya bas nged kyi khyim na mchod gnas skra rta'i rngog ma ltar gyong zhing rtsub pa/ pags pa yang rta'i pags pa ltar gyong zhing rtsub pa/ mi sdug pa'i mtshan rtags bco brgyad dang ldan pa zhig yod do zhes smras pas skye ba lnga brgya'i bar du de lta bu'i skye ba blangs so/ /phyis rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi btsun mo la bu mo skra dang pags pa rtsub pa sogs mi sdug pa'i mtshan rtags bco brgyad dang ldan pa zhig btsas pa gzhan la ston pa la ngo tsha nas/ mi gzhan gyis mi mthong ba'i sar sbas so/ /de phyis sangs rgyas dang mjal ba'i byen rlabs kyis gzugs mdzes par gyur to/ /sngon dge slong gcig dang dge tshul gnyis 'grogs nas phyin pas/ dge slong de yur ba zhig la rgyangs kyis mchongs nas phyin pas/ dge tshul des dge slong de la khyod ni spre'u bzhin rtsal che bar 'dug go byas pas skye ba lnga brgya'i bar du spre'u ru skyes so/ /yang dgra bcom pa skad ngan pa zhig la khyod kyi skad de khyi zug pa 'dra'o zhes smras pas/ khyi'i skye ba lnga brgya blangs pa dang / ying bud med gcig gis bud med gzhan ma la khyi mo 'dra ba yin smras pas/ khyi mo'i skye ba lnga brgya blangs par gsungs/ de bzhin du ngag 'khyal sna tshogs spras na 86

nyes dmigs de dang gzhan yang mang po 'byung bas/ 'o skol rnams kyis/ 'jig rten pa'i ngag 'khyal ku re bzhad gad byed pa'i gtam sna tshogs gtong ba dang / pha mes dgu brgyud kyi gtam/ sangs rgyas mi bden/ chos mi bden zer ba lta bu'i mtho bshad dma' bshad smyon pa bzhin kha nas ci zer 'di zer med pa'i don med lab lob mang po byed pa sogs ngag 'khyal gye rigs spra mi rung / sngon yul 'khor mo 'jigs na/ rgyal po brnab sems can zhig yod pa'i lho phyogs na bram ze phyug po zhig la khang pa'i phug na ci 'dod longs spyod 'byung ba'i khron pa zhig yod pas/ rgyal po de gdan drangs nas bsnyen bkur rgya chen po byas so/ /rgyal ngan des bram ze 'byor ba dang bral bar bya snyam bsam ngan skyes nas pho brang du song / mi gcig btang nas phyug po la khron pa de zhag 'ga' yar la g.yar po thongs/ ma btang na chad pa gcod byas pas/ bram zes yar mi 'gro ba shes nas khron pa 'bul bas mar len mkhan thongs byas pas/ rgyal pos blon po thams cad bsags nas/ bang chen pa thongs la khron pa longs la shog ma blangs na khyed rnams kyi mgo gcod byas pas/ blon po rnams kyis gros byas te/ rgyal po gdug pa can 'di ma bsad 87

na/ phyin chad da dung yang mi 'os pa'i gtam 'di lta bu 'ong bas 'di gsod dgos zhes thams cad log nas rgyal po bsad pas ngan song du skyes so/ /bram ze chad pa las grol lo/ /yang sngon grong 'dabs shig tu wa zhig zas 'tshol du song bas/ lug thug mi bsrun pa gnyis yun ring 'thab pas rwa'i rtsa ba nas khrag byung ba mthong nas/ wa brnab sems skyes te khrag bldag par gzas pas/ lug thug gnyis po phan tshun du brdung ba'i bar du wa'i mgo chud pas rdza ma rdo gnyis bar du brdungs pa bzhin/ mgo bo kha mang por gas nas de ma thag shi bar gyur to/ /sngon yul wā rā ṇa ba'i rgyal po tshangs pas byin gyi mdun na bram ze phyug cing btsan pa zhig gis gzhan nor la brnab sems chen bo byas/ nor ci 'byor kun gser du bsgril nas bsags pas/ gser bum pa bdun byung ba gter du sbas so/ /de nas bram ze de gser la chags bzhin du shi bas sbrul chen po zhig tu sgyes nas bsrungs so/ /sbrul de shi nas kyang yang dang yang du sbrul du sgyes nas gser bum pa bdun po de bsrungs so/ /sngon klu mang po zhig sbrul du brdzus nas mtsho khar ltad mo blta ru 'ongs pa/ klu bdud byung nas gtses pa mi gcig gis mthong nas/ klu bdud des sbrul rnams gsod du ma bcug pas/88

sbrul gcig gis mgo btegs nas dngos grub ster ba'i brda byas nas song ngo / /mi de yi bsam pa la nor bu la sogs ji 'dra'i dngos grub cig ster ram snyam brnab sems chen po skyes mtsho khar song nas yun ring bsgugs pas ci yang ma byen tshe/ da mi ster bar 'dug snyam log nas tshur 'ong lam gyi sdong po zhig gi rtsa nas ngal gsos pas gnyid du song / gnyid sad tshe klus rin po che'i dngos grub byen pas/ da bar mi ster ba ci yin dris pas/ khyod 'dod pas bsgribs nas da bar ngas byen kyang mi mthong bar gda'/ da 'dod pa zad pas mthong byung zer skad/ de bzhin du brnab sems chen po byas na nyes dmigs de dang de 'dra gzhan yang mang po 'byung bas/ 'o skol rnams kyis/rang gi zas gos gser dngul g.yu byur sogs/ dngos po rnams la chags zhen byed pa dang /gzhan gyi nor 'di dang 'di lta bu bdag la byung na snyam g.yo sgyu sna tshogs kyi sgo nas len snyam pa dang / yang bdag tu ma bzung ba'i ri dang lung ba rtswa chu bzang ba sogs la chags nas de 'dra yod na snyam pa'i brnab sems byed mi rung /sngon yul phyogs gcig na rgyal po chen po zhig yod/ de'i ri khrod na gcan gzan gyi rgyal po kun ta zhes bya ba lus gser gyi 89

kha dog lta bu sder mo thams cad rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa byams snying rje dang ldan pa zhig yod pa rgyal po'i rmi lam du byung bas/ rngon pa rnams la de sod la pags pa bshus sder mo chod la khyer shog de ma byung na khyed tsho thams cad kyi ske dus gcig la bcad nas gsod do byas pas/ rngon pa thams cad gros byas te/ rngon pa mi snying stobs can zhig yod pa de la khyod song la ri dwags de sod dang / nged rnams kyis nor mang po bsdus nas khyod la ster/ gal te khyod ma 'ongs kyang bu smad nor dang ldan par bya zhes spras pas/ mi de nags khrod du phyin pa dang / bye ma'i 'dam du byeng nas 'gro ni chen po ma nus tshad pas gdungs skam la nye ba dang / gcan gzan gye rgyal po kun tas mthong nas snying rje skyes lus chu la bcug nas rngon pa'i lus la khril gyis 'khril lo/ /yang yang de ltar byas nas rngon pa de'i lus tshad pas gdungs pa de gsos so/ /rngon pa de'i bsam pa la/ rgyal pos bshad pa'i ri dwags de 'di yin par 'duga'adis nga'i srog bskyabs pas/ 'di gsod pa las nga shi ba sla'o/ /'on kyang ma bsad na rngon pa thams cad kyi ske rgyal pos dus gcig la bcad nas gsod pas da ci drag gam snyam nas ngo 'dzum gnag bsdad pas/ gcan gzan des khyod kyi ngo 90

'dzum gnag pa ci yin dris pas/ rngon pa des sngar gyi lo rgyus rnams bshad pas gcan gzan gyi rgyal po de na re/ de yin na khyod 'jigs skrag sbug bsngal mi dgos/ nga'i srog ma gcod par/ nga'i sder mo chod/ pags pa bshus la khyer cig byas pas/rngon pa des mi phod rung bags kyis sder mo bcad pags pa bshu nas rgyal po la phul bas/ rngon pa thams cad kyi ske ma bcad do/ /gcan gzan gyi rgyal po de'i sha khrag grog sbur stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyis zos 'thungs pas/ de dag thams cad sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha gnas su skyes so/ /gnod sems can gye sdig rgyal de shi nas rgya mtsho'i nang gi chu srin chen po zhig tu skyes so/ /de'i lus la srog chags dpag tu med pas zos pas ma bzod de/ shel gyi ri la lus kyi lcid bkal nas 'phrugs pas srog chags rnams bcar bas rgya mtsho yang khrag gis rgyang grags re dmar por 'gro ba byung / de ltar srog chags mang pos yang yang zos pas sdug bsngal yun ring myangs so/ /sngon sprang po zhig dge 'dun pa mang po la sems khros nas/ 'di rnams kyi ske shing rta'i 'khor lo zhig gis bcad na ci ma rung snyam pa'i gnod sems skyes pas/ phyi dro lam gye 'gram na nyal yod pa'i mgo la rgyal pos shing rta'i 'khor lo bskor nas 'gro 91

ba phog nas mgo bo chad nas shi'o/ /shi nas mnar med pa'i dmyal bar skyes so/ /yang sngon khra zhig gis byi'u zhig gsod snyam bdas pas bye'u tsher phung zhig gi gseb tu zhugs pas/ khras tshod ma zin par tsher phung gi rtsa bar babs pas tsher ma'i rtsa ba na byi la rgan pa zhig yod pas khra de bzung nas bsad skad/de bzhin du gnod sems byas na nyes dmigs de dang de 'dra gzhan yang mang po 'byung bas/ des na 'o skol rnams kyis dngos su gzhan gyis tshur la gnod pa byas pa med rung / gzhan la gnod sems 'chang ba dang / yang gzhan gyis gnod pa byas pa zhe la bzhag nas de'i lan du gnod pa byed snyam pa dang /gnod pa byed mkhan kho la gnod ma nus kyang / de'i gnyen tshan nam mdza' bshes sogs la gnod ci 'khyol bya'o snyam nas/gnod sems byed mi rung /sngon sangs rgyas mi bskyod pa 'jig rten du byon nas 'gro don dpag tu med pa mdzad/ de'i bstan pa la dge slong thub dka' gzhon nu zhes bya ba zhig byung ngo / /de la slob ma thar pa nag po zhes bya ba zhig yod pas/ bla mas nges don gyi chos bstan pa khos log par go rjes su bla ma la yang dad log byas/las rgyu 'bras la mi brtsi bar pho byung tshad bsad nas sha zos/92

mo byung tshad la sbyor ba byas/ log spyod mang po byas pas shi nas lce spyang / dur phag dur bya/ khra'i lus mang po blangs/ de nas mnar med dmyal bar skyes/ de nas srin bu'i sgye ba mang po blangs/ mthar lang ka pu rir/ bdud po ru tra thar pa nag po zhes bya bar gyur/ lha 'dre thams cad bran du bkol/ sems can la gnod 'tshe chen po byas so/ /de'i tshe dge slong thub dka' gzhon nu de sangs rgyas shākya thub pa chen por gyur to/ /khong gis zhi bas mi thul/ drag pos thul ba mkhyen nas/ dpal chen po he ru ka dbu dgu phyag bco brgyad pa/ spyan nyi shu rtsa bdun yod pa/ sku la gshog sgo bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod pa zhig tu sprul te btul nas chos bstan/ bstan pa'i srung mar bskos/ ma 'ongs pa na de bzhin gshegs pa thal ba'i dbyangs zhes bya bar sangs rgyas zhes lung bstan to/ /yang sngon lag pa'i skar ma zhes bya bas sangs rgyas kyi nye gnas lo mang po'i bar du byas kyang / sangs rgyas kyis ci mdzad thams cad gsog dang gsob 'ba' zhig tu bltas pas sa gas nas dmyal bar lhung ngo / /sngon rgya gar gyi grub thob cig dang / phyi rol pa gnyis kyis phyi nang gi grub mtha'i rtsod pa byas pas/ phyi rol pas tshe phyi ma med zer/ grub thob des yod gsungs/ 'o na ston byas pas/93

grub thob des phyi rol pa khrid nas/ dmyal khams bco brgyad bstan pas/ kho yid ches pa byung skad/ yang sngon shā ri'i bu dang mo'u 'gal gyi bu gnyis dmyal bar phyin dus phyi rol mu stegs pa las rgyu 'bras med par lta ba'i log lta can gyi slob dpon zhig kyang dmyal bar skyes nas sdug bsngal myong ba mthong ngo / /de bzhin du log lta byas na nyes dmigs de dang de 'dra ba gzhan yang mang po 'byung bas/ des na 'o skol rnams kyis/skyon med pa la skyon du lta ba/ dkon mchog gsum bden pa la rdzun par lta ba/ las rgyu 'bras yod pa la med par lta ba sogs log lta'i rigs su gyur pa byed mi rung /sngon sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la/ byang chub sems dpa' blo gros chen pos sha zos pa'i nyes pa gsung du gsol zhes zhus pas/ sangs rgyas kyis bka' stsal pa/ phyogs tsam zhig bshad pa/ sems can thams cad pha ma yin pas pha ma'i sha za mi rung / gal te zos na dmyal ba ngu 'bod du skyes shing / thar nas mi sha za ba'i phra men pha dang phra men ma dang / sha mang du za ba'i seng ge dang stag dang / gzig dang / spyang ) bye la wa dang /'ug pa/ srin po sogs su skye/ mir skyes kyang snying rje med pa/ dri mi zhim zhing smad pa dang / spyon pa dang / gdol ba sme sha can gyi 94

rigs dang / btso blag mkhan du yang yang skye bar gsungs so/ /sngon rta mgrin gyi rnal 'byor pa zhig gis dngos grub cig thob khar/ rta sha zhig zos pas ma thob/ rdo rje phag mo'i rnal 'byor pa gcig gis dngos grub cig thob khar phag sha zhig zos pas ma thob skad/ ngas kyang snying rje bsgoms pas rgyud la ma skyes par yun ring song bas/ phyis sha ma zos par spangs pas snying rje rang bzhin shugs kyis skyes pa byung / sngon rgyal po seng ge 'bang bzang zhes bya bas zas su sha kho na zos pas/ phyis su sred pa cher song / mi'i sha yang zos par gyur pas/ blon 'bangs rnams kyis rgyal po yul bton nas sdug bsngal myangs/ shi nas ngan song du skyes so/ /sngon rgyal bu dad pa brtan po srin po lang ka pu ri'i yul du/ me tog ku sha na len du byon nas/ lam 'gag na mi ser po mig dmar po ral pa dmar ser rkang pa'i sar slebs pa/ sbar mo rnams lcags kyi rnam par sngo seng nge rno ba/ sna che zhing so rno ba/ lag na gser gyi ral gri thogs pa zhig 'dug pa'i drung du song / srin po rnams kyi rgyu mtshan dris pas/kho na re/ khyed rang gi ston pa shākya thub pa zhes zer ba des/bco lnga'i nyin par srin po rnams la bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa phog sha'i nyes dmigs mang po bstan/ sha de yang pha dang ma'i 95

sha 'ba' zhig yin thams cad kyis chod gsungs kyang / nged srin po rnams kyi za skal sha khrag yin pas/ tshes bco lnga ma gtogs dus thams cad du gcod ma nus/ 'on kyang khyed mi rnams dang mi 'dra tsham tshom la dam bca' mi byed/ dam bcas nas bcas pa las mi 'da' ba nged kyi lugs yin/ da khyod dus khyad par can tshes bco lnga'i nyin par 'byon dgos/ de'i nyin byon na gnod pa mi byed kyi steng du zhabs tog byed pa'ang srid/zer ro/ /sngon rgyal po dpa' bos rta pa brgya tsam zhig byas skyo sangs byed cing yod pa'i rtsar/ rgyal po spyod med kyis rta pa nyis brgya tsam zhig byas nas ri dwags kyi sha dmar po khyer nas byung /khyed sha dmar po 'di za'am zer ba la/ rgyal po dpa' bo na re/sha dmar po za ba srin po yang mi rung na/ mir lta smos kyang ci 'tshal/ da lta dag 'khor g.yog la sogs pa rag ste/ sdig rgyal gyi tshe la brtan pa ma thob pas lus srog dang bral tsa na/ grogs med gcig pur rkang 'gros 'bab ste/ da lta bsad pa rnams kyis lan ldon 'pham par 'gro/ ngas ni btsan po dang / phyug po dang rigs bzang ba la sogs pa sus kyang / nga btsan po yin pas ma shi ba bya ba la sogs pa gcig kyang ma mthong byas pas/96

rgyal po spyod med kha sgyengs ngo tsha dpa' zhum nas lan glan par ma nus so/ /gzhan yang lho nub yul gyi srin po rnams kyi kha gtam la/ 'di nas byang phyogs gdong dmar srin po bod kyi yul bya ba na/ sems can gye srog bcad nas sha zos khrag 'thung ba tsam du ma zad/ rus pa yan chad brdungs nas mur zhing de'i khu ba yang 'thung skad/ nged tsho las de rnams shin tu 'jigs par gda' zhes zer skad/ des na sha zos na srin po dngos yin/rus khu yan chad 'thung na srin po las 'jigs pa yin pas/'jigs rung srin po gzhan na yod par ma sems shig gzhan yang sha 'di dngos grub dang sa lam gye gegs/ ngan song gi sa bon/ srog gcod kyi gshed ma/ sha 'dis sems can gyi lus srog la gnod gnong zhig zas gzhan gang gis kyang mi gnod/sdig zas sha 'di chang dang bud med bsten pa las kyang thu ba yin pas/ kun gyis dug bzhin du spongs shig ces tshogs drug rang grol gyis gsol ba 'debs pa lags so/ /sngon bud med cig bu btsa' khar khyo ga grong gzhan zhig gi nang du chang 'thung du song ngo / /bud med kyis bu btsa' ba'i dus la bab tshe sgo mnan nas bu btsas pa'i dus/ khyo ga chang gis bzi nas yong / sgo phye zer ba bud med kyis nga bu btsas 97

pas cung zhig sgo 'byed mi nus par gda' byas pas/ der khyo bo khros nas sgo bcag nas nang du 'ongs/ khyod kyis nga la sgo mi 'byed na 'di dgos zer/ bud med de la brdungs nas 'chi tshad pa byas/ bu btsas pa de yang blangs nas bsad de ma'i kha nang du brdzangs so/ /bud med des ma zos pas/ yang bu sha de gtubs bcad myag myog tu btang nas khar brdzangs te/ da mi za na gsod pa yin zhes gri tshad pas srog la 'jigs drag nas bu de'i sha mi 'dod bzhin du za dgos byung / des na chang 'di smyo chu dngos yin pas 'thung na de lta bu'i 'phung tshabs chen po yang byed nus/ sngon rgyal blon sde dang bcas pa chang gis 'phung ba zhig lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis gzigs nas/ khong gi sprul pa lag na chang bum pa gang thogs pa zhig rgyal blon rnams kyi thad ga'i mdun gyi nam mkhar song nas chang gi bum pa bstan nas/ 'di e nyo byas pas/ rgyal blon rnams kyis nang na ci yod byas pas/ sprul pa na re/ nang na don yal/ nor yang zad par byed cing rang gzhan thams cad 'phung bar byed pa'i dug chu ngar ma lta bu'i ming la myos 'gyur gyi chang zhes bya ba de yod byas pas/ rgyal blon sde dang bcas pas chang gi nyes dmigs shes nas dug bzhin spangs pas rgyal khams thams cad bde 98

bar gyur/ yang sngon rkun ma gnyis kyis mi tshang gcig gi mdzod phug ste nor btsal bas/ chang btsag ran pa'i rdza ma gcig dang 'phrad de/ zhabs nas btsags na tshor gyes dogs nas kha nas bcus nas 'thungs pas bzi ste/ gcig na re/ ngas glu len zer ba la/ gcig po na re/ 'di ci zer bdag pos tshor na rang cag gnyis ka bsad yong / kha rog pa sdod byas kyang ma nyan par glu blangs pa/ chang kha nas btsags na 'di 'dra na/ da zhabs nas btsags na ji ltar mchi/ zer zhing bro 'khrab pas/bdag pos tshor ba byung yang khyim bdag de mi bzang po zhig yin pas ma brdungs par chang yang mnyam por 'thung skad/khyem bdag de ngan pa zhig yin na rkun ma de gnyis kyang chang gis myos nas chag sgo rin gyis nyos pa byung / yang sngon mi gcig chang gis bzi nas rta yis 'phangs drud pas lus kun dum bur chad/ rkang pa g.yas yob chen du bzung nas rta rang khyim du log nas byung skad/ yang mi gcig gis chang 'thungs/bzi nas gad kha zhig nas chab gsang byas pas gad kha nas lhung / rked pa chag nas shi ba byung / yang mi gcig gis chang 'thungs nas bzi/ tshong zong dngul rdo tshad cig yod pa yang stor skad/ gzhan yang chang 'thung na tshe 'dir 'phung ba tsam du 99

ma zad/ phyi mar dmyal ba ngu 'bod du skye zhing / khye dang smyon pa'i lus kyang mang po len par gsungs so/ /des na chang 'di nyes pa kun gyi rtsa ba yin pas/ 'o skol rnams kyis dug chu ngar ma lta bur bltas nas/ rtswa rtse'i zil ba tsam yang mi 'thung bar spang bar bya'o//sngon yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal nas/ ci 'dra ba yi las byas pa/ /'bras bu de 'dra smin par 'gyur/ /gsungs pa dang / khyad par dri mi zhim pa bdug pa las/ sna gnyer ba dang 'khyog po sogs sna skyon can dang dri ngan bro ba 'ong bar gsungs/ des na dri mi zhim pa ngan pa zhig la sgog pa dang tha ma kha las thu ba zhig gzhan na med/des na phyi ma sna skyon can dang lus las dri ngan pa 'byung bar 'dod na ma gtogs mi 'dod phyin chad gdong mi mdzes pa dang dri ngan 'byung bas rgyu'i gtso bo 'di gnyis spang dgos/sngon gyi bla ma dam pa 'ga' zhig gis/ tha ma kha yi dud pa phog tshad kyi lha klu mi ma yin phal cher brgyal 'gro zhing / la la grib phog gis dogs nas sems mi dga' bar 'bros la/ gzhan yang tha ma kha khog tu song ba'i mi de'i sems 'tshub/ chags sdang che/ rtsa dbu ma la dud pa phog pas 'pho ba btab na yang thebs 100 ༄

dka' bar gsungs/ yang bla ma kha cig gi zhal nas/ dus kyi mtha' la 'byung bas tha zhes bya/ /nyes kun gzhi ma yin pas ma zhes bya/ /kun gyi kha ru 'thung bas kha zhes zer//de phyir tha ma kha 'di spang bar bya/ /gsungs skad/ sngon bla ma zhig gi drung du bud med bdud mo gnyis byung nas/ 'dod log spyod dgos byas pa ma spyad pas/ phyir log pas lam kha nas mngal khrag sa la lhung ba la/ smon lam log pa 'di ltar btab ste/ mi gtsang ba'i rdzas ngan 'di bskal pa snyigs pa'i tha ma la sa gseb nas brog pa dang tha ma kha ru smin nas/ de kha la reg tshad/ grib kyis mnan nas bsam pa ngan du song / las ngan sdig pa bsags/ shi na dmyal bar 'gro bar gyur cig sogs smon lam log pa mang po btab skad/ des na sgog pa dang tha ma kha 'di gnyis/ mngal khrag mi gtsang ba las bskyed pas/ shin tu mi gtsang zhing dri ngan pa smon lam log pa las byung bas bkra mi shis pa'i rdzas ngan yin pas bsten mi rigs/ sngon dge slong zhig gis 'bras bu zhig thob khar sgog pa zhig zos pas ma thob pa byung / sngon 'das log kha cig dmyal bar phyin dus/ tha ma kha 'then mkhan mang po dmyal ba me mdag dud pa'i tshal sogs su skyes nas sdug bsngal myong ba mthong ba byung / 'jig rten pa'i kha gtam la 101

yang / dud 'then dmyal ba'i gting du skye/ /dud sgon de yi 'khor du skye/ /zer ba yang ma go'am/ des na tha ma kha dang sgog pa bsten na nyes dmigs de dang gzhan yang mang po yod pas khyem pa pho mo spyi dang / khyad par rab byung dge slong rnams kyis dug bzhin du spang bar bya'o/ /sngon mdza' bo'i bu mo zhes bya ba rgya mtshor rin po che len du 'gro bar chas pas/ mas 'gror ma bcug par lam bcad nas nyal ba'i mgo rdog pas phud nas song / rgya mtshor gru btang nas phyin pas gru zhig tshong ba mang po rgya mtshor nub nas shi/ mdza' bo'i bu mos shing tshal zhig la 'jus nas rgya mtsho'i mthar phyin pa'i skabs shig grong khyer zhig mthong nas song / lcags khang zhig tu phyin pas gshin rje rnams kyis sgo bcad do/ /der bltas tshe ma la gnod pa byas pa'i mi gcig gi mgo la lcags kyi 'khor lo me 'bar ba 'khor nas klad khrag 'thor bzhin sdug bsngal myong ba zhig mthong ngo / /de nas 'khor lo de 'phags nas byung /mdza' bo'i bu mo'i mgo thog tu babs nas drag tu 'khor bas mgo bo gas/ klad khrag thon/ bzod glags med pa'i sdug bsngal chen po byung nas/ 'di ltar pha ma la gnod pa byas pa rnams snying re rje/ de rnams kyi sdug bsngal bdag gis bzod par bya yi/102

de rnams 'dir mi 'ong bar gyur cig byas pas lcags kyi 'khor lo yar nam mkha' la 'phags so/ /tshe'i 'du byas nas sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha gnas su skyes/ yang sngon rna ba bye ba ri rgya mtshor rin po che len du 'gro khar/ mas bu dang gson por nam zhig 'phrad na byas ngus pas/ bu'i bsam pa la ma 'dis nga 'gro khar bkra mi shis pa byas so snyam/ khros nas ma la khyod ngan song la ci'i phyir mi blta zhes tshig ngan smras nas song / rgya mtshor zhugs nas nor bu blangs/ rgya mtsho'i 'gram du tshur thon nas/nyin gcig tshong bas bskyur/ lam stor nas song song bas ngan song gi gnas mang po mthong ba byung / yang sngon byes pa gzhon nu gcig ma la khros nas/ sdang mig bltas tshig ngan mang po smra bas/ tshe yang ring po ma lon par shi nas dmyal ba'i gnas su skyes so/ /sdang mig bltas pa'i rnam smin gyis gshin rje rnams kyis bzung nas dpral ba'i mig phyung / tshig ngan smra ba'i rnam smin la lce lkog ma'i 'og nas mar bton/ sa la brgyangs nas steng du lcags kyi phur ba 'dom gang tsam btab nas sdug bsngal myang du bcug skad/ de bzhin du drin can gyi pha ma gnyis la gnod pa cung zad re byas na yang / tshe 'dir tshe thung nad mang gtam ngan 'byung don mi 'grub/ shi na ngan song du skyes 103

nas sdug bsngal yun ring myong dgos pas/ des na 'o skol rnams kyis drin can gye pha ma la gnod pa cung zad tsam byed mi rung / gal te byas song na yang / de ma thag bshag pa byas/ phyin chad de 'dra mi byed pa'i sdom sems byed pa gces/sngon mi gcig chu chen po zhig gis khyer nas 'gro ba/ ri dwags ru ru bya bas mthong nas rgyab tu bskyon te tshur skam du blangs nas/ nags khrod 'dir nga lta bu'i ri dwags 'dug ces su la ma smra byas kyang / mi ngan khrel med de yul du song nas rgyal po la zhus/ dmag drangs nas 'ongs/ mi des rgyal po la lag pa brkyangs nas ri dwags de bstan pa'i tshe/ lag pa mkhrig ma'i mtshams nas chad de sa la lhung bar gyur/ de nas shi nas dmyal bar skyes/ yang sngon mi zhig khron pa lta bu'i nang na chu yod pa mtha' ris bskor nas 'gro sa med pa zhig tu lhung ba spre'u zhig gis mthong / snying rje nas mar song rgyab tu khur nas ri khar bton nas mi de la nga ngal dub 'dug pas gnyid dgos/ khyod kyis nga gcan gzan gzhan gyis 'tshe ba med par srungs byas gnyid pas/ mi ngan des spre'u'i drin brjed nas/ da 'di bsad nas sha za snyam ngan sems skyes/ rdo chen po zhig btegs nas brgyab pas ma phog par sa la brgyab pa'i sgra spre'us tshor nas/104

dgra gzhan zhig byung ngam snyam/ phar mchongs te tshur bltas pas kho yin par shes so/ /mi des drin lan log par 'jal ba'i rnam smin gyis yul la yang ma phyin par lam bar nas mdze nad kyis thebs/ rkang lag chad nas yun ring sdug bsngal myangs pas mthar sa gas nas mgo bo thur du bstan nas dmyal bar lhung ngo / /des na phan pa'i lan du de 'dra'i gnod pa gtan nas byed mi rung / sngon rgyal po zhig gi g.yog mos khye rnams dus rtag tu btags nas lto yang mi ster bar/ khye yi lto skal phyed lkog nas btsongs nas rgyan cha 'dra nyos/ khye gcig tsam zhig ltogs grir 'chi ru bcug pa'i rnam smin gyis/ g.yog mo de shi nas dmyal ba'i bar lam zhig na khye mo zhig tu skyes/tsher phung dmar po zhig la lcags thag dmar po zhig gis kyang dus rgyun du btags pas kha nas me dmar po 'bar zhing ltogs skom gyis gdungs nas sdug bsngal bzod glags med pa myangs/ sngon tshong dpon zheg gis bong bu zhig ded nas tshong la song bas/ khal lci bas bong bu 'gro rgyu chen po ma byung ba la kho khong khro langs nas/ dbyug pa zhig gis mang po brdungs pa'i rnam smin gyis/ shi nas dmyal ba'i gnas su skyes/ gshin rje skyes bu mdog mi sdug pa snying rje med pa khro zhing gtum pa zhig 105

gis mi de bzung kha sbub tu bsgyel nas/ lcags kyi dbyug pa gru bzhi pa zhig gis brdungs nas sdug bsngal chen po byung ngo / /de bzhin du khye la lto ma byen pa dang bong bu sogs sgo phyugs la brdungs na nyes dmigs de 'dra ba 'byung bas/ des na khyed khyim pa rnams kyis khyi'i nang nub kyi lto chag tu 'jug mi rung /bong bu rta glang mdzo g.yag sogs la khal lci mo bkal/ rdeg rdung byed mi rung / sngon khyim bdag gi bu dga' ba'i blo gros dang / khyem bdag gi bu mo dpal gyi 'od zer zhes bya ba gnyis gcig la gcig chags nas nyin yang mnyam du sdod/ mtshan yang lhan du nyal ba las/ dus nam zhig gi tshe bu mo de pha mas khyim thab gzhan zhig la btang bas/ khye'u de bu mo de la chags bzhin du shi bas/ bu mo de'i mngal gyi srin bur skyes so/ /bu mo de'i mngal na nas sangs rgyas 'khor bcas gdan drangs nas bu mo 'di nad 'di lta bus mnar ba las ci 'dra zhig yin nam zhes sangs rgyas la zhus pas/ sangs rgyas kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyem bdag gi bu dga' ba'i blo gros de bu mo 'di la chags bzhin du shi ba de slar bu mo 'di'i mngal gyi nang gi srin bur skyes te mngal na bar gyur to/ /skye ba 'dir ma zad skye ba lnga brgya'i bar du gang du 106

skyes pa dang / bu mo 'di'i mngal gyi srin bur skye bar 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang dmyal ba sogs su skyes nas kyang sdug bsngal yun ring myong bar 'gyur gsungs/ sngon bud med cig 'chi khar bu gcig yod pa la chags zhen drag po skyes nas shi bas bu yi gos kyi gong ba'i shig tu sgyes pa bu yis ma yin par ma shes par blangs nas sen mo'i bar du bcar nas bsad kyang / da dung chags zhen ma chod par bu yi lus kyi shig tu skyes nas yang yang bsad nas sdug bsngal myangs/ sngon dgon pa'i ja ma zhig dge 'dun pa'i ja thug la chags bzhin du shi nas/ dge 'dun pa rnams la ja thug skol snod rdo las grub pa zhig yod pa'i mthil gyi rdo gseb tu sbal ba zhig tu skyes/ me btang ba dang tsha nas skad 'don/ me bzhag pa dang skad mi grag pa de grwa pa gzhon nu rnams kyis rgan pa la dris pas/ rgan pa kha cig na re/sngon nas 'di 'dra yod/ rdo gseb tu chu song ba min nam zer/nyin gcig rdo snod de skad chen po dang bcas gas nas song ba la bltas tshe/ mthil nas sbal ba ril ma tsam zhig byung skad/yang sngon dge slong zhig lhung bzed legs po zhig yod pa de la chags bzhin du shi nas sbrul zhig tu skyes/ lhung bzed nang du 'khyil ba bton nas 'phangs pas shi nas dmyal ba'i me nang 107

du skyes/ yang dge slong zhig snam sbyar legs po zhig yod pa la chags bzhin du shi bas bye la zhig tu skyes/ snam sbyar bar du bsdad skad/ des na bu dang chung ma zas gos nor rdzas gang la chags rung lus ngan pa blangs nas sdug bsngal myong bas/ gang la yang chags zhen skye mi rung / sngon sangs rgyas 'od srungs kyi bstan pa la dge slong khab len dang sran can gnyis kyis tshe gang po tshul khrims legs par bsrungs kyang / 'chi khar dgra bcom pa zhig la khong khro skyes nas shi bas gnyis ka dmyal ba mnar med du lhung / sngon sangs rgyas kyi dus su dge slong rgan pa zhig nye gnas gzhon pa zhig yod pa la dus rgyun du tshig pa za zhing / khyad par nyin gcig khong khro chen po langs pa'i mthus lus ma spangs par skad cig de nyid la sbrul chen po zhig tu gyur/khri 'og tu mar babs song bsdad nas nye gnas bsgugs nas gsod grabs byas tshe/ nye gnas grwa pa gzhon pa des shes nas bros so/ /sngon dge tshul zhig klu rnams la khros nas smon lam log pa btab pas/ de ma thag yan lag rnams nas chu zags nas klu rnams la gnod pa'i klu ma rungs pa zhig tu gyur/ klu gzhan la klad pa'i nad btang nas bsad do/ /des na rang gzhan thams cad 'phung byed khong khro 'di yin pas/ dgra yi rtsa 108

bar bzung nas khong khro nam byung yang de ma thag pang du dug sbrul byung ba 'dor ba ltar rgyang ring du dor bar bya'o/ /sngon bud med ser sna can zhig gis mchod sbyin byed pa phar zhog g.yog po g.yog mo la yang lto mi ster g.yo sgyu byas/ mo rang gis g.yog po g.yog mo dang lhan du lto za dus/ lto chen po mi za ba'i khul byas/ de yang myur du zos langs nas las ka 'dra byas te/ g.yog po rnams la khyem bdag ma nga rang gis kyang lto chen po mi za na khyed g.yog po rnams kyis lto chen ngo ga la za rung / da myur du zo las ka la rgyugs zer/ lto chen po mi ster/byen pa de yang bag phab nas za khom med par las ka byed du 'jug de rnams gzhan du song ba dang / mo rang gis lto zhim po dang mang po bzos nas yod tshad zos nas bsdad/ g.yog po rnams nang du 'ongs pa dang sngar rgyun ltar mi za ba'i khul byas/nyin gcig 'bri 'jo ba'i sgang la/ be'u btags yod pa shor nas 'o ma bsgyel nas sa la pho bas/ mo tshig pa zos/ mgo la dbyug pa brgyab pas be'u'i mig la phog pas mig ya gcig bcar/ de nas bud med ngan ma de shi nas/ ser sna byas pa'i rnam smin gyes yi dwags sdong dum mes tshig pa bzhin mdog nag pa/ skra gzengs/ rgyu ma stong pa sgal tshigs la 'byar ba/109

rkang lag phra ba zhig tu skyes/ sngon be'u'i mig bcar ba'i rnam smin gyis mig ya gcig zhar ba/ sngon kha nas ngas kyang zas chen po mi za zhes rdzun byas pa'i rnam smin gyis/ kha khab mig ltar chung zhing mgrin pa rta rnga tsam phra ba/ skog nas zas mang po zos pa'i rnam smin gyis/ mgrin par lba ba chen po byung / mgrin pa phra bas mgo dang lba ba gnyis mi theg cing / ltogs skom nas sdug bsngal chen bo myangs skad/ des na ser sna byas g.yog po g.yog mo tshor lto ma byin na de 'dra yong bas/ 'di skye pho mo spyi dang /khyad par bud med rnams kyi sems la gzhag 'tshal/ sngon shā ri'i bu dang / mo'u 'gal gye bu gnyis khams bsang du mchis pa'i sa na/ yi dwags mo sngo la skam pa/ skra 'dzings pa/ mig dmar la g.yon du yo ba/ mchu ring la g.yas su yo ba/ kha nas nga dgos/ med ma sbyin/ ster na che bar 'ong / ches cher bri la byin zhes/ sgra rnam pa lnga brjod pa skyi zing nge ba zhig dang 'phrad pas/ de sangs rgyas la zhus pas/ bka' stsal pa/ sngon ser sna byas pa'i dbang gis yi dwags su skyes/ gzhan la mig gis mi legs par bltas pas mig yo ba byung / ster na che bar 'ong zhes pas mchu ring la yo ba byung / sngon brjod pa'i bag chags ngan pa'i dbang gis kha nas sgra rnam pa lnga sgogs pa yin 110

gsungs/ des na zas nor gang la yang ser sna byed mi rung /sngon bud med gcig gis gzhan gyis sbyin pa gtong ba zhig gtong du ma bcug par sbyin pa'i kha 'gegs byas pa'i rnam smin gyis shi nas bud med nor yod kyang dbang med pa zhig tu skyes nas sbyin pa sna gcig gtong rgyu'i skal ba ma byung / des na gzhan gyis sbyin pa gtong ba'i grogs byed ma nus rung / sbyin pa'i kha 'gog mi rung ngo / /smras pa/ rnam 'dren rgyal ba stong gi nang nas kyang / /pad dkar lta bur bsngags pa'i bcom ldan 'das/ /bdag gi spyi gtsug 'khor lo'i rgyan du bzhugs/ /spyi bor brgyan nas de gsung glu ru len/ /sngon tshe mi rnams tshe lo brgya ba'i dus/ /ston pa sangs rgyas zhing 'dir byon pa'i tshe/ /tshangs pas gser gye 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang / /brgya byin gyis kyang dung dkar g.yas 'khyil phul/ /'gro la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor dgos zhes/ /rab tu gus pas gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ /wā rā ṇa ste bya rgod phung po'i ri/ /yangs pa can sogs rgya gar 'phags yul na/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing kun 'od kyis 'gengs bzhin du/ /lha mi yongs la chos 'khor bskor ba rnams/ /rgyas par phye na bsam gyis mi khyab kyang / /bsdu na sdig spong dge sgrub gnyis su 111

'dus/ /mi dge bcu bo chen po byas gyur na/ /dmyal bar skye zhing 'bring tsam byas pa rnams/ /yi dwags skye zhing chung ngu tsam byas pa/ /dud 'gro'i gnas su skyes nas sdug bsngal myong / /gal te ngan song gsum gyi gnas ngan nas/ /thar nas mi yi gnas su skyes na yang / /srog gcod byas pas tshe thung nad mang zhing / /ma byen blangs pas 'byor ba chung bar 'gyur/ /mi tshangs spyad pas khyem thab yid mi 'ong / /rdzun tshig smra bas gzhan gyis skur ba 'debs/ /phra ma smra bas gnyen bshes 'byed pa mang tshig rtsub smra bas mi snyan gtam ngan thos/ /ngag 'khyal smra bas tshig la yid mi ches/ /brnab sems byas pas bsam pa'i don mi 'grub/ /gnod sems byas pas dgra dang 'jigs skrag mang / /log lta byas pas lta ba ngan par 'gyur/ /de phyir ston pa sangs rgyas gsung bzhin du/ /srog gcod ma byen len dang mi tshangs spyod/ /dzun dang phra ma tshig rtsub ngag 'khyal dang / /brnab sems gnod sems log par lta ba ste/ /mi dge sdig pa bcu bo dug bzhin spongs/ /gzhan yang rang gzhan 'phung byed myos 'gyur chang / /sems can srog la 'tshe ba'i sdig zas sha /nyes kun gzhi ma bkra mi shis pa'i rdzas/ /sgog tsong tha ma kha rnams spang bar bya/ /'khor ba spyi dang khyad par ngan song rgyu/ /pha ma drin can 112

rnams la gnod cing 'tshe/ /bran g.yog sgo phyugs rnams la sdang ba dang / /chags sdang ser sna la sogs byed mi rung / /thub pa'i dbang po'i gsung rab dgongs don ltar/ /mi dge sdig pa'i las rnams spong ba'i tshul/ /kun gyis tshig don go sla yid ches phyir/ /gtam rgyud mang po sbyar nas bshad zin to/ /da ni nyi ma'i gnyen gyi gsung bzhin du/ /rnam dkar dge ba'i 'chi med bdud rtsi de/ /ngom pa med pa kun gyes 'thung ba'i tshul/ /'dir ni gsal bar bshad kyis legs par nyon//de yang mnyam med bu ram shing pas rnam dkar gyi dge ba sgrub tshul gsungs pa rnams 'dir kun gyis go sla ba'i phyir gtam rgyud dang sbyar nas bshad par bya ste/ sngon rgan mo zhig gis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la mar me chung ngu zhig phul bas/ sangs rgyas kyis rgan mo de ma 'ongs pa na sangs rgyas mar me 'od ces bya ba dbang bcu dang ldan pa zhig tu 'gyur zhes lung bstan pa byung / gzhan yang mar me phul na tshe 'dir bgegs bar chad zhi ba dang 'chi khar shes pa gsal ba dang /bar dor mun pa mi 'thib pa dang / gal te mun pa 'thibs kyang 'od snang byung nas bsal nas lam rnyed pa dang / sangs rgyas ma thob bar du gang du skyes kyang gzugs byad mdzes pa 113

dang / mthar thug mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku thob pa sogs phan yon mtha' yas pas/ des na lha la mar me 'bul ba la brtson par bya/ sngon mi gcig gis zan snum can zhig me kha na bzhag pas snum me nang du thigs pa la rtse mtshar lta bur kha nas bcom ldan me lha mchod ces smra bas/ me lhas dngos grub byen te/longs spyod dpag tu med pa byung ba dang / rab 'jigs kyis gser bum pa gang rnyed dus/ 'di'i thog nas dkon mchog gsum po la lan cig mchod pa zhig 'bul snyam pa'i bsam pa legs po zhig skyes pa byung / phyis mchod pa 'bul rgyu ma byung yang / lan cig bsam pa bzang po de skyes pa'i mthus tshe rabs mang por gser la sogs rin po che la longs spyod rgyu'i skal ba byung / dkon mchog mchod ces kha nas 'don rgyu byung ba dang /mchod snyam pa'i bsam pa re skyes na yang phan yon de lta bu 'byung na/ snying thag pa nas dkon mchog mchod na phan yon rgya chen po 'byung ba smos ci dgos/ des na 'o skol rnams kyis spos mar me zhal zas la sogs kyis dkon mchog mchod pa la yang brtson par bya'o/ / sngon sangs rgyas gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i dus su/ dge slong chos smra ba des pa zhes bya ba la/ yul de'i rgyan po rgyal ba po zhes 114

bya bas gdugs dang mchil lham bla gos mgron bu lnga phul nas smon lam btab/ dge slong des kyang yon bsngo ba byas nas/ mi de yul du 'ongs pas chu'i khron pa'i nang nas/ gser dngul brdol nas chu bum chen po zhig gi lnga tsam len rgyu byung / de nas kyang mchod sbyin rgya chen po byas pas/ yul de'i rgyal por gyur/de nas sngar gyi de bas kyang mchod sbyin rgya chen po byas pas shi nas/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed/ 'phrul dga'/ dga' ldan/sum cu rtsa gsum rnams kyi rgyal po bye ba phrag du mar byas/ de nas mi'i rgyal po bsod nams zhes bya ba btsas pa'i tshe/ lha'i rin po che'i char pus mo nub pa babs shing / dbang che bar grags pa/ bsam pa tsam gyes dgos 'dod thams cad char bzhin 'bab par gyur/ mthar rgyal ba shākya thub par gyur to/ /sngon tshe dang ldan pa kā tyā ya na'i bu chen po 'khor lnga brgya dang bcas par/ bram ze'i bu mo skra can gyis ma la rang gi skra bcad nas btsong du bcug nas /rṣa pa na lnga brgya khugs pas 'tsho ba sbyar nas drangs pas/ ring po ma lon par/ bu mo de rgyal po gtum po rab snang gi btsun mor blangs/ ming la btsun mo zhi ba zhes bya bar grags/ dpal 'byor chen po dang ldan par gyur/ma de la rgyal pos gsang ba'i rgyan lnga/ phyi rol gyi rgyan brgyad/ grong 115

khyer mchog lnga byin pas bde zhing skyid par gyur/ sngon bram ze bza' mi gnyis kyis/ rang sangs rgyas shig la chos ston zhig drangs pas/ de'i bsod nams kyis tshe de nyid la zhing gi steng du gser gye snye ma 'khrungs nas tshe gang po bde skyid tshad med pa byung / sngon byes pa gcig gis sangs rgyas la sa lag pa gang phul bas/ 'dzam gling phyed dbang ba'i chos rgyal mya ngan med ces bya bar gyur/ rgan mo zhig gis 'phags pa kā tyā ya na la/chu lhung bzed gang drangs pas/ sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha gnas su skyes/ sngon ma bzang mo dang / bu ge sar gnyis la rgyags chad nas yod pa'i skabs shig dge slong bsod snyoms pa zhig byung ba la 'bras phul gang yod pa de 'dren snyam/ zangs su btsos pas mang du 'phel ba byung / de drangs pas bsod nams chen po skyes te/ ge sar shar gyi nags khrod du phyin pas ci bsam 'grub pa'i lham rnyed/ nub kyi nags khrod du phyin pas lha sman gyes 'tsho ba'i g.yang rkyal byin pa khyer 'ongs/ g.yang rkyal nas zas phun sum tshogs pa byung ba ma la byin/ ma bu gnyis po skyid po byung /bram ze'i bu mo zhig gis dge slong zhig la khab cig phul bas 'phags pa shā ri'i bur gyur/ skyu ru ra zhig phul bas/ stong 'khor los sgyur rgyal dang 'gran pa'i longs spyod can zhig tu 116

gyur/ mi dbul po zhig gis gzhan ci yang ma 'byor bar rde'u spar gang rin po che sna tshogs par dmigs nas/ dge 'dun pa'i tshogs gral du gtor bas phyis mir skyes/ skyes ma thag tu rin po che sna bdun gye char babs nas khyim gang ba dang / yang mi dbul po gnyis kyis/ gzhan gyis dge 'dun pa mang po la mang ja rgyag pa'i nang du/ 'o ma mar gyis 'brel ba cung zad re bzhag pas/ phyis 'o ma dang mar khu'i rgya mtsho la longs spyod rgyu'i skal ba byung / sprang po zhig gis dge 'dun pa mang po mthong nas/ snga dro 'di rnams mchod rgyu'i skal ba re byung na ang snyam pas bsod nams chen po skyes nas/ phyi dro dpon po zhig gi tshab byed rgyu byung nas bsam pa'i nang ltar dge 'dun pa rnams mchod rgyu'i skal ba byung / de bzhin du dge 'dun pa rnams la dngos bo cung zad res mchod pa dang / mchod snyam pa re byung na yang phan yon de lta bu 'byung bas/ snying thag pa nas dge 'dun pa la bsnyen bkur byas/ mchod na phan yon rgya chen po 'byung ba smos ci dgos/ des na 'o skol rnams kyis dge 'dun pa mang po la ja thug dang 'gyed gtong ba dang / de 'dra mi nus pa rnams kyis kyang dge 'dun pa bzhi sde/ tha na re re yan chad la ja phor ba gang re gtsang ma byas 'dren pa sogs che 'byor 117

chung 'byor gyi sgo nas dge 'dun pa rnams mchod bstod bkur ba la brtson par bya'o/ /sngon bcom ldan 'das rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs dus/ dge slong rnams la bka' sa ba pa/ khyim gang dag na pha ma gnyis la legs par ri mor byed pa dang / legs par mchod par byed pa dang /legs par g.yog byed pa'i khyim de dag ni/ tshangs pa dang /slob dpon dang / sbyin pa'i 'os su gyur pa dang /mi dang lha dang ldan pa yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ pha ma gnyis ni rig pa'i sgo nas de dag dang 'dra ba'i phyir ro zhes tshigs su bcad nas bka' stsal pa/ pha ma gnyis ni tshangs pa ste/ /de bzhin dang po slob dpon yin/ /bu yis kun sbyin 'os gyur pa/ /mi yang yin la lha yang yin/ /de phyir de gnyis phyag gi gnas/ /dril ba dang ni khrus rnams dang / /rkang pa dag kyang bkur ba dang / /yang na zas dang skom rnams dang / /gos dang mal cha stan rnams kyis/ /mkhas pa dag gis bkur sti bya/ /pha ma dag la bkur byas pa/ /des na mkhas pa de dag ni/ /'dir yang smad par mi 'gyur la/ /shi na mtho ris 'gro bar 'gyur/ /gsungs pas/ dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par 118

shestod do/ /sngon mdza' bo'i bu mos tshong byas/ nyin gcig gaste pa na bzhi/ nyin gcig brgyad/ nyin gcig bcu drug nyin gcig sum cu rnyed pa ma la byen pas/ tshe der rgya mtsho'i gling du phyin nas/ grong khyer chen po bzhi la rim bzhin song ngo / /grong khyer gcig tu sngon la phyin pas lha mo bzhi 'ongs nas sngon nas bsus nang du bos nas song mchod do/ /yang grong khyer gcig tu phyin pas lha mo brgyad kyis mchod/ yang grong khyer gcig tu phyin pas lha mo bcu drug gis mchod/ yang grong khyer gcig tu phyin pas lha mo sum cus mchod nas/ de dag rnams su lo mang po'i bar du dga' mgur spyad nas bde skyid tshad med pa myangs so/ /de bzhin du pha ma mchod na/ tshe 'dir yang lha mi'i dpal 'byor mang po thob cing snyan pa dang grags pa che/ shi na yang mtho ris lha mi'i nang du sgyes nas bde zhing skyid par 'gyur bas/ des na 'o skol rnams kyis rgas pa'i drin can gye pha ma gnyis rtag tu lha bzhin bkur nas zas zhim po gos 'jam yang / gtam snyan po'i sgo nas mchod par bya'o/ /sngon bud med cig gis ngan slong zhig la lto zhig byin pas rin po che sna lnga las grub pa'i khang pa zhig tu ro brgya ldan pa'i zas za ba zhig tu skyes pa dang / sngon rdzi bo gcig gis zan zhig 119

zos pa'i lhag ma cung zhig yod pa grog tshang zhig la btab pas/yul gru chen po zhig gi rgyal po ra skyes pa dang / bud med cig gis khye 'khyams shig la lto 'khru bshal zhig blud pas/ shi nas mi lus glang gi mgo can zhig gis bud med de khrid nas dmyal ba'i gnas su 'gro ba'i lam 'og nas mi lus khye mgo can zhig byung nas glang mgo can de la 'dzing res byas pa'i bar der bud med de lam dkar po zhig la zhugs nas mtho ris su song ngo / /gzhan yang dbul po la lto zan changs gcig byin kyang ma 'ongs pa na brgya 'gyur gye longs spyod 'byung / myur mo byas byen na rang gi don gang yin yang myur mor 'grub/ khye sogs kyi 'jigs pa 'ong du ma bcug na/ sa gang du song yang 'jigs pa mi yong / rang gi lag gis byen na/ rang gi lag tu zas nor 'jog mkhan mang po 'byung / dbul por sbyin pa btang na sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad dgyes pas mchod pa'i mchog tu 'gyur/ lha rnams dga' nas srung skyob byed/ mi rnams dga' nas snyan pa dang grags pa chen po 'byung / de'i shugs kyis nor longs spyod gnang mkhan dang 'bul mkhan yang mang po 'byung / lha mi thams cad kyis mchod bstod bkur nas tshe 'dir yang bde skyid snyan gsum 'byung / phyi mar lha dang mi'i 120

nang du skyes na yang phyug po nor ldan gyi rigs su skye/ nor longs spyod bsam gyes mi khyab pa 'byung / de dus kyang sngon gyi bag chags bzang po sad nas mchod sbyin byed 'dod 'byung /byas na mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang yang bde blag tu thob pas/ chos byed nus na dbul por sbyin pa btang ba 'di kho nas chog 'di las lhag pa'i chos gzhan mi dgos/ des na 'o skol rnams kyis dbul po ngan slong la sbyin pa gtong ba shin tu gal che bas lag len la rgyun du 'debs dgos/sngon dge slong gcig gis mchod rten zhig la phyag cig phul bas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhal nas/ dge slong 'di'i lus kyis ci tsam mnan pa de tsam gyis/ 'di nas dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi la thug gi bar na rdul phran ci yod kyi grangs las stong 'gyur gyis stong 'khor los sgyur rgyal gyi lus len zhes gsungs/sngon khye zhig phag gis bdas pas mchod rten zhig la skor ba lan cig byas pa'i bsod nams kyi mthus/ mthar khyem bdag dpal skyes zhes bya bar gyur nas dgra bcom pa'i go 'phang thob par gsungs/ de bzhin du phyag dang skor ba byas na sdig sgrib 'dag pa sogs phan yon gzhan yang mang po yod pas/des na sku gsung thugs rten la phyag skor byed pa yang brtson 121

par bya'o/ /sngon bram ze zhig gis mchod rten zhig gi kha dog ser po byas/ dri bzang gi lag ris sum cu byas pas/ phyis sangs rgyas kyi dus gcung dga' bo zhes bya ba sku lus gser gyi mdog lta bu mtshan bzang sum cus brgyan pa de byung / sngon phag cig lus la 'dam gyis gos pa/ mchod rten la drud pas mchod rten gyi gas kha zub pas sum cu rtsa gsum gye lha'i gnas su skyes/des na mchod rten rnying ba la zhig gso/ sku dkar gsol ba sogs byas na phan yon de dang de 'dra gzhan yang yod pas/ de sems la bzhag nas brtson par bya'o/ /sngon mi gcig gis lam 'phrang dog po zhig na yar mar la 'gro ba'i rkang pa la gnod pa'i rdo zhig yod pa bton nas 'phangs pas/ shi nas gshin rje chos rgyal gyis yar btang bas/ mi yul du log ma ṇi yi ge drug ma bgrangs pas sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams shig tu skyes skad/gzhan yang gru zam dang lam ngan bcos na tshe la bar chad med pa dang / tshe gegs 'dra byung ba rnams kyang grol bas sku rim gye mchog tu 'gyur/ phyi mar bar do'i 'phrang la bgrod mi dgos/bde ba'i lam la zhugs nas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing du 'gro ba dang / sa lam rim gyis bsgral nas sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob pa'i skal ba yod pas/ des na gru zam dang lam ngan pa 122

bco ba la yang brtson par bya'o/ /sngon sangs rgyas 'od srungs kyi bstan pa la/ bram ze zhig gis bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad pa'i sdom pa blangs nas bsrungs pas mi yi rgyal por skyes/ rgyal po des kyang bsnyen gnas bsrungs pas lhar skyes/ lha des kyang sangs rgyas kyi drung nas bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad pa'i sdom pa blangs te/ chos nyan pas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob/sngon grong dpon zhig gis srog gcod kyi sdom pa nyin gcig tsam bsrungs pas/ mthar sangs rgyas phan bzhed ces bya bar sangs rgyas/ sngon bud med cig gis rang gi khyo ga tshong du song shul nas skyes pa gzhan zhig btsal bas/ bus ngas pha yong na bshad byas pas/ ma tshig pa zos nas bu la rkang tho brgyab pas bu shi ba byung / de nas khyo ga 'ongs pas shes nas dgung mo sang gi da tsam khyod la ngas ster ro byas pas/ bud med 'jigs nas dgung mo chang la dug btab nas byen pas/ tshong ba dpon g.yog bcu lhag cig sdeb gcig la shi ba byung / de nas bud med rgas nas 'gyod pa drag po byung / bla ma zhig la zhus pas bla ma des rgan mo la smyung gnas bsrung du bcug pas/ sdig sgrib kyi dbang gis nyin gcig ltogs nas zas zos/ nyin gcig skom nas chang 'thungs/ nyin gcig legs par bsrungs pas rjes 123

su shi nas/ smyung gnas lan gcig bsrungs pa'i mthus sdig sgrib de kun dag nas rgyal po zhig gi bur skyes/ de'i tshe sngon smyung gnas bsrung dus lto zos pas mdog mi sdug par gyur/chang 'thungs pas smyon pa bzhin shes pa mtho dman can zhig byung skad/ des na bsnyen gnas dang smyung gnas lan re tsam bsrung na sdig pa 'dag cing lha dang mi'i nang gi drag shos su skyes nas mthar sangs yang rgya bas/ des na khyim pa pho mo sogs kyis tshegs chung don che ba'i bsnyen gnas dang smyung gnas bsrung ba la yang brtson par mdzod cigasngon ra dza zhes bya ba/ las ka skyabs 'gro nor du dad pa/zas su bsod snyoms byed pa zhig bod phyogs mdo khams yul du phyin pas/ khyim bdag gcig la zas bslangs pas/ mar zan zhig byen pa khyer nas phyin pa na khye rgan po stobs med pa zhig lam ga'i bzhi mdo na nyal ba mthong nas/ 'di mi zas bsten dgos pas za rgyu med pa snying rje snyam/ zan de khye la byin nas khang bzang zhig tu phyin pas mi mang po shi ba mthong nas/ rtogs 7ldan a tsa ra gsum khrid nas yong / bzhi po der bsdad pas srod la gdon mig mang po can zhig mngon sum du 'ongs/ phu brgyab nas mar me bsad pas/ rtogs ldan rnams kyis gtor 124

rgyag byas kyang ma thub par tshur rtogs ldan a tsa ra gsum po dus gcig la bsad do/ /ra dza la khyod blo dkon mchog la gtod nges pas mi gsod zas zo zer gdon de song / de'i phyi nyin dge slong bgres po zhig khrid nas 'ongs der bsdad pas/srod la gdon byung nas mar me la phu brgyab pas gsod ma nus/dge slong bgres pos se gol zhig gtogs pas mig mang de gan rkyal du 'gyel ba byung / de nas dam la btags so/ /sngon rgya gar shar phyogs ka ma ru ba'i byang phyogs la 'o bar ba ta zhes bya ba na/ gnod sbyin a lang 'bar zhes bya bas zhag re la mi re khyer nas za ba la/ zhag gcig bram ze'i bu mo dge bsnyen bde ma zhes bya ba zhig la za res babs nas/ dge bsnyen bde ma long 'khrid dang 'khar ba la brten pa des/ lha dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 'gro byed kyin 'khor zhing khrol khrol/ gnod sbyin gyi rtsar phyin pas/ gnod sbyin des me dpung chen po zhig tu mthong nas za bar ma nus so/ /yang rgya gar shar phyogs na/ dge slong zhig skyabs 'gro byed cing yod pa la/ gshin rje'i tshogs dpag tu med pas dge slong de za bsams nas phyin pas/ dge slong gi rtsar slebs pa dang / bcom ldan 'das shākya thub par mthong nas phyag skor byas so/ /yang dge slong bgres gzhon 125

gsum lam du song bas/ bgres po des skyabs 'gro byed kyin phyin/ gzhon pa gnyis kyis long gtam mang po lab kyin song bas/ jag pa mang por 'phrad pas/ jag pa rnams na re/ dge slong bgres po 'di chos par 'dug pas thongs/ gzhon pa gnyis mi nag skye bo dang khyad mi 'dug pas khyigs shig zer/bsha' lug bzhin du bkyigs/ sgog pa bzhin du bshus/ snye phung bzhin du brdungs/ brkus nor bzhin du grog phug cig tu sbas so/ /de bzhin du skyabs 'gro byas na mi dang mi ma yin gyi gnod pas mi tshugs pa dang / gzhan yang sdig sgrib 'dag pa/ nyams rtogs 'char ba/ myur du sangs rgya ba sogs phan yon gzhan yang mang po yod pas/ nang nub kun tu dkon mchog la skyabs su 'gro ba la brtson par bya'o/ /sngon st+waṃ ga la'i bud med cig gi khyo bo shi nas yi dwags shig tu skyes/ rtag tu nang du 'ong ba la/ yul dbus kyi tshong dpon zhig der 'ongs nas/ spyan ras gzigs kyi sgom bzlas byed kyin bsdad pas yi dwags de nang du 'ong ma nus pas/ bud med des tshong dpon la spyan ras gzigs kyi sgom bzlas zhus nas nyams su blangs pas de nas bzung ste yi dwags de ma 'ongs/bud med de yang mthar grub pa thob pa byung / yang phyi rol pa mu 126

stegs pa zhig la mdze byung nas/ nad pa dang mthun pa'i bsod nams bsags skyabs 'gro dang bshag pa byas/ ma ṇi yi ge drug ma tshad med pa bzhi dang sbyar nas bzlas pas mdze nad las grol nas lus sngar bzhin du gyur/ da dung yang de bzhin du dka' thub chen pos sgrub pa rtse gcig tu byas pas grub pa thob ste lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod du gshegs zhes grags so/ /sngon rgya gar lho phyogs su bstan pa dar ba'i tshe/ grong khyer chen po zhig na/ tshong dpon gyi bu su kha de ba zhes bya ba zhig yod pa des/ paṇḍi ta zhig la ma ṇi yi ge drug ma zhus nas/ bud med kyi g.yog byas nas lo bcu gnyis bsgrubs pa'i rmi lam du 'phags pa'i zhal gzigs te po ta lar 'deng gsung ngo / /bdag 'gro ste slob dpon la 'dri dgos zhes zhus nas gnyid sad pa dang /slob dpon dang g.yog la dris pas/ de nged gnyis kyi'ang drin yin pas/ nged gnyis kyang 'khrid dgos byas pas/ yang sgrub pa yun ring byas pas/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs mngon sum du byon nas/ dpon g.yog gsum ga po ta la'i zhing khams su 'khrid dus/ su kha de ba kha phyir phyogs nas smras pa/ ltos shig sngags kyi nus pa dag /che bas nga yang grub pa thob/ /bya ba thams cad yongs spong la/ /sngags kyi bya ba sgrub par gyes/ /127

gsungs nas po ta lar gshegs so/ /sngon rgya gar lho phyogs su bstan pa dar ba'i tshe/ gtsug lag khang chen po zhig na/ paṇḍi ta ting nge 'dzin la brtan pa thob pa zhig nyin re bzhin du snga dro po ta lar gshegs nas thugs rje chen po la chos gsan pas/ de la g.yog dge bsnyen zhig yod pas/ nga yang lan cig 'khrid dgos zhus pas/ ngas 'phags pa la zhu gsungs/ de'i phyi nyin phebs nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la/ nga'i nye gnas dge bsnyen de khrid yong na chog gam zhus pas/ 'phags pa'i zhal nas/ dge bsnyen des las ngan chen po byas pas da myur du dmyal bar skye bas nga dang mjal ba'i skal ba med gsungs/las ngan pa ci byas zhus pas/ khyed rang gi gtsug lag khang gi brgyad stong pa dngul gyi glegs bam la gser gyis bris pa'i shog bu gnyis brkus nas gzugs mchog ma la byen gsungs/de nas phyir phebs te 'phags pa'i gsung de dge bsnyen la bshad pas kho shin tu ngo tsha/ dmyal bar skye bar 'jigs nas ngus te/ bdag las ngan 'di las thar pa'i thabs shig thugs rjes gzung du gsol zhes zhus pas/ yi ge drug pa'i sgom bzlas rdzogs par gnang nas/ lho phyogs dpal gyi ri'i nags gseb cig tu sdong po zhig gi khog par bsdad pas/ shing de'i pags pa 128

za zhing lo bcu gnyis bar du bsgrubs pas grub pa thob/ klu'i dbang po nor rgyas kyis 'tsho ba sbyar ba bzhes so/ /de nas bzung ste 'jig rten du ka ma la go mi zhes bya ba'i grub thob chen por grags so/ /sngon slob dpon dga' rab rdo rjes oṃ ma ṇi padme hūṃ zhes lan gcig tsam ma gtogs bgrang ma dgos par skad cig de nyid la sangs rgyas so/ /de bzhin du sbyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi sgom bzlas byas na phan yon de dang de 'dra gzhan yang mang po yod pas/ lo rgyus de rnams la yid ches par byas nas/ bod kyi lha skal 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs 'di kun gye lhag pa'i lha ru bsten cing / chos thams cad kyi snying po ma ṇi yi ge drug ma chu bo'i rgyun bzhin du bgrang ba la brtson pa gces so/ /sngon rje nā ro pas/ bde mchog yi ge bdun pa'i bsnyen pa 'bum phrag cig bzlas pas/ sa g.yos shing lung bstan thob pa byung / sngon slob dpon zla grags sgu tshegs pa'i tshe/rgan mo gcig gi bu mo bag mar gtong ba'i phyir nor bslangs pas/ slob dpon la na bza' dang chos po ti gcig ma gtogs gzhan ci yang med pas/ rgan mo sems ma dga' ngus pas slob dpon gyes snying rje nas rtsig logs la sgol ma rgyan dang bcas pa gcig bris nas bstod pa mdzad pas/ zhabs kyi gdu bu'i 129

nor bu rin po che brgyad stong ri ba zhig gog nas byung ba de rgan mo la byin pas tshims par mdzad do/ /des na yi dam lha'i sgom bzlas dang / sgrol ma kha 'don bya'o/ /sngon rgyal po gcig gi btsun mo rnams kyis skyed tshal na glu len bro brdung zhing yod pas/ mi gcig gis ram pa 'thag pa'i sgras glu bro mi snyan par byas so byas blon po 'ga' res rgyal po la zhus pas/ rgyal pos mi de sod cig gsungs pa/ blon po mchog gcig gis gsod pa'i nyes pa med do zhus pas/ 'o na ma gsod gsungs nas/ ma bsad par mi de tshe thar pa byung / mi tshe thar du btang ba'i bsod nams kyis/ blon po de tshe 'phos nas/rgyal po ma skyes dgra'i blon po btsan phyug 'dzom pa zhig gi bu gang gha dar zhes bya bar gyur to/ /lo bcu drug lon nas rab tu 'byung snyam pa pha mas byed du ma bcug tshe/ da ni shi nas dbul po zhig gi bur skyes nas rab tu byung nas chos bya dgos snyam/brag mthon po zhig gi kha nas mchongs pas 'chi ma 'dod/ yang chu chen po zhig la mchongs pas kyang ma shi/ yang rgyal pos chad pa bcad nas gsod du 'jug snyam/ btsun mo rnams kyis rgyan gos phud nas khrus byed dus khyer nas bros pas/ rgyal po ma sgyes dgras mda' lan gsum 'phangs pas 'bror ma 'dod pas/130

khyod lha klu gnod sbyin rgyal po chen po 'jig rten skyong ba su zhig gi bu yin dris pas/ gang gha dar na re/ nga ni lha klu gnod sbyin gang gi bu ma yin/ khyed kyi blon po zhig gi bu yin te/ 'khor dang longs spyod 'du 'dzi che bas rab tu byung ba'i skal ba ma mchis pas/ shi nas mi dbul po zhig gi lus blangs nas rab tu byung byang chub bsgrub snyam/ brag g.yang chu la mchongs kyang 'chi ma 'dod/ rgyal po'i chad pa phog pa'i las byas na yang rgyal pos kyang bdag gsod ma thub pas/ da ni rgyal pos bdag rab tu phyung bar zhu zhus pas/ rgyal po ma skyes dgra ngo mtshar dga' mgu yi rangs te/ sangs rgyas kyi drung du khrid nas rab tu byung /bden bzhi'i chos bstan pas/ sems rnam par grol te dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu thob par gyur to/ /de bzhin du mi dang dud 'gro sogs sems can gzhan gyi srog bskyabs na shi na mtho ris su sgye zhing / skye ba der tshe la bar chad med par tshe ring nad med pa de lta bur 'gyur bas/ des na tshe thar srog blu byed pa la 'bad par bya'o/ /sngon rgyal po chen po gnyis kyis sgyes phar skyel tshur skyel byas mdza' mo yod pas/ nyin gcig rgyal po gnyis lhan cig tu 'dzoms/ rgyal po gcig gis khyad nor ngo mtshar ba mang po 131

bstan nas/ rgyal po gzhan de la/ khyed la nged la med pa'i khyad nor ngo mtshar ba ci yod dris pas/ rgyal po de na re/ nga la khyad nor ngo mtshar ba cher med de/ rta dzi ngo mtshar ba zhig yod smras pas/ 'o na rta dzi la ngo mtshar ba'i yon tan ci yod dris pas/snyigs dus 'dir rgyal blon yin yang rdzun mi smra ba dkon kyang /rta rdzi kho tshe gang po rdzun gcig tsam mi smra bas ngo mtshar che'am snyam smras pas/ rgyal po de na re/ ngas rdzun smra ru 'jug nus zer/de mi nus smras pas/ rgyal po gnyis kyis rgyal sa'i phyed rgyal du btsugs nas/ rgyal po de'i bu mo na chung mdzes ma zhig rta rdzi yod sar btang nas/ bza' mi byas mthun par yod thog la bud med des na rdzu byas/ rta dzis nad la ci phan dris pas/gzhan phan med/ nus na rgyal po'i cang shes kyi rta bsad nas snying khrag nga la ster rgyu byung na phan smras pas/ rta rdzis de mi nus byas/ bu mos nad cher song 'chi la nye ba ltar byas pas/ kho'i sems kyis ma bzod par dgung zhig cang shes rta de gsod snyam sta re khyer nas rtsar song bas/ rtas shes nas bros so/ /de'i phyi dgung song bas kyang rtas shes nas bros/ de'i phyi nyin gyi dgung mo yang song tshe/ cang shes kyi rta'i bsam pa la/ rta rdzi 'dis rgyun du rtswa chu byin pas drin can yin/ snying re rje/ da kho 132

la phan na nga bsad kyang rung snyam ma bros par mgo bstan nas bsdad pas/ rta rdzis kyang gsod ma nus rung / 'dod pas gdungs nas bud med kyi dbang du song ba'i mthus rta cang shes kyi mgo la sta re brgyab nas bsad/ snying khrag blangs nas byin pas/ bu mo des nad drag pa'i khul byas/ zhag gcig gi 'phro la cang shes kyi rta yi mgo dang rngog ma sogs rta bsad pa'i rtags ston rgyu rnams khyer nas/ rgyal po'i rtsar bros song ngo / /de nas rta dzi'i bsam pa la/ ngas tshe 'di la rdzun sngar ma smras da ni rgyal po la rdzun smras na yong ngam mi yong snyam the tshom byung nas/tho zhig brtsigs nas/ ngas dzun smra ba bzang na/ zhu dus tho mi 'jig par shog mi bzang na 'jig par shog ces brjod nas/tho de rgyal po yin pa'i khul byas drung du song / rgyal pos dri ba ltar byas te/ rta rnams bde'am byas/ de'i lan du bde lags zhus pas/ tho cung zhig 'khrugs so/ /de nas kyang rgyal pos khyad par cang shes da lta bde bar yod dam zhes dris pa ltar byas/de'i lan du bde bar yod lags zhus pas/ tho 'gyel lo/ /yang brtsigs nas rgyal pos dri ba ltar byas/ rta spyi bde'am byas/lan du bde rgyu cher ma byung lags zhus pas/ tho ma 'khrugs/khyad par cang shes bde bar gnas yod dam byas/ lan du rta 133

cang shes da lo bdag gis gsod dgos byung lags zhus pas/tho ma zhig par sngar rgyun ltar gnas pa byung / yang rgyal pos rta ci'i phyir bsad ces dris pa ltar byas/ de'i lan du bu mo zhig byung nas bza' mi byas tshul nas bzung mjug gi bros tshul gyi bar rgyas par zhus pas/ tho ma zhig pa tsam du ma zad sngar bas brtan par gnas tshe/ rta rdzi'i bsam pa la/ ngas tshe gang po 'di la rdzun gcig kyang ma lab pas da bar bde ba byung / da dung yang dzun ma smras na bde ba'i tshod na gda'/ gal te da res ma bde rung / shi na phyi mar bde bas/ srog la babs kyang da res rgyal po la rdzun mi zhu bar drang por zhu snyam pa byung / de nas rgyal po gnyis kyi gcig gis bu mo bos nas skog tu sbas nas bzhagagacig gis rta dzi bos nas/ rgyal blon mi mang 'tshogs pa'i dkyil nas/ rgyal pos rta rdzi la/ rta rnams bde bar yod dam gsungs pas/ rta dzi na re/ da lo bde rgyu cher med lags zhus pas/ 'o na khyad par cang shes da lta bde bar yod dam gsungs pas/ cang shes rta da lo gsod dgos byung lags zhus pas/ de ci'i phyir bsad gsungs/ sngar gyi bu mo de byung nas mjug gi bros tshul bar rdzun gyi bsre slad med par drang por zhus pas der 'tshogs pa kun ngo mtshar/ rgyal po gzhan de'i rgyal sa'i 134

phyed thob pas/ rgyal po yang thugs dga' nas rta dzi de yang go sa spos te/ blon po zhig gi go sar bzhag nas/ mi kun gyi bden rdzun gyi dbang po byas skad/ de bzhin du rdzun ma smra bar dus rgyun du drang por smras na phan yon de dang de 'dra ba gzhan yang mang po 'byung bas/ des na 'o skol rnams kyis rdzun spangs nas rtag tu gtam drang por smras na legs so/ /sngon rgyal po tshangs byen zhes bya ba blo dang ldan pa zhig yod pa des/ bram ze mchog sred sogs mkhas pa rnams 'dus te rtsod pa na/ mkhas pa mchog sred la rgyal po mgu ste/ rang gi bu mo gser mdog can khyem thab tu byin pas/ bu mo'i bsam pa la 'di bas nga mkhas/ nga bas mkhas pa zhig byung na de'i khyim thab bgyed do/ /smras so/ /de la bram ze mchog sred sems 'khrugs te/nga lta bu'i mkhas par mi mgu na/ bu mo khyod kyi mgo bskor ro snyam/ glen pa zhig btsal bas/ mtha' zhig na glang rdzi gzugs bzang zhing 'du shes glen pa gcig shing sdong zhig gi yal ga'i rtse mo na bsdad/ rtsa ba gcod pa zhig 'dug pa de la dpags nas glen pa yin par shes te/ de gsang nas khrid 'ongs grib ma la bzhag 'o mas sku mnye byas/ oṃ swasti bya ba bslabs nas kha ton byed du bcug de nas bdag la slob dpon nga las ches 135

shin tu mkhas pa zhig yod pa/ de bu mo'i khyim thab dang rgyal po'i mchod gnas su 'bul zhus nas/ glen pa la paṇḍi ta'i chas bskon nas khyod kyis mi mang 'tshogs pa'i dbus su song dus oṃ swasti brjod la me tog rgyal po'i spyi bor zhog gzhan su la yang gtam lan ma 'debs byas khrid pas mi kun gyis mkhas pa mchog sred las lhag pa'i khong gi slob dpon mkhas pa 'byon pa la/ ltad mo blta zer skye bo pho mo kun 'dus pa'i khrod du khri so so la rgyal blon bu mo bram ze mchog sred bcas bzhugs/kun gye gong du blun po de bzhag pas rgyal po'i spyi bor ske tog bzhag nas/ sngar bslabs pa brjed nas/ oṃ san kru ra byas pas/ de bod skad du bsgyur na mo mtshan gyi lce ring zhes phyin ci log ngo tsha'i gtam yin pas/ de thos pas der 'tshogs pa kun kha skyengs ngo tsha khong 'dzum shor co 'dri bar brtsams pa na/bram ze mchog sred na re/ de nyid kyis 'di mkhas pa yin te/o dang / san dang kru dang / ra'i sgra las drangs nas 'di skad ces bya'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ thams cad kyi spobs pa bcom pa dang / bu mo des/ a ti/ ka pa/ tsi te/ wa ga bi shwa zhes pa bod skad du bsgyur na khyad par 'phags pa'i ngag 'ga' zhig gda' 'am dris pas/ lan ci yang ma byung / yang mchog sred 136
