pa'i ri bong mang po zhig gi thag nye na/ mtshe'u zhig yod pas chu de 'thung zhing bde bar gnas pa la/ skabs shig sos ga'i tshad pas gdungs pa'i glang chen mang po der byung rdzing bu brdzis ri bong rnams yul bton pas/ thams cad gros byas pas/ gcig na re/ thabs shig 'dug pas/ kho bo khyed kun gyis shing mthon po zhig gi khar skyol byas pas/ ri bong gzhan kun gyis kho shing mthon po zhig gi rtser bskyal lo/ /de nas glang chen kun 'dus pa na skad mthon pos/ kwa ye sdod cig byas pas/ glang chen rnams kyis gdong gyen du phyogs nas khyed su yin zer/ nga ya gi'i skal ldan zla ba'i pho nya yin byas pas/ khyod 'dir ci la btang dris pas/ zla ba'i zhal nas nga'i lto ba na gnas pa'i ri bong 'di'i rigs su gtogs pa 'di rnams yul 'don na khyed rnams la tsha zer dgye'o zer gyen gda'o byas/ yang tshes bcu bzhi'i zla ba sprin g.yo ba'i ngogs na gnas pa de bstan nas/ zla ba 'dis khyed rnams la sngar bas nyis 'gyur gyi bka' bkyon par gda'o/ /de bas khyed rnams bde bar 'dod na nga'i ngag mi snyan yang nyon/ nga la ma 'tshe zhig byas pas/ glang chen rnams kyis gros byas te/ zla bas nged rnams la bka' ma bkyon dang /gsung la nyan/ pho nya khyod la mi 'tshe zer/ 'o na nga glang chen khyu 205

mchog gi spyi bor 'bab byas pas de ltar bgyid zer sa la babs nas sprin dang bral ba'i zla ba bstan te/ da zla ba khyed rnams la bka' bkyon pa mi 'dug khyed thams cad rang gnas su bde bar song zhig byas pas glang chen kun song tshe/ ri bong kun sngar rgyun ltar bde bar gnas so/ /des na de lta bu'i thabs mkhas kyis dgra 'dul bar bya'o/ /sngon grong khyer bde ldan gyi rgyal bu skyabs sbyin zhes bya bas grong khyer gye khron par glang po che lhung ba'i ro la grong 'jug mdzad nas bskyal bas/ de'i bar la/ blon po kun tu 'gro zhes bya bas/ rgyal po'i lus la grong 'jug byas/ rang gi ro la rma btod nas nyams par byas/ blon pos rgyal po byas so/ /rgyal po de phyir 'ongs nas 'jug yul ma rnyed par ne tso zhig gi ro la zhugs nas sngar gyi btsun mo'i rtsa ru song / yin tshul bshad pas/btsun mo na re/ da thabs ci yod dris pas/ ne tsos btsun mo la khyod kyis dus rgyun du nga la gces par gyis dang / ngas nyin gcig rgyal pos zas za dus shig la lus thal bar bcug nas 'ong sku mdun du sprugs dang zas su thal ba song tshe/ rgyal pos nga la brgyab yong de dus nga shi tshe khyod kyis nga'i ne tso legs po de shi ba zhes ngus dang rgyal pos khyod kyi mya ngan sangs phyir ne 206

tso'i ro la grong 'jug byas yong / de'i bar la nga sngar gyi lus la 'jug ces gros byas nas/ de ltar byas pas/ sngar gyi lus la zhugs nas sngar ltar rgyal po byas so/ /blon po ne tsor gyur pa de yang rjes nas rgyal pos snying je nas/ khye'u zhig gi ro rnyed pa chus bkrus nas blon po'i rnam shes de la bkug nas yon tan bslabs/ rab tu phyung / dben par bzhag 'tsho ba sbyar ro/ /de nas rang gi bu bzhin du bskyangs pa'i blon po sogs kyis rang la dgra bzhin bltas/ gnod pa chen po byed na yang / gnod lan du gnod chen po mi skyel bar/ de lta bu'i thabs mkhas kyis gdul bar bya'o/ /sngon grong khyer rtswa mchog gi rgyal bu seng ge sgra zhes bya ba/ lo gcig lon pa lo bdun tsam lon pa'i gzugs bongs tsam/ ral pa sngon po rked pa tsam du nyil le ba/ gzhon nu la rgyal po'i chas byas/ yab la rta pa brgyas bskor te/ rgyal bu gdong tsam la zhugs te rtswa mchog gi byang phyogs na phar phyin pa dang / yab kyi dgra rgyal po spyod med rta pa nyis brgya dang bcas ri dwags gshor zhing nags gseb na yod pa'i sar song tshe sa mer mer g.yo zhing / lam gyi rdo pha bong sdong dum la sogs pa yang sna la sdod ma tshugs par/ g.yas g.yon du 'phar zhing 'gro ba mthong bas/ sdig rgyal spyod med 'khor bcas skrag go /der 207

thog chen po zhig byung ba rgyal bu seng ge sgras sdigs mdzub kyi rtse mo la blangs nas brag la brgyab pas grog po btod pa byung /drung du song mdung shing sa la bsnun pas sa dong du song / nang du rgyal po spyod med 'khor bcas nub pas rab tu 'jigs pa'i nga ros da res rta nyis brgya po 'di bzhes/ de nas rjes su rgyal srid kyang 'bul lo/ /bdag cag 'di nas thon par gyis zer ba la/ rgyal bu seng ge na re/ 'o na khyod kyis sdang sems 'dor ram mi 'dor/ 'dor na rgyal srid med kyang sla/ mi 'dor na da lta rang brlag pa yin gsungs pas/ ci gsung bgyi'o zer/ sa steng du bton nas/ chas dang rta med par yul du phyin pas/ rgyal bu seng ge'i nga ros/ sdig rgyal spyod med pham so byas yul phyogs thams cad la grags pas khyab/ de btul bas nags kyi ri dwags tshun chad la bde ba tshad med pa byung /sngon rgyal bu 'od stag ces bya ba nags khrod cig tu song ba mtha' 'khob rgyal po zhig gis bzung bkyigs nas shing gi yal ga la bkal ba/ yab rgyal pos tshor nas lcags kyi mda' gzhu thogs/ shin tu 'jigs pa'i gzugs su phyin/ mda' bkang nas thang shing la brgyab pas/ thang shing chen po de 'gyel nas shing gzhan mnan pa mthong tshe/ mtha' 'khob rgyal po 'jigs 208

skrag ste/ stobs can khyod kyi 'dod pa smos ci gsungs sgrub zer/'o na nga'i bu khrol/ khyod kyi bu mo 'di la byin cig smras pas byin pas gnyen du gyur/ de nas thabs kyis chos la bkod do/ /des na rang la gnod pa'i dgra bsad na tshe 'dir yang dgra mang du 'gro zhing phyi mar dmyal bar 'gro bas/ blo gros can rnams kyis dgra gsod mi dgos par de gadra'i thabs mkhas kyis gdul bar bya'o/ /sngon pha rgad po zhig la bu gnyis yod pa/ nor dang gdams ngag ster bas khyed gnyis gang 'dod dris pas/ bu chung bas gdams ngag 'dod zer/ bu che ba na re/ gdams ngag khyod 'khyer na nga nor tshags byed pa las 'os med zer nor rnams tshags byas so/ /de nas pha 'chi khar/ bu chung bas gdams ngag dgos byas pas/ rgad po na re/ tug gis thug na rgan pa la gros dris bya ba las gzhan ma byung / der nor med nas yul gzhan du phyin tsa na/ rgyal po shi ba'i btsun mos rgyal sred bzung nas 'dug pa/ rgad po zhig la/ 'di ci 'dra yin dris pas/ des thams cad bslu ba yin pas/ gan du 'gro na 'di ltar gyes byas bslab bya bslabs pa ltar byas pas/ bud med des 'di blo dang ldan pa zhig 'dug snyam mgu nas khyem thab byas te/ pha'i yo byad 209

pas rgyal po'i rgyal srid thob pa byung / yang sngon rgyal po gcig gi mig na nas sman pas bud med rang gi khyim thab ma yin pa'i skyes pa gzhan gyis ma spyad pa'i nu zho dgos zer bas rgyal pos de lta bu yod pa la bya dga' ster byas pas/ bud med gcig na re/ khyo ga la de lta bu nga yin gyis la bya dga' longs zer bas/khos grogs po gcig la dris pas/ grogs bo de na re/ de mi bden/ mi bden na rgyal po'i chad pa 'ong bas/ de las bzlog la dris la ci zer ltos byas pas/ khyo gas khyod kyi des mi 'ong bar 'dug skyes pa brgyas spyad pa zhig dgos zer byas pas/ mo na re/ de nga la yod yong zer/ bgrangs pas dgu bcu go dgu byung skad/ de yang grogs po blo ldan de la dris pas/ rgyal po'i chad pa ma byung ba yin/ de bzhin du bya ba gang byed kyang grogs po bzang po la dris nas byas na bab mi brdal ba 'ong bas/des na bya ba rang gis mi shes pa dang / shes na yang grogs po bzang po la dris nas bya'o/ /sngon bye ba dbyeg ldan dang / phug ron ri mo'i mgrin pa can/ gsang bar rgyu ba'i bya rog ri dwags ri mo'i lus can/ rus sbal dal gyes 'gro rnams grogs mched byas/ gcig gis gcig la phan 'dogs pa ma gtogs gnod mi skyel ba'i mna' bskyal lo/ /de nas phug ron ri mo'i 210

mgrin can 'khor bcas bya rgyas zin pa dang / 'khor rnams 'phur bar 'dod pa la/phug ron ri mo'i mgrin can na re/ khyed rnams de ltar ma byed/ ngas gang byed gyis byas thams cad thibs kyis bsdad pa dang mi rgan de'i bsam pa la bya thams cad zin 'dug snyam bya rgya btang ba dang / ri mo'i mgrin can 'phur bas bya thams cad dus mnyam du 'phur nas song /grogs po bye ba dbyig ldan gyi drung du babs te kye grogs po dbyig ldan 'dir byon dang byas pas/ dbyeg ldan 'ongs khyod ci nyes dris pas/ nged bya thams cad rgyas bcings pa 'di'o/ /da khyed kyis chod cig byas pas bcad nas phan btags so/ /yang nyin gcig rus sbal dal gyis 'gro de byi la rgan po zhig dang 'phrad pas khyer ro/ /des grogs rnams bos pa phug ron gyis tshor nas ri dwags dang gnyis/ byi ba dbyig ldan gyi rtsar phyin nas gros byas/ byi ba na re/ ri dwags khyod song la byi la rgan po 'gro ba'i lam nas shi rdzun gyis dang / der khos rus sbal bzhag nas 'ong gis/ de'i tshe bya rog gis rus sbal gyi sgyid nas zungs la longs shog de dus ri dwags kyang bros byas pas/de ltar byas pas rus sbal de byi la rgan po'i kha nas thar pa byung / de bzhin du grogs bzang po bsten na sdug bsngal las 211

thar zhing / bde ba dang ldan zhing gros mthun gyi sgo nas bya ba sgrub na 'grub la/ gal te ma grub na yang mjes shing gzhan gyi 'phya smod mi 'ong rjes nas 'gyod pa mi skye bas/ des na 'o skol rnams kyis grogs bzang po btsal nas grogs mched byas phan tshun gcig gis gcig nam yang mi bslu bar/ sdug bsngal gyis nyen pa'i dus su phan 'dogs pa dang / bya ba las don re byung tshe blo ldan grogs la gros 'dri zhing / gros mthun gyi sgo nas bya ba gang yang bsgrub par bya'o/ / sngon rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi blon po ri dwags chen po bya ba'i bu chung ba'i chung ma lha mtshams ma zer ba'i bud med bzang mo zhig yod do/ /de dus rgya mtsho las bya zhig gis 'bras kyi snye ma zhig khyer 'ongs pa rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi pho brang du lhung / rgyal pos blon po so sor bgos nas byin/ khyed rnams kyis 'di spel gsungs pa/ blon po ri dwags chen pos lha mtshams ma la sprad pas/ spel nas mang du 'phel lo/ /gzhan rnams kyis spel ma shes so/ /nyin gcig rgyal po'i btsun mo bsnyungs nas blon po rnams la 'bras spel du bcug pa khyer shog dang btsun mo la sman du gtong dgos/ zhes gsungs pas/ blon po kha cig gis bye bas zos nas ma smin zer/ kha cig gis rul te ma smin zer/212

blon po ri dwags chen po lha mtshams ma la 'dri ru phyin pas/mna' ma na re/ mi gcig tu ma zad/ mi brgya stong khri 'bum gyi sman du gyur pa yod ces mang po zhig bskur/sman du btang bas nad drag pas rgyal po dga' nas blon po la bya dga' chen po gnang ngo / /de'i tshe nyi 'og gi rgyal po gzhan cig rgyal po gsal rgyal la 'thab par brtsams pa na/ rgyal po des thog mar rgyal po gsal rgyal la blon po blo ldan yod med blta snyam/ rta ma bu che chung sru kha 'dra ba gnyis bang chen par bskur nas/ 'di'i ma bu gang yin byas pas/ rgyal po gsal rgyal 'khor bcas kyis shan ma phyed/ blon po ri dwags 'dzin gyi mna' ma lha mtshams ma la dris pas/ mna' ma na re/ de las sla/ rta ma bu gnyis phyogs gcig tu bzhag nas bza' rgyu zhim po lhan du byin na/ ma gang yin pa des/ bu gang yin pa de'i mdun du bza' rgyu stob par 'gyur zer/ de ltar byas pas rta ma smad kyi shan phyes nas bang chen pa la bskur ro/ /yang sbrul pho mo chu zheng gab pa gnyis bang chen pa la bsgur nas/ pho mo gang yin zer ba blon po'i mna' ma la dris pas/ ras 'jam po'i steng du zhog dang mo gang yin pa de bde ba la chags nas gnas la/ pho gang yin pa des bde ba mi bzod par 'gul bar 'gyur zer ba ltar byas sbrul pho mo 213

shan phyes nas slar bsgur ro/ /yang shing mgo mjug sbom phra mnyam pa sta re dang ste'u'i rjes med pa zhig bsgur nas/ ma go mjug gang yin dris pas/ sngar bzhin lha mtshams ma la dris/chu la skur dang / rtse mo gang yin pa de chu steng du thon zhing sngon la 'gro/ rtsa ba gang yin pa de chu'i gting du bying zhing rjes nas 'gro zer ba ltar byas pas shan phyes nas slar bskur bas/ rgyal po des bang chen pa la bya dga' chen po byin/ rgyal po gsal rgyal blon po rig pa dang ldan pa yod par gda'/ 'thab pas mi thub snyam/ rgyal po gsal rgyal la bkur sti mang du byas/ mdza' bar byas te dga' bar byas so/ /de la rgyal po gsal rgyal dga' mgu yi rangs te/blon po ri dwags chen po khyod kyis 'di lta bu rtogs shing khong du chud pa ngo mtshar che'o gsungs bya dga' chen po gnang bas/ blon pos bdag gis shes pa ma yin mna' ma blo dang ldan pa zhig yod pa des 'di rnams rtogs shing khong du chud do zhus pas/ rgyal pos de yin na khyod kyi mna' ma lha mtshams ma dang bdag gnyis ming sring bya'o gsungs/ ming sring ltar shin tu mdza' bar byas so/ /yang sngon rje btsun mi la'i mas dbus phyogs kyi rnal 'byor pa gnas skor byed pa bang chen du 'os pa zhig la bza' 214

btung byin/ gos bem po zhig 'dug pa la lhan pa brgyab/ bem po'i nang gi rgyab gzhung du rnal 'byor pa la rgyus med pa'i gser srang bdun sbas/ de'i steng du lhan pa nag po kha gang gru bzhi pa zhig brgyab/ dbus su skud pa dkar po sbom po'i gzer tshom skar ma smin drug gi dbyibs 'dra ba phyir mi mngon pa gcig gis mnan te/ rnal 'byor pa rang la rngan pa chen po byin/yi ge rgya can zhig bskur ba rnal 'byor pa des khyer nas/ rje mi la la sprad pa klog pa'i nang na/ ma khams bde/ yul du mthu'i rtags thon/ da dung ser ba phob/ rgyags chad na lung pa kha byang du lta ba sprin nag po ldang zhing skar ma smin drug 'char ba'i 'og na rang re'i nye tshan grong pa bdun yod pas de na rgyags ci 'dod yod pas longs/ rtsad ma chod na lung pa de'i nang na rnal 'byor pa 'di rang bzhugs pas/ gzhan du ma 'dri bya ba zhig 'dug pa/ rje mi la dang bla ma gnubs chung ba gnyis kyis ma mkhyen/ bla ma la jo mo ye shes mkha' 'gro'i mtshan rtags dang ldan pa zhig yod pa des shes nas/ rnal 'byor pa de nang du bos/ chang zhim po byin te bzi ba dang / rnal 'byor pa'i rgyab nas bem po phud de mo rang gis gyon nas/ bem po 'di 'dra gyon nas rgyal khams 'grim pa'i mi la skyed 'ong zer phar tsam 215

tshur tsam byas khang steng du 'jegs nas song ste/ bem po'i nang nas gser bton/ lhan pa sngar bzhin btsems/ bem po rnal 'byor pa la g.yogs/ gser rje mi la dang bla ma rnam gnyis la sprad nas/ mo na re/ thos pa dga' la ma grung mo zhig yod par gda'/ lung pa kha byang du lta bar nyi ma mi 'char ba ltar/ rnal 'byor pa'i bem po'i nang la nyi ma mi 'char ba la zer bar gda'/ sprin nag po ldang ba lhan pa nag po kha gang btab pa la zer/ skar ma smin drug 'char ba/ skud pa dkar po'i hab btsems la zer/ nye tshan grong pa bdun ni gser srang bdun la zer/ rtsad ma chod na lung pa de na rnal 'byor pa 'di rang bzhugs pas gzhan du ma 'dri bya ba ma go na/ gser rnal 'byor pa'i bem po la yod pas gzhan du ma 'tshol bya bar gda' byas pas/ bla ma na re/ khyed bud med blo rno zer ba de bden par gda' gsungs/ des na de lta bu'i blo gros dang ldan pa'i bud med la gros yang 'dri rung zhing / kha la yang nyan par bya'o/ /sngon 'brug pa kun legs kyis/ ngag dbang chos rgyal sku mtshams la yod dus shig la/ nye gnas la/ nga sku mdun du lan cig 'gro dgos byas pas/ de mi yong mtshams dam po yod byas pas/ nga la spub chal bzang po zhig gi gzigs 'bul rgyu yod do 216

byas pas/ 'o na ngas zhu zer zhus pas/ bla ma ngag dbang chos rgyal gyis 'o na kho nang la 'ong du chug gsungs/ song nas gleng mo mang po byas nas/ skabs shig bla mas khyod la sbub chal zhig yod pa khyer shog dang blta gsungs pas/ 'brug pa kun legs na re/ sbub chal gzhan med/ ngas kha sbub sbub 'di'i nang nas gtam chal chal thon pa 'di yin lags zhus pas/ bla ma nye gnas dang bcas dpon slob kun bzhad gad thag ge ba zhig byung / bka' yang ma bkyon skad/ yang sngon mi gcig skye dman gzhan zhig gi rtsar dgung mo song bas/ snga mo khyo gas shes nas/rogs gzhan dang bcas 'ongs/ sgo nas bsgugs te 'dzin grabs byas tshe/ kho zin gyes dogs nas/ gos phud de gcer bur bros pas ma zin/ la zhig gi phar rgyab tu song nas/ rgad po zhig gis zhing rmo ba la/ rgyang ring po nas lag pa g.yab/ skad chen bos gcer bur bros/ yang yang zer gyen rgyug pas/ rgad po'i bsam pa la/ mi pha gi'i 'bros lugs dang zer lugs gang la bltas na skyon cig 'dug lan cig nga yang 'bro dgos snyam/rgad pos kyang gos phud de gcer bur pha gi'i nags gseb tu bros pas/ shul gye gos khos gon nas/ zhing rmo zhing bsdad pas/'dzin mkhan gyi mi rnams byung nas/ gcer bu re mthong ngam 217

dris pas/ mi gcer bu 'dra ma mthong / mi gcer bu zhig ded nas ci bya byas pas slar log tshe/ rgad po bos nas/ kho rang gi gos bskon rgyu mtshan bshad pas gnyis ka ha rgod byas skad/yad sngon khyem bdag cig gis zhing ri bong gis zos pa mthong nas tshig pa zos mda' gzhu khyer nas gsod du phyin pas/ ri bong gis mi de la kha bltas nas rgod pas ya kha shor ba mi des mthong nas/ mda' 'degs long med par rgod rgyu byung / mang po bgad pas/ zhe sdang yang zhi nas ma bsad par ri bong btang skad/ yang sngon g.yog mo zhig chu len du phyin pas/ chu zom nang du nya zhig byung ba khyim bdag gis mthong nas/ g.yog mo la nya 'di tsam yod pa mi mthong ba zer tshig pa zos nas brdeg tu 'ong tshe/ g.yog mos chu nang du skyogs brgyab nas nya len grabs byas pas/ nya de rgod bzhin du chu nang nas yar rgyug mar rgyug byas pas g.yog mo bgad/ gnyis ka rgod pa khyem bdag gis mthong nas brdeg long med par rgod rgyu byung / gsum ga mang po rgod pas khyem bdag gi zhe sdang zhi nas g.yog mor ma brgyab/g.yog mos kyang nya ma bsad par slar rang gnas su bskyal skad/ sngon gcod gtong mkhan zhig mtshan mo gcod gtong du phyin pas/ rogs pa zhig yod pa des/ rtsag pa zhig yod pa phyir 218

bslogs nas gyon te thag nyer song / gcod pas mthong nas 'dre zhig yin snyam 'jigs nas phaṭa byas tshe/ rogs pa des kho 'jigs pa shes nas phar song tshe phaṭa byas/ yang ga le byas song tshe sleb la khad la phaṭa byas na yang mi 'gro ba 'jigs po gda' zer/ langs nas bros song tshe mi de yang ga le byas rjes su 'ongs pas/ kho khyim du 'dzul nas/ nga'i rjes 'di na 'dre zhig kyang 'ong gin gda' sgo chod byas pas/ rogs pa de slebs byung tshe ngo shes nas thams cad bzhad gad byas skad/ sngon tsa ri'i grub pa zhig gis sha zhig za snyam mal nas gcer bur langs te/gnam la sha btags yod pa gri yis bcad/ sha ma bcad par rang gi gsang mtshan bcad nas shi bas/ phug pa de la gsang mtshan bcad phug ces zer/sngon la phyi gangs kyi grub chen zhig gcer bur langs nas me btang bas/ thal dong nang nas bud med cig gi mo mtshan zhig byung bltas pas cher song tshe/ ltas ngan yin snyam mo mtshan nang du me ma mur skyogs gang blugs pas/ rang gi gsang mtshan thog tu blugs te tshig nas shi skad/ sngon mi gnyis lam du song tshe/ glang chen dang phag gnyis snga phyi byas 'gro ba mthong nas gcig na re/ 'di gnyis kyi sna dang mjug ma rgyab sogs gang la 219

bltas na lus dbyibs 'dra bas/ glang chen rgud pa phag tu gyur pa 'dra zer/ yang gcig po na re/ de ma red/ kho bos 'di gnyis 'dra tshul la bltas na/ phag dar na glang chen du gyur pa 'dra zhes rtsed mo byas skad/ sngon bla ma zhig la mi gzhan zhig gis khyed spyos 'dug zer ba la/ bla ma na re/ nga yis bltas na khyod re smyo/ /khyod kyis bltas na nga re spyo/ /nga spyo ba chos kyi dbyings su smyo/ /khyod smyo ba 'khor ba'i 'dam du smyo/ /gsungs skad/ yang sngon dbu mdzad cig gis/ nyams mgur na/ dal ba'i rten 'di yid bzhin nor las lhag /zer ba la/ dbyangs ring po byas/ dal ba'i rten 'di yid bzhin nor las lhag /byas pas/ gzhan grwa pa kha rgod cig na re/ 'di 'dra thob pa da res tsam zhig yin zer ba bsgyur nas/ 'di 'dra thos pa da res tsam zhig yin/ zhes bton pas kun bzhad/ yang sngon bla ma mkhas pa zhig gis mi dge bcu bshad nas/ dal 'byor gyi chos bco brgyad song byas pa la/ gzhan cig gis de dus khyed tshos yar la ci zhus byas pas/ nyan mkhan kha rgod cig na re/ gzhan zhu ma nus/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/ /mi dge bcu yi rnam dbye legs gsungs nas/ /dal 'byor chos ni bco brgyad song zhes zer/ /mkhyen pa chen po mnga' la gsol ba 'debs/ /220

zhes sku bstod cig phul byas kun bzhad/ sngon rgyal dbang lnga pa rin po che la/ zhabs phyi ba rnams kyis gsol 'debs shig dgos zer ba la/ gcig gis gcig la rku zhing kun gyis rku/ /rkun ma rku ba kun gyi mchog yin te/ /rkun ma rgya mtsho'i dbus na lhang nge ba/ /ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshor gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes gsungs bzhad skad/ sngon sman pa zhig gis nad pa gcig la/ khyod kyi lce ston byas pa/ nad pas ma go bar gsang mtshan ston zer snyam pa bstan pas/ sman pa 'dzum bzhin du/ de yang bzang por gda'/ da kha nang gi lce zhig ston byas nas bstan pas sman pa nad g.yog nad pa gsum po rgad/ yang sngon mna' ma zhig rgad pos sdod du ma bcug pa/ a ne rgan mo la bshad pas/ rgan mo na re/ de yin na mna' ma khyod nga'i nyal sar nyol/nga khyod kyi nyal sar nyal byas/ de ltar byas pas/ rgad po mna' ma yod sar song nas 'dod pa spyad tshe/ rgan mos mna' ma yin khul byas/ khyed kyi rgan mo dang nged gnyis la khyad 'dug gam dris pas/ khyad shin tu che bar gda' zer ba dang / rgan mo rgod rgyu byung nas ma thub par rgod pas/ rgad pos kyang rang gi rgan mo yin par ngo shes nas rgod/ de mna' mas kyang tshor nas rgod do/ /sngon byes pa zhig gi lag na yos kha shas yod pa'i rdog po 221

gcig brul ba khung bu zhig tu shor bas byes pas khung der mdzub mo bcug nas ma lon tshe/ nang du kha bltas nas mang po ngus pas/ snabs lug nas khung bur song ba mgo btegs pas snabs la yos 'byar nas steng du byung tshe/ byis pa dga' nas rgod pa dge bshes glang ri thang pas gzigs pas khong yang bzhad skad/ sngon bla ma zhig gis phyen zhig btang nas dkon mchog mchod byas pas dri bzang phun sum tshogs pa byung yang /der yod pa'i bu slob 'ga' zhig la rgod rgyu byung nas ma thub par rgod do/ /des na byeng rmugs kyis non pa dang / don med kyi chags sdang dang / mya ngan sems khral can gyi mi phal che ba la/'di dang 'di 'dra'i gtami rgyud/ kha btsog ku re rtsed mo'i gtam sna tshogs bshad nas/ rgod kha blangs nas skyon de dag bsal bar bya'o/ /sngon gyi rgyal po rab snang zhes bya ba de sdig pa'i bu yin pas/des mar gyi ming tsam tshor na yang mi dga' bas/ rgyal po la gnyid gtan nas ma 'ongs/ sman pa'i rgyal po 'tsho byed bos pas/ sman pa na re/ blon po rnams la/ rgyal po la yod pa'i rnga mong mgyogs pa de sta gon gyis/ glang po che 'dam bu'i ri la 'bras yos byen la chu ma ldud cig chu glang mo'i grod pu gang 222

tshags gyis shig byas pas/ blon po rnams kyis kyang sman pa'i ngag bzhin byas so/ /de nas rgyal pos ma tshor ba byas/ chang bzang po la rtsi mar gyi dwangs ma sbyar nas/ rgyal po la blud pas/de ma thag rgyal po gnyid du song ngo / /skabs der 'tsho byed rnga mong mgyogs pa de la zhon/ chu grod pu gang po de khyer nas bros so/ /de nas rgyal po gnyid sad nas/ sgregs pa byas pa la mar gyi dri ma chil byung bas/ rgyal po khros nas/ sman pa gang na yod dris pas song tshar zhus pas/ des nga la mar byen 'dug pas/blon po zhig glang po che 'dam bu'i ri la zhon nas rgyugs la lam nas sod shog cig g.yo can des zas gang byen yang / ma za zhig gsungs pas/ blon po zhig glang po la zhon nas bdas pas/sman pa 'tsho byed kyi rjes zin la nye ba na/ chu dang 'phrad de glang po che skom pas chu 'thungs nas 'gror ma nyan pa'i bar la cher 'gyangs so/ /de nas bdas pas zin la nye ba na sman pas sngar gyi chu grod pu gang po 'phangs pas/ glang po che chags pa'i stobs kyis glang mo'i grod pu de la snam snom mang po byas pa'i bar la sman pa 'tsho byed mnyan yod kyi kun dga' ra bar phyin par gyur to/ /blon po sleb tu nye ba na 'tsho byed kyis blon po la khong nad cig yod pa shes nas/ sen mo g.yon pa'i thog tu 'khru 223

sman zhig blugs/ g.yas pa'i sen mo'i bar du sgyu ru ra zhig bcangs te/ slebs ma thag khyod 'ongs pa legs so/ /'di zo zhig byas/ g.yon ngos kyi sman byen nas/ g.yas pa de'i 'phro yin khul byas/ 'tsho byed kyis zos pas/ blon pos kho rang yang za bar 'dug snyam zos pas khong nad bkrus te de tshugs nas nad drag pa byung / dga' nas phyir log pas/ rgyal pos g.yo can de bsad dam dris pas/ blon po na re/ ma sod shor song /khyed kyi nad la phan 'dug gam dris pas/ rgyal po na re/ phan 'dug zer/ 'o na nga la yang khong nad cig sngon la yod pa da lan sman pas zas shig byin pa zos pas phan 'dug pas/ phan thogs byed mkhan gyi mi la drin gzo ma byung rung / gsod pa'i khrims yod dam zhus pas/ rgyal pos kyang thugs bsam bzhes nas/ de shin tu bden par 'dug gsungs/ 'tsho byed la bka' drin gtang rag tu ras zung zhig phul ba de/ 'tsho byed kyis ston pa sangs rgyas la phul ba/ ston pa'i na bza' byas par gsungs so/ /des na 'tsho byed kyis zas su sgo btags nas/ sman byin te rgyal blon gnyis kyi nad gsos pa ltar/ bdag gis kyang gdul bya dad can rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ 'jig rten mi chos dang sgo bstun nas dam pa'i lha chos 'di legs par bshad zin to/ /224

legs bshad 'di yi nang bzhin byas na tshe 'dir chos dang mthun pa'i 'jig rten gyi bya ba thams cad yid bzhin du grub nas bde zhing / shi nas phyi mar yang mngon mtho lha mi'i nang du skyes nas skyid la/ nam phugs bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob nas/ 'gro ba lha dang bcas pa'i gtsug gi rgyan du 'gyur bar gdon mi za'o/ /des na 'di ni rang gi skyon dang yon tan rnams la blta 'dod pa rnams la gsal bar ston pa'i me long dang / gzhan gyi skyon yon legs nyes blang dor gyi gnas rnams la blta 'dod pa rnams kyi mig dang 'dra bas/ blo gros can rnams kyi legs bshad 'di nyid sangs rgyas kyi gsung bzhin gces par zungs shig de ltar legs par bshad pa'i dge ba rnams gnas skabs dang mthar thug smon gnas rnams su 'dun pa drag pos bsngo zhing / smon lam dri ma med pa'i mtshams sbyor bya ba'o//smras pa/ sangs rgyas thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /khyod kyi skyes rabs rnam par thar pa bzhin/ /bdag kyang sgrub par nus pa'i smon lam 'debs/ /rnam dag smon gnas 'grub par byin gyes rlobs/ /mgon khyod dang po sangs rgyas dpag med kyi/ /drung du byon nas thugs mchog bskyed pa ltar/ /bdag 225

kyang deng nas sangs rgyas mang po yi/ /drung du song nas sems mchog bskyed par shog /bar du bskal chen grangs med gsum gye bar/ /sangs rgyas mang po bsnyen bkur mchod pa ltar/ /bdag kyang deng nas bskal chen grangs med bar/ /sangs rgyas dpag tu med pa mchod par shog /sngon tshe rgyal po mang por gyur pa'i tshe/ /chos phyir lus dang srog kyang btang ba ltar/ /bdag kyang deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /chos phyir lus dang srog kyang gtong bar shog /bram ze chen po zhig tu gyur pa'i tshe/ /stag mo ma bu sha yis gsos pa ltar/ /bdag kyang nyam thag 'gro ba snying rje nas/ /gces pa'i lus kyang phangs med sbyin par shog /shi ba'i rgyal por gyur tshe longs spyod dang / /spyan yang bram ze long bar byen pa ltar/ /bdag kyang zas nor longs spyod sbyin par btang / /long ba rnams la mig kyang ster bar shog /ko sa la yi rgyal por gyur pa'i tshe/ /tshe rabs dran cing sbyin pa btang ba ltar/ /bdag kyang tshe rabs dran cing sems can la/ /chos dang zang zing sbyin pa gtong bar shog /tshong dpon sbyin la dpa' bar gyur pa'i tshe/ /me 'obs brgal nas 'phags pa mchod pa ltar/ /bdag kyang lus dang srog la mi lta bar/ /snying stobs chen pos dkon mchog mchod par shog /tshong dpon 226

zil gyes mi non gyur pa'i tshe/ /rtswa btsong rin gyis phongs pa gsos pa ltar/ /bdag la nor rdzas med kyang thabs mkhas kyis/ /nor rnams bsgrubs nas phongs pa gso bar shog /ri bong gyur tshe bram ze bkres pa zhig /gso phyir me yi nang du mchongs pa ltar/ /bdag kyang bkres pas nyen pa'i sems can la/ /rang gi lus kyang btang nas gso bar shog /bram zer gyur nas dka' ba spyod pa'i tshe/ /dka' thub zas kyang slong la byin pa ltar/ /bdag la 'tsho ba cung zad tsam zhig las/ /med rung slong ba byung na ster bar shog /rgyal po byams pa'i stobs su gyur pa'i tshe/ /gnod sbyin rang gi khrag gis gsos pa ltar/ /bdag kyang khrag la dga' ba'i sems can la/ /lus kyi khrag kyang byen nas gso bar shog /rgyal bu thams cad sgol du gyur pa'i tshe bu dang bu mo rgyal srid sbyin pa ltar/ /bdag kyang gces pa'i mi nor zas gsum kun/ /btang nas 'gro kun bde la 'god par shog /sa skyong rgyal por gyur tshe bgrang yas kyi/ /dud 'gro'i srog bskyabs dge la bkod pa ltar/ /bdag kyang dud 'gro mang po'i srog skyob cing / /'gro kun dge bcu'i khrims la 'god par shog /lha yi dbang por gyur tshe g.yul 'gyed dus/ /rang srog blos btang bya phrug srog bskyabs ltar/ /bdag kyang rang gi lus 227

srog blos btang nas/ /sems can gzhan srog skyob la 'bad par shog /bram zer gyur tshe rang gi slob dpon gyes/ /bskul yang ma byin pa rnams ma blangs ltar/ /bdag la gzhan nor longs zhes bskul na yang / /ma byin pa rnams nam yang mi len shog /shi bi'i rgyal por gyur tshe blon po yis/ /mjes ma phul yang log g.yem ma byas ltar/ /bdag la gzugs mdzes bu mo phul na yang / /mi tshangs spyod pa nam yang mi byed shog /ded dpon chen por gyur tshe bden tshig gis/ /don mthun rgya mtsho'i klong nas mthar phyin ltar/ /bdag kyang bden tshig grub nas nyam thag gi /sems can chu dang mtsho las sgrol bar shog /nya yi rgyal por gyur tshe bden tshig gis/ /char phab mtsho skam nya rnams gsos pa ltar/ /bdag kyang bden tshig brjod nas sems can la/ /phan pa'i dus su char ba 'phebs par shog /sreg pa'i phru gur gyur tshe bden tshig gis/ /nags me phyir log gzhan srog bskyabs pa ltar/ /bdag kyang bden tshig brjod nas nags la me/ /shor ba bsad nas gzhan srog skyob par shog /lha dbang brgya byen gyur tshe chos bstan nas/ /rgyal blon sde rnams myos chang spangs pa ltar/ /bdag gis gzhan rnams chang gis phung ba la/ /chos bstan chang spangs bde la 'god par shog /rgyal rigs phyug 228

por gyur tshe 'dod yon gye/ /nyes dmigs mthong nas blo yis btang ba ltar/ /bdag kyang 'dod yon nyes dmigs legs bsams nas/ /'khor ba'i phun tshogs blo yis gtong bar shog /grags ldan bram ze'i rigs su 'khrungs pa'i tshe/ /rkyen ngan lam bsgyur gnod sems spangs pa ltar/ /bdag kyang rkyen ngan chos kyi grogs su bsgyur/ /gnod cing 'tshe ba'i bsam ngan spong bar shog /rgyal po'i tshong dpon gyur tshe rab byung nas/ /khas blangs tshul khrims mtha' ru phyin pa ltar/ /bdag kyang tshe rabs kun tu rab byung nas/ /khas blangs tshul khrims mtha' ru phyin par shog /gtsug phud byang chub gyur tshe rgyal po yis/ /brnyas kyang khro med bzod pa bsgoms pa ltar/ /bdag la mthon po rnams kyis brnyas na yang / /nam yang khro med bzod pa bsgom par shog /ngang pa'i rgyal por gyur tshe rnyi nang du/ /bzung yang khro dang 'jigs med chos bstan ltar/ /bdag kyang gzhan gyis bzung nas bkyigs na yang / /khro dang 'jigs pa med par chos ston shog /kun rgyu byang chub ces byar gyur pa'i tshe/ /mang pos brnyas kyang khro med bzod pa ltar/ /bdag la mang po rub nas brnyas mod kyang / /mi khro de dag chos la sbyor bar shog /spre'ur gyur tshe g.yang la lhung ba'i mi/ /drangs tshe mi des gnod kyang phan 229

btags ltar/ /bdag gis phan byas lan du gnod na yang / /da dung gnod lan phan pas 'jal bar shog /ri dwags sha rar gyur tshe rang nyid la/ /gnod pa'i rgyal po g.yang las drangs pa ltar/ /bdag kyang dgra dang gnyen la khyad med par/ /gnod pa'i dgra yang bu bzhin skyong bar shog /ri dwags bse rur gyur tshe chus khyer mi/ /bsgral nas gnod pa byas kyang bzod pa ltar/ /bdag gis phan btags lan du gnod byed kyang / /de la khro med bzod pa bsgom par shog /spre'ur gyur tshe rang lus zam pa byas/ /spre'u mang po chu las bsgral ba ltar/ /bdag kyang rang gi lus la brten nas gzhan/ /'jigs pas nyen pa chu las sgol bar shog /drang srong bzod pa smra bar gyur pa'i tshe/ /rgyal pos lus po gtubs kyang bzod pa ltar/ /bdag kyang gzhan gyes lan mang gtubs na yang / /khong khro bral zhing bzod pa bsgom par shog /tshangs pa'i rgyal por gyur tshe yan lag byen/ /lta ngan yang dag lam la bkod pa ltar/ /bdag kyang yan lag la sogs lus btang nas/ /lta log yang dag lam la 'god par shog /glang chen gyur tshe skye bo bdun brgya tsam/ /bkres pa lus po byen nas gsos pa ltar/ /bdag gis gces pa'i lus kyang bkres pa la/ /phangs med byen nas sems can gso bar shog/rgyal bu zla 230

bar gyur tshe rkang khra la/ /chos bstan btson du bzung rnams btang ba ltar/ /bdag gis brtson 'grus chen pos chos bstan nas/ /btson du bzung ba rnams kyang thar par shog /lcags khyim gnas pa'i rgyal por gyur pa'i tshe/ /byang sems ting 'dzin bsgom la brtson pa ltar/ /bdag kyang rnam g.yeng tshogs rnams rgyang bsrings nas/ /dben pa'i gnas su bsam gtan bsgom par shog /ma ter gyur tshe spre'us gtses pa la/ /bzod cing gnod sbyin zhig la chos bstan ltar/ /bdag la dman pa rnams kyis gtses na yang / /bzod cing gnod sbyin rnams la chos ston shog/bya shing rta mor gyur tshe nyam thag gi /seṅge gsos nas lha la chos bstan ltar/ /bdag gis shes rab chen pos 'chi ba rnams/ /gso zhing lha la dam chos ston par shog /tha mar zas gtsang sras por gyur pa'i tshe/ /myur du sangs rgyas chos 'khor bskor ba ltar/ /bdag kyang myur du mngon par sangs rgyas nas/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro la chos 'khor bskor bar shog /ston pa 'das kyang gsung rab glegs bam gyis/ /'gro ba yongs la phan thogs 'byung ba ltar/ /bdag ni shi yang glegs bam 'di nyid kyis/ /mthong thos 'gro la phan thogs 'byung bar shog /dpe 'di gang gis 'dri zhing 'don pa dang / /lan cig tsam re 231

thos pa thams cad kyi/ /mi dge sdig pa'i bsam sbyor shugs kyis 'gags/ /rnam dkar dge ba ngang gis 'phel bar shog /glegs bam gang du gnas pa'i sa phyogs su/ /nad mug 'khrug rtsod ming yang mi grag cing / /lo legs 'bru nor longs spyod 'phel zhing rgyas/ /bkra shis dge legs g.yang kun 'khyil bar shog /ces ngo mtshar sprul pa'i glegs bam zhes bya ba 'di ni/ lam bslab pa gsum gye nyams len/ lung sde snod gsum gye 'chad nyan sogs ri bo dge ldan pa'i bshad sgrub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan mthon po srid pa'i rtse mo'i bar du ches cher bsgreng ba'i bla ma skyes bu dam pa'i rnam 'phrul bon ri'i sprul sku dang / rdo chu'i sprul sku/byang chub kyi sems gnyis 'byongs pa'i sar gnas kyi byang chub sems dpa' mda' ba bla ma dang / sog po dge slong blo bzang skal bzang / gsang sngags snga 'gyur rnying ma'i chos la mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa ya tho ring bla ma dang / rig 'dzin o rgyan rnam rgyal/ 'phags pa'i nor bdun gyes phyug cing dpal ldan 'bri gung pa'i rang lugs 'dzin pa'i rgyang grags bla ma dang /kun bzang bstan 'dzin/ dpal ldan sa skya ba'i ring lugs dri ma med pa 'dzin skyong spel ba bon mo phug gi bla ma dang / bzhi sde'i slob bu rgyal mtshan/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzoms 232

pa'i mang nang bla ma dang / blo bzang phun tshogs/ dam pa'i chos la thos bsam sgom gsum la brtson pa'i bstan 'dzin nyi ma dang / bsod nams rin chen rnams kyis lha rdzas bcas kun gyi shes rgyud la phan pa'i legs bshad cig dgos zhes snga gong nas bskul ba dang / phyis su sngon bsags smon lam gyi mthu che zhing / dad gtong shes rab kyi nor dang ldan pa'i spu hreng bshad 'phel gling gi chos mdzad thogs med dang / dge slong bstan dar/ rig gnas shes bya'i phyogs la blo gros che ba'i blo bzang dar rgyas dang / dge rgan drung pa/ lugs gnyis blang dor gyi gnas rnams la mkhas pa'i dbu mdzad don 'grub chos 'phel dang / dge bskul rta mgrin/ rnam dkar dge sbyor la brtson pa'i gnyer tshang sde pa dang / grwa tshang gnyer ba/ bsod nams ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis bsog pa la brtson pa'i blo bzang bsod nams dang / bsod nams dar rgyas sogs dad can gyi slob bu dge 'dun 'dus sde yongs kyis kyang / khyed gdul bya gzhan don du phebs 'gro yang / 'dir sdod pa'i bdag cag rjes 'jug rnams la/ thos pa tsam gyi blo chos min gyi snang ba dur re po 'di 'gags nas/ rnam dkar dge ba'i bag chags sems la 'jog nus pa'i legs bshad zab mo zhig dgos zhes yang 233

yang bskul ngor/ rang gi yid la goms par bya phyir dang / skal bzang gzhan la'ang phan par bya ba'i lhag bsam dag pas kun nas bslangs te/ ston pa thugs rje can gyi skyes rabs rnam thar dang / gsung rab kyi dgongs don rnams kun gyis go sla ba'i phyir ngo mtshar ba'i gtam rgyud rnam pa sna tshogs dang sbyar nas/bya btang snyom las pa tshogs drug rang grol lam/ ming gzhan byams pa chos dar du 'bod pas/ bde skyid snyan gsum 'dzoms pa'i spu hreng bshad 'phel gling gi dgon pa'i 'du khang gi yang steng / 'od gsal nyi 'od 'khyil ba'i bka' 'gyur lha khang nyams dga' nas sbyar ba'o//smras pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi rnam thar dang / /chos dang 'jig rten gnyis kyi bslab bya'i mchog /sngar med ngo mtshar sprul pa'i glegs bam 'di/ /chos pa 'jig rten pa la phan pa'i phyir/ /mdo smad reb gong gser mo ljongs kyi yul/ /gnas mchog bkra shis 'khyil nas par du bsgrubs/ /'dis mtshon dge bas rgyal khams thams cad la/ /bde skyid nyi ma bzhin du 'char bar shog /sarba maṅga lam̐//234

༄ / /rgyal sras sprul pa'i glegs bam bzhugs so//༄༅/ /na mo gu ru mañdzu sgo ṣa ya/ /g.yas nas tsan dan lde gu 'jam pos sku la byug par byed pa dang / /g.yon nas sta gri rnon pos sku lus gshag par byed pa gnyis la yang / /nye ring chags sdang phyogs ris mi mnga' dgra gnyen bar ma'i sems can rnams/ /rang gi bu bzhin brtse bas skyong mdzad ston pa sangs rgyas gus phyag 'tshal/ /byams brtse byang chub sems kyi gru chen la/ /brten nas 'gro kun 'khor ba'i mtsho las bsgral/ /rnam mkhyen nor bu'i gling du 'khrid mkhas pa'i/ /ded dpon mchog gyur jo bo yab sras mchod/ /rgyal ba'i gsung rab dgongs 'grel tshig don gcig kyang ma lus thugs su chud/ /rgyal khams yongs la bstan pa spel ba'i bstan 'dzin skyes bus sa steng khyab/ /rgyal bstan spel la 'gran zla bral zhes rab 'byams phyogs bcu'i zhing na gleng / /rgyal ba gnyis pa blo bzang grags pa'i zhabs kyi padmor lan brgyar 'dud/ /byams dang snying rje byang chub sems gnyis kyi/ /gdams pa ston mdzad rtsa 235

ba'i bla ma la/ /snying nas phyag dang bcas te gsol ba 'debs/ /byang chub sems mchog 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /snyan pa yongs grags rgyal sras thogs med kyi/ /snyan brgyud gdams pa blo sbyong don bdun ma'i/ /snyan pa'i ba dan dkar po bdag gis 'phyar/ /snyan gyi dbang po gtod la kun gyis nyon/ /de yang gangs ri'i mgon po 'phags pa sbyan ras gzigs kyi rnam 'phrul rgyal sras thogs med rin po ches/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab kun gyi nying khu rgyal sras rnams kyi thugs dam gyi mthil/ sangs rgyas kyi sa ru bgrod pa'i myur lam/ dpal ldan a ti sha yi man ngag byang chub kyi sems gnyis la blo sbyong ba'i tshul snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa zab mo phyi rabs gang zag rnams kyi don du yi ger bkod pa blo sbyong don bdun ma zhes yongs la grags pa de ni gang bshad par bya ba'i chos so/ /de ji ltar 'chad na/ blun po bdag dang bdag 'dras go sla zhing yid ches pa'i phyir/ de'i don gyi cha rags rim tsam zhig sngon gyi gtam rgyud dang gsung sgos khyad par can rnams dang sbyar nas bshad par bya'o/ /de yang 'gro ba yongs kyi sngon nas ma 'dris pa'i mdza' bshes chen po mnyam med thub pa'i dbang po de nyid/ bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol nas bde ba can la 236

sogs pa'i dag pa'i zhing khams gzhan las kyang ches cher rnam par dag pa'i zhing khams shig tu rgyal ba dbang po'i tog tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas zin kyang / slar yang sems can gye don du byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pa'i tshul bstan nas/ bskal chen grangs med gsum gye tshogs rdzogs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'od srungs 'jig rten du byon pa'i tshe bram ze'i khye'u bla mar gyur/ de nas dga' ldan du dam pa tog dkar du gyur pa de nyid lha'i rol mo'i sgra las 'dzam bu'i gling du phebs par bskul bas/ gzigs pa lngas gzigs te ser skya'i gnas su yum sgyu 'phrul ma'i lhums su zhugs shing /mchu zla ba la sku bltams/ de nas dgung lo nyer dgu'i bar du rgyal bo'i khab tu bzhugs nas lha mi grangs med smin par mdzad/ nyer dgu pa la khyem nas khyem med par rab tu byung ste/lo drug tu dka' ba spyad/ de nas rgya gar rdo rje gdan gye byang chub shing dbang gi drung nas mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i tshul bstan nas chos 'khor bskor te 'gro ba grangs med pa zhig smin cing grol bar mdzad pa yin la/ ston pa thugs rje can de nyid kyis gsung rab kun gyi snying po byang chub sems kyi gdams pa/ rgyal tshab byams pa mgon po la gnang / des 237

'phags pa thogs med la gnang / des slob dpon dbyeg gnyen la gnang / des 'phags pa grol sde la gnang / des btsun pa grol sde la gnang / des seng ge bzang po la gnang /des gu ṇa mi tra la gnang / des ku su lu che ba la gnang / des ku su lu chung ba la gnang / des bla ma gser gling pa la gnang ste/bla ma 'di gser gling rgyal po'i sras yin/ gling de 'dzam gling dang gling chung gnyis ka ma yin zhing / gling der res nang pa'i bstan pa/ res phyi ba'i bstan pa byung ba las/ de dus phyi ba yod/khong 'khrungs ma thag dkon mchog la skyabs 'gro mdzad pas/mu stegs byed rnams kyi blo la ma ran kyang / rgyal po'i sras su song bas ci yang byed ma nus so/ /lo drug bdun lon dus nags gseb tu byon pas/ thub pa'i gser sku mtho gang tsam zhig rnyed byung nas/ de la phyag mchod 'ba' zhig mdzad/ cher bskyed pa dang 'di chos la mos par 'dug pas/ rgya gar du chos slob tu gtang ba drag zer nas rgya gar du btang bas mkhas pa'i mchog tu gyur cing / grags pas kyang 'dzam gling khyab par gyur/ de nas gser gling du byon nas thams cad nang pa'i bstan pa la bkod de chos dang dpal 'byor gnyis ka rgyas par mdzad do/ /des jo bo rje la 238

gnang / jo bo 'di za hor rgyal po dge ba dpal bya ba'i sras bar ba yin/ khong la 'bangs grong khyer 'bum tsho bdun yod/longs spyod rgya nag stong khun dang mnyam/ khong 'khrungs ma thag sgrol ma'i zhal gzigs/ bu chung gi dus su bla ma ra hu la gu ṇa bha tra la kye rdor gyi dbang zhus pas zhal mthong / cher bskyed nas lo nyer dgu'i bar du spyir rig pa'i gnas lnga khyad par rgyud sde bzhi la sbyangs pas mkhas shing grub pa brnyes/ yi dam mang po'i zhal gzigs/ dkyil 'khor gye sgo mang po phye/ ting nge 'dzin ri rgyud tsam yod/ mngon shes lnga thob bo/ /jo bo'i thugs dgongs la/ da ni nags sam dur khrod du bsdad la gsang sngags kyi sgo nas tshe gcig la sangs rgyas bsgrub par bya'o/ /snyam du bsams ma thag bla ma ra hu la ri nag bya rkang can na bzhugs pas mkhyen nas/ de dang jo bo bzhugs pa'i bar la nyin lam mang po yod kyang skad cig la jo bo'i mdun du byon na sa/ khyod kyis rig pa'i gnas lnga shes pa sogs gong gi yon tan de rnams kyis gar yang mi phyin pas/ rab tu byung la yi dam thugs rje chen po la gyis/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems 'ba' zhig sgoms gsungs/ bla mas de ltar gsungs kyang / nga rang cha lugs 'di la gnas te gsang sngags kyi kun spyod bya snyam du dgongs pa la/239

nub cig rmi rām du thub pa 'khor bcas gdugs tshod gsol gyin 'dug pa'i gral bshams na khong rang yang 'dug la/ thub pa 'khor bcas khong la spyan ce re gzigs nas/ khyod ci la chags nas rab tu mi 'byung gsungs pa zhig rmis pas/ da nges par rab tu 'byung dgos par 'dug dgongs nas phal chen sder chig rdzogs mdzad de/ bla ma rnyarma rakṣi ta la blo sbyong zhus pas byang chub sems la nges shes skyes/ yang bla ma byams pa'i rnal 'byor pa la zhus pas sngar bas nges shes skyes/ rdo rje gdan la phyi skor mdzad pa'i nam mkha' la bud med rgan gzhon gnyis 'dug pas rgan pa la gzhon pas phyag 'tshal nas/ myur du sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pas chos gang la bslab par bya zhes zhu yin 'dug pa la/ rgan pa na re/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems la bslab par bya'o gsungs nas/ gsang sngags lugs kyi byang sems sgom pa'i man ngag cig gsung gin 'dug pa la jo bos kyang gsan pas bum pa gcig nas gcig tu byo ba ltar thugs su chud cing / byang chub kyi sems la sngar bas kyang nges shes skyes/ yang nang skor la byon pas gtsang khang gi lha chung ba rnams kyis lha che ba la phyag 'tshal nas sngar ltar zhus pas/lha che che rnams kyis sngar ltar gsungs nas/ phar phyin lugs kyi 240

byang sems sgom lugs shig gsung gin 'dug pa'ang gsan pas sngar ltar gyur/ de nas bla ma gser gling pa byang chub sems kyi bdag po byed kyin 'dug pas/ khong la'ang zhu ru 'gro dgongs nas tshong pa mang po dang bsdongs te gser gling du phyin pas/ bla ma dang mjal ma thag skye ba snga ma'i bla mar shes/mos gus tshad med skyes/ bla mas kyang khyed bstan pa'i bdag por mnga' gsol ba'i rten 'brel byed pa yin gsungs nas khong rang gis rnyed pa'i gser sku de gnang / khyed ci la 'ongs gsungs/ bdag byang chub kyi sems zhu ru 'ongs pa lags zhus pas/ 'o na lo bcu gnyis su sdod nus sam gsungs/ nus lags zhus/ der lo bcu gnyis dbu sngas sbrel nas zhus gdams ngag bum pa gang byor gnang nas bdag pas gzhan gces kyi lhag bsam rnam dag 'khrungs/de nas rgya gar rdo rje gdan du byon nyin gcig jo bo kha sar pa ṇi la phyag mchod mdzad du byon pas kha sar pa ṇis jo bo la/khyod kyis rnyed pa legs po rnyed do/ /da ni sems can la phan pa dpag med sgrubs shig khyad par bod du song / de na khyod kyi yi dam sgrol ma yang 'gro don mdzad kyin yod gsungs nas lung bstan pa ltar bod du byon nas byang chub sems kyi gdams pa 241

'dis mtshon pa'i zab rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas 'gro don rgya chen po mdzad do/ /jo bo rje la mkhas grub kyi bla ma brgya dang lnga bcu tsam yod kyang / bla ma gser gling pa'i mtshan thos pa tsam gyis spyan chab 'byin/ phyag thal mo sbyor/ zla ba re re bzhin 'das mchod kyang mdzad pa la bu chen rnams kyis jo bo la mkhas grub kyi bla ma mang du bzhugs pa la gser gling pa la 'di tsam gyis gus pa ci lags zhus pas/ nga'i bla ma rnams la yon tan che chung yod nas khyad par byas pa min/ gser gling pa kho bo la bka' drin che bas yin gsungs/ bka' drin ci bdog zhus pas/ kho bo la yon tan du bya ba sems bzang po phrig tsam zhig yod pa 'di gser gling pa'i sku drin yin gsungs/ zengs shig phyag bsnyung du byung ba la bang ston gyi pang du phyag bzhag nas/ 'di la khyod kyis byin rlabs shig gyis dang / khyod la bsam pa bzang po yod gsungs nas/ bsam pa bzang po kho na la rtsis su mdzad/ khams bde byed pa la'ang sems bzang po byung ngam gsungs/ zhal ta mdzad pa la'ang sems bzang po gyis ang gsungs/ jo bos/ 'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas la gnang / des mnyam med po to ba rin chen gsal la gnang / des sha ra ba la gnang / des byang sems 'chad kha ba 242

la gnang / 'chad kha ba khong gis sngar gsang sngags gsar rnying —gi chos mang du mkhyen/ mtshan nyid kyi gzhung la yun ring sbyangs/po ti brgya tsam zhig mkhyen kyang / thugs kyi gting na 'tshang rgya ba la chos byed lugs 'di 'dra min pa'i man ngag gi gnad zab mo zhig yod yong snyam pa zhig nar mar byung / nam zhig na dge ba'i bshes gnyen glang ri thang pa'i blo sbyong tshig brgyad ma'i dpe zhig gzigs pas/ khe dang rgyal kha gzhan la 'bul/ /gyong dang bub kha rang gis len/ /gsungs pa de la thugs dad chen po 'khrungs nas/ dpon g.yog 'ga' dang bcas sha ra ba'i spyan sngar phyin te bdag gis mthong ba'i chos shig na/bdag gi bde ba sems can la btang zhing / sems can gye sdug bsngal rang gi khur du blang bar bya gsungs par gda' bas/ de bdag gi sems la phan pa zhig byung bas/ de sangs rgyas pa'i gdams ngag gsha' ma zhig lags sam zhus pas/ jo bo ston pa khyod kyi sems la phan ma phan gyi kha na ci yod/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas mi bsgrub na mi bsgrub/ bsgrub phan chad bsam pa de lta bu zhig la ma brten par 'grub mi srid gsungs/ 'o na de la yid ches kyi lung zhig 'tshal zhus pas/'phags pa klu sgrub la tshad mar mi byed pa su yod/ rin chen 243

phreng ba las/ bdag la de dag sdig smin cing / /bdag dge ma lus der smin shog /ces gsungs gda' ba gsungs pas/ shin tu mos par gyur te/ blo sbyong gi gdams pa 'di zhus nas thugs nyams su bzhes pas gdeng thob par gyur cing / chos 'di'i 'phrin las kyi bka' babs byang sems 'chad kha ba de nyid kyis se spyil bu pa la gnang / des lha spyil phu pa la gnang / des ram pa lha sding ba la gnang / des sangs rgyas dpon la gnang /des yon tan dpal la gnang / des mkhan chen bde ba dpal la gnang / des mkhan chen bka' bzhi pa la gnang / des rin bo che bsod nams grags pa la gnang / des rgyal sras thogs med bzang po la gnang / khong gi sku tshe ril por blo sbyong 'di nyams su bzhes pas bdag pas gzhan gces pa'i byang chub kyi sems bcos ma ma yin pa thugs rgyud la 'khrungs pas/ 'brel tshad don dang ldan par gyur te/ tha na dud 'gro'i rigs su gtogs pa rnams kyang sku'i gam du nye bar sleb pa na zhe sdang zhi nas phan tshun byams sems dang ldan par gyur ces grags te/de yang sems dpa' chen po de la gzhan gyes phul ba'i sha khye zhig yod pa yang rna ba mo dang rtse ba dang / spyang ki zhig yod pa'ang sems can la mi 'tshe/ ngang pa zhig yod pa des kyang 244

sems dpa' chen po skor ba mdzad pa'i tshe skor ba byed pa byung /bla ma dpal ye la shig nad byung dus khong gi shig nad blangs pa dang / sprang po shig nad can gye shig nad blangs pa sogs gzhan gye sdug bsngal dngos su blangs pa'i lo rgyus kyang mang du mchis/ tshogs chos gsungs pa'i dus sems can gyi sdug bsngal la ma bzod nas rgyal sras pa nyid kyis bshums tsa na chos nyan byengs po ngu cho thag thag 'ong / de la mtshan nyid pa zhig na re/ mkhan po bu ston pas chos gsungs tsa na bzhad gad thag thag nyams dga' zhad che bar 'dug 'di pas chos gsungs pa 'di mi gces shi ba bzhin ngu cho thag thag sdug zhad che zer/ khong gi thugs rje chen pos gzhan nag can bskyabs pa dang / 'jigs pas nyen pa thar par mdzad pa'i gtam rgyud kyang mang du snang / rgyal sras rin po che des rje btsun red mda' ba la gnang / des rje btsun tsong kha pa chen po la gnang /khong gis byang chub sems kyi gdams pa 'di nyid thugs nyams su bzhes nas rjes su gdams pa 'dis mtshon pa'i zab rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas stod dzra ti dbyug pas brdung ba man chad nas/ smad rgyal mo chu la dar 'thag pa yan chad la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i snying po gser sbyangs btso ma lta bus 245

khyab par mdzad/ ngur smrig 'chang bas 'dzin ma'i khyon kun dog par bgyi nus pa tsam byung / des thugs sras hor ston nam mkha' dpal la gnang / des rje dge 'dun grub la gnang /des 'dul 'dzin blo gros sbas pa la gnang / des paṇa chen ye shes rtse mo la gnang / des skyabs mchog dpal la gnang / des rje btsun dben sa ba chen po la gnang / des mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes la gnang / des rje btsun chos kyi rgyal mtshan la gnang / des rje zhabs drung lha ba blo bzang dar rgyas la gnang /des grub chen blo bzang byams pa la gnang / des grub dbang chos rgya mtsho la gnang / des grub dbang blo bzang rnam rgyal la gnang /des yongs 'dzin paṇḍi ta ye shes rgyal mtshan la gnang /des drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma yon tan lhun grub la gnang / des bdag la dgyes bzhin gnang ba'o/ /brgyud pa'i bla ma de dag rnams kyang lung rtogs yon tan du ma mnga' brnyes pa/ yi dam gyi lha mang po'i zhal gzigs pa/spyan dang mngon shes sogs yon tan mtha' yas pa mnga' ba/mtha' yas pa'i 'gro ba sgol ba la gcig tu gzhol zhing mthu dang ldan pa/ khyad par byang chub kyi sems gnyis kyi rtogs pa mchog tu gyur pa'i mkhas grub 'ba' zhig go /brgyud pa de las 246

byung ba'i gdams pa yid bzhin gyi nor las lhag pa 'di nyid nyams su len pa la/ dang po sngon 'gro rten gyi chos bstan pa dang / dngos gzhi byang chub kyi sems gnyis sbyang ba dang / rkyen ngan byang chub kyi lam du 'khyer ba/ tshe gcig gi nyams len dril nas bstan pa/ blo 'byongs pa'i tshad/ blo sbyong gi dam tshig blo sbyong gi bslab bya dang bdun las/ dang po sngon 'a/ gro ten gye chos bstan pa ni/ mnyam med gser gling pa dang jo bo yab sras sogs bka' gdams bla ma rnams kyis chos gang nyams su len kyang / dang po sngon 'gro sbyor ba'i chos drug gtong ba'i phyag len ltar/ thog mar gnas khang byi dor bya zhing sku gsung thugs kyi rten bkram/ mchod pa g.yo med cing bkod pa mdzes par bshams/ bde ba'i stan la lus rnam snang chos bdun nam tsog pu sogs spyod lam gang bder gnas nas rang rgyud la brtags nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi bsgom/ mdun gyi nam mkhar thub dbang gis gtso byas tshogs zhing gi lha gsal gdab/ bsags sbyang gi gnad bsdus pa yan lag bdun pa maṇḍal dang bcas pa 'bul/ phyin ci log gi blo sna mtha' dag 'gags pa dang / phyin ci ma log pa'i blo sna mtha' dag rgyud la skye ba dang / rkyen phyi nang gi bar chad thams cad nye bar zhi bar 247

byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes gsol ba 'debs pa rnams thun gyi thog mar btang nas/ chos gang nyams su blangs kyang rgyud la nyams rtogs ma skyes pa skye ba dang / skyes pa rnams gong 'phel du 'gro ba'i thabs gnad bla na med pa'o/ /khyad par blo sbyong 'di'i bla brgyud gsol 'debs rgyas pa bya zhing / de ma thub na/mnyam med thub pa'i dbang po man chad nas/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma yan chad kyi/ /blo sbyong brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /blo kha chos la phyogs par byen gyis rlobs/ /dam chos lam du 'gro bar byin gyis rlobs/ /byang chub sems gnyis 'byong bar byen gyes rlobs/ /bdag gzhan don gnyis 'grub par byen gyes rlobs/ /zhes gsol ba yang yang 'debs par bya'o/ /de yang las dang skal bar ldan pa rnams kyis tshe 'dir myur ba myur du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par 'dod pas thog mar lam gyi rtsa ba bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten dgos te/ mnyam med po to ba chen pos 'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas la sogs bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po tshul bzhin bsten nas gzhan la yang / chos rnams kun gyi dang po'i mgo ni/ bshes gnyen dam pa mi gtang ba yin gsungs/ rgyal sras thogs med rin po ches/248

mkhan chen bsod nams grags pa la sogs pa'i bshes gnyen dam pa mang po bsten nas gzhan la yang / gang zhig bsten na nyes pa zad 'gyur zhing / /yon tan yar ngo'i zla bzhin 'phel 'gyur ba'i/ /bshes gnyen dam pa rang gi lus pas kyang / /gces par 'dzin pa rgyal sras lag len yin/ /gsungs/ de bzhin du rje bdag nyid chen pos rje btsun red mda' ba la sogs pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po bsten nas gzhan la yang / de nas 'di phyi'i legs tshogs ji snyed pa/ /rten 'brel legs par 'grig pa'i rtsa ba ni/ /lam ston bshes gnyen dam pa 'bad pa yi/ /bsam dang spyor bas tshul bzhin bsten pa ru/ /mthong nas srog gi phyir yang mi gtong bar/ /bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i mchod pas mnyes par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsam sbyor gnyis kyi sgo nas tshul bzhin du bsten dgos/ de la bsam pa dad gus kyis bsten tshul ni/ sngon sangs rgyas 'khor bcas lho phyogs kyi ri mtho ba la gshegs pa dang / 'khor de'i nang nas byang chub sems dpa' mthong ba don yod kyi bsam pa la kye ma da lta ni sangs rgyas la chos nyan du yod na/ sangs rgyas 'das nas ji ltar bya snyam pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhal nas/ kwa ye 249

mthong ba don yod khyod/ /phyi ma'i dus su gyur pa na/ /nga ni slob dpon gzugs kyis ston/ /gsungs/ yang sngon ston pa sangs rgyas kyis bya gsod pa'i rngon pa sa twa zhes pa sku dngos kyis gdul ba'i skal bar ma gyur pas/ kho rang 'dra ba'i rngon par sprul te thabs kyis btul ba'i lo rgyus bzhin/ sngon dus sangs rgyas kyis 'dul ba'i spyod yul du ma gyur pa rnams la deng sang snyigs dus 'dir gang la gang 'dul gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi skur sprul nas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa yin te/ rnga bo che'i mdo las/ mya ngan ma byed kun dga' bo/ /nga ni phyi ma'i dus su ni/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen nyid sprul nas/ /khyod la sogs pa'i don byed 'gyur/ /gsungs/ des na nga la bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'di rnams sangs rgyas mi yi gzugs su shar ba yin snyam du/ sangs rgyas dang 'dra ba'i dad gus bya'o/ /sngon rtsi rgyal ba ye shes bya bas ston mo zhig byas nas/ dge bshes la yun ring po lo bcu bzhi tsam bsten pa la/ rgyud dang chos gnyis ha cang 'drer ma 'tshal na/ de gnyis 'dre ba'i thabs ji ltar bgyi zhes zhus pas/ dge bshes kyi zhal nas/rabs chad po zhig bu bu zer nas ngus so/ /gzhan gyes khyod bu med par ci la ngu byas pas/ nga bu med pas ngu ba yin zer lo/ /250

de bzhin du khyod rgyud dang chos 'drer ma btub pa de yang /khyod rang la dad pa med pas lan pa yin pas/ dad pa dad pa gyis la ngus gsungs skad/ sngon jo bo rje la bod kyi dge bshes mang pos chos gcig zhu lags zhus pas/ dad pa bskyed mdzod gsungs/ de ma gsan pa yin snyam nas skad bskyed de/ a ti sha chos zhu lags zhus pas/ te ma thos pa de ma lags te/ gdams ngag dad pa kho na lags mod/ dad pa bskyed mdzod gsungs skad/ des na bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos dang / zhal nas gsungs pa'i chos la sangs rgyas kyi gsung dang khyad par med pa'i yid ches kyi dad pa drag po bya'o/ /sngon lho brag grub chen las kyi rdo rje la/ yi dam phyag na rdo rje'i zhal gzigs pa'i dus su/ gsang ba'i bdag po'i zhal nas/ las kyi rdo rje bla ma la mos gus ma thob par yi dam lha'i zhal gzigs zer ba dang / nyams myong bzang po skyes zer ba dzun yin/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa rgyud la ma skyes par 'jig rten blos gtong zer ba rdzun yin/ las rgyu 'bras la yid ches med par sdig pa ma byas zer ba dzun yin/'khor ba'i nyes dmigs ma dran par 'jig rten mtha' dag blos gtong zer ba dzun yin/ phan sems rdul tsam yang med par byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems skyes zer ba rdzun yin/251

kun rdzob kyi chos thams cad bden med du ma rtogs par stong pa nyid rtogs zer ba rdzun yin/ las kyi rdo rje chos gsha' ma gcig byed na gzhi dad pa gal che gsungs/ 'o na nga'i bla ma 'di sangs rgyas dngos yin na skyon 'dra 'dug pas sangs rgyas dngos rang ma yin no snyam na/ de rang snang ma dag pa'i dbang gis de ltar mthong ba yin te/ sngon drang srong skar ma la dga' bas/ sangs rgyas la mu stegs kyi drang srong du mthong ba yin/'phags pa thogs med kyis rje btsun byams pa khye mo ro smad 'bus g.yeng bar mthong / slob dpon mtsho skyes kyis/ yan lag med pa'i rdo rje phag dzir mthong / slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes kyis 'phags pa 'jam dpal zhing las byed par mthong / nā ro pas tai lo pa nya gson por bsregs pa sogs mi 'tsham pa byed pa'i smyon pa lta bur mthong / me tri pas rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug sha ba ri ba rngon par mthong ba sogs sngon byon skyes chen dam pa rnams la yang mthong snang de 'dra byung na nyon mongs pa'i gting du lhung ba bdag la mthong snang log pa de 'dra 'byung ba smos ci dgos snyam du rang gis bla ma'i mdzad spyod 'ga' re skyon du mthong tshe/ dper na mkhris nad can gyis dung dkar ser por mthong ba bzhin/ de bla ma'i skyon ma yin rang 252

snang ma dag pa'i skyon gyis de ltar mthong ba yin snyam du slar mos gus cher bya'o/ /ras chung bas/ rje btsun gyis chos gsungs pa dang / gsung gang 'byon yang thugs khros thabs su gsungs pa de ci la dgongs pa lags zhus pas/ rje mi la'i zhal nas/ de gcig tu na nga'i khams rigs kyang yin la/ gnyis su nga dang mi phal cher spyod pa ye rang mi mthun par 'dug pa des lan pa yin nam gsungs/ dge bshes lha bzo ba la stod lung pas mjal res kyis bka' bkyon drag po re 'byon pa la/ lha bzo ba'i slob ma'ang yin pas/ nyag mo pas/ slob dpon 'di 'o skol dpon slob la sdang ba rang zhig 'dug byas pas/ lha bzo ba'i zhal nas/ khyod kyis bka' bkyon du go'am/ kho bo la 'dis 'di lta bu re mdzad res kyis dpal he ru ga'i byin gyis brlabs pa 'dra ba re 'ong gin yod gsungs/ des na bka' bkyon dang rdung rdeg byas na yang byen rlabs dang bka' bsgo ba yin pas dga' ba bsgom dgos te/ paṇa chen nā ro pa chen po'i sgyes mtha' 'gro mgon gtsang pa rgya ras kyi zhal nas/ rdung rdeg byas na dbang bskur yin/ /byin rlabs 'jug na de la 'jug /bka' bkyon drag po drag sngags yin/ /bar chad thams cad de yis sel/ /thugs la mi 'dogs dus tsa na/ /thugs rje 253

zhags pas 'dzin rtags yin/ /byams na byams te legs pa yin/ /sdang na sdang bas 'tshengs pa yin/ /gsungs/ gzhan yang sngon ston pa sangs rgyas kyis/ gzhan la sdig pa'i rnam smin shin tu che zhing / su gang gis bzlog tu med par myong dgos pa ston pa'i ched du dgongs nas/ 'phags skyes kyis shākya bdun stong bsad dus/ dbu snyung zhing klad pa mi bde ba byung ba dang / nyin gcig seng sdeng gi tshal ba sor bzhi pa zhig zhabs la zug pa dang / bdud kyis spyogs rdo 'phangs pa zhabs g.yas pa'i mthe bong la phog pas khrag 'o ma'i rgyun ltar babs pa'i tshul bstan pa dang / yang las kyi rnam par smin pa rang gis myong nges rnams gzhan la bsgyur du mi btub pa ston pa'i ched du/ kun tu rgyu gnas ma'i bu sangs rgyas kyi sku mdun du bsad pa la/ sangs rgyas kyis ma bskyabs par btang snyoms su bzhag pa dang / yang phyi rabs gang zag rnams la sdug bsngal byung na yid mi sun par bya ba'i ched du/ mu stegs kyi bram ze bha ra dzas/ sangs rgyas la rngan bgrangs te spyo ba byas pa dang / bram ze bu mo grags mas shing gi gzhong bur bcug nas kho mo'i lus ni dge sbyong go'u ta mas sbrum par byas so zhes skur ba btab pa dang / grong khyer ba la can du bsod snyoms la phyin pas/ 'bras zegs pa gcig 254

kyang ma rnyed par lhung bzed stong par log pa dang / mtha' 'khob kyi grong khyer la phyin dus/ bsod snyoms ma 'byor bar/3tshong ba'i rta chas sran ma rul ba bzhes dgos pa'i tshul bstan pa dang / yang ngal zhing dub pa'i mtha' spang ba'i ched du sku rgyab bsnyungs nas sman pa'i rgyal po 'tsho byed la sman uta pa la ha ta gha na rnya blangs pa dang / sku na bgres te lo drug cu rtsa gcig lon pa dang nga la nye gnas shig dgos gsungs nas kun dga' bos rtsis rnam pa bzhi bzung nas lo nyi shu rtsa gnyis su nye gnas byas pa'i tshul bstan to/ /de bzhin du rang gi bla ma yang sangs rgyas mi gzugs su shar ba yin gshis/ bzang ngan gyi mdzad pa gang ston kyang de gang gi ched du bstan pa yin mi shes snyam du rab tu dad cing gus par bya'o//de ltar ci mdzad legs par mthong ba'i dad gus chen po byas na bla ma'i byen rlabs sems la zhugs nas nyams dang rtogs pa'i yon tan thams cad 'bad med lhun grub tu 'char te/ jo mo 'ur mos/ ngas sgom tsam ma byas pa la rnam rtog rang bzhin pa mi skye bar 'dug lags zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ bla ma'i byin rlabs zhugs na rnam rtog rang sar zhi nas phyag rgya chen po ngo 'phrod pa ci rigs yod gsungs/ yang rje mi 255

la ras pa lho brag tu rje mar pa'i gzim khang la phyag 'tshal ba la byon dus na spyan chab mang po 'byin pa la/ ras chung ba rnams kyis mi bshum par zhu zhus pas/ ngas rje mar pa yab yum gye bka' drin dran pa yin gsungs/ sngon grub thob gling chen ras pa de nyid skabs shig tu dpal phag mo gru pa la mos gus tshad med pa skyes nas gsol ba 'debs shing spyan chab phyung ste dbu gyang la brdabs pas/ dpal phag mo gru pa de nyid tshogs pa mang dag cig la gsung chos gnang gin yod pa la sku'i bzhugs stangs mi thub par 'gul skyod mdzad kyin 'dug pa la/mdzad pa de 'dra ci lags zhus pas/ gling ras kho mos gus sgyes mgo bo gyang la brdabs shing 'dug nga la sdod tshugs pa'i dbang mi gda'/ mos gus gting nas skyes pa'i slob ma 'di 'dra la zer ba yin gsungs/ sngon sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis slob pa lam gyi dus su/ skye ba yod na 'chi bar 'gyur/ /'gog pa 'di ni bde ba yin/ /bya ba'i tshigs bcad phyed pa re tsam mam/ tshigs bcad re re tsam gye phyir du bla ma'i bka' drin bsab pa'am/ bla ma mnyes par byed pa la gser srang bye ba phrag 'bum mam/ rgyal po'i sras dang btsun mo yang yon du phul ba dang / sku lus la mar me stong 'dzugs pa sogs 256

sku srog longs spyod thams cad phangs pa med par btang snang /bdag gis de lta bu'i dka' las gang yang myong mi dgos par tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgya ba'i zab rgyas chos mang po thob rgyu byung ba bla ma thugs rje can gye bka' drin yin/ drin lan 'jal dgos shig 'byung rgyu yin na stong gsum gser gyes phyur bur bkang nas lan stong phul yang sku drin gye cha shas tsam yang ga la 'khor snyam du/ lto gos chos gsum gyi sgo nas bskyangs pa'i bka' drin rnams yang yang dran par byas te/ bla ma 'di bdag la bka' drin re che snyam du phyag dang zhe sa ldang ba sogs gus pa khyad par can bya'o/ /sbyor ba zang zing gi nor 'bul ba/ lus ngag gi zhabs tog byed pa/ bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i mchod pa gsum gyi sgo nas bsten tshul ni/ sngon mnyam med jo bo rje yer pa lha ri snying po'i mgul na bzhugs dus/ dge bshes 'brom gyes gser zho dgu dgu la srang re byas pa'i srang brgya dang bcu/ rta bco brgyad la sogs pa'i 'bul mo che phul/rngog legs pa'i shes rab kyis bka' gdams pha chos bu chos zhu dus gser gye maṇḍal mda' gang ba la rin po che sna tshogs pa'i tshom bu bkod nas phul ba dang / lho brag mar pa la gzhung gi rngog ston chos rdor gyes snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa zhu dus phyi 257

nang gi nor yod tshad dang / tha na ra ma rgan mo rkang pa chag pa yan chad phul ba ltar/ zang zing gi nor gang yod phul nas bla ma mnyes par bya dgos/ sngon grub thob gling ras pas/ sgom gcig mdzad de nyin cig mo rengs ma rgan mo zhig gi sgor byon nas/ da nang nga la gdan non gyis gsungs pas/ drang rgyu med zer thon 'gro grabs byed kyin 'dug pas/ mo'i thu ba nas bzung ste/ nga la rtsam pa drang rgyu med na lo ma sbang ma gang 'dug blangs gsungs/ mo nang du log song bas/ phye sgye sprugs te sran rtsam phye skyogs su hub gnyis tsam yod pa khyer byung ba ka pa lar blugs nas bzhengs byon pas/ lam la sgog chag gcig tshar 'dug pa bsdus 'ongs nas chu khar byen/ sgog chag de brdungs/sran rtsam de la bsres chu blugs sbrus te bcang ba chen po gcig byung ba la sgyur byas sgog chu de blugs nas zhal du gsol bas/bda' drags te sred pa zhig skyes pa la kha nang nas bton te/dpal phag mo gru pa mchod/ zhes nam mkhar dor btang nas gad phug cig tu thugs dam la bzhugs so/ /de'i dus tshod na dpal phag mo gru pa nye gnas stag lung pas phyag phyi byas te/zhogs ja bzhes pa'i gsol dkar gyi nang du slebs byung ba la/'gro ba'i mgon po'i zhal nas/ da nang gi gling ras kyi sgog chu 258

de zhim gsungs pa la/ stag lung pas rgyu mtshan zhus pas/ kho bo da nang gi lto ba la sgog chab cig gis phul nas za bzhin 'dug pa sred pa skyes nas/ dpal phag mo gru pa mchod zer nas 'dir stes byung ba yin gsungs/ des na zas kham gcig rnyed kyang bla ma mchod dgos/sngon sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bu mo ye shes ldan zhes bya bar gyur tshe/ chos smra ba zhig snyung ba la/sman pas de'i sman la/mi gson po'i sha dang khrag dgos/ zer ba la/ bu mo des rang gi lus kyi sha khrag phul ba'i lo rgyus bzhin/ bla ma la phan na rang gi lus kyi sha khrag 'bul dgos rung mi chags par dga' zhing spro bzhin 'bul thub pa zhig dgos/ sngon rje btsun mi la ras pas/ lho brag mar pa mnyes phyir/ sras mkhar dgu thog khyams dang bcas pa brtsigs/ rgyab tu sgal mig gsum tsam byung ba ltar/ lus ngag gi sgo nas bla ma la zhabs tog gang dgos byed dgos/ rnal 'byor pa phyag pa khri mchog gis jo bo rje'i bka' bzhin rwa sgreng gi shug gseb na ri dwags rnams dang khyad par med par bzhugs nas sku tshe gang po sgrub pa mdzad pas grub pa thob pa ltar/ dben pa'i gnas su bsdad nas bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i mchod pa phul nas bla ma mnyes par byed dgos/ de 259

ltar bsam sbyor gnyis kyi sgo nas bla ma tshul bzhin du bsten na don thams cad 'grub ste/ sngon byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngus sha dang khrag dang rus pa dang / rkang sogs kyi lus dang srog btang ste/ byang chub sems dpa' chos 'phags la bsnyen bkur byas pas tshe de nyid la phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob pa dang / nā ro paṇa chen gyes kyang grub chen te lo pa bsten dus lus srog thed la bor nas dka' ba dpag tu med pa bya dka' ba rnams spyad pas bzhed don grub pa dang / mar pa lo tstshas bla ma nā ro pa chen po sku gshegs zin kyang dad pa'i shugs chen pos btsal bas bla ma dang mjal ba'i lo rgyus dang /rje btsun mi las lho brag mar pa yab yum la bsnyen bkur byas pas don thams cad grub pa dang / bya yul pas sbyan snga ba tshul bzhin du bsten pas/ nang ma gcig la sde snod gsum dang /rgyud sde bzhi'i tshig don ma lus pa thugs la 'khrungs pa dang /dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi 'bras kyi char 'bebs nus pas bla ma pa'i bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i nye gnas lo bcu gnyis kyi sngon du sangs rgyas pa dang / bal po'i dpe dkar bhe ha rar/ bla ma grub pa thob pa'i nyin par nyid kyi sngon du nye gnas lo bcu gcig gi gong du grub pa thob pa dang / jo bo rje'i nye gnas 260

dgon pa gong ma sgrub pa byas pa'i slob ma gzhan pas khong gis bla ma'i zhabs tog 'ba' zhig byas pas rtogs pa bzang bar gyur pa dang / chos rje sa skya ba chen po'i slob ma dge bshes gtsug tor rgyal po 'das pa'i tshe/ rin po che'i khri dang gdugs dang me tog gi char babs nas mkha' spyod du gshegs pa yul ba thams cad kyis mthong ba dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen nyi ma 'od la rdzu 'phrul dang mngon shes byung ba sogs gtam rgyud de rnams dran par byas te dga' zhing spro bzhin du bla ma'i zhabs tog byed dgos/ sngon jo bo rje gshegs khar slob ma rnams 'tshogs nas bla ma mi bzhugs pa la nye bar snang / bla ma'i srol 'dzin pa su yod ces gleng ba'i dus su nag tsho'i zhal nas/ ngas da mi shes te chos thams cad kyi nang nas yon tan che skyes chung sgyes thams cad bla ma la brten nas sgye bar bshad 'dug pas bla ma'i zhabs tog 'brom ston pa 'dra ba re sus kyang ma grub/jo bo'i srol 'dzin pa zhig 'ong na khong la 'ong mchi gsungs/yang jo bo'i slob ma rnal 'byor pa'i thugs dgongs la/ nga bsod nams chung bas bla ma'i zhabs tog byed byed nas sgom pa'i dus ma byung snyam pa'i 'du shes shig byung ba na/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ lus ngag yid gsum bla ma'i zhabs tog tu bkol na 261

bsgoms kyi dmigs pa gzhan nas btsal mi dgos gsungs te/jo bo'i mngon par mkhyen pa'i zhal ta yin par gda'/ yang rnal 'byor chen pos jo bo'i zhabs tog mdzad pa la khong kun gyis sgrub thabs shig ma zhus par rta phyugs de nya ra byed cing bsdad pas ci yang ma 'ongs snyam nas rtswa gtub cing yod tsa na/ston pa'i tshems dang zhal rnam nem mdzad cing bkyon thabs su yon tan thams cad bla ma'i zhabs tog byas pa las 'byung ba yin te/ sgrub thabs re re zhus pas ci yang mi 'ong ang bya ba lan gsum gsungs/ dge bshes dgon pa ba'i zhal nas/ slob dpon ston pas lo tstsha byas/ slob dpon rnal 'byor pas bla ma'i g.yog byas/ ngas dben par rtse gcig tu sgom byas pa la rtogs pa khong gnyis po mtho bar 'dug gsungs/ grub thob gling chen ras pas/ nga la dus deng sang ja zhim po rgyun ma chad par 'thung rgyu byung ba 'di snga mo rje phag mo gru par bka' chos zhu dus shig la ja khog ma gang phul ba yin te/ de'i bsod nams yin nam snyam gsungs/ des na skal ldan gyi slob ma rnams kyis dben par bsgoms pa las kyang mtshan ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhabs tog byas na nyams rtogs bzang po dang bsod nams chen po skye bas/ dus dang rnam pa thams cad du bla ma'i zhabs 262

tog kho na la brtson par bya'o/ /sngon rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi drung du/ slob ma gcig gis/ bla ma'i gsung bzhin tshe 'di'i 'khri ba bcad/ chu bug sgo la 'dril ba byas nas rtse gcig tu bsgoms pas bla ma sangs rgyas su mthong ba sogs kyi yon tan mang rab byung lags pa bka' drin che/ da 'di bzhin byas nas bsdad na dga' 'am/ mtshams bton nas sku mdun du 'ong na dga' zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas nga 'phrad du 'ong mi dgos/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor sgom pa dang ma bral na tshe rabs thams cad du bla ma dang mi 'bral ba yin gsungs/ des na bla ma dang 'bral ba med par 'dod pas dus rtag tu bla ma'i rnal 'byor sgom pa la 'bad dgos/ yang chos rje rgod tshang pas nyams len mthil bla ma'i gsol 'debs la mdzad pa la/ dge slong sangs rgyas 'od kyis/ gsol 'debs kyi phan yon zhus pa la 'di ltar gsung ste/ gsol ba btab pa'i phan yon ni/ /spyir ni bsam gyis mi khyab lags/ /mdo tsam bsdu na 'di tsho yin/ /gsol ba btab pa'i phan yon ni/ /rje dang thugs yid gcig tu 'dres/ /gsol ba btab pa'i phan yon ni/ /thun mong ma yin rtogs pa 'char/ /gsol ba btab pa'i phan yon ni/ /rgyun chad med pa'i 263

nyams myong 'ong / /gsol ba btab pa'i phan yon ni/ /dkon mchog thugs rjes rtag tu skyobs/ /gsol ba btab pa'i phan yon ni/ /ci bsam dgos 'dod lhun gyis grub/ /gsol ba btab pa'i phan yon ni/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong bu bzhin gzigs/ /gsungs/ dge bshes ston pa'i zhal nas/ ngas ni yi dam lha la gsol ba btab pa las/ a ti sha la gsol ba btab pa byen rlabs che bar nyams myong yod gsungs/ rong chung ras pas/ rje btsun lags bsgoms pa dang bla ma la gsol ba btab pa bogs gang che lags zhus pas/ rje mi la'i zhal nas/ bla ma mtshan ldan zhig la slob ma gus ldan zhig gis gsol ba btab na sgom zhor la 'ong gsungs/ des na dus rgyun du bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa gal che/ gzhan yang bla ma lan re tsam dran pa'i phan yon ni/ ye shes gsal ba sgron me'i rgyud las/ gang gis bskal pa brgyad khri bzhi stong gi bar du sbyin pa btang /tshul khrims bsrungs/ bzod pa bsgoms/ brtson 'grus brtsams/bsam gtan la mnyam par bzhag shes rab bskyed pa las/lha'i sku mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa skad cig dran pa bsod nams che/ de bskal pa brgyad khri bzhi stong gi bar du bsgom pa bas bla ma skad cig dran pa bsod nams che'o/ /de 264

ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshe 'di nyid du sangs rgyas pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes dang / kun 'dus las/ gang gis bskal pa 'bum phrag tu/ /lha sku 'bum phrag bsgom pa bas/ /bla ma dran pa bsod nams mchog /bsod nams 'di ni pha mtha' yas/ /gsungs/ kri ya dpung bzang gi rgyud las/ skyes bu gang zhig 'chi ba'i tshe bla ma skad cig dran gyur na/ /'pho ba kun gye mchog tu 'gyur/ /skyes bu de ni mngon sangs rgyas/ /gsungs/ bla ma mthong ba'i phan yon ni/ sdong po bkod pa las/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen mthong ba ni/ yon tan rin chen thams cad kyi 'byung gnas so/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thams cad yongs su dag cing yongs su rdzogs pa'i rgyu'o/ /dran pa rnam par dag pa byed pa'o/ /gzungs kyi dkyil 'khor la sbyor ba'o/ /ting nge 'dzin gye snang ba bsgyed pa'o/ /sangs rgyas mthong ba sgrub pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi sprin gye char 'bab pa'o/ /zhes dang / gro lung pa'i bstan rim las/ de mthong bas kyang yon tan rin chen tshogs/ /kun 'byung rgyal sras spyod pa rdzogs pa'i rgyu/ /dran dang ting 'dzin gzungs sogs 'grub pa ste/ /sangs rgyas mthong zhing don chen kun rdzogs 'gyur/ /gsungs/ pha dam pa'i zhal nas/ yi dam gye lha brgya'i zhal mjal ba las/ bla ma'i zhal ras 265

lan gcig mjal ba phan yon che ste bod blun po tshos ma go'agrangs pa'i mi la mar zan brgya byin pa las/ ltogs pa'i mi la zan chang gcig byin pa bsod nams che ste bod blun po tshos ma go gsungs skad/ des na/ dus rtag tu bla ma yid la yang yang dran zhing zhal mjal phyag dbang zhu ba la yang brtson par bya'o/ /yang sku bzhengs pa dang mchod cing bstod pa'i phan yon ni/ a ti bkod pa'i rgyud las/ 'jig rten khams ni thams cad kyi/ /gser dngul la sogs rgyu las ni/ /sangs rgyas dpag tu med pa yi/ /sku gzugs grangs med byas pa bas/ /bla ma'i sku 'bag sus bris pa/ /'di ni bsod nams khyad par 'phags/ /brgya stong khri 'bum char mi phod/ /gang gis bla ma'i sku 'bag la/ /mchod cing bstod pa sus byas pa/ /rdo rje 'chang la bskal pa brgyar/ /mchod cing bstod pa'i bsod nams che/ /'bum phrag sum cu rtsa lnga yang / /phod cing mnyam pa ma yin no/ /gsungs/ 'das mchod byas pa'i phan yon ni/ bla ma'i yon tan yongs su bzung ba'i rgyud las/ bla ma 'das nas gdung bas mchod byas na/ /dge ba'i rnam smin bla ma'i rjes 'brang ste/ /thugs kyi dgongs pa gong du yongs rdzogs shing / /slob mas bla ma'i rnam thar bsnyeg par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / a ti bkod pa'i rgyud las/ 'das pa'i lo 266

zla tshes grangs la/ /ma nor ba ni brtsis byas nas/ /mchod pa'i rnam pa sus byas pa/ /tshogs gnyis rab tu rdzogs pa dang / /tshe 'dir longs spyod 'phel bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / sha ra ba'i zhal nas/ 'dus byas kyi dge ba la/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen la 'das mchod byas pa bsod nams che gsungs/ des na bla ma'i sku bzhengs pa dang / sku gzugs la mchod cing bstod pa dang /zhing brjes dus 'das mchod kyang phun sum tshogs pa bya'o/ /yang bla ma bsten tshul cung zad re log na yang don mi 'grub ste/ ḍo bhi te ru gas dang po phyugs rdzi byed pa'i dus su/nā ro pa chen po la dad nas yang yang mjal bas/ nā ro pa'i zhal nas/ khyod nga la dad dam gsungs/ dad lags zhus pas/'o na chang zhig khyer la shog gsungs/ byin pas de'i nub 'khor lo bde mchog gi dbang bskur bas/ dbang thob pa dang grub pa thob pa mnyam du byung / de'i tshe bram ze zhig ḍo bhi pa la dad nas chos zhu zer ba la/ bla ma ḍo bhi pa'i zhal nas/ bram ze la nga rnal 'byor pa'i phyi'i kun spyod la ma dad na yon tan 'grib pa yin no gsungs/ bram zes ḍo snyi pa bsten nas dzu 'phrul dang mngon shes thob cing / bla ma la bsnyen bkur tshul bzhin du byed pa'i tshe/ bla mas chang gsol ba'i zhal skyugs cung zad bram ze'i mgo 267

la phog pa bram ze gzhan zhig gis mthong ba de na re/ de 'dra khyod kyi bla ma yin nam zer ba la/ khos nga'i bla ma min byas pas/kho'i rgyud kyi mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul thams cad dung gi rdul phyis pa bzhin du song ngo / /yang snar thang pa'i lam mchog 'grel ba las/ bla ma rigs ngan gyi khri'i drung na slob ma rgyal po yod pa'i mgo thog tu bla ma'i skyug pa byung ba la byin rlabs byung snyam pa'i dad gus kyis rkang mgyogs kyi dngos grub thob cing /de nas mi mang pos bskor ba'i tshe/ bla ma byon pa la yid kyis dad gus byas/ dngos su mis 'phyas dogs nas phyag ma byas pas dngos grub yal skad/ sngon slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyes dkyil 'khor mngon sum du bstan nas sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs la khyod thog mar lha'am nga la phyag byed gsungs pas/ da lam lha gal che snyam nas phyag mdzad pas lha med song / gzod bla ma rang la phyag byas pas dngos grub thob par gsungs/ des na rang re la dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams las kyang bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams bka' drin dang byin rlabs che ba yin pas/ bla ma bzhengs shing phebs pa'i dus phyag dang ldang ba tsam yang ma byas par bsdad na yang nyes dmigs che bas dus rtag tu bla ma phyag mchod zhing gi mchog tu 268

go nas phyag 'tshal zhing skor ba byed pa dang / mchod bstod bkur ba la 'bad par bya'o/ /sngon sangs rgyas ye shes kyis 'khor lnga brgya tsam la chos 'chad pa'i tshe/ 'jam dpal bshes gnyen thag ring po nas byon pa ma gzigs pa ltar spyan byol bas spyan gnyis sa la lhung / gsol ba btab pas ye shes kyi spyan gnang skad/ sngon gling ras pas phyag rgya ma bsten pa la/ bla ma khyung mtshangs pa ma mnyes par bka' bkyon 'ga' yar gnang ba lan cig ma dad pa zhig byung / rgyu de la brten nas da lta mi kha cung zad re zer ba yang des lan snyam gsungs/ yang sngon slob dpon nag po spyod pa dang / paṇḍi ta rgyal ba'i lhas bla ma'i bka' bcag nas spyod pa la byon nas/ gnyis ka la khrag thur du zags te grongs pa'i tshul bstan/ des na bla ma la ma dad pa cung zad re dang / bka' lan re tsam bcag na yang nyes dmigs che bas/ dus kun dad cing gus pa'i sgo nas bla ma'i bka' bzhin sgrub pa gces so/ /sngon 'phan yul nang na jo gdan pa zhig gis mi bsad pas tshogs gral nas phud pas/ de phu mdo na chung ma zhig dang 'dres yod pa la/ lan cig spyan snge tshul khrims 'bar dang mjal bas spyan snga bas las rgyu 'bras gsungs nas/ mdo 269

'gag bla ma dam pa zhig bsten dgos tshul zhib par gsungs pas/ jo gdan gyi bsam pa la bla ma 'di tsho mi mgo bskor ba'i rdzun lab pa la ni mkhas par gda'/ 'on kyang rwa sgreng du 'brom gyi sku mdun du phyin pa zhig byas nas dad pa zhig skye e thub bsams nas phyin pas/ 'brom 'das pa dang thug de nas dge bshes dgon pa ba dang mjal bas/ dge bshes dgon pa bas chos gsungs pa thams cad la kho yid ma ches te/ lan cig tshogs gcig na/ 'di 'og stong phrag nyi shu na/ /mnar med dpa' bo de tsam mo/ /gsungs pas/ der jo gdan yid ma ches te/ 'di 'og dpag tshad stong phrag nyi shu na mi su phyin nas mnar med pa yod pa mthong ba lags zhus pas/ dge bshes dgon pa ba re shig spyan chab kyis brnangs nas lan ma thebs pas/ dge bshes gar sde de thams cad mkhyen pas gsungs pa yid ches kyi gnas su gzung dgos pa ma gtogs/ de na phyin mkhan gyis bshad pa la yid brtan byas pa min byas pas/ jo gdan des/ des na thams cad mkhyen pa yang thams cad mkhyen pa yin zhes mna' e thon zer nas langs song / phyis jo gdan de la/ rgyal gser khang pa'i ban de zhig gis/ khyod dge bshes dgon pa ba la dad pa skyes sam byas pas/ dge bshes 270

dgon pa ba de rdzun ma rlabs po che zhig 'dug kho de ngu ba skad mang po byed 'dug ste/ pho khyo ga nga mgo bskor thub pa zhig min zer/ des na khyod dgon pa ba la dad pa yod dam dris pas/ kho na re/ dad pa'am de ci la zer mi shes/ spyir chos sgor zhugs pa dang / bsnyen rdzogs byas pa dang / sbyang ba byas pa dang / chos zhus pa thams cad las byang chub bzang mo dang nub gcig nyal ba gnyis nub gcig nyal ba de la dga' ba byung zer/gtam de kham pa lung pas gsan pas zhag bcu'i bar du rnal ye ma byung bar bshums gda'/ des na jo gdan pa de 'dra ba zhig tu nam yang mi 'gro ba'i smon lam 'debs dgos/ mdor na bla ma bsten dus bka' bkyon gnang yang dad log mi byed cing / bla ma khur du ma song rgyan du 'gro ba zhig bya dgos te/gtsang pa rgya ras kyi zhal nas/ bde skyid 'dzoms tsa na kha po sus kyang thongs/ sdug thug tsa na kha po thon pa zhig gyis/ bla mas thugs la 'dogs tsa na mos gus su yang skye/ bka' bkyon btang tsa na dad pa ma log pa zhig gyis/ 'gal rkyen med dus jo bzang su yang yong / rkyen ngan byung tsa na gnyen pos sleb pa zhig gyis gsungs/ dge bshes dol bas/ phu chung ba la bla ma bsten tshul zhus pas/ dge bshes pa'i zhal nas/ bla ma bsten 271

pa'i dus na/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi rgyan du 'gyur bar bya yi/khur du 'dug pa mi bya gsungs/ de'i don ni/ dper na rgyan bzang po btags pa'i mi de rgyan gyis skyo bar mi 'gyur gyi/ rgyan yod pa de srid du dga' bar 'gyur ba bzhin du/ bla ma'i drung na 'dug pa'i dus su/ bla ma dgyes par 'gyur ba bya yi/ skyo bar 'gyur ba mi bya gsungs/ des na rgyal ba'i gsung rab bla ma gong ma rnams kyi gsung bzhin mtshan ldan gyi bla ma tshul bzhin du bsten pa la 'bad par bya'o/ /de ltar mtshan ldan gye bla ma bsam sbyor gnyis kyi sgo nas tshul bzhin du bsten nas/ thos pa byed dgos te/ sngon 'das pa'i dus drang srong chen po mchog ces bya ba/ mngon par shes pa lnga dang ldan pa rtag tu byams snying rje dang ldan pa zhig byung ba las/ des 'di snyam du 'di tsam gyis sems can rnams kyi nyon mongs pa sel yang mi nus/ 'phags pa'i lta ba bskyed kyang mi nus so/ /'phags pa'i lta ba gang las skye na mang du thos pa dang /tshul bzhin du so sor rtog pa las skye bas thos pas btsal lo snyam du brtson pa na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mthong ste chos du ma bstan nas/ khyod rtag tu 'du 'dzi med par tshul bzhin du so sor rtog pa la brtson par bya zhes gsungs/ yang 272

sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la/ 'khor rnams kyis sbyin pa dang / tshul khrims gnyis dang / thos pa bsod nams gang che zhus pa'i lan du rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na ri'i rgyal po ri rab kyi mdun na yungs 'bru gcig 'dug pa bzhin du sbyin pa'i tshogs dang tshul khrims kyang de dang 'dra bar blta bar bya'o/ /ri'i rgyal po ri rab ji lta ba bzhin du thos pa'i tshogs lta bar bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu de lta bas na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po brtson 'grus brtsams pa rnams kyis/thos pa'i tshogs la brtson par bya'o/ /gsungs/ 'od srungs kyi le'u las/ 'od srungs 'di lta ste/ dper na sprin med cing gnam thang ba'i nam mkha' la ni char 'bab pa'i rgyu med do/ /'od srungs de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' thos pa nyung ba la'ang dam pa'i chos kyi char 'bab pa'i rgyu med/ de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ dper na sprin med gnam thang nam mkha' la/ /char 'bab pa ni nam yang mi dmigs so/ /de bzhin byang chub sems dpa' thos nyung la/ /chos ston nam yang dmigs par mi 'gyur ro/ /'od srungs 'di lta ste/ dper na sprin chen po las byung ba'i char gyi rgyun ni lo tog thams cad mngon par 'bab bo/ /'od srungs de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' snying rje chen po dang 273
