ldan pa dang / mang du thos pa'i chos kyi sprin las byung ba'i dam pa'i chos kyi char yang sems can la mngon par 'bab bo de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ dper na sprin chen glog dang bcas pa las/ /char ba 'bab pas lo tog ngoms par byed/ /de bzhin byang chub sems dpa'i dam chos kyi/ /sprin byung chos kyis sems can tshim par byed/ /gsungs/ yang sngon bcom ldan 'das kyis chos gsungs pa'i sgra ngang pa lnga brgyas thos pas dad nas shi 'phos ma thag sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lhar skyes pa la/ kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten du gshegs pa ni ngo mtshar rmad de/ chos kyi char gyis ngoms pa ma mchis so/ /chung ngu na dud 'gro'i skye gnas lta bu yang chos thos pas bsod nams thob na mi lta ci smos te/ dad pa'i sems kyis gzungs su bzung ba'i bsod nams kyi 'bras bu de bas brgya stong gi lhag ste dper ma mchis so gsungs/sngon sangs rgyas 'od srungs 'jig rten du byon dus chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na/ mi gnyis kyis bsnyen gnas blangs te bsrung ba las/ gcig gis gtsang mar bsrungs pas 'khor los bsgyur pa'i rgyal por gyur/ gcig gis bsnyen gnas ral 274

bas klur skyes pa las/ bsnyen gnas kyi dpe blangs nas yang bsnyen gnas bsrungs pas/ phyis lhar skyes nas ston pa mchod du byung ba la chos bstan pas 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las thar/'phags pa'i go 'phang thob skad/ yang gcig gis sangs rgyas 'od srungs kyi dus su/ dge bsnyen gyi bslab pa nyams pas ne tsor skyes nas/ sangs rgyas shākya thub pa dang mjal te sems dad cing gus par gyur pa las/ re zhig na khras bsad de shi bar gyur pa lhar skyes nas/ ston pa las chos mnyan pas 'phags pa thob skad/ yang sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha nor bu dri ma med pa zhes bya ba des sngon pha bsad pa las/ 'chi khar bshes gnyen dam pa dang 'phrad pa'i mtshams sbyor khyad par can byung ba dang / sngon gyi dge ba'i las shig gis thog mar lhar skyes/phyis dmyal bar skyes te ngan song dang mi khom par gtan 'khyam lta bur bya dgos pa las/ de la sogs pa'i sems can gyi phyir spyod rgyud gsungs shing / de dmyal bar skye ba la brgya byin gyis chos gsungs pa dag byas pas/ de dga' ldan gyi lhar skyes gsungs/ yang sngon sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten khams 'dir byon nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i dus su/ lha mis gtso byas pa'i las dang skal bar ldan pa'i gdul bya mang 275

pos bka' chos thos pas skad cig tsam dang / dar cig tsam bsgoms pas kyang dgra bcom pa'i go 'phang thob pa dang / rjes su nye gnas kun dga' bos kyang zhag bdun tsam las bsgom ma dgos par dgra bcom pa thob par gsungs/ des na mtshan ldan gyi bla ma dam pa'i zhabs drung nas theg pa chen po'i bka' chos zhus nas nyan pa la brtson par bya'o/ /yang sngon tshong dpon zhig rgya gar mtha' phyogs shig la tshong du 'gro bar/ nang mi rnams kyis nor dngos po 'di 'dra khyer shog ces gnyer gdams byas pa'i tshe/ ne tso smra mkhan zhig yod pa de la/ dngos po gang khyer yong dgos byas pas/ ne tso na re/ gzhan gang yang mi dgos/ lam khar ne tso'i khyu chen po zhig dang 'phrad byung na/ de'i dbus su song la/ ne tso smra mkhan gyes khyed rnams khams bzang zhing bza' shing gi ra ba na gang skyid skyid byas sdod pa dga' ste/ nga mi'i lag tu jebs nas sbubs shin tu thums pa zhig 'dug pas/ de las thar pa'i thabs gang 'dra byas na drag gam zhes 'phrin bskur byung zhes lab rogs gyis byas so/ /de nas tshong dpon lam du thon nas zla shas song tshe ne tso'i khyu chen po zhig dang 'phrad de'i dbus su song nas 'phrin bskyal ba'i tshe/ ne tso de rnams kyi nang nas gcig sems 276

sdug dran med brgyal ba lta bu'i gshog pa lteb steb byed cing skad cig la ljon shing rtse nas sa la lhung ste shi song ba ltar byas pas/ tshong dpon gyis 'phrin bskyal ba dran/ sdig pa chen po bsags snyam/ 'gyod bzhin tshong la phyin tshong thebs nas nang du 'khor ba dang / ne tso smra mkhan gyis 'phrin e bskyal byas tshe/tshong dpon gyis 'phrin bskyal te/ thos ma thag ne tso gcig shi song byas pas/ de thos pa dang dus mnyam ne tso smra mkhan de yang sdug bsngal ba'i nyams dang bcas te tshang nang nas glo bur du shi song ba ltar byas tshe/ tshong dpon de yang 'gyod pa rtas mi zin pa byung nas/ nga yis 'phrin de 'dra gang du bskyal ba'i sa der sdig pa tshabs can bsags/ da cha ngas ne tso snying rje ba 'di yang med par byas tshar snyam/ tshang nas phyir bton 'gram du ngu bzhin bsdad pas/ ne tso shi rdzu btab pa las langs te btab btab byas 'phur nas rgya gar la song ngo / /de la dpags nas ne tso snga ma des kyang shi rdzu byas pa yin par shes so/ /de yang ne tso snga ma des shi rdzu gyis dang tshang nas thar yong zhes brda bstan pa de'i don ne tso smra mkhan gyis go nas shi rdzu byas pas tshang nas thar te rgya gar du slebs pa bzhin/ bla ma dam pas 'khor ba nas thar pa'i thabs dam pa'i chos bstan 277

pa de'i don slob ma rnams kyis go nas/ de bzhin nyams su blangs na 'khor ba las thar nas bde chen sangs rgyas kyi sa la sleb nges/ sngon long ba zhig gis/ ston dus nang mi rnams btsas ma rgyag tu song ba'i shul du nang bsrungs nas/ nyi ma mang po bsdad pas sems sun/ sdod ma tshugs par nyin gcig nang nas phyir thon phar rgyang ring zhig tu khams bsang byed du song bas/ slar phyir 'ong dus mgo 'thoms nas lam ma shes dus khong tshang gi glang ri khar yod pa'i skad go tshe kho'i bsam pa la/da glang gi mjug ma lag tu thebs na kho nang du 'gro dus nga yang slebs yong snyam/ de phyogs su song / glang gi rtsar slebs pa dang / mjug ma nas bzung bas glang gis rdo dang tsher ma la sogs sa cha rtsub po gang du khyer kyang mjug ma ma btang bar gar 'gro sar rgyugs pas dgong mo nang du slebs pa byung / des na bka' gdams pa'i gsung 'ga' re na/ long bas glang mjug bya dgos zer ba dpe de yin par gda'/ de bzhin du bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis byams pa dang snying rje byang chub sems kyi gdams pa bstan pa rnams/ rkyen ngan gang byung yang nam yang mi gtang bar nyams su blangs na nam phugs sangs rgyas kyi sa la sleb par 'gyur ro/ /278

smras pa/ rnam dag sdom pa dam tshig tshul bzhin bsrung / /rnam mang mdo sngags dge ba'i chos sdud cing / /rnam pa kun tu 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i/ /rnam grol lam ston bla ma spyi bor bzhugs/ /rgyal ba'i gsung rab bstan bcos phal cher gyi/ /bar skabs rnams su tshigs bcad mdzad pa bzhin/ /'dir yang legs bshad 'doms pa'i skabs skabs su/ /tshigs bcad dbyangs snyan dal bus bsgrag par bya/ /skyon kun zad cing yon tan kun dang ldan/ /phan btags ma btags med par 'gro kun gyi/ /mgon skyabs dpung gnyen mdzad pa'i lha mchog de/ /ston pa sangs rgyas ma gtogs gzhan ma mchis /mgon de'i gsung rab 'o ma'i rgya mtsho yi/ /snying po byang chub sems kyi mar mchog de/ /bod yul ljongs 'dir bsnams nas 'byon mkhan rje/ /mnyam med jo bo ma gtogs gzhan na gang / /de nyid bdag la rab tu brtse ba'i sgos/ /stsol mdzad drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma yi/ /sku drin gzhal dgos byung na su yis 'khor/ /snyam nas dad gus dbyar gyi mtsho ltar rgyas/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad mchod pa las/ /bla ma'i ba spu gcig mchod bsod nams che/ /bskyed rim bskal pa'i bar du bsgom pa las/ /bla ma dran pa bsod nams 'bum phrag lhag /bsnyen sgrub 279

bzlas pa sa ya byas pa las/ /bla ma'i gsol 'debs lan gcig byas pa dga'/ /yi dam lha brgya'i zhal ras mjal ba las bla ma yud tsam mjal ba phan yon che/ /rang la dam chos ston pa'i bla ma rnams/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas las kyang drin che bas/ /drin gzo'i phyir du zang zing nor 'bul zhing / /lus ngag zhabs tog bka' bzhin sgrub pas mchod/ /bla mas lto gos chos gsum gnang ba'i dus/ /dad pa mi sgye ba zhig med mod kyang / /skabs re bka' bkyon rdung rdeg gnang ba'i dus/ /dad pa ma log pa re byed pa gces/ /rtag tu ngu dang nā ro mi la rje/ /'brom ston la sogs gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen tshul bzhin bsten nus na/ /tshe 'dir mchog thun dngos grub thob par nges/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos mtshan ldan bla ma la/ /brten nas byang chub sems kyi gdams pa sogs/ /zab rgyas chos la thos bsam sgom gsum byas/ /rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyes 'grub par smon/ /zhes pa bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /de ltar bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten nas/ rnyed dka'i dal ba'i rten la snying po len dgos te/ rje rin po ches /dal ba'i rten 'di yid bzhin nor las lhag /'di 'dra rnyed pa da res tsam zhig yin/ /gsungs/ sangs rgyas thugs rje can gye 280

zhal nas/ mi lus ni shin tu rnyed par dka' na de thob nas/des rnyed pa'i rgyal ba'i bstan pa la rab tu byung ba yang rnyed nas/ thar pa'i don dang mi mthun pa dag gis bslus te/gtan du sdug bsngal bar gyur ta re gsungs/ rgyal sras rin po che'i zhal nas/ chos sgrub pa'i rten dal 'byor gyi mi lus thob pa la/ rgyu dge ba phun sum tshogs pa sgrub dgos la/ sems can gyi nang na dge ba rnam dag sgrub pa nyung bas/ 'bras bu dal 'byor thob pa dka' la/ dud 'gro la sogs pa 'gro ba gzhan la bltas na dal 'byor thob pa srid pa tsam du 'dug pa las/ bdag gis dal 'byor thob pa 'di don med par mi 'gyur bar/ chos rnam dag cig byed dgos snyam du sgoms gsungs/ mnyam med po to ba'i zhal nas/ chos kyi dbu dal 'byor rnyed dka' ba dang /'chi ba rjes su dran pa bsgom pa 'di yin gsungs/ 'di gnyis kyi don la so zhig ci thebs byed dgos/ 'di gnyis la so zhig thebs na chos kyi sgo dbye bas/ gong ma thams cad rgyud la spungs pa bzhin du yong ba yin pas/ chos kyi dbu bya ba de la zer gsungs/ sngon mdo khams sgang gi mi gnyis la mar khu spyi la drangs pas/ lto la ngan shos kyis skyu gting ring po byas kyin bcus pas/ kha yi rtsar sleb tsa na ske rtsar chags kyin mar khu 281

bas zan rang yang khar ma chud par sa la ltung gin song bas/gcig gis khrel bas/ mar khu mang du 'ong ba'i thabs gting zab pa yang gal che ste/ ske rtsa der gzob zer ro/ /dpe de bzhin du skad cig la sangs rgya ba'i thabs stong pa nyid la sogs pa'i zab pa yang gal che ste/ ske rtsa dang 'dra ba'i dal 'byor rnyed dka' 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ las 'bras 'di la gzab dgos/ ma bzabs na mar khu dang 'dra ba'i sangs rgyas pas zan dang 'dra ba'i lha mi rang yang mi thob par 'gro gsungs/sngon 'phan yul rgya phu pa gcig gtsang du phyin pa dang / gzhan gtsang pa rnams glu len pa'i ngag las/ lo sdeng bu li yin no cog /gser gyi ri la brkos na ang / /zer ba thos pas nga ni de rang yin snyam/ phyir 'ongs nas gser brkos so/ /de bzhin du dal 'byor gyi mi lus thob pa 'di lha mi kun gyes smon pa'i gnas yin pas/ smon ne thog tu sleb pa'i dus 'dir chos byed dgos/ sngon slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i smon lam nas/ma skyes zer ba tshor ma skyes skye bar shog zer ba rnams kyi steng du da res phyin nas 'dug pas/ da ci'i phyir don med par sdod snyam du chos la 'bad dgos/ sngon pha bu gsum gyis zan za ba'i tshe/ bu chung bas rang gi zan skal rgyab tu sbas/ pha dang phu bo'i 282

zan zos pas/ kho rang gi zan rgyab nas khyis khyer bas ngus/ ma ngu byas pas/ brgya la lan cig gi zan de khyis khyer ba zer lo/ /de bzhin du rang cag rnams kyis kyang / rnyed par dka' ba'i mi lus lan cig rnyed pa 'di 'chi bdag khyi rkun dang 'dra bas ma khyer gong du 'dir snying po len dgos/ sngon mi gcig gi sgor mi mang po byung ba'i nang nas dgra snying na ba zhig yod pa mthong nas/ kho rang nang na gri brdar gyin ma sod kyis dogs nas/ pha mes kyis bkug ste dre bos gtong nyen yod zer lo/ /de bzhin du pha mes dang 'dra ba'i sngon las kyis dal 'byor gyi lus 'di bkug ste/ dre bos chos ma byas par sdig la zhugs nas chud zos su gtong nyen yod gsungs/ sngon mi gcig la gtsang khyab bslabs te/ dge don legs kyi gzhi/ chos tshul rab kyi dbyengs/mchod rten thams cad la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo gyis byas pas/ khos de ma shes par/ yags na yags kyi gzhi/ nyes na nyes kyi gzhi/ yags gzhi nyes gzhi la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo zer ro/ /de bzhin du dal 'byor 'di la brten nas dge ba sgrub na skye ba gtan gyi bde mgo tshugs pas yags la/ sdig pa bsags na gtan du sdug bsngal bar 'gyur bas de bas rig pa sgrim dgos/ phu chung ba'i zhal nas/ dal 'byori gyi mi lus 283

thob nas dge ba'i las ma byas par shi na/ nor bu rin po che rin thang med pa zhig rnyed nas longs ma spyad par stor du bcug pa dang 'dra ste/ sdig pa byas na nor bu dug dang 'dres pa'i lhad zan rdog po gcig tu btsongs pa dang 'dra gsungs/de bas na da res dge ba la 'bad dgos/sngon 'phan yul phya mkhar bya ba na mkhar dos can zhig yod pa dgras phrogs nas yun ring du kha nyen du song bas/ rgad po zhig dus rtag tu mkhar des gdungs nas yod pa la/ lan cig rgad po'i rna ba la phya mkhar thob zer ba thos pas 'gro mi nus bzhin du mdung zhig gi gsum gnyis tsam nas bzung phyed shas byed cing / rma'i phya mkhar thob pa 'di rmi lam min na rung zer lo/ /de bzhin du dal 'byor thob pa 'di rmi lam min na rung ste snyam nas dga' ba'i shugs kyis de chud mi gson par chos sgrub dgos snyam du yang yang bsam par bya'o/ /dge bshes dol ba nyid kyi zhal nas/ ngas dal 'byor rnyed par dka' ba 'di la 'phrig cig tshud pas chos yod de nas byung gsungs/ 'o na dal 'byor rnyed dka' sgom skyes pa'i tshad ci tsam yin snyam na/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen spyan snga ba lta bu re yin/ khong mnal ye ma log par thugs dam mdzad pa la/ dge bshes rnal 'byor 284

pas/ bu skabs su khams bag re ma bsang na/ khams log 'ong nyen yod do gsungs pas/ de deng lags te/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' 'di bsam tsa na gnyid log long rang mi gda' gsungs zer/ de la chos rje rgyal sras pa'i gsung gis/ de shin tu mad par gda'/ de 'dra re med kha mi 'dug ste/ rang res ni de'i cha tsam yang ma nus par 'dug khong gis mi g.yo ba'i bsnyen pa dung phyur dgu song zer te/ mi tshe la mnal ye ma log pa'i tshod du 'dug gsungs pa ltar/ dal 'byor gye mi lus rnyed dka' bsams nas/ dam pa'i chos la nyin mtshan med par 'bad par bya'o/ /de yang dal 'byor gyi mi lus rnyed dka' bar ma zad 'jig sla ba'i tshul bsams nas chos myur du bya dgos te/rje rin po ches/ rnyed dka' 'jig sla nam mkha'i glog dang 'dra/ /tshul 'di bsams nas 'jig rten bya ba kun/ /sbun pa 'phyar ba bzhin du rtogs gyur nas/ /nyin mtshan kun tu snying po len pa dgos/ /gsungs/ bdag cag gi ston pa'i zhal nas/dge slong dag shes pa ni 'grib/ srog ni 'chad tshe yi 'du byed ni stor/ ston pa'i bstan pa yang nges par 'jig par 'gyur na/ci'i phyir brtson 'grus dang brtul ba brtan pos bsgrub par mi byed gsungs/ yang rgyal po la gdams pa las/ rgyal po chen po 285

'jig rten 'di ni 'dor/ pha rol tu ni 'gro skyas chen po ni 'degs/ khrod sdug por ni 'jug /dgon pa chen por ni 'khyams/ zas kyi tha ma ni za/ mal gyi tha ma ni nyal/ gnyen gye tha mas bskor nas/ sbyin pa byen no zhes gsol ba ni 'debs/de'i tshe de'i dus na/ chos 'ba' zhig skyabs dang mgon dang dpung gnyen du 'gyur ro gsungs/ rgyal sras rin po che'i zhal nas/ tshe la nges pa med cing 'chi ba'i rkyen shin tu mang bas de ring tsam mi 'chi ba'i gdeng yang mi 'dug pas/ da lta nyid du dam pa'i chos bya dgos snyam du sgom mo gsungs/ a mi thar rgyal gyis bod kyi mtha' ci 'gyur byas pas/ dge bshes ston pa'i zhal nas/ thar rgyal bod kyi mtha' la ma rtog thar rgyal gye mtha' la rtog gsungs pa ltar/ gzhan gyi skyon sogs la mi rtog par/ rang nyid nges par 'chi zhing nam 'chi cha med/ do nub tsam yang mi 'chi ba'i gdeng spu tsam yang med tshul la brtags nas da lta rang 'chi brod dam pa'i chos la 'bad dgos/ rje mi las/ thugs sras ras chung pa phebs khar phyag nas bzung ste/'chi ba 'chi ba/ rtsa na rtsa na/ gtug ge gtug ge gda' ye gda' ye/ zhes zhal gdams mthar thug la 'chi ba rtsa na gtugs gda' ye gsungs/ yang kha che'i bla ma ta khin la zer 286

bas/ me tog cig la bltas nas/ me tog 'di dang po mdangs mtshar zhing bung ba mang po'i 'phur lding g.yo bzhin/ dbyangs snyan rna ba'i dpyid du 'jo ba zhig mchis mod kyang / ston gyi bser bu kho byung tshe/ mdangs nyams dri shor lo ma phyogs kun tu 'thor/ bung ba'i 'gro 'ong tsam yang med pa de bzhin du/rang cag 'khor ba la spyod pa rnams kyang pho gzhon dang mo gzhon bsdebs/ rgyan gos kyi gzab 'phyor ngom/ bde bde skyid skyid skad du 'dod yon kho nar spyod skabs/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa kho byung tshe lus kyi bkrag mdangs nyams/ drod shor/ mthar rus pa dur khrod na phyogs kun tu thor/ nye 'brel gyi 'gro 'ong tsam yang med pa de 'dra'i ngang tshul bsam na/ chos zab mo zhig yong bar 'dug zer ba bzhin du/ gang la bltas kyang mi rtag pa dran pa zhig dgos/ phu chung bas/ gzhan shi ba'i gtam gsan pa rnams grangs bgrang gin 'chi ba 'chi ba zhes gsungs shing bsgom par mdzad gsungs/ dge bshes dgon pa ba'i zhal nas/ jo bo kun gyi tsab tsub de yo zhog la/ 'chi ba gcig pu soms dang / chos yod de la 'ong gi bya ba de yin gsungs/ yang rje rin po che'i zhal nas/ skyes bu'i don sgrub pa'i dus ni rten khyad par can thob pa'i dus 'di kho na yin la/ 'o skol phal 287

cher ngan 'gror bsdad cing bde 'gror lan re tsam 'ongs kyang mi khom pa'i gnas su shas che bas/ der chos sgrub pa'i skabs ma rnyed la/ bsgrubs pas chog pa'i rten re rnyed pa yang chos tshul bzhin du mi sgrub pa ni/ da dung mi 'chi snyam pa 'di la thug 'dug pas na/ blos mi 'chi ba'i phyogs 'dzin pa ni/ rgud pa kun gyi sgo dang / 'chi ba dran pa ni phun sum tshogs pa thams cad kyi sgo'o gsungs/ mkhas grub rjes/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa'i blo shugs drag cig ma skyes na mi'i sngon du grub grub mdzes mdzes lo 'dod grags 'dod cig gis khyer nas/ thos bsam sgom gsum dag pa ltar snang du song nas tshe phyi ma la phan pa ye mi yong / gnyid rmugs dang bre mo'i gtam dang bza' btung rnams kyang bshol thabs med pa bzhin song nas de'i dbang du 'chor/ mi rtag pa'i blo shugs drag cig skyes na 'chi khar mi 'gyod pa'i steng du 'chi ba la dga' brod skye ba zhig yong bas 'chi ba sems pa gal che gsungs/sngon gye dus bod ston rnams snang ba sel lam mi sel/sangs rgyas la ye shes mnga' 'am zhes rtsad gcod pa la/ po to ba'i zhal nas/ snang sel mi rtag pa 'di yin te/ tshe 'di'i snang ba thams cad 'dis sel gsungs/ byang du nad pa zhig gi rim 288

gror zan gye bshos bu btang ba mi gcig gis blangs pa la 'phyas pas/ ngan na yang ngan byang gsar kha'i bshos bu de rang rnyed par gyes dang zer lo/ /de bzhin du mi rtag pa sgom pa la yang ngan ngan por byed kyin 'dug ste/ 'di rgyud la skye ba mdzod dang / des chog gi gsungs/ po to ba la dmigs pa spo bar zhus tsa na/ spo rgyu med/ 'di kho na sgoms/ 'di las zab pa med/ yang khyod nga bas rgyud tshod mtho na 'dir bsdad pas mi phan/ nga dang mnyam na nga la snang sel chen po 'dis phan pa byung bas khyod la'ang phan mchi gsungs/ sngags pa zhig gi bu mo shed nga'i me long 'di chung zer/ pha shed sngon du byad blta ba 'di la gyis dang der chung 'dug na nga'i 'khar rnga tshugs la song zer lo/ /de bzhin du mi rtag pa chos chung zer ba la/ sngon la 'di rgyud la skye ba mdzod dang / de nas gzhan rtsad chod gsungs/ sngon rgyal po u tra mtha' yas kyi btsun mo zla 'od bya ba zhag bdun nas 'chi bar nges pa de dgra bcom ma ri ma zhes pa zhig la gtad/rab tu byung nas mi rtag pa bsgom du bcug pas zhag bdun nas shi nas lhar skyes bcom ldan 'das la chos mnyan pas bden pa mthong / des na 'pho ba'am 'chi kha ma'i chos la yang 'di zab par gda'/ sngon bcom ldan 'das kyis zhi lhag gi 289

ting nge 'dzin mtha' yas pa zhig thob kyang da dung thar pa'i go 'phang ma brnyes pa la/ lam bden bzhi/ mi rtag pa sogs bcu drug khong du chud de bsgoms pas/ bdud rtsi'i go 'phang brnyes zer/ des na mi rtag pa bsgom na sangs rgya ba la yang myur ba yin pas/ myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya bar 'dod pas 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsgom par bya'o/ /yang rgyal sras rin po ches/ mdo las mi rtag pa mang du bsgoms na sangs rgyas thams cad la mchod par byas pa yin no/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyis dbugs dbyung ba yin no/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyis lung bstan pa yin no/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyis byin gyes brlabs pa yin no zhes gsungs pa yin gsungs/ des na sangs rgyas thams cad la mchod par 'dod pa dang dbugs dbyung lung bstan byen gyis rlob par 'dod pas 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsgom par bya/ sngon dwags po'i slob ma'i khyu rgyan grub thob rnal 'byor pa chos g.yung bya ba la/ khams pa zhig gis gos yug gcig phul nas chos zhus pas ma gnang / yang nan gyis zhus pas/ kho'i lag pa nas bzung ste/ nga yang 'chi khyod kyang 'chi bya ba de lan gsum bskyar nas bla mas kyang de las gsungs pa med/ nga la yang nyams su len rgyu de las med/ khyod 290

rang yang de sgoms/ de las lhag pa yod ri gsungs nas dbu snyung bzhes/ der khams pas kyang bsgoms pas grub thob cig byung skad/ des na grub pa thob par 'dod na yang 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsgom par bya/ sngon yer pa'i zhang btsun gyis gshegs dogs 'ba' zhig byas/ snyun nad cung zad re la snyad 'dogs kyin/ da cha cha gsungs nas yo byad ci yod thams cad gzhan la bsngos nas/ med mi rung ci rigs la/ ma shi'i bar du g.yar chug gsungs/ gshegs pa na lha'i rol mo di ri ba thams cad kyis tshor ba byung / des na 'chi khar ngo mtshar ba'i ltas 'dod na yang 'chi ba mi rtag pa sgoms/sngon mi zhig gis dur khrod cig na bud med shi ba'i ro lto dral ba zhig mthong nas/ de ji 'dra bar bud med thams cad de 'dra la rang gi lus kyang de 'dra'o snyam/ yang yang yid la byas pas/ de shi nas rgya gar du rnam thos sras kyi dpal la 'gran du rung ba'i gtso bo chen po zhig gi sras su skyes/ rigs kyi bu grags pa zhes bya bar gyur te cher lon pa na btsun mo'i 'khor gyes bskor te 'dod pa'i yon tan thams cad dang ldan par gnyid log sad nas bud med gnyid log pa rnams mthong ba na/ dur khrod cig na 'dug pa snyam du mi gtsang ba dang skyug bro 291

ba dang / yid 'byung ba dang 'jigs pa'i 'du shes skyes te/ de nyid du langs nas nam la bros phyin pas/ bcom ldan 'das dang mjal chos mnyan pas bden pa mthong dgra bcom thob skad/ de dang 'dra bar da lta mi rtag pa'i blo nan gyes sbyangs na sgye ba phyi mar yang mi rtag pa dran nas ci la yang mi chags chos min pas dgos pa med snyam chos kho na byas nas sangs rgyas kyi sar thogs pa med par 'gro ba zhig 'ong bas 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsam pa la 'bad 'tshal/ yang shi na las kyi dbang gis 'khor ba mtho dman du skyes nas bde sdug sna tshogs myong ba'i tshul la bsams nas dge sdig gi 'dor len bya dgos/ sngon jo bo stod mnga' ris yul du byon dus/ lha btsun byang chub 'od kyis jo bo la bod kyi yul du chos zab zab po dang mtshar mtshar po bas kyang rgyu 'bras kyi chos kyis bskyang bar zhu zhes zhu ba phul bas/de la jo bo shin tu mnyes nas jo bo'i zhal nas/ chos shin tu zab pa las rgyu 'bras kho na yin/ yi dam gye lha'i zhal mthong ba bas/ las rgyu 'bras la yid ches brtan po thob na de nyid mchog tu gyur pa yin te/ gshin rje gshed kyi rnal 'byor pa yi dam gye lha'i zhal mthong bas/ da 'di tsam la ltos te skyon mi 'ong gis snyam nas/ dge 'dun gyi yo byad cung zad thug thub tu spyad pas/292

yi dwags gshin rje gshed kyi gzugs can zhig tu skyes pa dang /bri ka ma la shī la'i lag bde bas/ dge 'dun gyi de ring gi bsnyen bkur nang bar du bskyur bas/ de'i nub mo yi dwags su sgyes pa dang / yang dge 'dun gye gnas brtan zhig gis dge 'dun la dbang po che byas te/ 'bras bre phyed thug thub tu spyad pa yi dwags shin tu dbang chung bar skyes pa la sogs pa'i gtam rgyud mang du gsungs/ sngon rgyal po seng ge sgra'i grong khyer du las rgyu 'bras med par lta ba'i mu stegs rgyang 'phen pa zhig dang / rje btsun te lo pa gnyis kyis rtsod pa byas te lung rigs kyis sun phyung yang / kho na re/ las rgyu 'bras dngos su ma mthong bas yid mi ches zer ba la/ 'o na khyod rang mig tshums la nga la 'jus shig gsungs nas/ dmyal ba'i gnas su khrid de btso bsreg gi sdug bsngal nyams su myong ba mthong ba dang / zangs gcig na khro chu khol zhing btso rgyu med pa zhig 'dug nas dris pas/ 'dzam bu gling na rgyu 'bras med par 'dod pa'i mu stegs pa mi dge sna tshogs spyod pa zhig yod/ de shi na 'dir 'tshod pa yin zer ba bstan pas der kho na re/ mi dge ba spyad pas ngan 'gror 'gro ba bden par 'dug ste/ dkar po'i rgyu 'bras ma mthong zhing med pas dge ba mi sgrub zer ba yang ngas bstan 293

gyis gsungs nas/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha'i gnas su khrid de/lha'i gzhal yas khang rnams na lha pho mo zung re 'dod yon lnga'i bde ba la spyod pa la/ khang pa zhig na lha mo rkyang ba zhig las mi 'dug pa la dris pas/ 'dzam bu gling na las rgyu 'bras yod par 'dod pa mi dge ba spong zhing dge ba spyod pa zhig yod/ de shi nas 'dir skye ba zhig yin zer ba dang / mu stegs pa de dad nas rjes su bzung ste gdams pa bstan pas smin cing grol bar gyur to/ /yang rigs ngan gtum po'i grong khyer du bshan pa srog chags mang po bsad nas/ kho rang gi bu smad gso ba zhig yod pa gdul byar gzigs nas byon pa dang / khos srog chags mang po bsad pa'i sha 'tshod cing yod pa la/ bu de mi snang bar byas te sha rnams bu'i shar bsgyur nas/ te lo pas sha blangs pas khros nas ma sbyin/ sha'i kha phye ste bltas pas/ rang gi bu'i shar song nas 'dug pa mthong nas bred de sdug bsngal nas ngus pas/ khyod rang bu med na sdug bsngal ba ltar/ gzhan yang bsad na sdug bsngal bas ma gsod byas pas/ kho na re/ nga'i bu byung na dag mi gsod zer ro/ /srog gcod spong na bu yod pa bya/gsungs bu gtad nas/ rang gis byas pa'i sdig pa ni/ /'bras bu rang la smin par shes/ /zhes gsungs nas/ kho dad par gyur 294

nas rjes su bzung ste gdams pa bstan pas smin cing grol bar gyur to/ /des na las rgyu 'bras 'di shin tu bden pas yid ches kyi nges shes bskyed nas srog gcod la sogs pa'i mi dge sdig pa spong zhing / tshe thar srog blu sogs rnam dkar dge ba'i phyogs la brtson par bya'o/ /sngon rgyal po chos kyi bla ma zhes bya ba de mtha' yas pa'i zhing tsher ma can zhes bya ba dge sdig gi sgra mi grag pa zhig tu phyin te/kla klo'i mi de dag gi yid la ci dran pa bshad cing lhan cig 'grogs pas/ khong tsho na re/ nged kyis ci dran pa khyed kyis shes par 'dug pas/ gang dag cig na sangs rgyas sam zhig yod zer ba de khyod yin nam zer ba la yin smras so/ /khong rnams na re/ khyed 'dir ci la 'ongs zer ba la/ khyed cag la chos 'chad du 'ongs byas pas/ chos kyis ci byed zer/ chos med na ngan song du skye'o smras pa dang / kho cag na re/ chos dang ngan song ston dang zer/ der sprul pa'i dmyal ba bstan pas/ 'di re sdug zer/ khyed rang yang 'di 'drar skye smras pas/ ci'i phyir skye zer/ srog bcad pa las skye smras pas/ 'o na srog mi gcod zer ro/ /yi dwags bstan pas 'di ci las byung zer/ ser sna byas pa las byung smras pas/ ser sna mi byed zer/ byol song bstan pas 295

'di ci las byung zer/ 'di log lta las byung smras pas/ log lta mi byed zer/ lha ma yin 'thab rtsod bstan pas/ 'di ci las byung zer/ 'di phrag dog byas pa las byung ba yin smras pas/phrag dog mi byed zer/ lha'i gzugs dang longs spyod bstan pas/ 'di re dga' na zer/ 'di dag dge ba spyad pa las byung ngo smras pa dang / nga cag kyang dge ba spyod do zer nas chos la tshud do/ /des na las rgyu 'bras kyi chos la yid ches par byas nas/ srog gcod pa dang / ser sna dang / log lta dang / phrag dog sogs mi byed par mchod sbyin sogs rnam dkar dge chos la brtson par bya'o/ /sngon bshan pa srog gcod kyi gling na/bshan pa dmar ru rtse dang / dkar ru rtse zhes bya ba gnyis dga' mthun byas te/ nyin re bzhin lug re dang phag re gsod pa la/ nyin cig lug gcig mig ce re blta zhing phag gis kyang skad ngan bton pas/ dmar ru rtse khros nas lug gi mig tu sa btab/ phag gi lce bcad nas bsad pas dmyal bar sgyes so/ /dkar ru rtse snying rje skyes nas gsod ma phod par nags khrod cig tu bsdad pas/ der kho ltogs nas sngo zhig zos pas sngo sman de'i nus pas ri kha zhig tu 'phur nus pa byung / de rngon pa zhig gis mthong nas rgyal po la smras pas/ rgyal po de la ngo mtshar 296

skyes nas bya dga' mang po byen no/ /de la lha tshangs pa ya mtshan skyes nas tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ srog gcod sdig pa byas pa yi/ /rnam smin mngon du snang ba ni/ /dmar ru rtse ni dmyal bar lhung / /dkar ru rtse ni mtho ris song / /dge sdig las 'bras de 'dra ba/ /mngon sum snang ba ya mtshan che/ /zer ro/ /des na srog gcod pa spangs te tshe thar gtong dgos/ yang ma byin len pa rkun ma'i gling na/ rkun ma mang po khyim bdag dpa' bo zhes bya ba'i mdzod du rkur phyin pas/ zla bo rnams kyis nor mang po khur bas/ nang nas rkun ma dga' bo zhes bya ba'i bsam pa la/khyem bdag gis dkon mchog la bsngos pa'i nor la 'di ltar 'dzin chags kyis rku ba mtshang che snyam gad mo chen po zhig shor ba khyem bdag gis tshor yang kho la ci yang ma byas/ gzhan zla bo rnams ded pa'i tshe/ shing gi lha mo 'od 'chang mas lung bstan nas/ khyem bdag gis gser gye gter rnyed de phyug por gyur to/ /de la ngo mtshar nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis smras pa/dge ba'i bsod nams mthu yi ni/ /dpa' bo khyim bdag gser dang ldan/ /rkun ma dga' bo mtho ris skyes/ /zla bo gzhan ma ngan song lhung / /e ma shin tu ngo mtshar che/ /ma byin len sgong sbyin pa thongs/ /zer ro/ /des na ma byin len pa spangs nas 297

sbyin pa meng po gtong dgos/yang 'dod log spyod pa smad 'tshong ma'i gling na/ smad 'tshong ma dga' byen ma dang / gsal ba'i 'od ces bya ba gnyis yod pa'i/ gsal ba'i 'od na re/ 'di ltar ngo tsha la sgyug bro ba/sdig che la tshim pa med pa/ 'di 'dra ba'i las byed pa zer nas sangs rgyas kyi drung du phyin te/ tshangs spyod kyi sdom pa blangs nas bsrungs pas lha'i bu rin chen 'od ces bya bar skyes so/ /dga' byin ma 'dod pa la shin tu chags te/ mnyam por dga' ba la rin thang gzhan gyis ster/ 'di las lhag pa gang na yod snyam nas 'dod log spyad nas/ yi dwags kyi mngal/ ngan skyugs kyi 'dam du skyes pas/ de la ya mtshan nas lha'i bu rin chen snying pos tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ 'khor ba'i rtsa ba 'dod chags te/ /spangs pas 'od gsal lha ru skyes/ /spyad pas dga' byen yi dwags lhung / /'di yang ya mtshan ngo mtshar che/ /'dod log spongs la tshangs spyod bsrung / /zer ro/ /des na 'dod pas log par g.yem pa spangs nas tshangs spyod kyi sdom pa bsrung dgos/yang rigs ngan rdzun smra ba'i gling na/ rigs ngan rdzun po che zhes bya ba dang / bram ze dzun med ces bya ba gnyis kyis rgyal po'i ma he stong khyu 'ig 'tshos pas/ ma he rnams kyi nang na khyu 298

mchog rta ri zhes bya ba rtswa'i phud za ba/ chu'i phud 'thung ba/ 'gro ba'i sna 'dren pa/ sdod pa'i mjug sdud pa/ spo mtho la bsdad nas dgra dang gcan gzan gyi bya ra byed pa zhig yod pa la rdzi bo gnyis kyis de bsad nas zos pa la/ der rigs ngan na re/nged rang gnyis la rgyal po'i chad pa 'ong bas/ khyu mchog rta ri ba rbab la lhung nas shi gyis shig zer ro/ /bram ze na re/ nga skyes nas dzun byed ma myong bas/ da yang rdzun mi shes so zer skad/der rgyal pos khyu mchog rta ri 'tsho'am zer ba la/ bram zes khyu mchog nged gnyis kyis bsad nas zos so byas/ rigs ngan gyis rbab la lhung nas shi zhes dzun byas pas lce bcad do/ /de la ya mtshan nas lha dbang phyug chen pos tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ dzun las ldog nas bden pa smras/ /bram zes bya dga' mtho ris thob/ /rigs ngan lce bcad ngan song lhung / /de bas rdzun spong bden pa smos/ /zer ro/ /des na rdzun spangs nas bden pa smra dgos/ yang tshig rtsub ag tsar du smra ba'i gling na/ khyim bdag nag po brtsegs pa zhes bya ba tshig rtsub mo sha stag smra ba zhig dang / bram ze padma'i ngang tshul can zhes bya ba ngag 'jam por smra ba zhig yod pas/ bram zes khyim bdag la de skad ma zer/ mtshon gye rma ni 'tsho ba yin/ /tshig ngan rma ni 'tsho ma 299

yin/ /smras pas/ khyem bdag na re/ tshig rtsub kha drag gi kha non yin/ nga la sus kyang tshig ldog mi nus zer nas/ tshig rtsub dang ag tsar nyi tshe smras pas/ yul pa kha log ste khyem phrogs nas/bram ze la byin no/ /der dri za'i rgyal po zur phud lnga pa ngo mtshar skyes nas tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ tshig rtsub kun gyi zhe bzlog pa/ /smras pas khyim bdag yul dang bral/ /ngag 'jam kun gye yid dang mthun/ /bram ze nor ldan ngo mtshar che ma ma ngo mtshar shin tu che/ /tshig rtsub spong la ngag 'jam sgos/ /zer ro/ /des na tshig rtsub mo spangs nas ngag 'jam po smra dgos/ yang ngag 'khyal cal col du smra ba'i gling na/ mgar ba mu cor du smra ba zhes bya ba ngag 'khyal ci rung rung du smra ba zhig dang / 'ba' ro grags pa seng ge zhes bya ba don dang ldan pa'i gtam nyi tshe smra ba zhig yod pa las/ mgar ba'i khyim du dge slong nyi ma'i 'od zer zhes bya ba zhig phyin pas/ mgar bas ngag 'khyal ci rung rung smras pas/ 'ba' ros mgar ba la bab col du ma smra/dge slong rang yang brang khang du gshegs 'tshal byas pas/ dge slong la 'tsho ba ma drangs par ngag 'khyal ba brjod pas/ dge slong khams log ste rbab la brul te grongs so/ /der rgyal pos nga'i mchod gnas 'di tsug la 'gro ba ci yin zer/ 'ba' ros 300

lo rgyus zhib tu smras pas 'ba' ro la bya dga' byen/ mgar ba'i lce bcad do/ /der lha'i drang srong skar mda' gdong gis tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ ngag 'khyal smra ba smyon pa 'dra/ /mgar ba mu cor lce dang bral/ /'ba' ro nor dang bya dga' thob/ /rnam smin 'phral byung ngo mtshar che/ /ngag 'khyal spong la don dam smos/ /zer ro/ /des na ngag 'khyal spang sa nas don dang ldan pa smra dgos/ yang phra ma 'byed byed kyi gling na/ phra ma smra ba dga' byed ces bya ba phra ma mang po byed pa zhig yod pa des/ 'ba' ro yul dpon zhes bya ba longs spyogaldan pa zhig yod pa dang / yul de'i rgyal po gnyis kyi bar du phra ma bcug ste/ rgyal po'i rtsar phyin nas 'ba' ros rgyal po bas nor nga che 'khor nga bzang rgyal po la bsdos kyang thub bo zer gyin 'dug ces phra ma bskyal bas/ rgyal po dang 'ba' ro 'khrug pa chen po shor te 'thab bo/ /yul de na bram ze mdza' bo zhes bya ba 'thab pa thams cad sdum par byed pa zhig yod pa des/ rgyal po dang 'ba' ro gnyis bsdums byas te rgyal khams bde ba la bkod do/ /rgyal po dang 'ba' ro gnyis kyis phra ma yin par shes nas phra mkhan gyi lce bcad/ bram ze la khong gnyis kyis gser srang brgya rtsa re byen 301

no/ /de ya mtshan skyes nas mi'am ci'i rgyal pos tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ phra ma gzhan 'byed rnam smin gyis/ /lce bcad ngan song gnas su lhung / /bram ze mdza' bo sdum mkhan des/ /gser srang nyis brgya'i bya dga' thob/ /rnam smin 'phral byung ngo mtshar che/ /phra ma spong la 'thab rtsod bsdum/ /zer ro/ /des na phra ma spangs nas 'thab rtsod bsdum dgos/ yang brnab sems 'dod pa'i gling na/ khyem bdag 'od gsal zhes bya ba shin tu phyug pa/rang gi nor la shin tu chags pa/ gzhan gyi nor la yang khram dang g.yo sgyus 'phral ba/ khyad par dkon mchog gi nor la chags pa zhig dang / li tsa bye dri ma med par grags pa zhes bya ba chags pa dang bral ba zhig yod pas khyem bdag la smras pa/ 'di tsam gyi nor 'dug bzhin du chog shes med par gzhan gyi nor la brnab pa/ khyad par dkon mchog gi nor la brnab sems byed pa 'jig rten 'dir yang bkra mi shis/ phyi mar ngan song du ltung bar 'gyur ro/ /byas kyang ma mnyan par gzhan gyi nor dang khyad par dkon mchog gi dkor la brnab sems chen po byas pa'i 'bras bus nor thams cad dmag gis phrogs/ snying ma hā ka las bton nas bsad pas/ tshe phyi ma la yi dwags su skyes so/ /li tsa byi la rgyal khams kyi mis bsnyen bkur byas nas nor 302

la zad pa ma byung ngo / /de la ya mtshan nas sa'i lha mo bstan mas smras pa/ chog mi shes pa'i 'dod pa las/ /'dir sdug phyi mar ngan song myong / /chags zhen med pa'i li tsa bye/ /bde zhing phyug pa ngo mtshar che/ /brnab sems skyungs la 'dod yon sgong / /zer ro/ /des na brnab sems spangs nas 'dod chung chog shes byed dgos/ yang gnod sems brdung 'tshog gi gling na/ gyad zla ba bzang po zhes bya ba thams cad la brdung zhing 'tshog pa zhig dang / lha'i bu gser gzungs zhes bya ba byams pa dang ldan pa zhig yod pas/ gyad zlal bzang pos rgyun du gzhan la gnod sems rang byas pa'i rkyen gyis gshin rje'i pho nyas khrid nas dmyal bar skyes so/ /lha'i bu gser gzungs ni dus rgyun du sems can la byams pa dang ldan pas mngon sum du lha yul du spyan drangs so/ /de'i tshe lha'i dbang phyug rnam thos sras kyis smras pa/ kun la gnod sems ldan pa yi/ /gyad ni mngon sum gshin rjes khrid/ /byams pa ldan pa'i gser gzungs ni/ /lha gnas spyan drangs ngo mtshar che/ /gnod sems spong la byams sems bsgyed/ /zer ro/ /des na gnod sems spangs nas byams snying rje bskyed dgos/ yang log lta mu stegs kyi gling na/ mu stegs 'od srung rdzogs byed ces bya ba tshe snga phyi med/ dkon mchog rdzun 303

yin zer/ rang yang de ltar bsam la gzhan la yang de ltar ston pa zhig dang / dge slong seng ge zhes bya ba dang po byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa/ bar du dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba/ tha mar yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par smon lam 'debs pa zhig yod pas/ mu stegs lta ba log pa'i skyon gyis dmyal bar skyes so/ /dge slong dkon mchog la mos pa'i byen rlabs kyis bde ba can gyi zhing khams su skyes so/ /de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje snying pos smras pa/ dzu 'phrul ldan pa'i mu stegs rdzogs byed kyang / /mngon sum nyid du dmyal ba'i gnas su skyes/ /log par 'dzin pa thams cad snying re rje/ /yang dag ldan pa'i dge slong seng ge ni/ /dkon mchog gsum la mos gus byas pa yis/ /nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams su/ /skyes pa ya mtshan ngo mtshar shin tu che/ /log lta spong la yang dag lta ldan mdzod/ /zer ro/ /des na log lta spangs nas yang dag lta ba dang ldan par bya dgos/gzhan yang sngon pha dam pa rgya gar gyis nyin gcig thugs dam la bzhugs dus/ a tsha la sogs pa'i sgra lung pa gang ba tsam gsan/ 'od gsal gyi ngang nas bltas pas/ ding ri glang 'khor gyi grwa btsun rnams kyis shig yod pa'i dug hrul nyi ma la 304

bzhag pa'i nang gi shig nyi mas tshig pa yin pa mkhyen nas/ grwa btsun rnams bos te/ khyed rnams dmyal bar 'gro ba la gzhan mi dgos par gda'/ shig yod pa'i dug po nyi ma la bzhag pa 'di kho nas chog par gda' gsungs/ de nas bzung grwa btsun rnams kyis shig yod pa'i gos nyi ma la yang mi 'jog pa byung /des na rang gi lus kyi shig yan chad mi gsod par sdig pa chung ngu la yang 'dzem dgos/ yang pha dam pa'i zhal nas/ khyed ding ri'i rgan rgon phal cher dmyal bar 'gro ba la gzhan mi dgos/kha kho nas chog par gda' gsungs/ rgad po zhig na re/ nged tsho'i kha 'dis dmyal ba'i rgyu ji ltar sgrub par gda' zhus pas/khyed rnams 'chi la nye yang ma ṇi bgrang rgyu bzhag nas/ da dung lug gcig gsod kyang ka gsod rogs gyis zer/ jus nyes gtong / nang mi khyem mtshes rnams la tshig ngan mang po rgyag pa 'di lags mod gsungs pas/ de nas bzung rgan rgon rnams kyi kha 'jam du song skad/ yang rgad po gcig na re/ khyed kyis chos kho na gsungs pa las/ skabs re sgrung dang gtam rgyud sogs 'jig rten pa'i gtam re yang gsungs na legs zhus pas/ pha dam pa thugs khrel te/ rgad po khyod kyi kha la rul dri mi kha'am gsungs pas/ mi bro lags ci yin nam zhus pas/ khyod 305

kyi khog gi snying de rul yod pa'i tshod red gsungs/ de nas bzung ding ri'i rgan rgon snying rul ba tsho gsungs/ rjes su sku mdun du song na/ khong gis sgrub khang gi sgo rgyab nas nang du mi gtong / sgo na bzhugs dus song na/ na bzas dbu btums nas bzhugs/ zhal mjal gsung thos dgos zhus pa'i tshe/ zhal mjal rgyu ci yod/ a tsa ra rgad po de lags mod/ ngas chos ma gtogs 'jig rten pa'i gtam ni mi shes/ nam 'chi cha med la long gtam lab khom med/ khyed ding ri'i rgan rgon snying rul ba tsho/ 'chi ba mi yong bas ma ṇi ma bgrangs/ nyi phug dro sa nas long gtam lab gsungs/ des na 'chi ba bsams nas chos gzhan ma nus kyang / ma ṇi rem nas bgrang dgos/ sngon sangs rgyas kyis ljags kyi dbang po phyung ste zhal gyi dkyil 'khor mngon par bkab bo/ /de nas rim pa bzhin dbu dang sku dang /seng ge'i khri dang / 'khor rnams dang stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams rnams mngon par bkab bo/ /de nas ljags kyi dbang po phyir bsdus te bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu 'di 'dra ba'i ljags kyis de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dzun gsung bar mi 'gyur gyis/ khyed rnams dad par gyis shig gsungs/ des na sangs rgyas kyis rdzun mi gsung ba'i rtags su/306

ljags kyang de ltar mnga' bas gsung la yid ches kyi dad pa bskyed dgos/ sngon nye gnas legs pa'i skar mas/ mu stegs gcer bu sdug bsngal 'gyur bya ba de dgra bcom pa yin zer ba la/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis glen pa 'di ni da nas zhag bdun bar ma zhu ba'i nad kyis shi nas rgyal po'i khab kyi phyi sa khung du skyug pa za ba'i yi dwags su skye bar 'gyur na/ dgra bcom pa de ltar 'gyur ram gsungs pas/ kho sdug bsngal 'gyur gyi drung du song nas khyod la bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di skad zer bas zon gyis shig byas pas/ des zon byas te zhag drug ltogs par bsdad pas/ ltogs ches nas bu ram zhig zos chu 'thungs pas de nyid ma zhu nas zhag bdun pa la shi ste/ der skyes pa dang / legs pa'i skar ma mtshan mo don zhig la phyin pas/ de na cag cag pa zhig 'dug pa su yin byas pas nga gcer bu ba sdug bsngal 'gyur yin zer/ khyod der sgyes sam byas pas/ skyes/ khyod bcom ldan 'das la yid mi ches sam zer/ des na sangs rgyas kyis dus gsum sa ler mkhyen pas dzun gsung don med pas gsungs pa'i chos la yid ches dgos/sngon bdud lhas sbyin gyes/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gsod snyam sgogs rdo 'phangs dge 'dun gyi dbyen sogs byas/307

dus rgyun du sangs rgyas 'khor bcas la gnod pa ci 'khrol byas kyang / kho ma zhu ba'i nad kyis thebs pa sman pas kyang bor nas 'chi la nye tshe/ sangs rgyas kyis snying rje nas phyag spyi bor bzhag byen rlabs byas te/ nad las grol bar byas/ dus rgyun du rang gi sras dgra gcan 'dzin dang lhas sbyin gnyis la khyad par med par byams/ des na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la dgra gnyen la khyad par med par kun la byams pas dzun gsung don med pas/ sangs rgyas kyi las rgyu 'bras kyi chos gang la yang yid ches kyi dad pa bskyed nas spang blang ma nor bar bya/de yang mi dge ba'i dbang gis ngan song du skyes na/ sdug bsngal yod pa sgos ci dgos/ las dang nyon mongs pa gzhan gyi dbang gis mtho ris lha mi'i nang du skyes na yang sdug bsngal ma gtogs bde ba med de/ dmyal bar skyes na tsha grang gi sdug bsngal/ yi dwags la bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal/ dud 'gro la bkol spyod kyi sdug bsngal/ mi la skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal/ lha ma yin la 'thab rtsod kyi sdug bsngal/ lha la 'chi 'pho ltung ba'i sdug bsngal te/ sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod pa yin pas na spyir 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho zhes yongs su grags pa dang /sgos su 'khor ba'i khyem thab byas pa me'i 'obs 308

srin mo'i gling / dug sbrul nag po'i tshang du chud pa'i mi dang 'dra la/ yang sgos khyad par can du 'khor ba'i phun tshogs nor longs spyod 'dzoms po rnams kyang / dug dang 'dres pa'i kha zas/ spu gri'i khar chags sbrang rtsi/ dug sbrul mgo yi nor bu ltar reg na yang 'phung la/ de nyid bsten na smos ci dgos snyam du/mtho rgyal po'i rgyal sred la yang yid smon skad cig tsam yang med pa zhig bya dgos te/ sngon bdag cag gi ston pa thugs rje can gyis rgyal srid dug gi sdong po 'dra bar gzigs/ longs spyod thams cad mchil snabs bzhin du dor nas mtshan gung zhig la bros/ mchod rten rnam dag drung nas dbu skra bsil/ chu bo neeradzhana'i 'gram du dka' ba spyad/ rgya gar rdo rje gdan nas sangs rgyas te/ 'gro la bden bzhi'i chos 'khor bskor dus su yang thog mar sdug bden 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs sha stag gsungs pa la ltos dang / 'khor ba sdug bsngal yin pa ha go yong / sangs rgyas kyi 'khor nyan thos dgra bcom rnams kyis kyang 'khor ba 'di'i nang du skyes phyin chad nas nor yod na yod sdug sked na med sdug yod med mnyam sdug mi tshe sdug zad la 'gro ba'i tshul la bsams nas khyem nas khyem med par rab tu byung nas dgra bcom pa'i go 'phang thob/ de bzhin du rgya bod 309

kyi mkhas grub rnams kyis skye 'chi 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsams nas/ pha yul nor rdzas thams cad 'phongs phyis pa'i rdo bzhin du bskyur nas/ mtshan ldan gyi bla ma dam pa'i gsung bzhin na bun gos ltar gyon/ brag phug zhwa ltar bsten/ gyong lto gos gtam gsum la btang nas/ sgrub pa kho na la gzhol nas phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob nas rang gzhan gyi don gnyis lhun gyes grub pa byung / de lta bu'i gong ma'i rnam thar rjes 'jug gdul bya rnams kyis nyams len du 'khyer shes dgos la ston pa sangs rgyas nas bzung da lta'i rtsa ba'i bla ma yar bzung gi dngos brgyud bla ma rnams kyis 'khor ba spyi dang bye brag khyem thab dang 'dod yon la spyad pa'i nyes dmigs cher gsungs pa'i nang ltar/ 'jig rten 'khor ba'i bde ba la yid smon skad cig tsam yang mi byed par/ 'dod yon shig tsam re'i rtsa ba na sdug bsngal ri tsam re yod tshul la bsams nas/ skyug nad can la zas bstan pa bzhin zhen pa gting nas ldog cing / seng ge'i sngon du rtswa sngon po bzhag pa ltar 'dod pa spu tsam yang med par nag can btson dong nas 'bros pa ltar/ 'jig rten khyem thab rgyal po'i btson ra 'dra ba 'di la phyi mig tsam yang mi lta bar rgyang 310

ring por bor nas/ ri khrod dben pa'i bsil grib tu 'khod nas dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi ngoms med du 'thungs nas/ tshe 'dir 'chi med rdo rje sku sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa zhig bya dgos/ da ltar byed pa la thog mar 'dod yon gyi nyes dmigs bsams nas/ tshe blos gtong dgos/ 'dir 'dod yon gye nyes dmigs cung zad cig brjod na/sngon sangs rgyas 'khor bcas rgyal po'i khab tu bsod snyoms la gshegs dus bskal pa dang po'i mis gter sbas pa char chu che drags pas sa khar thon nas 'od 'bar ba gzigs tshe/ 'di na dug sbrul drag po 'dug ces bskor nas phyin pas/ de na 'bras bu dang rtsa ba 'thu ba'i mi zhig yod pas thos nas 'ong bltas pas/ gser yin tshe blangs nas khyer phyin lkog nas longs spyad pa yul de'i rgyal po ma skyes dgras go nas/ mi de'i nor thams cad phrogs nas btson rar khrid pa bzhin/ deng sang yang nor mang po can la gzhan rgyal blon ham can gyi chad las sna tshogs 'byung ba la ltos dang go yong / nor la chags na phyi mar yang brlag ste/ sngon dge slong zhig rang gi lhung bzed la chags te/ shi bas lhung bzed nang du sbrul gdug pa zhig tu skyes pa dang / bud med cig rang gi lus la chags te shi bas lus de 311

nyid kyi nang du sbrul gdug pa zhig tu skyes pa dang / khyim bdag cig gser la chags bzhin du shi bas/ gser de nyid la 'khril ba'i sbrul gdug pa zhig tu skyes par gsungs/ des na gang la yang ma chags ma zhen pa dgos/ khyad par du dkor la shin tu 'dzem dgos te/ sngon grub thob thang stong rgyal po pha bong chen po zhig gi steng du/ ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pas/ thugs rje'i nus pas pha bong de gas pa'i bar nas/ sbrul gnya' shing gang tsam la sbal ba mthe bong tsam stong rtsa mang pos so 'thams nas yod pa zhig thon byung ba la/ ljags chab gtor nas gnas spor mdzad mthar/ 'o/ zhing dang bsam pa ma dag pa'i dge ba ster mkhan dang / za mkhan tsho 'di 'dra ba yang yong gsungs/ yang garma pa chen po dgung lo drug bzhes dus/ long po lcags mkhar zer ba'i lung pa dang nye ba'i thad na bzhugs nas/ zhabs 'chag par byon pas/ lam nas mi ring ba na pha bong chen po zhig la/ sku rtsed kyi tshul du phyag lcags phyogs du ma nas btsugs pas/ phur bu'i shul lta bu byung ste/ bar bye ba gshog cig gsungs pas/ gshags pa'i bar nas srog chags glo ba 'dra ba khru gang tsam la/ phyi thams cad srog chags nag po dang / nang thams cad srog chags dkar po til gye 'bru tsam them me nem 312

me gang ba byung bas/ ljags mchil btab nas ting nge 'dzin gtad pas/ de'i mod la thams cad shi bas/ ro de bsreg sbyangs mdzad nas gnas spar ro/ /de'i rgyu mtshan zhus pas/sngon nga rol ba'i rdo rje'i dus su yul 'di'i gshin gson gyi dkor za ba'i bla ma gcig gis nga la ngan song nas 'dren par zhus nas ngas khas blangs pa yin/ srog chags nag bo mang pos za ba gshin zas zos pa'i rnam smin dang / dkar po mang pos za ba gson dkor zos pa'i rnam smin yin/ de ngas khas blangs pa ltar drangs pa lags/ de min ngan 'gro nas ngan 'gror 'gro ba yin gsungs/ yang rje kha rag pa chen po'i dus la/ khra zhig gis nyin re srog chags mang po bsad pas/ slar gang du skye gzigs pas sngar bsags dge sdig gnyis kyi dge ba de sngon la smin nas/ 'brog pa shin tu phyug po'i bur skyes nas/ srog gcod las kyis myur bar tshe'i 'du byas so/ /de nas gang la skye gzigs pas/ bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen gdul bya shin tu che bar skyes nas/ gdul bya che drags gshin gson gyi 'dren chog thams cad rta steng nas byed pas/ bla ma rta chog pa zhes grags so/ /mthar dpang mo che zhig btsugs nas mi kun 'dus pa'i dus/ bla ma de sku gshegs song de na rje kha rag pa'i nye gnas 313

kyang yod pas kun kha 'chams par/ bla ma'i dbang po lnga po la sbyang chog zhu rgyu rje kha rag pa la bskur na legs zhes nye gnas la bskur bas/ nye gnas kyis khyer nas/ rje'i drung du ma slebs tsam na/ 'di khyer na bka' bkyon 'dra yong snyam/ dar gye sgril 'bog bcas ma tshad kyi brag 'og cig tu bzhag nas/ drung du phyin nas gnas tshul phul bas rje'i zhal nas/ 'o na nga'i snam sbyar 'dis g.yog gsungs/ ting nge 'dzin gyi byin gyis brlabs nas gnang bas/ de bzhin bya snyam nas nye gnas kyis khyer te song bas/ brag 'og der dbang po lnga po de/ sdig pa che chung ra tsam du song zin nas tshur la gzigs byas pas/ 'dul skal gyi rten 'brel ma 'dzoms pas/ snam sbyar g.yog ma thub 'jigs skrag bros pas/ pha tshad du brag chen po zhig yod pas/de las dbang gis gas pa'i bar du song ngo / /de'i phyi la sngon lan chags kyi 'brel ba yod tshad kyi srog chags rigs 'dra grangs med song / mthar las kyi dbang gis brag de slar kha zum pa byung / sdig pa de'i snying ga nas yar shug pa'i sdong po zhig skyes pas shug sdong chen po de bya'i rkang pas ma zad kyi bar du sdug bsngal myong dgos par gsungs/sngon sangs rgyas kyi drung du bud med rgan mo lo brgya lon pa/314

dbul zhing phongs pa mi sdug pa zhig phyin nas/ dri ba dang dris lan rgya cher gsungs pas mthar sgren mo de shi 'phos nas/sangs rgyas 'od dpag med kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skyes nas/ sangs rgyas grangs med pa la mchod pa byed par 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan pas/ kun dga' bos/ 'o na 'di ltar du dbul zhing phongs pa/ mi sdug pa gang lags zhus pas/ bka' stsal pa/ sngon sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig la nga rab tu byung ba'i dus/ 'di ni nga'i mar gyur te de'i gong du'ang nga'i skye ba brgya'i ma yin pas/ de'i dus su nga'i zan zhig gi gsham nas bcad de zos pas de'i rnam par smin pas/ 'di phan la skye ba lnga brgya'i bar du/ rgan mo mi sdug pa dbul bar gyur pas 'di ni dbul ba'i mtha' ma yin no gsungs/ des na mthu ma gtong / dkor thongs zer ba ltar/ dkor 'di mthu las kyang 'jigs pas/ dkor bsdus nas rang gis bag med du za zhing gzhan nye 'brel gye kha la rgyag pa sogs gtan nas byed mi rung bas/ 'di la gzab par bya'o/ /'o na tshe blos ji ltar gtong dgos snyam na/ sngon sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis khyim dang bzung ba thams cad spangs/ lo drug dka' ba spyad tshe blos gtong lugs ji 'dra mdzad 'dug de la kha mig 315

yar lta byed dgos/ khong gis rjes 'jug 'o skol rnams la/zas bsod snyoms pa/ gos phyag dar khrod pa/ gnas shing drung ba/ sman bkus te bor ba bzhi bsten dgos zhes gsungs pa ltar/ nged rnams kyis kyang mkhan slob rnams kyi spyan sngar ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas pa rnams dran par byas nas lag len la 'debs dgos/ de yang ji ltar 'debs na/ dngos po thams cad spangs nas 'phral du rnyed pa'i bza' btung bzang ngan gang rnyed tsam gyis chog shes par byed pa/ zas bsod snyoms pa/ gos bzang po dang mang po spangs nas/ bzang ngan gang rnyed pas chog par byed pa/ gos phyag dar khrod pa/ gnas mal bzang po spangs te rtsol med bzang ngan gang byung gis chog pas gnas shing drung ba/ gzhan gyis bkus shing longs spyad de bor ba'i sman bzang ngan rtsol med gang byung gis chog par byed pas sman bkus te bor ba dang bzhi bo gnas par bya'o/ /bla ma gong ma rnams kyi zhal nas tshe blos gtong ba la/gtad pa bzhi/ rdo rje gsum/ bud snyeg thob gsum/ dgos pa yin gsungs/ dang po bzhi ni/ blo phugs chos la gtad/ chos phugs spang la gtad/ spang phugs shi la gtad/ shi phugs grog po stong par gtad/ rdo rje gsum ni/ thebs med rdo rje sngon la 316

btang / khrel med rdo rje rjes la 'jog ye shes rdo rje rang dang 'grogs/ phyi ma gsum ni/ mi khyu nas bud/ khye gral snyegs/ lha gral thob gsum mo/ /'di rnams bcom ldan 'das kyis rab byung ji ltar mdzad/ dka' ba lo drug sbyad lugs/ rjes 'jug ji ltar rab tu byung ba sogs gsung lugs rnams go na gong gi gnad rnams shin tu zab pa chos kyi mthil du go nas yong / de bcu la phugs nor bcu zhes pa'i tha snyad mdzad/ de rnams yid la bzhag pa tsam gyis nyon mongs kyi rdzong 'gyel/ las ngan gyi gru 'jig gnyen po'i thang bde ba la slob pas/ phugs nor gyi mchog rang du snang ngo / /des na tshe blos gtong tshul gyi gdams pa 'di rnams snying la bcangs nas lag len la thebs nges bya'o/ /sngon jo bo lha gcig skyes bu dam pa de 'da' khar rnal 'byor pa phyag pa khri mchog gis/ jo bo gshegs pa na bdag gis bsgom par zhu zhus pas/ bya ba ngan pa yin pas bor la thongs gsungs/ 'o na 'chad par zhu zhus pas kyang de skad gsungs/'o na res bshad res bsgom mam zhus pas kyang de skad gsungs/ 'o na ji ltar bgyi zhus pas/ tshe 'di blos thongs gsungs/ btsun pa gcig gis dgon par skor ba byas pas/317

ston pa rin po che'i zhal nas/ jo bo skor ba byed pa'ang glo ba dga' ste/ de bas kyang chos shig rang byas na dga' gsungs/kho'i bsam pa la phyag cig byas na dga' ba yin nam snyam nas byas pas kyang de skad gsungs/ de bzhin du kha ton dang sgom byas pas kyang de skad gsungs/ 'o na ci bgyi lags zhus pas/tshe 'di blos thongs shig lan gsum gsungs/ chos rje red mda' ba'i zhal nas/ thos pa'i gting dpags nas/ tshe blos btang gi sgrub pa snying por byed pa las lhag pa'i rgyal ba sras bcas mnyes par byed pa'i mchod pa gzhan med/ de'i thad na deng sang gi 'chad nyan 'dra ba gzhan don ltar snang yin/ rnyed bkur lhur byed kyi thabs dbang bskur lung khrid la sogs 'khor sdud pa'i thabs gzhan don ltar snang byed pa rnams la snying po med gsungs/ de bas na gang la bsams kyang snying po med pa'i tshe thung 'di la ma chags par blos ci thongs bya'o/ /sngon ras chung pa la rgad po bza' mi gnyis kyis g.yu rdog chen po zhig bcol bas/ tshags mi byed byas pas ma nyan par bcol song / dgong mo sa sros pa dang / mi ra slog gyon pa/ phad tshe la khres po byas pa/ skra spyi bor bkyigs pa zhig nang du 'ongs pa mthong nas/ phyi la bltar phyin pas/ gnam sgo phye nas gzhan ci 318

yang mi 'dug tshe/ lha 'dre'i bar chad du shes nas/ nang bar g.yu kho rang la gtad skad/ des na nor tshags byed pa phar zhogatha na gzhan gyis nor bcol ba yang len mi rung / sngon rje btsun mi la ras pas brag dkar rta so na zwa la dka' thub mdzad dus lan cig mtshan mo mi gcig gis rje btsun la zas nor yod du re nas byung ste phug pa'i nang kun g.yeng gin 'dug pa la/ rje btsun rgod cig shor te/ ngas nyin mo ma rnyed pa'i sa de nas khyod kyis mtshan mo e rnyed ltos shig byas/ kho rang yang rgod cing thon song gsungs/ de lta bu byed rgyu byung na rab/ ma byung yang de'i cha 'dra tsam re cis kyang bya'o/ /sngon byang chub sems dpa' mched drug nags su sgom gyin bzhugs dus padma'i rtsa ba gsol ba las gcig gis padma'i rtsa ba brkus snang bas khong rnams kyis rtsa ba sus brkus pa de la longs spyod mnga' thang gra rgyas pa re yong na sdug thag chod pa re yong dgongs nas/ gcig na re/ bram ze khyed kyi rtsa ba sus khyer ba/ /'byor pa'i mtshan mas brgyan pa'i khyem pa ba/ /chung ma yid du 'ong ba rnyed par shog /bu dang tsha bo rnams dang ldan par shog /kha cig na re/ bram ze khyed kyi rtsa ba sus khyer ba/ /phreng ba do shal can ldan gos bzang dang / /bu yis reg pa'i rgyan rnams 319

btags byas te/ /'dod pa mi zad pa la spyod par shog /gcig na re/ gang gi rtsa ba mthong la chos ma mthong / /de ni gcig pu dge ba rnams dang bral/ /bsnyen bkur byas pas myos par gyur nas ni/ /kha zas zhim po dag la dga' bar shog /gcig na re/bram ze khyed kyi rtsa ba sus khyer ba/ /rig byed legs par lobs nas ston par byed/ /dka' thub can du re ba chen po yis/ /de ni yul mi kun gyes mchod byed shog /ces dmod pa re re bor ro/ /des na nor longs spyod mnga' thang gra rgyas pa de skyid min sdug bsngal gyi gra rgyas pa yin pas/ spong ci thub la 'bad par bya'o/ /bka' gdams kyi bla ma 'ga' res nor 'dis mtho ris thar pa'i gnas su yar 'gro ba'i lam nor du bcug nas/dmyal ba yi dwags la sogs pa'i ngan song gi lam log pa ru mar 'gro ba'i rgyu byed pas na/ nor zer ba'i sgra don de yin/de'i rgyu mtshan shes na nor bsog pa phar zhog nor zer ba'i ming go na yang 'jigs rgyu yong bar gda' gsungs skad/'jig rten kha dpe la yang / 'khor ba rgya che na sdug bsngal grangs mang / zer ba ltar/ deng sang gi phyug po phal cher gyis nor yod tshe/ rang gis za mi thub gzhan la ster mi thub/ chos 320

phyogs la gtong mi thub par nor mang po bsags pa'i mthar gang yong na/ ser sna can gyi zas nor te/ /nyam pa can gyi kha la rgyag /zer ba ltar yul de'i dpon po'am/ yang na mi ngan ham can gyis don med kyi snyad mang po bskos/ nor thams cad khyer yong / gzhan yang / nor ni phung krol kun gye rtsa ba yin/gsungs pa dang / mnga' thang rgyas kyin sdug bsngal mtsho rdol gsungs pa dang / nor dgra 'dre 'bod pa'i g.yab mo yin gsungs pa ltar/ nor longs spyod gra rgyas pa rnams la mis gnod pa tsam du ma zad lha 'dre rnams kyis kyang nad tsha shi chad god kha sogs mi 'dod pa'i rigs rgyun mi 'chad du btang yong / des na tshe 'di'i mi nor zas gsum gang la yang mi chags pa rje mi la ras pa lta bu 'ong ba'i smon lam 'debs par bya'o/ /sngon rwa sgreng na jo bo'i dngul gye gdung khang byed mkhan a tsa ra ma nu bya ba yod pa/ tshes bco lnga'i zla ba shar ba na ngu skad/ de tsug yin byas pas/ da tsam na rgya gar na nga'i bu mo rnams zla rtsed byed par dran zer lo/ /'o na khyod da lta rang sangs rgya ba dang / bu smad dang 'phrad pa gang la 'dam byas pas/ bu smad dang 'phrad pa 'dam zer lo/ /des na rang re yang 'khor ba la shi sbar 'tham pa a tsa ra ma nu de 'dra ba zhig tu ma 321

gyur pa bya'o/ /sngar mngon shes kyis lung ston byed pa zhig yod pa la/ de na re/ bran ka mon po dmyal bar skye bar 'dug zer/der kho na re/ dmyal ba su sreg pa sreg nga rang ni 'di na chang 'thung zer lo/ /des na 'o cag gis kyang 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs ma bsams na bran ka mon po'i lad mo byed nyen che bas/ da ni sha chang la sogs pa'i 'dod yon spong ci thub la 'bad par bya'o/ /sngar bram ze rnams la dus ston bzang po zla ba gsum mam/ bzhi yod pa la/ der bram ze'i lag pa la sbrang rtsi'i rgyas btab pa'i bram ze zhig mkhas pa yon tan dang ldan pa yin yang / sred pa che bas sbrang rtsi'i ro mngar ba la chags nas rgya de lces bldags/ der rgya med pa dang sgo srung gis ma btang bar dus ston shor ro/ /de bzhin du rang re yang sbrang rtsi lta bu'i tshe 'di'i bde skyid cung zad la chags na/ dus ston bzang po lta bu'i gtan bde sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i skal ba 'chad pas gang yang ma chags pa bya gsungs so/ /sngon shākya'i rgyal po bzang ldan sogs shākya lnga brgya cig char rab byung byas nas/ bzang ldan phyag dar khrod kyi gos gyon/ rigs ngan las bsod snyoms blangs te byung ba rgyal po gsal rgyal gyes mthong bas brgyal nas bog song ngo / /der dal gyis 322

bslangs nas bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du byon nas/ bzang ldan rgyal srid spangs nas 'di ltar du bgyid pa zhes zhus pas/bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal nas/bzang ldan ni da lta ga na 'dug kyang bdag re skyid bdag re skyid/ sngar rgyal po'i pho brang na srung ma brgya phrag gis bskor te gnas kyang rtag tu 'jigs shing bag tsha ba la/ da ni spyil bu sgo med na yang bag tsha ba med par bde'o zhes lan gsum gsum brjod par 'dug gsungs/ de bzhin du tshe blos btang nas/ ri khrod dpen pa'i dga' tshal bsten pa'i gang zag de las skyid pa zhig rgyal po la yang med/des na sngon gye sgyes bu dam pa rnams kyis tshe blos btang nas dben par skyid pa'i rgyang glu kho na blangs pa la ltos dang ha go yong /yang sngon mi glen pa zhig phyogs gzhan zhig tu tshong la song nas/ dgong gcig tshil bu zhig me la bsregs nas tsha mo kha nang du bzhag pas kha lce gnyis ka tshig pas/ a tsha zhes skad ngan dang bcas te phar rgyang ring du 'phangs pa'i phyi nyin snga mo mthong tshe/ da dung yang bred nas phye zil ba tsam re 'dug ste/nang na da dung me dmar po zhig 'bar gyen yod yong zer/ de'i phyogs su mi 'gro skad/ de bzhin du 'dod yon shig tsam re rtsa 323

na/ sdug bsngal ri tsam yod tshul bsams nas spong ci thub la 'bad dgos/ sngon mi glen pa zhig rnga chen po zhig len du song nas/ kho'i bsam pa la sgra dang gzugs che tshul la lcid khog che yong snyam shed chen pos yar btegs pas/ yar mgo thog tu shor nas sa la lhung dus sgra chen po byung tshe/ kho 'dzum byas te/khyod sgra che ba ma gtogs lcid gang yang mi 'dug zer/ de bzhin du lha mi'i bde skyid zer ba 'di la sgra che ba tsam ma gtogs snying po gang yang mi 'dug pas/ gang la yang ma chags pa bya'o/ /sngon mi glen pa zhig gis gzhan gyi snum rdza ma gang khur nas lam la 'gro dus bsam blo 'di ltar btang / ngas mi yi gla byas rngan pa bsags pas ba mo zhig nyos/ ba mo de mang du song ba dang skye dman zhig blangs/ de la bu zhig byung na bu des nga sgo na yod tshe/a pha zhes bos na ngas a zer dgos/ nang du shog la ja 'thung zer dus yong yong zhes mgo gug gug bya dgos snyam/ mgo gug gug byas pas/ snum 'khur gyi lung thag mgo la dkris yod pa shor nas rdza ma sa la brdabs nas snum thams cad med par byas pas/ snum bdag tshig pa zos nas kho la mang po brdungs nas btang skad/ des na mi dran dgu dran gyi mgo la mi yong dgu yong / dran rgyu ma mang na bzang / sngon rgya gar lho phyogs kyi 324

mi mda' rtsal che ba zhig gzhan rtsal can gye grogs kha shas dang 'grogs nas rgya gar nub phyogs kyi mtha' logs shig tu song song bas/ skabs shig nags khrod nyams dga' zhig tu slebs/de na mkha' 'go ma zhig yod pa des/ 'dod pa'i don gcig yod pa de khong rnams kyis bsgrubs pas mkha' 'gro ma thugs mnyes nas mi de kun la nor bu zhig byin pas/ mi de rnams kyi gcig gis nga dgos/ yang gcig gis nga dgos zhes 'phrog res byas steng nas 'khrug pa shor tshe/ nang nas mda' rtsal che ba'i mi des/ nga la nor bu mi dgos khyed rnams kyis 'khrug pa ma rgyag ces bar bshol bas mi kun thang chad tshe gcig na re/'o na nged rnams mi 'grig na/ kho la byen byas pas/ gzhan kun gyis kyang de yong zhes sngar nor bu mi dgos zer mkhan de la byin nas thob skad/ des na 'dod pa med na/ dngos grub thams cad mi 'dod bzhin du thob yong / sngon lha'i dbang po'i bsod nams las ches lhag pa'i gang po bya ba rab tu byung nas/chos gang zhig yid la byas na myur du grol ba thob pa'i gdams ngag ste ma zhig bcom ldan 'das la gsol ba btab pas/gzhan ci yang mi gsung bar khyod 'dod pa la chags na grol ba mi thob pas/ khyod 'dod pa la ma chags pa gyes dang grol ba 325

thob bo zhes tshe bloca/ btang gi chos nyag gcig gsungs nas/khong gis bsgoms pas dgra bcom pa thob par gsungs/ des na dgra bcom pa'i go 'phang thob par 'dod pas kyang / tshe blos gtong ba'i gdams pa 'di thugs dam gyi mthil du gzung bar bya'o/ /sngon thub pas thugs bskyed dus bstan pa la chos gos ngur smrig sor bzhi 'chang ba la'ang bza' btung bsam pa bzhin ma thob na/ bdag gis sangs rgyas bslus pas sangs rgyas mi thob par gyur cig ces dam bca' mdzad cing / khyem pa'i skye bo thams cad kyis/ /sen mo'i steng du zhing rmos kyang / /nga yi rab tu byung ba rnams/ /'tsho bas phongs par mi 'gyur ro/ /gsungs pas rang gi ngos nas thub pa'i bka' la blo 'gel nus na/ dben pa'i gnas su rtse gcig tu sgrub pa byed pa la 'tsho bas phongs mi srid do/ /sngon gyi dam pa rnams kyi rnam thar gyes kyang shes te/ rgya bod du sngon byon pa'i dam pa phal mo ches tshe 'di blos btang ste/ dben pa'i gnas su sgrub pa la rtse gcig tu gzhol ba sha stag mdzad 'dug kyang rnyed bkur dang snyan grags 'bad med du rgyas pa las/ 'tsho bas phongs nas chos dang srog gi bar chad du gyur pa de dag su la byung ba'i lo rgyus mi snang ngo / /des na tshe blos thongs na rnyed bkur snyan grags 326

kyang 'bad med lhun 'grub tu 'ong bar gda'/sngon rje btsun 'brog la phyi gangs kyi ra ba na bzhugs dus/mgon po bya rog gdong can yang byung bas/ rje mi la'i zhal nas/ ngas tshe stod la mthu kho na la las ka byed dgos pa zhig byung dus na khyod mi 'dug da khyod kyi dgos pa ci yod gsungs nas/ glang ber gcig gis brdungs pas chos skyong na re/ de dus rje btsun chos pa min pas nga 'khor sa med pa lags/ da ni rje btsun chos kho na mdzad pas yang yang 'khor dgos pa yin gsungs pas/ rje btsun mi las khyod rang bden gsungs/yang rje btsun chu bar na bzhugs dus su/ nor lha thams cad drung du byung bas/ mi las glang beer gyis khong tsho brdungs nas/ngas tshe stod la zan kham re mi rnyed pa byung dus khyed tsho mi 'dugad khyed kyi dgos pa med gsungs pas/ de dus na rje btsun 'dod pas gdungs pas/ nged tsho 'khor sa ma byung ba lags/ da lta ni rje btsun 'dod pa zad pas/ nged tsho rang dbang med par 'khor ba lags zhus pas/ mi la'i zhal nas/khyed bden gsungs/ des na chos skyong nor lha rnams 'khor bar 'dod na yang / tshe blos btang nas chos bzhin byas na 'ong ba'i tshul la bsams nas/ tshe 'di'i 'dod nag 'di'i dbang 327

du ma song ba byas tshe blos ci thongs la 'bad dgos/ tshe blos ma thongs par dgon chung re bdag tu bzung chags sdang gi 'khor lo bskor na/ bka' brgyud pa'i gdung rgyud chad pa dang 'dra ste/rje mi la'i zhal nas/ sgom chen pa sdod tshugs la snyad btags nas/ dgon chung re brtsigs pas mi bsog dgu bsog byed tsa na/ sgom dang bral tshar ba yin gsungs skad do/ /yang ngas gzhi dgon ma bzung bas 'tshengs/ dgon chung khra tsong nge ba zhig brtsigs na 'dzin chags shugs la skye/ gang zag blo chung rnams sgom dang bral gsungs/ yang dus phyis tsa na nga'i brgyud 'dzin yin zer nas/ ri khrod spangs te dgon chung re bzung nas/mdun na chang bum re bzhag nas lag pas rnga khog re bzung /khas mi nag po la chos nag sgrog de tsam na nga'i brgyud pa chad pa yin gsungs/ lar yang chos pa dang / sgom chen pa bya ba de ni rgas la thug tsam na 'dzin chags je chung la 'gro dgos pa yin pa la/ dus da lta'i chos pa dang / sgom chen pa phal cher ni/rgas kha shi khar song ba dang 'dzin chags je che je cher 'gro bar 'dug gsungs/ des na skye ba nas tshe rabs thams cad du de lta bu zhig tu ma gyur pa bya'o/ /mdor na 'khor ba 'dir 'khor ba'i rgyu rkyen de las bzang ngan sna tshogs byas pa las 328

byung / las de chags sdang la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis bsags/ de'i rtsa ba gang la thug na/ nga ltogs yong / nga grang yong / nga skom yang / nga na yong / nga shi yong / nga la zas dgos/ nga la gos dgos/ nga la bu dgos/ nga la nor dgos/ mi dgos dgu dgos kyi 'dod nag mkhan/ nga bdag 'gong po phung rgan 'di la thug 'dug pas/ snyigs dus kyi tshe thung 'di la dgra nag po bdag 'dzin 'gong po 'di ci thul la 'bad dgos/ bdag 'dzin de ring brlag na de ring sangs rgya/ sang brlag na sang sangs rgya bas/ bdag 'dzin nyon mongs 'dul ba'i gdams ngag ni chos thams cad yin mod kyang / nyi ma gcig gis mun nag kun sangs pa/ a ru ra rnam rgyal gcig gis nad kun 'joms pa/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu gcig gis kun gye re ba skong ba/ gri gcig gis 'ching ba kun gcod pa/ mi dpa' bo gcig gis dgra kun thul ba ltar chos gcig nyams su blangs pas bdag 'dzin nyon mongs kun thul nas/ tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgya bar byed pa'i gdams ngag kun gye mchog tu gyur pa de gang yin snyam na/ de byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems gnyis yin pa'i tshul ni/ sngon byon rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas mgrin gcig dbyangs gcig ltar gsungs 329

pas/ blo gros can rnams kyis 'di la gcig dril du 'bad par bya'o/ /smras pa/ sa skyong rgyal blon che dgu'i spyi bor bkur/ /sa steng 'di na 'gran zla ma mchis kyang / /sa gzhi bzhin du dman pa'i sa bzung nas/ /sa lam ston mkhas bla mas thugs rjes gzigs/ /'jig rten pa yang dpon po bzang po yi/ /drin gyis skyid tshe glu dbyangs len pa bzhin/ /bdag kyang bla ma dam pa'i bka' drin gyes/ /skyid pa'i dus 'dir chos kyi glu dbyangs len/ /dal 'byor rnyed dka' thob pa da re tsam/ /myur du lha chos byed pa'i dus la bab/ /da re don chen byang chub ma bsgrubs na/ /phyin chad mi lus yang yang rnyed par dka'/ /de ring tsam yang mi 'chi'i nges pa med/ /da lta nyid du lha chos byed re ran/ /glo bur shi nas 'jig rten pha rol tu/ /'gro dus dam chos ma gtogs phan pa med/ /dge sdig gnyis las 'bras bu bde sdug 'byung / /sdig pa spangs nas dge ba sgrub pa gces/ /snga ma ci byas rang gi lus la ltos/ /phyi mar gar 'gro rang gi sems la dris/ /sdig pa'i dbang gis ngan song gsum po ru/ /skyes na sdug bsngal yod pa smos ci dgos/ /las nyon dbang gis mtho ris lha mi ru/ /skyes kyang sdug bsngal ma gtogs bde ba 330

med/ /'khor bar skye ba'i rgyu ni las yin pas/ /las de bsog mkhan nyon mongs bdag 'dzin te/ /dper na sdong po rtsad nas gcod pa ltar/ /bdag 'dzin phung rgan rtsad nas gcod re ran/ /bdag 'dzin 'gong po thul nas tshe gcig la/ /sangs rgyas thob thabs gdams pa kun gyi mchog /byams dang snying rje byang chub sems gnyis po/ /da ni nyams su len pa'i dus la bab/ /ces pa bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o//gnyis pa dngos gzhi byang chub kyi sems gnyis la blo sbyong tshul ni/ yongs 'dzin paṇḍi ta'i zhal nas/ dbang rnon chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba dag gis ni/ sngon la gnas lugs rtogs pa'i lta ba rgyud la bskyed nas/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can la snying rje chen po bskyed pa'i sgo nas byang chub kyi sems rjes su sbyong ba'ang yod gsungs/ de bzhin du dgongs pa rab gsal las/ theg chen gye rigs can chos kyi rjes 'brang ni/ yang dag pa'i de kho na nyid shes pas 'tshol ba sngon du btang ste don dam pa legs par gtan la phab pa'i 'og tu sems can la snying rje chen po bskyed pa la brten nas/ sems bskyed cing thub pa'i brtul zhugs byang sems kyi spyod pa la slob bo gsungs/ des na thog mar don dam byang chub kyi sems bsgom tshul ston te/ rgyal 331

sras rin po che'i zhal nas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang nas bla ma la gsol ba btab ste/ yan lag bdun pa phul nas lus drang por 'dug la dbugs phyir 'gro nang 'gro nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bar du lhag chad med par bgrangs te/ 'dis bsam gtan gyi snod du rung bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bya'o/ /de nas don dam byang chub kyi sems 'di ltar bsgom dgos te/ dper na/ rmi lam gye snang ba sna tshogs de nyid gnyid kyis bslad pa'i sems snang yin pa de bzhin du/ da ltar gye yul snang sna tshogs 'di yang bag chags kyis bslad pa'i sems snang yin te/ lang shar gshegs pa'i mdo las/ bag chags kyis ni dkrugs pa'i sems/ /don du snang ba rab tu 'byung / /don yod ma yin sems nyid de/ /phyi rol don mthong log pa yin/ /gsungs/ rgyal sras rin po ches/ 'di ltar gzung ba'i yul du gyur pa'i snod bcud 'di dag rmi lam dang 'dra ste/ rang gi sems nyid 'khrul nas de ltar snang ba yin gyi/ sems las logs su gyur pa cung zad kyang med par sgro 'dogs bcad gsungs/ sngon byang chub sems dpa' mdzes pa'i tog gnyid kyis log pa'i rmi lam na gser gye rnga kun tu snang ba nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dra ba zhig mthong ngo / /phyogs thams cad na 332

sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das grangs med dpag tu med pa dag rin po che'i shing drung na rin po che baiḍūrya'i khri rnams la bzhugs shing / 'khor brgya stong du mas bskor te/ mdun gyis bltas nas chos ston pa mthong ngo / /de nas kyang skyes bu bram ze'i gzugs lta bu zhig gis rnga de brdungs pa mthong ste/ rnga'i sgra de las/ gser 'od dam pa'i rnga chen sgra yis ni/ /stong gsum 'jig rten 'jig rten gsum 'di na/ /ngan song sdug bsngal gshin rje sdug bsngal dang / /dbul ba'i sdug bsngal sdug bsngal zhi bar shog/rnga bo che yi sgra skad 'di yis ni/ /'jig rten phongs pa thams cad zhi gyur cig /ji ltar thub dbang 'jigs med 'jigs zhi ltar/ /sems can 'jigs med 'jigs dang bral bar shog /ji ltar 'khor bar kun mkhyen thub dbang po/ /'phags pa'i yon tan kun dang ldan pa ltar/ /skye dgu ting 'dzin byang chub yan lag gi /yon tan ldan zhing yon tan rgya mtshor gyur/ /rnga bo che yi sgra skad 'di yis ni/ /sems can thams cad tshangs pa'i dbyangs ldan gyur/ /sangs rgyas byang chub dam pa mchog reg shog /chos kyi 'khor lo dag pa bskor gyur cig /bskal pa bsam gyes mi khyab bzhugs par shog /'gro la phan phyir chos ni ston gyur cig /nyon mongs 'joms 'gyur 333

sdug bsngal sel bar shog /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug zhi gyur cig /ces pa la sogs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa'i sgra mang po thos so/ /yang sngon sangs rgyas 'od srungs kyi sbyin bdag rgyal po kṛ kṛ'i rmi lam du/ glang po'i rgyal po skar khung nas byung ba la de'i mjug ma thogs pa dang / skom pas phyi nas khron pa bsnyegs pa dang / phye bre gang dang mu tig bre gang tshong byed pa dang / tsan dan shing phal ba rin mnyam par byed pa dang / kun dga' ra ba'i me tog dang 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa ma byen pa len pas phrogs pa dang / glang bo'i phru gus spos kyi glang po 'jig par byed pa dang / spre'u mi gtsang bas gos pa gzhan la skud pa dang / spre'u rgyal por dbang bskur ba mthong ba dang / ras yug gcig mi bco brgyad kyis bgos pa las re re'i lag tu ras yug tshang ma re re byung ba dang / sgye bo'i tshogs chen po 'dus nas 'thab rtsod byed pa rmis pa/ sangs rgyas 'od srungs la zhus pas/ khong gi zhal nas/ khyed kyi rmi ltas de rnams/ ma 'ongs pa na shākya thub pa'i bstan pa la/ dge slong rnams khyim nas byung yang gtsug lag khang dang rnyed pa la chags pa 'byung ba dang /gzhan gyis chos bshad pa na nyan par mi byed pa 'byung ba dang /bza' ba'i ched du chos ston pa 'byung ba dang / mu stegs kyi 334

gzhung dang sangs rgyas kyi bka' mnyam par 'dzin pa 'byung ba dang / dge 'dun gye longs spyod kyis khyem pa'i ngo srung ba 'byung ba dang / dge slong sdig can gyes khrims ldan dge slong zil gyes gnon pa 'byung ba dang / tshul khrims nyams pas tshul khrims ldan pa la skur ba 'debs pa 'byung ba dang / rmongs pa rnams rgyal por dbang bskur ba 'byung ba dang / shākya thub pa'i bstan pa la sde ba bco brgyad 'byung ba dang / shākya thub pa'i bstan pa rtsod pa'i chos kyis nyams par 'gyur ba'i snga ltas so/ /zhes ma 'ongs lung bstan rim pa bzhin du gsungs/ sngon mnyam med dwags po rin po che de nyid/ dge bshes rgya yon bdag gi rtsar byon te/jo bo rje'i man ngag mtha' dag gsan/ dge bshes khong gi zhal nas/ nga la jo bo'i gdams pa sangs rgyas lag pas byed pa 'dra ba yod de khyod la bstan gyis gsungs nas/ dmigs pa'i 'gro ldog zad pa med pa gsungs pa bzhin bsgoms pas/rmi lam du gser 'od dam pa dang mdo sde sa bcu ba nas bshad pa'i sa bcu thob pa'i snga ltas kyi rmi lam/ khri rkang dag la 'dzegs pa dang / /lngon shing dag la 'dzegs pa dang / /phal ba'i skas la 'dzegs pa dang / /mchod rten dag la 'dzegs pa dang / /gyen la shin tu 'dzegs pa dang / /ri bo'i rtse la 'gro ba 335

dang / /rin chen skas la 'dzegs pa dang / /nam mkha'i skas la 'dzegs pa sogs/ /rmi ltas ngo mtshar can dpag tu med pa byung ngo / /yang rje btsun mi la mjal du 'gro bar thag bcad nas/bla ma dkon mchog la mchod pa phul/ gsol ba btab nas nyal ba'i rmi lam na/ rag dung ring po zhig bus pa'i skad kyis 'dzam bu'i gling thams cad khyab pa rmis te/ deng sang rag dung 'di las sgra che ba med zer ba rmis/ yang nam mkha' rten med pa la rnga bo che yang dag pa gcig 'dug ste/ brdungs pa'i sgra chen po tshad med pa byung / sgra de la ri dwags mang pos nyan zhing 'dugami mang po dpag tu med pa 'dug pa la/ mon mo'i cha lugs byas pa'i bud med gcig na re/ mi 'di rnams la rnga 'di rdungs/ri dwags 'di rnams la 'di sbyin zer nas 'o ma thod phor gang byin/ 'dis ri dwags mang po 'di rnams la mi khebs byas pas/khyed rang thungs dang ri dwags 'di rnams las 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can thams cad khebs par 'ong / nga ni nyi ma nub phyogs su 'gro zer ba rmis/ da lta snod dang mi ldan pa rnams la lam rim gyis sbyangs te rnga'i sgra la nyan pa'i mi rnams yin par 'dug bka' gdams kyi bla ma rnams kyang drin che/ ri dwags de rnams ri khrod 'grim pa'i sgom chen pa rnams yin 336

par 'dug bla ma chen po mi la'i gdams ngag thabs lam dang /phyag rgya chen po kho nas kyang sngar gye rmi lam gyi ltas de ka ltar byung gsungs/ des na chos thams cad rmi lam gye snang ba ltar snang la rang bzhin gyis ma grub cing sems kyi rnam rol tu shes par bya'o/ /yang sngon lam 'bras pa'i sgom chen pa zhig la rtsa rlung gi byed pas skom pa'i nyams shig byung ste/ chu 'thung bar 'dod nas/ chu ra chu mig gtsang po rnams su chu 'thung du phyin pas chu mi 'dug the tshom skyes nas chos gos phar kha'i brag bar gcig tu bzhag ste phyir log nas nyal bsdad/ gnyid sad pa dang skom nyams kyang yal 'dug chu ra sogs na'ang chu 'dug chos gos kyang pha ka na 'dug pas len pa la ko ba gtang dgos par byung zer/ de ltar chu yod du snang ba bden rgyu med/ chu med du snang ba rdzun rgyu med pas na/ cir snang rang sems su thag bcad do/ /'o na snang ba 'di phyi rol gyi don min na sra zhing 'thas pa sogs su snang ba mi rigs snyam na/ bag chags goms pa'i phyir rigs te/ 'jam dpal rnam par rol pa las/ lha'i bu padma rnam par rol pas 'jam dpal la smras pa/ 'jam dpal phyi rol gye yul 'di ji ltar blta bar bya/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/337

phyi rol gyi yul 'di rnams sems rtog pa'i bag chags rgyas pa'i dbang gis snang ba yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ bag chags ji ltar brtas kyang sra zhing 'thas pa 'di ltar snang du ga la rung / 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ de ltar snang du rung ste/dper na grong khyer wā rā ṇa bar/ bram ze mo zhig gis rang lus stag tu bsgoms pas/ thams cad kyis stag dngos su mthong nas mi thams cad bros te/ grong khyer stong ba byung ngo / /yang dge slong zhig gis rang lus mi gtsang bar bsgoms pas/thams cad kyis keng rus su mthong ba byung ngo / /de rnams yun thung ngus kyang de ltar snang na/ thog ma med pa'i dus nas bag chags brtas pas ci ste mi snang / des na ci snang thams cad rang snang yin no/ /mdor na 'o skol rnams la/ gnyid sems kyi rgyu rkyen gyi rten 'brel las mtshan mo bzang ngan gyi rmi lam mang po byung ba de dag thams cad rmis pa'i dus su snang la rang bzhin med cing / thams cad sems su rang snang tsam las phyi rol na logs su grub pa rdul tsam yang med pa de bzhin du/ da lta sems kyis las bzang ngan sna tshogs bsags pa'i rgyu rkyen rten 'brel la brten nas/ snod bcud bzang ngan gyi snang ba ci snang yang snang ba'i dus nas rang bzhin gyis grub pa med cing /338

sems kyi rang snang tsam las phyi rol logs su grub pa rdul tsam yang med pas chos thams cad sems kyi rol par shes par bya'o/ /'o na de ltar byed mkhan sems kyi gnas lugs ji lta bu zhig yin snyam na/ sems kyi gnas lugs brtags shing dpyad nas btsal ba'i tshe/ rang bzhin gyis grub pa rdul tsam yang med par/ gdod nas stong zhing gsal la 'dzin pa med pa sgrib med zangs thal khyab gdal slong yangs nam mkha' lta bu yin pas/de'i ngang la nam mkha' lta bur mnyam par 'jog dgos te/'gro ba yongs kyi sngon nas ma 'dris pa'i mdza' bshes chen po 'dren pa mnyam med ston pa sangs rgyas kyi zhal gyi bum bzang las/ 'di ltar sems yongs su tshol te/ 'dod chags par 'gyur ba'am/ zhe sdang bar 'gyur ba'am/ gti mug par 'gyur ba'i sems de gang yin/ ci 'das pa'am ma 'ongs pa'am da ltar byung ba zhig yin/ de la sems 'das pa gang yin pa de ni zad pa'o/ /ma 'ongs pa gang yin pa de nam phyin pa'o/ /da ltar byung ba ni gnas pa med do snyam mo/ /'od srungs/ sems ni nang na'ang med/ phyi rol na med gnyis ka na yang med cing mi dmigs so/ /'od srungs/ sems ni gzugs med pa/ bstan du med pa/ thogs pa med pa/ rten med pa/ snang ba med pa/ rnam 339

par rig pa med pa/ gnas med pa'o/ /'od srungs/ sems ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyis kyang ma gzigs mi gzigs gzigs par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / 'od srungs/ sems ni kun tu btsal kyang mi rnyed do/ /gang mi rnyed pa de ni ma dmigs pa'o/ /gang mi dmigs pa de ni 'das pa yang ma yin/ma 'ongs pa yang ma yin/ da ltar byung ba yang ma yin no/ /gang 'das pa yang ma yin/ ma 'ongs pa ma yin/ da ltar byung ba yang ma yin pa de no dus gsum las yang dag par 'das pa'o/ /gang dus gsum las yang dag par 'das pa de ni yod pa yang ma yin med pa yang ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs/ gzhan yang byams pas zhus pa/ bcom ldan 'das nang gi sems ji ltar lta bar bgyi/bka' stsal pa/ sems ni dbyibs med pa nam mkha' lta bu'o/ /gsungs/yang sngon sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das byang chub shing gi drung na bzhugs dus/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rgya mtsho tsam gyi zhal mthong ba de dag rnams kyis gsung gcig gis bka' stsal pa/ sems kyi spyod yul ci 'dra zhes/ /rang gi sems ni so sor rtog /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung thos nas/ /rang gi sems la rtogs bzhin du/ /yun ring du ni gnas pa na/ /sems kyi rnam 340

pa ma mthong ste/ /gsungs/ mnyam med po to ba'i chig lab ring mo las/ khams gsum 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gye rgya mtsho chen po 'dir thog ma med pa nas 'khyams pa 'dir nga sems ma rtogs pas lan nas 'dug da 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyes 'jigs nas thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa thob par 'dod pas rang gi sems rtogs dgos gsungs/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen pos/ dwags po sman lung gi rgya sog phur sgrub pa mdzad pa'i tshe/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs mngon sum byon nas nyams len mdor bsdus gsungs pa la/ rje nyid kyis bsdus don mdzad pa las/gang la gnas pa med par ni/ /sems nyid nam mkha' lta bur bsgom/ /de yi grogs rnams kun la 'bad/ /bse ru lta bur gnas par bya/ /'du 'dzi dag kyang spang bar bya/ /nang du mnyam par gzhag par bya/ /byang chub chen po brnyes par bya/ las kyi rnam par smin pa gdon mi za/ /nges par 'byung dang byang chub sems bsgoms te/ /dran pa'i me chen rgyun chad med par sbar/ /yul drug bud shing nges par 'tshig par 'gyur/ /'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos rnams kun/ /sngon chad gang gis ma dmigs mi dmigs phyir/ /nam mkha' bzhin du 'di yi mtha' 341

dang bral/ /yul gye snang ba nam mkha'i padmo bzhin/ /sems kyi 'dzin pa bder gshegs su yis rnyed/ /dbyengs rig gcig pa mo gsham bu yis bsgrubs/ /de 'dra gang yin de dag rgyal ba'i lam/ /zhes gsungs/ rje rin po ches dang po lta ba'i dogs pa ma chod par yul rgya gar rang du 'byon dgongs tshe/ grub chen las kyi rdo rjes yi dam phyag na rdo rje la zhus pas yi dam gyis sgu mi ston pa'i gzhom med kyi sgra zhig gis 'di skad gsungs/ las kyi rdo rje ma ti bha tra shrī la/ nga'i tshig 'di tsho rna bar skyol cig dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa/ye shes kyi ḍā ki ma thams cad kyi snying gtam/ rdo rje 'dzin pa dag gi gsang tshigatheg pa'i yang rtse sman mchog chen po'i sgrub pa/ sems nyid 'od gsal gyi rtsad chod gsungs/ yang las kyi rdo rjes zhus pa/ 'od gsal gyi ngo bo ji lta bu lags zhus pas/ gsang bdag gi zhal nas/ las kyi rdo rje 'od gsal gyi ngo bo/ ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje gsum du 'du gsungs/ yang gsang bdag gi zhal nas/ las kyi rdo rje/ rig pa'i ngo bo stong pa 'di sus kyang ma bcos pa rgyu med pa/ rkyen med pa/ ye gdod ma nas gnas pa yin/ 'di la bca' bcos ma byed par khong rang gang 'dug gi steng du zhog dang gol sa med/ de bzhin du rang bzhin gsal ba 'di ye 342
