gdod ma nas stong pa dang dbyer med du lhun gyis grub/ de'i rtsal thugs rje 'gag med gang shar yang rang bzhin gyes rdul tsam du yang ma grub pas gsum ga dbyer med zung 'jug chen por shes par gyis dang / des dbyer med du sangs rgya yis gsungs/ mkhas grub rin po che'i zhal nas/ sngon du sems lta bu de tshol ba'i gzhir byas nas/ de nyid la rang bzhin sems pa'i rig pas ji ltar grub tshul btsal ba na/ cung zad kyang ma rnyed pa'i nges pa lhang nge skyes pa'i 'dzin stangs kyi shugs ma nyams par skyong ba'i nges don dang po 'tshol ba'i gzhir byas pa'i rang sems la sogs pa'i snang ba gtan nas ldog dgos/zhes gsungs/ sangs rgyas gnyis pa jo bo rjes/ rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs na jo bo zhal gyur ta re'i lha khang gi thad ka tshur byon tsa na/ nam mkha' na bud med rgan gzhon gnyis kyi gzhon shos kyis chos thams cad gang du 'dus dris pas/ rgan shos na re/ rang gi sems su 'du zer/ sems kyi mtshan nyid ji lta bu yin zer bas/ sems kyi mtshan nyid nam mkha' lta bu yin gsungs pas/ jo bos de'i dus su sems tsam dang dbu ma'i lta ba thugs su chud skad/ yang jo bo rang gi zhal nas/ sems ni shin tu brtag dka' ste kha dog med pa dbyibs dang bral ba 343

nam mkha' dang 'dra ba rang bzhin gyes ma grub pa'o/ /gsungs/sngon jo bo rje la/ 'brom ston pas stong pa nyid kyi lta sgom kho nas sangs rgya ba lags sam zhus/ 'di ltar snang tshod grags tshod 'di thams cad rang gi sems las ma byung ba med/ sems rig pa stong pa yin/ de rig stong gnyis med du rtog pa de lta ba yin/de la ma yengs par dran pa rgyun chags pa de sgom pa yin/ de'i ngang nas sgyu ma lta bu'i tshogs gnyis bsog pa de spyod pa yin/ de da lta nyams 'og tu chud pa zhig yod na rmi lam du 'ong / rmi lam du byung na 'chi kha 'ong / 'chi khar byung na bar dor 'ong /bar dor byung na mchog gi dngos grub thob nges pa yin gsungs/ 'brom rin po che'i zhal nas/ thams cad sems kyi rang bzhin yin/ sems nyid stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin yin/stong pa ye stong spros bral gye rang bzhin du shes pa ni ye shes yin te sangs rgyas su gsungs pas/ sangs rgyas las lhag pa'i lha med gsungs/sngon slob dpon bsam yas na bzhugs dus/dad can rgas po rngog shes rab rgyal po zhes bya ba lo drug cu rtsa gcig lon pa zhig gis/ 'chi kha ma'i chos shig zhu 'tshal zhus pas/ slob dpon gyes rgas po'i snying khar phyag 'khar btsugs nas 344

gdams pa 'di gsungs so/ /nyon cig rgas po/ rang rig pa byang chub kyi sems 'di la ltos shig gzugs dang kha dog tu grub pa med/ mtha' dang dbus su grub pa med/ dang po byung sa med de stong / bar du gnas sa med de stong / tha ma 'gro sa med de stong / stong pa cir yang ma grub pa gsal la dwangs pa zhig 'dug pa de mthong nas/ ngo shes na rang ngo rang gis shes pa yin/ de ltar rtogs na 'byung ba'i lus rgas kyang byang chub kyi sems la rgas pa med do/ /rgas po/ yang dag pa'i don nyams su longs shig gsungs pas/ ming yang rgas po 'khar btsugs kyi gdams pa zhes bya'o/ /rngog shes rab rgyal po de nyon mongs pa'i 'ching ba las grol nas grub pa thob bo/ /sngon slob dpon chen po brag dmar bsam yas na bzhugs dus/ dad ldan rgan mo stag bza' dge ldan mas 'chi kha'i chos shig zhu 'tshal zhus pas/ slob dpon gyes rgan mo'i snying khar phyag mjub btsugs nas/ gdams pa 'di gsungs so/ /rgan mo nyon cig yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa dang / khams gsum gye sems can la khyad ci yod byas na/ sems nyid kyi don rtogs ma rtogs gnyis las med/ sems nyid kyi don rtogs na sangs rgyas te/ don ma rtogs pa'i ma rig 'khrul bas sdug bsngal byung /345

mar 'khor bar 'khyams pa yin/ sangs rgyas kyi rgyu de rang la yod kyang ngo ma shes pa yin/ rang ngo rang gis shes pa'i man ngag ni/ nyams su len pa'i dus/ rang rig pa dri ma med pa/sal le sang nge hrig ge bde ba gsal ba mi rtog pa zhen 'dzin med pa blos ma bslad pa 'di kho na sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa yin/ 'di rgan mos nyams su longs mdzod cig gsungs pas/ming yang rgan mo mdzub btsugs kyi gdams pa zhes bya'o/ /rgan mo dpon g.yog gnyis po nyon mongs pa'i 'ching ba las grol nas grub pa thob bo/ /des na 'chi kha ma'i mi la yang gdams ngag 'di las zab pa dang ngo mtshar ba zhig gzhan na med par gda'/ yang grub chen las kyi rdo rje la/ yi dam phyag na rdo rje zhal gsum phyag drug pa zhig gi zhal gzigs pa'i tshe/ dbus zhal mthing kha'i zhal nas/ las kyi rdo rje/ myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya bar 'dod pas/ bslab pa'i gnas bzhi la bslab pa gal che gsungs/ bslab pa'i gnas bzhi gang lags zhus pas/ dang po sangs rgyas ngo shes par bya ba la bslab/ngo shes nas 'dris par bya ba la bslab/ 'dris nas mi 'bral bar bya ba la bslab/ ma bral ba'i don smin cing nar son par bya ba la bslab gsungs/ g.yas zhal dkar po'i zhal nas/ de 346

la gnad kyi gdams pa bzhi gces te/ mkha' ltar dag pa'i lta ba la/ /rig pa'i khyung lding yan du chug /gser gling bsam gtan bsgom pa la/ /ma yengs rgyun du gnas par mdzod/ /glang chen lta bu'i spyod pa la/ /'dzin chags med par rol du khrid/ /sgrub tu med pa'i 'bras bu la/ /brtson 'grus shin tu myur ba gces/ /gsungs/ g.yon zhal dmar po'i zhal nas/ de la gces pa bzhi dang ldan pa zhig dgos/ mu mtha' bral ba'i lta ba la/ /gdengs kyis chod pa shin tu gces/ /bsam du med pa'i sgom pa la/ /dran pas zin pa rab tu gces/ /blang dor med pa'i spyod pa la/ /bag dang ldan pa rab tu gces/ /thob tu med pa'i 'bras bu la/ /re dogs bral ba shin tu gces/ /gsungs/yang las kyi rdo rjes zhus pa/ myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya bar 'dod kyang rnam g.yeng le lo chags sdang re dogs kyi dbang du song nas/ rtogs pa'i dus mi gda' bas/da myur du rtogs pa'i gdams pa zhig bstan du gsol zhes zhus pas/ las kyi rdo rje/ lta ba la lta ru med kyang rtogs su yod de/g.yeng ba can rnams la dka' bas/ g.yeng ba thams cad rgyab tu bskyur ba gces/ sgom pa la sgom du med kyang goms su yod de/ le lo can rnams la dka' bas/ mgo la me shor ba lta bu'i 347

brtson 'grus bskyed pa rab tu gces/ spyod pa la spyad du med kyang rtsal sbyang du yod de/ chags sdang can rnams la dka' bas/chags sdang gting nas spong ba rab tu gces/ 'bras bu la thob tu med kyang mngon du 'gyur du yod de/ re dogs can rnams la dka' bas/ re dogs til 'bru tsam yang med pa shin tu gces gsungs/ yang zhal gcig phyag gnyis shin tu khro ba zhig tu gyur pa'i zhal nas/ las kyi rdo rje/ stong pa btson du zungs/ /rig pa stod la non/ /gzung 'dzin bcud la bor/ /rnam rtog 'gags su chug /tshig bzhi po 'di rab tu gces gsungs/ yang de la gnad kyi gdams pa drug gces te/ chos nyid stong pa la dngos po'i khong 'tshang mi gzhug rig pa gcer bu la mtshan ma'i gos kyis mi dkri/ sems nyid gnyug ma la chags sdang gi rten mi bca'/ ye shes rnam dag la dge sdig gi blo mi gzhug mtshan ma rang grol la gzung 'dzin gyi mdud pas mi bcing / ye stong ye grol la dngos po dang tshad mar mi gzung / zhes gsungs nas mi snang bar gyur to/ /de bzhin du dang po rang sems sangs rgyas su ngo shes nas nyams su blangs na myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyal sras rin po ches slob dpon 348

skyob pa dpal la gdams pa/ sems rtog med kyi ngang la gsal sang nge ba de'i ngo bo la bltas nas cir yang ma grub par stong sang nge gnas pa de la rig pa gsal stong 'dzin med zer ba yin/ de dang po nas thams cad la yod mod kyi gzung 'dzin gyi rnam par rtog pas bsgribs pas ngo ma shes pa yin/ khyed rang gis nyams len gyi stobs kyis ngo bo mthong ba yin pas/ sems kyi ngo bo stong par 'dug pa de la legs par ltos/ de'i thog tu zhog mdzod/ yon tan gye 'char tshul gong nas gong du 'byung zhing / mchog gi dngos grub kyi rgyur 'gyur bas/ dga' ba sgoms la nyams su longs mdzod gsungs/ sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas ngur smrig gar gye rnam rol paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan la/ bya btang ri khrod 'dzin pa phyag rgya chen po'i rnal 'byor pa dpal 'byor phun tshogs kyis bskul ngor/ phyag rgya chen po'i gnad 'gag mgur du bzhengs pa las/ sngon thog ma med nas da lta'i bar/ /sems 'khrul ba'i dbang gis 'khor bar 'khyams/ /da 'khrul ba'i rang mtshang rig pa na/ /sems stong nyid rang zhal rjen par mthong / /chos kun gye rang bzhin gdod ma'i gshis/ /don dbyer med sems kyi rdo rje de/ /blos ma bcos lhug par 'jog pa 'di/ /lam phyag rgya chen po'i nyams 349

len yin/ /zhes dang / gzhan yang nyams mgur 'di ltar mdzad de/ ha ha/ sems gsal rig 'gags med skye ba 'di/ /skye med du mthong ba ya re mtshan/ /skye med la gnas dang 'gags pa dang / /mo gsham gyi bu mo'i 'gyeng bag bzhin/ /sems rang bzhin stong pa'i mtha' dang bral/ /gdeng 'gags med cir yang 'char zhing snang / /dbyengs gzung 'dzin gyi sgog las rnam grol kyang / /der spar 'dzin byed pa 'di ci 'dra zhig /khong gzhan ma tsho lta khrid dang phyag chen bsgoms/ /mi kho bo la bsgom bya sgom byed dang / /don 'di bsgoms kyi mtshan ma rdul tsam med/ /sgom sgrub kun ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod/ /da myur du shi'am gson kyang sla/ /sems snang stong bde chen gye grogs mchog dang / /dus skad cig kyang mi 'bral 'grogs nas 'gro/ /sdug bsngal kun ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod/ /kha phyir lta'i tha snyad rtog ge bas/ /'di thos na 'gal 'du'i phung por sems/ /don nyams myong can gyi rnal 'byor pas/ /glu 'di 'dra gsan na 'dzum pa 'chor/ /gsungs/ phyag na padmo'i rnam 'phrul rgyal ba bskal bzang rgya mtshos rje rin po che'i legs bshad dang /yongs 'dzin dam pa'i drin la brten nas nges don gye rtogs pa thugs la 'khrungs tshe nyams mgur 'di gsungs so/ /snying 350

'dab brgyad a wa dhū ti'i dbus/ /gzhi 'gyur med sems kyi rdo rje gar/ /lha sangs rgyas kun 'dus blo bzang grags/ /pha bla ma'i ngo bor phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhi 'khor 'das chos rnams ma lus pa/ /nang rang gi sems kyis btags pa tsam/ /sems de yang brtags na sgye 'gags bral/ /gnas lugs kyi ngo bo e ma ho/ /ston mkha' la chu 'dzin dwangs pa bzhin/ /dbyings rang sems dbyer med snang ngo la/ /myong snang gis spros pa ma lus nub/ /nga sgye med nam mkha'i rnal 'byor pa/ /gshis cir yang ma grub rdzun po che/ /snang grags kun sgyu ma'i ltad mor mthong / /nyams dga' ba snang stong zung 'jug 'dis/ /bslu med kyi rten 'brel nges pa rnyed/ /rje mkhyen pa'i gter dang dbyer med pa'i/ /pha blo bzang grags pa'i legs bshad dang / /rje mtshan ldan bla ma'i bka' drin las/ /ngas nges don glu ru blangs pa yin/ /gsungs/ sngon thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa rje srong btsan sgam po la/ lha mo sgrol ma'i sprul pa rgya bza' kong jos/ gdams ngag tshig gcig gis rtogs grol dus gcig tu 'ong ba zhig zhu 'tshal zhes zhus pas/sprul pa'i rgyal pos bka' stsal pa/ rgya mo bza' nyon cig sems can gye blo ma rig pa de sel bar byed pa la/ gdams ngag tshig gcig las med/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad kyi 351

rtsa ba sems yin/ sems phyi na med pas nang du ltos shigabaltas pas sems kyi ngo bo gang du yang ma rnyed cing ma grub pa ngo bo stong pa/ rnam pa gsal ba/ nyams su myong ba zhig 'dug pa de lta ba/ stong gsal ngang las dus rtag tu ma yengs pa de sgom pa/rang ji ltar 'dug kyang gsal stong dang mi 'bral ba de spyod pa/stong gsal gye ngang las lus bor ba'i dus su sangs rgyas pa 'bras bu'o/ /zhes gsungs pas rgya mo bza' rtogs grol dus gcig tu gyur to/ /des na dam pa gong ma rnams kyi gsung bzhin/ chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba sems kyis rtsad brdar yang yang bcad nas/ ngo bo stong pa nyid nam mkha' lta bur gtan la phab nas/ stong sang nam mkha' lta bu'i rgyun skyong ba la 'bad par byas /sngon bla ma cog ro rnal 'byor pa la/ slob ma zhang sgom bya ba dang mtshan nyid pa'i ston pa gnyis kyis/ rdul phra rab 'di cha bcas lags sam cha med lags zhes dris pas/ nga la shes pa spros bral du lhod bzhag tsa na/ rtog pa rang 'gags su khegs/'gags nas sems gsal dwangs rtog med la bzhag tshad lhan lhan 'gro ba zhig yod kyis/ rdul phra rab 'di cha bcas sam cha med khyed rang gang yin pa gyes/ da brtag dpyad rang mi 'jug 352

gsungs so/ /de bzhin du sems kyi gnas lugs stong pa nyid du rtogs nas/ phyi gzung ba'i yul la nang 'dzin pa'i sems mi 'jug par shes pa lhod kyis glod nas nam bzhag kyang phra rags kyi rnam rtog thams cad rang 'gags la song nas/gsal stong rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi ngang du lhan lhan ma gnas kyi bar du dran shes kyis bskyang bar bya'o/ /de ltar bskyangs pa'i stong nyid kyi rtogs pa mngon du 'gyur tshul ni/sngon grub thob gling ras pas/ lo gsum gye dam bca' phul nas sgrub pa la zhugs/ zhag gsum song ba'i tho rangs mos gus chen po zhig gis sna drangs te/ rtogs pa mun la khri gdugs shar ba lta bu phyi nang gi chos thams cad ji lta ba dang / ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes mda' phug med par mngon sum du rtogs/ thugs dam de la bral thob med par brtan pa yang thob/ gling gi thugs dgongs la snang ba rgya yan ma rig pa sdug btsir gyi kha na mi 'dug bsgoms ma bsgoms/ ngo shes ma shes/ bltas ma bltas/dran ma dran/ gang ltar byas kyang chos nyid kyi yo lang las mi 'dug snyam nas/ mtshams las thon te/ dgon pa dang / yul grong kun tu nyul zhing bsgoms pas/ rjes su rje phag mo gru pa mjal dus/ rje yi zhal nas gnyug ma'i don/ /sgoms shig 353

gsungs nas bsgoms lags te/ /bsgom bya dang sgom byed stor nas thal/ /sgom thun mtshams su gzung rgyu mi gda'o/ /zhes pa la sogs pa'i mgur phul bas bla ma shin tu mnyes nas/ rgya gar gyi chu bo gaṅgā phan chad na bram ze sa ra ha chen po rtogs pa mtho de tshun la khyod rtogs pa mtho bar gda' gsungs/ thugs shin tu dgyes par gyur skad/ sngon grub thob thang stong rgyal pos/ kun la mngon shes thogs med du gsungs pas/ slob ma rnams kyis ngo mtshar che ji ltar mkhyen par gda' lags zhus pas/ sems mnyam par bzhag pas khyab gdal nam mkha' lta bus dus gsum sa ler shes pas/ nga la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes zhog la gsol ba thob gsungs/ de bzhin du 'gro mgon gtsang pa rgya ras kyis rtogs pa'i mgur bzhengs pa las/ 'od gsal ngang la mnyam rjes med/ /rnal 'byor lus rgya zhig tsa na/ /mtha' bral 'khor 'das yongs la khyab/ /tshe phyi ma khyod sku khams ci bder bzhugs/ /bdag rdzogs pa chen po'i phu thag bkrus/ /phyag rgya chen po'i ngo bo mthong / /dbu ma chen po'i ngang du nyal/ /pha rol phyin pa'i sa la slebs/ /gsungs/ kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams pas/ yangs ngo che 'o chos kyi dbyengs/ /nam mkha' 'dra ste spros dang bral/ /lta ba rtogs pa'i tshad du phyin/ /354

'dun ma rtse mor phyin pa lags/ /zhes dang / 'chi med rig pa'i don la sbyangs/ /'byung bzhi'i phung po nam yang 'jog /rig pa gnas lugs btsan sa zin/ /na rga 'chi skyid rnal 'byor lags/ /gsungs/ rje rin po ches mdzad pa'i lam rim chen mo las/ de ltar bsgom pas yun ring ma bsgoms snyam nas bltas tsa na/ nam dang nyi ma 'ud 'ud bcad nas snang na sems zin pa yin la/ ring rab bsgom snyam nas bltas pa na ci yang ma song snang na/ sems ma zin pa yin/ sems zin pa'i tshe na/rgyud la nyon mongs pa chung ba dang gnyid kyang sgye ba la mi 'ong snyam pa 'ong / de nas snga dro la sogs pa thun re la 'khyongs pa na/mtshan nyid bzhi ldan du skye ste/ mi rtog pa ni/ mnyam par gzhag pa na/ dbugs phyi nang du 'gyu ba yang mi tshor bar dbugs dang rtog pa phrar song ba'o/ /gsal ba ni ston dus kyi nyi ma phyed kyi dus kyi nam mkha'i dkyil gsal ba dang khyad par med pa'o/ /dwangs pa ni ting gtsang ma'i nang du chu blugs nas nyi ma la bzhag nas bltas pas dwangs pa dang 'dra ba'o/ /phra ba ni/mtshan nyid gsum po de'i ngang nas bltas pa na dngos po spu'i rtse mo gshags pa'i cha gcig byung ba yang mthong ba 'ong ba'o/ /gsungs/ des na de lta bu nam 'ong gi bar bsgom la 'bad 30 du

dgos te/ sngon grub thob thang stong rgyal pos rang don mngon du gyur nas gzhan don la phebs pa'i dus su/ 'bras spungs kyi dka' bcu ba zhig na re/ khyed gang nas byon/ da gang du gshegs/ yon tan ci mkhyen/ don gang la byon zer ba la nga yul blo 'das zhen med nas yong / slob ma 'tshol du 'gro/ rang rgyud 'dul ba shes/ don bstan pa dang sems can gye don byed pa yin gsungs pas/ slob ma la chos bshad rgyu ci yod zer ba la/ phyi rol gye snang ba 'di rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur ston/ nang sems kyi chos nyid mngon sum du ston pa shes/ nyams len slob ma la rag las gsungs/ des na 'di lta bu'i gnas lugs kyi don bla mas bstan kyang nyams len rang la rag las pas/ dus rtag tu nyams len la brtson par bya'o/ /mnyam gzhag las langs nas thun mtshams rnams su/ ci snang thams cad bden med sgyu ma lta bur snang stong du bsgom mo/ /de yang ma yin pa la yin par bsgoms pa min/ yin pa la yin par gsal btab cing bsgoms pa yin te/ de yi rgyu mtshan sngon sangs rgyas kyi dus su sgyu ma mkhan bzang po bya bas/ rgyal po'i khab kyi rtsogs dgu thams cad 'dus pa'i gnas der khyams dang khri dang gdan dang gsol zas dang rim gro ba la 356

sogs pa bkod pa phun tshogs shig sprul nas/ sangs rgyas la mngon shes yod med tshod bgam pa'i phyir gdugs tshod la spyan drangs pas/ sangs rgyas kyis mkhyen bzhin byon no/ /der sgyu ma mkhan bzang pos tshod brtag pa'i phyir 'di ltar bgyis pa'i nongs pa 'chags lags so/ /'di dag bshig par 'dod kyang ma nus lags zhus pas/ khyod kyi 'di sgyu ma'i sprul pa yin no/ /sems can rnams ni las kyi dang / dge 'dun rnams ni chos kyi dang / nga ni ye shes kyi sgyu ma'i sprul pa yin no/ /de ltar shes na de dag drongs shig gsungs pas khos kyang drangs so/ /sangs rgyas 'khor bcas kyis longs spyad de/ 'khor re res kyang / ji ltar de ni sgyu ma mkhan/ /bzang pos sprul pa byas pa ltar/ /'jig rten chos rnams de 'dra ste/ /byes pa rnams kyis mi shes so/ /zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad re gsungs so/ /rjes su/ gang gis sbyin pa gang la byin/ /sbyin pa ji ltar mi rtog pa/ /sbyin pa mnyam pa de nyid kyis/ /bzang po la ni yongs rdzogs shog /ces gsungs pas/ bzang pos dad pas ting nge 'dzin thob bo/ /de las langs nas byang chub tu sems bskyed cing / mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob/ ma 'ongs pa na sangs rgyas rnam par 'phrul ba'i rgyal po zhes bya bar 'gyur zhes lung bstan/ yang sngon dge 357

bshes rong po dkon rgyal gyis/ brang rings kyi mtha' 'og tu ja mang skol byas/ rta brgya dang dngul bre bcu gcig dang / dar zab mang po phul nas/ khyung po rnal 'byor khyod cag gis/ /rgya gar yul du lan gsum byon/ /bla ma brgya dang lnga bcu btsal/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma bzhi yod pas/ /khyed grub thob tu gyur nas snang ba rang bzhin med par rtogs pa yin zer bas/ brag 'di la phar thal tshur thal 'ga' re gyes la/ nam mkha' 'di la skyil krung gyis la 'dug dang zer ba la/ brag ri de la thal byung du phyin te/nam mkhar skyil krung bcas nas gcig dang du mar snang ba la sogs pa'i rdzu 'phrul 'ga' re bstan pas rong po dang grwa pa thams cad shin tu dad de/ de lta bu'i yon tan de gdams ngag gang bsgoms pa las byung ba yin/ zer ba la/ chos rnams sgyu ma lta bu la/ /sgyu ma lta bur nyams blangs pas/ /sgyu ma lta bur mngon sangs rgyas/ /snang yang bden med chos rnams la/ /byes pas bden par bzung bas 'khrul/ /med bzhin snang ba e ma ho/ /la sogs pa'i chos bshad pas dad de/ zla ba bcu gcig nas/rong pos yi dam gye zhal mthong nas snang ba bden med du rtogs so/ /des na snang grag gi chos thams cad snang stong sgyu ma lta bur bsgoms nas mngon du 'gyur nges bya'o/ /kun rdzob byang 358

chub kyi sems bsgom tshul ni/ spyi bor bla ma lha sgom bzhin pa'i ngang nas mtha' skor du sems can thams cad dmigs nas 'di ltar bsam ste/ 'khor ba la thog ma med pas rang gi sgye ba la yang thog ma med cing skye ba gcig nas gcig tu brgyud de yul phyogs dang sa phyogs 'dir ma skyes pa gcig kyang med/ sgye ba la grangs kyis mi chod/ sems can 'dis lus ma blangs bya ba gcig kyang med/ blangs pa la grangs kyis mi chod/ sems can 'di'i bdag gi ma ma byas pa gcig kyang med/ byas pa la grangs kyis mi chod/ sems can re res kyang mi'i rten la bdag gi ma ma byas pa gcig kyang med/ byas pa la grangs kyis mi chod cing da dung yang byed par 'gyur/ des na drin gyes bskyangs pa'i ma cis kyang yin snyam du bsam mo/ /bdag gi ma 'dis tshe 'di kho nar ma zad tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas bdag gi ma bgrang las 'das pa byed byed pa yin/ khyad par tshe 'dir yang dang por mngal du brtse bas bskyangs/ btsas pa'i tshe 'jam pa'i stan la bzhag sor mo bcu'i rtse la g.yengs/ sha'i drod la sbyar/brtse ba'i 'dzum gyes bsus/ dga' ba'i mig gis bltas/snabs khas phyis/ mi gtsang ba lag pas phyis/ ma rang srog la babs pa lta bu'i sdug bsngal byung ba las/ bdag cung zad na ba 359

la sdug bsngal che bar byas/ sdig sdug gtam ngan rang srog la'ang ma bltas par sha thang thang du sgrub pa'i zas nor thams cad bdag la brtse bas phog ma rang gis 'khyer 'khos dang bstun pa'i phan pa dang bde ba tshad med pa sgrub/ gnod pa dang sdug bsngal tshad med pa las bskyabs pas drin shin tu che snyam du bsam mo/ /de bzhin du pha la sogs pa'i dgra gnyen bar ma'i sems can thams cad kyis tshe sngon ma rnams la ma byas pa'i dus su tshe 'di'i mas drin gyis bskyangs pa bzhin du phan tshad med btags/ gnod pa tshad med las bskyabs pas/ drin can sha stag yin snyam du bsam mo/ /dper na ma bzang mos bu gces phrug de la zas gos kyis phongs nas lus sems la bde ba med pa'i tshe/ nga'i bu la bde ba zhig byung na snyam/ ma sprang mo zhig yin na yang / zas kham gang rnyed na yang ma rang gis za mi phod par bu la byen nas dus rgyun du lus ngag yid gsum gye sgo nas gang byams byams byed pa ltar/ tshe 'dir yang lto gos kyis phongs pa'i ngan slong sogs lus sems la bde ba med pa'i ma sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan na ci ma rung / bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan pa zhig bdag gis bya'o/ /de ltar 360

byed nus par bla ma lhas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes phyogs med kyi byams pa bsgom dgos/sngon a mdo phyogs kyi sde gnyis 'khrugs nas mi bsad mang po byung / nyin gcig rgan mo ma bu gnyis ri khar phyin pas/gzhan gyi sde de'i dmag 'ongs pa mthong tshe ma'i bsam pa la nga bsad rung bu mo 'di ma bsad na ci ma rung snyam/ byams pa'i sems kyis bu mo de 'og tu bcug gos kyis bkab nas bsdad pa'i steng gi ma bsad nas song / bu mo 'og na yod pa ma tshor bar thar pa byung / des na bde ba med pa'i pha ma sems can la snying thag pa nas byams dgos te/ rgyal sras rin po ches/sems can 'di dang 'di zhes bya ba bde zhing skyid 'dug zer ba gsan tsa na/ de legs so gsungs nas shin tu mnyes shing /drung na 'khod pa rnams la yang mnyam nyid du nye ring med par byams gsungs/ sngon kun dga' bo rgyal po'i khab tu zhugs nas mthar gyis bsod snyoms blangs so/ /de'i tshe bram ze ci yang med pa gcig gis/ ma rgan mo khur te slong mo byed/ de yang kha zas zhim po dang shing thog bzang po rnyed na ma la ster zhing kha zas ngan pa dang shing thog skam po dag rnyed na kho rang za ba de mthong nas rab tu dga' bas/ rigs kyi bu ma la sri zhu byed 361

cing mchod par byed pa ngo mtshar che zhes smras so/ /de bzhin du rang gi mas gtso byas pa'i mar gyur sems can thams cad la gang byams byams byed dgos/ de ltar byams pa bsgom na bsod nams che ste/ ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las/ bye ba khrag khrig dkrigs pa'i zhing dag na/ /mchod pa rnam mang dpag med ji snyed pa/ /skyes mchog rnams la de yis rtag mchod pas/ /byams pa'i sems kyi grangs dang char mi phod/ /ces dang / 'jam dpal zhing bkod las/ byang shar mtshams na sangs rgyas dbang phyug chen po'i rgyal ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams stong gis brgyan pa zhes bya ba/ dge slong 'gog pa la zhugs pa'i bde ba bzhin du sems can rnams bde ba dang ldan no/ /der lo bye ba brgya stong du tshangs spyod spyad pas ni zhing 'dir tha na se gol gtogs pa'i yun tsam du sems can thams cad la byams pa'i sems bsgyed na/ snga ma las bsod nams ches mang du bsgyed pas na/ nyin mtshan du gnas pa lta ci smos/ zhes dang / rje rin po che'i zhal nas/ byams pa yod na lha mis byams shing ngang gis 'du ba dang / rgyal bas kyang bdud sde byams pa'i stobs kyis pham par mdzad pas bsrung ba'i mchog tu 'gyur/ zhes dang /spyan snga bas/ smyug rum pa la nan tar na pha rol po 'joms pa 362

la byams pa tsam med/ de bas na byams pa bya ba 'di ming thos pa tsam gyes/ snying sangs sangs 'dug gsungs/ 'di gal che ba'i rgyu mtshan mang po spyan snga bas gsungs pas glang thang pas phyag mdzad de/ bdag dus 'di nas bzung ste/ byams snying rje 'ba' zhig bsgom par zhu zhus pas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen pas dbu zhwa phud/ thal mo spyi bor sbyar nas/ shin tu cha yang bzang lags/ zhes lan gsum gsungs/ myur lam las tshe 'di la 'dzam bu gling tsam la byams pa bsgoms na/ de la dbang ba'i 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur/ gling gnyis pa la skyes na/ de la dbang ba'i zangs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur/ gsum pa la skyes na de la dbang ba'i dngul gye 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur/ gling bzhi pa la sgyes na de la dbang ba'i gser gye 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur/ stong gsum la sgyes na lha'i dbang po tshangs par 'gyur/stong chung dang stong gnyis pa dang bar ma la sgyes na de la dbang ba'i bdag por 'gyur/ nam mkha'i mthas khyab pa'i sems can la skyes na/ de'i 'bras bu rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas min pa gzhan du mi 'gyur gsungs/ rgyal sras rin po che'i byams pa'i shugs kyis drung na 'khod pa'i bya dang ri dwags gcan gzan 363

kun kyang gcig la gcig phan tshun gnod pa med cing byams/slob ma rnams kyang khong nga kho na la mnyes shing byams snyam du thams cad de ltar du sems shing / de rnams kyang gcig la gcig mthong che zhing byams pas/ phan tshun che mi rtsod par gral 'og tu sdod pa la hab thob byed cing gcig la gcig snyan par smra'o/ /gsungs/ yang mkhar sngon bya ba'i sde'i phyug po zhig gis dge rtsa byed pa'i dus/ khro zangs chen por ja bskol yod pa'i nang du bu chung lo brgyad tsam zhig lon pa lhung song ba bton tshe/sha kun tshos pa mas mthong ba dang / shas mi bzod pa'i snying rje drag po skyes te/ bu 'di lhung ba las mo lhung rung bzod zer/gdong la spar shad byas/ mgo sa la brdabs nas khrag byung tshe gzhan gyis re zhig bar du bzung nas sdod dgos byung / de bzhin du rgya nang na rgya mi phal cher gyis phag pa ma shi gong du chu khol ma'i nang du 'tshod pa dang phag phrug dang khyim bya rnams rdza khog nang du bcug nas 'og nas me sbar nas gson sreg byed pa dang / bal po na/ khyo ga shi na ro dang lhan du bud med kyang me nang du bcug nas gson sreg byed pa dang / gzhan yang nag can mi la khrims gcod pa dang chu dang me dang g.yang du lhung nas shi ba mthong thos rnams yid la dran par byas nas sdug 364

bsngal gyis mnar bas nyam thag pha ma sems can la shas mi bzod pa'i snying rje chen po bskyed par bya'o/ /sngon mtshungs med bzod pa rgya mtsho lho kha'i phyogs su gnas skor du phebs pa'i nyin gcig sha ba zhig rngon pa gnyis dang khye zhig gis ded nas/ chu brag 'thab pa'i bar du bcug tshe 'gro sa ma rnyed par srog dang 'bral ba shes/ rngon pa gnyis la phyi mig lta bzhin blos ma tshugs/ 'jigs pa'i chu nang du bros dus der khyes rmugs rngon pas rdo yis brgyab nas gsod pa'i dus/ snying rje tshad med pa skyes nas spyan chab shor zhing sha ba la phan pa'i 'pho ba dang smon lam rgyas par mdzad skad/ de bzhin sdig can rnams kyis bya dang ri dwags nya sogs sems can gzhan gsod pa rnams la dmigs nas snying rje mchi ma 'khrug nus pa tsam bskyed dgos/ rje btsun mi la ras pa dbyar sos shig thang chen po dpal thang du byon pas/ khye zhig shi ba'i ro la 'bu mang po byung 'dug pa gzigs nas snying rje chen po rgyud la 'khrungs nas/ khyi ro de'i 'gram du thugs gtad nas zhag drug bzhugs/ khye de'i rnam par shes pa mtho ris su drangs/ 'bu rnams la las kyi 'brel ba bzhag gsungs/ yang gnya' nang tshong 'dus su phebs pas mon pa zhig gis lug nag po zhig la 365

khong lag btang bas/ rma bzos tsam na rgyu ma na ra ra lug shor te/ 'jigs nas skad chen po 'don zhing 'dar khri le ba'i ngang la rje btsun yab sras la skyabs 'tshol du byung nas lug tshe'i 'du byed pa'i bar la/ rje btsun gyis spyan chab bsil zhing lug la 'pho ba mdzad nas/ rnam shes byang chub lam la bkod de snying rje chen po mi bzod pa'i ngang nas/ e ma 'khor ba'i sems can rnams/ /thar pa'i lam la yar ltos dang / /a tsa ma sdig can snying re rje/ /la sogs pa'i mgur gnang / de bzhin du 'o skol rnams kyis kyang ra lug g.yag gsum gsod sar song nas mig nas mchi ma ma byung gi bar du snying rje bsgom dgos/ sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi sprul pa paṇa chen rin po che'i zhal nas/thog mar shan pas gsod bzhin pa'i lug lta bu'i sdug bsngal gyis nyam thag pa'i 'gro ba la bsgoms/ de'i tshul ni/ mdun du de'i rnam pa gsal bar dmigs nas/ yan lag rnams ni bcings/ brang gi pags pa ni gshags/ shan pa'i lag pa khong bar bcug pas/ srog la babs pa ni mngon sum du shes/ mig shan pa'i gdong la trig hrig blta zhing sdug bsngal gyis nyam thag pa'i tshul bsams nas/ des na sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gye rgyu thams cad dang bral na ci ma rung / sdug bsngal 366

dang sdug bsngal gye rgyu thams cad dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gye rgyu thams cad dang bral bar bya'o/ /zhes snying rje sgom tshul gsal bar gsungs pa ltar yang dang yang du bsgom par bya'o/ /dper na ma sgo ru song shul nas bu thab kha'i me nang du lhung nas rkang lag tshig rgyu ma lug pa mthong tshe/ bzod glags med pa'i snying rje shas mi bzod pa skye ba ltar/nag can gyi mi btson dong du chud pa dang / sdig can gye mi dmyal ba'i me dong du lhung ba sogs sdug bsngal gyes nyam thag pa thams cad yang yang yid la dran par byas te/ de dag sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gye rgyu dang bral na ci ma rung / sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gye rgyu dang bral ba zhig bdag gis bya'o/ /de ltar byed nus par bla ma lhas byen gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba 'debs bzhin snying rje shugs drag la rgyun ring ba bsgom par bya'o/ /rgyal sras rin po che dgung lo bcu drug tsam lon dus su/dge bshes gcig gis bang chen pa la btang bas/ bo dong nas sa skyar 'byon pa'i phyed lam sleb pa'i thang dkyil gcig na khye'i phru gu bzhi lnga zhig skyes pa mas bor nas song 'dug pa 367

gzigs pas snying rje nas bshums shing / 'khyag pa dang / pho rog gcan gzan gyis gsod kyis dogs de ring 'di ba bskyal la do nub mtshan bskyang la 'gro dgos dgongs/ khye gu nang du skyel ba log nas byon gsungs/ yang dgung lo nyi shu tsam la/e'i dge 'dun rnams chos gzhi la btegs pas rgya sgo'i rtsa na sprang mo zha ba zhig yod pa de ngu yin 'dug pa la thugs kyis ma bzod nas ci nyes dris pas/ btsun pa thams cad 'byon par 'dug de nas nga la lto ster mi mi 'ong zer/ ngas khyod len du 'ong gis duḥ kha ma byed gsungs te thag pa khyer nas byon te sngon la gos gdan bskyal/ de nas mo rang khur nas chos pas e'i rar bskyal gsungs/ des na sems can dngos su duḥ kha ba mthong na lta smos kyang ci 'tshal/ gzhan gyis sems can duḥ kha ba 'di 'dra 'dug zer ba gsan na/ nga'i ma rgan snying re rje gsungs te/ bshums nas gsung gleng yang 'phro chad nas 'gro zhing / glang ri thang pa la gzhan gyis ngo nag po byas pa gsan pas/ ngas ma rgan sems can rnams kyi duḥ kha 'di la bsam tsa na ngo gdong dkar po yod pa mi 'dug gsungs zer/de khong mad par gda' gsungs nas sbyan chab nyil nyil mdzad cing 'di ltar yang gsungs so/ /duḥ khas mang gzir 'gro 'di 368

yal bor nas/ /rang nyid zhi bde 'ba' zhig don gnyer ba/ /pha ma me yis tshig pa yal bor nas/ /rang nyid bsil ba'i dzing bur khrus byed 'dra/ /'gro 'dis rang gi bde ba yal bor nas/ /bdag gi don du kha khur gang blangs pa/ /sa dang rgya mtsho'i rdul bas ches mang na/ /de dag bdag gis ji ltar yal bar 'dor/ /thog med dus nas lan mang phan btags pa'i/ /'gro mang bzod dka'i sdug bsngal gyes gzir ba/ /mthong thos dran yang gas par ma gyur pa/ /bdag gi snying 'di lcags las byas sam ci/ /sngon chad yang yang duḥ kha sel byed ma/ /mnar med me yi nang du tshig gyur pa/ /de la snying rje'i bsam pa mi skye ba/ /bdag 'dra mi yi lus can dud 'gror zad/ /ces gsungs shing / snying rje'i nyams byung rgyal du btang na nyin mtshan khor yug tu de nyid la rtse gcig tu 'byams nas phyi rol pas bltas na brgyal bar mngon pa ltar yong gin 'dug gsungs/ gzhan yang 'di ltar gsungs te/ ngan song gsum da a cang che/ mi'i nang nas kyang duḥ kha la dngos su spyod pa 'di rnams snying shin tu rje mod bsam blo legs par btang na duḥ kha yi rgyu la longs spyod pa 'di rnams snying rje gsungs shing / da lta 'jig rten gyi mi che ru re/ grung du re/ 'khor mang kha drag nor che las su sdig pa 'ba' 369

zhig byed pa de 'dra rnams gzigs pa'am/ dran pa'am/ de dag gi gleng mo byung tsa na spyan chab 'byen zhing / pha rol po rnam rtog skyer 'ong bsam pa byung nas nyams snang bskyal gyin tshod bzung ba min na/ de 'dra rnams dang phrad tsa na mchi ma rang dbang med par yong gin 'dug gsungs/ dge bshes ston pa'i drung du/ kham pa lung pa'i slob ma btsun pa zhig byung ba la ston pa'i zhal nas/ kham pa lung pa khos ci mdzad kyin 'dug gsungs pas/ khong ba grog kha rer bzhugs dbu btums te bshum pa 'ba' zhig mdzad kyin gda' zhus pas/ ston pas dbu zhwa phud/thugs gar thal mo sbyar/ spyan chab mang po phyung nas shin tu ngo mtshar che/ chos bya ba khong gis byas pa yin/ 'di'i yon tan mang po bshad rgyu yod de/ da lta bshad na khong mi mnyes par 'dug gsungs par gda'/ des na jo bo bka' brgyud rnams kyang thugs dam gye gtso bor 'di la mdzad par gda' gsungs/de yang snying rje chen po ni/ theg pa chen po'i lam gye rtsa bar med mi rung yin te/ rnam snang mngon byang las/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes de ni snying rje'i rtsa ba las 'byung ba yin/zhes dang / blo gros mi zad par bstan pa las/ btsun pa shā ra 370

dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi snying rje chen bo mi zad do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na sngon du 'gro ba'i phyir ro/ /btsun pa shā ra dwa ti'i bu 'di lta ste/ dper na dbugs phyi nang du rgyu ba ni mi'i srog gi dbang po'i sngon du 'gro ba yin no/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' snying rje chen po ni theg pa chen po yang dag par sgrub pa'i sngon du 'gro ba yin no/ /zhes dang /gā ya go ri las kyang / 'jam dpal byang chub rnams kyi spyod pa'i rtsom pa ni gang / gnas ni gang / 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi spyod pa'i rtsom pa ni snying rje chen po'o/ /gnas ni sems can no/ /zhes dang / chos yang dag par sdud pa las kyang / bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' chos rab tu mang po la bslab par mi bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' chos gcig rab tu bzung zhing rab tu rtog par bgyes na/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad de'i lag mthil na mchis pa lags so/ /chos gcig po gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ snying rje chen po'o/ /bcom ldan 'das snying rje chen pos ni sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lag mthil du mchis pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das dper bgyi na/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal 371

po'i 'khor lo rin po che de gang du mchis pa der dpung gi tshogs thams cad mchi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i snying rje chen po gang du mchis pa der sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad mchi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das dper bgye na srog gi dbang po mchis na/ dbang po gzhan rnams kyang mchi bar 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin du snying rje chen po mchis na byang chub sems dpa'i chos gzhan rnams kyang 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / slob dpon zla ba grags pas kyang /gang phyir brtse nyid rgyal po'i lo tog phun tshogs 'di'i/ /sa bon dang ni spel la chu 'dra yun ring du/ /longs spyod gnas la smin pa lta bur 'dod gyur pa/ /de phyir bdag gis thog mar snying rje bstod par bgyi/ /zhes snying rje chen pos sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang sgrub pa la thog mtha' bar gsum du gal che ba med mi rung du gsungs so/ /des na slob dpon ka ma la shī la'i zhal nas/ snying rje ni ting nge 'dzin la 'dug kyang rung / spyod lam thams cad du yang rung ste/ dus thams cad du sems can thams cad la bsgom par bya'o/ /gsungs pa ltar sgom pa la brtson par bya'o/ /de ltar byams pa dang snying rje chen po yang yang bskyed nas/bdag pas gzhan gces kyi blos bdag cag gi ston pa thugs 372

rje can gyi skyes rabs rnam par thar pa ltar 'gro ba gzhan don la lus dang srog la mi lta bar 'jug dgos te/ sngon thub pa'i dbang po 'di rgyal po padma bya bar 'khrungs/ dus gcig gi tshe khong gi mnga' ris su nad yams chen po byung nas mi mang po shi bas/ rgyal pos sman pa rnams bos te/ 'di la ci phan dris pas/de dag na re/ nya ro hi ta'i sha yod na phan/ gzhan gang phan nad kyi grib kyis rmugs nas mi shes par 'dug zhus pas/ rgyal pos dus bzang la bab pa'i snga dro khrus byas gos gsar ba gyon/gso sbyong blangs/ dkon mchog la mchod pa rgya chen po phul/gsol ba drag po btab nas/ bdag shi ma thag chu klung zlog byed du nya ro hi tar sgye bar gyur cig ces smon lam btab ste/ khang bzang khru stong pa'i kha nas mchongs so/ /de ma thag tu chu der nya der brdzus te sgyes so/ /de nas mi'i skad du/ nya ro hi ta yin pas/ nga'i sha longs la zo zhig ces smras pas/ thams cad kyis sha blangs te gzhogs gcig gi sha zad tsa na gzhogs bsgyur cing bcad pas/ gcig zos tsa na gcig gi sha sgyes te/ de ltar gzhogs res mos kyis zos pas nad thams cad la phan no/ /der mi rnams la/ khyed kyi don du ngas 'di ltar byas so zhes sngar gye lo rgyus gsungs te/ nged kyi drin lan du sdig pa spongs 373

la dge ba ci nus sgrubs shig gsungs pas/ de dag gis kyang bka' bzhin sgrub bo/ /de nas bzung ste de dag ngan 'gro log par ma lhung ngo gsungs/yang thub pa 'di nyid rus sbal chen po zhig tu 'khrungs pa'i dus su/ tshong pa lnga brgya rgya mtshor phyin pas gru zhig ste 'chi ba la thug pa la/ rus sbal gyes mi'i skad du/ thams cad nga la zhon cig ngas bsgral gyis gsungs nas/ rgya mtsho las bsgral bas thang chad de mtsho mthar gnyid pas/ sbrang bu ke ta ka brgyad khris khong gi khrag bzhibs pas/ gnyid sad de bltas pas sbrang bu mang po 'dug chur phyin pa'am sa la 'gres na/ sbrang bu mang po 'chi bar 'dug dgongs/ de ga la bzhugs te sku tshe btang bas/ sangs rgyas pa'i dus su sbrang bu rnams lha brgyad khrir gyur nas/ sangs rgyas la chos nyan pas/ de dag gis bden pa mthong bar gsungs/ yang rgyal po gser gyi gtsug tor gye sras/gtsug na nor bu zhes bya bar gyur tshe/ dbu la rin po che'i gtsug tor yod pa las/ bdud rtsi 'bab cing / de lcags la reg pas lcags rnams gser du bsgyur nus pa de bram ze slong mkhan zhig la bcad nas sbyin pa dang / rgyal po byams pa'i stobs su gyur tshe/ gnod sbyin spun lnga la sku lus kyi khrag gi sbyin 374

pa btang ba dang / rgyal bu snying stobs chen por gyur pa'i tshe stag mo la sku lus sbyin pa dang / rgyal bu zla 'od du gyur tshe bram ze la dbu bcad nas sbyin pa sogs slob pa lam gyi dus su rang yal bar dor gzhan gces par bzung nas/ gzhan don mdzad mdzad nas sangs rgyas pa ltar/ rang gis kyang tshe rabs thams cad du bdag pas gzhan gces kyi blos lus srog longs spyod thams cad phangs pa med par btang nas/ mar gyur 'gro ba'i don kho na la 'bad par bya'o snyam pa'i dam bca' yid smon yang yang bya'o/ /sgyes bu chen po'i rnam rtog brgyad ni/bdag gis nam zhig sems can gyi duḥ kha sel bar nus snyam nga/ dang / nam zhig dbul bas nyen pa'i sems can rnams 'byor pa chen po la 'jog nus snyam pa dang / nam zhig sha khrag dang bcas pa'i lus kyis sems can gye don nus snyam pa dang /nam zhig dmyal bar yun ring du gnas nas kyang sems can la phan 'dogs snyam pa dang / nam zhig 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i 'byor pa chen pos sems can gyi bsam pa rdzogs par byed nus snyam pa dang / nam zhig sangs rgyas su gyur nas sems can gye duḥ kha nges par 'byen nus snyam pa dang / sems can la mi phan pa'i sgye ba dang / don dam pa'i ro 375

la gcig tu spyod pa dang / skye bo thams cad la sem par mi byed pa'i tshig dang / gzhan la mi phan pa'i 'tsho ba dang / lus dang shes rab dang nor dang dbang phyug dang ldan pa dang / gzhan la gnod pa byed pa la dga' bar tshe rabs thams cad du ma gyur cig snyam pa dang / sems can gye sdig pa'i 'bras bu bdag la smin zhing / bdag gi bde ba'i 'bras bu de dag la smin par gyur cig snyam pa rnams so/ /ngo bo rnam rtog yin kyang ngo mtshar can yin pas sgyes bu chen po rnams kyang bsgom par gsungs na/ 'o skol rnams kyis lta ci smos/ des na 'di la nan tan byed pa gces so/ /sngon bdag cag gi ston pa 'di mdza' bo'i bu mo ru gyur tshe/rgya mtshor rin chen len du chas pas mas sgo bcad nas nyal te 'gror ma bcug pa la khros nas ma'i mgo rkang pas phul nas phyi'i rgya mtshor song dus gru zhig shing tshal zhig la 'jus nas rgya mtsho'i gling zhig tu slebs/ lcags khang zhig gi nang du phyin pas mi gcig gi mgo la lcags kyi 'khor lo bskor nas klad pa'i dkyil du 'bug gin 'dug 'dis ci byas pa yin dris pas ma'i mgo la bgoms pa'i rnam smin yin zer/ 'o na nga yang las kyis 'dir khrid snyam pa dang / de ma thag lcags kyi 'khor lo de 376

mgo thog tu byung nas 'khor te/ sdug bsngal gyis gzir tshe des rkyen byas sems can la snying rje drag po skyes te/ ngas sems can gye phyir du 'khor lo 'di bzod par bya yis/ gzhan gang gis 'di 'dra'i las byas pa rnams 'dir ma 'ong zhig byas pas/'khor lo nam mkha' la 'phags nas 'dug pa dang / shi 'phos nas dga' ldan du skyes so/ /yang sngon de bzhin gshegs pa dmyal ba'i shing rta 'dren pa'i gyad du gyur tshe/ shing rta drang ba'i rogs gzhan zhig yod pas 'dren ma nus tshe/ dmyal srung rnams kyis brdungs pa la snying rje skyes nas/ 'di'i thag pa yang nga'i gnya' bar thogs dang / bdag gcig pus drang bar bya'o byas pas/ dmyal srung na re/ khyod snying rje che ba zhig yod zer/lcags kyi tho ba mgo la brgyab pas/ khong tshe 'phos nas lhar skyes so/ /des na myur du mtho ris lha'i gnas su skye 'dod rnams kyis kyang / bdag pas gzhan gces kyi byang chub kyi sems la bslab par bya'o/ /yang sngon mi nag mdung thung can gyis tshong pa lnga brgya gsod pa'i bsam ngan skyes pa na/ ded dpon snying rje can gye bsam pa la/ mi lnga brgya'i srog dang bral ba byung na/ de rnams snying rje/ de'i las dbang gis mi 'di dmyal bar skye nges pas 'di yang snying re rje/ de bas bdag gis 377

mi 'di'i srog phral nas nga rang gcig pu dmyal bar 'gro bar bya'o snyam nas/ mi de kho rang gis mdung bsnun nas bsad pas/snying rje chen po'i dbang gis bskal pa 'bum gye 'khor ba phyir bsnyil/ tshogs rdzogs par gsungs/ sngon bram ze khye'u skar ma'i tshe/ lo bzhi khri bzhi stong du tshangs par spyad nas bzhugs tshe/ bu mo zhig chags pa'i dbang gis srog 'chad du nye bar gzigs nas/ snying rje chen po sgyes te khyem du lo bcu gnyis gnas nas yang khyem nas byung ste/ tshangs par spyad pas bskal pa khri'i 'khor ba phyir bsnyil te tshogs rdzogs par gsungs/ des na srog bcad pa dang mi tshangs spyad pa la sogs pa'i sdig pas mi gos par 'dod pas kyang / bdag pas gzhan gces kyi byang chub kyi sems la bslab par bya'o/ /sngon 'phags pa thogs med kyis rje btsun byams pa bsgrubs pas nyin gcig lam nas khye mo ro smad 'bus g.yeng ba zhig gzigs pas/ shas mi bzod pa'i snying rje chen po sgyes/ brla sha bcad pa'i steng du 'bu rnams lces len rtsis byas pas las sgrib kun dag nas/ rgyal ba byams mgon zhal mjal/ bla ma rnyarma rakṣi tas bdag gzhan mnyam brjes kyi byang chub kyi sems shugs drag pos brla'i sha bcad de nad pa zhig la phan pa'i phyir du byen pas/ thugs rje chen 378

po'i zhal gzigs shing byen gyis brlabs/ bla ma byams pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ bdag gzhan mnyam brjes byang chub kyi sems 'ba' zhig bsgoms pas/ byams mgon zhal gzigs lung bstan thob/ jo bo rjes bdag pas gzhan gces kyi byang chub kyi sems rin bo che thugs dam gyi mthil du mdzad pas/ rje btsun sgol ma la sogs lhag pa'i lha mang po'i zhal gzigs shing rgya bod gnyis su 'gro don rgya chen po byung / des na yi dam lha'i zhal mthong 'dod pa dang / gdul bya 'gro don che bar 'dod pas kyang / bdag pas gzhan gces kyi byang chub kyi sems la bslab par bya'o/ /rje btsun byams pa mgon po rgyal po gser mdog ces bya bar gyur pa'i tshe/ de bzhin gshegs pa gser bzang 'od kyi drung nas thugs bskyed/ de nas bskal pa brgyad khri bzhi stong lon nas/ thub pa'i dbang po rdza mkhan gye khye'u snang byed du gyur pa'i tshe/ de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub chen gyi drung du thugs bsgyed par gsungs/ thugs bsgyed pa la byams mgon snga yang 'tshang rgya ba la thub pa'i dbang po snga ba ni bdag pas gzhan gces pa'i byang chub kyi sems rin po che 'di ches shugs drag tu bsgyed pa'i mthu yin par gsungs/ des na myur du mngon 379

par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par 'dod pas kyang / bdag pas gzhan gces kye byang chub kyi sems rin po che la bslab par bya'o/ /de ltar byams pa dang snying rje bdag pas gzhan gces kyi byang chub sems kyis kun nas bslangs te/ lus dang longs spyod dge tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad blo yis blangs nas ma sems can thams cad la gtong ba'i tshul ni/ sdong po bkod pa'i mdo las/ bdag nyid 'gro ba thams cad kyi nye bar 'tsho ba'i yid bzhin gye lus su bsgyur/ zhes dang / rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi mdo las/ 'byung ba chen po bzhi ni sgo sna tshogs tshul sna tshogs nas/ sems can thams cad kyi nye bar 'tsho ba de bzhin du/ byang chub sems dpa'i bdag nyid kyi lus kyang sems can thams cad kyi nye bar 'tsho ba'i gzhir bsgyur zhes dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sa las/ byang chub sems dpa' dben par song ste/ yid nang du bsdus nas bsam pa dag cing snying thag pa nas/ dad pas kun tu rtogs pa dag gis/ sbyin par bya ba'i chos rnam pa sna tshogs pa rgya chen po dpag tu med pa dag mos shing sems can rnams la sbyin pa dag stob par byed de/ des byang chub sems dpa' tshegs chung ngus tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /de ni byang chub sems dpa' shes rab 380

dang ldan pa'i sbyin pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gang la gang 'dod kyi rnam par blos sprul nas gtong ba yin/ de la dang po lus gtong ba'i dmigs pa ni/ yongs 'dzin rin po che'i zhal nas/ rang gi lus yid bzhin gyi lus kyi rnam par bsam la/thog mar tshe 'di'i ma gsal btab ste/ de la byams pa dang snying rjes kun nas bslangs te/ rang gi lus rang 'dod la ltos pa med par ma la btang bas/ lus de las gang la gang 'dod kyi dngos po thams cad byung nas/ ma rgan de'i lus kyi nyes skyon thams cad dag nas mtho ris kyi yon tan bdun dang ldan pa'i lus phun sum tshogs pa/ nad la sogs pa'i skyon rnam pa kun nas med cing / lha'i lus lta bur bzang zhing yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa zhig tu gyur/ lus de la dgos pa'i longs spyod thams cad kyang bsam pa bzhin du grub ste chos bsgrub pa'i phyi nang gi mthun rkyen thams cad tshang / sems rgyud la byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems phyin drug bsdu bzhi la sogs pa lam thams cad rdzogs te/ lus gzugs kyi sku dang sems chos sku'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsam mo/ /de nas rang gi pha la yang dmigs nas de bzhin du sbyar te gtong ba'i sems bsgoms/ de nas nye 'brel gzhan rnams la de bzhin du 381

bsgoms/ de nas rang gi nye 'khor gyi sems can rnams la de bzhin du bsgoms/ de nas rim gyes rgya je cher btang ste 'dzam bu'i gling gi sems can rnams dang / gling bzhi'i sems can rnams dang / de nas stong dang po/ de nas stong gnyis pa/ de nas stong gsum pa/ mthar sems can thams cad la dmigs pa gong bzhin byas la gtong ba bsgoms/yang res 'ga' dmyal ba mnar med nas bzung ste rim gyis sems can thams cad la lus gtong ba'i dmigs pa sbyongs/ de'i tshul ni/ rang gi lus yid kyi rnam pa las lus dpag tu med pa sems can gyi grangs dang mnyam pa sprul nas/yang sos la sogs pa'i tsha dmyal brgyad/ chu bur can la sogs pa'i grang dmyal brgyad/ nyi tshe ba dang nye 'khor ba'i sems can dmyal ba ji snyed yod pa rnams la btang bas/ de thams cad gser 'gyur gye rtsis lcags gser du byed pa ltar skad cig la dmyal ba'i lus 'gyur nas/ 'phags pa'i nor bdun gyes phyug pa'i mtho ris yon tan bdun ldan gyi dal 'byor gyi lus sha stag thob par bsam mo/ /yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che las zas gos sogs gang la ci 'dod par 'byung ba ltar yid bzhin gyis lus las dmigs yul de dag la kha zas ro brgya ba/382

gos stong phrag brgya ba/khang pa brtsegs pa lnga brgya ba dang / smon lam gcig tu byas pa'i grogs phun sum tshogs pa ste/ gang gis longs spyod pa'i rten/ yul gang la longs spyod pa'i longs spyod/gang lhan cig longs spyod pa'i 'khor phun sum tshogs pa rnams thob cing / de thams cad kyang theg pa chen po dam pa'i chos sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen du gyur par bsam mo/ /de bzhin du phyi'i rkyen gtso bo jeg pa chen po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen mtshan nyid dang ldan pas dgyes bzhin du rjes su 'dzin pa/gang la thos bsam bya ba'i gzhi mdo sngags kyi gsung rab la sogs phyi'i rkyen rnams dang / nang gi rkyen dad pa sogs 'phags pa'i nor bdun/ dbang po lnga/ stobs lnga dzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi byang chub kyi yan lag bdun/ 'phags lam yan lag brgyad/ lam bslab pa rin po che gsum/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems rgyud la sgyes te spyod pa pha rol tu phyin pa drug spyad pas/ tshogs gnyis mthar phyin te sangs rgyas nas thams cad kyang sems rgyud chos sku'i bde ba dang ldan par bsam mo/ /de bzhin du phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas mu med pa na/ yi dwags kyi rigs sum cu so drug gis bsdus pa'i sems can ji snyed yod pa rnams la lus 383

btang bas/ sngar bzhin de dag so so'i lus sems kyi nyes skyon dang gdung ba rnams zhi zhing sgrib gnyis dag ste/ sangs rgyas nas chos sku'i bde ba dang ldan par bsam mo/ /de bzhin du 'jig rten gye khams na dud 'gro bying na gnas pa rnams dang kha thor ba rnams la btang bas/ de dag so so'i lus sems kyi nyes skyon dang gdung ba rnams zhi zhing sgrib gnyis dag ste/sangs rgyas nas chos sku'i bde ba dang ldan par bsam mo de bzhin du phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na gling bzhi gling phran brgyad na mi khom pa'i skye gnas su song ba'i mi'i 'gro ba dang / gzhan yang tshe de la thar lam bsgrub pa'i skal ba med pa rnams la lus btang bas/ sngar bzhin de dag so so'i lus sems kyi nyes skyon dang gdung ba rnams zhi zhing sgrib gnyis dag ste/ sangs rgyas nas chos sku'i bde ba dang ldan par bsam mo/ /tshe de la thar lam skye ba'i skal ba dang ldan pa'i mi rnams la lus btang bas/ lam bsgrub pa'i phyi'i rkyen rnams dang nang gi bsam pa'i rkyen thams cad tshang nas sngar ltar sangs rgyas par bsam mo/ /de bzhin du rgyal chen rigs bzhi la sogs pa'i 'dod lha rigs drug tshangs ris nas 'bras bu che ba'i bar gye gzugs khams gnas rigs bcu bdun/ gzugs med skye 384

mched mu bzhi na gnas pa'i sems can re re la'ang lus tshang ba re re btang bas/ sngar bzhin de dag so so'i nyes skyon dang sgrib gnyis dag nas rim gyes sangs rgyas par bsam/ srid pa bar ma do na gnas pa'i sems can rnams la btang bas de dag so so'i lus sems kyi nyes skyon dang gdung ba rnams zhi zhing sgrib gnyis dag ste/ sangs rgyas nas chos sku'i bde ba dang ldan par bsam mo/ /yang res 'ga' ni shar la sogs pa phyogs mtshams kyis phye ba'i sems can rnams la rim gyes gtang bar bya ste/ 'di ltar shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gye khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed na sems can ji snyed yod pa rnams la lus btang la rim gyis sngar bzhin sangs rgyas par bsam/ de bzhin du phyogs mtshams lhag ma rnams la'ang 'dra bar shes par bya'o/ /de ltar sems can la rang gi lus gtong ba'i tshul sgo sna tshogs nas sbyang ste res 'ga' rang gi lus dpag tu med pa sprul nas sems can re re la'ang btang bas gang la gang 'dod kyis tshim par bsam/ res 'ga' lus gcig pu 'di las gang la gang 'dod kyi dngos po dpag tu med pa sprul nas sems can rnams la gtong / de ltar sems can tha mal pa rnams la lus gtong ba'i dmigs pa sbyangs nas lam zhugs kyi 385

gang zag rnams la rang gis lus gtong ba'i tshul ni/ theg pa dman pa'i gang zag rnams la rang gi lus yid bzhin gye lus kyi rnam par bsgyur nas re re la lus re re phul bas/ theg dman gye lam du zhugs pa'i nyan rang de rnams kyi nyes skyon thams cad skad cig la dag nas/ sku lus gzugs kyi sgur gyur/thugs rgyud kyi sgrib pa dang gnas ngan len thams cad skad cig la dag theg pa chen po'i sa lam rdzogs te thugs chos kyi sgur gyur par bsam/ de bzhin du theg pa chen po'i tshogs lam nas sa bcu ba'i bar gyi byang chub sems dpa' rnams la rang gi lus yid bzhin gye lus kyi rnam par blos sprul nas phul bas/sems dpa' chen po de dag gi sku lus dang thugs rgyud la nyes skyon phra mo yod pa thams cad dag tshogs gnyis myur du rdzogs te/ sku mtshan dpes spras pa'i gzugs sku dang / thugs chos sgur gyur par bsam mo/ /de nas rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dam pa rnams dang / phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas mu med pa na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la sngar bzhin du rang gi lus yid bzhin gyi lus kyi rnam pa dpag tu med par bsams te phul bas/ de dag re re'i drung du'ang lus du mar sprul/ lus re re la mgo dpag tu med pa dang /386

mgo re re la lce dpag tu med par blos sprul te/ rgyu dang 'bras bu'i yon tan las brtsams te ngag gis bstod dbyangs brjod pa dang / yid kyis dad pa bsgom zhing lus kyis phyag 'tshal ba dang / yid bzhin gye lus las mchod pa'i tshogs rab 'byams bsam gyes mi khyab pa byung bar bsams te phul bas/ de rnams kyis thugs rgyud la zag pa med pa'i bde ba chen po 'khrungs par bsam zhing / phyogs bcu'i zhing na mchog gi sprul pa'i sku mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul ston du nye ba rnams la/ rang gi lus sngar ltar phul zhing gsol ba btab pas/ mya ngan las mi 'da' bar bskal pa'i bar du bzhugs nas chos 'khor bskor bar bsam/ rang gi bla ma dngos su bzhugs pa rnams la lus sngar bzhin phul bas/ sku tshe mdzad pa 'phrin las dang bcas pa rgya cher 'phel bar bsam mo/ /yang rang gi lus yid bzhin gyi lus kyi rnam pa dpag tu med par sprul nas snod kyi 'jig rten rnams la gtang bar bya ste/ de yang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gye khams mtha' yas mu med snod kyi zhing rnams la btang bas/snod kyi 'jig rten gye mi gtsang ba sdong dum tsher ma/ gyo mo/gseg ma/ ngam grog g.yang sa la sogs pa'i snod kyi skyon thams cad dag cing gnas 'gyur te/ 'jig rten gye khams thams 387

cad kyang rin po che sna tshogs kyi rang bzhin lag mthil ltar mnyam pa tha gru che ba/ yangs pa/ reg na 'jam zhing bde ba/ dri ma med cing 'od gsal ba tsan dan sbrul gyi snying po'i dri bsung dang ldan pa/ lha'i me tog sna tshogs gcal du bkram pa/ mtha' rin po che'i pha gu dang rtsig pa/ gser dang / dngul dang / mu tig gi phye ma gram bur bdal ba/ uta pa la dang / ku mu da dang /padma 'gying zhing ldem pas khebs pa/ chu bya sna tshogs skad snyan par sgrogs pa dga' zhing 'phyo la lding bas brgyan pa'i yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i mtsho dang / rdzing dang lteng ka dag gis mdzes par byas pa sogs dag pa'i zhing phun sum tshogs par gyur te/ sangs rgyas byang sems 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams la mchod pa'i sprin gye phung po chen po bsam gyes mi khyab par byung bar bsam zhing / zhing de dag na yod pa'i bcud kyi sems can rnams la de lta bu'i phun sum tshogs pa'i 'byor pa de dag nga rgyal dang rgyags pa dang dregs pa'i rkyen du skad cig kyang mi 'gro zhing / byang chub sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen sha stag tu gyur par bsams te/ 'di ni sangs rgyas kyi zhing sbyong du yang 'gyur bas gal che'o/ /de ltar lus gtong ba'i dmigs pa sbyangs nas/longs spyod gtong ba'i dmigs pa sbyong ba ni/ zas gos gnas 388

khang 'khor g.yog sogs gang la gang 'dod kyi longs spyod bsam gyis mi khyab pa blos sprul nas/ thog mar rang gi ma nas bzung / mthar sems can thams cad kyi bar gong bzhin btang bas/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i longs spyod bsam gyes mi khyab pa yul de dag re re la'ang cha tshang ba re byung zhing / de dag kyang tshogs rdzogs pa'i mthun rkyen sha stag tu gyur nas/ de'i rkyen gyis myur du tshogs rdzogs nas sangs rgyas par bsam/ de nas lam zhugs nyan rang rnams dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la longs spyod bsam gyis mi khyab par sprul te/sngar ltar 'bul ba'i dmigs pa byed/ de nas rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams dang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams la longs spyod bsam gyes mi khyab pa blos sprul nas 'bul zhing dmigs pa sngar ltar byed/ de nas dge rtsa gtong ba'i dmigs pa sbyong ba ni/ rang gis dus gsum du bsags pa dang gsog par 'gyur ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad dmigs yul du byas la/ tshe 'di'i ma nas bzung mthar sems can thams cad kyi bar la gtong tshul gong ltar byed/ de nas nyan rang rnams dang byang sems rnams dang / rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams dang sangs rgyas rnams la'ang gong ltar 'bul ba'i dmigs pa 389

sbyongs/ de ltar rang gi lus longs spyod dge rtsa rnams gzhan la gtong ba'i dmigs pa sbyong ba ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rmad du byung ba yin pas theg pa chen po'i mdo sde rnams su rgya cher bsngags shing / de'i nang nas kyang dge rtsa gtong ba 'di shin tu gal che bar gsungs/ de nas gzhan gyi sdug bsngal len pa la 'jugade yang gzhan gye sdug bsngal blangs nas mi mngon par byed pa'am/ rang gi phung po las logs su gzhan zhig tu 'jog pa lta bu min gyes/ rang gi snying gi nang du len pa yin pas/ ma rgan sems can gye rgyu kun 'byung dang 'bras bu sdug bsngal thams cad ma lus pa blangs te/ rang gi snying gi nang du gces 'dzin gnas pa'i mgo thog tu babs pa'i mos pa bya gsungs/de ltar mi 'dod pa mtha' dag bdag gces 'dzin gye thog tu spungs pas/ gces 'dzin 'gong po skad cig nyid la brlag par bsam/ len pa bsgom pa 'di'i skabs su yang sngar bshad pa ltar/ rang gi tshe 'di'i ma nas mthar sems can thams cad kyi bar rim gyes len/ yang res 'ga' dmyal ba pa rnams nas bzung rim gyis len te/ tsha dmyal ba rnams la lcags sreg gi sa gzhir mes sreg pa dang / mtshon gyis gtub pa dang / zangs 390

zhun khar ldug pa la sogs pa tsha ba'i sdug bsngal ji snyed cig yod pa rnams dang / grang dmyal ba rnams la lus 'khyag rom gyi sbubs su chud pa dang / grang bas nyen te lus dum bu stong du gas pa sogs grang ba'i sdug bsngal ji snyed cig yod pa rnams bsams te/ bzod glags med par snying rje bsgyed nas bdag gi ma rgan 'di rnams 'di ltar du nyam thag pa snying re rje/ sdug bsngal 'di thams cad bdag gis blang la 'di rnams da lta nyid du thar par bya'o snyam du snying rje dang lhag bsam shugs drag pos dmyal ba'i gnas kyi sdug bsngal thams cad rang gi phung po'i steng du blangs pas/ dmyal ba pa de dag thams cad sbug bsngal dang bral nyon mongs pa thams cad zhi/ lus gnas 'gyur te mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i lus su gyur/ sems chos skur gyur par bsams shing de ltar gyur na dga' ba'i 'dun pa drag po bya'o/ /de bzhin du yi dwags/ dud 'gro/ lha ma yin/mi'i 'gro ba/ 'dod lha rigs drug gzugs med kyi lha rnams la so so'i sdug bsngal ji ltar yod pa rnams bsam la/ sdug bsngal de dang de dag las myur du grol na ci ma rung snyam pa dang / sdug bsngal de dang de dag thams cad bdag gi phung po 'di'i steng du blangs nas/ de dag myur du thar par bya'o snyam du snying rje 391

dang lhag bsam shugs drag tu bskyed nas/ de dag gi sdig sdug rnams rang la blangs pas de dag sdig sdug thams cad dang bral nas/ sangs rgyas par bsams shing de ltar gyur na dga' ba'i 'dun pa drag po bya/ de nas nyan rang rnams kyi sku lus la yod pa'i nad dang rgas pa'i sdug bsngal la sogs pa rnams dang / thugs rgyud kyi gnas ngan len dang bag chags thams cad rang la blangs pas/ de dag gi sku lus skad cig la gnas 'gyur nas gzugs kyi sku dang / thugs chos kyi skur gyur nas sangs rgyas par bsam/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs rgyud la yod pa'i shes sgrib phra mo tshun chad rang gi rgyud la tshur blangs pas/ sems dpa' chen po de rnams skad cig la sangs rgyas par bsam/ de nas snod kyi 'jig rten gyi ngam grog dang g.yang sa la sogs pa/ las dbang gis byung ba'i skyon thams cad rang gi phung po 'di'i steng du blangs pas/ snod kyi nyes skyon thams cad dag nas dag pa'i zhing lta bur gyur par bsam gsungs/ mdor bsdu na rgyal sras rin po ches/ thog mar rang gi rtsa ba'i ma gsal bar dmigs te/ 'dis bdag lto ba na gnas pa nas bzung ste/ chud ma zos par bskyangs pas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang mjal zhing / lam sgrub tu byung bas shin 392

tu drin che/ tshe 'di kho nar ma zad kyis thog ma med pa nas/byams pa'i mig gis bltas/ brtse ba'i sems kyis bzung /gnod pa las bskyabs phan bde bsgrubs pas shin tu drin che/de ltar bdag gi don byed byed nas 'dis 'khor bar duḥ kha sna tshogs myong ba snying re rje snyam du yid la drag tu bsgom la/ da ni ngas kyang 'di la lan du phan gdags/ gnod pa bsal bar bya'o/ /'di la gang gis gnod na duḥ kha dang kun 'byung gnyis kyis gnod de duḥ kha dngos su gnod cing / kun 'byung gis brgyud nas gnod pas/ de gnyis ngas blang snyam du bsam la/ma'i rgyud na yod pa'i duḥ kha kun 'byung thams cad rang gi snying nang du byung bar bsgom zhing / byung na dga' ba'i 'dun pa drag tu bya'o/ /ma la cis phan na bde ba dang dge bas phan pas/bdag gi bde dge thams cad rang 'dod la ltos pa med par ma la btang bas/ ma de 'phral la bde zhing chos sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen thams cad 'dzoms nas/ 'phral la sangs rgya nus pa tsam du gyur par bsgom zhing / de ltar gyur na dga' ba'i 'dun pa drag tu bsgyed do/ /de bzhin du pha la sogs pa'ang bsgom ste/ mthar sems can thams cad la bsgom par bya'o/ /de yang 'di ltar sems 393

can thams cad kyang / thog ma med pa nas bdag gi pha mar gyur te/ phan dpag tu med pa btags pas drin shin tu che la/drin can de rnams 'khor bar duḥ kha sna tshogs kyis gtses pa la duḥ kha de dag dang bral na ci ma rung snyam pa'i snying rje drag tu bsgom la/ de dag gi duḥ kha bdag la thim zhing / bdag gi lus longs spyod dus gsum gyi dge ba rnams sems can la btang nas/ de dag bde dge 'phel bar bsam/ de ltar gyur na dga' ba'i 'dun pa drag tu bya'o/ /bdag gzhan brje ba'i blo de skye sla ba'i phyir/ rlung phar 'gro ba na de dang 'grogs nas bdag gi bde dge thams cad gzhan la song zhing / tshur 'ong ba na gzhan gyi sdig sdug thams cad bdag la byung bar sgoms gsungs/ yul yid du 'ong mi 'ong bar ma gsum la brten nas chags sdang rmongs gsum sgyes pa na/ bdag ltar yul gsum la brten nas dug gsum skyes pa'i sems can mang po yod pas/de rnams kyi dug gsum thams cad bdag la 'dus nas/ de rnams la chags sdang gti mug med pa'i dge ba gsum dang ldan par gyur cig snyam du bsgom mo/ /de la dran pa bskul phyir sems can rnams kyi sdig pa dang duḥ kha thams cad bdag la smin zhing / bdag gi bde ba dang dge ba thams cad sems can 394

thams cad la smin par gyur cig ces brjod cing 'dun pa drag tu bya'o/ /gzhan gyi duḥ kha len nus par bya ba'i phyir/bdag la ma 'ongs pa na 'byung ba'i duḥ kha rnams da lta blangs pas/ rgyud gzhan gye duḥ kha yang len nus par 'gyur ro zhes gang gsungs pa ltar bya'o/ /de ltar byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems la blo ma sbyangs na/ gzhan gang bsgoms kyang lam la sa chod chen po mi 'byung bas/ 'di rgyud la skye ba'i phyir du bskal pa du ma'i bar du 'bad dgos kyang 'bad par bya ste/ 'brom rin po ches rnal 'byor pa chen po la/ khyod la rna rtsar rnga bo che brdungs kyang mi zhig pa'i sgom yod kyang / byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems med na nyin mtshan du bshag pa bya dgos pa'i sar skye ba yin gsungs/ jo bo rjes byams pa dang snying rje sbyong mi shes pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bod kyis shes pa gsungs/ yang theg chen chos sgor 'jug 'dod pas/ /mun sel gdung ba zhi byed pa/ /nyi zla lta bu'i byang chub sems/ /bskal par 'bad pas sgye yang rung / /gsungs/ zhang sna chung ston pas jo bo la gdams ngag zhus kyang / 'jig rten blos thongs/ byang chub kyi sems bsgom bya ba zhig las mi 'ong byas pa la/ dge bshes ston pas khrel nas/ de jo bo'i gdams ngag gi mthil 395

phyung ba la gsung / rje rin po ches/ bskal pa du ma'i bar du rmad du byung ba'i mkhyen rab kyis ches phra bar byas te/ lam rnams la dpyad pa na 'di nyid 'tshang rgya ba'i thabs dam par rgyal ba sras bcas kyis gzigs gsungs/ dge bshes 'chad kha ba zhing gshegs khar snang srid kyi sgra gcig la blo sbyong gi sgra 'di las snyan pa med pas khyed kyis brjod dang gsungs/ des na byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems la blo sbyong tshul gyi chos skor 'di rnams thugs dam gyi mthil du bzung nas/ rang gis nyams su len cing gzhan la yang rgya cher bshad par bya'o/ /smras pa/ dbang phyug phun tshogs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yang / /dbang du bsdu na gzhan rnams smos ci dgos/ /dbang phyug brgyad ldan zla med bla ma yis/ /dbang dang byen rlabs dngos grub mtha' dag stsol/ /rang gi sems la goms 'dris yong phyir dang / /skal bzang slob ma gzhan la phan pa'i phyir/ /gal che dus su 'bum kyang brgya tshar re/ /sgog bzhin chos 'di yang yang bsgrag par bya/ /snang srid snod bcud chos rnams ma lus pa/ /rmi lam bzhin du snang stong sems kyi 'phrul/ /sems kyi gnas lugs gdod nas nam mkha' 'dra/ /stong gsal 'dzin med ngang la mnyam par zhog /thun mtshams rnams su rang 396

gzhan snod bcud kun/ /sgyu ma lta bur snang la rang bzhin gyis/ /grub pa rdul tsam med par shes byas nas/ /rgyal sras spyod pa gang la bslab par bya/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal myong ba'i sems can gyis/ /rang gi pha ma ma byas gcig kyang med/ /byas tshe tshe 'di'i ma bzhin drin che bas/ /pha ma 'di dag 'khor 'khyams snying re je/ /snyam du yid kyis bde dge gzhan la btang / /gzhan gyi sdug bsngal tshur la len par bya/ /yul snang yid du 'ong dang mi 'ong dang / /bar ma gsum la brten nas dug gsum po/ /sgyes dus 'di ltar gzhan la skyes tshad kun/ /rang la 'du bar gyur cig snyam du bsgom/ /'gro kun sdig dang sdug bsngal bdag la smin/ /bdag gi bde dge 'gro la smin gyur cig /snyam du brjod na de 'dra'i gtam snyan zhig /'jig rten khams na med pas brjod par rigs/ /zhes pa'ang skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o//gsum pa rkyen ngan byang chub kyi lam du bsgyur tshul ni/ rgyal sras rin po che'i zhal nas/ duḥ kha thams cad bdag 'dzin gyis bskyed pas/ bdag 'dzin la dgrar bltas te/ bdag med la bdag tu lta ba'i blo 'dis 'khor ba thog med nas da lta'i bar du/ duḥ kha thams cad bskyed cing mtho ba la phrag dog397

dma' ba la brnyas chos/ mnyam pa la 'gran sems thams cad 'di las byung zhing / bdag 'khor ba las mi thar pa dang / mi dang mi ma yin pas gnod pa la sogs pa duḥ kha thams cad 'dis byas pa yin te/ zhi ba lhas/ 'di yis brgya phrag thams cad du/ /'khor bar bdag la gnod pa byas/ /da ni 'khon rnams dran byas te/ /khyod kyis rang don sems pa gzhom/ /zhes gsungs pas bdag 'dzin nam byung tsa na/ brtag na bdag gang yang mi 'dug pa la/ ci'i phyir bdag tu 'dzin/ zhes bdag 'dzin nam skyes dus spangs te/ phyin chad bdag gces 'dzin mi sgye bar bya ba'i phyir 'bad par bya gsungs/ sha bo'i zhal nas/ da res kyi tshe thung 'di la 'gong po 'di ci thul zhig bya 'tshal gsungs/ dge bshes 'ban gyi zhal nas/ da ni sems kyi mkhar sgor gnyen po'i mdung thung zhig mnan la bsdad pa min pa gzhan bya rgyu med/ kho bsgrims na nga yang bsgrims/ kho glod na nga yang glod gsungs/ bdag 'dzin la dgrar bltas nas spong ba 'di la sha bo sgang ba'i zhal nas/ 'gong po 'gong rdzong gi chos zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar bdag 'dzin la dgrar bltas nas/ gzhan gces par 'dzin dgos tshul ni/ rgyal sras rin po ches/ spyir sems can thams cad thog ma med pa nas kyi 398

ma byas pa'i drin can yin pas/ sngar yang drin che la bla na med pa'i byang chub sgrub pa yang sems can la rag las te/ zhi ba lhas/ sems can rnams dang rgyal ba la/ /sangs rgyas chos 'grub 'dra ba la/ /rgyal la gus byed de bzhin du/ /sems can la min ci yi tshul/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i gang zag la/ sangs rgyas dang sems can mnyam pa'i tshod yin pas/ de ltar drin che ba'i sems can rnams la byams pa dang snying rje drag po bsgoms nas/ de dag gi duḥ kha bdag la blang zhing / bdag gi bde dge de rnams la sbyin par bya'o/ /khyad par du bdag la gnod pa byed pa'i mi'am mi ma yin pa byung na/gnod byed 'dis thog ma med pa nas bdag gi ma byas nas/rang gi sdig sdug gtam ngan la ma 'dzems par bdag gi don byed byed nas/ 'khor bar duḥ kha sna tshogs myong zhing / 'khrul ba'i stobs kyis sngon gyi nye du yin par ngo ma shes pa dang /bdag gi las ngan gyes bsgul nas/ 'dis bdag la gnod pa'i sdig pa byas pas phyis de'i 'bras bu duḥ kha myong bar 'gyur bas/ bdag la brten nas 'dis dus yun ring por duḥ kha myong zhing / myong bar 'dug pas snying re rje snyam du drag tu bsgom/ sngar ni ngas 'di la gnod pa 'ba' zhig byas 'dug399

da ni 'di'i gnod pa bsal zhing phan pa bsgrub par bya snyam du bsam la gtong len drag tu bsgoms/ khyad par mi'am khye lta bu yin na de la dngos su phan ci thogs la 'bad cing / gang ltar byas kyang dngos su phan gdags ma nus na bsam pas gnod byed 'di duḥ kha dang bral/ bde ba dang ldan sangs rgyas myur du 'thob par gyur cig snyam du zhe thag pa nas bsam zhing / ngag tu'ang brjod par bya'o/ /yang da phyin chad bdag gis dge ba ci byed thams cad 'di'i don du bya'o snyam pa'i sems bskyed par bya'o/ /paṇa chen shākya shrī'i rnam thar bzhi ni/ nyin gcig gi 'tsho ba las lhag ma bre gang yang rang don du mi 'dzin pa dang / nyin zhag phrugs gcig la chos spyod bcu kha tshang re mdzad pa dang /rkyen ngan ci byung yang stong pa nyid sgom pa ma gtogs bsrung ba gzhan mi byed pa dang / gnod pa byed pa'i lan du phan 'dogs pa dang bzhi yin pa las/ tha ma 'di dang chos rje rgod tshang ba'i thugs dam bcu gnyi sa kyi ya gyal gyi gnod byed la lan du phan 'dogs pa'i dam bca' mdzad pa sogs/ skyes bu chen po rnams kyis gnod lan la phan 'dogs pa phal che ba bsam pa'i sgo nas phan 'dogs pa yin la/ de yod na sbyor bas phan 'dogs pa 'bad med du 'byung ste/ byang chub sems 'grel 400

las/ gzhan don las la mthu med kyang / /de yi bsam pa rtag tu bya/ /gang la bsam pa de yod pa/ /de ni de la don gyis zhugs/ /zhes gsungs pas/ gnod byed la phan sems drag tu bya'o/ /'di yod na blo sbyong gi bslab bya dang / dam tshig kyang phal cher 'dir 'dus so gsungs/sngon bcom ldan 'das drang srong bzod pa can du gyur pa na/ rgyal po rtsod 'byung blon po bzhi dang bcas pas/ de'i yan lag bcad pa'i tshe/ khyed kyis da ltar nga'i yan lag bcad pas/ngas ma 'ongs pa'i dus na/ khyod kyi nyon mongs pa dang sdug bsngal thams cad gcad par bya'o/ /zhes dang / yang de la phyag dar gyi rdul gtor ba na/ khyed kyis nga la rdul gyes bgos pas ngas ma 'ongs pa na khyed kyi nyon mongs pa'i rdul bsal bar bya'o/ /zhes dam bcas pa dang / gzhan yang skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis gnod lan du phan 'dogs pa'i dam bca' mdzad pa'i rjes su slob par 'dod pas/ de ltar dam bca' zhing smon lam 'debs pa'i tshul ni/ rgyal sras rin po ches/ yan lag bdun pa sngon du btang nas/ sems rtse gcig pa'i sgo nas/mkhyen brtse nus pa phul du phyin pa'i mthus/ /'gro la phan par 'dod pa'i bsam pa'i don/ /ji ltar bsam bzhin 'grub 401

mdzad bslu med skyabs/ /rgyal ba sras bcas bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag gam bdag gi bshes la sgo gsum gyis/ /gnod pa byed pa mthong thos dran gyur na/ /bzod dang snying rje'i stobs kyis gnod byed la/ /ci nus dngos po bsam pas phan gdags bgye/ /gang zhig khro dang nga rgyal dbang gyur nas/ /bdag gi lus la rma srol cher btod de/ /'chi bar nges pa'i gnas skabs byung gyur na'ang / /de tshe dam bca' 'di ni dran par bgye/ /nor la chags pa'am bdag la sdang ba yis/ /bdag gi bdag kun phrogs nas nyin gcig tsam/ /'tsho ba'i zas tsam med pa'i skabs byung na'ang / /de tshe dam bca' 'di ni dran par bgyi/ /'gro mang dbus su sdang mig ldan pa'i mis/ /tshig ngan bzod par dka' bas dma' phab nas/ /gdong pa 'degs pa'i skabs kyang med byas na'ang / /de tshe dam bca' 'di ni dran par bgye/ /gang zhig thos na bdag la 'gro kun gyes/ /khrel bar 'gyur ba'i grags ngan mi zad pa/ /phyogs bcur bsgrags pa mthong thos dran gyur na'ang / /de tshe dam bca' 'di ni dran par bgyi/ /bdag la nyes skyon yod dam med kyang rung / /mtho dman mnyam pa su yang rung ba yis/ /gnod pa'i rnam pa che chung ci byas kyang / /de tshe dam bca' 'di ni dran 402

par bgyi/ /bdag gi mthun phyogs rnams la gzhan dag gis/ /gnod pa byas pa mthong thos dran gyur nas/ /chags sdang dbang gis bdag sems 'khrugs gyur na'ang / /de tshe dam bca' 'di ni dran par bgyi/ /bdag gi lus dang srog la gnod byed pa/ /de dag tshe ring nad med dgra dang bral/ /lam la bar du gcod pa kun spangs nas/ /chos sku skye 'jig bral ba myur thob shog /mthu 'am 'jab bus bdag gi nor khyer te/ /dpal 'byor phun tshogs chog shes blo dang ldan/ /'phags pa'i nor bdun dag la longs spyad nas/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku'i dpal 'byor myur thob shog /bdag gi dge ba'i bar chad byed pa rnams/ /ci bsam thams cad chos bzhin grub gyur nas/ /bar du gcod pa'i bdud bzhi rab bcom ste/ /sprul sgu thob nas 'gro kun don byed shog /bdag gi yan lag gcod par byed rnams kyi/ /nyon mongs duḥ kha bdag gis gcod par shog /bdag ni chu bor 'dor bar byed na de/ /'khor ba'i chu las bdag gis sgol bar shog /bdag ni btson rar 'ching byed de dag gi /bdag lta'i 'ching ba bdag gis gcod par shog /bdag gi bde ba 'joms par byed pa rnams/ /zag med bde la bdag gis 'god par shog /bdag la duḥ kha sgyed par byed pa de'i/ /duḥ kha 403

rgya mtsho bdag gis skem par shog /mdor na su yis dngos sam bsam pa yis/ /bdag la 'phral dang yun du gnod pa'i las /byas dang byed dang byed 'gyur de dag gi /gnod pa thams cad bdag gis sel bar shog /ces gsungs pa ltar gnod lan du phan 'dogs pa'i dam bca' dang smon lam bya zhing 'phral du lag len la yang phan ci thogs bya'o/ /yang dngos su grags ngan dang skur ba btab kyang mi khro ba glang thang pa lta bu re byed dgos te/ khong la khyim bdag phyug po zhig gis bu ma sos pa la/ thengs shig bu zhig skyes pa la mo rtsis byas pas/ dge bshes bzang po zhig gi bu yin byas na sos par 'dug zer bas/ kho bo'i chung mas bu de khong gi drung du bzhag ste/ khyed rang gi bu de na yod do byas nas 'bros thabs su byas song bas/ khong bas ci'ang mi gsung bar/ bud med gzhan zhig la bcol nas gsos pas thams cad je tshom du gyur/ lo 'ga' song tsa na pha ma gnyis 'ongs nas bsnyen bkur dang 'bul ba chen po byas te bu blangs zer ba dang / sne zur ba la'ang phrag dog gis de 'dra byung ba'i lo rgyus gsungs/ des na grags pa ngan pa de 'dra byung na yang / de ltar mi khro snyam du bsam par bya'o/ /ma nyes kyang nyes par khas blangs na sdig pa 'dzad de/ rwa 404

sgreng du dge slong bzang po zhig gis ja brdungs pa'i rtsa ru phyin pas/ sder ma bor ba'i khag byung nas/ mkhan po la/ bdag la nyes pa med de gang drag zhus pas/ khas longs la mang ja bsgol/rgyal gyis/ da gzod gtsang sar thon par 'dug gis gsungs pas/ khong gis kyang de ltar byas pas/ de'i nub mo sdig pa mang po dag pa'i rtags byung / phyis gzhan nas sder ma'i rtsad chod byung ste/ khong gtsang sar yang thon pas mkhan po la'ang mos su song / de ltar byas pa la dga' ba skyes gsungs/ yang gnod byed lha 'dre yin na/ ngas thog ma med pa nas khyod kyi sha khrag la sogs pa zos 'thungs pas/ de'i lan du bdag gi sha khrag la sogs pa khyod la sbyin par bya'o snyam du bsam la/ gnod byed de'i mdun du rang gi lus blos kha phye ste/ bdag gi sha khrag rus pa la sogs pa gang 'dod zo snyam du blos ling gis bskyur zhing ngag tu'ang brjod par bya'o/ /de nas gnod byed des bdag gi sha sogs zos pas bkres skom sogs zhi nas/ lus sems zag med kyi bde bas gang zhing / byang chub kyi sems gnyis 'byongs par bsam mo/ /de bzhin sha khrag za ba'i lha 'dre ji snyed yod pa thams cad la/ bdag gi lus sngar ltar byin pas thams cad tshims nas bde zhing dge bar gyur par bsam/ de ltar na nyes 405

pa thams cad bdag gces 'dzin las byung 'dug pas/ de la dgrar bltas la gnod pa ci 'khyol bya zhing / phan bde thams cad sems can las byung 'dug pas/ de la gnyen du bltas la phan ci thogs byed de/ glang ri thang pa'i zhal nas/ ngas ci tsam pa'i chos zab mo zhig zhal phye nas bltas kyang / skyon thams cad rang gi yin/ yon tan thams cad jo bo sems can pa'i yin par 'dug de'i gnad gas khe dang rgyal kha gzhan la gtong /gyong dang bub kha rang gis len pa 'di min pa go rgyu med gsungs/ nyon mongs pa dang phyi nang snod bcud kyi gnod pa la brten pa'i duḥ kha gang byung yang / nyon mongs pa dang duḥ kha 'di dag thams cad rang gi sems 'khrul ba'i snang ba yin pas/ bden par grub pa cung zad kyang med/ kun rdzob tu de ltar snang ba ni rmi lam du mes tshig pa'am chus khyer nas nyam thag pa ltar mi bden pa la bden par bzung bas lan pa yin/don dam par ni chos thams cad cir yang grub pa med pas/nyon mongs sam duḥ kha de'i ngo bo la bltas na/ de dang po gang nas kyang ma skyes pas skye med chos sgu yin/ ma skyes pa la 'gag rgyu med pas 'gags med longs sku yin/ sgye 'gags med pa la bar du gnas pa med pas gnas med sprul sku yin/ de rnams ngo 406

bo dbyer med pa ngo bo nyid kyi sku yin pas/ 'khrul snang sgu bzhir blta ba 'di sku bzhi ngo sprod kyi gdams pa yin no gsungs/ paṇa chen shākya shrī'i rnam thar bzhi'i nang nas/ rkyen ngan ci byung yang stong pa nyid bsgom pa ltar 'o skol gyis kyang lha 'dre la sogs pa'i rkyen ci byung yang stong nyid bsgom na bsrung ba'i mchog tu 'gyur te/ slob dpon arya de wa'i zhal nas/stong pa nyid ni bsgom byas na/ /'chi bdag gis kyang mi tshugs te/ /bdud rnams bye ba dag gis kyang / /gnod par 'gyur bar ga la srid/ /gsungs/sngon rje btsun mi la ras pa brag dmar khyung lung na bzhugs dus/ bgegs kyi rgyal po bi nā ya ga'i a tsa ra bdun du badzus nas glags 'tshol du byung dus/ khro bo'i lta stangs kyi ngang nas sngags bzlas rung ma song / snying rje chen po thugs la 'khrungs nas chos bshad rung 'gror mi 'dod pa'i tshe/ thugs la nga la lho brag mar pas chos thams cad rang sems su ngo sprad cing / rang sems 'od gsal stong par kho thag chod pa la/gdon bgegs phyi rol tu bzung nas song na dga' ba 'di byed don mi 'dug dgongs/ mi 'jigs pa'i gdeng mngon du gyur nas/ lta ba gdeng dang ldan pa'i mgur gsung bzhin/ nang 407

du thal gyes byon pas/ a tsa ra rnams 'jigs skrag dngangs nas gcig la gcig thim pa'i mthar/ gcig po yang rlung 'tshub 'khyil ba zhig byas nas med par song / yang sngon sgom chen pa zhig brag phug 'dre can zhig tu bsdad pa'i 'dre mo zhig byung nas/ ma sdod byas kyang ma nyan par stong nyid sgom bzhin bsdad pas/ 'dre mo phyir log nas 'dre dmag mang po khrid 'ongs/ thog mar rdo char zhig phab nas nang du 'ongs nas 'dre gcig gis mi kho gang na zer tshe/ da ci 'di na yod de da mi 'dug zer/ smin phrag la mdzub mo btsugs tshe/ 'dre mo zhar ma zhig na re/ re yod re med pa zhig gis rdo rjes brgyab nas nga'i mig ya cig 'di yang bcar ba yin pab// da bsdad na mi bzang 'gro 'gro zer thams cad song skad/ des na stong nyid bsgom na lha 'dres gnod par yang mi nus pas stong nyid bsgom pa gal che'o/ /gzhan yang gnod byed 'dis bdag byang chub kyi sems gnyis sbyong ba'i skul ma byung bas bka' drin che/ bdag gnyen po dang bral nas nyon mongs pa skyes pa ma tshor ba la 'dis sbran pas/ bla ma'am sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa yin snyam du bsam/ yang mdze nad la sogs duḥ kha drag po byung na/ duḥ kha 'di med na bdag tshe 'di'i shom ra la song nas chos mi dran par 'dug pa 408

la/ 'dis chos dran du btsud pas 'di bla ma dkon mchog gi 'phrin las yin snyam du bsam/ mdor na bla ma la brten te byang chub kyi sems skye ba ltar/ gnod byed dam duḥ kha 'di dag la brten nas/ bdag la byang chub kyi sems gnyis skye bar 'dug pas/ 'di dag gis go bcad snyam du zhe thag pa nas bsam mo/ /bdag la duḥ kha byung ba na 'di med na dga' ste snyam pa'i bsam pa 'byung bas/ de'i tshe khyed kyis duḥ kha mi 'dod cing bde ba 'dod na bde ba'i rgyu tshogs gsogs shig byas pa'i brda yin gyes snyam pa byas la/ bla ma dkon mchog gi mchod pa/dge 'dun gyi bsnyen bkur/ 'byung po'i gtor ma sogs/mdor na lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas tshogs bsog pa la 'bad cing skyabs 'gro sems bsgyed bya ste/ bla ma dang dkon mchog la maṇḍal phul la gsol ba drag tu btab nas/ bdag na ba legs na na bar byen gyes brlab tu gsol/ sos pa legs na sos par byen gyes brlab tu gsol/ shi ba legs na shi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes re dogs 'gog pa'i gsol ba gdab bo/ /khyed duḥ kha mi 'dod na duḥ kha'i rgyu sdig pa spongs shig byas pa'i brda yin snyam pa byas la/ sngar byas kyi sdig pa la 'gyod pa rnam par sun 'byen pa'i stobs dang / phyin chad srog 409

la babs kyang mi byed snyam pa nyes pa las ldog pa'i stobs dang /dkon mchog la skyabs su 'gro zhing /byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa rten gye stobs dang / stong pa nyid bsgom pa dang / gzungs sngags khyad par can zlos pa gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs te/ stobs bzhi'i sgo nas sdig pa bshags pa tshad du slong bar bya'o/ /gdon la gtor ma phul te/ khyed kyis bdag gis byang chub kyi sems gnyis sbyong ba'i grogs byas pas bka' drin che/da dung sems can gye duḥ kha bdag la smin par mdzad du gsol/ zhes zhe thag pa nas gsol ba gdab bo/ /de ltar mi nus na gtor ma byin/ byams snying rje sgoms la/ ngas khyod la 'phral dang yun du gang phan bya yis/ nga'i chos kyi bar chad ma byed cig ces bsgo bar bya'o/ /chos skyong la gtor ma phul la/ chos kyi 'gal rkyen zhi ba dang / mthun rkyen 'grub par gsol ba gdab bo/ /nad gdon dang dgra la sogs pa glo bur ba byung nas duḥ kha drag po byung na/ 'jig rten gye khams na 'di lta bu'i sdug bsngal byung ba dpag tu med pa yod pas/ de rnams snying re rje snyam du bsam la/ de dag gi duḥ kha thams cad bdag la 'ub kyis bsdu yang gnod byed 'dis bdag gis byang chub kyi sems gnyis sbyong ba'i grogs byas pas/ bla ma ltar bka' drin che snyam 410

du bsam/ yang duḥ kha ba mthong na de ma thag tu blang zhing / rang ngam gzhan la nyon mongs pa drag po skyes pa na/ gzhan gyi nyon mongs pa thams cad bdag la 'du bar gyur cig snyam du zhe thag pa nas bsam mo/ /rkyen ngan lam du bya thabs 'di thams cad kyis re dogs gnyis 'gog pa yin pas/ mthar thug re dogs gnyis dang bral ba'i lam la sgyel yang / da lta'i dus su dgra zun gnyis su byas nas sbyor ba shing 'khyog po srong ba dang 'dra'o zhes glang ri thang pas gsungs so/ /smras pa/ chos rab 'byed pa'i blo gros rgya che ba'i/ /chos rnams kun gye de nyid legs rtogs nas/ /chos dbyings ngang las nam yang ma g.yos bzhin/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i bla ma mchod/ /chos tshig lhug par smra ba'i bar skabs re/ /tshigs su bcad pa yod na lhag par snyan/ /de phyir gong du bshad pa'i mdo 'gag rnams/ /slar yang tshigs su bcad nas smra bar bya/ /snod bcud sdig pa'i 'bras bus gang ba'i tshe/ /rkyen ngan byang chub lam du bsgyur ba gces/ /sdug bsngal rang nyid gces par bzung las byung / /bde skyid gzhan rnams gces par bzung nas yong / /gnod byed rang gi tshe sngon ma yin kyang / /nyon mongs gdon gyis spyos nas ngo ma shes/ /bu la gnod pa byed pa 411
