snying re rje/ /gnod byed dgra 'dis tshe sngon ma byas dus/ /bu nga'i don du sdug bsngal dpag med myang / /da yang bu nga'i las kyis kho bsgul nas/ /nga la gnod pa byas na phyi ma ru/ /sdug bsngal myong nges shin tu snying re rje/ /bdag la gnod pa'i lan du byams pa dang / /snying rje byang chub sems gnyis bsgoms gyur na/ /tshogs rdzogs sgrib byang sangs rgyas 'thob par 'gyur/ /nga la gnod par mi 'dug phan par 'dug /snyam du drin gzo mi dang khye lta bu/ /dngos su yod na phan thogs gang nus bya/ /med na yid kyis gtong len yang yang bya/ /rmi lam skabs su mes tshig chus khyer nas/ /nyam thag pa ltar sdug bsngal gang byung yang / /'khrul snang tsam yin rang bzhin grub pa med/ /nyon mongs sdug bsngal ngo bo bltas tsa na/ /gang nas ma sgyes skye med chos kyi sku/ /ma skyes pa la 'gags med longs sku yin/ /skye 'gags gnas pa med pa sprul pa'i sku/ /de rnams dbyer med ngo bo nyid kyi sku/ /nyon mongs sdug bsngal ngo bo sku bzhi ru/ /blta ba sku bzhi ngo sprod gdams pa lags/ /shes na gnod byed ma yin byang chub sems/ /gnyis po sbyong ba'i grogs yin ngo mtshar che /sdug bsngal med na snyam pa skyes pa'i tshe/ /'o na de rgyu sdig pa spong dgos pa'i/ /brda' yin snyam du sngar byas 'gyod pa dang / /phyin 412

chad mi byed snyam pa'i dam bca' bya/ /bde ba yod na snyam pa skyes tsa na/ /'o na de rgyu tshogs bsog bya dgos pa'i/ /brda' yin snyam du mchod sbyin gtong ba dang / /lus ngag yid gsum sgo nas tshogs bsog bya/ /gdon la gtor ma phul te rgyarje chub sems/ /sbyong ba'i grogs ldan mdzod ces bsgo bar bya/ /chos skyong mchod la chos kyi 'gal rkyen zhi/ /mthun rkyen 'grub par mdzod ces 'phrin bcol bya/ /glo bur nad gdon dgra sogs sdug bsngal rigs/ /rang ngam gzhan la byung ba mthong thos tshe /'di 'dra'i sdug bsngal yod tshad snying re rje/ /'gro kun sdug bsngal yid kyis rang la bsdu/ /dper na rtswa shing ci tsam mang na yang / /me dpung 'bar ba'i grogs su 'gro ba ltar/ /gnod byed sdug bsngal ci tsam byung na yang / /byang chub sems gnyis 'phel ba'i grogs su 'gyur/ /zhes pa bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o /bzhi pa tshe gcig gi nyams len dril nas bstan pa ni/ rgyal sras rin po ches/ da nas bzung ste zla ba 'di dang / lo 'di dang / ma shi'i bar dang / sangs rgyas kyi bar du byang chub kyi sems gnyis dang mi 'bral bar bya'o/ /zhes blos 'phen pa drag po yang yang bya'o gsungs/ de yang rje btsun mi la ras pa brag 413

dkar rta sor bzhugs dus su/ bdag nyams rtogs khyad par can gcig ma skyes kyi bar du ri khrod 'dir ltogs grir shi rung /dad zas dang gshin zas kyi thal ba 'gam phyir mi 'bab/'khyags grir shi rung gos phyir mi 'bab/ skyo grir shi rung 'du 'dzi dang g.yeng ba'i las mi byed/ na ste shi rung sman thun gcig gi phyir yang mi 'bab/ tshe 'di'i bya ba sgrub phyir lus 'gul ba tsam yang mi byed par sgo gsum yengs med du sangs rgyas bsgrub bo/ /bdag gi dam bca' 'di rnams 'grub par bla ma yi dam rnams kyis byen gyes rlobs shig mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams kyis 'phrin las sgrubs shig gal te dam bca' 'di rnams las 'gal na sgrub pa mi byed pa'i mi lus pas shi ba skyid pas/ dam can rgya mtshos dam bca' las 'gal ma thag tu nga'i srog chod cig bla ma yi dam gyes phyi mar dam pa'i chos dang mjal nas/ sgrub pa byed nus pa'i mi lus su skye bar byen gyes rlobs shig ces dam bcas nas dam bca' smon lam gye glu 'di blangs so/ /rje nā ro'i bu brgyud thar pa'i lam/ /spang ri khrod zin par byin gyis rlobs/ /bdud 'jig rten gyi g.yeng bas mi g.yeng bar/ /sgom mnyam gzhag gi bsam gtan 'phel bar shog /zhi gnas kyi rdzing la mi zhen par/ /lhag mthong gi me 414

tog 'khrungs par shog /spros bcas kyi tsab tsub mi ldang bar/ /spros med kyi lo 'dab rgyas par shog /sgrub khang du yid gnyis mi skye bar/ /nyams rtogs kyi 'bras bu smin par shog /bdud rigs kyis bar chad mi nus par/ /rang sems la nges shes 'drong bar shog /thabs lam la the tshom mi skye bar/ /pha rjes bu yis zin par shog /rje mi bskyod kyi ngo bo thugs rje can/ /spang ri khrod zin par byen gyes rlobs/ /zhes sgon lam btab nas dka' spyad snying rus mdzad nas lo drug bsgoms pa'i mthar phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub thob nas nam mkha' la 'phur nus pa byung / sngon jo bo rje mnga' ris su phebs dus/ lo tstsha ba rin chen bzang pos chos mang po zhus so/ /jo bos nga'i lo tstsha ba la 'gro dgos gsungs pas/ dbu dkar por song ba bstan nas/ da sgrub pa zhig byed par zhus pas/ 'o na de ltar gyes gsungs/der khong gi sgrub khang gsum rim sgo la rim pa bzhin/ sgo 'di'i nang yan chad du/ mi dge ba dang / chos min dang / rang 'dod kyi rtog pa skyes na chos skyong rnams khros pas mgo tshal bar khos la/ phyi mar mnar med du skyur cig ces mna' bor nas bsgrubs pas lo drug nas mchog gi dngos grub thob bo/ /des na 415

chos bzhin byed pa la thog mar 'phen pa drag po btang dam bca' zhe mna' bor nas sgrub pa gal che'o/ /gzhan du 'gro yang khe dang rgyal kha gzhan la ster/ gyong dang pham kha rang gis len/snyam pa'i 'phen pa btang nas song na rkyen ngan pa re 'phrad kyang blo sbyong mi 'chor te/ skyor mo lung na jo gdan bzang po zhig yod pa/ dus mi bde ba zhig gi dus su/ nyin gcig rgyu 'grul la 'gro dgos pa byung bas/ khong gi thugs dgongs la/deng sang gi dus mi bde lugs 'dis de ring yang ci yong mi shes te/ mi 'dod pa'i rkyen ci byung yang chos ma shor ba zhig byed dgos snyam pa'i 'phen pa btang nas phyin pas/ 'jigs sar mi ngan mang po rub kyis byung bas/ dang po snying had pa zhig byung / de'i rjes la da nang gi dam bca' dran nas/ khyed rang la 'khyer rgyu gang 'dug khyer cig byas/ khong tsho'i gseb tu phyin pas thugs bde 'bol gyis song gsungs/ des na dus rgyun du blo sbyong gi nang ltar byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems gnyis dang nam yang mi 'bral bar bya'o snyam pa'i blos 'phen pa drag po yang yang gtang bar bya'o/ /rgyal sras rin po ches/ sku tshe tril bor byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems la blo sbyangs pa ltar/ thun dang thun mtshams/ 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug 416

spyod lam thams cad la yang dang yang du byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems gnyis la blo sbyong ba'o/ /de ltar sbyangs kyang rgyud la mi skye na skabs re ri khrod shin tu dben pa'i mi med lung stong ngam/ yang na gzhan gyi skad mi go ba'i bug pa phug ring tshor phyin nas/rang gi mdun du bla ma 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i rnam par sgoms la/ bla ma spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug mkhyen/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bsgoms kyang rgyud la mi skye ba'i las ngan dred po bdag la thugs rjes gzigs/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems da lta nyid du rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes skad ngan bton nas ngu ngag gis gsol ba 'debs/ de nas rkang pa g.yas kyi pus mo yar gyen du bslangs/ g.yon gyi pus mo mar sa la phab/lag pa g.yas kyi gru mo pus mor btsugs te lag sor rnams 'gram pa la sbyar/ g.yon gyi sor mo rnams pus mo la bkab ste/mya ngan gyi 'dug stangs byas la/ dmyal ba yi dwags la sogs pa'i rigs drug gi sems can gyi sdug bsngal rim bzhin rgyud steng du blangs nas rang gis myang bar bsam zhing / de ltar mngon sum du myong mkhan gye ma rgan sems can nyam thag rnams kyi nyin re tsam gye sdug bsngal yang su zhig gis bzod 417

snying re rje snyam du ngag tu yang / nga'i pha ma sems can nyam thag 'di rnams snying re rje/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug mkhyen/ pha ma sems can 'di rnams la thugs rjes gzigs zhes skad ngan chen po brgyab nas ngu zhing / ngu rgyu mi yong na yang yong ba ltar byas yun ring ngus na nam zhig ngu rgyu yong ste bla ma gong ma 'ga' res/ spyo rdzu byas na sbyo mgo chos rdzu byas na chos mgo zer ba dang / ngu ba'i kha la bltas na ngu bro/rgod pa'i kha la bltas na rgod bro zer ba ltar/ skabs thog der rgyu la byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bcos ma ma yin pa zhig ma skyes kyang skyes song ba ltar byas ngus na/ chos thams cad rten 'brel la rag las pas/ skabs shig byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bcos ma ma yin pa rgyud la sgye bar gsungs/sngon ldi ri brag po bya ba spun gnyis kyis/ dge bshes ston pa la grub mtha' nyan du 'ongs pas/ ston pa rin po che'i zhal nas/ rgya gar na nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i 'jug pa gcig bya ba dang / phyi rol pa'i 'jug pa rnam pa bdun bya ba yod zer/ rang cag bla ma'i man ngag sgoms/ man ngag gang yin na 'chi ba dang las 'bras mang du sgoms la tshul khrims dag par bya/ byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems brtan par bsgoms nas/ des 418

'phangs pa'i sgo du ma nas tshogs gsog sgrib pa sbyong ba man ngag yin gsungs/ yang ston pa 'od zer rgya mtsho bya ba zhig gis zhus pa la yang de skad gsungs/ kham pa dpal 'bar gyis 'gro chos zhus pas kyang ston pa rin po che'i zhal nas/ 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug thams cad ting nge 'dzin du 'gro ba zhig yod de/ de gzhon dus lus sems la sbyangs pa byas pa zhig la yong ba yin/rang cag bla ma'i man ngag sgoms/ man ngag gang yin na 'chi ba dang las 'bras mang du bsams nas tshul khrims dag par bya/byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems brtan par sgoms/ des 'phangs pa'i tshogs sna tshogs nas gsog sdig sna tshogs nas sbyangs pa de man ngag yin gsungs/ des na byang chub kyi sems gnyis sgyes pa dang 'phel ba'i don du ci nus pa'i tshogs gsog par bya'o/ /tshogs gsog tshul ni bla ma'i zhabs togadakon mchog mchod pa/ dge 'dun bsnyen bkur/ ngan slong la sbyin gtong bya zhing khyad par tshegs chung ngus tshogs gnyis bde blag tu rdzogs pa'i thabs gtor ma btang na phan yon che ste/sngon grong khyer ser skya'i nags khrod du/ gcung dga' bos chos yid la byed cing yod pa'i drung du nam gye cha smad la/ yi dwags kha la me 'bar ba 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' ba zhig byung nas/ khyod 419

da ste zhag bdun nas 'chi ba yod/nga'i zas skal yin zer bas/dga' bo byed nas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pas/ ston pas gzungs sngags gzi brjid tshad med pa'i gtor ma 'di thongs gsungs nas/ dga' bos gtor ma btang bas dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa las grol te/ yon tan tshad med pa brnyes par gsungs/ sngon rnal 'byor kun ldan ri pa zhes pa zhig gis/ gtor ma gtong ba'i dus su/ mi ma yin phra mo mang po glu gar byed cing rtsed mo byed kyin yod pa las phyis de rnams ngu ba la/ khyed rnams ci la ngu byas pas/ khyed da zhag bdun nas 'chi bar 'dug pas/ nged rnams la gtor ma ster mkhan mi yong ba 'dug pas ngu ba yin zer skad/ de la thabs med dam byas pas/ khong rnams na re/ thabs yod/ bdog pa thams cad thongs shig nged rnams kyi rgya mtsho'i 'gram na sman chen po zhes bya ba'i dngul chu yod pas blangs nas sbyin gyis/ de'i bcud len gyis shig dang tshe 'phel bar 'gyur ro zhes zer bas/ rnal 'byor pas rdzas kyi dngos po yod tshad po gtor mar btang bas tshe 'phel nas lo lnga brgya thub par gsungs/ gzhan yang gtor ma brgya rtsa btang na tshe yi bar chad sel zhing tshe ring ba sogs phan yon bcu gnyis tsam 'byung bar gtor ma brgya rtsa'i 420

rnam bshad nas gsungs so/ /des na gtor ma brgya rtsa gtong ba la yang brtson par bya'o/ /tshogs bsags na sgom gang yang rgyud la myur du sgyes nas grub pa thob ste/ sngon nub phyogs o rgyan gyi yul na grub pa thob pa rnams kyis thog mar tshe blos gtong dus/ nor gang yod dge 'dun sde la phul nas dben par sgom byas pas/ nyams rtogs myur du shar nas grub pa thob pa sha stag byung / rjes su dge 'dun gye sde rnams 'tho ra ba byung nas grub pa 'thob 'dod pa rnams kyis tshe blos gtong dus/ nor gang yod khyem pa sogs zhing ma dag pa la btang nas dben par sgrub pa yun ring byas kyang grub pa thob pa ma byung skad/ bla ma dharma rakṣi tas/ bsod nams kyi tshogs rlabs chen bsags pa'i mthus/ gnas lugs stong pa nyid kyi don/ klu sgrub yab sras kyi dgongs pa bzhin thugs la 'khrungs/ dbu ma rigs tshogs rnams kyang gzhan gyi bslab pa dang dpe gzigs pa la ma ltos par thugs la wal gyis shar nas zhal 'don du mdzad pa zhig byung gsungs/ des na byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems gnyis rgyud la skyes nas/ rang gzhan gyi don gnyis lhun gyes 'grub pa'i phyir sgo sna tshogs nas tshogs gsog pa la 'bad par bya'o/ /rgyal sras rin 421

po ches/ bdag gces 'dzin gye rnam rtog byung ba na/ 'dis thog ma med pa nas duḥ kha sna tshogs la sbyar/ tshe 'dir yang sdig pa chos 'dod pa bzhin ma byung ba la sogs pa thams cad 'dis byas pa yin snyam pa byas la/ bdag gces 'dzin gyi rnam rtog rgyangs kyis spang bar bya'o gsungs/ spyan snga ba blo gros rgyal mtshan gye zhal nas/ nga rgyal gye brag ri la bdag 'dzin gye rdzong bcas nas nyon mongs kyi dmag dpung 'gyed pa/ zhe sdang gi ral gris bsod nams kyi ljon shing gcod pa/ khong khro'i gzhu la tshig rtsub kyi mda' bkang ste pha rol gyi snying la 'debs pa ser sna'i zhags pas gtong sems kyi sgyes bu dam du bcing ba/ tshul min yid byed kyi rlung dmar gyes 'dod chags kyi chu bo g.yos pas dge ba'i gru bshig pa/ the tshom gye kha phrag tu shes rab kyi 'gros bshol ba/ thar 'dod kyi skyes bu lta ngan gyi dong du 'jug pa'i dgra bo 'di la sngon chad dgrar ma go da ni rje bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis rang la dgrar ngo 'phrod/ ces gsungs shing / sems dpa' chen po hor ston pa'i zhal nas/ gti mug ma rig pas drangs pa'i rang gces par 'dzin cing / gzhan yal bar 'dor ba 'dis log par lta ba'i mtshon rnon po bzung ste/ dge sdig khyad du bsad nas mngon mtho nges legs kyi srog gcod 422

pa'i sdig can bshan pa mkhan de yang 'dir 'dug rang gces 'dis dug gsum gye rkyal ba thogs/ dge ba'i lo thog 'joms par byed pa'i chom rkun de yang 'dir 'dug snying gi phugs su bsod nams ma yin pa'i rdzas ngan du ma bsags nas/ mi dang mi ma yin gyi gnod byed thams cad spyan 'dren par byed pa'i 'phung byed 'ug pa'i rwa/go bo can de yang 'dir 'dug mdor na gyong dang sdug bsngal thams cad bsgyed pa'i gzhi rang gces kyi dbang du lus ngag yid gsum gye spyod pa btang na/ phyi dgra dang nang 'khrug 'di phyi'i gnod pa thams cad 'byung ba'i snga ltas ltas ngan gye bye'u mgo sngon lta bu de/ rang gces 'dzin gzhan yal bar 'dor ba'i blor shes par byas la/ 'di la dgrar bcar gyis bzung la dgra zun gyi ru phyed par bya zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bdag 'dzin la dgra ru bltas nas ming ngan btags/ nam byung yang khyad gsod sun 'byin kho na byas/ tshe mjug 'di la 'gong po 'di ci thul la 'bad par bya'o/ /rgyal sras rin po ches/ dge sbyor thams cad kyi gsham du da nas sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du byang chub kyi sems gnyis sbyong ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig rkyen ngan ci byung thams cad chos 'di'i grogs su 'khyer bar gyur cig ces smon lam gdab 423

cing / bla ma dkon mchog dang chos skyong la gtor ma phul nas/de ltar 'gyur bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba yang gdab bo gsungs/ gsol ba 'debs tshul yang dus gsum skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rin po che brgyud pa dang bcas pa rnams kyi thugs rgyud la ji ltar 'khrungs pa/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs la ji ltar mnga' ba/ nges pa'i don gyi mdo sde rin po che rnams kyi brjod bya'i don gye mthil/ kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems rin po che rnam pa gnyis bdag gi rgyud la da lta nyid du skye bar byen gyis brlab tu gsol/ 'byor pa rgud pa/ mtho ba dma' ba/ bde ba sdug pa/ na ba 'chi 'pho ba/ skye ba'i gnas skabs thams cad du byang chub kyi sems rin po che mi brjed par mngon du 'gyur bar byen gyis brlab tu gsol/ rkyen dang bar chad ci byung yang chos 'di'i grogs su 'khyer nus par byen gyes brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba 'debs par bya'o/ /'o na chos 'di'i lugs kyi 'chi kha ma'i gdams ngag ji ltar byed na/ rgyal sras rin po ches/ yo byad thams cad bla ma dkon mchog la mchod pa la sogs bsod nams gang che sar gtang 424

la/ de rnams la chags zhen med par bya/ bla ma dkon mchog la yan lag bdun pa phul te/ bdag bar do tshe rabs phyi ma thams cad du byang chub kyi sems gnyis sbyong bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ chos 'di ston pa'i bla ma dang mjal bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes gsol ba drag tu gdab cing / de ltar smon lam kyang gdab bo/ /bdag gces 'dzin gyi rnam rtog 'dis sngar yang sdug tu bcug da dung yang 'di dang ma bral na bder mi ster 'dug cing / da lta yang lus 'di la gces par bzung nas duḥ kha bar 'dug pas/ lus la gces 'dzin gye rnam rtog spangs nas/ sems la bdag tu gzung rgyu mi 'dug pas/ lus sems gang la yang bdag 'dzin spang la bzhag go /ngas bar dor yang byang chub kyi sems gnyis sbyang bar bya'o snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag po yang yang bya'o/ /de nas sngar gyi byang chub kyi sems gnyis sbyong tshul de dran par byed pa'o gsungs/spyod lam ni/ sngon yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ grong khyer rtswa can du/ mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul ston pa'i tshe/ sku'i gzhogs g.yas pa phab/ phyag g.yas 'gram pa la sbyar/ g.yon brla'i steng du brkyangs/ zhabs g.yas pa'i steng du g.yon pa bzhag dbu byang dang zhal nub tu bstan nas 425

gshegs par mdzad do snyam du ston pa'i rnam thar dran par byas te/ gzhogs g.yas pa phab/ mthe'u chung ngam srin lag gis sna bug g.yas bkag la rlung g.yon nas rgyu bar bya/ lag pa g.yon brla'i steng du brkyangs/ rkang pa g.yas pa'i steng du g.yon pa bzhag mgo byang kha nub tu blta bar bya'o/ /de lta bu'i spyod lam gye gnas na bdud dang log 'dren gyis gnod par mi nus shing / nyon mongs pas kyang mi brdzi ba dang / ston pa'i rnam thar rjes su dran pa'i mthus byang chub kyi sems rin po che shugs drag sgye ba sogs phan yon shin tu che bar gsungs/ des na spyod lam 'di ni 'chi kha tsam du ma zad deng sang mtshan mo nyal ba'i tshe na'ang 'di ltar byas na shin tu legs so/ /de nas byams snying rje sngon du 'gro bas rlung 'gro 'ong la bskyon nas gtong len gnyis po sbyang ngo / /de'i rjes la 'khor 'das skye 'chi la sogs pa thams cad sems snang yin/ sems nyid cir yang ma grub pa'i ngang la blos cir yang mi 'dzin par bzhag go /de ltar byang chub kyi sems gnyis po de spel zhing sgom pa'i 'phro la 'chi bar bya'o/ /'chi kha ma'i gdams ngag la 'ud che ba mang ste/ 'di bas ngo mtshar che ba med gsungs/ de yang byams pa dang snying rje bdag pas gzhan gces kyi sgo nas 'phos na 'pho 426

ba'i mchog yin te/ ma smad gnyis chus khyer bas/ ma la bu mo 'di ma shi na/ bu mo la ma 'di ma shi na snyam pa'i bsam pa byung bas gnyis ka tshangs pa'i gnas su skyes par gsungs/ rgyal sras rin po ches/ sku gshegs khar snying rje dmigs pa ched kyis ma byas kyang / 'gro ba'i duḥ kha dran tsam na ngang ngam shugs kyis sgyes par 'dug byung rgyal du btang na nyid cag rnams ya nga bar dogs nas dran 'dzin chen po byas pa yin 'chi khar 'pho ba yang sgom pa la 'di 'dra'i 'phro la shi na yang legs pa yin mod gsungs/ gzhan yang dmyal ba gyad kyi shing rta 'dren pa dang / mdza' bo'i bu mo'i lo rgyus sogs dang / bdag pas gzhan gces kyi blo bcos min skyes pas/ 'di nyid du'ang ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma 'byung ste/ bya ba ko khar ko ba gcig gi nang du btsun pa drug dang bang chen pa gcig gis zhugs nas ko ba btang bas chu'i bzhi cha tsam song ba dang / ko mkhan na re/cung lci 'dug pas rkyal shes pa yod na gcig 'thon rogs gyes/ yang na nga yis 'thon gyis/ khyed rang gcig gis skya ba zungs zer ba la/ thams cad kyis gnyis ka mi shes par 'dugabang chen pa de na re/ thams cad shi ba bas nga gcig pu shi ba drag zer nas chu la mchongs pas/ de ma thag 'ja' zug me 427

tog gi char babs/ rkyal mi shes kyang ji zhig ltar na chu mthar thon nas ma shi zer/ des sngar chos tsam byas pa'i rigs su mi 'dug zer te/ blo rnam dag lan re la'ang de 'dra 'byung na/'chi khar mang du bsgom na 'pho ba'i mchog yin pa smos ci dgos gsungs/ yang 'pho bya 'pho byed dang bral ba'i don dam byang chub kyi sems kyi sgo nas 'pho na yang 'pho ba'i mchog yin te/ grub chen las kyi rdo rje'i zhal nas/ 'chi khar tshe 'di'i chags zhen gyi 'khrul ba thams cad rbad kyis bcad la/ don dam par sems la skye shi med par thag bcad/ phyag rgya chen po la bsgom rgyu med par thag bcad/ sgom med kyi don la ma yengs par bzhag pas ye shes zang thal du song nas bar do med par 'tshang rgya'o gsungs/ des na byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems gnyis kyi sgo nas 'pho bar bya'o/ /gzhan yang dmigs pa dang rlung sbyor sogs kyi sgo nas 'pho ba'ang shin tu zab gsungs/rdzas kyi 'pho ba ni/ rdo khab len dang / 'gron bu bu che ma bsregs pa zhib tu btags nas sbrang smyon gyis sbrus te/ ril bu sran ma tsam byas pas/ 'chi khar chang la sbyangs nas spyi gtsug tu skud pa'ang gnad zab mo yin gsungs so/ /smras pa/ legs byas dge tshogs bye bas bskrun pa'i sku/ /428

legs bshad 'gro ba'i rna bar sgrogs pa'i gsung / /legs nyes chos kun sa ler mkhyen pa'i thugs/ /legs tshogs rtsa ba bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /dam pa'i chos kyi glu dbyangs len pa de/ /dam pa gong ma'i phyag srol yin pas na/ /dam chos glu dbyangs snyan mo len la spro/ /dam gtsang mched lcam slob bu'i tshogs rnams nyon/ /deng nas bzung ste sangs rgyas ma thob bar/ /byang chub sems gnyis sbyong ba'i 'phen pa btang / /yang dang yang du byang chub sems gnyis sbyangs/ /de gnyis skye dang 'phel phyir tshogs bsag bya/ /rang nyid gces par 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog 'dis/ /sngar yang sdug btang da dung yin na yang / /sdug la sbyor nges chos bzhin ma byung ba/ /'di yis lan pa yin pas dug bzhin spangs/ /dge sbyor mjug tu sangs rgyas ma thob bar/ /byang chub sems dang nam yang mi 'bral shog /rkyen ngan ci byung byang chub sems gnyis kyi/ /grogs su 'khyer bar shog ces smon lam gdab/ /'chi khar yo byad thams cad mchod pa sogs/ /bsod nams che sar btang nas chags med bya/ /bla ma mchog gsum mdun gyi nam mkhar dmigs/ /yid kyis yan lag bdun pa maṇḍal phul/ /bdag ni bar dor phyi mar song na yang / /byang chub sems gnyis 'byong bar byen gyis rlobs/ /byang chub 429

sems kyi gdams pa ston mdzad pa'i/ /rtsa ba'i bla mar mjal bar byen gyis rlobs/ /zhes pas gsol ba shugs drag yang yang btab/ /de ltar 'grub pa'i bsngo ba smon lam bya/ /lus 'di gces par bzung nas sdug bsngal bar/ /'dug pas lus kyi gces 'dzin rnam rtog spangs/ /sems la bdag tu gzung rgyu mi 'dug pas/ /lus sems gang la bdag 'dzin spangs la bzhag /bar dor song yang byang chub sems gnyis po/ /sbyang bar bya snyam 'dun pa yang yang bya/ /de nas 'chi khar byang chub sems gnyis po/ /sbyong tshul de yang yid la dran par bya/ /gzhogs g.yas 'og bcug lag g.yas 'gram par brten/ /mthe'u chung gis sna bug g.yas pa bkag /de nas byams dang snying rje sngon du btang / /rlung gi 'gro 'ong la brten gtong len sbyongs/ /de yi rjes la 'khor 'das sgye 'chi sogs/ /snang grags chos rnams rang gi sems snang yin/ /sems nyid ngo bo cir yang ma grub pa'i/ /ngang la cir yang mi 'dzin rang babs bzhag /de ltar byang chub sems gnyis spel bzhin du/ /bsgom pa'i 'phro la 'chi bar byed pa gces/ /'chi kha ma yi gdams ngag 'ud che ba/ /mang po 'dug kyang 'di nyid ngo mtshar che/ /mtshan ldan bla ma dam pa'i thugs kyi sras/ /mar gyur 'gro ba yongs kyi gces phrug ngas/ /430

'di 'dra'i gdams pa zab mo sgom bzhin du/ /mtho ris thar pa'i gnas su yar la 'gro/ /e ma dad ldan skye bo pho mo rnams/ /'chi nges nam 'chi cha med 'chi dus su/ /gdams ngag 'di 'dra bsten la yar shog dang / /phyi mar dag pa'i zhing nas mjal bar nges/ /zhes pa bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o//lnga pa blo 'byongs pa'i tshad ni/ rgyal sras rin po ches/ theg pa che chung gi chos thams cad kyi dgos pa ni bdag 'dzin 'dul bar 'dus pas/ bdag 'dzin gyi gnyen por ma song na chos byas tshad don med du song ba yin/ chos byas tshad bdag 'dzin gyi gnyen por song na blo sbyong rgyud la skyes pa'i rtags yin/ chos chos su song ma song gi khyad par 'di na yod pas/'di chos pa srang la 'jal ba'i rgya ma yin gsungs/ gzhan dag na re/ jo bo de kun gyi rgyud la chos skyes 'dug chos pa bzang po bya ba de la zer ba yin zhes gzhan gyis ma khrel ba'ang dpang po yin mod kyis/ de gtso bor mi gzung ste/ 'jig rten phal ba rnams kyis bdag gi sems mi rtogs pas/ phyi'i spyod lam legs pa sna re tsam mthong bas kyang mgu srid pas so/ /des na rang gi sems kyis ma khrel ba zhig dpang po'i gtso bo yin pas/blo gzu bos legs par brtags pas rang la rang gis ma khrel 431

na blo 'byongs pa'i rtags yin pas/ gnyen po bskyed la rang la rang gis ma khrel ba la 'bad par bya'o/ /blo legs par sbyangs pa'i stobs kyis/ da phyin chad rkyen ngan ci byung yang blo sbyong gi lam du khyer bas chog snyam pa'i blo gdeng 'chos na blo 'byongs pa'i tshad yin pas/ rkyen ngan ci byung yang de la dga' ba bsgoms nas/ de'i steng du gzhan gyi rkyen ngan thams cad len pa la nyam nga ba med par bslab par bya'o/ /rta rtsal can de yengs kyang rta las mi ltung ba ltar/ ma brtags par glo bur du gnod byed la sogs pa rkyen ngan byung na zhe sdang sogs mi skye bar/ rkyen ngan de nyid blo sbyong gi grogs su khad kyis 'gro yin 'dug na blo sbyong 'byongs pa'i tshad yin pas/ de ltar 'gyur ba la 'bad par bya'o/ /'byongs pa'i tshad 'di dag ni blo sbyong rgyud la skye ba'i rtags yin gyis/ 'byongs zer nas da sbyong mi dgos pa ma yin pas rtags 'di dag byung nas kyang 'bad de blo sbyong bar bya'o gsungs/ gzhan yang skyes chen dam pa rnams kyi thugs kyis mi khrel zhing bstod bkur bsngags gsum byed na dpang po kun gyi mchog yin te/ rgyal sras rin po che la skyes bu dam pa gzhan gyis bstod bkur bsngags gsum mdzad tshul ni/dpang lo tstsha ba blo gros brtan pa'i gsung na re/ thog mar shes 432

bya kun la mkhas par bya/ /bar du mkhas pa'i tshogs su legs par bshad/ /tha mar 'dris pa'i don la brtson par sgom/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi bzhed gzhung yin/ /zhes sa skya paṇḍi tas gsungs pa de gu ru thogs med khong gis byas pa yin no/ /'o skol chos pa rnams kyi nang na chos byed pa mang rab 'dug ste/ bstan pa thob pa rang du tsam bdog gam/ gzhan gyi rgyus ni nga la med/ bstan pa thob ngo shes pa gu ru thogs med khong yin/ pho skyes pa zer na de kun la zer lags/ mi gzhan gyis nga'i rgyud tshod du sleb pa la da rung dka' las chen po yod/ ngas gu ru thogs med kyi rgyud tshod la sleb pa la bskal pa mang por tshogs gsog dgos/ nga khong gi bla ma yin/ kho nga'i slob ma yin te/ nga ni bla ma gcig las kyang de la mos/ mi rgan nam 'chi ba'i sngas kha der gu ru thogs med yod pa zhig byung na dga' ste/ nga phyogs thams cad du rgyug khong sa gcig tu bzhugs pa 'dis yid smon thog tu e 'bab yin gsungs zer zhing / gsung yig snyan dngags dang bcas pa bskur ba'i nang na yang / khyod la nga 'dra'i slob dpon brgya yod kyang / /nga la khyod 'dra'i slob ma khyod las med/ /ces sogs kyi bstod pa mang po yang 'dug go /kun mkhyen rong po'i gsung na re/ nga la pha bas lhag pa'i bu 433

gcig yod pa yin/ nga'i slob ma 'di 'dra gzhan la yod na smon ni 'chor/ skyes bu dam pa 'di 'dra 'jig rten na dkon gsungs zer/ bla ma rin ye ba bla ma yin yang / sems dpa' chen po'i mtshan brjod tsam na/ phyag thal mo sbyar/ spyan chab 'byin zer ro/ /rgya ma dpon po chos rje kun mkhyen pa la mjal du phyin dus/ khyed dngul chu ba rnams bla ma'i skal brgya ragargyal sras pa de mtshungs pa med pa'i byang chub sems dpa' yin/ 'di nas 'phos ma thag byams mgon gyi drung du zang thal 'gro rgyu de yin/ de'i rgyu thams cad khong la tshang ba yin gsungs zer/ yang rta nag tu 'byon skabs shig dngul chu'i thad kyi sprin la phyag mdzub btsugs nas/ der 'dus pa rnams la pha gi'i 'og na sangs rgyas mi gzugs su bzhugs pa gcig yod pa yin e shes gsungs zer/ dpal ldan sa skya'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'jam sgeg gi gsung na re/ dbus gtsang gnyis po 'di na mthong thos dran pa la dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang bo 'dug ste/ gzhan su bas kyang bo dong thogs med la smon/ nga yang tshe mjug la sgom zhig zhu rgyu byung na bo dong thogs med de la zhu/khong mtshams dam po zhig yod par 'dug pas/ rten 'brel ma 'grig na/ nga rang gi slob ma rdor gzhon la sgom gcig zhu/ 'di 434

gnyis min pa bla ma sgom chen su yang yid mi smon gsungs zer/bla ma mnyam med pas/ kho rang gi slob ma sgom la 'gro ba rnams la/ khyod tsho 'di dang 'dres pa'i sgom zhig byed na bla ma 'di dang 'di'i rtsar rgyug sems rdul med kyi chos shig byed na bo dong thogs med de'i rtsar rgyug da lta de bas lhag pa med do gsungs pa 'dug zer/ mkhan chen bu ston pa'i gsung gis kyang / sde snod gsum gyi don la mkhas gyur cing / /rgyud sde zab mo'i rtogs pa kun chub pa/ /byang chub sems gnyis 'byongs pa rgyal ba'i sras/ /zhes sogs kyi bstod pa yang mdzad cing /sems dpa' chen po zha lur byon pa'i res khong rang gi grwa pa rnams la da lta bod gangs can gyi khrod na chos shes nas nyams su blangs ngo shes pa rgyal sras thogs med pa tsam gcig yin/ngas kyang chos shes shes te/ kun mkhyen 'phags 'od kyi gsung zhig la brten nas bshad nyan byed dgos pa byung nas/ khong gi 'dra ba'i nyams len byung ba med/ 'di lta bu'i byang chub sems dpa' la chos 'brel thogs pa tsam res kyang 'khor ba mtha' can du 'gyur ro shes pa yin pas/ mtshams la yod kyang gseng la chos zhus/ de bar gyi zhabs tog thams cad bla brang nas byed pa yin gsungs zer/ de'i res sems dpa' chen po yang zla ba 435

gcig zha lur bzhugs nas/ gang la gang 'dod kyi chos gsungs te/ 'gro ba dpag tu med pa'i don mdzad ces grags so/ /de bzhin du skyes bu dam pa gzhan rnams kyis bsngags brjod byed na byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems gnyis 'byongs pa'i rtags yang dag pa yin par shes par bya'o/ /glang ri thang pa'i zhal nas/ ngas blo 'byongs ma 'byongs khams su ston pa sher 'bum can du phyin na shes/ khong snying dang 'dra ba'i mched grogs yin pas/ nga byung ba la rab tu dga' nas rnyed bkur phun tshogs 'ong du re ba la/ de ltar mi byed par ma zad slar rdung rdeg byas/ ci yod phrogs kyang nga la khong khro mi skye zhing sngar gyi brtse ba de mi 'gyur na 'byongs pa yin gsungs/ de bzhin du re che sa nas gnod pa bskyal na/ sngar gyi brtse gdung de mi 'gyur na byams snying rje byang sems la blo 'byongs pa'i rtags yin/sngon sangs rgyas kyi slob pa lam gyi gnas skabs su/ shi bi'i rgyal por gyur tshe spyan gnyis po blangs nas bram ze long ba gcig la byin pa dang / ri bong du gyur pa'i tshe bram ze bkres pa zhig gso phyir me dpung gi nang du mchongs pa dang / lha'i dbang por gyur tshe lha ma yin dang g.yul 'gyed dus/rang gi srog blos 436

btang nas bya'i phru gu'i srog bskyabs pa dang / drang srong bzod pa smra bar gyur tshe/ rgyal pos yan lag thams cad gtubs kyang bzod pa bsgoms pa dang / tshangs pa'i rgyal por gyur pa'i tshe yan lag byen nas/ lta ngan yang dag lam la bkod pa dang /glang po cher gyur tshe skye bo bdun brgya tsam bkres pas nyen pa la lus po g.yang la bskyur nas byin te gsos pa ltar/ gzhan sdug bsngal gyis nyam thag pa la rang gi gces pa'i lus kyang gtong snyam pa yang yang byung na/ byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems khyad par can rgyud la 'byongs pa'i rtags so/ /yang sngon sangs rgyas rgyal bu thams cad sgol du gyur tshe/ bu dang bu mo rgyal srid kun sbyin par btang ba dang / sa skyong rgyal por gyur tshe dud 'gro bgrang las 'das pa'i srog skyob mdzad pa dang / bram ze zhig tu gyur tshe dka' thub kyis zas cung zad las med rung / de yang slong ba zhig byung ba la sbyin par btang ba dang /tshong dpon zil gyes mi non par gyur tshe/ rang la nor rdzas med rung / phongs pa snying rje nas rtswa btsongs nas rin gyis slong mkhan gsos pa ltar/ rang la nor rdzas gang yod thams cad gtong nus shing / med rung nor btsal nas kyang / sems can phongs pa gso snyam pa'i 'dun pa yang yang skyes na blo sbyong rgyud 437

la skyes pa'i rtags so/ /yang sngon sangs rgyas gtsug phud byang chub tu gyur tshe/ rgyal bos brnyas kyang khro med bzod pa bsgoms pa dang / ma he ru gyur tshe spre'us yang dang yang du gtses pa la/khro med bzod pa bsgoms pa dang / ngang pa'i rgyal por gyur tshe rnyi nang du bzung yang khro ba dang 'jigs pa med par slar chos bstan pa dang / kun tu rgyu byang chub tu gyur tshe/ mang pos brnyas kyang khro med bzod pa bsgoms pa ltar/ mchog dman bar ba mang pos brnyas smod khyad gsod sun 'byin rdeg rdung gang byas kyang / khong khro mi lang bar bzod pa bsgom nus na blo sbyong rgyud la skyes pa'i rtags yin/ yang sngon byang chub sems dpa' spre'ur gyur tshe/ sdig can khron pa'i nang nas drangs rjes su mi ngan des gnod pa bskyal kyang / gnod lan du yang phan btags pa dang / ri dwags sha rar gyur tshe/ rang la gnod pa bskyal ba'i sdig rgyal g.yang la lhung nas 'chi la nye ba snying rjes yar drangs pa dang / ri dwags bse rur gyur tshe chus khyer ba'i mi chu las bsgral nas rjes su mi ngan des gnod pa byas kyang phan btags pa dang / rgyal bu dge don du gyur tshe/ sdig don la bsam ngan skyes nas/ mig la smyug tshal brgyab nas mig bcar kyang rjes su gnod lan du phan btags pa ltar/ rang la gnod 438

pa byed mkhan ci byung rung bzod pa bsgom par ma zad/ da dung snying rje chen pos gnod lan du phan 'dogs pa dang / dngos su phan 'dogs ma nus na yang / yid kyis bya zhing ma 'ongs pa na phan thogs pa'i smon lam 'debs pa byung na/ byang chub kyi sems 'byongs pa'i rtags yang dag pa'o/ /sngon 'phan yul glang thang pa yin pa'i ston sgom byang chub sems dpa' gcig la shig nad byung ba'i steng du gzhan gyi shig nad thams cad blangs te/ shig thams cad la lus dngos su sbyin par btang nas gshegs pa rgyal sras rin po ches gsan tshe rjes su yi rangs/ shākya thub pa rus sbal du 'khrungs pa'i dus su/ srin bu ke ta ka brgyad khrir sku lus sbyin par btang ba dang don gyi cha mthun pa de nyid yin/ khong gi sems la 'gyod pa yong ba'i rigs su mi 'dug ngo mtshar che gsungs/khong gis kyang 'chad nyan mdzad tshe/ 'jam dbyangs don yod pa sku mched kyis bo dong du chos gsungs pa'i dus/ rgyal sgo'i 'gag na shig nad tshabs can byung ba'i sprang rgan lus kyi zungs shor ba gos dang stan la sogs pa shig gi phung por gyur pa zhig gi dri chen po mnam pa zhig 'dug pa de la/ drung sku mched pa'i skya bo tshos/ drung nas skyug bro 'gag der ma bsdad 439

zer zhing 'phud par gzigs pas/ snying rje drag po skyes shing spyan chab shor te/ de'i nub mo kho'i gos dang stan shig gi phung por gyur pa rnams nang du khyer/ sprang po la na bza' gcig gnyis dang / bza' rgyu gnang nas shig rnams la sku lus sbyin par btang ste/ shig gi phung po'i gseb tu gzims nas zhag gcig gnyis song ba dang / slob dpon dang mched grogs 'ga' res tshor nas bltar byon pas/ sprang po'i gos dang stan shig gi phung por song ba rnams gsol/ sku lus thams cad 'brum nad 'thug po byung ba bzhin du gyur 'dug pa mthong nas/ khong rnam pa ha las te/ nyid da dung lus gtong ba'i dus tsam la ma slebs las che/ de 'dra ha cang thal drag mi mdzad par zhu zhes zhu ba nan gyis phul yang ma gsan par gsos pas/ring por ma lon par shig rnams yal nas song zhes grags so/ /de bzhin du rang gzhan gyi shig thams cad la lus zar 'jug nus na byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems la blo 'byongs pa'i rtags yin/ sngon rje btsun mi la ras pa la/ a nes chung dus sdug mang po btang ba'i rjes nas chos mdzad dus kyang /g.yo thabs du ma'i sgo nas zhing rnams len dus/ khong gi thugs bsam la/ zhe sdang skye yul med na bzod pa su la bsgom/ nga rang 440

do nub shi na zhing gi mi tshad 'di rnams kyis kyang ci byed sangs rgyas thob pa'i thabs la bzod pa mchog tu gsung ba yin/ de bsgom pa'i rten a ne yin zhing dam pa'i chos dang mjal ba yang a khu dang a ne'i drin yin/ bka' drin du che ba'i drin lan du phyi ma sangs rgyas thob pa'i smon lam rtag tu 'debs/ tshe 'dir zhing du ma zad khang pa yang byen pas chog snyam pa byung ba ltar/ a ne la yang go bar lab ste byang chub sgrub pa la bla ma'i gdams ngag min pa cis kyang dgos pa med pas/ zhing du ma zad khang pa yang a nes khyer cig byas glu 'di blangs so/ /rje bla ma'i bka' drin ri khrod 'grims/ /sprang po'i skyid sdug khyed rang shes/ /'jig rten 'khor ba las kyis dub/ /'bag na thar pa'i srog rtsa gcod/ /sgye ba'i so nam sdig pa'i las/ /spyad na ngan song sdug bsngal myong / /nye du'i gdung sems bdud kyi mkhar/ /brtsigs na me 'obs kyi nang du tshud/ /zas nor gyi gsog 'jog mi yi nor/ /bsags tshad dgra bo'i rgyags phye yin/ /skyid 'dod kyi ja chang btsan dug gi chu/ /'thung na thar pa'i srog rtsa gcod/ /a ne'i zhing rin ser sna'i zas/ /zos na yi dwags kyi gnas su skye/ /a ne'i kha ta zhe sdang gi tshig /lab na bdag gzhan gnyis phung yong / /bdag gi zhing khang thams cad ni/ /a 441

nes khyer la dga' bar gyes/ /mi kha chos kyis sangs pa yin/ /lha kha snying pos sgrub pa yin/ /'dre kha snying rjes gnon pa yin/ /nyes kha rlung la bskur ba yin/ /rang kha gyen la blta ba yin/ /rje mi bskyod kyi ngo bo bka' drin can/ /sprang ri khrod thub par byen gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa'i glu blangs pas/ a ne na re/ chos pa bzang po bya ba tsha bo 'di 'dra la zer ba yin/ dga' rab yin zer/ dga' nas song ngo / /yang rgyal sras rin po che 'jam dbyangs bsod nams rgyal mtshan pas chos zhu ba la sa skyar gdan drangs nas chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor te/ tshur byon dus/ lab btsas nag por jag pa byung ste/ sems dpa' chen po rang gi sku la ma regazhabs tog pa rnams 'ol le ba re bkyigs te/ jag pas za ma za dus/ zhabs tog pa gcig bkyigs pa grol byung ba'i rtsa na jag pa'i ral gri bzhag 'dug pa khyer nas bros na bsam yod tsa na/ sems dpa' chen pos mkhyen nas/ nyid de blo tsab tsub ma byed ang gsungs pas 'bro ma nus zer/ dngos po 'di rnams rin chen sgang ba'i sa char ma 'khyer/ ngas blos btang yod pas 'phrog pa yin snyam pa'i blo yang ma byed/ nga'i go lag 'khyer na yang khyer gsungs pas/ jag pa rnams kyis phyag 4 42

'tshal nas/ nged tsho yang phongs nas thabs rdugs pas nyid lta bu zhig dang thug zer gyin 'dug zer/ jag pa rnams la rjes zlos byed du bcug nas bsngo ba yang mdzad ces thos shing / nyid kyi zhal nas/ nor la chags pa'am bdag la sdang ba yis /bdag gi bdog kun phrogs nas nyin gcig tsam/ /'tsho ba'i zas tsam med pa'i skabs byung na'ang / /de tshe dam bca' 'di ni dran par bgye/ /zhes gnod lan du phan 'dogs par dam bcas pa ltar mdzad do/ /bdag gi yongs 'dzin dam pa a rig dge bshes rin po che la dad can sbyin bdag gzhan gyes phul ba'i dud 'gro mang po yod pa/ nyin gcig mgo log gi jag pa mang po byung nas ded nas song ba khong gis gsan tshe/ sdig pa'i rgyu de rnams med pa zhig bya snyam yod/ da bar lus song / da res 'dod thog tu babs byung gsungs/ dge 'dun pa rnams 'tshogs su bcug nas mang ja btang / bsngo ba rgyas pa zhig gsungs nas/ su dag 'dod chen dbang gis bdag gi nor/ /thams cad 'phrog gam 'phrog tu 'jug na yang / /lus dang longs spyod dus gsum dge ba rnams/ /de la bsngo ba rgyal sras lag len yin/ /zhes rgyal sras rin po ches gsungs pa lag len la 'debs rgyu byung gsungs/ thugs gang dgyes dgyes mdzad 443

snang / yang bkra shis sgo mang dgon chen gyi thag nye'i ri khrod na/dge slong gcig bzhugs pa la/ shing skyel ba'i mi zhig yod pa des nyin gcig dge slong ri la khams bsang du phebs pa'i shul du mi de nang du 'dzul nas/ gang yod khur nas sgor thon pa dang / dge slong khams bsangs nas phebs pa gnyis kha thug brgyab pas/ mi des ci yang mi smra bar yar langs nas bsdad tshe/dge slong gis da yar nang du khur byas nang du khur nas sa la phog ja skol du bcug 'thungs nas/ da dung de'i thog tu gang yod bsnan nas mang du btang / khres po btegs te/ da song gzhan la ngas rkus yong ma zer/ nga la gnang song gyes/ phyin chad gzhan la de 'dra ma byed ces kha ta bslab bya mdzad/ mi de rang yul du btang bas/ rjes su bsngo ba smon lam kyang byas zer ba'i dge slong byang chub sems dpa' zhig byung / des na de 'dra'i jag pa rkun ma byung nas rang gi nor thams cad khyer na yang / dga' zhing spro bzhin bsngo ba dang smon lam 'debs thub pa byung na/ byang chub kyi sems rgyud la 'byongs pa'i rtags yin/sngon sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis/ blo gros chen po/ngas sha'i zas ni su la'ang ma gnang mi gnang / gnang bar mi 'gyur ro/ /rab tu byung ba rnams la sha'i zas ni mi rung bar 444

ngas bshad do/ /yang 'khrul dang ni gnyen bshes dang / /khu chu khrag las byung ba'i phyir/ /'byung po rnams kyang dngangs gyur na/ /rnal 'byor can gyis sha mi za/ /gsungs pa ltar/ 'phags pa kātyā ya na 'brum bu me dbal nag pos bsnyung ba la/ sman pas ra sha dang ra khrag phyi nang gnyis gar gtong bar zhus pas/bslab pa las 'gal ba las 'chi ba dga' gsungs nas/ ma bzhes par mya ngan las 'das pa dang / 'gro mgon phag mo gru pas bslab pa gsum la gces spras su mdzad cing / kha na ma tho ba'i zas sha la sogs pa gtan nas spangs pas tshil bu'i sdor tsam btab pa'i thug pa'ang mi bzhes shing / sku mya ngan las 'da' khar dug gi snyung gzhi byung ba la/ sngags kyis btab pa'i chang gi nying khu zhal gang bzhes na phan par gsal bzhin du/ sku srog dang bsdos nas spangs par gsungs/ rje stag lung thang ba sku gshegs khar bzhes thug la tshil bu'i sdor btab nas snyung dwangs 'gro bar zhus pa la/ mi tshe tril bo bsrung thub nas/ shi khar sdom pa nyams pas ci rung gsungs/ ma gsan par sku gshegs pa dang / dge bshes kha rag pa'i sku tshe snga mar/ tshe rabs lnga brgya'i bar du sha ma bzhes par byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems la blo sbyangs pa'i mthus/ sgu ring de la jo mo kha 445

rag gi ri khrod de na bzhugs dus/ bya ri dwags thams cad nye drung du 'khod cing / rgyun du gnas pa'i tshe dbyar ri dwags mo rnams kyi 'o ma yang bzhos nas 'thungs skad/ rgyal sras rin po ches/ sku tshe de la dgung lo lnga bcu nga bdun bar du sha gtan nas ma bzhes shing / slob ma gzhan la yang nyid kyi zhal nas/thog med dus nas gnyen gyur srog chags rnams/ /las kyis shi na'ang mchi ma 'byung rigs na/ /de dag sha yi ched du bsad pa'i sha /za bar rigs pa ma yin shes rab grub/ /gsungs/ jo bo rje/ 'bri gung skyob pa yab sras/ stag lung thang ba sogs sgyes chen mang po zhig gis/ bu ram dang sbrang rtsi sogs la tshogs dang / 'o ma dang zho sogs la tshogs chang mdzad pa'i lo rgyus la/dpon slob lo chen ni rjes su yi rang cher mdzad cing / chos rje rgod tshang sna tshogs rang grol gyis kyang / deng sang ban de phal mo ches za 'dod 'thung 'dod kho na'i ched du/ tshogs chang bzos nas bag med du 'thung mkhan tshor bltas na ni/ gong gi jo bo dang 'bri stag sogs kyi mdzad pa de yang ya mtshan che'o/ /gsungs/ dper na a ma bzang mo des/ rang gi bu bu mo'i sha gtan nas za 'dod mi skye ba ltar/ pha ma sems can gyi sha'i rigs su gyur pa gtan nas za 'dod mi skye ba byung na byams 446

snying rje byang chub kyi sems rgyud la skyes pa'i rtags yin/sngon rgya gar gyi rgyal po zhig gis/ 'bangs mi zhig la chad pa gcod nges byung tshe 'jigs nas/ pha ma bu gsum yod pa zhag brgyad kyis sleb pa'i yul zhig la bros nas song bas lam nor nas zhag bcu gnyis la yang ma slebs par kun ltogs nas shi la thug tshe/ bus pha ma'i drin lan 'jal phyir g.yang zhig la mchongs nas 'chi ru bcug pas/ pha ma gnyis kyis bu'i sha za mi 'dod na yang / srog mi 'chad par 'gro sar sleb phyir mi 'dod bzhin du za dgos byung ba ltar/ byang chub sems dpa' la nam yang sha za 'dod kyi sred pa gtan nas mi skye na yang / lo lon lus zungs zad zas gzhan gyes ma phan tshe/ gzhan don du lus srog 'tsho ba'i phyir mi za thu med 'dra byung nas sha za dgos byung tshe/ 'dod sred gtan nas mi skye bar ma zad sems can de la dmigs pa'i byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems skye na/ blo sbyong rgyud la skyes pa'i rtags yin/ yi dam phyag na rdo rje'i zhal nas/las kyi rdo rje tshe 'di la blo log na lto gos kyis phongs kyang mi 'gyod/ bla ma'i bka' dang ma 'gal na/ dam tshig nyams zer yang mi 'gyod/ dal 'byor chud ma zos na/ chos ma byas zer yang mi 'gyod/ sems la g.yo sgyu med na/ 'phags pa ma mnyes 447

zer yang mi 'gyod/ stong nyid snying rje dang ma bral na chos spyod zhan zer yang mi 'gyod/ mnyam pa nyid kyi rtogs pa shar na/gang zag gis gshe yang mi 'gyod pas/ de rnams dang ldan pa zhig byed dgos gsungs pa ltar byung na blo sbyong rgyud la skyes pa'i rtags yin gsungs/ yang blo sbyong rgyud la ma skyes pa'i rtags la 'di 'dra 'byung ste/ sngon lam kha zhig nas dge slong gcig la grwa pa kha rgod cig 'phrad tshe/ khyod su 'dra zhig yin zhes dris pas/ blo sbyong ba zhig yin byas pas/ grwa pa na re/ khyod blo sbyong ba yin na khyod kyi pha'i sha zo byas pas/ kho ngo mdangs 'gyur rdung res rgyag grabs byas tshe/ ngas khyod la ku re byas blo ma 'byongs 'dug pas da dung blo sbyongs zer skad/ de bzhin du tshig ngan re tsam yang mi theg na blo ma 'byongs pa yin/ yang sngon rgyal ba 'bri gung bas slob ma mang po gangs rir btang la kha shas sgrub pa brgyab nas 'ongs pa la khyed rnams kyi rgyud la nyams rtogs yon tan ci 'dra skyes gsungs pas/ nang nas dbu mdzad na re/ sgyu lus 'byongs lags zhus pas/ khyod rjes su zhig sdod gsungs/ bsdad tshe/ khyod kyi sgyu lus 'byongs pa lags te khyod la gangs ri nas bud med kyi gtam ngan zhig byung ba de bden na shin tu ma legs pa zhig byung gsungs tshe/448

kho ngo mdangs 'gyur nas/ de sus sgu mdun du zhu ma /ban byung /ngas yid la yang ma shar na nga la 'di 'dra'i gtam ngan sgogs pa zer tshig ngan mang po lab tshe/ khong gis ngas khyod la ku re byas pa yin/ sgyu lus ma 'byongs 'dug pas da dung sbyongs gsungs skad/ des na gtam ngan re rna bas thos tshe mi bzod na blo sbyong rgyud la ma skyes pa yin/sngon bla ma zhig gis sha'i nyes dmigs mang po bshad tshe/de'i nyin nye gnas kyis tshod brtag phyir sha sku mdun du ma khyer bas/ bla mas sha khyer shog byas pas/ nye gnas kyis de ring khong gis sha'i nyes dmigs mang po gsungs tshe/ mi bzhes sam snyam khyer 'ong ma nus byas pas/ de khas bshad tshod red/ da sha tshod khyer shog zer skad/ la dwags pa gcig na re/ bshad rgyu de bla ma chos bshad yong ste/ go rgyu de bla mas kyang go mi yong zer ba ltar/khas chos bshad mang po byas kyang / lag len la mi thebs na blo sbyong rgyud la ma skyes pa'i rtags yin/ sngon jo bo rje stod mnga' ris na bzhugs dus bod pa'i drung yig cig yod pa'i nyin gcig dpe cha la snag tsha pho ba gzigs nas 'gram lcag cig btang / rjes sor dbus gtsang du slebs nas yang drung yig gis snag tsha pho nas ma dpe bzad pa gzigs nas yang 'gram 449

lcag tsha bo zhig btang tshe kho tshig pa zos nas nga la 'gram lcag lan gcig min lo snga ma mnga' ris nas kyang gcig btang / da lan yang gcig btang zhes tshig ngan smras pa'i tshe/ jo bo rjes/nged rgya gar ba da lta khong khro langs kyang da lta zhi nas sems la gzhag rgyu mi 'ong / khyed bod kyi mi 'di bsam pa ngan par 'dug gsungs skad/ des na bod kyi sku drag bsam pa ngan pa kha cig gis/ sngar gzhan gyes gnod pa re bskyal ba zhe la bzhag nas phyis gnod lan 'jal thub pa'i dus byung tshe/ gnod lan ci 'khyol bskyal zhing / gal te pha'i ring la sgyel ma thub na zhe la bzhag nas bu'i ring la gnod pa skyel ba ltar/ bsam ngan yid la bzhag nas nam yang mi brjed par dran cing / gnod lan du gnod sgyel snyam pa yid na yod phyin/ blo sbyong rgyud la ma sgyes pa'i rtags yin gsungs/ de ltar blo sbyong rgyud la skyes ma skyes legs par brtags nas rgyud la skyes pa'i rtags khyad par can de dag rnams dang ldan pa zhig bya'o/ /smras pa/ rab gus mchod bstod bkur la mi chags shing / /rab mang gnod pa byed la mi sdang bar/ /rab yangs nam mkha' lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa/ /rab mchog bla ma rje yis 'gro kun skyongs/ /gzhon nu so dkar dus su blo 'byongs pas/ /mgo bo 450

dkar por song yang blo re bde/ /lus sems gnyis po bde zhing skyid pa'i mod/ /mgur dbyangs skad gseng mthon pas len snying 'dod/ /tshigs su bcad pa'i legs bshad snyan mo yis/ /thos tshad yid la dga' ba bskyed par nus/ /de phyir dad can rnams kyis thos pa'i mod/ /sems la phan thogs 'byung ba'i mgur dbyangs 'then/ /theg pa che chung chos rnams thams cad kyi/ /dgos pa bdag 'dzin phung rgan 'dul la 'dus/ /dam chos bdag 'dzin gnyen por ma song na/ /byas tshad thams cad don med song ba yin/ /bdag 'dzin nyon mongs gnyen por song tsa na/ /blo sbyong rgyud la sgyes pa'i rtags kyi mchog /lha chos byas tshad gnad du song ma song / /khyad par 'di na yod pa'i chos pa kun/ /srang la 'jal ba'i rgya ma 'di yin gsungs/ /chos pa bzang po bya ba de yin zhes/ /gzhan gyis ma khrel dpang po yin mod kyang / /rang gi sems la rang gis ma khrel ba/ /byung na dpang po'i gtso bo yin par gda'/ /mi 'dod rkyen ngan ci byung blo sbyong gi /lam du khyer na chog go snyam pa yi/ /blo gdeng yod na blo sbyong 'byongs pa'i tshad/ /rta rtsal can gyi mi de rta thog nas/ /yengs kyang steng nas sa la mi ltung ltar/ /glo bur gnod byed rkyen ngan ci byung yang / /de la zhe sdang la sogs mi skye bar/ /rkyen 451

ngan ci byung thams cad blo sbyong gi /grogs su 'gro bar 'dug na blo sbyong chos/ /rgyud la skyes pa'i rtags tshad bzang po lags/ /de ltar 'byongs rag bar du 'bad par bya/ /blo sbyong rgyud la 'byongs rtags byung zer nas/ /phyin chad sbyong mi dgos pa ma yin pas/ /blo sbyong rgyud la skyes rtags ci byung yang / /da dung yang yang 'bad nas sbyang bar bya/ /blo sbyong rgyud la skyes pa'i rtags tshad dang / /ldan pa'i skyes bu dam pa su yin kyang / /yid bzhin nor bu dbang gi rgyal po bzhin/ /kun gyes spyi bor bkur nas mchod par 'os/ /de ltar blo sbyong sgom pa'i gang zag rnams/ /skye ba phyi mar 'gro sa'i lam gcig cing / /sangs rgyas zhing gcig rigs kyi bdag po gcig /sangs yang mnyam por rgya ba'i skal ba yod/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod kun/ /skye ba phyi mar dag pa'i zhing nas mjal/ /ngo mtshar sangs rgyas zhing khams thams cad du/ /lhan du song nas rgyal ba mchod gyur cig /ces pa bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o//drug pa blo sbyong gi dam tshig bstan pa ni/ rgyal sras rin po ches/ nga blo sbyong ba yin zer nas bslab pa phra mo khyad du gsod pa spangs te/ bsam pa blo sbyong dang ldan pa'i sgo nas/ so thar nas rdo rje theg pa'i bar rang gis ji ltar khas blangs pa'i 452

bslab pa rnams ma nyams par bsrung bar bya'o/ /bslab bya phra mo yin yang khyad du bsad na shin tu nyes pa che ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyis chos gsungs pa la/ btsun chung gcig chos nyan du byung bas/ khyod 'od srungs kyi bstan pa la rma 'byin par ma zad/nga'i bstan pa la'ang rma 'byin par byed dam/ rang gi gzugs kyis chos nyon gsungs pas/ btsun chung de log song / phyi nyin sbrul chen po zhig gi mgo la/ shing e la'i 'dab kyi sdong bo chen po skyes pa zhig byung ba la mi thams cad skrag nas bros pas/bcom ldan 'das kyis thams cad la ma 'jigs shig kha sang gi btsun chung de yin gsungs/ 'o na 'di'i rgyu ci yin zhus pas 'di 'od srungs kyi dge slong yin pa la/ kho brel ba zhig gi dus su lam 'gag gcig tu shing e la'i 'dab kyi yal ga la chos gos thogs pas dge slong khros te/ bslab pa khyad du bsad nas shing bcad pas 'di ltar gyur pa yin gsungs/ des na bslab pa phra mo tshun chad ma nyams par bsrung bar bya'o/ /sngon slob dpon jo btsun bya ba'i dge bshes bzang po zhig gis bla ma'i dus mchod bcad pas/ tshal pa'i dpon dga' des khong gi slob ma gcig la da lta dbus gtsang gi dge bshes la khong bzang bar 'dug pa bla ma'i dus mchod gcod pa rang mi 453

'thad dam byas pas/ kho slob dpon gyi drung du phyin te mi kun 'di skad zer byas pas/ nga bla ma la mos gus med pa'am/ cha rkyen 'phongs pa min/ de la dmigs nas tshong pa mang bo yong bar gda' ba dang / dge 'dun rnams g.yengs nas dge sbyor 'chag pa dang / btsun pa gnyen po chung chung rnams chud za bar 'dug pas bcag pa yin/ sdom gsum la nyes ltung gis ma gos pa zhig byed kyin yod/ 'dis thugs dgongs rdzogs mchi gsungs pa la/ rgyal sras rin po che'i zhal nas/ dus mchod rang de bzang bar 'dug ngo mtshar che gsungs/ bdag gces 'dzin med par gzhan gyis go bar bya ba'i phyir/ shing gnyan gcod pa dang / mdze pho dang 'grogs pa la sogs pa tho co'i spyod pa rnams spangs te/ dge bshes ston pas rwa sgreng du bstan pa'i srol btsugs pa'i bka' gdams kyi rnam thar dang mi 'gal bar bya'o/ /mi'i gnod pa bzod la/ lha 'dre'i gnod pa mi bzod pa dang / che ba la gus la chung ba la brnyas pa dang /gnyen la byams la dgra la sdang ba la sogs phyogs re ba thams cad spangs la/ thams cad la blo 'byong bar bslab bo/ /bsam pa sngar rang gces par 'dzin pa ste/ da bdag pas gzhan gces par bsgyur la lus ngag gi spyod pa grogs chos mthun 454

rnams dang 'dra bar so thub par bya ste/ blo sbyong thams cad mngon tshan chung la chod che ba zhig byed dgos zhes 'chad kha ba la gsungs pas/ gzhan gyis ma tshor bar rgyud smin pa zhig bya'o/ /gzhan la 'jig rten pa'i skyon zhar ba la sogs dang /chos kyi skyon tshul khrims 'chal ba la sogs pa mi snyan pa'i tshig rnams mi brjod pa'o/ /spyir sems can thams cad dang / khyad par chos sgor zhugs pa rnams la skyon mthong na/ nga rang snang ba ma dag pa yin gye/ khong ba la de 'dra'i skyon yod nyen med snyam du bsam la gzhan skyon rtogs pa'i blo de spang bar bya'o/ /'ga' zhig gis la la la 'phya smod btang tsa na/ nā ro pas tai lo pa nya bsha' ba la sogs su mthong ba dang / sangs rgyas ye shes kyis 'jam dpal bshes gnyen khyem btsun nyo tshong byed par mthong ba sogs kyi gtam rgyud gsungs nas/ 'o skol rang blo ma dag pa yin/ khong kun ji 'dra yin mi shes/ lar yang 'o skol gyis mi la skyon brjod mang po byas tsa na/ 'o skol la yang thams cad kyis tshur 'thab pa zhig rten 'brel gyes cis kyang 'ong gsungs/des na gzhan skyon rtogs pa'i bsam sbyor spang bar bya'o/ /rang rgyud la nyon mongs pa gang che brtags nas/ gang che ba de'i gnyen por chos thams cad spungs nas/ de nyid thog mar 455

btul lo/ /blo sbyong byas pas tshe 'di'i rnyed bkur la sogs pa dang / phyi ma la lha mi'i bde ba dang / rang nyid mya ngan las 'das pa thob pa la sogs pa rang 'dod thams cad spang bar bya'o/ /dngos po'i bden 'dzin dang / bdag gces 'dzin gyi rnam rtog 'dres pa'i dge sbyor thams cad zas dug can dang 'dra bas de spang bar bya'o/ /pha rol gyis gnod pa byas pa la 'khon du bzung nas/ 'khon de las nam yang mi ldog pa de spang bar bya'o/ /gzhan gyis tshig ngan smras pa'i lan du gzhan gye blo la gnod pa'i tshig ngan mi smra zhing nyes pa byung na 'dis lan zhes mi smra'o/ /sngon mu stegs ston pa la phyogs pa'i kun tu rgyu zhig gis/kun dga' bo la/ khyed kyi dge sbyong go'u ta ma yon tan chen bo dang ldan zer ba rdzun no/ /yang dag po kho btsas nas zhag bdun lon pa na ma shi bas sdig can yin par mngon no/ /yab rgyal po dang chung ma rnams kyi gdong mchi mas gang bzhin bskyur nas bros pas khrel med pa yang yin par mngon no zhes ngan smras byas so/ /yang mu stegs ston pa drug gis/ ston pa sangs rgyas la phrag dog gi dbang gis 'di skad smras te/ go'u ta ma 'dis ci yang mi shes pho brang nas byung ste byang chub shing drung 456

na 'dug 'dug nas/ nga ni rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes thob zer ba dzun no/ /de yin na rgyal po a khye tas bsod snyoms sbyin par bos nas/ rta chas 'ba' zhig byen te ngan du byas kyang ma shes te der song bas na thams cad mkhyen pa ma yin no/ /yang kun dga' bo la kun dga' ra ba na bya mang pos ci'i phyir ca co'i skad 'byin ces dris na/ bya mang po zas phyir ro zhes smras so/ /de dang sbyar na thams cad shes pa ma yin no/ /btsas ma thag tu ma yang shi bas/ bkra mi shis te sdig can yang yin no/ /pha ma la rim gro mi byed par ri la langs te song bas drin mi shes pa yin no/ /chung ma blangs pa la yang chung ma'i bya ba ma byas par bor nas song bas khrel med pa yang yin no/ /dper na rlung chen po langs na shing lo thams cad lhan cig spungs pa ltar sangs rgyas kyi chos kyang de dang 'dra'o/ /bya mang po mis bor ba'i kha zas la 'du ba ltar/ 'khor yang de dang 'dra ste ci rnyed rnyed len cing za'o/ /des na dge sbyong go'u ta ma 'khor bcas la su zhig mchod pa bya bar sems zhes skur ba btab bo/ /des na sangs rgyas la yang de 'dra'i skur ba 'debs mkhan byung na/ 'o skol la smos ci dgos snyam du gzhan gyes gshe skur sna tshogs pa byed mkhan byung yang lan du tshig ngan mi smra 457

bar kha rog par gnas par bya'o/ /gzhan yang o rgyan pa la slob ma rnams kyis zhus pa/ byang chub sems dpa' gzhan don byed pa la mi kha dang gshe skur la mi 'jigs pa zhig dgos gsungs pa de la ji lta bu zhig dgos lags zhus pas/ de 'di ltar yin mod/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed/ theg pa chen po khas blangs/ 'gro ba sems can gye don la zhugs pa'i dus su/phyi mi'i gshe skur dang ngan smra la mi 'jigs pa zhig dgos pa yin/ gshe skur dang ngan smra la 'jigs na theg pa chen po mi yong / gtam ngan dang sgro skur la 'jigs na zeg pa chen bo mi btub/ ma nyes pa'i kha yog dang / 'phyar kha la 'jigs na theg pa chen po mi yong bas/ bde sdug dang mtho dman gang byung yang / chos nyid kyi klong du rgyags pa gcig dgos pa yin/ de'i rgyu mtshan theg pa chen bo zer ba mi des go mod/ byang chub sems dpa' zer ba de yang sems can dpag tu med pa'i don 'grub pa la zer ba yin mod/ sems can gyi don mi 'grub na sems bskyed kyi dgos pa med/ bstod smad dang gshe skur la sogs pa'i snyan pa dang / mi snyan pa dang / bde ba dang sdug bsngal la sogs pa'i 'gal mthun thams cad sems dpa' gzhan don la zhugs pa'i dus su yong ba yin te/ chos rje sa skya 458

ba'i zhal nas/ 'phan zel rin chen la blta yi/ /mgal dum la ni su zhig dpyod/ /ces gsungs pas/ nyan thos dang lta spyod mthun pa'i spyil chung re ru zhugs/ ngag tu sems bskyed pa skad du zer/ 'gro don la shi gzur ku gzur du bzur/ bde sdug la skyon yon du blta/ 'gal rkyen du ma tsam byung na/ bya 'jol mo bzhin du sa phyogs gzhan du bzur nas 'gro ba de la/ gshe sgur dang log sgrub gang na yong / dper na mgo chag dang rmas ma'i rigs te dpa' bo g.yul du zhugs pa las yong ba lags mod/sdar ma wa bros byed pa la rmas ga na mchi/ dpe de bzhin du bstod smad dang sgro skur la sogs pa theg pa chen po gzhan don byed dus yong ba yin/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang ma rungs pa 'dul ba la 'phrin las kyang bzhi ga dgos/ sdod sa nges med du sdod dgos/ zla bo sems can dang 'grog dgos/ su ma rungs pa rnams dang 'grog dgos pa yin mod/ dper na phyugs ma 'tsho ba'i dzi bo de blo mi gsal ba 'dra/ phyugs rdzi yang dus thams cad du phyugs dang 'grogs pa las shes pa blun pa las 'os ci yod/ de dang 'dra ba sman pa mkhas pa de dus rtag tu nad pa dang 'grog dgos te/ nad pa dang 'grog mi nus na sman pa'i bya ba mi 'grub/ brtag pa mkhan po de dus rtag tu mdze bo dang 459

'grog dgos te/ de lam du mi lhongs na brtag pa mkhan po'i don mi 'grub ste/ de la gzhan gyis bltas na dus rtag tu nad pa dang mdze bo skyong ba de la yang 'brang gtsang mo tsam yong ste mi mchi/ de bzhin du 'gro don byed pa'i dus su/ log sgrub mi yong ba la rem res med/ de byung ba thams cad chos nyid kyi steng du ro snyoms dgos pa lags mod/ de ro mi snyoms na sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi rnam thar la bltas nas/ pho so sgyed dang mig thag 'chang bas/ da rung gnas ri khrod kyi dgon par dben pa bsten pa drag pa yin te/ de la dgongs nas chos rje sa skya ba'i zhal nas/ bstod smad phal cher ya rabs la/ /'byung gi ma rabs bde ba'i rgyu/ /nor god phal cher phyug po la/ /'byung gi dbul po bde ba'i rgyu/ /zhes gsungs pas/ skabs don la mtho dman gyi log sgrub mi bzod na/ chos brgyad rang dgar spyad pas gzhan don pas rang don yang mi 'grub ste/slob dpon klu sgrub kyi zhal nas/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa rnyed dang ma rnyed dang / /bde dang mi bde snyan dang mi snyan dang / /bstod smad ces bgyi 'jig rten chos brgyad po/ /bdag gi yid yul min pas mgo snyoms mdzod/ /ces gsungs/ 'jig rten chos brgyad mgo snyoms dgos par gda'/ 'gro don pher ba 'di 460

dka' las che ba lags mod/ 'gro don pher ba la stong pa nyid dang snying rje zung du chud nas legs tshogs kyi rten 'brel 'grigs pa la mkhas pa zhig dgos par gda'/ chos brgyad kyi dbang du song na gzhan don lta zhog rang don yang mi 'grub pas sems can gye log sgrub mi bzod pa na da dung sgrub pa rang byas na bzang / sems can da dung mi 'dzad pas/ ha cang ring rgyu tsam med/ 'gro don la zhugs nas sgo skur la 'jigs ma 'jigs med/ de'i rgyu mtshan sems can gye gshis de ka las ma grub pa lags mod/ sangs rgyas zhal bzhugs pa'i dus na'ang sgur ba byung ste/ bcom ldan 'das chu bo neerañdzana'i 'gram na dka' thub la bzhugs pa'i dus su bdud kyis zan skam rul ba dang / sbang skam spyil bu'i mtha' mar gtor nas dka' thub byas pa med do zer nas sgur ba btab pa dang / yang skye bo mang po'i dbus na thugs bskyed gsungs pa'i dus su/ bdud kyi bu mos bcom ldan 'das la bu chung gtad du byung ba dang / slob dbon klu sgrub gser khar chos gsung du byon pas/ gser pa rnams na re/ dge slong 'di byung bas gser yong 'phro chad/dge slong de 'dre can gcig 'dug zer ba lta bu'am/ slob dpon zhi ba lha/ dpal nā lend+ra'i gtsug lag khang du byon pa 461

dang / de'i gnyer pa na re/ khyed byung bas ma he'i zho bskams/khyed bsod nams med pa gcig 'dug pas/ da ma yong zer bas/ der slob dpon thugs mug ste/ sems can mos pa sna tshogs pa/ /rgyal bas kyang ni mi mgu na/ /bdag 'dra ngan pas smos ci dgos/ /gsungs nas gshegs skad/ des na gshe skur gyes kyang thabs mi chag gshe skur 'debs mkhan gyis kyang thabs mi chag pa ro snyoms shing dgag sgrub med pa gcig dgos pa yin gsungs pa ltar bya'o/ /gzhan gyis gnod pa byas pa zhe la bzhag nas gnod pa'i lan 'jal ba'i dus byung tsa na 'jal ba de spong ba'o/ /mi'i skyon mtshang nas 'bru ba dang / mi ma yin la srog sngags bzla ba la sogs pa gzhan gyi sems la gnod pa drag po 'byung ba'i spyod lam mi byed pa'o/ /rang la 'bab pa'i las khur ram/ khag ngan g.yo sgyu'i sgo nas gzhan la bsgyur ba sogs khong skyon can gye spyod pa de lta bu spong ba'o/ /'di shin tu nyes pa che ste/ sngon kha che'i dge slong ra ba ti zhes bya ba mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul thob pa/ slob ma mang po yod pa zhig nags kyi gseb na chos gos ngur sprig cig 'tshod kyin yod tsa na/ de dang nye ba'i khyim bdag cig gi be'u stor nas 'tshol du phyin pas/ dge slong gcig me 462

gtong gin 'dug khyed ci byed pa yin byas pas/ chos gos 'tshod pa yin zer/ tshos phru kha phye nas bltas pas sha rus 'dug pa zer/ khong rang gis kyang sha rus su mthong / der khos khrid nas rgyal po la gtad de/ 'dis bdag gi be'u brkus pas chad pa chod cig byas pas/ rgyal pos de dong du bcug go /de nas zhag 'ga' nas kho rang gis be'u rnyed de/ dge slong des be'u brkus par mi gda' bas gtong bar zhu zhus na'ang rgyal po yengs nas zla ba drug tu btang ba ma byung / der khong rang gi slob ma rdzu 'phrul thob pa mang po yod pa rgyal po'i khab tu byon nas/ dge slong 'di bzang po zhig lags pas gtong bar zhu zhus te/ rgyal po dge slong gtong du byon pas/ dge slong 'o brgyal ba gzigs nas shin tu 'gyod de/ khos kyang len thongs pa lags na'ang / ngas brjed pa des sdig pa chen po bsags 'dug zhus pas/ nga rang gi las kyis lan pa yin gsungs/las ci 'dra bsags zhus pas/ nga sngon rkun po zhig tu skyes/ de dus be'u gcig brkus pas/ bdag pos ded nas/ nags gseb na rang sangs rgyas shig mnyam par bzhag 'dug pa'i mdun du bskyur nas bros pas/ des rang sangs rgyas khrid de zhag drug dong du bcug de'i rnam smin gyes skye ba mang por ngan 463

song gi duḥ kha mang po myangs/ tshe 'dir yang duḥ kha myang ba de rnam smin gye tha ma yin gsungs/ des na g.yo sgyu nyes pa che tshul bsams nas dug bzhin du spang bar bya'o/ /phugs rang bzang bar 'dod nas gzhan la pham kha len pa dang / 'dre gdon nam nad zhi bar 'dod nas blo sbyong ba ni lto bcos dang 'dra bar rang 'dod spang bar bya'o/ /tshan gcig gis rnam rtog la blo sbyong ba 'di 'dre gdon la phan pa'i thabs shig tu go ba 'dra ste/ de tsug song na bon byed pa dang khyad med/ chos bya ba nyon mongs pa dang rnam rtog gi gnyen por 'gro ba zhig dgos pa yin gsungs/ pha dam pa la/ chos bya ba ci la zer lags zhus pas/nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por 'gro ba zhig la zer ba yin gsungs/ longs spyod thun mong ba la thabs sna tshogs kyi sgo nas bdag gis thob par byed pa'i bsam sbyor spong ba'o/ /'jig rten pa kun gyes rang gi lha ma mgu nas rang la gnod pa byas na lha bdud du babs zer ba ltar/ blo sbyong gi sgo nas nga rgyal dang rlom sems drag po byas na/ chos chos min du song ba yin/blo sbyong gis rang rgyud 'dul dgos pa yin pa la/ nga rgyal gyis rang rgyud lhag par rengs na chos gnad du ma song ste/ 'dre shar sgo nas gnod pa la/ glud nub sgor sgyel ba dang 'dra bas/ des 464

na sman nad thog tu btang zhing bdag gtsas spangs la kun la bran gyi tha ma ltar bya'o/ /rang gi nye du grogs mched la sogs pa shi na/ de dag gi zas nor dang dpe cha la sogs pa nga la yong /yon bdag la na tsha shi chad byung na tshogs gsog yong / rang dang mnyam pa'i sgom chen shi na nga gcig pu la sku bsod yong /dgra shi na gnod byed mi yong bas/ nga 'tshengs snyam pa lta bu rang skyid pa'i thabs su gzhan sdug par 'dod pa spang ngo / /'di nyes pa che la 'byung nye bas zon cher byed dgos/ chos pa gnyom chung rnams la dngos su dgra gar ma rang med na'ang dgra gnyen 'di blo'i 'dzin stangs su 'dug pas/ bla ma slob dpon dpon po dgon sde yul phyogs sogs kyi phyogs cha bzung nas/ rang phyogs gzhan phyogs su phye ste/ gzhan phyogs kyis gnod pa spu tsam yang ma bskyal/ rang phyogs kyis phan spu tsam yang ma btags kyang / pho rus che bar 'dod pa 'ga' zhigadangos pas zhe sdang che ba'i rigs yong bar 'dug dge bshes che rab gnyis 'gran zlar yod pa la/ gcig la bud med yod zer ba thos pas/ nye gnas la ja zhim po zhig skol zhig gtam snyan thos zer/ ja bskol nas drangs te/ gtam snyan ci gsan zhus pas/ rang re'i 'gran zla de la bud med byung lo zer/ de 465

kun spangs grags rgyal gyes gsan pas/ zhal nag ting song nas/ de gnyis sdig pa gang che'am gsungs zer te/ thugs shin tu mad par 'dug gsungs/ yongs 'dzin rin po che'i zhal nas/ dben pa'i gnas su gnas pa rnams la/ dngos su lus srog la gnod pa byed pa'i dgra ma byung yang / grogs nang phan tshun la don med du tshul min yid byed kyi rnam rtog gis dgrar 'dzin pa ni 'byung nye/ de'i tshe 'ga' zhig la dgrar bzung /'ga' zhig la gnyen nye bar bzung ste/ khong tsho dang nged tsho zhes phyogs ris su gcod/ de la brten nas dge 'dun gyi sde 'khrug 'byung / dge 'dun gye sde 'khrug ni rnam par smin pa shin tu tshabs che bar gsungs te/ sngon dam pa gong ma rnams kyi zhal nas/ dge 'dun gye sde 'khrugs pa'i tshe/ gang 'khrug pa byed pa de rnams mnar med du 'gro ba smos ci dgos/ sa der gnas pa'i srog chags gzhan rnams la'ang khong khro rgyas te dmyal bar 'gro ba dang / gnas de'i sa tshig pa zhes bya bar 'gyur gsungs/des na sa tshig pa la myu gu mi skye ba bzhin du/ sde 'khrug byas pa'i sa der yang sgrub pa byas kyang 'bras bu gsar du mi 'byung bar gsungs te/ 'dul ba lung las kyang / lhas byen gyis dge 'dun gyi dbyen byas pa'i tshe stong gsum 'jig rten gye khams 466

'dir srog chags su'i rgyud la'ang dge ba'i sems ma skyes pa gsar du sgye ba'i rgyun chad par gsung ba ltar ro/ /des na bsam gyis mi khyab brjod kyis mi lang ba'i rnam par smin pa rab tu tsha ba myong dgos pa'i las tshabs po che de 'dra ba la ni srog gi phyir yang mi 'jug cing / de 'dra ba'i kun slong gi bsam pa phra mo tsam yang bkag nas tshe rabs thams cad du'ang / de 'dra ba'i las tshabs po che gsog par ma gyur cig ces smon lam gdab bo/ /sngon dge bshes gsal she zer ba sde snod thams cad la sbyangs pa'i mkhas pa zhig yod pa des nam zhig na sde 'khrug gi dpon po byas pas/ dge bshes ston pa'i zhal nas/ nga'i gsal she lo gsum gyis shi ba 'gyangs/ kho de'i gong du shi na sde snod gsum pa zhig shi ba yin pa la gsungs/yang dge bshes po to ba mya ngan las 'da' khar/ dge 'dun rnams la zhal gdams gnang ste/ rang res gtor ma chen po zhig bzhengs te mna' zhig bsgag dgos yod de ma byung /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dung la rdul phyis pa bzhin 'or phyis la gtong ba de dge 'dun gye sde 'khrug 'di yin no gsungs/ de lta bu'i gnad rnams bsams nas spyir sems can su la'ang ngan sems mi bskyed cing / rnam pa kun nas gang phan dang / lhag 467

par rang gi mig lam du snang ba'i grogs chos mdzad rnams la dag snang dang gus pa ci sgye bya'o/ /zhes gsungs so//smras pa/ mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan tshad med rnams/ /mngon du gyur kyang sbas pa'i tshul ston zhing / /mngon mtho nges legs ma nor lam bzang kun/ /mngon sum ston mkhas bla mas rtag tu skyongs/ /chos pas 'jig rten glu len mi 'os kyang / /chos kyi mgur dbyangs skabs re len par rigs/ /chos bzhin byed pa'i bya btang rnal 'byor ngas/ /chos kyi mgur dbyangs snyan la ring ba len/ /nga ni theg chen blo sbyong mkhan yin zer/ /bslab pa phra mo khyad du gsod mi rung / /so so thar nas rdo rje jeg pa'i bar/ /rang gis khas blangs bslab pa nyams med srungs/ /bdag 'dzin med pa gzhan gyis go ba'i phyir/ /shing gnyan gcod dang mdze bo 'grogs pa sogs/ /tho co'i spyod pa ngan pa rnams spangs te/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen ston pas rwa sgreng du/ /bstan pa'i srol bzang btsugs pa'i bka' gdams kyi/ /rnam thar dag dang nam yang 'gal mi bya/ /mi yi gnod pa bzod la lha 'dre yi/ /gnod pa mi bzod che la gus na yang / /chung la brnyas dang gnyen la byams na yang / /dgra la sdang ba la sogs phyogs re ba/ /thams cad spangs nas kun la blo 'byong 468

dgos/ /snga sor rang nyid gces par 'dzin pa de/ /da ni bdag pas gzhan gces bsgyur na legs/ /lus ngag spyod pa chos mthun grogs 'dra bar/ /'gyur ldog med par rang so thub par bya/ /blo sbyong thams cad mngon tshan chung ba la/ /sa chod gzhan las che ba byed pa dgos/ /gzhan skyon zhar ba tshul khrims 'chal sogs la/ /mi snyan tshig rnams nam yang brjod mi bya/ /gzhan gyi yid 'ong 'jam pa'i gtam rnams smra/ /sems can spyi dang khyad par chos pa yi/ /skyon 'dra mthong na rang snang ma dag pa'i/ /dbang gis de ltar snang ba ma gtogs pa/ /khong la de 'dra'i skyon med snyam du bsams/ /gzhan gyi skyon la nam yang rtogs mi bya/ /rang rgyud nyon mongs gang che sngon la 'dul/ /rang 'dod rnyed bkur re ba rgyab tu bskyur/ /gces 'dzin dbang gis dge sbyor gang byed spangs/ /gnod pa byas pa 'khon du 'dzin mi bya/ /tshig ngan lan du tshig ngan mi smra zhing / /nyes pa byung na 'dis lan zer mi rung / /gnod pa'i lan du gnod pa bskyal mi bya/ /khag ngan gzhan gye thog tu bsgyur ba spangs/ /nad gdon zhi phyir blo sbyong bsgom mi bya/ /thun mong longs spyod thabs kyis len pa spangs/ /nga rgyal rlom sems gtan nas byed mi rung / /rang skyid gzhan kun sdug na bsam mi bya/ /de dang de 'dra'i blo sbyong dam 469

tshig rnams/ /nam yang nyams pa med par bsrung nus na/ /gnas skabs mthar thug 'dod don ma lus pa/ /'bad med lhun gyis 'grub par gdon mi za/ /deng nas bzung ste tshe rabs thams cad du/ /bdag gzhan 'gro kun mtho nas mtho ru song / /mthar thug sangs rgyas zhing du legs phyin nas/ /ngo mtshar ltad mo sna tshogs blta bar smon/ /zhes pa bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o//bdun pa blo sbyong gi bslab bya bstan pa ni/ rgyal sras rin po ches/ blo sbyong mi nyams shing 'phel bar byed pa'i thabs la slob pa ste/ de la zas dang gos kyi rnal 'byor la sogs pa thams cad gzhan phan gye sems 'ba' zhig gis byed pa'o/ /blo sbyong bsgom pas na tsha dang 'dre gdon dang / mis sdang ba dang /rang gi nyon mongs cher 'gro ba la sogs byung nas blo sbyong sgom snying mi 'dod pa byung na/ 'jig rten gye khams na bdag gi nyes pa 'di lta bu byung ba'i sems can mang po yod pas/ de rnams snying re rje snyam du bsams nas/ de dag gi nyes pa rnams bdag la 'dus par gyur cig snyam du bsam zhing gtong len bsgom par bya'o/ /snga dro'i tshe de ring byang chub kyi sems gnyis dang mi 'bral bar bya dgos snyam pa'i 'phen pa btang nas/ nyin 470

mo'ang de bzhin du dran shes bzhin gyis zin par byas la/dgong mo nyal ba na nyin par gyi spyod pa rnams la brtags te/byang chub kyi sems gnyis dang 'gal ba byung na/ bdag la mngan bgrangs te bshag pa byas la/ phyis de 'dra mi 'byung ba'i blo bskyed/ ma 'gal bar 'dug na dga' ba bsgoms te/ phyis kyang de bzhin du bya'o snyam du bsam mo/ /'khor dang longs spyod la sogs pa phun sum tshogs pa byung na des ma dregs par sgyu ma lta bur shes par bya ste/ gzhan la phan pa'i thabs su ci 'gyur bya zhing / shin tu rgud de 'og nas 'gro ba chu las med pa byung na yang / de yang sgyu ma lta bur shes par bya ste/ gzhan gyi rgud pa thams cad len pa la zhum pa med par bya'o/ /chos spyi'i dam tshig dang / khyad par blo sbyong gi dam tshig gnyis med na/ 'di phyi'i bde ba gang yang mi 'byung bas/ dam tshig gnyis srog las kyang gces par bsrung ba'o/ /nyon mongs pa skyes pa na/ dang po dran pa dka'/ bar du bzlog pa dka'/ tha mar rgyun chod par dka' bas/ dang po nam skyes pa na ngos zin par byas la/ bar du gnyen po'i stobs bskyed de spangs nas/ mthar mi 'byung bar bya ba'i phyir 'bad par bya'o/ /chos bsgrub pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo bla ma bzang po dang mjal ba dang / rang gi blo las su rung bas 471

chos tshul bzhin nyams su longs pa dang / chos bsgrub pa la dgos pa'i mthun rkyen 'dzom pa ste/ de gsum rang la tshang na dga' ba bsgom zhing gzhan la de gsum tshang bar smon lam gdab/ rang la de gsum ma tshang na 'jig rten gyi khams na bdag ltar rgyu'i gtso bo gsum ma tshang bas chos rnal ma ma byung ba mang po yod pas/ de rnams snying re rje snyam du de rnams kyi rgyu gsum ma tshang ba'i nyes pa thams cad bdag la smin nas/ de dag la rgyu gsum tshang bar gyur cig snyam du zhe thag pa nas sgom mo/ /theg pa chen po'i yon tan thams cad bla ma'i mos gus la rag las pas/ bla ma la mos gus nyams pa med pa dang / blo sbyong theg chen gye yang snying yin pas/ de sgom pa la spro ba nyams pa med pa dang / theg pa che chung gi bslab bya phra mo tshun chad ma nyams par bsrung ba'o/ /de rnams kyi nang nas kyang bla ma'i mos gus 'di shin tu gal che ste/ rnal 'byor gye dbang phyug rje btsun mi la ras pa de nyid dben pa'i ri la bzhugs dus/ dbus phyogs su sprin langs pa nam mthong ba'i tshe/ sprin ma gi'i 'og na/nga'i bla ma yod gsungs nas phyag mdzad cing khyad par mchong lung khyung gi rdzong na 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po'i ngang la bzhugs pa'i dus nam zhig gi tshe/ 'tsho ba'i sta gon la bzhengs 472

pas/ phye tshwa chu sdor dag lta ci smos te/ go kha na shing yang mi 'dug thab kha na chu dang me yang mi 'dug pas/ nga'i 'di ha cang rang yang blos btang drags 'dug pas/ shing zhig 'thu ru 'gro dgos dgongs nas byon te/ shing thu ba gang tsam rnyed pa'i tshe rlung chen po zhig glo bur du langs nas ras bzung tshe shing khyer/ shing bzung tshe ras khyer ba las thugs dgongs la/ ngas sngar ri khrod du de tsam zhig bsdad rung / da dung bdag 'dzin blos ma thongs par 'dug bdag 'dzin blos ma thongs pa'i chos sgrub pas ci byed snyam/ ras dga' na ras khyer/ shing dga' na shing khyer gsungs/ gnyis ka blos btang ste bzhugs pas/ 'tsho ba ngan pa'i stobs kyis bser ma'i rnam pas yug cig thugs dran med du thim pa las bzhengs pa'i tshe/ rlung zhi ba dang ras de shing sdong gcig gi rtse la ling nge 'dug pa dang /thugs skyo ba'i nyams shar ba'i ngang la pha bong lug ro tsam zhig gi khar mnyam par bzhag pa'i mthar/ shar phyogs gro bo lung gi phyogs su sprin dkar po zhig ling nge byung bas/ sprin ya gi'i 'og na gro bo lung gi dgon pa yod/ de na nga'i bla ma sgra bsgyur mar pa lo tstsha de bzhugs te snyam pa dang / bla ma yab yum mched grogs rdo rje spun gye 'khor dang bcas pa'i dbus na rgyud kyi bshad pa 473

dbang dang gdams ngag rnams gnang tshul dran nas/ da lta bzhugs na ci la thug rung mjal du 'gro ba yin te dgongs pa dang / sngar gyi skyo shas de'i khar bla ma dran drags/ thugs skyo ba tshad las 'das pa zhig gi ngang nas/ sbyan chab mang po bsil zhing thugs skyo ba'i gdung dbyangs bla ma dran drug gi mgur 'di gsungs so/ /pha dran pas gdung sel mar pa'i zhabs/ /sprang gdung dbyangs thal lo mar pa rje/ /brag dmar mchong lung shar phyogs na/ /chu 'dzin sprin dkar lang ma ling / /sprin dkar po ldang ba'i 'og cig na/ /rgyab ri glang chen 'gying ba'i mdun zhig na/ /mdun ri seng chen 'gying 'dra'i steng zhig na/ /gnas chen gro bo lung gi dgon pa na/ /rdo chen a mo li ga'i khye steng na/ /gdan khri snyan sa le'i pags steng na/ /de ni su bzhugs su mi bzhugs/ /de na sgra bsgyur mar pa bzhugs/ /dus da lta bzhugs na dga' ba la/ /nga mos gus chung rung mjal snying 'dod/ /gdung sems chung rung mjal snying 'dod/ /ngas bsam zhing mtshan ldan bla ma dran/ /bsgom zhing mar pa lo tstsha dran/ /yum ma las lhag pa'i bdag med ma/ /dus da lta bzhugs na dga' ba la/ /sa skor thag ring yang mjal snying 'dod/ /lam bgrod par dka' yang mjal snying 'dod/ /bsam zhing mtshan 474

ldan bla ma dran/ /bsgom zhing mar pa lo tstsha dran/ /rgyud zab mo dgyes pa rdo rje de/ /dus da lta gsungs na dga' ba la/ /nga shes rab chung rung 'dzin snying 'dod/ /blo gros chung yang skyor snying 'dod/ /bsam zhing mtshan ldan bla ma dran/ /bsgom zhing mar pa lo tstsha dran/ /snyan brgyud brda' yi dbang bzhi de/ /da lta bskur na dga' ba la/ /nga 'bul ba chung rung zhu snying 'dod/ /dbang yon med rung zhu snying 'dod/ /bsam zhing mtshan ldan bla ma dran/ /bsgom zhing mar pa lo tstsha dran/ /khrid zab mo nā ro chos drug de/ /da lta gsungs na dga' ba la/ /nga snying rus chung rung zhu snying 'dod/ /nga sgom bsran chung rung sgom snying 'dod/ /bsam zhing mtshan ldan bla ma dran/ /bsgom zhing mar pa lo tstsha dran/ /mched grogs dbus gtsang dad 'dus de/ /da lta bzhugs na dga' ba la/ /nga nyams rtogs ngan rung bsdur snying 'dod/ /go ba zhan rung bsdur snying 'dod/ /bsam zhing mtshan ldan bla ma dran/ /bsgom zhing mar pa lo tstsha dran/ /sprang mos gus kyi ngang nas 'bral med kyang / /bla ma snying nas dran pa yi/ /'dod pas gdungs nas bzod glags med/ /dbugs stod du 'tshangs nas skad ma thon/ /bu'i gdung ba sol cig bka' drin can/ /zhes gsungs/475

yang rgyal ba dge 'dun grub kyis nyin gcig shar phyogs gangs ri'i rtse na sprin dkar po ldang ba mthong bas rkyen byas/ rje yab sras chos mdzad mched grogs dang bcas pa dran te/ shar gangs ri ma'i gdung dbyangs 'di blangs so/ /shar gangs ri dkar po'i rtse mo na/ /sprin dkar po gnam la bsnyegs 'dra ba/ /de mthong ba'i mod la bla ma dran/ /drin bsams shing bsams shing dad pa skyes/ /sprin dkar po ldang ba'i shar phyogs na/ /'brog dge ldan rnam par rgyal ba der/ /mtshan brjod par dka' ba'i drin po che/ /pha blo bzang grags pa yab sras bzhugs/ /lam rim pa gnyis kyi rnal 'byor sogs// /chos zab la shin tu rgyas par gsungs/ /bod kha ba can gye skal ldan la/ /mgon khyod kyi bka' drin bsam mi khyab/ /sgos snyom las 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun grub/ /blo cung zad chos la phyogs pa 'di/ /rje yab sras rnams kyi bka' drin yin/ /drin che bar nges so yab sras rnams/ /dus 'di nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ /rje yab sras khyed rnams ma gtogs par/ /skyabs re sa gzhan du mi 'tshol bas/ /thugs brtse ba'i lcags kyus drang du gsol/ /drin ji bzhin 'khur bar ma nus kyang / /sems chags sdang dbang du ma song bar/ /mgon khyod kyi bstan pa 'dzin pa la/ /dus nam 476

yang brtson pa bgyed par sgon/ /lar da lta gangs ri'i khrod 'di na/ /rang bstan pa 'dzin par khas len cing / /gzhan bstan 'dzin dgra bo'i dwangs mar 'dzin/ /tshul 'di la skyo ba gting nas skyes/ /gzhan 'phung bar 'dod pa'i kun slong dang / /rgyud mtshan 'dzin dam pos bcings lags kyang / /lam mthon por gnas pa'i khas len byed/ /'di brtags na kun gyis khrel ba'i rgyu/ /lam gol sar rgas pa'i sdug yus kyis/ /chos tshul bzhin byed pa'i gang zag la/ /rgyud khong nas 'khrugs pa'i gdug sems can/ /gdon thugs la zhugs pa ma lags sam/ /dgra nyon mongs 'dul thabs mi byed par/ /gshags 'gyed pa tsam gye bshad nyan yang / /'dre shar sgo'i phyogs su gnas pa la/ /glud nub sgor gtong ba don re chung / /don de ltar go ba'i bshes gnyen nga / /spyir lus can kun la bka' drin bsam/ /sgos chos mdzad yongs la dag snang sbyong / /dgra nang na 'dug pa'i nyon mongs 'dul/ /mi kho bo'i rjes 'jug grogs po rnams/ /yid phyogs su lhung bas ma bcings par/ /blo gzu bor gnas pa'i rtog dpyod kyis/ /lam drang por zhugs pa cis kyang legs/ /gtam 'di la brten nas 'gro ba rnams/ /byams snying rjes drangs pa'i sems bskyed dang / /dbyings spros bral rtogs 477

pa'i lta ba yis/ /dpal bla med byang chub myur thob shog /gsungs/ rgyal ba bskal bzang rgya mtshos kyang / ri sman ljongs dri bzang ngad pa 'thul/ /dus gsum du me tog lding khang bkra/ /shing g.yu lo rgyas pa'i tshang tshing gis/ /rje bla ma'i mdzes sku yid la shar/ /chab lhung lhung 'bab pa'i nyal 'gro'i sgra/ /yid khus su phebs pa'i 'dab chags skad/ /chos legs bshad dar dir sgrogs pa yis/ /rje bla ma'i gsung dbyangs yid la dran/ /ston g.ya' dang bral ba'i dgung sngon spor/ /sprin dkar gsal lang long rtsib shar sgreng / /nyi gzhon gyi 'od snang lam lam 'dis/ /rje bla ma'i mkhyen brtse yid la shar/ /gsungs/ de bzhin du bla ma skyes bu dam pa mang pos/ bla ma dran pa'i gdung dbyangs blangs pa mang ngo / /des na rang nyid yul gang na gnas kyang bla ma mi brjed par nyi ma re re bzhin yang yang yid la dran par byas te/sangs rgyas dngos su mos la rab tu gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing gsol 'debs kyi gdung dbyangs len par bya'o/ /sngon zhang sgom ri bas/ chos rje rgod tshang ba la khrid zhus nas/ ling nge'i brag la sgom gyen bzhugs pas/ mnga' bdag yab yum shin tu dad de/ dgra nag gi dbang zhig zhu bar 'dod nas/ khong ba gdan drangs zhabs tog bzang po byas te/ drung 478

ba gang la thugs dam mdzad pa'i chos shig thugs la 'dogs par zhu/ bdag cag kyang de la yi dam byed pa lags/ zhus pas/khong ba na re/ bdag la nyams su blang rgyu'i chos gsum yod de/nyid cag gis mi 'ong mchi/ yong na byen pas chog gsungs/khong tsho'i bsam pa la nag 'jigs skor gsum yin yong snyam nas/ gsum po cis kyang thugs la 'dogs par zhu/ bdag cag kyang nyams su len lags zhus pas/ khong ba na re/ 'o na chos rnam dag byed pa la/ chags sdang spong dgos par gsungs/ dang po 'dod pa'i yul spong bya ba yin pas/ bdag la'ang nyid cag gi mnga' thang tsam med kyang / bsam gling la sogs pa'i dgon gzhis dang / 'bri mtshams phyogs na 'khor dang bu slob rgya che rab yod de/ de thams cad spangs nas bya bral byas pa de nyams len gcig lags te/ de nyid cag gis mi 'ong mchi/ gnyis pa dgra'i sgo gsham bar ma la rgyob bya ba yin pas/ nged rang gi dgra rnams kyi yul du phyin nas sgo yon blangs pas khong tsho'ang shin tu dad de/ khong 'di bzhin mdzad phyin chad/ 'o skol rnams kyis kyang zhabs tog bya dgos zer nas nang du bos te bsnyen bkur bzang po byas/ de ltar dgra rnams dga' ba bskyed cing rang gzhan gyi zhe sdang zhi bar byas pa de gcig 479
