lags te mi 'ong mchi/ gsum pa ni chags sdang spangs shing dben pa bsten nas/ dal bar bsdad du phangs par gda' bas/ sgo gsum skad cig kyang mi dal bar dge sbyong gyis/ de gcig lags te mi 'ong mchi/ gsungs pa ltar/ lus ngag yid gsum dge ba dang mi 'bral bar byed pa'o/ /yul sems can dang sems can ma yin pa thams cad la phyogs ris med par blo sbyong ba dang / blo la gang shar thams cad blo sbyong gis khyab par byas nas/ kha tsam ma yin par gting nas 'byong bar byed pa'o/ /rang gi 'gran zlar 'dug pa dang lhan cig tu 'grogs pa dang / phar gnod pa ma byas kyang tshur gnod pa byed pa dang /phan btags pa'i lan du gnod sgyel ba dang / las kyi dbang gis snying du mi sdug pa la sogs pa skye dka' ba rnams la lhag par byams snying rje sgom zhing / bla ma dang pha ma la sogs pa yul gnyan pa rnams la gnod par 'gyur ba khyad par du spang bar bya'o/ /zas gos la sogs 'dzoms pa dang / mi dang mi ma yin gyi gnod pa med pa dang / khams bzang ba la sogs pa mthun rkyen 'dzoms pa la mi ltos par/ mthun rkyen ma 'dzoms na ma 'dzoms pa de nyid byang chub kyi sems kyi sgo nas lam du 'khyer ba'o/ /thog ma med pa nas lus ji snyed blangs pa don med du 480

song 'dug da res kyi tshe 'di la don gye gtso bo zhig sgrub dgos par 'dug pas/ tshe 'di bas chos gtso/ chos la bshad sgrub gnyis las sgrub pa gtso/ chos gzhan pas byang chub kyi sems sbyong ba gtso/ de'ang lung rigs kyi sgo nas sbyong ba las bla ma'i man ngag la brten nas sbyong ba gtso che ste/ ting nge 'dzin tshogs kyi le'u las/ ji tsam gyi sems mnyam par 'jog nus pa de tsam gyis gdams ngag kho nas tshim par byas la/ sems kyi ngang tshul 'phral du 'byung ba yang / bla ma la zhus shing bsgom par bya yis/tshad ma rnam bdun dang / brda' sprod rnam bzhi dang / chos mngon pa rnam bdun dang / rnal 'byor spyod pa'i sa la sogs pa'i mtshan mas yid mi gdung ste/ bskal pa dpag tu med par ngal ba byas kyang / tha snyad nye bar sbyar ba dag ni mi zad kyis/tshe yongs su gtugs pa kho nar zad do zhes dang / jo bo rje'i zhal nas/ tshe ni yun thung shes bya'i gnas kyang mang / /tshe yi tshad kyang ci tsam ma nges pas/ /ngang bas chu la 'o ma len pa ltar/ /rang gi 'dod pa dang du blang bar bya/ /gsungs/ de yang po to ba dang / dge bshes chos kyi 'od zer bya ba'i mkhas pa chen bo zhig yod pa de gnyis la/ slob ma thun mong ba mang po yod pa las/ khong tsho na re/ po to bas chos bshad dus nges shes 481

skye ba tsam khyed kyis bshad pa la mi skye bar 'dug zhus pas/khong gi thugs dgongs la chos nga mkhas pas de tsug mi thang /'on kyang nga la med pa'i gdams ngag khong la yod pa yin te 'ong snyam nas khong gis kyang po to ba la chos mnyan pas/ khong rang yang nges shes skyes nas/ khong la chos mnyan pas ma shes pa'i shes rgyu ma byung ste/ ma go ba'i go rgyu zhig byung gsungs pas/po to ba na re/ bden/ ma shes pa'i shes rgyu med de chos khyed rang mkhas/ ma go ba'i go rgyu yod de ngas chos kyi mde'u rtse nang du bsgyur nas bshad pa yin gsungs/ des na bla ma'i man ngag rang gi rgyud steng du bskor nas nyams su len pa gces so/ /spyod lam gzhan pas mal du bsdad nas sbyang ba gtso che ste/ sha ra ba'i zhal nas/ ngas mdun ma thams cad stan thog gcig tu bcad pa yin gsungs/ la stod lhor chos 'khor zhig byung ba la/sgyes pa kun rta rtsed la sogs pa mang po byed kyin 'dug pa la/ma cig zha ma'i g.yog mos kyang bltas pas ya mtshan snyam nas/dgong mo ma cig la/ de ring ltad mo gda'/ khyad par du langs nas rta rgyug pa la chags kyin gda' zhus pas/ ma cig na re/ngas de 'dra min pa stan thog tu'ang chags gsungs/ yang dgon pa'i zhal nas/ ltogs 'khyags 'dzom pa'i spyil po ru/ /482

sdug rgur tshugs pa'i snying rus can/ /stan la chags pa'i skya rtsal can/ /gsungs/ rje mi las/ dwags po lha rje la/ gdams ngag zab shos shig yod pa da gzod ster ro gsungs nas ma gnang /dwags po yul la 'gro khar/ gdams ngag de thugs la 'dogs par zhu zhus pas/ phangs par 'dug gsungs nas ma gnang /de nas dwags po ba la skyel thung byas/ so sor khams bde byas nas/ dwags po ba thag ring por song ba dang / bos te log la shog dang gsungs nas/ log phyin pas/ 'phangs te ma phan bstan gyes gsungs nas/ na bza' bslogs te/ stan thog tu bzhugs drags pas/ 'phongs rmen par song ba de bstan nas/zab shos 'di yin no gsungs/ bla ma gong ma 'ga' res ston chen lham rdol brgya las/ sgom chen stan rdol gcig dga' gsungs skad/ des na gnas skor sogs 'gro 'dug mang po mi byed par gnas bzang po gcig nas/ 'phongs rul gdan rdol shi rung / byang chub sems kyi gdams pa zab mo 'di 'dra bsgom dgos/ yul spong ba pas gnyen po bsten pa gtso che bas gtso bo de rnams nyams su len pa'o/ /chos sgrub pa'i duḥ kha mi bzod par dgra 'dul ba dang gnyen skyong ba la sogs pa'i duḥ kha bzod pa bzod pa go log go /chos rnam dag byed pa la 483

'dun pa mi byed par/ tshe 'di'i dpal 'byor la 'dun pa byed pa ni 'dun pa go log go /thos bsam sgom gsum gye sgo nas chos kyi ro mi myang bar/ 'jig rten gye bde ba'i ro myang ba ni ro myang go log go /sdig pa byed pa la snying rje mi sgom par/chos phyir dka' thub byed pa la snying rje sgom pa ni snying rje go log go /de yang sngon slob dpon paṇḍi ta zer ba dang / nye gnas gzhon rgyal zer ba gnyis spun yin pas/ paṇḍi ta na re/ gzhon rgyal zer ba'i blo ma khug pa 'chi ba ma dran pa 'di snying rje gsungs/ nye gnas na re/ paṇḍi ta zer ba'i mkhos med bo rang gi lto gos tsam yang mi 'byor ba 'di snying rje zer lo/ kho'i de go log yin gsungs/ go log 'di pe ta mgon skyid kyis kyang byas te/ mos 'bad rtsol chen po byas pas rtsam pa bre bzhi tsam dang / sha gzug gcig chang dam gang rnyed nas khyer te/ mi la bzhugs sar phyin nas btsal ba'i dus su ma rnyed/ mjug tu brag 'og cig na 'dug pas/ khong zas su zwa kho na gsol bas mdog sngo nag tu song / tshwa med pas lus la spu chen po skyes 'dug pa mthong nas/ 'di mi ma yin nam snyam du 'jigs pa zhig byung /legs par brtags pas so de 'dra bar 'dug nas rtsa ru phyin te lag pas 'jus nas/ gzhan gye chos pa kun rang yang skyid/484

gnyen la yang phan pa zhig 'dug ste/ a jo'i chos 'di 'dra rang sdug la/ gzhan la mi phan pa su'i lugs yin nam zer nas ngus so/ /mo sdug ma chos rgyus chung bas lan pa yin/ a jo de 'dra la snying rje bsgom mi dgos/ thams cad mo'i a jo ltar song na go bcad pa yin/ 'on kyang mo'i de sdig par mi 'gro gsungs/mo'i sha chang de gsol bas rtsa mdud grol nas nam mkha' la 'phur ba yin par 'dug pas don chen grub par gda' gsungs/rang la ltos pa'i mi chos la mi sbyor bar tshe 'dir dpal 'byor che ba'i thabs la sbyor ba na gnyer sems go log go /'khor 'das kyi bde ba dang dge ba la dga' ba mi bsgom par/ dgra la duḥ kha byung na dga' ba bsgom pa ni rjes su yi rang go log go /go log drug spangs nas/ go ma log pa drug nyams su blang bar bya'o/ /chos la nges 'byung ma skyes pas res byed res mi byed pa spangs nas/ rtse gcig tu rgyun mi 'chad par blo sbyong ba'o/ /blo sbyong nyid la blo ling bskyur nas phyogs gcig tu sbyong ba'o/ /rang rgyud la nyon mongs gang che brtags nas de 'bad pa drag pos spang ste/ de nas nyon mongs de sgyes pa'i yul bsten pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas de skye mi skye brtags te/ sgye na yang gnyen pos spang 485

zhing / mi skye bar 'gyur ba'i bar du 'bad par bya'o/ /pha rol la bdag gi drin yod pa dang / rang gis chos yun ring la dos drag pa byas pa dang / mkhas pa dang btsun pa la sogs pa'i yus mi byed pa ste/ bdag pas gzhan gces sgom pa la yus bya sa med do/ /mi la re ba ma che lha la gsol ba thob bya ba rwa sgreng ba'i bka' yin gsungs/ bdag la gzhan gyis mi mang sar rma phab pa la sogs la lan mi bya zhing ko long mi sdom mo/ /da lta 'o skol chos pa rnams kyi chos bdag 'dzin gyi gnyen por ma song bas/ bzod bsran she'u bas chung / ko long gtsang btsan pas dam par 'dug ste/ des chos kyi go mi chod pas bdag 'dzin gyi gnyen por 'gro ba zhig dgos gsungs/ cung zad tsam la dga' mi dga'i rnam 'gyur ston pa ni grogs la gzan pas mi bya'o/ /gzhan la phan btags pa'am/ chos byas pa la tshig gi gtang rag dang / snyan grags la re ba med par bya'o/ /de ltar tshe tril gyis byang chub kyi sems gnyis po mnyam rjes gnyis kyi sgo nas legs par sbyangs nas 'byongs pa'i gdeng thob par bya'o/ /dus dang sems can dang tshe dang nyon mongs pa dang / lta ba'i snyigs ma lnga ste/ lnga bdo ba'i dus 'dir bde ba'i rkyen ni nyung / mi dang mi ma yin gyis 'tshe ba la sogs pa'i duḥ kha'i 486

rkyen shin tu mang bas/ rkyen ngan gye ru 'dzings pa na/ de nyid blo sbyong gi grogs su byas nas blo sbyong bsgoms pas rkyen ngan ci tsam mang yang dge sbyor 'phel bar 'gyur bas/ dug thams cad sman du bsgyur bar byed pa'i bdud rtsi lta bu/ bla ma gser gling ba'i man ngag 'di man ngag gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa yin no/ /de ltar blo sbyong shes na/ grong khyer skyid pa'i 'byung gnas bya ba blo sbyong sgom pa'i lus 'di nyid la zer ba yin te/ rang gzhan 'khor 'das kyi bde ba thams cad 'di las 'byung ba yin pas/ rtsom pa thams cad gcig tu dril nas/sems dang chos 'dres par legs par blo sbyangs na/ ring por mi thogs par rang gzhan gye don phun sum tshogs pa thob par 'gyur ro gsungs so/ /smras pa/ chos rje bla mar phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul/ /chos 'gal sdig ltung kun bshags rjes yi rang / /chos 'khor bskor zhing rtag par bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /chos spyod dge ba byang chub chen po bsngo/ /de ltar tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong gnad bsdus pa'i/ /yan lag bdun pa zhig kyang sngon btang nas/ /slar yang blo sbyong bslab bya'i rim pa rnams/ /tshigs su bcad nas dbyangs su len par bya/ /zas gos spyod kyang gzhan phan 487

sems kyi spyod/ /rkyen ngan mang dus lhag par gtong len sgoms/ /snga dro byang chub sems gnyis bsgom snyam pa'i/ /'phen pa btang nas nyin mo dran shes bsten/ /dgung mo byang chub sems gnyis 'gal ba'i rigs/ /byung na rang la rngan bgrang bshag pa bya/ /phyin chad de 'dra mi byed 'dun pa bskyed/ /ma 'gal 'dug na rang la dga' ba sgoms/ /phyin chad de bzhin bya'o snyam du bsam/ /dar ba byung tshe khengs dregs mi bya zhing / /rgud pa byung yang zhum pa med par bya/ /chos spyi'i dam tshig khyad par blo sbyong gi /dam tshig gnyis po srog las gces par srungs/ /nyon mongs sgyes tshe ngos bzung gnyen pos spangs/ /phyin chad mi 'byung phyir du 'bad par bya/ /bla ma bzang zhing rang blo las su rung / /mthun rkyen 'dzoms tshe de ltar gzhan la yang / /'dzom par gyur cig snyam du smon lam gdab/ /ma 'dzoms dus su 'di ltar ma 'dzoms par/ /lha chos ma 'ongs pa rnams snying re rje/ /ma 'dzoms nyes pa thams cad bdag nyid la/ /'du bar gyur cig snyam du gtong len bya/ /bla ma'i mos gus nyams pa med pa dang / /blo sbyong bsgom la spro ba mi nyams shing / /theg pa che chung bslab bya nyams mi bya/ /lus ngag yid gsum dge dang mi 'bral zhing / /yul la phyogs ris med par 488

blo sbyong sgoms/ /khyad par lam gol rnams la rtag par sgoms/ /mthun rkyen 'dzom la mi blta ma 'dzoms pa/ /de nyid byang chub sems kyi grogs su 'khyer/ /'jig rten 'di bas dam pa'i lha chos gtso/ /chos la bshad sgrub gnyis las sgrub pa gtso/ /lha chos gzhan las byang chub sems gnyis gtso/ /de'ang lung rigs sgo nas sbyong ba las/ /bla ma'i man ngag sgo nas sbyong ba gtso/ /spyod lam gzhan la brten nas sbyong ba las/ /rang gi mal du bsdad nas sbyong ba gtso/ /yul ngan spong las gnyen po bsten pa gtso/ /gtso bo de rnams nyams su len par bya/ /lha chos sgrub pa'i sdug bsngal mi bzod par/ /dgra 'dul ba dang gnyen skyong la sogs pa'i/ /sdug bsngal bzod pa bzod pa go log go /dam chos byed la 'dun pa mi byed par/ /don med tshe 'di'i dpal 'byor che thabs la/ /'dun pa byed pa 'dun pa go log go /thos bsam sgom gsum sgo nas chos kyi ro/ /mi myang 'jig rten 'di yi bde ba'i ro/ /myang ba de ni ro myang go log go /sdig pa byed la snying rje mi bsgom par/ /chos kyi phyir du dka' ba spyod pa la/ /snying rje bsgom pa snying rje go log go /rang la ltos pa'i mi rnams lha chos la/ /mi sbyor tshe 'di'i dpal 'byor che thabs la/ /sbyor ba de ni gnyer sems go log go /'khor 'das gnyis kyi bde dang dge 489

ba la/ /dga' ba mi bsgom sdug bsngal dgra byung na/ /dga' ba rjes su yi rang go log go /go log drug po de nyid shes byas nas/ /ma log pa drug nyams su len par bya/ /res byed res 'jog gnyis po mi byed par/ /rtse gcig rgyun chad med par blo sbyong bsgoms/ /blo sbyong kho na blo gtad dol chod sbyongs/ /nyon mongs gang che brtags nas dug bzhin spangs/ /de nas nyon mongs skyes pa'i yul la brten/ /da dung sgyes sam ma skyes legs par brtags/ /skye na gnyen pos spong zhing phyin chad kyang / /nam yang mi skye bar du 'bad par bya/ /gzhan la lto gos chos kyis phan btags shing / /rang gis chos kyang yun ring byas pa sogs/ /rang gzhan bstan 'gro'i don chen gang bsgrubs kyang / /ngas byas snyam pa'i khong yus ma che zhing / /rang la gzhan gyes mi mang 'tshogs sa ru/ /rma phab na yang ko long mi sdom zhing / /dga' dang mi dga' rnam 'gyur ston pa de/ /grogs la gzan pas nam yang mi bya bar/ /rtag tu 'dzum pa'i bzhin gyis gnas par bya/ /gzhan la phan btags pa dang chos byas pa/ /rnams la tshur la tshig gi gtang rag dang / /snyan grags 'ong du re ba med par bya/ /de ltar blo sbyong bslab bya ma nyams par/ /bslab na rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub par nges/ /zhes pa bar 490

skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /de yang 'o skol rnams kyis dka' las cher med bzhin du/bla ma rnams kyi drin las rang gzhan thams cad 'tshengs pa'i gdams pa yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bu 'di dang 'di 'dra thob pa la dga' spro tshad med pa bskyed cing / tshe blos btang ste dben pa bsten nas nyin mtshan med par dka' spyad snying rus kyi sgo nas nyams su len dgos te/ sngon jo bo bla ma gser gling ba la byang chub sems kyi gdams pa 'di zhu ru phebs dus/ rgya mtsho chen po la gru btang nas zla ba bcu gsum byon pa sogs chos phyir dka' ba mang po spyod dgos byung tshe/ bu slob rnams la khyed rnams kyis dka' ba ma spyad par chos zab mo rnyed pa don re che yi/ da legs par spyod cig gsungs/ rje rin po ches mdo rgyud kyi gsung rab dgongs 'grel thams cad/ gang zag gcig gi nyams len gye rim par dril nas nyams su blangs nas gdeng thob pa'i gsung nyams mgur du mdzad de/ theg chen gnyis kyi thun mong lam dang ni/ /thun mong min pa'i lam gye rim pa gnyis/ /gnad bsdus tshang ba'i lam la 'dris par sbyangs/ /tshul 'di bsams shing 'dun ma legs nas gda'/ /gsungs/ gzhan tsha kho'i dpon po ngag dbang grags pa sogs 491

la nges 'byung byang sems yang dag pa'i lta ba ste/ lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum gnang nas/ de ltar lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum gyi/ /gnad rnams ji bzhin rang gis rtogs pa'i tshe/ /dben pa bsten nas brtson 'grus stobs bskyed de/ /gtan gye 'dun ma myur du sgrubs shig bu/ /gsungs/ de yang sngon rgya gar grub thob lū i pas kyang rje btsun ma'i bka' bzhin dben pa'i gnas su 'tsho ba dka' thub la brten nas sgrub pa mdzad pa dang /grub chen dril bu pas kyang dben pa'i nags khrod du dka' spyad drag po'i sgo nas sgrub pa mdzad par gsungs/ de bzhin du rgya gar gyi grub chen phal mo ches dben pa'i gnas su sgrub pa rtse gcig tu mdzad par gda'/ bod du sngon brag yer pa'i zhang btsun dar ma mi rtag nges 'byung gis rgyud bskul/ zang zing longs spyod kyi 'ching thag rbad kyis bcad/ sku tshe gang po zhen med kyi bya btang kho na mdzad/ gnas dben par sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs/ brag skyibs kyi gnyan ston shāg 'byung gis da lta nyid du 'chi nyen yod gsungs/ tha na me shing gi tshegs yang mi mdzad par bya ri dwags kyi spyod pa dang khyad par med par mdzad nas gnas dben pa rnams su sgrub pa kho na mdzad/'ban gung rgyal gyis 'jig rten chos brgyad mgo bsnyams/492

kun slong ngan pa'i dbang du skad cig kyang ma shor ba mdzad/ sku 'tsho tsam la sdig med kyi bsod snyoms gsol te sgrub pa rang mdzad/ grub thob nyi phug pas/ brag rta sgo dben pa'i mtha' rtsa ru/ phye phul dgu la 'tsho ba'i rten mdzad nas dgung lo bdun sgrub pa mdzad/ shangs lha phu'i rin cen rmog cog pas/ shing lo ma'i zas la bcud len mdzad nas lo bcu gsum sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs/ rgyal gyi shrī'i rje rgyal ba rgod tshang bas byang lha khab dben pa'i mtsho dbus su tshe blos btang chu yi dka' thub la brten nas lo gsum du sgrub pa'i srol kha bzung / mon bum thang gi dung mtsho ras pas 'jig rten gyi 'dod yon blos btang chu yi bcud len byas/ lo sum cur sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs/ kong sding gi gter ston 'ja' tshon snying pos gnas bang ri 'jog gi ri khrod du lo bcu bdun bug sgo 'dag sbyar mdzad/ grub thob bka' bzhi bas/ gnas sngo ri dben pa'i bas mtha' ru gang byung gi 'tsho ba la brten nas rtse gcig tu sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs/ ngor chen chos kyi rgyal pos gnas dpal ri gnyis pa dmar sgom du/ 'jig rten gye zhen pa blos btang nas tshe hril bor sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs/ rje garma pa chos 'phel gyis gnas dmigs lung dben pa'i bas mtha' 493

ru/ lo bcu gnyis sgrub khang gcig tu bzhugs/ ri mtshams kyi kha rag sgom chung bas/ gtsang gi jo mo kha rag gi brag phug tu/ri dwags kyi 'o ma sogs la brten nas sgrub pa yun ring mdzad/yul ngam shod kyi chos rje lo ras pas/ byang gnam mtsho phyug mo'i mtsho dbus su/ lo gcig gi 'tsho rten la dpon g.yog gnyis kyis lo bdun gye rgyags byas sgrub pa mdzad pa dang / khyad par du rje btsun mi la ras chen de/ brag dkar rta so dbu ma rdzong na bzhugs dus na/ bka' gdams pa'i dge bshes sher seng bya ba de/ bal por rten mchod bsgrub pa la 'ongs nas/klong mda' nas bltas pas brag dkar na dud pa sngo khyug byung ba mthong nas lam 'grul la/ ya gir su yod pa yin dris pas/ya gi na gung thang rtsa ba mi la sher rgyal gyi bu thos pa dga' bya ba khu bo dang yul ba thams cad phung la gtong mkhan de yod pa yin zer/ dge bshes kyis yang dris pa/ 'o na khos da lta der ci byed pa yin byas pas/ lam 'grul la la na re/ sdig bshag byed pa yin zer/ la la na re/ da dung yang mthu sgrub pa yin zer/tshod longs pa mi 'dug zer/ der dge bshes bal por 'gro ba bshol nas brag dkar la phyin pas/ phug pa'i nang na mi gcer bu lus thal skya thul le ba zhig 'dug pas/ dge bshes kyis khyed 494

'dir ci byed pa yin/ 'dir bsdad nas ci tsam song byas pas/mi la na re/ skye shi'i 'jigs pas chos byed pa yin/ 'dir bsdad nas lo bcu gcig tsam song zer/ dge bshes kyi bsam pa la/ 'o na khong gis nga'i sna lan cig byed yong bsams nas yug tsam bsdad pas/ mi la na re/ khyed rang brag rtsa pha gir song la bzhugs mdzod zer bas/ dge bshes brag rtsar phyin nas bsdad pas/ mi la'i bsam pa la/ dge bshes la khur po chen po 'dug pas/ nga la yang bza' rgyu 'dra ster ram bsams nas yod tsa na/ nyin gcig na dge bshes na re/ sgom chen pa 'dir shog dang / nga'i mig la rdul song ba len rogs gyis zer bas/mi la phyin nas khong gi mig rdul bsal nas phug la yar bltas pas/ dge bshes kyis rdza ma la zan g.yos pa dang / skyo tsha skol ba'i zan kha le 'dug pa/ gzhan yang rtsam pa dang / mar dang /bu ram yang 'dug pas/ mi la'i bsam pa la/ dge bshes 'dis nga la bza' rgyu byin pa'i rigs su mi 'dug pas/ rdza ma de g.yar nas bkrus la 'thung dgos/ yug cig gis bcud len du 'gro bar 'dug bsams nas/ nga'i rdza ma chag pas dge bshes kyi rdza ma de thebs shig g.yar dgos gsungs pas/ khong ba'i bsam pa la/ sgom chen pa ri khar yun ring bsdad pa gtsang 495

sbra che ba yin pas rdza ma bkrus nas gtad dgos bsams nas/nyid cag yug tsam phar bzhud dang / de nas ngas skad cig btang tsam na rdza ma len du byon zer bas mi la'i bsam pa la rdza ma g.yar byas pa de legs/ nga la zan mar cig dang skyo tsha zhig ster bar 'dug de yang zan dang skyo tsha sbags nas za bu ram la bcud byed/ mar la sku mnye byed bsams te dga' nas yod tsa na/ dge bshes kyi rdza ma len du byon zer bas phyin tsa na/rdza ma bkrus nas gtsang sang nge gtad du byung bas/ der mi la ngo nag ting byas nas/ da rdza ma mi dgos zer nas song / 'di la ni bla ma rje btsun chen po dpal ldan bzhad pa'i rdo rje dus phyis kyang yang yang de'i nyin mo las yi mug pa ma byung gsungs skad/ de nas dge bshes rgyags zad nas yul du phyin te/ gle gleng la zhor 'phros byung bas/ ska skyongs pa mkhan po na re/ sgom chen de rgyags med phongs pa zhig yod pa min nam/ khyed kyis rdza ma len shog byas dus lag na ci 'dug gsungs/ lag na phor gog stong pa zhig 'dug zhus pas/ 'o de yin sgrub pa po rgyags med cig yin par 'dug pas/ da myur por bsnyen bkur bzang po khyer la song / chos kyang zhus gsungs nas/ yang brag dkar du cha rkyen bzang po khyer nas phyin pa dang / khong rnams 496

sleb pa'i zla ba gcig gi sngon tsam la rje btsun grub pa thob nas gnya' nang phyogs su gshegs tshar 'dug zer/ dus phyis zhabs la gtugs nas chos zhus pas grub thob chen po li khor byar ru yin skad/ gtam rgyud 'di rnams gsan dus kyu ra rin po che 'bri gung bas spyan chab dpag tu med pa byon skad do/ /dus phyis kyang 'bri gung ba'i zhal nas/ ri ba rnams la khyed tsho ri la 'gro ba rnams kyis phug ston re gyis la 'tsho ba mnyam por zo zhig la la phyug po/ la la dbul po ma byed cig gsung nan chen po mdzad pa yin zer/ da lta yang ri ba tshos phug ston re byed pa gtam rgyud 'di'i rjes su 'brangs nas byed pa lags so/ /yang bya zhig gis lug gi sre long zhig phug sgor bskyur nas song ba des kyang zla ba gsum tsam chu'i dbal bsad pas lus po mnyen lcug ge song skad/ de bzhin du dka' spyad snying rus kyi sgo nas tshe dang sgrub pa bsnyams nas da lta 'chi yang nyams dga' yal le/shes pa spro seng nge / bag dro 'ur re/ blo bde bol le 'chi ba zhig bya dgos te/ ma cig ri ma'i zhal nas/ mi zhig 'chi ba nga las nyams dga' ba med/ nga'i 'chi ba 'di kun dper na ri chen po'i 'og nas thar pa'i tshod yin gsungs/ de 497

'dra des duḥ kha 'dod kyang mi myong ste/ glang thang pa chen po sku 'da' ru 'cha' tsa na/ nga dmyal ba skye ru 'dod nas snying thag pas smon lam mang po btab pa yin te/ de'i smon lam mi 'grub pa 'dra/ da lta nga la dag pa'i snang ba 'ba' zhig las/ tha mal gyi snang ba tsam yang mi 'dug gsungs/ zhang ston chos bla grongs khar mgur gsungs pa/ skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum la blo gtad byas/ /rin chen byang chub mchog tu sems bsgyed cing / /zab yangs chos kyi ngang las ma g.yos bar/ /'chi ba 'di ni bsod nams bsags pa yin/ /gsungs/ rnal 'byor gye dbang phyug 'chad kha bas thugs legs par sbyangs pas/bdag pas gzhan gces kyi thugs rang 'dod kyi 'khri ba gtan nas med pa skyes pa'i gdeng thob tshe/ sngon sbyangs las kyi 'phro sad pas/ /rang gi mos pa mang ba'i rgyus/ /sdug bsngal gtam ngan khyad bsad nas/ /bdag 'dzin 'dul ba'i gdams ngag zhus/ /da ni shi yang mi 'gyod do/ /gsungs/ de bzhin du mdo smad phyogs kyi rje btsun dpal ldan bkra shis kyi zhal nas/ nga dang po 'chi ba 'jigs nas thos pa btsal/ /bar du 'chi brod dgos snyam nyams len byas/ /tha ma 'chi rgyu med par nyal nas bsdad/ /rgad po nga yi bya ba tshar nas gda'/ /gsungs pa de lta 498

bu zhig bya dgos/ mjug tu de ltar nyams su blangs pa'i dge tshogs rnams rang gzhan gyi gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'dod pa'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i phyir 'dun pa drag pos bsngo ba smon lam bya dgos te/ bsod nams dam pa'i mdo las/ mi lus thob pa'i dus 'dir dge ba chung ngu nas bsag dgos/ de yang bsngo dgos/ ma bsngos pa'i rdzas rnams ni bye tshan la chu thigs brgyab na myur du bskam pa dang 'dra/ bsngo ba byas pa'i phan yon ni/ rgya mtsho chen por chu thigs shig blugs na chu de mi zad cing slar 'phel bar 'gyur ba dang 'dra gsungs/ sngon de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen snying po la/ rgyal bo rtsibs kyi mu khyud 'khor bcas kyis bsnyen bkur dpag med byas nas/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bla na med pa'i byang chub tu bsngor bcug pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med du gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'brug sgra dbyangs kyi rgyal po la/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po nam mkhas bsnyen bkur dpag med mdzad nas de bzhin gshegs pa zhing gzhan du gshegs pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba gang du bsngo je tshom du gyur pa na/ de bzhin gshegs pa des sprul pa zhig btang ste/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rdzogs pa'i byang 499

chub tu bsngor bcug pas/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs su gyur/ sngon yul dbus kyi rgyal po gos sbyin gyes/ sangs rgyas rin chen gtsug tor can 'khor bcas la bsnyen bkur byas nas/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po thob par bsngos nas dung phul bas/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po dung du 'gyur bar lung bstan pa dang / mtha'i rgyal po nor ldan gyis sangs rgyas rin chen gtsug tor can 'khor bcas la bsnyen bkur nas dge ba'i rtsa ba rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngos nas/bcom ldan 'das mgon po byams par 'gyur bar lung bstan pa byung / sngon sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das yangs pa'i grong khyer na bzhugs dus/ yul mi rnams kyis chos ston drangs pa'i dge ba rnams/ khong rnams kyi pha mes yi dwags su skyes pa rnams kyi don du bsngos pas/ yi dwags rnams de nyid du tshe 'phos nas sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha gnas su skyes/ sngon grong khyer rdo can gye bshan pa dang smad 'tshong ma sogs dmyal bar skyes nas sdug bsngal myong ba rnams kyi don du yul na yod pa'i bu dang bu mo rnams kyis khong rnams kyis bsags pa'i zas nor gyi steng nas/'phags pa kā tyā ya na la bsod snyoms phul/ 'phags pas kyang bsngo ba mdzad pas/ de dag rnams dmyal ba nas thar par gyur/500

sngon dbul mo gnyen dga' mos/ mar bslangs nas gyo ril zhig gi nang du mar me chung ngu zhig sbar nas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar phul bas/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis skye dgu'i tshe lo brgya thub pa na/ 'jig rten du ston pa shākya thub pa ji lta ba de bzhin du bdag kyang 'gyur bar shog cig ces smon lam btab pas/ sangs rgyas kyis kun dga' bo la/ bu mo 'di ni ma 'ongs pa'i dus na sangs rgyas mar me 'od ces bya ba dbang bcu dang ldan par 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan pa byung /sngon sangs rgyas 'jig rten dbang phyug rgyal po'i drung du/ dge slong chos kyi 'byung gnas kyis rang gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams bzung ba ji bzhin du bdag kyang smon lam 'debs kyis 'grub par gyur cig ces brjod pas/ bde ba can gye zhing khams grub par gyur/ sngon mu lto ba'i dpon zhig gis 'phags pa rang sangs rgyas shig la snum 'khur zhig phul nas/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis bdag mi'i rgyal por gyur te/ 'di ba'i khyad du 'phags pa'i ston pa la bsnyen bkur bar shog ces smon lam btab pas/ shākya'i rgyal po bzang ldan du gyur nas/ sangs rgyas 'khor bcas la bsnyen bkur rgya chen po byas so/ /sngon yul mi zhig gis sangs rgyas 'od srungs kyi mchod rten gye glang po'i 501

gzugs zhig pa bcos shing ldong ros kyis bskus te smon lam btab pas/ tshe rabs thams cad du gzugs bzang zhing longs spyod che ba dang / gser gyi glang po rtag tu yod par gyur/sngon padma'i mig gis sangs rgyas kyi mchod rten la/ rin po che mthon ka gcig phul bas/ bskal pa dgu bcu rtsa gcig gi bar du 'byor pa che bar gyur/ 'bras bu thob pa'i smon lam btab pas dgra bcom par gyur/ rgyal po ka pi nas sangs rgyas 'od srungs kyi mchod rten la zhig gso byas pas tshe rabs thams cad du phun sum tshogs pa thams cad thob cing / dad pa dang smon lam gye mthus dgra bcom pa'i go 'phang thob par gyur/des na bsags pa'i dge tshogs rnams/ rang gzhan sems can thams cad gnas skabs bde zhing mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang myur du thob pa'i rgyu ru dmigs nas bsngo ba dang smon lam gye rgyas 'debs byed tshul ni/ mgon po klu sgrub kyi gsung 'di ltar bya ste/ de ltar bgyis pa'i bsod nams dang / /bdag gis bgyis dang ma bgyis gang / /des ni sems can thams cad kyang / /bla med byang chub sems ldan shog /sems can thams cad dri med dbang / /yongs rdzogs mi khom kun 'das shing / /spyod pa rang dbang yod pa dang / /'tsho ba bzang 502

dang ldan par shog /lus can dag ni thams cad kyang / /lag na rin chen nyid ldan zhing / /yo byad thams cad mtha' yas pa /'khor ba srid du mi zad shog /bud med thams cad dus kun tu/ /skyes mchog nyid du 'gyur bar shog /lus can thams cad rig pa dang / /rkang bar ldan pa nyid du shog /lus can kha dog ldan pa dang / /gzugs bzang gzi brjid che ba dang / /lta na sdug cing nad med dang / /stobs chen tshe dang ldan par shog /thams cad thabs la mkhas gyur te/ /sdug bsngal kun las thar pa dang / /dkon mchog gsum la gzhol ba dang / /sangs rgyas chos nor cher ldan shog /byams dang snying rje dga' ba dang / /nyon mongs btang snyoms gnas pa dang / /sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod brtson 'grus/ /bsam gtan shes rab kyis brgyan cing / /tshogs rnams thams cad yongs rdzogs te/ /mtshan dang dpe byad gsal ba dang / /bsam gyis mi khyab sa bcu dag /rgyun mi 'chad par bgrod par shog /bdag kyang yon tan de dag dang / /gzhan kun gyis kyang brgyan ldan te/ /nyes pa kun las grol ba dang / /sems can kun mchog byams pa dang / /sems can kun gye bsam pa dang / /dge ba thams cad rdzogs bgyid cing / /rtag tu lus can thams cad kyi/ /sdug bsngal sel bar 503

bgyid par shog /'jig rten kun na skye bo gang / /su dag 'jigs pas skyo ba de/ /bdag gi ming tsam thos pas kyang / /shin tu 'jigs pa med par shog /bdag ni mthong dang dran pa dang / /ming tsam thos pas skye bo rnams/ /rab dang 'khrugs med rnal ma dang / /rdzogs pa'i byang chub nges pa dang / /tshe rabs kun tu rjes 'brang ba'i/ /mngon shes lnga po thob par shog /sems can kun la rnam kun tu/ /rtag tu phan bde bgyid par shog /'jig rten kun na skye bo kun/ /sdig pa byed pa 'dod gyur pa/ /de dag thams cad gnod med pa/ /rtag tu gcig char bzlog gyur cig /sa dang chu dang me dang rlung / /sman dang dgon pa'i shing bzhin du/ /rtag tu sems can thams cad kyis/ /rang dgar gegs med spyod par shog /sems can rnams la srog bzhin phangs/ /de dag bdag la ches phangs shog /bdag la de dag sdig smin cing / /bdag dge ma lus der smin shog /ji srid sems can 'ga' zhig kyang / /gang du ma grol de srid du/ /de phyir bla na med pa yi/ /byang chub thob kyang gnas gyur cig /ces pa dang / gzhan yang bzang spyod dang / spyod 'jug smon lam sogs bsngo smon gye rigs rgya gang che bya'o/ /thun mtshams rnams su byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems rin po che rnam pa gnyis kyi 504

gdams pa blo sbyong gzhan dang / rgyal ba'i gsung rab dgongs 'grel rnam thar gsung mgur rnams la blta zhing / bstan dang 'gro ba yongs la yang dngos sam brgyud nas phan gang thogs la 'bad cing / mdor na tshe 'di nyid la rang gzhan gyi don gnyis lhun gyes 'grub pa zhig bya'o//smras pa/ nye ring med par sems can kun gyi skyid sdug legs nyes sa ler mkhyen/ /phyogs ris med par 'gro la brtse ba'i mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po de/ /skyo ngal med par slar yang bdag cag snang ngor dge ba'i bshes su sprul/ /sba gsang med par zab rgyas chos ston sku drin can khyod gtsug na mdzes/ /mtshan ldan bla ma sman pa'i rgyal po yis/ /byang chub sems kyi sman mchog gnang ba de/ /'thungs pas nyon mongs nad las grol ba'i mod/ /sku drin bsams kyin legs bshad mchod sprin spro/ /byams dang snying rje byang chub sems gnyis po/ /mnyam rjes gnyis kyi sgo nas legs sbyangs na/ /snyigs ma'i dus 'dir rkyen ngan ci byung yang / /byang chub sems gnyis 'phel ba'i grogs su 'gyur/ /kun gye srog la gnod pa'i dug gi chu/ /sman du sgyur byed bdud rtsi lta bu yi/ /bla ma gser gling ba yi man ngag 'di/ /man ngag gzhan las khyad par 'phags pa yin/ /de ltar legs 505

par blo spyong shes gyur na/ /grong khyer skyid pa'i 'byung gnas zhes bya ba/ /blo sbyong sgom pa'i lus 'dir zer ba yin/ /srid zhi'i bde skyid thams cad 'di las 'byung / /blo sbyong rin chen che chung mang mchis kyang / /nang nas tshig don dag gsal 'od 'bar ba'i/ /blo sbyong don bdun yid bzhin nor bu 'di/ /chos mdzad gzhon nu'i spyi bo'i rgyan du mdzes/ /lung rigs nor bu bye bas yongs gang gzhung lugs rab 'byams rgya mtsho nas/ /legs 'ongs ngo mtshar gtam rgyud gsung sgos gzi brjid 'od stong phyogs brgyar 'phro/ /ris med skal bzang gdul bya'i blo gros padmo thams cad kha 'byed pa'i/ /sngar med legs bshad nyi ma mchog 'di gsar du shar la da ltos shig /dngos brgyud bla ma rnams kyi bka' drin las/ /rnyed pa'i blo sbyong gdams pa zab mo 'di/ /rnal 'byor rang gi sems la goms phyir dang / /skal bzang gzhan la'ang phan phyir bshad pa lags/ /byis pa chung ngus rgan pos bshad pa'i gtam/ /go nas gang shes gzhan la sgrogs pa'i tshe/ /re gnyis nor nas 'khrul tshig smra na yang / /pha mas go tshe khong khro mi skye ltar/ /blun po bdag gis rgyal ba sras bcas gsung / /'ga' zhig go nas gang shes bshad pa yin/ /nang gi tshig don re gnyis nor song yang / /mkhas pas mkhyen 506

tshe ma khrel chos bzhin 'chos/ /legs par bshad pa'i dge tshogs 'gro kun gyes/ /byang chub sems nyid 'byong ba'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /bdag kyang deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /byang chub sems dang nam yang mi 'bral shog /gnam la dri med 'od gsal nyi zla gza' skar tshogs rnams nam 'char dang / /sa la g.yo med ri rab lhun po gling bzhi gling phran nam gnas bar/ /snyan brgyud dri med byang chub sems kyi gdams pa zab mo 'di nyid kyang / /nam yang nyams med sa 'dir gnas nas bstan 'gro yongs la phan thogs shog /'di nyid mthong thos dran reg skye bo yis/ /bdag pas gzhan gces byang chub sems kyi sgos/ /khe dang rgyal kha gzhan la ster nus shing / /gyong dang pham kha rang gis len par shog /gang du khyer kyang lam la bar chad med/ /gang la bzhag kyang sa der lo phyugs legs/ /gang gis mchod bstod bkur ba thams cad kyis/ /gang bsams don kun 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /ces blo sbyong don bdun ma dang 'brel ba'i chos kyi gtam rgyal sras sprul pa'i glegs bam zhes bya ba 'di ni/ lung rtogs yon tan du ma dang ldan pa'i bla ma skal ldan rang grol/ byang chub sems gnyis 'byongs pa'i bla ma sbyin pa nor bu/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzoms pa'i phug 507

brag mkhan po dang / bla ma ye shes dbang phyug 'phags nor bdun gyes phyug pa'i brag dmar bla ma dang / bla ma tshul khrims/dben par sgrub la gzhol ba'i rdo rje slob dpon dang / rdzogs chen pa/ dad gtong blo gros che ba'i blo bzang dar rgyas dang /dge slong rab 'byor/ rtogs ldan nam mkha'i rnal 'byor/ bla ma 'jam dbyangs dang / lo chen pa/ phyogs med ri khrod 'grim pa'i la zhing grub chen dang / gang shar rang grol/ bslab gsum rgyan gyis mdzes pa'i la dwags mkhan po dang / phyag mdzod skal bzang / tshe 'di blos btang slob ma mkhas pa dang / kun dga' nyi ma/ gzhan yang chos bzhin mdzad pa'i u rgyan dang / mdo sngags bstan 'dzin/ skal bzang tshul khrims/ yon tan rgya mtsho/blo bzang nor bu/ bstan 'dzin nyi ma/ bstan 'dzin zla ba/rgyal sras bzang po/ 'brel tshad don ldan sogs byang chub kyi sems gnyis la blo 'byongs pa'i skal bzang las 'phro can gyi slob ma brgya phrag du mas/ 'di lta bu'i zab mo'i gdams pa zhig dgos zhes yang yang bskul ba'i ngor/ rang gzhan la phan du re ba'i blos/ phyogs med kyi rgyal khams dang / nges med kyi ri khrod nyams dga' rnams 'grim pa'i rnal 'byor zhabs dkar bas/bka' brgyud gong ma'i gdan sa/ lha dang drang srong bzhugs 508

gnas/ ma dang mkha' 'gro'i do ra/ 'du 'dzi grong gi pha rol/g.ya' dang gangs kyi 'dabs rol/ sprin dang na bun rgyun du 'khrigs pa'i 'brog la phyi gangs kyi ra ba'i dben gnas bdud 'dul phug mo che nas sbyar ba'o//smras pa/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i thugs dam mthil/ /bla ma gser gling pa nas brgyud pa yi/ /snyan brgyud gdams pa blo sbyong don bdun ma'i/ /snying po rgyal sras sprul pa'i glegs bam 'di/ /phyogs dus kun tu dar zhing rgyas pa'i phyir/ /rgyal ba blo bzang grags po 'khrungs pa'i yul/ /mdo khams smad kyi reb gong sa yi cha/ /gnas mchog bkra shis 'khyel nas par du grub/ /'dis mtshon dge bas phan bde 'byung ba'i gnas/ /byams dang snying rje byang chub sems mchog gi /gdams pa yid bzhin nor bu lta bu 'di/ /phyogs dus kun tu dar zhing rgyas gyur cig /sarba maṅga lo//509

༄ / /ya mtshan sprul pa'i glegs bam bzhugs so//༄༅ / /na mo gu ru/ nyi ma 'bum las gzi brjed 'od 'bar bla ma thub pa'i dbang po rje/ /deng nas bzung ste 'bral ba med par bdag gi spyi bo'i rgyan du bzhugs/ /'dren pa mnyam med ston pas gsungs pa'i chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong rnams/ /rtsol ba med par rgyud la 'char bar yang dang yang du byin gyes rlobs/ /shes rab mkha' las yangs pa'i yi dam 'jam dbyangs snying gi dbus su bzhugs/ /mkha' ltar che zhing glog ltar myur ba nyi ma bzhin du gsal la dwangs/ /rgya mtsho'i gting ltar dpag par dka' ba'i shes rab mchog de myur thob nas/ /'chad rtsod rtsom la thogs med dngos grub gter kha nang nas rdol du gsol/ /mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo lta bas mi ngoms dbyangs can lha mo dgyes 'dzum can/ /rab snyan pi wang sgra dang lhan du gsung dbyangs snyan po 'byon bzhin du/ /bdag gi mgrin pa'i padmor bzhugs la gzhan gyi rnar snyan yid 'bab kyi/ /legs bshad 'doms la bar chad med par smra bar snyan 5 10

pa'i dpal sbyin zhig /bla ma dam pa rnams kyis stsal pa'i chos kyi glegs bam rnams/ /bdag sems gsal stong kun dga' ra bar gcig kyang ma lus shong ba mtshar/ /nang nas ya mtshan sprul pa'i glegs bam gzhan la phan phyir sbyin la spro/ /shes rab che zhing dad pa can gyes nor bu bzhin du gus pas longs/ /zhes tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs snyan pos sngun bsus nas lhag bsam dag pa'i sgo nas rang gzhan la phan pa'i gtam 'chad pa la 'jug par bya'o/ /de yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rgya bod kyi mkhas grub thams cad kyi rnam par thar pa dang gsung bzhin du/ spyir 'khor ba sdug bsngal gye rang bzhin/ sgos su 'dod yon lnga sdug bsngal gye longs spyod/ de'i nang nas kyang lto gos bud med gsum sdug bsngal gyi 'byung gnas/ khyad par lus 'di sdug bsngal thams cad 'dren pa'i gzhi ma yin tshul zhib tu bsams nas/ lus longs spyod gang la yang chags zhen spu tsam yang med par 'phongs phyis pa'i rdo bzhin bskyur nas/nag can btson dong nas 'bros pa ltar/ pha yul bdud kyi btson ra nas bros te/ ri khrod dben pa'i gnas su song nas ri dwags rmas ma bzhin du gcig pur dam pa'i chos kho na la 511

'bad dgos te/ de yi rgyu mtshan gang yin zhe na/ spyir rang gzhan sems can thams cad tshe 'khor ba thog ma ma mchis pa nas/ tha ma da lta la thug gi bar du/ yang dag pa'i don la rmongs pas ma rig pa dang / las rgyu 'bras kyi dbye ba la rmongs pas ma rig pa gnyis sam gang rung gi dbang du song / ma rig pa'i dbang gis chags sdang sogs nyon mongs pa thams cad rgyas/ nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis las bzang ngan sna tshogs pa bsags/ las kyi dbang gis 'khor ba mtho dman gye gnas rnams byung / 'gro ba drug gam lha min gye gtso bo thags bzang ris sogs lha'i khongs dang phal ba rnams dud 'gro'i khongs su bsdus pas 'gro ba lnga'i lus gang yang rung ba blangs/ spyi mthun la 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal/ sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal/ khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal/ bye brag tu dmyal ba tsha grang / yi dwags la bkres sko ma/ dud 'gro bkol spyod/ mi la sgye rga na 'chi/ lha ma yin la 'thab rtsod/ lha la 'chi 'pho ltung ba'i sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab/ dper na me'i dong chen po tsha ba'i ngar dang ldan pa gting zab la dpangs mtho ba/ rgya che la mu med pa 'jigs su rung ba'i nang du mi mang po lhung na/ mtho dman gang du lhung rung sdug bsngal gyi gnas/ me nang gi mi su dang 'grogs kyang 512

sdug bsngal gyi grogs/ me ma mur gang la longs spyod kyang sdug bsngal gye longs spyod/ 'gro 'dug 'gul skyod sogs bya ba gang byas kyang sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin las ma 'das pa ltar/ las nyon gyi dbang gis 'khor ba'i gnas 'di'i mtho dman gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal gyi gnas/ su dang 'grogs kyang sdug bsngal gyi grogs/ ci la longs spyod kyang sdug bsngal gye longs spyod/ bya ba ci byas kyang sdug bsngal sgrub pa'i thabs 'ba' zhig las ma 'das/ bde ba'i go skabs skad cig tsam yang med de/rgya cher rol pa las/ srid sred ma rig dbang gis sgye bo rnams/ /mi dang lha dang ngan song rnam gsum po/ /'gro ba lnga po dag tu mi mkhas 'khor/ /dper na rdza mkhan 'khor lo 'khor ba bzhin/ /srid gsum rga dang nad kyi sdug bsngal 'bar/ /'di na 'chi me rab 'bar mgon med de/ /sred las byung la 'gro ba rtag tu rmongs/ /bum par chud pa'i bung ba 'khor ba bzhin/ /zhes dang / dran pa nyer bzhag las/ sems can dmyal ba dmyal mes nyams/ /yi dwags bkres shing skom pas nyams/ /dud 'gro gcig la gcig zas nyams/ /mi dga' 'tsho ba thung bas nyams/ /lha dag bag med pa yis nyams/ /'khor ba khab kyi rtse tsam la/ /bde ba nam yang yod ma yin/ /gsungs/ slob 513

dpon klu sgrub kyis/ 'khor ba de 'dra lags pas lha mi da nga / /dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro rnam dag tu/ /skye ba bzang po ma lags skye ba ni/ /gnod pa du ma'i snod gyur lags mkhyen mdzod/ /gsungs/ klong chen rab 'byams pas/ 'khor ba rgyal po'i btson ra 'dra/ /'khrul snang sdug bsngal dpag tu med/ /da res bde chen byang chub gling / /gtan gye 'dun ma byas na 'ong / /gsungs/ sgu gsum don thig las/ rigs drug rnams la 'gyur dang 'du byed dang / /sdug bsngal sdug bsngal dag gis mnar ba dag /legs par brtags na sdug bsngal phung po ste/ /las 'bras blang dor 'bad cing brtson par bya/ /da lan rgyu rkyen rten 'brel 'dzom dus 'dir/ /yang gsang rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs te/ /bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i don la gcig tu gzhol/ /gsungs/'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad rgyas par bshad na lce brgyar sprul nas/ bskal pa bye bar brjod kyang rdzogs pa'i yul las 'das te/ lho brag mar pas rje mi la la/ bu yis 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal soms/ /'khor ba'i rang bzhin 'di 'dra zhes/ /bdag gis lce brgyar rab sprul nas/ /bskal pa bye ba bsam yas su/ /bshad kyang brjod kyis mi lang bas/ /ngas bshad dam chos 514

chud ma gsan/ /zhes gsungs so/ /sgos su 'dod yon lnga ni sdug bsngal gye longs spyod kho na yin te/ dper na lus la na zug bskyed pa'i dug dang 'dres pa'i zas de la sdug zas ma gtogs skyid zas zhes sus mi smra ba bzhin/ sdug bsngal bskyed pa'i 'dod yon 'di la sdug bsngal gye longs spyod ma gtogs bde ba'i longs spyod sus zer/ sdug bsngal gye longs spyod yin pa'i rtags su bza' btung mang po zos rgyags ches na na tsha zug rngu byung 'chi la khad byed pa mthong thos mngon gyur du 'byung ba la ltos/ bde ba'i rgyu yin na spyad kyin bde ba cher 'gro dgos kyi sdug bsngal zhig bskyed don ga la yod/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'dod yon bde ba'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir ro/ /sdug bsngal bsgyed na sdug bsngal gye longs spyod/ bde ba bskyed na bde ba'i longs spyod ces smra dgos kyi/ de gnyis go ldog tu blun po zhig yin na ma gtogs mkhas pa su zhig gis smras/ sdug bsngal gye longs spyod yin zhes brgya smras rung / ltogs yod dus rtsam pa dang sha sogs zos na bde cham me 'gro bar 'dug pas/bde ba zhig kyang yod tshod red zer na/ de ltogs pa'i sdug bsngal chen po 'gags nas/ rgyags pa'i sdug bsngal gye mgo rtsom du yod pa'i bar de la bde ba'i ming btags pa yin gyi/515

don gyi bde ba zhig yin dogs med/ de'i dus na rgyags pa'i sdug bsngal chung bas lkog gyur gye tshul du mi mngon par yod/ de bzhin du nyi mas tsha dus bsil grib cig tu song na tsha ba'i sdug bsngal 'gags nas/ bde ba ltar snang yang grang ba'i sdug bsngal gyi mgo nas bzung ba yin/ de dus sdug bsngal chung bas lus sems dngos su mi tshor/ yun ring na skabs shig grang ba'i sdug bsngal mngon gyur du 'byung / des mtshon 'dod yon lnga'i longs spyod thams cad de'i rang bzhin yin/ 'khor ba 'di na sdug bsngal mi bskyed pa'i longs spyod cig ga na yod/ dper na phye ma leb gzugs la chags pas/ mar me dang me 'bar ba lha khang du mthong / nang du mchongs nas 'chi ba dang / rgya gar gye ri dwags shig sgra snyan la chags pas/ mi 'ga' zhig gis pi wang brdungs/ mda' brgyab nas gsod pa dang / bung ba dri la chags pas dri gar yod sar song chu dang 'dam gyis gos/gshog pa chad nas 'chi ba dang / sbrang rtsi bsags pa mi yis len dus gsod pa dang / nya ro mngar ba la chags pas mtsho 'gram du song / nya pas dol dang / lcags kyus bzung nas gsod pa dang / glang po che reg bya la chags pas glang dzis 'phrugs/ lcags kyus btab nas bran du bkol ba dang / nyi 316

mas gdungs tshe glang chen phal cher mtsho ru zhugs/ reg bya 'jam tshe phar phar song nas phyir 'ong mi nus par 'chi ba ltar/'dod yon lnga po bsten pa'i mi rnams kyis rgyal po phan tshun 'thab nas mi mang po bsad/ mnga' thang phrogs/ rgyal blon bkrongs/ ban bon sngags gsum gyes dug mthu ngan sngags byas/ rang gzhan phung la sbyor/ sde ba tsho ba rnams kyis phan tshun gsod res byed/ bla ma slob ma grwa rogs grogs mched rnams 'khon/ dgon pa rnams kyis rgyab 'gras brgyab/ nang 'khrug langs/ jag pa rkun ma rgyal pos khrims su bzung / mig blangs rkang lag gcod/ khyem pa pho mo rnams kyis khral mi theg 'u lag babs/ dmag la song / tsha grang bkres skom ngal dub dngangs skrag 'jigs gsum/ rdeg rdung na tsha zug rngu mi bzod pa sogs tshe 'di'i mi 'dod pa thams cad 'dod yon lnga po 'di la brten nas 'byung / phyi mar spyir 'khor ba khyad par ngan song du skyes nas sdug bsngal myong ba'i rgyu/ 'dod chags/ zhe sdang / gti mug nga rgyal/ phrag dog ser sna sogs nyon mongs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong dang / srog gcod pa/ ma byen len/ mi tshangs spyod/dzun/ phra ma/ tshig rtsub/ ngag 'khyal/ brnab sems/ gnod sems/ log lta ste mi dge ba bcu dang / mtshams med pa lnga/ nye 517

ba lnga/ lci ba bzhi/ log pa brgyad la sogs mi dge ba thams/ cad 'dod yon lnga po 'di la brten nas bsags yong / des na 'dod yon lnga ga la brten pa'i mi rnams la/ sdig sdug gtam ngan gsum gye mtsho brdol nas/ tshe 'di phyi gang du nam yang bde ba'i go skabs shig med de/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis/ ri dwags glang po phye ma leb dang nya/ /sbrang ma lnga po lnga yis bcom gyur na/ /gcig gis 'joms na gang zhig lnga rnams ni/ /shin tu bsten pa ci phyir 'joms mi 'gyur/ /gsungs/ kha rag sgom chung bas/ snyan grags bdud kyi phye gtor yin/ /rnyed bkur 'ching ba'i zhags pa yin/ /bsod nams dge sbyor bar chad yin/ /dug la sman du ma blta ang / /gsungs/ dwags po lha rjes/nor rdzas sgyu ma'i bslu brid sdug bsngal rgyu/ /pha yul bdud kyi btson ra 'ching byed mkhan/ /su dag 'di la zhen pa 'khor bar 'khor/ /gsungs/ rje skal ldan rgya mtshos/ yul sde dgon bdud kyi btson ra yin/ /dpon grwa slob dge ba'i bar chad yin/ /nor rnyed bkur 'ching byed thag pa ste/ /gsungs/ rig pa'i dbang phyug gis/ 'dod yon dgra bo'i dwangs ma 'dra/ /nye 'brel 'ching ba'i zhags pa 'dra/ /che 'dod 'gong po phug zhugs 'dra/ /snang shas ma che rgya ma pa/ /gsungs/518

des na tshe 'di'i bya ba dang dam pa'i chos byed pa gnyis mnyam du mi 'ong ste/ lho brag mar pas/ rje btsun mi la la bu 'jig rten 'di blos ma thongs par 'di yi bya ba dang / dam pa'i chos bsres na/ chos shor zer ba de rang yin gsungs/ tshe 'di'i phun tshogs che thabs ma shor bar chos bsgrubs nas/thar pa thob par 'dod pa rmongs pa'i zhe 'dod yin te/ sa skya paṇa chen gyis/ tshe 'di'i phun tshogs che thabs ma shor bar/ /gtan gyi phan bde thar pa re ba de/ /rmongs pa'i zhe 'dod gzu lum nyid yin pas/ /tshe 'di blos thongs 'bad pas byang chub sgrubs/ /gsungs/ dam pa'i chos dang tshe 'di'i bya ba gnyis mnyam du sgrub par 'dod pa rnams kyis rang nyid bslu ba yin te/ chos rje rgyal sras pas/ dam pa'i chos dang tshe 'di'i bya ba gnyis/ /mnyam du 'grub pa su zhig yod ma yin/ /sgrub par 'dod pa de dag rang nyid kyis/ /rang nyid bslu ba nyid la the tshom med/ /gsungs/ tshe 'di blos ma thongs par ci tsam dge ba la 'bad kyang / tshe 'di'i lag cha chos brgyad kyi khol po yin pas/ phyi mar lag stong gcer bur 'gro dgos te/ khro phu lo tsā ba'i zhal nas/ tshe srog lbu bar ma shes shing / /zhe nas 'chi ba ma dran na/ /dge phyogs mang po byas gyur kyang / /da dung tshe 'di'i 519

lag cha yin/ /rnyed bkur sgyu mar ma shes shing / /che 'dod khe grags ma bor na/ /mi yis dam par bzung gyur kyang / /da dung chos brgyad kyi khol po yin/ /tshe 'di thang la ma bor na/ /ji tsam dge la 'bad byas kyang / /phyi mar lag stong gcer bur 'gro/ /phyi mar ci 'khyer a tsa ma/ /'khor ba'i nyes dmigs ma go zhing / /'dod yon tshim pa ma mchis na/ /kha lta'i rbad kham che na yang / /da dung zog po rdzun chen yin/ /gsungs/ tshe 'di blos ma thongs par tshe 'di ba dang lhan du gnas pa rnams ston pa'i rjes 'jug ma yin te/ 'brug pa kun legs kyis/ bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung na ci 'dug ma 'ongs pa na nga'i nyan shos yin zer/ bstan pa la rma 'byin pa mang du 'byung / de tsho nga'i nyan thos min/ nga de tsho'i ston pa'ang min gsungs/ de la rtags ji lta bu zhus pas/ rngog chags rta dang 'dab chags bya/ /sder chags khye dang rmig chags phyugs/ /zhing dang khang pa 'bru rjen dang / /g.yog po skra can bsrel ba rnams/ /dman pa brgyad kyi gcig yin no/ /gsungs pas/ sangs rgyas ni snga dro chos gos dang lhung bzed 'khar gsil bsnams nas/ mnyan yod kyi grong khyer chen por bsod snyoms la gshegs zer ba min pa/dre'u khal bkal/ 'u lag bdas/ rta bzang zhon nas song zer 520

ba mi gda'/ khong lha dang mi thams cad kyis mchod pa des/mdzo rta 'ga' los shom ste/ mi mdzad par 'dug rgyu 'bras phra mo 'di kun la 'dzem dka' mo rang 'dug mdzo rtas badzis pa/rkang 'og lag 'og tu song ba/ me shing khrod nas shi ba grangs kyis mi chod/ sdig dang 'dres pa'i dge ba 'di kun ltar snang dge na'ang / don la sdig pa la dge ba'i ming btags par 'dug gsungs/ tshe blos ma thongs par rang chos par rlom pa blun po yin te/ rig pa'i dbang phyug gis/ chos kyi nyams len sna gcig ma grub par/ /khyod nyid chos par rlom pa kye ma blun/ /chos kyi dang po tshe 'di blos thongs pa/ /rang gi rgyud la 'dug gam mi 'dug ltos/ /gsungs/ tshe blos thongs na bde ba'i mgo tshugs pa yin te/ sangs rgyas kyis/ gal te bde ba kun 'dod na/ /'dod pa thams cad yongs su spongs/ /'dod pa thams cad yongs spangs na/ /mchog tu bde ba thob par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / slob dpon klu sgrub kyis/ g.yan pa 'phrug na bde snyam ste/ /de bas g.yan pa med na bde/ /'dod yon spyad na bde snyam ste/ /de bas 'dod yon spangs na bde/ /gsungs/ skyes mchog pas/ tshe 'di rlung la bskur nus na/ /zhen log bo zhes 'dogs pa lags/ /cis kyang dgos pa med tsa na/ /grags pas 52 1

sa steng khyab pa lags/ /gsungs/ tshe gcig la sangs rgya ba yang tshe blos thongs na yong ste/ dwags po lha rjes/ dge bshes gnyug rum pa la/ tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgya ba srid dam zhus pas/ tshe 'di la ltos pa spu tsam med pa zhig dgos pa yin gsungs/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba thams cad bzhag na chos byed pa'i skal ba dang ldan te/ rje mi las/ ras pa zhi ba 'od la/ lar thams cad bzhag nas 'gro dgos na/ /dus da lta bzhag na don chen lags/ /mi nga zer de tsho nyan spyod na/ /bu khyod la lha chos skal ba yod/ /gsungs/ tshe blos ma thongs na chos mi 'ong /thongs na chos yong bas na/ skyes bu dam pa thams cad kyis tshe blos btang / rjes 'jug rnams la tshe blos thongs zhes yang yang gsungs te/ jo bo rjes/ bsod nams zer ba'i 'du 'dzi de yang chos kyi bar chad yin pas spongs/ /rnyed dang bkur snyi bdud kyi zhags pa yin pas srang kha'i rdo bzhin sol/ /bstod dang grags pa'i tshig rnams bslu brid yin pas mchil snabs bzhin du dor/ /da lta bde skyid snyan gsum 'dzoms yang yud tsam yin pas rgyab tu skyur/ /gsungs/klong chen rab 'byams pas/ mdor na tshe 'di'i bya ba thams cad kun/ /kha zas bzang la btsan dug 'dres pa 522

bzhin/ /snying nas spong ba dam pa'i rnam thar lags/ /nges par byang chub sgrub pa'i dus la bab/ /gsungs/ gang shar rang grol gyis/ lar da lta'i gnyen grogs kun gyis bslu/ /tshe 'di ni yud tsam zad nas 'gro/ /nor zas gos sogs la ma chags par/ /da kun spangs gyes shig snying gi bu/ /gsungs/ spyan snga bas/ ja thud sha mar la sogs pa/ /bkra mi shis pa de dag gis/ /khyod la ltas ngan gtong 'gyur gyis/ /sbrul gdug de dag myur spongs la/ /dpag tshad brgya yi pha rol song / /gsungs/ grub chen yul mo bas/ nyams la yar bskyed med pa de/ /zla ba nyi mas non pa 'dra/ /de gnyis snang gi yul la zhen pas lan/ /sems 'khri ba chod cig skal ldan kun/ /gsungs/ kha rag pa sgom chung bas/chos min chos ltar bcos pa yis/ /chos la brten pa'i g.yo sgyu yis/ /tshe 'di'i che thabs ma bsgrubs par/ /'jig rten blo yis thongs shig ang / /gsungs/ rje mi las/ bu snying nas lha chos bya bsam na/ /dad pa gting nas skyes pa na/ /tshe 'di la phyi mig mi blta na/ /bden par nga phyir 'brang ba na/ /gnyen 'dun bdud kyi bshol 'debs yin/ /bden no ma snyam 'khri ba chod/ /zas nor bdud kyi so ba yin/ /'dris shing ngan no 'dzin chags spongs/ /'dod yon bdud kyi zhags pa yin/ /'ching bar nges 523

so zhen pa thongs/ /gzhon grogs bdud kyi bu mo yin/ /bslu bar nges so khong zon gyis/ /pha yul bdud kyi btson ra yin/ /thar par dka' yis myur du bros/ /gsungs/ mkhas btsun gzhon nu grub kyis/ 'dris bshes mang na phyogs ris zhen pa 'phel/ /sog rum mang pos lus ngag dge sbyor gcog /'dris med yul du 'khyams na mi 'thad dam/ /sha tsha'i gtam yin rang gi snying la dris/ /gsungs/ gtsang pa rgya ras kyis/ chags sdang rtsa ba pha yul spangs/ /sdug bsngal rtsa ba khyem thab spangs/ /'dzin chags rtsa ba nor rdzas spangs/ /g.yeng ba'i rtsa ba ngo srung spangs/ /gsungs/ tshe blos gtong na snying khams che ba/ mi dang mi bstun pa/ phyi rtsis med pa/ zhen log che ba bzhi dgos te/ rgyal ba yang dgon pas/ tshe 'di rlung la bskur ba'i snying khams dang gcig /blo sna mi dang mi mthun pa'i long med dang gnyis/ /dgos med phyi rtsis bor ba'i 'phral phyid dang gsum/ 'dod yon 'khri ba chod pa'i zhen log dang bzhi/ /tshe 'di blo yis gtong na dgos pa rang lags so/ /gsungs/ deng sang sdug bsngal thams cad bskyed pa'i gzhi ma 'dod yon longs spyod 'dzoms pa kha cig gis/ 'dod yon lnga'i nyes dmigs mtha' dag rgyal ba sras bcas kyis gsungs pa ma go rang gis kyang 'phral du sdug 524

bsngal myong ba ma shes bde ba'i rgyu ru rlom nas/ gzhan tshe blos btang nas dben pa'i dga' tshal nyams dga'i ljon shing dang brag ri'i bsil grib sogs la dge ba sgrub tu 'gro ba la/ yid smon byas yon tan mi brjod par ma zad/ de la 'do med spyon pa glen pa go ma chod zer/ brag phug yun ring gla bas bzung yod/ brag stod mthon por bya rgod gnas 'dug ste/ de la nyams rtogs yon tan cang byung e 'dug bu ma skyes rul song /chos byed na yul bzang po nas byas na yong / ri zhig la 'gro mi dgos/ khyod kyis 'jugs 'dug da 'di ltar gyes zer/ kha ta mang po byed pa de dper bzhag na/ dug dang 'dres pa'i zas la spyod pa'i mi zhig gis sdug bsngal bskyed par ma shes par zas kyi mchog tu rlom nas/ gzhan dug dang 'dres pa'i kha zas spangs nas lha'i bdud rtsi 'thung du 'gro ba la/ 'do med smyon pa go ma chod/ bdud rtsi lhas rgyun du 'thung gi de la yon tan cang yong e 'dug bu ma skyes rul song / bdud rtsi 'thung na dug dang bsres nas 'thung na yong / bdud rtsi gcig pu 'thung ga la dgos/ khyod kyis 'chugs 'dug da 'di ltar gyis/ zhes kha ta mang po byas pa dang 'dra/ yang 'ga' res tshe blos btang nas chos byed pa la de ma byed 'di gyis zhes tshe 'di'i che 'dod 525

grags 'dod sogs 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi che thabs blo/ba pa de/ mig can la mig med kyis lam bstan pa dang 'dra bas gzhan ma sems spyir 'dod yon 'du 'dzi'i nyes dmigs la bltas na tshe blos btang / ri khrod na gnas pa sangs rgyas song ba dang mtshungs zhes rje spyan snga bas gsungs/ 'dod pa zad na 'phags pa dngos/ /'dod pa chung na 'phags pa'i rigs yin/ /zhes mdo las gsungs/ bya btang ri khrod pa'i bde ba de lta bu lha'i dbang pos kyang rnyed par dka' zhes spyod 'jug las gsungs na/ gzhan rgya gar rgya nag bal po bod kyi rgyal po sogs mi'i rgyal po rnams kyis mi rnyed pa smos ci dgos/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ bya btang ri khrod pas khyim tshang bza' mi'i kha mi sos/ rgyab mi khebs/ dgra mi thul/ gnyen mi 'khyongs/ khe mi lon/ ston thog mi 'ong ba sogs kyi sems khral gang yang byed mi dgos par dus rgyun du dal bar gnas pas sems bde/ bde ba'i mchog ni sems skyid pa yin te/ sa skya'i legs bshad las/bde ba'i mchog ni sems skyid pa/ /nor gyi mchog ni sbyin pa ste/ /gsungs/yang bya btang ri khrod pas tshe 'di'i dgra 'dul gnyen skyong khe tshong zhing las 'tsho skyong sogs bya ba gang yang byed mi 026

dgos pas dus rgyun du lus dal bar gnas pas bde/ tshe 'di'i don du dzun phra ma tshig rtsub ngag 'khyal lab mi dgos pas dus rgyun du ngag dal bar gnas pas bde/ lus ngag yid gsum rtag tu bde zhing skyid pas chos gang 'dod byas na 'ong /chos byas na gtan du bde zhing skyid par 'gyur/ des na mdo las/ su dag nags khrod mngon par dga' ba yi/ /dge sbyong de ni shin tu bde ba myong / /zhes dang / tshul khrims yongs su dag pa rab gnas te/ /bsam gtan bsam mi khyab la rtag gnas shing / /su dag nags khrod mngon par dga' ba ni/ /de dag nam yang yid gnyis 'ong mi 'gyur/ /gsungs/ thugs rje chen pos/ las 'bras blang dor byed las dge ba med/ /dben gnas ri khrod zin las skyid pa med/ /gsungs/ rje mi las/ pha bla ma byen rlabs ri khrod 'grims/ /ri na bun can sprang po'i gtan yul skyid/ /rang gcig pu yi lus la lha tshogs 'khor/ /lha drin can rnams 'khor bas ngang gis skyid/ /gsungs/ dper na ma rgan mo gcig la bu mang po yod pas/ bu la na tsha shi chad byung na sems mi bde/ sems ma bde bas spre sngags sogs bton pas ngag mi bde/ mig chu byung lag pas brang la brdung ba sogs byas lus mi bde/ zas nor longs spyod 'dzoms nas kha skyid 27

kyang sgo gsum bde ba la phan pa med par sdug bsngal myong ba ltar/ 'jig rten pa'i rgyal po 'khor 'bangs sde rigs 'dod yon lnga'i longs spyod 'dzoms pa la de tshod kyi mi 'dod pa'i chag che nyam nga dus rgyun du 'byung bas sems mi bde/ sems ma bde bas gtam bzang ngan mang po smras pas ngag mi bde/ 'gro 'dug 'gul bskyod sogs byas pas lus mi bde/ gzhan 'ga' res phrag dog byas dug mthu ngan sngags mtshon sogs kyis ngan byas/ lus sems kyi thog tu na tsha zug rngu mi bzod pa byung / ngag gis 'khun bu ma ṇi bzhin bgrang dgos pa'i dus kyang 'byung / dus rtag tu lus ngag yid gsum la dal zhing bde ba'i skabs med pas chos gtan nas mi 'ong chos ma 'ongs na tshe sngon bsod nams kyi 'phen shugs zad tshe ngan song gsum du sgyes nas sdug bsngal la spyod par 'gyur/ des khye'u gaṅgā mas rgyal bu kun tu dge la/ nags khrod dben pa'i gnas mthong na/ /'khor mang rgyal po'i pho brang dag /grog tshang hrul po dag dang mtshungs/ /zhes dang / khyim gyi so nam bya ba la/ /snga ma byas pas nyon mongs nas/ /phyi ma byed pas sha thang chad/ /khyem ni sbrul gye tshang dang 'dra/ /zhes dang / 'khor ba mi rtag sgyu ma'i chos 'di la/ /blun po chags shing mkhas pas smon pa'i gnas/ /528

des na bdag kyang dben pa bsten pa lags/ /rgyal po nyid kyang dbeen pa bsten na legs/ /gsungs/ yang dgon sde grong sogs rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi che sar dge ba dpag med sgrub pa bas/dben par nyal nas bsdad pa dga' ste/ spyan snga bas/ 'du 'dzir dge ba dpag med sgrub pa bas/ /dpen par nyal nas sdod pa ches dga' ste/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho bde ba'i rgya mtsho gnyis/ /'dam kha ma nor dgos so shākya'i sras/ /gsungs/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'du 'dzi'i nang nas nyon mongs dug lnga 'phel/dge ba las/ mi dge ba mang / dben par nyon mongs kun zhi nas mi dge bcu'i las mi byed/ mi dge ba bcu spangs pa dge bcu yin/ dge bcu la dus rgyun du gnas na ngan song gsum du mi sgye/ ngan song du ma skyes na mtho ris lha mi'i gnas min gzhan du skye sa med/ bya btang ba dben par nyal bsdad kyang mtho ris kyi bde ba shugs kyis thob yong ba'i phyir ro/ /yang pha yul nas dge sbyor brgya byas pa bas/ dben pa'i gnas nas dge sbyor gcig byas pa dga' ste/ rje skal ldan rgya mtshos/ yul gyi dge sbyor brgya bas/ /dben pa'i dge sbyor gcig dga'/ /des na ri la song la/ /gang nus dge la 'bod cig /gsungs/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ pha yul nas sems rnam g.yeng gi dbang du 529

'gro/ sems g.yengs nas dge sbyor lo bskal par byab kyang 'bras bu mi 'byung ste/ sems ni rnam par g.yeng ba'i mis/ /bskal par bzlas kyang 'bras mi 'byin/ /gsungs pa dang /gang shar rang grol gyis/ sems g.yeng bas bzlas brjod dka' thub sogs/ /lo mang por 'bad kyang don med na/ /zhag lo zla kha shas dge sbyor la/ /'phral 'bras bu re ba gad mo'i rgyu/ /gsungs/dben par 'du 'dzi med pas sems nang du khug nas dge sbyor gang byas gnad du 'gro/ gnad du song na nyams rtogs yon tan 'byung ste/ klong chen rab 'byams pas ri ngogs dben pa'i gnas mchog na/ /nyams rtogs yon tan gong 'phel bas/ /chos nyid rig pa'i gtan yul zin/ /ri khrod dben pa 'grim du gshegs/ /sngon gye rgyal ba'i yon tan dang / /grub thob gong ma'i yon tan yang / /dben pa bsten las byung bar gsungs/ /ri khrod dgon pa 'grim du gshegs/ /gsungs/mdo las kyang / sngon gye sangs rgyas 'jig rten mgon/ /gang du mya ngan 'da' 'gyur ba/ /kun gyes dgon pa rab dben du/ /bla med byang chub brnyes par gyur/ /zhes dben pa'i bsngags brjod rgya cher gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /dben par sgrub pa byas na/530

bla ma'i zhabs tog pha ma'i drin lan/ 'gro don rnams dus gcig la 'grub ste/ lho brag mar pas rje btsun mi la 'byon khar/sgrub pa nus na bla ma'i zhabs tog pha ma'i drin lan/ sems can gye 'gro don thams cad dus gcig la 'grub pa yin gsungs/ des na tshe blos btang nas ri khrod dben par gnas nas/ chos byed pa la rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis yid smon gtong na/ gzhan 'jig rten pa'i rgyal blon khyem pa pho mos gtong dgos pa smos ci dgos/ rgyal sras zhi ba lhas/ nags na bya dang ri dwags dang / /shing dag mi snyan brjod mi bya/ /'grogs na bde ba de dag dang / /nam zhig lhan cig bdag gnas 'gyur/ /gsungs/ bu mo bdun gye rtogs brjod las/ shing drung ne tso ltar ljang ba'i/ /dur ba 'jam pa'i gos can du/ /mthong chos bde ba'i dga' ston dang / /nam zhig bdag ni nyal bar 'gyur/ /gsungs/ rje skal ldan rgya mtshos/ ri yid 'ong nyams dga' mthong ba'i tshe/ /sprang skal ldan dben pa'i dga' tshal dran/ /bya sna tshogs skad snyan sgogs thos tshe /bdag dben pa'i gnas la yid rab g.yos/ /shing sna tshogs sngo ljang 'dab rgyas tshe/ /bdag dben pa'i nags tshal dran zhing spro/ /rdza khra khra ldem pa mthong ba'i tshe/ /bdag de ru 'gro snyam 531

'dun pa shar/ /grogs bzang po 'ga' re ri la bzhugs/ /ri shin tu dben pa'i dga' tshal na/ /rang gcig pur drang srong spyod la gnas/ /de bsam zhing bsam zhing smon pa skyes/ /gsungs/ blo gros can rnams kyis tshe blos btang nas dben par sgom sgrub mdzad pa'i rnal 'byor mchog dman sus mthong yang / de lha'i dbang po tshangs pa brgya byen las kyang bsod nams che zhing 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kun tu bzang po sogs rgyal sras rnams dang skal ba mnyam par bltas nas brnyas smod nam yang mi bya bar bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa byas/ nam zhig rang yang khyem gye me 'obs nas thon/ dben pa'i bsil grib tu 'khod nas dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi 'thung ba'i yid smon byed pa gces/ deng sang zas nor gye gsog 'jog sogs tshe 'di'i lag len byed pa'i chos pa'i gzugs brnyan 'ga' res/ tshe blos btang zer ba de/ sems kyis thongs dgos phyi'i rnam 'gyur la bltas nas mi shes tsho zer/ zhe 'dod dang lag len mthun pa'i bya btang ri khrod pa bzang po la yang ya mtshan par bltas nas bsnyen bkur mi byed par ma zad/ tshe blos sus thongs yong mi shes tsho zer/ bya btang ba de bas kho bos tshe blos thongs yod pa lta bu'i gtam 532

kham po cher smras/ bya btang ba sgom chen bzang po de 'gab kyi stan dma' mor bzhag kho rang gong du 'gyeng / brnyas smod byas/ ho ha tsho zer ba de chos shes pa'i mkhas pa zhig gi mdzad spyod cig dang / bshad rgyu'i gtam zhig ma yin te/ tshe blos thongs yod na mi nor zas gsum 'dor ba chos nyid yin te/ mi gtsang ba blos btang nas mi 'phen par/ de yar la gsog 'jog byed dam thugs bsam bzhes tshe blos thongs na yang de dang 'dra/nang sems la gang yod phyi'i rnam 'gyur la bltas nas shes dgos te/ sba dbyug bzung nas bsod snyoms byas/ gsog 'jog mi byed pa la bya bral zer gyis bla ma mi zer/ gdugs rgyal mtshan bskor nas 'gro don byed pa la bla ma zer gyes bya bral mi zer/ de phyi'i rnam 'gyur la bltas nas shes pa yin gyes/mngon shes kyis shes pa ga la yin/ tshe blos btang ba/ zhe 'dod dang lag len mthun dgos kyis/ gsog 'jog byas ngas tshe blos thongs yod ces smras na 'jig rten rgad po yan chad kyi bzhad gad kyi gnas yin pas gzhan ma sems/smras pa/ phan bde'i 'byung gnas bla ma rin po che/ /nor bu bzhin du spyi bo'i rgyan du bzhugs/ /lag gnyis thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba 'debs/ /byen rlabs dngos grub dgos 'dod char 533

bzhin phobs/ /bla ma 'jam dbyangs dbyangs can lha mo yi/ /drin gyis legs bshad 'doms pa'i skal ba byung / /bar skabs 'dir yang rnar snyan yid 'bab kyi/ /dam chos glu dbyangs len la bdag yid spro/ /tshe rabs thog ma med nas da lta'i bar/ /rang gzhan 'gro kun ma rig dbang du song / /nga med pa la ngar bzung chags sdang langs/ /de la brten nas nyon mongs gzhan rnams rgyas/ /nyon mongs dbang gis las ni sna tshogs bsags/ /las kyi dbang gis 'gro ba rigs drug gi /nang du sgyes nas sdug bsngal dpag med myang / /bde ba'i go skabs skad cig tsam ma byung / /'khor ba'i khyem thab byed pa srin mo'i gling / /dug sbrul nag po'i tshang du chud pa 'dra/ /'dod yon longs spyod dug dang 'dres pa'i zas/ /spu gri'i kha yi sbrang rtsi ldag dang mtshungs/ /skyug nad can gyi mi la zas bstan bzhin/ /'dod sred zhen pa gting nas log pa dgos/ /seng ge'i sngon du rtswa phung spungs pa ltar/ /nor la 'dod pa spu tsam med pa gces/ /nag can btson dong nang nas 'bros pa ltar/ /da res 'khor ba'i nang nas 'bro re ran/ /phye leb ri dwags bung ba nya dang glang / /gzugs sgra dri ro reg byas phung ba ltar/ /'dod yon lnga ka bsten pa'i skye bo rnams/ /'di phyi gnyis ka phung bar 534

gdon mi za/ /de phyir tshe 'di'i bya ba blos thongs la/ /gcig pur ri khrod dben pa'i dga' tshal du/ /nyon mongs nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman gye mchog /dam chos bdud rtsi 'thung la yid smon mdzod/ /ces bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o//'dod yon lnga'i nang nas lto gos bud med gsum po 'di sdug bsngal gye 'byung gnas yin te/ de yi rgyu mtshan gang yin zhe na/ de yang ja 'di dang po mi rnams kyis 'thu ba'i phyir phar 'gro tshur 'gro byas dus sa dang shing la gnas pa'i srin bu mang po rkang lag gis bsad pa grangs mang / shing gi yal ga bcag nas shing sdig blangs/ ja lo 'thu ba'i g.yog po rnams kyis tsha grang bkres skom ngal dub na shi sogs sdug bsngal mi bzod pa mang po myang / thag ring nas bkal 'ong dus mdzo g.yag rta drel mang po la bkal 'ong / sa thag ring zhing khal lci bas ngal dub sgal ba bton pa dang / lam nas shi ba yang mang / tshong dpon g.yog po mang pos nyin par gyi lto bcag mtshan mo'i gnyid bcag nas yar bkal mar phab so dang mel tshe byas/ dgun yin na grang nas rkang lag phyid la chad sdug myang / dbyar yin na nyi ma'i tsha bas gdungs/ kha skom bza' btung spyod lam dman lhag la brten nas tsha ba'i nad sogs nad sna du ma byung /pya 35

mi mang po shi ba dang / khyad par tshong dpon bu gces snying dang 'dra ba shi ba mang / sdig pa de kun gye nang nas phal che ba zhig ja 'thung mkhan rnams la 'byung ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ ja 'thung ba po med na/ ja 'thu mkhan dang 'tshong mkhan mi 'byung ste/ dper na rgya gar gyi mis ja mi 'thung bas/ de la ja tshong mi 'gro ba lta bu'o/ /ja 'thung mkhan yod nas/ ja 'tshong ba po de'i don du 'ong ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rgya nag dang bod kyi mi rnams 'khrul ba tsam ma gtogs ja 'di la dgos pa ci yang med de/tshe phyi mar mi phan pa gzhir bzhag tshe 'di la yang zas za rgyu med na ja ci tsam 'thungs kyang bza' ba'i tshab tu mi 'gro/ chu med na skom dus ja spar ba byas 'chos kyang btung ba'i nyams la mi phan/ dgos pa med pa tsam du ma zad ja 'dis rang gzhan mang po tshe 'di phyi gnyis gar mi 'dod pa du ma gtong bas ja 'dis yul khams phung la sbyor te/ ja nyo mi rnams kyis nyo dus rin chen po byen nas nyo dgos/ mtho ba rta glang gser dngul nas/ dma' ba gro nas khab skud yan chad kyi nor rdzas thams cad don med shing lo zhig gi rin du zad nas/ mchog dman bar ba thams cad bu lon 'og tu 'dzud/ lhag par grwa pa grwa rkyang dang khyem pa nyam chung rnams dbul por btang ba mang /536

ja ha cang 'thung ches na/ rlung shas che bas rlung langs/ mtshan mo gnyid mi khug des na spyan snga ba blo gros rgyal mtshan gyes mdzad pa'i ja dkar bgags pa'i gtam spyo chu sun 'byen las/dus ngan snyigs ma lnga bdo la/ /thams cad 'dod yon lnga yis bslus/ /khyad par ja 'dis rlag pa tsam/ /dgra bo yis kyang ga la byed/ /'di dang phyi ma thams cad rlag /nor shor srog shor chos kyang shor/ /ja yi phyir du nor zad nas/ /sprang por 'gro ba grangs mi chod/ /sbyor thebs re la bzhi cha re/ /'jal dgos byung ba shin tu mang / /sbyor thebs bzhi bcur mar zho bcu/ /sprang por 'gro ba 'os med do/ /'khor bos bsgyur rgyal longs spyod kyang / /'di ltar byas na brlag pa la/ /yun ring 'gor ba ga la srid/ /ja la dga' dang chang la dga'/ /bud med dga' la dus nam yang / /tshod zin yong ba'i kha le med/ /tshod zin med na de tsam du/ /nor zad sprang por cis mi 'gro/ /phyug po 'dod na dgra bo che/ /ja la gdon du shes par gyis/ /ja dkar mang du 'thung ba yi/ /lus la nad ma zhugs pa med/ /grang ba'i nad kyis 'phral du gdungs/ /mi 'dod bzhin du 'khur dgos pa/ /bdag gis mang du mthong zhing thos/ /chu bsags chu rkyal bzhin song ste/ /shi ba byung ba shin tu mang / /ja yis rkang lag skyog po du 37

ru/ /btang ba'i grangs ni su yis chod/ /lus bying mi bde bad gan bskyed/ /dang kha dog cing zas mi 'ju/ /lar na nad rnams thams cad bskyed/ /nad kyis gdungs bzhin ja dgos zhes/ /'thung ba dag kyang mang du mthong / /ja yis spyo bar gyur pa'i mi/ /ma gtogs su zhig de ltar byed/ /des na ja 'di smyo chu ru/ /gdon mi za bar shes par mdzod/ /mdor na nad la mi dga' na/ /ja 'di dgra ru shes par gyis/ /zhes pa la sogs pa'i nyes dmigs che tshul mang po gsungs/ gzhan yang ja 'dis mtshan nyid pa'i slob gnyer 'chag sgom chen pa'i thugs dam 'chag tshul sogs chos kyi bar chad du 'gro zhes chos rje 'brug pa kun legs kyis gsungs/ de bden te/ ja mang po 'thung mkhan de/mar sgo la brgya stong 'bud dgos/ mal sa dron po nas thugs dam phar zhog rang ga sdod du yang mi 'jug char chu mun nag kha ba babs rung phyi sgo la 'gro dgos/ 'gro thag ring / dbyar yin na lam la ma bltas na srin bu mang po rkang pas brjis nas gsod/ gzhan gyi khye btsan po yod sa zhig yin na phyi sgo la song nas gtong gi yod pa'i sgang la skabs re khye shor nas gtong du ma bcug ded nas gsang sne na chu tsa ra ra bros pas/ sa rdo sogs la thogs nas rkang sne tsho nas khrag tsa ra ra byed pa'i dus 538

kyang 'byung / gcin gtong dus sngo rlan sogs srin bu mang sar btang na/ lan re la'ang 'bu bcu lhag re 'chi dus 'byung /gal te re gnyis mi 'chi dus med/ gcin gye dug gis sngo ljang rtswa rnams ser por btang / mdog shor nas bskams/ des na sangs rgyas kyis sngo rlan steng du bshang gci ma 'dor/ skye ba ma gcod/ srog gcod ma byed gsungs pa rnams dang 'gal nas/gcin gcig gtong ba'i ring la sdom pa gsum btang ba yin/sdom pa gang shor na ngan song gsum gang rung du skye zhes gsungs/ ja bskol na chu dang shing ci nas kyang dgos/ ja mang po 'thung mkhan yin na de tsam gye chu shing mang dgos/ chu shing 'di gnyis kyang sdig pa'i rtsa ba rang yin/ chu thag ring na de len du 'gro bas lam la bltas nas ma song na dbyar yin na srin bu mang po gsod/des na sangs rgyas kyis mig gis gnya' shing gang tsam la bltas nas 'gro dgos zhes bcas pa mdzad pa yang / 'bu mi gsod pa sogs la dgongs nas gsungs pa yin/ mig gis phyogs kun tu bltas/ lam la mi blta bar rkang pas 'bu mang po bsad na/ skabs der sdom pa gnyis shor ba yin/ chu nang na 'bu med pa'i chu dkon/ mtsho dang chu mig sogs na 'bu chung 539

chung khab rtse tsam dang spu rtse tsam pas khengs yod/ gzhan rdza chu dang chu chen yin yang chu len dus ma bltas na 'bu chung re gnyis yong srid/ des na sangs rgyas kyis chu tshag sa dgos zhes gsungs pa yin/ chu len dus chu tshags la ma btsags/ yang na zhib tu bltas nas ma blangs na 'bu mang po yong / 'bu btsos nas 'thung na skabs der yang sdom pa gnyis shor song ba yin/chu de len snod kyi nang gi ngos la bkru bshal byas/ chu sa la 'bo dus ma bltas na sa yi bu che chung mang po la phog chus khyer nas 'chi/ kha cig ma shi yang 'chi la khad kyi 'jigs skrag dang sdug bsngal myong / chu phyogs gzhan nas tshur rka la drangs na/ rka brko dus srin bu mang po gsod/ chu drangs na zla re 'phror rka mgo nas log chu chad na rka nang du gnas pa'i srin bu nyi mas bsregabye'u chung gis za/ skam na gnas pa'i srin bu mang po rka nang du 'tshangs/ rka mgo nas chu mar btang dus rka nang na gnas pa'i 'bu thams cad chu yis khur nas 'chi ba sogs sdig pa 'ga' zhig bsags yong / yang me shing la shing rlon pa bcad na skye ba gcod pa dang / gcod du bcug pa yin pas sdom pa zhig de dus shor/ shing bcad nas sa la bsgyel gtubs gshags pa'i dus sogs su shing skam po yin na shun pa dang nang na 'bu 540

dkar bo che chung mang po yod pa sa la 'phangs nas 'chi/ phal cher shing me la bsreg dus 'chi/ lci ba 'thu na 'thu dus phar 'gro tshur 'gro mang po byed dgos/ de dus sa la ma bltas na sa yi srin bu che chung mang po gsod/ lci ba la 'bu mang po brten nas yod/ de sa nas yar len dus khur nas 'ong ba'i dus nyi ma la skem dus 'bu mang po 'chi/ gal te ma shi ba rnams ja bskol dus me nang du bzhag nas 'chi ste/ 'brug pa kun legs kyis/ ja mang po bskol tshe thab shing gi nang du'ang me la gang tsam 'chi shes pa dang tshad gzung du mi 'dug gsungs/ sdig pa de thams cad kyi che shos de 'thung mkhan la 'byung bas/ gzhan zhig la 'byung bar ma sems/ gzhan yang ja 'dis nyon mongs dug lnga slongs/ mi dge bcu yang byed du 'jug pas/ mi dge ba che chung gang byas kyang phyi mar ngan song gsum ma gtogs gzhan du sgye sa med/ 'o na ja 'di la sangs rgyas kyis ma 'thung zhes chang ltar bcas pa ma mdzad pas 'thung na skyon med zer na/ sngon sangs rgyas kyi dus su ja 'di dngos su med pas bcas pa mdzad rgyu zhig ma byung ba yin/ dngos su yod rgyu zhig yin na chang las lhag pa 'di la bcas pa mdzad nges zhes sgyes bu dam pa du mas gsungs/ 'on kyang sangs rgyas kyis dngos su bcas 541

pa ma gnang yang / shugs kyis bcas pa mdzad yod de/ mi rung ba dang mthun pa'i phyogs kun spongs/ /zhes gsungs pas na/ja 'di las mi rung ba dang mthun tshabs che ba zhig gzhan na med/ des na chos pa 'jig rten pa su yin yang ja 'di spangs na legs/ gal te ngan goms kyi dbang gis 'thung dgos pa byung nas sgong mi nus kyang bag med du mi 'thung bar tshod 'dzin dgos/ deng sang bla ma mtshan nyid pa sgom chen pa man chad kyis ja 'di skyon du mi mthong bar yon tan du rlom nas ja mang bo mngar po 'thung rgyu byung na 'dzum langs/ gtam mang po lab/ nyi ma nam tsha btang chos spyod tsho skad gseng mthon pos dbyangs byas bton/ ja med par nyin gcig tsam la yang sdod mi tshugs par slob gnyer dang / thugs dam kyang mi 'ong ba lta bu'i thugs khral mdzad pa chos ma shes pa'i rang mtshang du go nas/ ja 'di la sred pa chung bar gyis/ lhag par bya btang ri khrod na sdod pa rnams kyis ja 'di la 'dod chung chog shes dus rgyun du bsten pa gces/yang mar 'di'i ched du mdzo mo'i bu mngal nas phyir thon ma thag nas bsad/ yang na 'o ma mi ster bar mu ges 'chi ru 'jug 'bri yi bu dus rgyun du rtod phur la btags/ nu zho 542

mngar mo cung zad re ma gtogs 'thung du mi 'jug kho rang gi kha yis rtswa za chu 'thung reg gi bar du zla ba mang por mug sdug myong / lus sgur/ khog pa gum/ phyugs 'tsho mkhan gyis nyin par gye lto bcag mtshan mo'i gnyid bcag char chu mun nag gi nang nas sdug bsngal myong / mdzo 'bri bzho mkhan gyes gci ba gcin gye 'dam rdzab nang nas bzho dus dka' las myong / 'o ma bzhos pa tsam du ma zad tshur khyer 'ongs nas me sbar 'o ma bskol/ zho bsnyal/ 'o ma dkrogs/ mar blangs/ da ra bskol/ phyur ba bskams/ thud bca' ba sogs khar za reg gi bar du dal ba med/ mdzo 'bri rnams kyi nu ma nas nyin re bzhin lag pas shed kyis 'then pa'i skabs shig tsha/ rma byung phra ba rgyag phyugs rnams kyis rtswa za dus chu 'thung dus phar 'gro tshur 'ong / nyal dus rnams su sa yi srin bu grangs kyis mi lang ba gsod/ mar de yar mar la 'khyer dus rta drel mdzo g.yag la bkal nas/ sgal rma byung ltogs skom tsha grang ngal dub kyi sdug bsngal myong / mar phar ster tshur len sogs kyi phyir mi rnams kyis kyang sdug bsngal du ma myong / mar gyi steng nas chags sdang ser sna sogs nyon mongs kun ldang / ma byen len rdzun sogs mi dge ba bcu'am gang rung gcig re gnyis re byed nges/ byas na phyi mar 543

dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro gsum gyi gnas su skye/ 'o ma zho dang mar phyur ba thud rnams kyis sgo phyugs sogs gzhan la sdug btang na/ za mkhan gyi steng du tshe 'di phyi gnyis ka sdig sdug gtam ngan gsum 'dren tshul bsam na mar 'di sdig zas kho na yin pas/ mar 'di mang po za ba'i chos pa la nyams rtogs shig 'char mi dgos sgrib sbyong ma byas na nyams grib cig 'ong ba'i tshod yin/ 'o na mar 'di la lus stobs rgyas pa rgas kha sra ba rlung la phan pa bkres skom sel ba sogs yon tan du ma yod tshul sman rgyud sogs nas gsungs 'dug pas/ 'di bsten par rigs zer na/ spyir 'khor ba'i phun tshogs kyi bde ba ni/ sems can rnams ma rig 'khrul ba'i dbang du song nas sdug bsngal la bde bar bzung / bde ba'i ming btags pa tsam ma gtogs/ don du bde ba spu tsam zhig med/ dper na dug dang 'dres pa'i zas zhim po zhig zos na 'phral du kha la zhim zhing khog tu song na/ bde ba 'byung ba ltar snang yang / phyi nas sdug bsngal tshad med bsgyed pa ltar/ 'khor ba'i phun tshogs kyang 'phral du longs spyod dus bde ba ltar snang yang / phugs su sdug bsngal tshad med bsgyed pas des na 'khor ba'i phun tshogs thams cad sdug bsngal gye rang bzhin kho na yin/ bde ba min 544

rung bde ba lta bu'i yon tan ltar snang re tsam yod na bsten chog pa ga la 'gyur/de yin na bud med la spyad na skabs der bde ba tshad med skyes/ de la brten nas na chung bu dang bu mo rnams lang tsho rgyas/chang 'thung na 'phral du lus la gzi mdangs 'bar sems la dga' bde 'char ba sogs yon tan ltar snang / de med na 'jig rten phun tshogs la med mi srid pas thams cad bsten na chog ste/ de ga la rung / dper na dug dang 'dres pa'i zas zhim rung phyi nas srog 'chad pa shes na sbyon pa 'dra ma gtogs blo ldan sems yod kyis nam yang mi za ba ltar/ 'dod yon longs spyod la bde ba ltar snang re yod kyang phyi nas sbug bsngal tshad med bskyed pa shes nas/ mar sogs 'dod yon spangs nas/ rab ting 'dzin zas/ 'bring bcud len/ tha mas kyang dka' spyad sdug 'khur byas/ sdig dang ma 'dres pa'i chos byed pa gces/ gal te dus kyi dbang gis zas de min med/ ltogs pa'i dbang gis bsten dgos pa byung na yang / dug zas za na mi gnod pa'i rdzas sngags sman bsten dgos pa ltar/ sdig zas 'ju ba tshul khrims dang dge sbyor rnam par dag pa byas/ bag med du bsten pa ma yin par srog 'tsho ba tsam du cung zad re 545

bsten par bya/ deng sang bla rgan kha ser mgo dkar 'ga' res/zas dkar gsum mngar gsum dge 'dun pa'i zas yin zer/mar kha la zos pas mi chog mar khu phor ba gang do re 'thung /'o ma dang zho phor ba mang po 'thung / thud zos brgyags nas 'chi tshad pa rkyang byas/ skabs re pho ba na zug langs/ mar 'grims/ skyug rdzogs pa rnams kyis 'dod yon gyi nyes dmigs dang / zas kyi tshod rig pa mi nyal bar rnal 'byor la brtson dgos gsungs pa rnams ma shes pa'i rang mtshang phyir bstan pa yin pas gzhan ma sems/ yang deng sang dgon pa phal cher gyis/ mdzo 'bri sogs sdug bsngal gyi rtsa ba/ kun gyis sdom pa 'chor ba'i rgyu yin par ma shes par chos kyi mthun rkyen du go nas/ spyi thog nas mdzo mo bcu nyi shu sum cu byas bzhag lo re bzhin 'o ma'i phyir mdzo mo'i rtol bu rnams gcig kyang mi 'jog par bsad nas/ de'i skal gyi 'o ma bzhos nas 'thung ba 'di ston pa'i rjes 'jug chos pa rnams kyi spyod yul zhig gtan nas ma yin/ 'o ma 'thung na/ dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar ltar/ dam pa chos kyi 'o ma bzhos nas 'di ltar 'thung dgos te/rje btsun mi la la/ 'ga' zhig gis sku bgres tsa na dum re gsol ba'i ba mo re bzung na dga' lags zhus tshe lan du 546

mgur 'di gsungs so/ / rje mi bskyod kyi ngo bo rdo rje 'chang / /sprang zhen pa zad par thugs rjes bzung / /nga sgyu ma lus kyi nags khrod du/ /stong nyid snying rje'i na spang rgyas/ /zhen med dad pa'i she ma yi/ /dam tshig gtsang ma'i lag pa bkrus/ /thabs shes gnyis kyi mdzo skyogs su/ /sems nyid rin chen ba mo 'jo/ /rnam dag gnyug ma'i sgom chen la/ /zag med bde chen gye 'o ma 'dren/ /spros med chos nyid kyi zhal du gsol/ /chags med longs spyod mgur gyis bzhes/ /dmigs med snying rje'i thugs la bstems/ /'phrin las phyogs med kyi zag pa gtong / /'gro don lhun grub sgregs pa klog /de 'dra'i ba mo 'jo ba la/ /khyod 'jig rten ba mo'i dgos pa med/ /chos brgyad kyi dgon par nga mi sdod/ /khrel med kyi spyod pa byed la thug /gsungs/yang rtsam pa 'di'i phyir du/ zhing 'debs dus mdzo glang g.yag la sa gshag tu bcug na sa sra bas 'then mi thub pas shugs langs nas 'then na phung po ngal dub/ 'gro ma nus na zhing rmo mis shugs drag brdungs nas ded skabs shig gnya' ba skrangs/ sdug bsngal myong zhing / rmo mkhan gyi mi de'i rkang lag ro stod na/ sa gshag dus zhing thog na srin bu che chung gang yod du 47

thams cad sa 'og tu bdas/ sa 'og gi srin bu thams cad sa steng du phud/ nyi mas bsregs/ bya dang bye'u chung gis zos/ zhing steng du chu gtong dus grog ma sogs srin bu mang po chu la 'debs/ ston lo thog len dus lo dang sa la gnas pa'i 'bu thams cad rkang lag gis brdzis/ lo thog brdung dus kyang 'bu bcar/ zhing gi so nam 'di'i phyir khyem pa pho mo thams cad kyis lo gcig ma yin par dus rgyun du dbyar dgun ston dpyid thams cad sdug dka' las bsam gyes mi khyab pa myang / khyem pa pho mos so nam ma thub par nyin par lto dang mtshan mo gnyid bcag nas rems pas/ spyod lam dang zas kyi dman lhag gi tshod mi zin par lus la na zug bskyed nas lo zla ba byas na ba dang / ma drag par shi ba yang grangs mang / mdor na zhing de btab nas bzung rtsam pa byas kha nang du za reg gi bar du mi phyugs gnyis ga'i lus sems kyis sdug myang / chags sdang byas sdig pa byas tshul rnams zhib tu bsam na/ gro nas 'bras sran sogs kha zas 'di thams cad sdig sdug gtam ngan gsum gyi rtsa ba che shos 'di ga yin te/ 'brug pa kun legs kyis/ da lta chos pa 'di kun zan bzhes pa la nyes pa med pa 'dra ba zhig mdzad nas/ lhung bzed brtol la khad gnang / kham zan bu 548

chung gi 'dzog mgo tsam bu ram mur ba bzhin 'dug ste/ sdig pa'i rtsa ba rang zan 'di la thug dper na zhing thog tu chu gtong ba nas mgo bzung ba'i sgre log la 'chi ba tsam mang / nya pas chu 'gram du sbrang bu dang bcas na e 'gro yin/ gzhan mas 'di'i srog gcod lugs kyi yo lang bar dka' gsungs/ sdig pa de kun gye phal che ba zhig zhing 'debs pa'i khyem pa las/ za mkhan bla ma dge slong sgom chen pa sogs kyi steng du 'byung / de ci'i phyir zhe na/ za mkhan mang po med na zhing 'debs mi dgos/gal te khyem pa pho mos rang kha gso phyir cung zad re btab na chog pas sdig pa chung / za mkhan mi mang po byung tshe de dag rnams kyi ched du dmigs nas zhing yang 'debs dgos pa tsam du ma zad rdo thog min tshad la 'debs dgos pa byung / btab nas sdig pa mang po bsags pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /des na bla ma dge slong bya btang ri khrod na sdod pa rnams la khyem pa pho mo dad can gyes rtsam pa sogs lto chas phul ba sdig zas yin par ma zad dad pas phul ba'i dkor zas yin pas mang po zos drag na thar pa'i srog rtsa gcod de/ rje mi las/dkor gnyan po srog gi spu gri de/ /mang thal na thar pa'i srog rtsa gcod/ /gsungs/ des na de'i don du dmigs nas dge sbyor 049
