rnam dag byed pa gces/ 'o na khyem pa pho mo'i nang ma rtsam pa sogs zas zos nas lus kyis phyag bskor ngag gis kha ton sogs dge ba sgrub pa dang / gzhan bla ma dkon mchog gi sa phyogs su gtong ba dang dbul po sbyin pa byed pa ni nyung bar gda'/ zhing btab nas rang gi kha la za ba'i khyem pa rnams shi na ngan song zhig ma gtogs yar yong mkhan med tshod na 'dug zer na/ rang gi zhing btab nas rang zas zos sdig pa zhig med tsho zer te/ 'di ltar sdig pa yod tshul shes nas chos phyogs re phyed btang nas dge sdig mgo mnyam pa re byed ma thub na/ rgyags tshad zos nas ba glang ltar nyal nas sdod mkhan gyi khyem pa pho mo rnams shi na yar yong zhig gang nas yong / 'o na zas kyis mi rnams kyi lus srog 'dzin par 'gyur/ srog brtan na chos 'jig rten gye bya ba gang yang 'ong / 'di bsten par rigs zer na/ tshe 'di'i srog 'dzin rung chos re bca' ma nus na/ srog 'dzin thabs zas 'di'i ched du sdig pa mang po byas na/tshe phyi mar srog 'dzin du mi 'gro/ srog gcod du gyur nas srog lan bye ba ther 'bum mang po 'jal dgos/ dper na phyi rtsis phog pa'i mi gcig gis nyin zhag gcig brgyags pa'i zas byung yang / de'i dbang gis phyis zhag po sum brgya drug cu tsam la 550

mug sdug myang dgos pa shes na/ nyin gcig la sdug bsran byed pa ltar blo gros can gyi chos pas tshe 'di'i yud tsam gye srog 'dzin pa la yon tan du mi 'dzin par skye ba phyi mar sdug bsngal myong tshul bsams nas/ ting 'dzin gyi zas dang / bcud len dka' spyad sdug sgur byed par rigs/ srog bzung ba tsam yon tan min/ srog bzung nas chos re bca' ma nus sdig pa rkyang byas na srog bzung ba bas shi ba drag tshe tshad la babs na zas kyis srog mi 'dzin par ma zad gnod nas srog gcod du 'gyur ba mang / zas nyes dmigs yod tshul mdo rgyud bstan bcos nas gsungs pa bsam na/ chos shig ma nus na/ zas rang gar za ba las ltogs grir 'chir 'jug dgos pa'i tshod yin/ 'chi ru 'jug sus nus/ 'chi ru 'jug pa phar zhog nyin gcig la lto med na yang sdod mi nus par srog gcod rku 'phrog sogs las ngan pa bsags nas/ phyi mar ngan song gsum du 'gro ba mang / da blo ldan rnams kyis zas 'di yang bde ba'i rgyu ru ma bsams par sdug bsngal bskyed pa'i rgyu 'ba' zhig tu 'dug snyam du bsam pa gal che/ de ltar shes na zas mang po byung na dga' ba dang / ma byung na sdug bsngal/ bzang po la 'dod sred ngan pa la zhen log mi skye bar/ zas bzang ngan gang 551

yin rung srog 'tsho tsam gyis chog par 'dug snyam/ 'dod chung chog shes dus rgyun du 'byung / de byung na zas ngan pa 'di'i steng nas 'thab rtsod dmag 'khrug sogs las ngan pa mi bsogam bsags na/ ngan song gsum du mi skye ba sogs phan pa'i dgos pa du ma 'byung / des na khyim pa pho mo rnams kyis kyang zas la 'dod chung chog shes bsten nas chos phyogs re gtong thub blta dgos/ bla ma dge bshes dge slong ban de bya btang sgom chen pa sogs chos mdzad skye bo pho mo rnams kyis dus ngan la zas 'di ma gtogs lus 'tsho ba'i zas gzhan za rgyu ma mchis pas/ srog 'tsho ba'i thabs su sdig zas 'di bsten dgos pa byung yang / mgo min tshad gsus pa byas ci yod za ba 'di zas kyi nyes dmigs ma shes pa'i rang mtshang du go nas/dper na nad la phan phyir sman bsten pa dang / rma la phan pa'i phyir khye tshil glan pa ltar/ lus srog bzung nas chos 'ong ba'i thabs su zas yod rung tshod rig par byas/ 'grang ltogs ran par bya dgos/ nges par snying nas lha chos rnam dag byed pa'i mis/ 'jig rten 'di'i zhing las sogs zas kyi rtsol ba thams cad spangs nas tshe phyi ma'i rgyags phye dam pa'i chos kyi so nam 'di ltar bya dgos te/ rje btsun mi la ras pas/ gzhi mnyam pa 0 52

nyid kyi zhing sa la/ /lam dad pa brtan pos chu lud sbyar/ /sems dkar bo dri med kyi sa bon btab/ /gsol 'debs drag po'i g.yu 'brug ldir/ /byin rlabs rtsol med kyi char ba babs/ /sems yid gnyis med pa'i rmon dor la/ /thabs shes rab gnyis kyi rmod gshol btags/ /'khrul rtogs med pa'i sgyes bu yis/ /yengs pa med pa'i thong zhig 'dzin/ /brtson 'grus drag po'i lcag gis 'brab/ /nyon mongs dug lnga'i tha ba slog /rang rgyud ngan pa'i rdo ba sol/ /g.yo zol med pa'i yur ma byed/ /las 'bras bden pa'i snye ma la/ /rnam thar bzang bo'i btsas ma rnga/ /gdams ngag bzang po'i 'bras bu yis/ /gtad so med pa'i bang ba 'gengs/ /mkha' 'gro'i rngod 'thag zas kyi mchog /bdag rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i 'tsho ba yin/ /zhes gang gsungs pa ltar bya'o/ /yang sprang rtsi dang bu ram sogs zas gzhan rnams kyang sdig dang 'dres pa'i zas yin pas yon tan du mi rlom par tshod bzung na bzang / sbrang rtsi 'di sbrang mas phyogs phyogs kyi me tog gi bcud bsdus nas byung ba yin/ me tog mang po bskor nas len dus sdug mang po myang / shi ba yang grangs mang / tshur bsdus pa mi yis blangs tshe sems sdug bung ba phal cher chu la du 53

lcebs/ phal cher mu ges 'chi/ bung phrug rnams sbrang rtsi dang lhan du bcar nas 'o skol rnams la btsong du khyer yong ba yin skad/ de bzhin bu ram kyang len dus bur shing dang sa na gnas pa'i srin bu mang po gsod/ de brdungs nas bskol dus kyang mi rnams kyis dka' las myang / de bzhin shing thog sngo tshod sogs len dus kyang rtsi shing la gnas pa'i srin bu grangs med bcar yod/ des na 'brug pa kun legs kyis/ sbrang bu 'di kun kyang sbrang ma 'chi ba dang / sbrang rtsi'i sems khral bskyed pa/ bu ram gyi tshi chen po 'di'i dkyil du sbrang zil ci tsam 'chi shes shing bgrang bar dka'/ des mtshon phra mo kun ngos ma zin pa yin/g.yag bsad pa dang sa gu tsi bsad pa gnyis kyi sha'i lan chags 'jal ba dka' sla ma gtogs/ srog gi lan chags la khyad med/ sha la che chung khyad yod mod/ srog la che chung khyad med dam bsam gsungs/gzhan yang tha ma kha dang / sgog btsong sogs la yang nyes pa mang po yod ces skyes bu dam pa du mas gsungs/ mdor na 'dod yon shig tsam re rtsa na sdig sdug gtam ngan ri tsam pa re yod pas na/ gang la yang tshod 'dzin dgos/ dug dang 'dres pa'i zas ltar mthong nas/ 'dod sred zhen pa gting nas ldog 554

dgos/ nad la phan phyir sman bsten pa ltar srog 'tsho tsam ma gtogs mang po rnyed kyang mi bsten pa zhig dgos/ sngon gye sgyes chen dam pa thams cad kyis 'dod yon tshur mi sgrub pa phar zhog rang la yod pa rnams kyang 'phongs phyis pa'i rdo ltar bskyur nas/ ri khrod dben par song / brag phug zhwa ltar bsten/na bun gos ltar gyon/ dka' spyad sdug khur zas ltar bsten pa yang / khong rnams kyis ma rnyed nas de ltar mdzad dgos byung ba min/ deng sang 'o skol rnams bu bzang drags rnyed nas bsten pa ma yin/ khong rnams kyis 'dod yon bsgrub rgyu yin na 'o skol rnams kyi 'di las brgya stong khri 'gyur gye 'dod yon rnyed/ lha'i bdud rtsi ro brgya'i zas la yang spyod nus te/ 'khor ba'i longs spyod 'di rnams nang na sdig dang ma 'dres pa'i zas shig dkon pas/ sdig zas mang po zos na sdig sgrib kyis bkab nas/sgom sgrub ci tsam byas kyang nyams rtogs mi skye bar ma zad sngar skyes yod pa rnams kyang 'grib 'jug gis dogs nas dug ltar spangs nas/ sangs rgyas kyis kyang rgyal srid mchil ma'i thal ba bzhin spangs/ chu bo neerañdzana'i 'gram du lo drug dka' ba spyad nas sangs rgyas/ de bzhin du rje btsun mi la/ grub thob thar pa'i rgyal mtshan sogs/ sngon byon skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis 550

dben par dka' spyad byas sgrub pa mdzad pas grub pa thob pa yin/ deng sang 'o skol sgom chen pa'i khur 'dzin pa lo mang por ri la mtshams dang 'dag 'byar byas pa rnams la yang rme sha mang po bsogs pa ma gtogs nyams rtogs ri bong rwa ltar gyur pa yang bla ma'i gdams ngag ma zab pa dang / rang gi snying rus chung ba sogs kyis ma lan/ gang gis lan na sdig zas 'dod yon longs spyod dkor nag gi dug chu 'di spong ma nus par/ 'di la rngam nas bag med du longs spyad pas lan pa yin pas ha de go nas/ yar thar pa'i go 'phang thob phyir chos gsha' ma zhig mdzad 'dod rnams kyis dus rgyun du 'dod chung chog shes zhen log nges 'byung rgyud la brten nas/ dben par bsdad nas nyams len mdzad dus srog mi 'chad pa tsam gyi zas skom gang byung gang rnyed ngan ngon tsam la brten nas dka' spyad kyi sgo nas dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar dang mthun par sgrub par byed pa gces/ lus ri la bzhag kyang sems grong du btang / dus rtag tu bza' btung gnyid gsum sems la bcings pa 'di deng sang bdag 'dra'i bya btang sgom chen pa phal che ba zhig gi thugs dam gyi mthil du song 'dug pas/ da rang legs su 'dod pa rnams kyis de ltar du ma song ba zhig ci 556

nas kyang gyes zhes thal mo sbyor ro//smras pa/ sangs rgyas kun dngos rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /ci gsungs bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ /dam gtsang rdo rje'i mched lcam slob ma la/ /skabs 'dir dbyangs snyan dam chos dga' ston 'gyed/ /chos kyi bar chad sdug bsngal bsgyed pa'i rgyu/ /ja mar rtsam pa sbrang rtsi bu ram dang / /tha ma kha dang sgog btsong la sogs pa'i/ /'dod yon nyes dmigs bshad na brjod mi lang / /mdor na 'dod yon shig tsam rtsa na yang / /sdug bsngal phung po ri tsam yod par gsungs/ /dper na dug dang 'dres pa'i zas ltar du/ /mthong nas mngon zhen spu tsam med pa dgos/ /'jig rten 'di yi zas nor longs spyod kyi/ /nang na sdig dang ma 'dres zas shig dkon/ /sdig zas mang po zos na sdig sgrib kyis/ /bsgribs nas nyams rtogs yon tan sgye mi 'gyur/ /de phyir tshe 'di'i bya ba blo yis thongs/ /sngon byon dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /dka' spyad snying rus sgo nas ri khrod du/ /tshe dang sgrub pa snyems pa shin tu gces/ /deng sang 'tsho ba med pa'i skyid 'dod mkhan/ /'ga' re ri la bsdad kyang grong yul dran/ /sbyin bdag 'ga' res zas nor ster du re/ /ma byung gams skor byed zer 'gro ba mthong / /khye yis lha khang yang 557

yang bskor ba de/ /dad pa ma yin zhal zas rku phyir labs/ /de bzhin lto gos ma rnyed gnas chen tsho/ /'grims pa'i ha yang go tshe gad mo 'chor/ /de phyir ja mar sha thud yid la dran/ /don med gnas skor grong yul ma 'grim zhes/ /bdag dang bdag 'dra'i bya btang sgom chen la/ /snying gtam zhus pa lags pas thugs la zungs/ /zhes pa'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o /yang sha 'di sdig zas ngo thog yin te/ ra lug phag dang g.yag sogs gsod nyes gdug pa can gye sgo nas/ rang ngam gzhan gyes bsad nas sha khrag dmar po za ba 'di tshe 'di'i pha ma gnyis kyi sha zos pa dang don du khyad par spu tsam yang med/de yi rgyu mtshan gang yin zhe na/ rang re rnams kyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pas/ sems can thams cad pha mar ma gyur pa gcig kyang med/ tshe rabs sngon ma'i ma dang tshe 'di'i ma gnyis ma yin pa dang drin gyes bskyangs pa la yang khyad par med/ lhag par tshe rabs sngon ma rnams su rang gi pha ma byas pa'i sems can rnams kyis tshe 'di'i pha ma gnyis kyi drin gyis bskyangs pa las kyang brgya stong 'gyur gyi phan tshad med pa btags pa dang /gnod pa tshad med pa las bskyabs pa mang / rang gi lto rgyab 558

gnyis kyi phyir tshe sngon pha ma de rnams kyi lus srog kyang phangs pa med par btang ba yod/ ces thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs/ de mi bden su zhig smras so/ /sangs rgyas kyi gsung de bden par brtsi na/ da lta pha ma sems can de rnams kyi drin lan du phan zhig mi 'dogs rung / srog bcad nas sha zos khrag 'thung ba 'di snying rje med pa'i srin po'i spyod pa ma nor ba dngos yin te/ de min na snying rje zhig ci la mi sgye/pha ma ra lug rnams sdig can bshan pa'i lag tu sprad nas gsod tshe/ dngangs shing skrag 'then skor mang po byas/ skad chen pos 'ba'/ mig mtha' la chu 'khyel/ sug bzhi 'dar bshan pa'i gdong la mig trig trig blta/ lug 'ga' re'i mig nas mchi ma khril le gtong / byang chub sems dpa' yod na snying rje rgyu de'i dus yod mod/ bshan pa lag dmar gyi dme lag gis gon pa'i kha gyen du brdzes/ gri rnon po brdar la ngo blangs gnya' bar myangs nas/ mgo bo rbad kyis gcod tshe bzod glags med pa'i sdug bsngal myang / ja thebs re la yan lag g.yab/ lus po shig shig yom yom 'gul/ 'o skol rnams kyi mgo gcod mi dgos rang gi sha sen mo gnyis kyi bar du tshir dang / de tsam gyi sdug bsngal mi bzod na pha ma ra lug rnams kyis de bas brgya 559

stong 'gyur gye sdug bsngal myangs nas shi ba yin pas/ de ltar rang lus la dpe blangs bsam mno zhib tu btang na/ byang chub sems dpa' zhig yin na snying rlung ldang na/ 'o skol rnams la snying rje zhig mi skye rung 'dod sred cig skyes nas za ba srin po ma gtogs gzhan sa zhig yod/ chos rje 'brag pa kun legs raring riring kyis/ spyir gyi theg pa che la sha rnams bkag gsungs pa yod/de'i don snying rje la gnod/ sha'i bro ba tshor ba des/ srog la gnod dogs pa dang / blo lad dogs/ khyad par sems can thams cad pha ma yin par mdo rgyud kun nas gsungs shing /rang gis kyang myong bas grub par sems can la thog mar 'di nas byung med pas pha ma yin par yid ches/ pha byas pa'i rus pa'i phung po dang / ma byas pa'i nu zho rgya mtshor bskyil na/ khams gsum snod du ga la shong / des na bsam mno btang na pha ma'i sha'am bu'i sha sus za nus/ nyan thos rnams kha sha za bar 'dod pa dang / rang la nyes par 'gyur bas dmigs sha ma byung na/des chog par brtsis nas/ nyan thos rnam gsum dag pa'i sha /za bar rung gis mi za na/ /lhas sbyin gyes ni brtul zhugs 'gyur/ /gsungs pa la 'khris nas sha bzhes kyin 'dug ste/'di la'ang mtshungs pa zhig zhu na/ stu shar po gsum 'khor ba 560

zhig la byas e chog mi chog na/ tshong 'dus gsum du ma brin pa'i sha yang zos mi chog don la mi bsam par tshig la 'khris pa 'dis phug skyon gcig ni rang la 'ong gsungs/ mnyam med po to bas ma mgron du bos pas mdun du bu'i sha btsos nas drangs na dga' bar 'gyur ram mi 'gyur/ de bzhin du sangs rgyas mchod pa la srog bcad pas mchod pa'ang de dang mtshungs gsungs/ mdo dran pa nyer bzhag las/ sha chang gnyis rang gis longs spyod pa lta ci smos/ sbyin par byen kyang dmyal ba ngu 'bod du skye gsungs/ sha za ba po dang gsod pa po gnyis kyi za ba po la nyes pa chen po 'byung ste/ chos rje 'brug pa kun legs kyis/ kha zas kyang za ba po dang gsod mkhan gnyis/ za mkhan nyes pa che bar dus kyi 'khor lo nas gsungs te/ za ba po med na gsod pa po mi 'byung zer ba 'dug gsungs pas/ 'ga' res 'o na bre log srang log 'chos mkhan dang tshong pa gnyis sdig pa tshong pa che bar 'dug zhus pas/ de los che/ srang de la ster mkhan dang /bre de la 'jal mkhan med na bre log srang log 'chos pas don ga la yod/ khe de mthong bas bla de btsong ba yin gsungs/gsung de la dpag na gzhan ja mar rtsam pa sogs zas gang yin yang 'bul mkhan las kyang za mkhan nyes pa che ba go sla 561

bas 'dod yon dkor la rngam pa rnams kyis sor bzhi thugs gar khroms la bsam mno thongs/ gzhan yang sha yi nyes dmigs mdo rgyud bstan bcos na mtha' yas pa gsungs pa rnams kyi don bsdu na/ sha zos pa'i rnam smin gyes dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro gsum mam gang rung du skye/ tsha grang bkres skom bkol spyod kyi sdug bsngal myong / mtho ris su skyes kyang tshe thung nad mang / rigs ngan rme sha can dang btso blag mkhan sogs su skyes nas sdug bsngal du ma myong bar gsungs/ gzhan yang sha 'di'i phyir du tshe 'dir yang mi nor zas gsum zad nas sprang por 'gyur ba dang / thos bsam sgom gsum shor nas grong khyem 'grims pa mang / sha 'chos thig le rgyas tshe dgon pa phal cher gye grwa pas btsun chung sogs bsten nas lhag ma bcu gsum gyi dang po phog nas tshul khrims shor/ phyag rdzogs pa'i chos pa phal cher gyis btsun ma dang skye dman bsten nas sgom sgrub shor ba mang / 'ga' res sha 'chos nas tsho ba sogs lus las su mi rung drang por bsrangs kyang 'khyog por 'gro/ yar langs na sdod mi tshugs nyal sdod dgos/ dus rgyun du 'phog rgyu med pa'i khur po lci mo zhig khur yod pa ltar 'gro 'dug 'gul bskyod mi nus/ song na la mi chod dbugs 'tshangs 'chi la khad byed/ mi 062

la bshad tshul med pa'i sdug bsngal la de che/ sha zos na bying rmugs gnyid gsum 'phel/ rig pa mi gsal nyin par gnyid na tshad pa sogs nad drag po steng du 'byung / ha cang zos che na pho ba ngan pa na gzer 'a ngas/ mar 'grims skabs 'ga' re ma zhu pho bar bsdad/ mgo na zug gzer ldang / sman pas sman sbyin pa 'thung rung mi 'tsho bar sha dug gis shi ba mang / sha khrag la longs spyod pa'i sa phyogs su dkar phyogs kyi lha mi 'du/ nag phyogs sha khrag la dga' ba 'du/ mi rnams la nad dang / phyugs la god kha gtong / sha khrom gar yod sar tshad pa khrag 'grams sogs nad rims kyang mi gcig pa mang po 'byung / mi phyugs mang po dus min du 'chi/ sha 'di pha ma sems can drin can rnams kyi sha khrag yin pas/ mang po zos na sdig sgrib kyis chos pa rnams kyis lam rim blo sbyong phyag rdzogs sogs bsgoms kyang rgyud la byams snying rje byams sems lta ba sogs kyi nyams rtogs khyad par can mi skye/ sngar sgyes pa yang 'grib sha 'dis chags sdang sogs nyon mongs pa kun slong / srog gcod ma byin len sogs mi dge ba bcu yang byed du 'jug mi dge ba'i dbang gis spyir 'khor ba dang khyad par ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab pa myong dgos/ mdor na kha sha la 563

dga' na tshe 'di phyi gang du bde skyid snyan gsum gang yang mi 'ong / sdig sdug gtam ngan gsum dus rgyun du 'ong bas/ des na skal bzang gtan gyi bde ba 'dod pa rnams yud tsam gyi bde ba la ma zhen par sdig zas pha ma'i sha khrag dug ltar spong dgos te/ lang gar gshegs pa'i mdo las/ gang gis thub pa'i tshig 'das te/ /bsam pa ngan pas sha za na/ /'jig rten gnyis ni bshig pa'i phyir/ /shākya'i bstan la brtul zhugs nyams/ /shin tu mi bzad dmyal bar yang / /sdig pa'i las can de dag 'dod/ /ma rungs ngu 'bod la sogs su/ /sha za de dag btso bar 'gyur/ /rnam gsum dag pa'i sha rnams ni/ /ma brtags pa dang ma bslangs dang / /ma bskul ba yang yongs med pas/ /de bas sha ni mi za 'o/ /rnal 'byor can gyes sha mi bza'/ /nga dang sangs rgyas dag gis bshad/ /sems can gcig la gcig za ba/ /sha zan dag gi rigs su skye/ /dri mi zhim zhing smad pa dang / /smyon pa rnams su skye bar 'gyur/ /gdol ba rme sha can rigs dang / /btso blag mkhan du yang yang skye/ /mkha' 'gro'i rigs kyi skye gnas dang / /sha za'i rigs su skye bar 'gyur/ /mi yi tha ma de dag ni/ /srin dang bye la'i rigs su sgye/ /glang po'i rtsal dang sprin chen dang / /mya ngan 'das dang sor phreng dang / /lang gar 564

gshegs pa'i mdo las kyang / /ngas ni sha yang rnam par smad/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /nyan thos rnams kyis smad pa la/ /ngo mi tsha bar za ba ni/ /rtag tu spyon par skye bar 'gyur/ /sha la sogs pa spangs pa'i phyir/ /bram ze'i rigs dang rnal 'byor can/ /shes rab can dang nor ldan par/ /de dag rnams su skye bar 'gyur/ /mthong dang thos dang dogs pa yis/ /sha rnams thams cad rnam par smad/ /sha zan rigs su sgye ba yi/ /rtog ge ba rnams mi shes so/ /ji ltar 'dod chags thar pa la/ /bar chad byed par 'gyur ba bzhin/ /de ltar sha dang chang la sogs/ /bar chad byed par 'gyur ba 'o/ /ma 'ongs pa yi dus na ni/ /sha za gti mug smra ba dang / /sha ni sdig med rung ngo zhes/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis bshad ces zer/ /zas la sman dang 'dra ba dang / /bu yi sha dang mtshungs par yang / /ran par dang ni mi 'phrod par/ /rnal 'byor can gyis zas la spyod/ /seng ge dag dang stag rnams dang / /wa la sogs dang 'grog 'gyur bas/ /ngas ni byams pas gnas pa la/ /rtag tu rnam pa kun tu smad/ /thar pa'i chos dang 'gal ba'i phyir/ /mi rnams dngangs par 'gyur ba'i sha /de phyir bza' bar mi bya ste/ /'di ni 'phags pa'i rgyal mtshan no/ /zhes pa la sogs pas sha'i nyes 560

dmigs rgya cher gsungs/gzhan yang mya ngan las 'das pa'i mdo las/ 'od srung ngas ni deng phan chad nye gnas su gyur pa rnams kyis sha thams cad zar mi rung ngo gsungs/ gal te zas kyi nang na sha snang na ma za zhig zos na nyes pa dang bcas te/ ngas sha za ba mi snang ba dang bcas pa 'di rgyas par bstan na zad pa'i mtha' med de/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i dus la bab pas phyogs tsam zhig bshad do gsungs/ des na sangs rgyas kyi gsung bzhin thams cad kyis sha spang dgos/ 'o na dgag bya ba la dgos pa gtso bas/ sha rlung shas che ba'i rgan rgon bla rgan dang / gsang sngags tshogs kyi 'khor lo/ bla ma skyes bu dam pa'i 'tsho ba sogs dgos pa ches mang bas spang mi rung zer na/ rlung nad can gyi kha nang du sdig zas pha ma'i sha khrag cig rgyag dgos pa'i nges pa med/rlung nad la phan pa'i zas brgya dgos na stong yod pa sman rgyud sogs nas gsungs/ de tsho'i gcig bsten na mi yong na gnyis bsten na mi chog gam/ tha na sgog skya yan chad kyis chog par gsungs/ rlung nad can gyes zho thud mar gsum gang rung bsten dang rlung gis mi 'chi ba'i khag theg tshogs kyi rdzas dgos na yang / sems can gyi srog ma bcad na sha mang du mi 566

'gro rung med ga la 'gro/ srog ma bcad na sems can mang du 'gro/ sems can mang ba tsam du 'chi ba mang 'chi ba mang ba tsam du ro mang / ro de rnams sha khrag rus pa yin pas/ des tshogs rdzas ci la mi 'ong / bla ma dam pa yin na 'tsho ba sha mi dgos te/ deng sang gi bla ma dam pa rnams sngon gyi rgyan drug mchog gnyis jo bo rje yab sras rnams kyi yan zhig min nam snyam/ de dag dang 'dra na zas dkar gsum mngar gsum sogs kyis yong / gal te dus kyi dbang gis sgyes bu dam pas kyang kha sha la dga' na tshol dang / ra lug glo bur du shi ba'i sha tshon po rnyed pas de lugs gnang 'tshal/ 'o na sangs rgyas kyis rjes 'jug rnams la rnam gsum dag pa'i sha zo zhes gnang ba byin yong bas sdig pa med kyi sha la longs spyad kyang nyes pa med zer na/ gnang ba byen pa la yang rnam pa mang / yul phyogs re na sha ma gtogs 'tsho ba'i zas gzhan med/ yul dus kyi dbang gis srog 'tsho ba'i phyir bsten dgos na/ dgag bya ba la dgos pa gtso yin pas rnam gsum dag pa'i sha cung zad re bsten chog dge slong rgan pa rlung gis 'chi ba'i nad rtsi la zas gzhan gyis phan ma byung / sha yis phan na rnam gsum dag pa'i sha bsten chog par gsungs pa yin gyi/ gzhan zas dkar gsum 567

mngar gsum rtsam pa gro zhib 'bras sogs ci 'dod za rgyu yod bzhin du bsten rung nyes pa med bsten na chog gsungs pa'i tshig tu 'khrul bar mi bya/ de yin na sha zos pa'i nyes dmigs gsungs pa rnams kyang rdzun yin zer dgos/ sangs rgyas kyis so sor thar pa'i mdo gsung tsa na/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing / /dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ /gsungs/ de yin na sdig pa mi dge ba'i rtsa ba sha 'di yin pas spong ci la mi dgos/ spangs na sems can la dngos sam brgyud nas phan pa'i dge ba phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /gal te yul dus kyi dbang gis sha za dgos pa byung na yang / sha za spyi la dmigs pa'i bshan pa'i sha lta bu dang / rang la sger du dmigs nas srog dbugs bcad pa'i sha ma yin pas shi sha sogs za dgos/ de yang sha za na bshan pa dang srin po rnams ltar rngam nas mi za bar/ sems can de dag la dmigs pa'i snying rje bsgyed/ sngags dang ting nge 'dzin gyi byin gyis brlabs/ rtsa gsum lha dang chos skyong la phud mchod/ sha za dus kyang brgyags ches pa ma yin par tshod bzung / ran par za dgos/ zos tshar nas sems can de dag la dmigs pa'i dge sbyor byas/ bsngo ba dang smon lam rnam dag ma byas na/ sngar bshad pa'i nyes dmigs de thams cad 568

steng du 'byung bar nges so/ /yang chang 'di yang sdig pa'i btung ba ngo thog yin/ chang gi rgyu'i nas dang 'bras sogs kyi phyir sdig pa byas tshul rnams sngar bshad pa ltar yin pas smos mi dgos/ chang 'tshod pa'i me shing chu yi phyir sdig pa byed pa yang sngar bshad pa ltar yin/chang de 'thung na 'dod chags zhe sdang sogs nyon mongs pa kun slong / zhes o rgyan rin po ches gsungs/ nyon mongs pa skyes phyin srog gcod/ ma byin len/ mi tshangs spyod/ rdzun sogs mi dge ba byed pa chos nyid yin te/ sngon dge slong khrims ldan gcig la bud med cig gis chang zhig khyer/ ra zhig khrid 'ongs nas/ khyed kyis ra 'di sod/ yang na chang 'di thungs/ yang na mo la chags pa zhig spyod dgos/ zhes smras pas/ de rnams gang yang byas mi chog smras pas/ ci nas kyang gcig byed dgos byas pas/ dge slong gi bsam pa la/ chang 'di 'thung na nyes pa chung snyam blangs nas chang 'thungs pas bzi tshe/ 'dod chags langs nas mi tshangs pa spyad/ ra yang bsad nas sdom pa shor skad/ yang chang 'thung na thos bsam pa la thos bsam mi 'ong /sgom chen pa rnams la sgom mi 'ong / khyim pa rnams la so nam mi 'ong / chos 'jig rten gnyis kyi don chen sgrub dgos pa rnams 569

chang 'di 'thungs pas 'chor zhes slob dpon klu sgrub kyis gsungs/ yang chang 'thung na shes pa rab rib tu gyur nas bsgyed rdzogs sogs bsgoms kyang gsal bo mi 'char/ ma shar na nyams rtogs shig ga la skye/ byang chub sgrub pa'i bar chad la chang 'di che zhes 'brom ston pa chen bos gsungs/ mi tshe yun thung nam 'chi cha med la chos shig bya snyam pas kyang chang 'thung na rnam g.yeng byas/ nyin mtshan gar shor mi shes/ mi tshe yad ma yud la 'chor/ tshe phyi mar lag stong du 'gro dgos/ chang 'thung na tshe 'dir yang don chen sgrub dgos pa kun 'chor ba tsam du ma zad/ tha ma rang gi srog gcod du 'gyur/ chang 'thung mgo gos kyis btums nas shi ba dang grang nas shi ba mang / g.yang sa la lhung ba/ rta yis drud nas bsad pa/ dgra lag tu shor ba sogs chang 'thung la chags sgo chen po yong yong zhig chang mi 'thung ba la mi 'ong / chang 'thung na mgo na/ zas bskyugs/mig tsha/ gnyid che/ bya ba bzang po sgrub pa dkon/ smyon pa bzhin bya ba ma yin pa thams cad byas/ phung tshabs la chang 'di las che ba zhig med/ des na skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu chang ni nyes pa kun gyi gzhi gsungs/ mdo dran pa nyer bzhag las/ chang 'thung na tsha dmyal du skyes nas 'tshod pa dang /570

chu bo rab med kyi nang du skyur ba dang / dmyal srung rnams kyis nya bton te lcags bsregs la rdeb pa ltar byed/ lcags bzhu ba khar blugs nas nang thams cad bsregs nas bshang lam nas thon/ mir gyur kyang / lkugs pa dang / dman pa dang / blun po'i lus len/ brjed ngas che ba dang / gnyid che ba dang / blo gros dman pa dang / ngo tsha dang khrel chung ba dang / gnod sbyin dang khye'i skye ba lnga brgya re dang / smyon pa'i lus de las kyang mang bar skye'o/ /yang pha rol po la yang chang blud na tshe rabs lnga brgyar lag med du 'ong na/ bdag 'thung ba lta ci sgos/ yang sdom 'dzin la chang byin na dmyal ba ngu 'bod chen por sgye'o gsungs/ des na chang 'di rtswa zil tsam yang btung mi rung ste/dgra bcom pa legs 'ong gi gleng gzhir/ gang zhig chang gi btung ba rtswa'i rtse mo gang yan 'thung bar byed pa ni nga'i nyan thos ma yin la/ nga ni de yi ston pa ma yin no gsungs/ rang gzhan kun bde bar 'dod pa spyi dang / khyad par bla ma grwa pa dge bshes bya btang sgom chen pa kun gyis chos gsha' ma zhig byed 'dod na/ tshogs rdzas tsam ma gtogs spyo chu 'di gtan nas spong dgos te/ mdo las/ phung khrol kun gye rtsa ba yi/ /chang gi btung ba rtag tu spangs/ /gsungs/ dwags po lha rjes/ sdig 571

zas khra bo'i sha dang gcig /myos byed ser mo'i chang dang gnyis/ /blo khrid na chung gzhon dang gsum/ /'di gsum chos pa'i btsan dug yin/ /chos gsha' ma zhig byed na 'di gsum spongs/ /snying nas mdzad na 'di gsum spongs/ /gsungs/ kha rag sgom chung bas/ shes pa 'phro la lus la gnod/ /mkhas btsun rnams kyis smad pa'i gnas/ /nyes pa thams cad 'byung ba'i rgyu/ /chang dang bud med spongs shig ang / /gsungs/ bla ma sgyes chen dam pa dang / gsang sngags kyi rnal 'byor chen po rtogs pa mchog dang ldan pa 'dra yin na ma gtogs/ gzhan sngags kyi sgor zhugs pa'i sngags pa'i khur 'dzin pa sogs skye bo phal ba rnams kyis glang rgan gyis chu 'thung ba ltar chang mang po 'thung nus pa la/ de tsam gye nyes dmigs che ba 'byung ba ma gtogs/ yon tan zhig skye ba rgyal ba sras bcas kyis sngar ma gsungs te/ dpal o rgyan chen po lho nub srin po'i yul du bzhud pa'i dus su rje 'bangs spyi dang khyad par sngags pa rnams la zhal gdams 'di ltar gsungs so/ /nga yi rjes 'jug sngags 'chang tshogs rnams gson: pad 'byung srin bo 'dul du 'gro ba la: mya ngan ma byed zhal gdams 'di nyid ni: nga nyid bzhugs dang khyad med sems 572

la chongs: sngags pa phung byed rgyu ni chang nag yin: chang la 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dang : nga rgyal phrag dog nyon mongs ma lus pa: slong ba'i rgyu kun 'di la tshang ba yin: de phyir chang nag ma 'thung zhal gdams yin: chang 'thung lha bsgoms bzlas brjod byed pa ni: rab tsha zangs zhun khar ldud dmyal bar skye: chang 'thung zor 'phen mnan gtad byed pa ni: lha min 'khrug pa'i dmag dpon chen por skye: chang 'thung bla ma rdo rje spun la ni: rdeg rdung byed pa rdo rje dmyal bar skye: chang 'thung chos rtsod nga rgyal byas pa yis: lce la thong gshol rmo ba'i dmyal bar skye: chang 'thung gzhan la gri 'phyar khros pa yis: gnod sems byed pa yang sos dmyal bar skye:chang 'thung gzhan gye bud med la spyod pa: shal ma ri yi sdong por rtag tu 'drud: chang 'thung rku 'phrog sna tshogs byas pa yis: yi dwags mtshon cha'i 'khor lo can du skye: chang 'thung ngo tsha khrel 'dzem bral ba deḥ glen cing lkugs pa'i dud 'gro'i gnas su skye: sngags pa chang 'thung khye yi lus su skye: gal te mir skyes na yang smyon par sgye: chang 'thung de phyir mdo dang rgyud sde nas: bkag phyir padmas chang 'thung gsungs pa med:ma 'ongs snyigs ma'i dus kyi sngags pa rnams: chang 'thung o 573

rgyan padma'i gsung yin zer: de dag nga yi rjes 'jug ma yin te: nag po bdud kyi rjes su zhugs pa yin: nga bsam nga bsgom nga mchod byed pa'i mis: chang 'thung padma nga nyid bslus pa yin: zhes gsungs so/ /des na kun gyis chang ma 'thungs pa rab yin/ gal te khyem pa pho mo rnams kyi nang nas 'ga' res bag chags ngan pa'i dbang gis chang 'thung dgos pa byung na yang sngar bshad pa'i chang gi nyes dmigs rnams bsams nas chen po mi 'thung bar 'dod chung chog shes bsten pa gces/ yang sngags pa rnams kyis kyang tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor dus sngags kyi gzhung bzhin/oṃ āḥ hūṃ/ ha ho trīḥ la sogs sngags dang ting nge 'dzin gye byin gyis brlabs/ rtsa gsum lha mchod/ rang lus lhar gsal ba la zag med kyi bdud rtsis mchod pa'i tshul du cung zad re bsten pa ma gtogs/ rang dgar hub gang 'thung rung dug dang khyad par med de/ brtag gnyis kyi rgyud las/ ha gsum la sogs dang bral bar/ /ci ste dam tshig can gyis 'thung / /de ni dug 'gyur je tshom med/ /sngags kyi dngos grub mi 'byung ngo / /gsungs/ byen rlabs byas nas 'thung yang / chang gis myos na dmyal ba ngu 'bod du skye ste/ rgyud de nyid las/ su zhig chang gis 574

myos gyur pa/ /de la gegs ni mang po 'byung / /sngags pa chang gis myos gyur gang / /ngu 'bod gnas su 'tshod par 'gyur/ /gsungs/ de ltar bka' dang 'gal na rtsa ltung gnyis pa phog ste/bde gshegs bka' las 'das pa ni/ /ltung ba gnyis pa yin par brjod/ /gsungs/ rtsa ltung phog na tshe 'dir sdug bsngal myong zhing phyi mar dmyal bar 'gro ste/ gzhan du dam tshig las nyams na/ /nyams pa bdud kyis gzung bar 'gyur/ /de nas sdug bsngal myong 'gyur zhing / /thur du bltas te dmyal bar 'gro/ /gsungs/ des na blo gros can gyis gzab 'tshal/ da ni chos bzhin byed na rab byung dge slong sngags pa sgom chen pa rnams kyis dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi 'di ltar 'thung dgos te/ dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa phag mo gru pas/ zhing smon lam dag pa'i sa gzhi la/ /nas dge ba bcu yi sa bon btab/ /thabs shes gnyis kyi sgal dor 'brel/ rtsa ba'i bla mas sna khrid byas/ /dbang po rab kyi thong gshol bzung / /dad gus kyi snyim pas rol tu brtsegs/ /byang chub sems kyi ljang bu 'khrungs/ /mi dge sdig pa'i ldum bu bsal/ /bsod nams dge tshogs kyi ston thog 'khrungs/ /'khor ba rtsad gcod zor bas brngas/ /du ma ro gcig gi bam por bcings/ /byang chub sems kyi bzung thag 573

bres/ /theg chen rgyan ldan skyes bus khur/ /lhun grub khang pa'i steng du phog /kun shes zhe 'dod kyi tshar ma brtsigs/ /kun khyab khri gdugs nyi mas skam/ /bde chen khang pa'i steng du bshar/ /'khor ba bde 'khyams dbyug pas brdungs/ /shes rab ye shes kyi rlung la 'phyar/ /g.yeng ba med pa'i bre la 'jal/ /thos bsam sgom gsum gyi sgyed po btsugs/ /stong nyid zangs kyi nang du btsos/ /'od gsal phya ra'i nang du brdal/ /ye shes bdud rtsi'i phabs phye btab/ /chos nyid ngang du gzim du bcug /sa bcu'i bar du zhag gsum bzhag /byang chub sems kyi skam pas bzung / /ye shes sla nga'i nang du bsdus/ /bka' brgyud bla ma mgron du bos/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i gral gcig bshams/ /'gro ba'i don la bzhes su gsol/ /'thung na dug gsum nad rnams sel/ /mtho ris rigs drug sems can mnyes/ /mi nged kyis chang 'thung de ltar 'thung / /gsungs pa ltar bzhes pa gal che/yang lus la gyon pa'i gos 'di yang sdig pa dang sbrags pa'i gon pa yin te/ snam bu dang phying ba 'di'i phyir du/ lug gi rgyab kyi bal len dus sa la bsgyel/ rkang lag thag pas bsdams/bal tshur 'then nas bregs na tsha/ 'breg mi shes pa'i mi yis 576

bregs na gri yis sha bcad/ 'breg yun ring na lug gi rkang lag na/ sbos nas 'chi la khad byed/ 'ga' res lug sa la bsgyel dus thabs mi mkhas par rdo dang sa 'bur shing sogs kyi steng du shed kyis bsgyel nas rkang lag bcag pa dang / thabs rdugs 'ga' res 'breg gtan nas ma shes/ rma che chung mang po bzos/rma la srin bu 'debs nyen byas nas shi ba mang / yang nam tsha ngan pa lug shed ngan dus 'breg ma ran bzhin du bal bregs nas blangs na/ kha char bu yug 'tshub na lug thams cad grang nas sug bzhi 'dar/ rab tu grang na shed ngan pa'i rigs shi ba grangs mang / ma shi ba rnams kyis kyang rgyab tu bal skye reg shed 'bud reg gi bar du nangs nub char babs dus sogs su gos med gcer bur bsdad pa lta bus grang ba'i sdug bsngal 'byung / 'chi la khad byed/ bal len dus dbyar sa na gnas pa'i srin bu phra rags mang po mi phyugs gnyis ga'i rkang lag lus po sogs kyis brdzis nas bcar/ lug gi rgyab kyi lug shig brgya stong yod pa/ gri dang lag gis bsad pa dang / nyi mas bsregs pa/ mu ges 'chi ba grangs kyis mi zin/ bal 'breg pa'i mi bran dang g.yog sogs kyis nyi ma tsha ba dang / char nang sogs nas tsha grang bkres skom ngal dub mang po blangs/ lug 577

rgod po gzung dus rwa dang rkang lag gis brgyab nas mig dang rkang lag bsnad pa mang / lug mang po'i bal bregs na lag pa dang mgo bo ro stod na/ yang bal bkrus bsed bkal thags su btags/ spu bslangs/ mdog sgyur bzo byas lus la gyon reg gi bar sdug bsngal dka' las mang po myong / de'i dus rnams su yang sa dang rtsi shing bar snang na gnas pa'i srin bu mang po gnod 'tshe byung nas 'chi/ gos kyi nang nas ra lug gi pags pa gyon na/ ra lug tshon po'i pags pa ma gtogs/ gzhan mu ges shi ba sogs kyi pags pas mi yong jed 'gro/ tsho lpags ci nas kyang dgos/ de dgos na tshon po rkyang mi 'chi/ tsho dus sha dang pags pa la dmigs nas gsod dgos/ bsad pa'i pags pa mang po bsdus nas bzos gyon na/ sems can thams cad pha ma drin can sha stag yin zhes sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pas na/don gyes tshe 'di'i pha ma gnyis bsad pa'i pags pa dmar bshus byas/ blangs mnyes bzos nas rgyab tu gyon pa dang khyad par spu tsam med pas sdig sgrib tshad las 'das pa 'byung / ma cig lab sgron gyes/ khye lpags 'di la grib sogs nyes pa che tshul mang po gsungs/ gsung de la dpag na/ deng sang spyang thul wa zhwa sogs gcan gzan ma rungs pa'i pags pa gyon gdan du 578

'ding ba sogs la nyams grib de'i che zhig mi 'byung rung / de tsam zhig yong ba sgos ci dgos/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ khyes mi gtsang ba za yang sdig pa chen po mi byed la/ wa spyang sogs kyis mi gtsang ba za ba tsam du ma zad/ ci za srog dbugs bcad pa'i sha khrag sdig zas kho na za ba'i phyir ro/ /mi dang dud 'gro gang yin rung sdig pa can thams cad la de'i tshod kyi sgrib pa che ste/ mi gsod pa'i dme po dang / ra lug gsod pa'i bshan pa/ri dwags gsod pa'i rngon pa rnams kyi gos gyon zas zos sam lhan du bsdad grib ma phog rung grib 'phog pa mthong thos myong bas kyang shes so/ /'o na khye yis mi gtsang ba za bas grib che gsungs pa yin zer na/ mi gtsang ba mi za ba dkon/ de yin na phag gi sha za ga la rung / mi gtsang ba kho na za/ ra lug 'bri g.yag phal che bas kyang / mi yi gcin 'thung skyag skam za ba mang bas/ de rnams la yang grib che bas sha zos pags pa gyon mi rung bar 'gyur/ de yin na gcan gzan rnams ltogs dus mi gtsang ba rnyed na za ba phar zhog tha na rtsag chad bal rul/srin bu sogs mi gtsang ba du ma za bas/ de gtan nas gyon mi rung bar 'gyur nges/ yang lhag par 'bu ras dang / gos chen gyon mi rung / de'i rgyu de srin bu zhig gsos pa'i khog nas sdom 579

gyi ba thag ltar 'then nas blangs pa yin/ de len dus srin bu mang po 'chi ba yin/ gal te ma shi ba rnams kyang khog gi 'then nas len dus na zug gnod pa chen po 'ongs nas 'chi la khad byed nges/ de len dus/ thags su 'thag dus/ kha bsgyur dus sogs/ rgyab tu gon reg bar du mi mang pos sdug dka' las myong / srin bu mang po gsod/ de gyon na rang mthong nga rgyal dang / zad 'gro bas ser sna/ gos de la snying po med cing sdig pa che ba ma shes pas gti mug gos de mi gtsang ba sogs kyis brdzad pa dang / gzhan gyis 'phrog na zhe sdang / gzhan gyis gos de las bzang ba gyon yod pa mthong na gzhan mtho bar dogs pas phrag dog kho la ga 'dra zhig byung na snyam pas 'dod chags/gos 'di bzang 'di dang ma bral na snyam pa'i zhen chags sogs nyon mongs pa kun slong / nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis brnab sems gnod sems skyes/ rdzun phra ma tshig rtsub smras/ srog gcod ma byin len sogs mi dge ba'i las thams cad nyin re bzhin gsog mi dge ba'i dbang gis tshe 'dir yang sdug la/ phyi mar spyir 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal/ khyad par ngan song gsum gye sdug bsngal dos drag la yun ring myong dgos/des na sngon gyi skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis pags pa dang 580

gos chen gyon pa phar zhog snam ther ras kyang mi gyon par/grub chen rnams kyis gsang gnas 'geb pa la ang rag re tsam ma gtogs gtum mo'i bde drod kyi gos gyon/ sku la mdzes pa'i rus pa'i rgyan drug gsol nas na bza' ye med pa byas/ston pa sangs rgyas kyis kyang lo drug dka' ba spyad dus na bza' ye med pa byas/ sku gcer bur ting nge 'dzin gyi ngang la bzhugs/ sangs rgyas nas kyang sha na'i gos sogs gos ngan ngon tsam bsnams pa ma gtogs/ gos chen mang po brtsegs nas mgo man chad btums gsungs pa zhig med/ de bzhin du sngon gye skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis ro gos dug hrul sogs lus 'tsho ba'i gos ngan ngon gang rnyed re bsten pa yin/ de ltar mdzad pa khong rnams kyis ma mkhyen pa dang / ma 'dod pa dang ma rnyed pa yang ma yin te/ gos la brten nas pha ma sems can mang por dngos sam brgyud nas rim gyis gnod kyis dogs nas/ rang gis yang gyon na sdig sgrib kyis bkab nas nyams rtogs khyad par can mi skye bar mkhyen nas ma gyon pa yin yang /deng sang bya btang ba sgom chen pa sogs mdo sngags nyams su len pa rnams kyis ci tsam 'bad kyang nyams rtogs mi sgye ba'i gegs dang / phyi mar ngan song gi rgyu/ sdig pa'i rtsa ba de phar 581

ded na lto gos 'di yin par ma shes/ 'ga' res/ nang na yon tan kun ldan yang / /cha lugs ngan na kun gyes brnyas/ /zhes sa skya paṇa chen rin po ches gsungs pa de bden par 'dug go zer/ de gang la dgongs nas gsungs pa yin gye dgongs pa mi 'tshol/ de bya btang ri khrod pa 'jig rten chos brgyad dkar nag khra gsum blos btang nas/ rang gzhan gye don du bla med byang chub thob pa'i phyir du chos rnam dag byed pa rnams la gsungs pa yin snyam go log tu go nas/ kha la za rgyu med pa rnams kyis kyang rgyab la gon rgyu gcig gis mi chog gnyis/gnyis kyis mi chog gsum bzhi sogs mang po bsgrubs nas spor len byas gyon pa rnams la nyams rtogs 'char ba phar zhoganyams grib kyis rmi lam bzang po zhig kyang rmi dka'/ bya btang ba sgom chen pa phar zhog ming tsam yang thob dka'/ lto gos mang na khyem pa rnams dang khyad spu tsam med/ tshe blos btang ba de gang la zer/ khyem pa rnams ltar lto gos bsgrub pa zhig la zer ram/ tshe 'di'i bde thabs lto gos gtam gsum blos btang ba la zer/ sems nang du khug brang steng du sor bzhi khroms la soms dang / 'o na da ci byed dgos/ lto ye med pa byas ma zos 'chi la khad kyi yi dwags 'dra ba zhig byas/ gos ye 582

med par mu stegs gcer bu ba lta bu zhig byas/ yang na sprang po ltar dug po tshem ber gyon pa'am/ yang na de yang ma byas gsang bar lhan pa zhig gis 'geb pa yang na lag pas bkab nas sdod dgos pa yin nam zer na/ chos phyir de lta bu zhig byed nus na chos dang yang mthun shin tu legs te/ de 'dra rje mi la sogs sngon gye sgyes bu dam pa rnams kyis lag len la yang btab 'dug deng sang de lta bu phar zhog de'i cha 'dra tsam yang byed mkhan med/ 'o skol rnams kyis yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nas bzung rim par byon pa'i sgyes bu dam pa gong ma rnams kyi rnam thar la kha mig yar blta byed dgos/ rjes 'jug rnams la ci gsungs 'dug de ltar bsgrub dgos pa yin/ 'o na sngon gyi rgyal ba sras bcas kyis ci mdzad/ 'o skol rnams la ji ltar gyes zhes gsungs yod zer na/ de sangs rgyas kyi sgyes rabs dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar mdo rgyud bstan bcos rnams su rgyas par bshad yod mod/ 'dir mdor bsdus te bshad na/ sngon sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis slob lam gye gnas skabs su rgyal po sogs kyi sku'i sgye ba bzhes tshe zas nor longs spyod bu bu mo spyan yan chad sbyin par btang nas tshogs bsags/ tha na dbu gcig pu yang lan stong tsam 583

sbyin par btang / phyis sku tshe de la yang rgyal srid mchil snabs bzhin dor nas zas gos med par byas/ chu bo nee rastona'i 'gram du lo drug dka' ba spyad nas sangs rgyas nas/ rjes 'jug 'o skol yongs la mi nor zas gsum thams cad blos thongs la gnas shing drung sogs dang / zas bsod snyoms gyis/gsog 'jog byas nas za mi rung / byen len ma byas pa dang /zas zhag gis lon pa yang phyi nyin longs spyod mi rung / sogs kyis bcas pa mdzad/ dus rtag tu zas gos gnas mal mkho ba'i yo byad ngan ngon tsam bsten dgos gsungs/ de bzhin du dam pa gong ma thams cad kyis mdzad nas/ rjes 'jug rnams la blo phugs chos la gtod/ chos phugs sprang la gtod/ sprang phugs ltogs grir 'chi ba la gtod/ 'chi phugs brag phug stong pa la gtod gsungs/yang mi gral nas bud/ khye gral bsnyegs/ lha gral thob gsungs/ yang jebs med rdo rje sngon la btang / khrel med rdo rje rjes la zhog ye shes rdo rje rang dang 'grogs gsungs/ de bzhin du mkhas grub rā ga a gyes kyang / bka' brgyud gong mas gsungs pa yi/ /ri chos rnams kyi don rtsa ni/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba blos/ btang nas/ /pha yul spangs nas gnas ri ru/ /mi rtag 'chi 584

bas sems dngangs te/ /lto gos gtam la gyong bskur nas/ /chu 'thung rdo mur ro gos gyon/ /gsungs/ spyan snga bas/ gos su bem po mda' sdug gyon/ /skom du tshwa med sdor med 'thung / /zas su gye na ngan ngon zo/ /brgya la mi yis mi mthong zhing / /gal te mi yis mthong ba na/ /mig rtsa sha zhan mdog nag cing / /gsang bar lhan pa gyon pa zhig /skyes bu 'di 'dra snying rje zhes/ /snying rje'i yul du byed pa zhig /da ni lag len mi 'gel ri/ /gsungs pa ltar ci la byed mi dgos/ sngon gye skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis chos phyir dka' spyad sdug khur byed dgos pa byung na/ 'o skol rnams kyis de bas lhag pa zhig byed mi dgos kyang /de dang mnyam pa'am/ gal te ma nus na/ de'i cha 'dra tsam zhig bya dgos pa smos ci dgos/ tshe sngon sdig pa mang po bsags pa'i khar/ tshe 'dir yang sdig zas dang / sdig pa'i gos kho na la longs spyod na nam yang thar pa'i go 'phang zhig ga la 'thob/deng sang bya btang sgom chen pa sogs chos sgor zhugs tshad yongs la chos rnam dag cig mi 'ong ba'i gegs gang gis byas na/ lto gos 'di gnyis blos ma thongs pa 'di gas lan/ lto gang bzang gon pa gang dro mdzad mkhan la chos rnam dag cig 'ong ba rgyal ba sras bcas kyis sngar ma gsungs te/ chos rje 'brug pa 585

kun legs kyi zhal nas/ lto gos 'di blo yis ma thongs na/ /pu ti mkhyen pa'i dge bshes kyang / /btsun pa'i khral 'jal ma gtogs pa/ /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa zin pa dka'/ /lto gos 'di blo yis ma thongs na/ /'jigs rung gi sngags pa hūṃ sgra sgrogs/ /rnga sil gye ldan pa gcog lags kyang / /don gyi thugs sgrub yin pa dka'/ /lto gos 'di blo yis ma thongs na/ /thor tshugs tsho hūṃ gis brgyan pa yi/ /rtogs ldan gyi spyod pa mdzad lags kyang / /spyod pa bzhi dang mthun pa dka'/ /lto gos 'di blo yis ma thongs na/ /khri thog na bzhugs pa'i bla ma yang chos bshad kyi 'brug sgra sgrogs lags kyang / /gzhan phan gyi thugs rje 'byung ba dka'/ /lto gos 'di blo yis ma thongs na/ /ri khrod na gnas pa'i sgom chen kyang / /phyi ltar gyi sgrub tshugs ma lags pa/ /nang don gyi rtogs pa 'char ba dka'/ /lto gos 'di blo yis ma thongs na/ /bug sgo la 'dzul ba'i grub thob kyang / /nyams kyi rtsal snang ma gtogs pa/ /mthar thug gi sangs rgyas thob pa dka'/ /lto gos 'di blo yis ma thongs na/ /rgyal khams kyi gnas chen skor mkhan kyang / /sa gu tsi rkang pas bsad bsad nas/ /gnas chen nas dngos grub thob pa dka'/ /lto gos 'di blo yis ma thongs na/ /'dul ba'i grwa sar bzhugs 586

mkhan kyang / /'phral gyi srung sdom rems lags kyang / /phugs kyi tshul khrims yin pa dka'/ /lto gos 'di blo yis ma thongs na/ /brgyud pa bzang bo'i dbon po yang / /'phral gyi zas nor bzang lags kyang / /sangs rgyas kyi gdung tshab yin pa dka'/ /lto gos 'di blo yis ma thongs na/ /khyed chen dang khrid chung zhu mkhan kyang / /'dir ltos kyi zas nor ma gtogs pa/ /don khrid rgyud la skye ba dka'/ /gsungs/ des na blo ldan lha chos rnam dag byed 'dod pa rnams kyis spyir ston pas gsungs pa'i 'dul ba'i gzhung bzhin dang / sgos su 'phags pa'i rigs bzhir gnas/dam pa gong ma'i gsung gi gtad pa bzhi/ bud bsnyegs thob gsum/ rdo rje gsum dang bcu bo 'di la phugs nor bcu zer/'di bcu dus rgyun du bsten pa gces/ de ltar byas nas shi song na yang legs te/ gang shar rang grol gyes/ bla ma'i rjes bzung bya btang khyod/ /sngar byas las la 'gyod pa bsgyed/ /mi yi khyu nas ro ltar bud/ /dka' spyad sdug khur dang du longs/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug mi la yi/ /snying rus mthu yis ji ltar thob/ /sos dal skyid chos can rnams la/ /ji ltar 'dug la bsam blo thongs/ /las nyon dbang gis skyes phyin chad/ /nam yang 'chi ba mnyam po la/ /chos phyir dka' spyad drag bsten nas/ /myur du shi 587

na mi legs sam/ /gsungs/yang bud med bsten na sdig sdug gtam ngan gyi gzhi ma/'khor ba ngan song du mar 'khrid pa'i sa mkhan yin te/ chung ma zhig len rgyu yin na/ de'i rin la nor rdzas rngams chen thams cad ster dgos/ phyug po yang dbul por gtong / sgur sgur sha dang / 'bru 'bru chang byas nas ston chen byed dgos/ ra lug g.yag gsum bsad pa'i rnam smin gyes dmyal bar skye ba phar zhog sha chang gzhan la byin pa'i rnam smin gyes kyang dmyal ba mnar med du sgye ste/ dran pa nyer bzhag las/ sha chang gnyis rang gis longs spyod pa lta ci smos/ sbyin par byen kyang dmyal ba ngu 'bod du skye gsungs/ sha chang mang po bsags nas ston mo chen po byed pa rnams kyis skabs rer bsam mno thongs dang bzang / chags pa spyad pas bde ba ltar snang yang / don du sdug bsngal la bde ba'i ming btags nas bde bar bzung ba yin pas bde ba dngos min/ dper na dug dang 'dres pa'i zas de zos nas bzung sdug bsngal gye mgo tshugs pa ltar/ chags pa spyad nas bzung sdug bsngal gye mgo tshugs song / dper na dug dang 'dres pa'i zas de za dus sdub bsngal phra bas bde ba ltar snang rung / phyi nas sdug bsngal che ru song / lus sems kyis myong 588

ba ltar/ 'dod chags spyod dus sdug bsngal phra bas bde ba ltar snang rung / phyi nas lus stobs shor/ gzi mdangs nyams/ grang nad bsgyed/ ro smad na/ khyad par 'bras bu skrangs/ 'ga' re rma ngan pa 'gos nas sdug bsngal chen po 'byung / 'dod chags kho rang bde ba yin na spyad kyin bde ba cher 'gro dgos te/ spyad kyin sdug bsngal cher bskyed pa de sdug bsngal yin pa'i rtags yin/ des na mdo las/ yud tsam bde la chags pa ni/ /'bar ba'i khri la chags pa 'o/ /gsungs/ chags pa spyad pa'i rjes su sdug bsngal gyi gzhi ma bu bu mo mang po 'ong / de kun gyi kha mi sos/ rgyab mi khebs pas sems khral che/ lto rgyab gnyis kyi phyir khe tshong zhing las 'tsho skyong sogs byas/ tsha grang bkres skom sogs mi 'dod pa'i sdug bsngal du ma 'byung / brnab sems gnod sems ngag 'khyal sogs mi dge bcu nyin re bzhin byed dgos/ byas na tshe phyi mar dmyal ba ma gtogs gzhan du 'gro sa mede/ khyad par bya btang sgom chen pas phyag rgya ma bsten pa/phung ba'i gzhi ma zhig bsten pa yin/ phyag rgya ma bsten phyin chad rgyu nom pa dgos/ phyag rgya ma bsten pa dang bya btang byed pa gnyis mi 'ong / nor rdzas sa zhing khang pa sogs gsar du gsog dgos/ de gsar du gsog rgyu zhig gi dbang du song na/ tshe 'di 589

ba byed dgos/ tshe 'di ba byas na sdig sdug gtam ngan gsum rgyun mi 'chad pas/ bde ba'i go skabs med/ chos mi dgos 'jig rten gyi bde ba yang mi 'ong / des na mdo las/ bltas shing gtam kyang phongs gyur na/ /de nyid bsten pa smos ci dgos/ /gsungs pa de thugs bden te/ deng sang khrims ldan 'ga' res bud med la bltas gtam zhig smras kyang / 'ga' res dge slong des kyang sdom pa la khrig khrig cig med tshod red zer/ bsnyen bkur snyan grags che ba yang nyams par 'gyur/ bla ma sgyes bu dam pa yin yang skur ba btab/ bsnyen bkur mi 'byung / bstan 'gro'i don chen po 'ong ba phar zhog rang don yang mi 'ong ba mthong thos mang /sngon a mdo bla rgan zhig gis bud med gcig la chags pa spyad pas bud med de la rma ngan pa zhig yod pa zhag gcig la 'gos/ phyis sman pas sman btang / kho rang gis mgo sgur nas gsang mtshan la sngags btab tshe/ gzhan rnams kyis de'i lad mo byas dpe 'then tshad kyis bzhag nas ha gad byed pa zhig byung skad/ des na rab byung dge slong bya btang sgom chen bla ma rnams kyis dus rgyun du tshul khrims bsrungs kyang dkor gyes tshos nas/ skabs rer gsang nas bud med re bsten rung chog 590

snyam nas bsten na/ nad ngan 'dra 'gos nas gsang mi tshugs par sman pa bos sngags 'debs dgos pa tsho 'byung nyen che bas/ ngo tsha khrel la 'dzem pa rnams kyis de 'dra'i gtam rgyud rnams soms la shin tu gzab 'tshal/ tshe phyi mar dmyal ba sogs su skyes nas sdug bsngal dpag med myong dgos tshul ni/bu ston rin po che'i zhal nas/ log par g.yem pas dmyal ba bsdus 'joms su/ /gsal shing 'bar bar ro smad 'bigs par 'gyur/ /de nas mi ru skyes kyang ma ning 'gyur/ /rmi lam bud med spyad pa'i ro myang na/ /dmyal ba padma ltar gas nang du ni/ /bum par 'tshod cing gtun gyes 'tshogs gyur na/ /dngos su spyad pa lta yang smos ci dgos/ /bud med mthong nas tshul min yid byed pa/ /mig ni zangs zhun 'bar bas sreg par byed/ /bud med glu dbyangs thos pas chags gyur pa/ /rna bar ro myags bskol ba khrug par byed/ /bud med glu dbyangs gar la chags pa yis/ /khu ba phyung nas 'gyod pa mi byed pa/ /lcags kyi me mdag char ba lus la 'bab/ /gzhan gye chung ma la spyad rdzun smra na/ /ngu 'bod chen po mun pas kun khyab par/ /spyi bo nas phug lce phyung bcad kyang ni/ /skad cig re rer sgye zhing gcod par byed/ /mi ru skyes kyang dmus long 'on pa dang / /lam zan 591

slong ba dag tu sgye bar 'gyur/ /dge bsnyen ma la log par g.yem pa yis/ /rab tu tsha bar thal ba'i lhag ma yang med par bsreg cing tshe rabs bzhi brgya ru/ /za ma dag tu skye bar 'gyur ba yin/ /zhes dang / bud med mtshan ma snyan dngags kyis bstod pa/ /skye ba lnga brgyar mngal gyi srin bur skye/ /chags pa spyad cing reg pa smos ci dgos/ /zhes mdo dang 'dul ba rnams nas rgyas par gsungs pa'i don tshig nyung ngur bsdus nas gsungs par gda'/ slob dpon bai ro tsa na'i zhal nas/bud med bya ba btsan dug ha la yin/ /sems can gang gis zos kyang 'chi ba yin/ /bud med bya ba las kyi sren mo yin/ /sems can gang gis 'khor yang la 'ur 'chi/ /bud med bya ba dmyal ba'i 'dam rdzab yin/ /sems can gang gis 'khor ba 'dam la 'dzin/ /bud med bya ba 'khor ba'i btson ra yin/ /gang gis 'bags kyang thar pa thob mi srid/ /bud med bya ba bdud kyi mya ngan yin/ /gang gis 'brel kyang sdug bsngal tshad med myong / /bdag gi sems la 'dod chags sa bon med/ /sems la med par lus la ci la skye/ /zhes dang / kha rag sgom chung bas/ bzar med khyem thab byas pa na/ /dogs med bu tsha byung nas ni/ /khrel med sprang po bya dgos kyi/ /gros nyes chung ma 592

ma len ang / /zhen chags bral ba'i dam pa la/ /las kyi phyag rgyas dgos pa med/ /zhen chags sems dang 'dres pa yi/ /phyag rgyas ngan 'gror 'khrid do ang / /gsungs/ 'brug pa kun legs kyis/ sdug bsngal bud med bsten pa'i bde ba de/ /dbang gsum bsgur don yin zhes gsungs na'ang / /de bsten nus pa thob pa yod dam kye/ /rtsal med rta rgod zhon pa a'u mtshar/ /zhes dang / dbang gsum dngos grub ster ba'i rig ma de/ /ma gsang sgrub dang sa spyod sdug bsngal bsgyed/ /bu mo btsun ma'i 'khor gyes bskor ba 'dis/ /rtsa ltung bdun pa phog go snying gtam yin/ /zhes dang / rang sems bde chen gyi khang bzang na/ /rang snang 'gags med kyi mkha' 'gro bzhugs/ /thabs mchog khyad par can zhig de na gda'/ /chags pas bud med ma bsten ang / /gsungs/ 'o na ji ltar byed dgos zer na chos bzhin byed na rje btsun mi la ras pa ltar/ chags bral stong nyid kyi phyag rgya bsten dgos te/ rje mi las/ spyir yang bud med chags pa'i rgyu/ /mtshan ldan rig ma shin tu dkon/ /lam pho nya'i bgrod pa ngo mtshar yang / /khyod skye bo ya ga'i sgo skur mchi/ /yongs de phyir phyag rgya bsten pa dka'/ /nga chags bral stong pa'i bud med la/ /snying rje'i mdangs can bzhin bzang ma byams 593

pa'i 'dzum gyis yid 'phrog cing / /sna tshogs dkar dmar re'u 'bri la/ /gnyis med thug phrad dar gyes g.yogs/ /ro snyoms spyod pa'i ka sha can/ /nyams dga' ba bzhi'i lan tshar la/ /du ma ro gcig do shal can/ /gzhi gnyug ma'i don rtogs mtshar sdug ldan/ /de rnal 'byor nga yi grogs mo yin/ /khyed 'khor ba'i khyem thab nga mi 'dod/ /gsungs/ bud med la spyad nas yon tan zhig len rgyu yod na khyem pa rgad po dang / ser khyem pa 'ga' res tshe gang po byas te/ mi kha gtam ngan gyod dang pham kha ma gtogs nang nas yon tan til 'bru tsam yang len rgyu ma byung / bud med la spyad spyad nas su yang mtho ris thar pa thob zer ba zhig mi snang / des na blo gros can gyis bud med bsten pa'i nyes dmigs mdo rgyud du ma nas gsungs pa'i tshig don rnams yang yang yid la bsams nas/ lha'i bu mo mthong yang chags pa mi skye bar tshul khrims bsrung ba'i phan yon ma bsrungs pa'i nyes dmigs mtha' yas gsungs pa soms la/mig 'bras bzhin tshul khrims bsrung la mdo sngags kyi chos gang yang nyams su longs/ kun mkhyen thu'u bkwan rin po ches/sngags rnying 'ga' re la sngon gye dpe hrul ser gog ma/ da dung zad zad bar du klogs gsungs pa ltar/ 'dod yon sha chang 594

bud med la spyod pa sngags su rlom pa'i sngags pa dud dreg can rnams kyis da dung gsang mtshan zad zad bar du chags pa spyod la/ gzhan chags bral gye rnal 'byor pa rnams la theg dman nyan thos pa tsho zhes khas ma gtong / sngags na thig le yungs 'bru tsam nyams na/ mkha' 'gro 'bum phrag ngu tsi ldir gsungs/ de bden na deng sang dbyar gyi glang dang / ston gye khye ltar spyod pa rnams kyis las la mkha' 'gro kun gyes has ring po 'debs kyin yod tshod na 'dug pas/ thig le yar 'dren mi nus pas bshag pa re gyis dang bzang ngo / /smras pa/ nyi ma bzhin du kun la phan thogs pa'i/ /dpal ldan bla mas 'gro kun brtse bas skyongs/ /skabab/ skabs snyan pa'i glu re len pa de/ /rang gshis yin kyang gzhan gyis nyan par 'os/ /tshe rabs 'khor ba thog ma ma mchis pa'i/ /pha ma ma byas sems can gcig kyang med/ /byas tshe tshe 'di'i pha mas bskyangs pa ltar/ /yang yang drin gyis bskyangs pa sha stag yin/ /drin can 'gro la phan zhig mi thogs rung / /bsad nas za ba khrel med rnams kyi lugs/ /ra lug gri yis gsod pa snying re rje/ /sdig zas pha ma'i sha la ma rngam zhig /don yal nor zad thos bsam sgom nyams shing / /khyad par sdom pa dam tshig nyams pa'i rgyu/ /595

spyo chu chang gi nyes dmigs dran bzhin du/ /rtswa rtse'i zil ba tsam yang btung mi bya/ /snam bu 'bu ras gos chen la sogs pa'i/ /gos kyi phyir du srog chags grangs med 'chi/ /sdig pa'i gos kyi nyes dmigs legs bsams nas/ /ngan ngon gos gyon gtum mo'i bde drod sbor/ /'jig rten khyem thab bud med len pa de/ /sdig sdug gtam ngan thams cad bskyed pa'i gzhi/ /de phyir gcig pur dben par sgom sgrub gyis/ /lus sems dga' bdes myos tshe skyid glu longs/ /skya min ser min 'di med phyi med kyi/ /bya ba ngan pa nam yang ma byed ces/ /snyigs dus skya ser pho mo thams cad la/ /skad gseng mthon bos bshad bzhin mi sdod 'gro/ /'di 'dra'i mgur dbyangs len bzhin ri khrod la/ /'gro ba'i mi la skyid po yong bar snang / /de phyir skal bzang las 'phro can gyi mis/ /ri khrod dben pa 'grims la lha chos gyes/ /zhes pa'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /khyad par lus 'di sdug bsngal thams cad 'dren pa'i rtsa ba yin te/ lus 'di med na lto gos sogs 'dod yon lnga gang yang mi dgos/ de ma dgos na sdig pa mi byed/ sdig pa ma byas na sdug bsngal mi 'byung / lus 'di blangs phyin lto gos sogs 'dod yon ci nas kyang dgos/ de dgos phyin sdig pa ci nas 596

kyang byed/ sdig pa byas phyin tshe 'di phyi gnyis shar sdug bsngal ci nas kyang 'byung / dper na lus na rnag khrag bsogs pa'i rma 'bras chen po zhig yod na/ de dang ma bral bar du na zug 'byung ba dang / lci ba'i khur po zhig gis mnan na/ de ma phog bar du nam yang bde ba zhig med pa ltar/ las dang nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis 'khor ba'i nang 'dir lus shig blangs phyin/de dang ma bral bar du bde ba zhig mi 'byung ste/ lus 'dis tshe 'dir na rga 'chi ba sogs sdug bsngal du ma 'dren/ phyi mar 'khor ba dang khyad par ngan song gsum gyi sbug bsngal steng du 'dren pa yin/ des na spyir 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs khyad par lus 'di'i nyes dmigs thams cad shes pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis lus 'di gos rgyan ltar rgyan du bzung nas bye dor mi byed par/ rma 'bras sam khur lci ba ltar khur du bzung / lus 'di dor nas skye rga na 'chi sogs sdug bsngal gye ming tsam yang mi thos pa'i 'phags pa'i go 'phang zhig thob na snyam/ de 'thob thabs chos sgrub pa'i phyir lus 'di 'dor ba la chags pa phar zhog khur po zhig phog pa ltar spro ba yin/ 'o skol rnams kyis kyang de ltar shes na/ gcin skyag snabs lud sogs mi gtsang ba'i rdzas sum cu so gnyis kyis gang ba'i phung po mi 597

gtsang rdzas kyi rkyal ba 'di bzang po phan 'dogs can du 'dzin pa'i blo log nas dgra ltar mthong yong / de ltar zhen pa log na lus kyi gces 'dzin blos thongs/ phyin chad 'khor ba'i gnas 'dir skye 'dod kyi blo mi skye bar/ da res nas bzung 'di las thar nas sdug bsngal gyi ming tsam yang med pa'i padmo las brdzus te skyes/ lus mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku/ ngag yan lag drug cu'i gsung / sems gsal stong chos kyi sku thob pa'i skal ba zhig byung na snyam pas thar 'dod kyi blo bcos ma ma yin pa zhig snying khong rus pa'i gting nas skye/ tshe 'dir 'khor ba las thar thabs kyi chos la 'bad pa ma gtogs/ 'khor ba'i lus bongs spyod gang la yid smon skad cig tsam yang mi skye bar lus kyi gces 'dzin lto gos gtam gsum thams cad 'phongs phyis pa'i rdo ltar blos thongs nas/ chos ma gtogs gzhan bsam rgyu ci yang med/ tshe blos thongs na zas nor sgrub blo gtan nas mi skye/ sgrub blo ma skyes na nyon mongs pa mi ldang / nyon mongs pa ma langs na las ngan mi bsog las ngan ma bsags na 'khor bar mi skye/ 'khor bar ma skyes na thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob yong / des na rgyal ba gong ma rnams kyis tshe blos thongs na thar pa'i lam sna zin gsungs pa'i rgyu mtshan de 598

yin/ de ltar ma shes na lus la gces 'dzin skye/ gces 'dzin gye dbang gis lto gang bzang gon pa gang dro sogs 'dod yon lnga sgrub blo skye/ de skyes na spyir 'dod yon lnga dang khyad par lto gos bsgrub dgos/ de bsgrub rgyu'i dbang du song na chags sdang sogs nyon mongs pa kun ldang / langs phyin mi dge bcu sogs las ngan pa bsogs/ las ngan pa'i dbang gis spyir 'khor ba dang khyad par ngan song gsum du skyes nas thar pa'i dus mi 'byung / des na bla ma skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis tshe blos ma thongs na ji tsam dge ba la 'bad pa byas kyang thar pa nam yang mi thob ces gsungs pa la mkhas pa zhig gis dpyad shes na go rgyu chen po yod/'o na chos kyi gnad gcig ma rtogs na tshe blos thongs pa tsam gyis gang yang mi yong / des yong na sprang po rnams kyis sngar nas thar pa thob par rigs zer na/ de gnyis phyi'i rnam 'gyur 'dra rung nang gi bsam tshul 'dra dogs med/ sprang pos ma rnyed pa ma gtogs rnyed na dga' ba la ma rnyed na sems khral che/ tshe blos btang gis rnyed kyang dga' ba med/ rnyed tshad mi len/ ma rnyed kyang 'gyod pa med/ rnyed pa mi 'tshol/ tshe blos thongs zer ba ma gtogs/ tshe phyi thongs gsungs pa med/ dper 0 99

na nor bu dang mching bu gnyis dbyibs mtshungs kyang / dgos 'dod 'byung mi 'byung gi khyad che ba ltar/ tshe blos btang dang sprang po gnyis phyi'i rnam 'gyur mtshungs kyang / nang gi bsam tshul mi gcig pas thar pa thob mi thob kyi khyad par gnam sa bas kyang che/ des na tshe blos btang ba dang sprang po gnyis gcig snyam nas/ kha nas kyang de skad smras pas chos ma shes pa'i rang mtshang phyir bstan pa yin pas gzhan ma sems/ tshe blos btang ba dang sprang po khyad med smras na sngon yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'khor nyan thos dgra bcom/ rgya bod kyi sgyes chen dam pa thams cad kyang sprang po dang khyad par med ces don gyes skur ba gdab par 'gyur/ sangs rgyas byang sems kun gyis tshe blos thongs zhes lan grangs du mar gsungs pa rnams kyang sprang po'i rgyu tsam bstan pa ma gtogs/ thar pa'i rgyu ru don gyes mi 'gyur zhes dgag pa gtang bar 'gyur/ de yin na tshe blos ma thongs pa thams cad de las khyad 'phags su khas len dgos/ de khas len na khyod dngos 'gal gyi khur gyes mnan nas 'og nas 'khun dgos pa'i tshod tsam 'byung yang / da de tsam gyes zhog la thongs/ yang deng sang lto gang bzang gon pa gang dro byed pa 'ga' res/ rje skal ldan rgya mtshos/ lto gang 600

bzang gon pa gang dro snyam/ /chos bzang po zhar dang zhor la sdus/ /gsungs pa sogs ma shes/ gzhan dben par 'tsho ba dka' thub la brten nas dam pa'i chos kyi snying po len pa la/glen pa u tshugs can/ chos phyir rang lus bzang po lag nyes la ma gtong / dka' ba spyod mi rung /grong chog sogs gyes lto mod pa gos dro ba gyis/ lus la gces spras byed pa gal che tsho zer/kha ta byed pa de/ dper bzhag na/ mi gtsang ba'i rkyal ba chen po zhig khur yod pa'i mis/ gzhan zhig gis mi gtsang ba'i rkyal ba khur ba phog nas lo tog skye phyir gtor ba mthong na/ glen pa u tshugs can/ lo tog smin phyir gtor nas ci bya/ dus rgyun du khur la mi gtsang ba je mang du thongs/ bye dor byed pa gal che/zhes smras pa dang 'dra ba'i mi de shin tu glen pa yin te/ rje mi las/ phung po mi gtsang rdzas kyi rkyal ba la/ /bzang 'dod bye dor byed pa shin tu glen/ /gsungs/ yang sngar bshad pa ltar/ 'khor ba'i lus dang longs spyod 'di'i phyir dus rgyun du khyem pa pho mo rnams kyis so nam zhing las 'tsho skyong sogs byas/ nyes pa mtha' yas pa bsog tshul la bsam blo zhib tu btang na/ dgon pa'i grwa pa 'ga' re dkor gyes tshig nas/ bud med bsten/khyem pa'i las la rems pa de/ dper na bsil khang nas mi sdod 601

par mig zum nas mar me chen po 'bar ba'i dkyil du mchongs nas tshig tshe yan lag g.yab pa dang 'dra bas gzhan ma sems/ 'o na 'khor ba'i lus dang longs spyod thams cad sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig yin gsungs pa dang / dal 'byor rnyed dka' don che yid bzhin nor las lhag gsungs pa dang /sngags bla med na gzugs phung rnam snang sogs phung po lnga rigs lnga yin pas/ zas gos sogs lha la mchod pa'i tshul du legs par ma phul bar/ dka' spyad byas na lha la brnyas pa yin pas/ phung po sangs rgyas mnga' bdag nyid/ /de la smod pa brgyad pa yin/ /gsungs pas/ rtsa ltung brgyad pa 'phog tsha grang bkres skom ngal dub mtshon cha rdo dang dbyug pas brdungs nas bsad pa'am/ yang na g.yang sa la mchongs pa 'gags nas 'chi ba sogs byas na/ yi dam gyi lha bsad pa lta bu'i nyes pa 'byung gsungs pa dang / 'di gnyis 'gal ba che zer na/ de gang la dgongs nas gsungs pa yin shes na 'gal ba med/dgongs pa ma lon na 'gal ba ltar 'gyu / dal 'byor don che rnyed dka' yid bzhin nor las lhag gsungs pa de/ mar ngan song gsum sogs mi khom pa'i gnas brgyad la bltas na da lta'i lus 'di yid bzhin nor las lhag pa de bden pas na/ de 602

la dgongs nas gsungs pa yin la/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bshad dus phung po 'di sdug bsngal thams cad bsgyed pa'i gzhi ma yin/ mi gtsang rdzas kyis gang ba'i rkyal ba dang 'dra gsungs pa de/ 'khor ba'i skye rga na 'chi sogs sdug bsngal gyi ming tsam mi thos pa'i dgra bcom pa'i sku dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi mtshan dpe gzi brjid 'bar ba'i sku la bltas na/ da lta'i phung po 'di mi gtsang rkyal ba dang mtshungs pa de bden pas/ de la dgongs nas gsungs pa yin/ dper na lcags kyi dus lcags phye zer ba ltar/ lus tha mal ba'i dus tha mal lus zer/ gser 'gyur gyi rtsis lcags phye rnams gser du bsgyur dus lcags mi zer bar gser zer ba ltar/ mtshan ldan bla ma las gsang sngags smin byed dbang dang grol byed khrid thob nas/bsgyed rdzogs bsgoms tha mal ba'i lus lhar bsgyur dus/ tha mal lus mi zer bar yi dam lha yin zhes brjod kyang chogaspyir chos thams cad sems kyi sgyur phyogs yin/ sgos su gsang sngags mos lam gyes 'grub pa yin pas/ lus lha/ ngag sngags/ sems thugs kyi rang bzhin du ye nas yin yang legs/min yang rung / gang ltar na'ang / gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i gzhung bzhin snod bcud thams cad lha dang gzhal yas khang gi 603

rang bzhin/ 'dod yon spyod tshad lha la mchod pa'i tshul du mos na skabs shig tha mal snang zhen chod nas/ rang snang lha'i zhing khams dang rang lus lha ru gyur/ mthar thug zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang mngon du 'gyur bas na/ gnas skabs lam gyi dus su rang bzhin gyi lus lha ru bltas/ mchod bstod bkur na/ tha mal du bzung nas brnyas smod khyad gsod sun 'byin rdeg rdung sogs byed pa'i nyes pa kun khegs nas kun la phan bde 'byung zhing / khyad par rtsa rlung thig le rgyas nas lam la sa chod chen po 'byung ba sogs phan pa'i dgos pa du ma yod par dgongs nas/ dka' spyad sogs mi rung lha brnyas pa dang bsad pa lta bu'i nyes pa che zhes gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i khyad chos tsam du gsungs pa yin gye/ nges don du rang lus lha ru gsal nus pa'i rnal 'byor pa zhig gis de la 'bul rgyu zhig kyang sprul nus pas lha le brnyas pa byed dgos don med/ gal te ma phul kyang snang stong lha sku la bkres skom mi mnga'/ phul kyang bzhes pa'i nges pa med/ mdo sde na/ bcom ldan 'das ni gzhan gye don du gzugs bzung yang / zhal zas lto bar bzhes ma myong ba'i lo rgyus 'dug ces 'brug pa kun legs kyis gsungs/ sku la bkres skom med/ bzhes pa'i nges pa yang med 604

na brnyas rgyu dang gsod rgyu zhig ga na yod/ de med na nyes pa 'byung dogs med/ de ltar rang lus lha ru gsal mi nus pas g.yang sa la mchongs pa dang 'gags pa dang / dka' spyad drag po sogs byas bsad rung sdig pa yod pa yin gyes/ yi dam lha bsad pa'i nyes pa mi 'byung / 'o na bla mas slob bu'i lus lha ru gsal btab nas/ gsang sngags kyi dbang bskur nas bzung /rang lus lha ru gsal mi gsal su yin rung brnyas pa byas na nyes pa 'byung zer na/ de yin na sngon ston pa sangs rgyas kyis ma mkhyen par lo drug dka' ba spyad nas/ yi dam brnyas 'dugade bzhin du rtag tu ngu / nā ro pa/ rje mi la/ rgod tshang pa/ spyan snga ba sogs sngon byon skyes bu dam pa mang pos dka' spyad byas/yi dam la pham glan 'dug sangs rgyas kyis slob pa lam gyi gnas skabs su/ ljon shing gcig gi drung du ni/ /dbu ni lan stong sbyin par btang / /zhes gsungs/ sangs rgyas kyis lha mang po bsad pa yin zhes zer dgos/ de yin na 'o skol rnams kyis yi dam lha'i klung rta dar du bcug 'dug da da ngas bsams na yi dam lha'i klung rta dar ba yin min mi shes/ phyi nas shi dus bya'am khye'i klung rta dar du bcug pa yin pa thag chod/ deng sang sngags bla med kyi dbang lung ji tsam thob pa 'ga' res/ gzhan 605

smyung gnas srung ba sogs chos phyir dka' ba spyad nas dal ba'i rten la snying po len pa la yon tan du mi lta bar ma zad/sngags kyi dbang thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas dka' spyad kyis lus gdung du bcug na sngags kyi rtsa ltung 'phog pa'i rgyu/ phyi rol mu stegs pa'i chos lugs dang 'dra bas de mi rung zer skyon du bltas brnyas smod byed pa mang / de chos ma shes pa'i rang mtshang bstan pa yin pas gzhan ma sems/ da khyod kyis phag bzhin gsos nang na len rgyu zhig yod na longs/ gzhan chos phyir dka' spyad nus pa'i skal bzang pho mo rnams la gtam de skad smra bar mi rigs/ chos phyir dka' ba spyod pa 'di/ pha bla ma mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i zhabs tog las sgrib sbyangs pa'i phyags shing / nyams rtogs skye ba'i mthun rkyen gyi mchog yin te/ rje mi las/ snying rus sdug bsran gyi sgrub pa 'di/ /pha bla ma mnyes/ pa'i zhabs tog yin/ /gcig pur ri khrod 'grims pa 'di/ /mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i zhabs tog yin/ /rang rtsis med pa'i dam chos 'di/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i zhabs tog yin/ /na rga shi skyid snying rus 'di/ /las sdig sgrib sbyangs pa'i phyags shing yin/ /sdig zas spangs pa'i dka' thub 'di/ /nyams rtogs skye ba'i mthun rkyen yin/ /gsungs/ chos phyir rang gis dka' ba spyad 606

gzhan yang de la bskul na phan yon dang bka' drin dpag med yod de/ rje mi las/ chos phyir dka' ba spyod pa la/ /bsod nams dpag tu med pa yod/ /de la 'jug cing bskul ba la/ /bka' drin dpag tu med pa yod/ /gsungs/ thams cad bsam pa la rag las pas/ tshe 'di'i che 'dod grags 'dod rnyed pa sogs chos brgyad 'dod nas dka' ba spyad na phan yon med pa bden te/ 'brom gyes tshe 'di'i 'dod pas kun nas bslangs pa'i las byas pa rnams la 'bras bu ci mchis zhus pas/ jo bo rje'i zhal nas/ 'bras bu de kho na nyid mchi gsungs/phyi mar ci mchis zhus pas/ dmyal ba mchi/ yi dwags mchi/ dud 'gro mchi gsungs/ de ma gtogs rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi don du thob bya bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par 'dod nas/ de'i phyir chos byed dus dka' ba dpag tu med pa spyad kyang nyes pa spu tsam med par ma zad/ phan yon dpag med yod pa mdo rgyud bstan bcos kun nas gsungs pas/ 'di la 'gal ba 'phud rgyu zhig med/ des na blo gros can gyes 'tsho ba dka' thub la brten nas dge sbyor byed pa gces te/ gang shar rang grol gyis/ dad zas 'di 'phral zhim phugs su gnod/ /dka' spyad de 'phral sdug phugs 607

su phan/ /dge sbyor gyis 'dir bde phyi mar skyid/ /de'i phyir na dad zas ma za bar/ /dka' thub kyi ngang nas dge sbyor mdzod/ /gsungs/ 'di lta bu'i tshig gi ngos nas 'gal ba lta bu mang bas/de gang la dgongs nas gsungs pa yin ma shes na 'khrul gzhi chen po 'byung /sngar yang mkhas par rlom pa mang pos rgyal ba'i gsung rab mdo sngags dang / rgya bod kyi paṇḍi ta dang grub pa'i dbang phyug rnams kyis gsungs pa'i bstan bcos kyi dgongs don gang yin ma shes/ tshig gi 'gal 'brel gcig pu brtsis nas/chos re chos rnam dag tu thag bcad de yang bzhag 'ga' re chos log tu thag bcad nas mar dor/ rgyal ba'i gsung la yang blang dor gnyis byas/ chos spong gi las ngan bsags nas/ ngan song gi g.yang khar gom 'gros 'khyor ba byung 'dug pas blo gros can gyes rgyal ba'i bka'i dgongs don 'tshol ba la 'bad pa gal che ste/ rje skal ldan rgya mtshos/ skyabs dkon mchog gsum la blo gtod la/ /bka' dri med dgongs don tshol la 'bod/ /gsungs/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab kyi dgongs pa lon na mkhas pa yin te/ bka' thang las/ tshig la mkhas na mkhas pa ma yin te/ /mi g.yo don la mkhas na mkhas pa yin/ /gsungs/608

rgyal ba'i bka'i dgongs pa ma lon na chos kyi tshig mang po shes nas ci bya/ lhas sbyin gyi blo la yang gsung rab glang po che'i rgyab khal re yod par bshad/ des na mkhas pa'i dbang po zhig mdzad na 'di ga ngo mtshar che/ 'o na 'dod yon longs spyod thams cad 'phongs phyis pa'i rdo bzhin 'dor dgos na/nyams len dus su khams kyi rten gso btsal/ /mthun pa'i yo byad kun dang ldan par bya/ /gsungs pa lta bu sngags kyi gzhung na mang / sa bzang ba dang grogs bzang ba/ /rnal 'byor bde ba'i yo byad ldan/ /gsungs pa lta bu mdo na mang bas/ de dag dang 'gal bar 'gyur zer na/ 'o de 'gal dogs med/ mthun rkyen bsag dgos zer ba de/ mang po zhig la go nas ham pa ma che/ ham pa che na mthun rkyen 'gal rkyen du song nas sdom pa dam tshig kyang shor yong / mthun rkyen bsags gsungs pa de/rje mi las zwa tshod bsags nas mthun rkyen byas pa ltar/ sngo dang shing 'bras tsam gyes srog 'tsho ru bcug na yang / mthun rkyen bsags nas 'grigs tshar ba yin/ rje mi las/ sdig zas spangs pa'i dka' thub 'di/ /nyams rtogs skye ba'i mthun rkyen yin/ /gsungs pas na/ mthun rkyen gye mchog ni dka' thub yin te/ rje skal ldan rgya mtshos/ rtsam thang sogs ci 'byor 'tsho 609

ba yis/ /'byung bzhi ni cha snyoms bde bar shog /gsungs pas na/ rtsam pa phor ba gang rnyed byung na mthun rkyen 'grigs pa zhig dgos/ de lta bu'i srog 'tsho thabs gang la mthun rkyen zer/'dod yon dkor nag gi dug chu mang po bsag dgos gsungs pa'i tshig tu 'khrul bar mi bya/ ja chang sha thud mar sogs mang po bsags pa chos kyi bar chad thar pa'i srog gcod pa'i spu gri yin te/ rje mi las/ zas zhim po ja chang tshogs 'khor de/ /mang thal na dge sbyor bar chad yin/ /de bas kyang gye na'i 'tsho ba dga'/ /dkor gnyan po srog gi spu gri 'di/ /mang thal na thar pa'i srog rtsa gcod/ /de bas kyang sems khur chung na dga'/ /gsungs/ yon bdag dad pa can gyis phul ba'i dkor zas mang po zos na nyams rtogs skye ba phar zhog dkor gyes 'tshos nas je blun du song / mthar bong bu lta bur 'gyur te/ spyan snga bas/ dkor gyis 'tshos pas 'phral du je blun song / /bong bu mngon sum yong ngo shākya'i sras/ /gsungs/ des na sngon byon rdo rje 'chang gi brgyud pa lta lo nā ro mi la sogs kyis chos sgrub pa'i sngon du zas nor longs spyod mang po bsags zhes rnam thar na e 'dug ltos/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'khor nyan thos dgra bcom byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis chos 610

sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen yo byad bsags zhes zer ba thos sam ci/mthun rkyen zhes lo mang po 'dang ba zhig bsag dgos na/sangs rgyas kyis zas zhag lon dang / gsog 'jog byas pa dang /byen len ma byas par za mi rung zhes bcas pa mdzad pa dang /gnas shing drung dang / zas bsod snyoms pa gyis gsungs pa dang / bdag tu 'dzin pa khab skud tsam yang mi bya gsung dogs med/ deng sang 'ga' res kho bo'i sngon du mthun rkyen bsgrubs nas phyis chos byed rgyu yin zer/ 'dre 'dul grong chog rdzun g.yo sgyu khram gye sgo nas yon bdag dad pa can gyi lag nas dkor mang po sdud pa de/ kho bos sngon la dug bsags nas phyis bdud rtsi dang bsres nas 'thung ba yin zhes phyogs phyogs su brgyugs nas/ dug mang po sdud pa dang 'dra bas gzhan ma sems/chos rnam dag cig byed na rang gi mi nor zas gsum thams cad phar blos gtong dgos na/ gzhan gyi zas nor longs spyod tshur sdud mi rung ba smos ci dgos/ 'di ni dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar gsung dang gtan nas rgyab 'gal yin pas/de skad smras nas lag len la 'debs pa rnams kyi kha la nyan mi rung / rang gi sdom pa dang nyams len 'chor du 'jug pa'i sdig pa'i grogs po zhig chos grogs su brdzus nas 'ongs pa 611

yin pas dogs zon gyis/ tshe 'di'i bya ba bsam na mkho ba mang / /zer ba ltar/ rnal 'byor par mkho ba'i yo byad thams cad bsag rgyu zhig gi dbang du song na/ lto gos bzang po dang /lha cha mchod cha rtsa can mang po dgos/ nye gnas la btsun chung gzugs mdzes lag bde'am/ bu mo gzhon nu zhig kyang dgos/der ma zad zas gos rgyu'i gser dngul dar zab rta nor lug gsum sa zhing sogs kyang dgos pas bsags kyis ga la lang /'o na tshe 'di dang chos gnyis tsha grang ltar 'gal na/ skyes bu dam pa du mas lugs gnyis gcig grogs su gcig khyer/gzhan la lugs gnyis zung 'brel gyi zhal gdams gnang ba dang 'gal bar 'gyur zer na/ dper na lo tog gi phyir 'bad na sog ma zhor la 'byung ba ltar/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba spangs nas dam pa'i chos bzhin byas na 'jig rten 'di'i longs spyod shugs kyis rgyas/ longs spyod rgyas pa rnams kyang chos phyogs su btang na chos su 'gyur bas de skad gsungs pa yin te/ chos bzhin byas na char bzhin 'bab/ /zer ba dang / 'jig rten pha rol don gnyer sgyes/ /'jig rten 'di yi 'bras bu rgyas/ /gsungs/ 'jig rten bstan bcos kyi mchog sa skya'i legs bshad las/ 'jig rten lugs kyi rjes 'brangs nas/ /kho bos 612

dam pa'i chos 'di bstan/ /zhes dam pa'i chos bstan gsungs kyis/ 'jig rten bya ba byed tshul bstan ma gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na 'jig rten gyis dang chos kyi grogs yin gsungs pa'i tshig tu 'khrul bar mi bya/ 'jig rten 'di'i bya ba byas nas chos shig 'ong ba rgyal ba rnams kyis ma gsungs te/ tshe 'di 'dod par gyur pa la/ /'jig rten pha rol don mi 'gyur/ /gsungs/ chos rje rgyal sras pas kyang / dam pa'i chos dang tshe 'di'i 'dun ma gnyis/ /mnyam du bsgrub pa su zhig yod ma yin/ /gsungs/ 'o na 'dod yon lnga'i longs spyod dug dang mtshungs/ 'di la brten nas chos mi 'ong na/ skyes bu dam pa 'ga' res/ lto gos phyag rgya ma sogs 'dzoms na chos yong gsungs pa dang 'gal zer na/ de spyir 'khor ba'i nang na bde ba zhig gtan nas mi srid pas/ sems can kun gyes 'dod yon sogs 'khor ba'i phun tshogs spangs nas/ thar pa'i bde ba don du gnyer dgos pa nges don yin kyang / ban bon sngags pa khyem pa ser sna dang chags zhen che ba la 'dod yon longs spyod 'di bzang / khyod bsod nams chen po red ces 'dzum ldang gi bcug de nas 'dod yon bongs spyod 'di'i steng nas chos byas na/ de bas thar pa'i bde ba yong bas/ tshe 'dir skyid 613

phyi ma skyid phyir mchod sbyin gyis/ nyams len mdzod ces gang zag kha cig yar rim gyis kha drangs pas drang don tsam dang /gzhan 'dod yon grogs su 'gro ba'i skyes bu dam pa dang sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa rtogs pa mthon po skyon gyis ma gos pa la/ kha mi gtong ba'i phyir de skad gsungs pa yin gyi/ chos mdzad gang zag spyi la 'dod yon sogs dang / mang po 'dzoms na chos yong gsungs pa'i tshig tu 'khrul bar mi bya/ de ltar ma shes blun po 'ga' res bden par bzung / lag je dam dang /zhen chags je che/ 'dod sred sogs nyon mongs kun me bzhin 'bar/ 'dod yon phyir las mi dge ba chen po bsags nas shi ma thag dmyal ba'i gting rdo byed nges/ yang sngags nas sha chang bud med sogs 'dod yon spyod ces gsungs pas na/ sngags kyi rnal 'byor pas 'dod yon la spyad kyang skyon med zer na/spyod gsungs pa khyod bden te/ spyod tshul la rnam pa mang bas de shes dgos/ las dang bo bas sha chang sogs rdzas tsam ma gtogs mi bsten par yid kyis gzhan bza' btung rnams sha lnga bdud rtsi lngar dmigs nas mos pas spyod/ rtogs pa cung zad mtho ru song nas sha chang dngos su spyod cing / las rgya la dngos su mi spyod par ye rgya tsam la mos pas spyod/ rtogs pa 614

mthon por slebs nas las rgya mtshan ldan la dngos su spyad kyang skyon med pas spyod dgos/des na gsang sngags mos lam gyis 'grub pas/ las dang po ba 'o skol rnams kyis sha chang rdzas tsam re dang / ye shes kyi phyag rgya ma tsam re mos pa byed pa ma gtogs/ dngos su 'dod yon la bag med du spyod mi rung / spyod gsungs pa rnams thog ma nas bag med du bsten dgos na/ sngags na sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga bsten gsungs/ de'i nang na/ khyi sha gcin skyag yang 'dun pa las/ gcin dang skyag pa yang sha chang bzhin bsten dgos par rigs/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ bsten gsungs pa rnams la spyod dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /gcin skyag pa bsten sus nus/ des na sngags kyi lam nyams su len pa'i gang zag las dang po ba 'dod yon lam du 'khyer mi nus pa rnams kyis phyis 'dod yon lam gye grogs su 'khyer nus pa'i rten 'brel du rdzas tsam bsten zhes gsungs pa yin par ha go dgos/ thog ma nas byis pa chung ngus gang mi yog pa la do byen na zas log pho bas mi 'ju bar 'chi ba ltar/ gsang sngags kyi sgor zhugs ma thag nas 'dod yon la bag med du spyad na de 'dra 'byung nges/ sngon rje mi la la/ gzhan 'ga' res/ khyed kyis mdzes se blangs nas lho 615

brag mar pa'i rnam thar bskyangs na legs zhus tshe/ seṅge'i lad mo was byas pas mi 'ong gsungs/ 'o na rje mi las mi'i bu mor ma zad mi ma yin gye bu mo phyag rgyar bzhes/ mi'i 'dod yon ma zad lha dang mkha' 'gro ma yongs kyi tshogs dpon mdzad nas/lho brag mar pa las ches cher 'dod yon la spyad tshul rnam thar na 'dug zer na/ dper na gzhon nu lang tsho dar la bab tshe sha chang phor ba gang gis mi tshad do zos kyang phung po rgyas pa ltar/bsgyed rim gyis tha mal snang zhen sbyangs/ rdzogs rim gyis dbu ma'i rtsa mdud sogs lhod por btang nas grol/ rtsa rlung las su rung / dbab bzung ldog 'grem nus/ thig le yungs 'bru tsam yang mi 'chor/ sha chang bdud rtsir byin gyis rlob nus pa'i dus su sha chang bud med mtshan ldan brgya stong bsten rung / rtsa rlung thig le rgyas/ bde stong phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur te/ kun mkhyen pad dkar gyes/ lus lha ngag sngags sems kyi ting 'dzin dang / /rtsa sbyangs rlung 'gags thig le gyen bzlog pa/ /rdo rje theg pa'i gsang tshig ngo ma yin/ /bags kyis nyams su bzhes dang 'dod don 'grub/ /gsungs/ thig le dbab bzung ldog 'grem nus pa'i rje mi la lta bu'i gang zag las rgya ma la brten nas mchog gi 'dod don 'grub pa rnams 616

la brten zhes gsungs pa yin/ gzhan gsang sngags kyi dbang khrid re thob tshad kyis sha chang bud med la bag med du spyod ces gsungs pa'i tshig tu 'khrul nas ham pa ma che/ ham pa che nas phyag rgya ma bsten/ thig le kun shor/ ngo nag dung nge song mig phrug thar re btang / chang 'thungs pas mgo bo na/ zas kha nas bskyugs/ sha zos pa pho bas mi 'ju na zug langs/ sman dang rim gro byas/ gsang sngags nyams su ma lon pa'i mtshang thams cad rang gis bstan nas chags bral gyi gang zag gis 'phya smod kyi gnas su 'gyur/ 'dod yon la brten nas nyon mongs pa langs/ las ngan pa bsags pa'i dbang gis phyi mar dmyal ba rdo rje gdan du song / gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i myur lam yang / mdo las kyang ring du btang / theg pa 'og ma zil gyis gnon mi dgos/ 'og tu lhung nas kha yar 'khor dus med pas gzhan ma sems/ yang sngags kyi rnal 'byor pas 'dod yon spyad pa'i nyes dmigs kyis ngan 'gror ga la 'gro/ sngags kyi gzhan mi shes rung / o.āḥ hūṃ bton nas zos kyang sdig sgrib mi yong zhes gsungs 'dug zer na/ de yin na las sla ba 'duga.o.āḥ hūṃ mi shes pa med/ des cang mi yong / des yong na sngags min rung mdo na yang gzungs sngags dang de bzhin gshegs 617

pa'i mtshan re brjod pas kyang mtshams med lnga sogs sdig sgrib ri rab tsam 'dag myur du 'tshang rgya ba sogs phan yon gsungs pa mang / de yin na gzhan mi dgos/ 'dod yon la spyad nas sgo ru skyag pa gtong ba'i 'gro zhor la sgo yi ya ther/ la bris pa'i padmo uddhā ṣa'i 'og tu 'dzul na de gcig pus chog par gda'/ des na o.āḥ hūṃ sogs bton pas nyes pa mi 'byung gsungs pa rnams kyang / chos kyi che ba brjod nas/gdul bya kha cig drangs pas drang don du de skad gsungs pa yin gye/ nges don du sngags bton pa gcig pus mi chog sngags kyi gzhung bzhin zab gsal gnyis med kyi lha'i bskyed rim gye ngang nas/ hūṃ gis kha dog dri nus kyi skyon sbyangs/ āḥ yis bdud rtsir rtogs par byas/ oṃ gyis mang po spel tshul gyi dmigs pa sogs byed dgos/ lha sngags ting nge 'dzin gsum po dgos phyin sngags kyi gzhung bzhin nyams su len pa'i rnal 'byor pa rab cig nges par dgos/ o.āḥ hūṃ kha nas 'don shes pa gcig pus chog par ma sems/ yang sngags lam du ma nas/ sngags kyi sgor zhugs pas thog mtha' bar gsum du'ang 'dod yon lnga la spyad chog ces rgyud du ma nas gsungs 'dugades na 'dod yon la spyad rung skyon gyis mi gos pa'i 618
