rtags yin zer na/ de'i tshe sngon sbyangs pa'i skal ldan las 'phro can/ nges 'byung skyo shas byang chub kyi sems yang dag pa'i lta ba rim gnyis kyi rtogs pa dang ldan pa 'dod yon spyad kyang /'dod sred kyi dbang du mi 'gro bar lam gye grogs su 'gro ba'i gang zag sha chang bud med sogs 'dod yon gang dgos 'bad rtsol med par shugs kyis 'dzoms pa'i bla ma rgyal blon phyug po'i gces phrug lta bu re gnyis la dgongs nas gsungs pa yin gyi/ gzhan 'khor bar zhen pa ma log 'dod sred che ba'i rigs gsang sngags kyi sgor zhugs ma thag nas bsgyed rdzogs kyi lam sgom pa bzhag nas/ rang la med rung gling gzhan du tshol la sha chang bud med la bag med du spyod la sred pa cher thongs zhes gsungs pa ma yin pa'i ha go dgos/ sngags kyi rnal 'byor pas kyang nad la phan phyir sman dang / rma la phan phyir khye tshil bsten pa ltar/ byang chub thob pa'i grogs su 'gro ba la dmigs nas 'dod yon bsten dgos kyi/ 'dod sred kyi dbang gis bsten pa zhig sngags gzhung du ma nas ma gsungs/ dper na gtsub shing gnyis gtsubs pa las me byung nas 'bar na shing gnyis bsregs nas me cher 'bar ba ltar/ phyag rgya bsten nas bde stong gi rtogs pa khyad par can skyes nas 'dod chags sogs 619

nyon mongs pa rnams chung du song / nyams rtogs cher 'gro ba zhig dgos/ mthar thug zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang mngon du byas dus nyon mongs pa kun gtan zad du song ba yin/ rdo rje 'chang gis phyag rgya ma 'chang ba zung 'jug gi mtshon byed tsam yin gye chags pas bud med cig bsten yod par ma sems/ mdo sngags kyi chos gang yin yang nyon mongs pa'i gnyen po yin pas/ nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por song na sngags nyams su lon pa yin gyi/ nyon mongs pa cher gtong ba'i grogs su song na ga 'dra yin mi shes/ deng sang gsang sngags nyams su len pa 'ga' re skabs shig 'dod sred cher song / bud med kyang gcig gis mi chog gnyis/ gnyis kyis mi chog gsum bzhi mang po dgos pa byung / kho la dbang thob rgyu yin na rgyal khams kyi bu mo gzugs mdzes pa kun bsdus nas spyod tshod na gda'/chang yang glang rgan dang bong rgan gyes chu 'thung ba ltar 'thungs nas/ mthar grub rtags la chang gis bzi nas lce lkugs/ zas bskyugs/ thig le btang nas lus zungs shor/ phru gu thar re gtong ba mang / de'i nang na skyon gyes mi gos pa re gnyis re srid kyang / phyi mig yul du btsog la/ mdo rgyud kyi dgongs pa dang mi mthun par gda'/ kho bos de rnams la khas 620

btang ba min te/ 'brug pa kun legs kyis/ mi la 'phog bsam pa ni ma shar/ spyir yang snyigs dus su song / thub pa'i gsung bzhin bltas pas de dang mthun par rang gis ma mthong / rang la 'khyer 'khos med pas/ blo la gang shar bris pa lags/ mis mi byed pa zhig byed kyi 'dug kyang ma byas/ byed pa zhig mi byed pa 'dug kyang ma byas/ snyan dngags yin na rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan lta bu lags pas/ skyon med dam bsam pa ni shar gsungs pa dang mtshungs/yang bu bu mo lho brag mar pa sogs sngon gyi skyes bu dam pa mang po la'ang 'dug pas/ de rnams kyis kyang sngags nyams su ma lon pa yin nam zer na/ de dang 'dra na legs te 'dra dogs med/ seng ge dang / phag gi phru gu ltar khyad che ste/ lho brag mar pa'i sras dar ma mdo sde gshegs dus/ rgad po gcig gis/khong rgan rgon gnyis kyi bu shi dus khyed kyis sgyu ma rmi lam yin gsungs/ khyed kyi sras yang sgyu ma rmi lam lags pas thugs khral mi mdzad par zhu zhus pas/ sgyu ma rmi lam yin pa khyod bden te/khyod kyi bu dang nga'i bu mi gcig nga'i bu de bsdad na bstan pa dang sems can la phan thogs pa zhig 'ong ba yin pas/ sgyu ma'i nang gi sgyu rgod/ rmi lam nang gi rmi rgod/ bu yi nang gi bu rgod 62 1

yin gsungs/ yang sngon gyi skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis bstan 'gror phan pa'i bu sprul pa yin/ thig le shor nas lan chags kyi bu byung ba ma yin te/ 'brug pa kun legs kyis/ nga la bud med dang bcas nas chos bshad na sangs rgyas zhe khrel 'gro/ mar pa lo tsā dgyes pa rdo rje dngos yin pas/ khong gis bu tsha sprul pa yin mod/ kun da shor ba'i phru gu ga na yin/ da lta mar pa'i bu rgyud yin zer nas/ sngo lo'i grangs byas nas nang 'thab byed kyi e 'dug chos 'chad pa la yang na skyon med pa zhig dgos/yang na rang skyon thal mos bkab nas gzhan skyon mdzub mos 'dru ba gcig dgos/ nga la de gnyis ka med pas chos mi bshad gsungs/ grub chen dril bu pas/ sras sras mo gnyis yod pa/ mi mang khrod nas sa la brdabs nas rdo rje dril bur bsgyur/ phyag gnyis su bsnams yum la 'khyud nas nam mkha' la gshegs nas/ dril bu pa zhes mtshan thogs pa yin skad/ sprul pa yin pa'i rtags des kyang shes/ sprul pa min rung de ltar bsgyur nus na bsten chog de 'dra ma gtogs gzhan gyis bsten ga la rung /mdo sngags gnyis kyi chos nyams su len pa'i gang zag mchog dman thams cad kyis srog 'tsho tsam gyi zas gos gnas mal sogs bsten dgos kyis/ gsog 'jog rgya chen byas/ 'dod 622

yon dkor nag gi dug chu la bag med du spyod dgos zhes mdo sngags gang nas kyang ma gsungs/ gsang sngags pa rnams kyis kyang rje btsun mi la yab sras sogs sngon gyi skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi rnam thar ltar/ zas nor longs spyod kyi 'khri ba btsan chod byas/ dben par dka' spyad snying rus byas sngags nyams su len dgos/ sngags na 'dod yon bsten dgos gsungs pa yang phal cher srog 'tsho tsam bsten dgos gsungs pa yin par go dgos/ phyag rgya ma ma bsten na sngags mi 'grub pas bsten dgos gsungs pa yang / dbang gsum pa'i dus dang rdzogs rim gye rtogs pa mthon por song ba'i dus sogs/ bsten na dgos pa che ba 'ga' zhig la dgongs nas de skad gsungs pa yin/ de la yang las rgya ma bsten rung gsang sngags thabs mang dka' ba med pa yin cing mos lam gyis 'grub pas/ ye shes kyi phyag rgya bsten na yang chog par gsungs/ des na 'dod yon lnga dang las kyi phyag rgya med par sngags gtan nas mi 'grub gsungs pa'i tshig tu 'khrul bar mi bya'o/ /sha chang sogs 'dod yon lnga dang las kyi phyag rgya ma bsten par sngags mi 'grub na/ bya rgyud spyod rgyud rnal 'byor rgyud gsum gyis phyag rgya ma bsten pas mi 'grub par 'gyur/ de ci'i 623

phyir zhe na/ sngags yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de mi 'grub na/ lam de nyams su blangs na 'tshang rgya gsungs pa rnams kyang dzun par 'gyur/ rnal 'byor bla med rgyud kyi rgyal po rdzogs pa chen po'i sgra ji bzhin nyams su len na/ 'dod yon lnga dang phyag rgya ma dang du blangs nas mi bsten par ma zad/ 'khor 'das kyi chos gang la yang spang blang dgag sgrub mi byed par/ khregs chod thod rgal kho na la gzhol na 'ja' lus zung 'jug gi sku 'grub par gsungs/ bskyed rim la rdzogs rim gyis snon pa btab na lam myur ba tsam ma gtogs zab gsal gnyis med kyi bskyed rim kho na nyams su blangs kyang grol bar gsungs/ des na sngags kyi gzhung shing bsgyed rdzogs/ rdzogs pa chen po yin gyi/ phyag rgya ma bsten pa lam gye yan lag tsam yin gyi/ deng sang gsang sngags pa 'ga' res/ rtsa ba dor nas yal ga bsnyabs pa ltar/ bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen bzhag nas las rgya bsten pa mang / dper na me chen po mi sbar bar/ me grogs shing yin snyam nas bsags kyang / me med par shing ci tsam bsags kyang grogs su mi 'gro bar ma zad/ khur du 'gro ba ltar/ gsang sngags kyi bsgyed rdzogs/ rdzogs chen mi sgom par/ spyir 'dod yon lnga dang /khyad par las rgya ma bsten pa de dang 'dra/ gsang sngags kho na 624

nyams su len kyang / phyag rgya ma ma bsten bzhin du sangs rgya ba'i tshul bsam gyis mi khyab/ des na sngags kyi lam nyams su blangs na skabs shig las rgya ma bsten par nyams su len tshul med pa lta bu dang / nyams su blangs rung rdzogs rim gyi rtogs pa khyad par can mi sgye snyam pa rang 'khrul ba tsam du ma zad/ de yin na bya rgyud spyod rgyud rnal 'byor rgyud rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud kyi bskyed rim rdzogs chen phyag chen sogs na phyag rgya ma la cung zad rag ma las par rtogs pa khyad par can 'khrungs nas tshe gcig la sangs rgya ba'i tshul mang po gsungs pa rnams kyang rdzun yin zer dgos/ de yin na sngar phyag rgya ma bsten par sangs rgyas pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams la yang skur ba 'debs dgos pa sogs mi 'grig pa bco brgyad 'byung /des na bskyed rdzogs/ rdzogs chen phyag chen sogs gsang sngags la yang thabs med pa'i 'dod yon dang phyag rgya bsten dgos pa'i nges pa med/ gsang sngags ni thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang gsungs pas na/ thabs gzhan bsten rgyu mang /gzhan gang la brten nas nyams su blangs na yang mchog thun gyi dngos grub 'thob par 'gyur/ phyag rgya kun gyi mchog ni/phyag rgya chen po/ rdzogs pa chen po/ dbu ma chen mo yin zhes 625

mkhas grub du mas gsungs la/ dgongs pa lung ston gyi rgyud las/ kun rdzob dang ni don dam dag /'di ni dbang po gnyis yin la/ /zung du 'jug pa grags pa ni/ /de dag gnyis med de sbyor ba/ /de la mnyam par sbyor ba yis/ /de dag thams cad nye bar spyad/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /'dod chags chen po'i tshul mchog go /gsungs pa 'di bzhag nas/ bud med bsten pa nor bu bzhag nas mching bu blangs pa dang 'dra bas mkhas pas smad pa'i gnas las gzhan ma sems/ de ltar go na sdom gsum mig gi 'bras bzhin bsrung / mi nor zas gsum gang la chags pa med par ri khrod dben pa'i bsil grib na gcig pur mdo sngags kyi chos nyams su len pa rnams bstan pa yongs kyi bdag po ru go nas dad gus tshad med skye nges/phyag rgya ma zhig ma bsten pas gsung rab thams cad gdams par ma shar ba dang / gsang sngags pa min par ga la 'gyur/ de 'gyur na ston pa sangs rgyas jo bo yab sras/ gsang sngags bstan pa'i bdag po rnams kyang / gsang sngags pa —min nyan thos pa yin zhes skur ba gdab par 'gyur/ spyir mdo sngags kyi chos gang yin yang nyams su len pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ 'jig rten chos brgyad blos btang nas/ nyams dga' rig pa dwangs 626

pa'i dben gnas su nyams su blangs na nyams rtogs skye zhing /khyad par gnas lugs stong gsal spros bral/ phyag rdzogs dbu gsum gye dgongs don la mnyam par bzhag na/ lus sems la shin sbyangs kyi bde ba bsam gyis mi khyab par skye/ ma bsgrubs lha zhal mang po mthong / mngon shes rdzu 'phrul kyang 'byung / rang don mngon du gyur/ gzhan bstan 'gro la yang dngos sam brgyud nas phan pa rgya chen thogs pas/ des na de lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa zhig la yid smon gtong dgos/ de min khyem pa las gsog 'jog cher byas/ 'dod yon dkor nag la spyod pa mdo sngags su yin rung / grong ltag gi dgon chung sogs gnas gang du bsdad rung rang gzhan gyi don gang yang mi 'grub ces rgyal ba sras bcas kyis gsungs/ mthong thos myong bas kyang shes par nus/ des na mdo sngags pa su zhig yin rung / 'dod yon la skyon du bltas nas spong ci thub gyes dang bzang ngo //smras pa/ chos phyir lus srog longs spyod gtong nus pa'i/ /grub thob gong ma'i rnam thar dran bzhin du/ /de dag rnams la kha mig yar blta byas/ /kha nas bstod dbyangs sgrogs bzhin lha phyag 'bul/ /las nyon gnyis kyis bskyed pa'i sgyu lus 'di/ /mi rtag mi brtan snying po gang yang med/ /rlung mkhris bad gan nad 627

gdon dgra la sogs/ /mi 'dod sdug bsngal 'dren pa'i tshul mkhyen nas/ /sngon byon rgyal ba gong mas chos phyir du/ /lus dang longs spyod phangs med btang ba bzhin/ /'o skol rnams kyang snying po med pa'i lus/ /chos phyir btang nas snying po len pa'i rigs/ /gsang sngags rnal 'byor mi la'i rnam thar bzhin/ /lo mang dka' ba spyod pa phar la zhog /nyin gcig tsam yang dka' spyad mi nus pa'i/ /snying rus chung ba'i skal med kha cig gis/ /rang nyid theg pa chen por ma slebs bar/ /theg chen spyod pa'i skabs kyi gtam 'dra lab/ /zas skal zos nas las skal mi las bzhin/ /sha chang spyad nas bskyed rdzogs mi bsgom par/ /seṅge mchongs sar wa yis lding tsa na/ /pha khar mi sleb g.yang la ltung ba ltar/ /'ga' re chang gis bzi nas lam du 'gyel/ /la la'i lce lkugs rang gzhan ngo mi shes/ /dka' spyad snying rus gang yang mi nus pa'i/ /mi dang 'grogs na rang yang je ngan 'gro/ /khag ngan sngags la bkal nas spyod ngan gyis/ /rgyal khams 'phung ba'i mi dang ma 'grog cig /tshe 'di blos btang sdom pa dam tshig gtsang / /dben par sgrub pa lhur len rnal 'byor par/ /'grogs na tshe 'dir rang don 'grub pa dang / /gzhan don yin yang shugs kyis 'ong bar nges/ /dam pa'i byen rlabs dben 628

pa'i ri sul du/ /dam pa'i lha chos byed pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /dam pa gong ma rnams kyi phyag srol bzhin/ /dam chos glu dbyangs 'di 'dra len par rigs/ /zhes pa bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o//gzhan yang mdo las/ ci 'dra ba yi las byas pa 'bras bu de 'dra smin par 'gyur/ /gsungs pa dang / lus can rnams kyi las dag ni/ /bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi za/ /tshogs shing dus la bab pa na/ /'bras bu nyid du smin par 'gyur/ /zhes pa dang /sdig pa chung ngu byas pas kyang / /'jig rten pha rol 'jigs chen dang / /phung krol chen po byed 'gyur te/ /khong bar song ba'i dug bzhin no/ /zhes dang / o rgyan rin po ches/ tshe rabs mang por sdug bsngal rgyur 'gyur ba'i/ /sdig pas tshe 'dir bde bas ci zhig bya/ /tshe 'di yun thung lo zla 'ga' zhig yin/ /'jig rten phyi mar tshad bzung med pa'i phyir/ /tshe rabs gtan du sdug bsngal mi 'byung zhing / /bde ba'i thabs su dge sdig blang dor bya/ /gsungs/ de bzhin du mdo rgyud bstan bcos gang na yang las rgyu 'bras phra zhing phra ba yang khyad du mi gsod nga/ra 'dor len byed dgos/ zhes mthun par gsungs pas na/sdig pa'i skyon gyis mi gos pa'i sgyes bu dam pa 'dra yin na ma 629

gtogs/ gzhan mdo sngags kyi chos sgor zhugs pa'i mchog dman bar ma su yin yang las rgyu 'bras mi bslu ba la nges pa brtan po rnyed nas/ sangs rgyas sras bcas kyis ci gsungs las rgyu 'bras ltar byed dgos/ 'o na ji skad byed dgos zer na/mdo las/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing / /dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /gsungs pa ltar sems can thams cad la 'phral du gnod la phugs su'ang gnod pa'i las thams cad mi dge ba yin pas spong dgos/ sems can la 'phral du phan la phugs su'ang phan pa'i las thams cad dge ba yin pas bsgrub dgos/ dper na gtar bsreg gis nad 'don pa 'phral du cung zad lus la gnod rung phugs su nad bton nas phan pa ltar 'phral du gnod pa mi dge ba ltar snang yang phugs su'ang phan thogs chen po 'byung na don du dge ba yin pas bsgrub dgos/ dper na dug dang 'dres pa'i kha zas sbyin par btang ba 'phral du phan pa ltar snang yang phyi nas sdug bsngal tshad med bskyed pa ltar/ 'phral du gzhan la phan pa dge ba ltar snang yang phugs su gnod pa chen po 'byung na/ don du mi dge ba yin pas spong dgos/ de dag gi blang dor zhib mo rgyas par sangs 630

rgyas kyi gsung rab dang lam rim sogs nas bshad pa ltar byed dgos/ 'o na sangs rgyas kyis chos thams cad rdzun pa bslu ba mi rtag pa snying po med pa sgyu ma dang rmi lam brag cha lta bu yin gsungs 'dug pas/ dge sdig la blang dor zhib tu ma byas kyang rung zer na/ de la chos rje 'brug pa kun legs kyis/ sgyu ma yin gsungs te/ chags sdang dang nor rdzas sgyu mar mi 'gro bas kun spyod sgyu mar 'gro ba 'di ci ltar yin ma shes gsungs/ de thugs bden te/ chos kun sgyu mar shar ba'i rnal 'byor pa bzang po zhig yin na/ de ltar ma rtogs pa rnams la lhag par snying rje skyes/ rmi lam la rang bzhin med rung gnyid las sad reg bar du lus sems gnyid sogs 'tshogs pa'i rten 'brel las rmi lam bzang ngan sna tshogs byung / bde ba myong ba dang sdug bsngal myong / snang ba yod pa ltar chos thams cad la rang bzhin med rung de ltar mngon du ma gyur bar du/ rgyu ma rig nyon mongs dge sdig gi las sna tshogs pa'i rten 'brel las/ 'bras bu bde sdug myong ba nges shes cher song nas/ sngar bas las 'bras la 'dzem pa zhig yin kyang / deng sang dbu rdzogs phyag gsum gyi lta ba bsgom par rlom pa phal cher rgyu 'bras la je rtsing du 'gro ba 'di ci yin mi shes te/ las rgyu 'bras la mi 'dzem par mi dge 631

ba dang 'dres pa'i spyod pa chal chol byed dus sgyu ma yin pas chags sdang sogs nyon mongs pa me ltar 'bar/ las ngan pa mtsho ltar bsogs dus khyod kyi sgyu ma gang du song / 'di ni dbu rdzogs phyag chen pa ru badzus nas las rgyu 'bras la gnod pa'i chom rkun zhig snyigs dus 'dir byung ba yin pas gzhan ma sems/ chos thams cad sgyu ma rmi lam ltar rtogs nas ji bzhin mngon du gyur pa'i sangs rgyas rnams la rang gi ngos nas phan gnod med rung / sems can rnams la phan phyir sdig spong dge sgrub byed pa sangs rgyas pa'i khyad chos yin/ sangs rgyas nas rgyu 'bras la mi 'dzem par sdig pa byed pa'i sangs rgyas shig sngar yod ma myong / 'o skol rnams tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa'i dus nas ma rig pa'i dbang du song / nga med pa la ngar bzung nas nyon mongs pa langs/ las bzang ngan sna tshogs bsags nas/'khor ba'i chos 'di rnams ma bcos bzhin du byung / tshugs thub bden grub tu bzung nas/ da bar 'khor ba 'dir yang dang yang du 'khyams nas bde sdug sna tshogs pyong ba yin/ da sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis chos thams cad sgyu ma rmi lam yin gsungs pa thos pa tsam gyes las dge sdig bsags na 'bras bu bde sdug mi myong bar ga la 'gyur/ sgyu ma rmi lam 632

yin zhes gsungs pa go ba dang nges shes skyes pa tsam gyes mi chogade ltar bsgoms nas skabs shig mngon༄srim du sgyu ma rmi lam dang khyad med du song nas/ lus bal ltar brgyangs/ 'dam ltar badzis/ zan ltar bcad rung / zan zhig la de ltar byas pa tsam gye snang ba ma gtogs/ sdug bsngal gye snang ba gtan nas mi 'byung na 'dor len ma byas kyang rung / 'on kyang rang la phan gnod med rung sangs rgya ba la sgrib gnyis sbyangs tshogs gnyis bsog dgos pas 'dor len byed dgos/ sangs rgyas nas gzhan sems can la phan gnod 'byung ba shes nas sems can thams cad la phan phyir rgyu 'bras kyi 'dor len dus nam yang byed dgos/ de ltar ma shes par stong nyid kyi gtam tsam go nas bzung / sngon gyi grub chen phal cher gyi lad mo byas sdig pa bsags na/ rang gi steng du tshe 'dir yang mthong chos myong 'gyur du sdig pa'i 'bras bu smin nas rnam smin rtsub po myong dgos/ phyi mar yang sdug bsngal tshad med 'byung / des na chos thams cad sgyu ma rmi lam ltar gyur nas ri brag la thal byung du bgrod nus/ lus 'dod dgur bsgyur nas bde sdug gang gis lus sems la phan gnod spu tsam yang mi 'byung ba'i tshad la 633

sleb reg bar du las rgyu 'bras ltar byed pa gces/ 'o na tshe 'di'i snang ba dang / rmi lam gyi snang ba la khyad med na/ rmi lam la gri btab nas mi bsad rkus byas bud med la spyad pa sogs rmis na sdom pa 'chor ram mi 'chor zer na/ de dngos su sems can la gnod pa med pas sdom pa mi 'chor bas/ sangs rgyas kyis rmi lam la bcas pa ma mdzad pa yin/ 'on kyang 'khor ba ngan song du skye ba'i rgyu bag chags ngan pa yin pas/ sangs rgyas kyis dus nam yang yid la bsam ngan sbyor rtsub skad cig ma gcig tsam la yang dran mi rung gsungs pa dang 'gal ba yin/de mi dge bcu'i nang gi gnod sems su gtogs pas bshag pa bya dgos/ khyad par rang gis bka' drin gsum ldan gye bla ma la log lta byas sgo skur 'debs pa 'khon 'dzing byed pa lta bu rmis na yang dmyal bar skye ba rgyud du ma nas gsungs 'dug pas/ de 'dra rmis na sad ma thag tu dug khong du song ba lta bu'i 'gyod sems kyis bshag sdom yang yang bya dgos/ 'o na rmi lam du sems can gye srog spyod pa bla ma la bsnyen bkur byed pa lta bu rmis na/ phan yon yod dam zer na/ de mtho ris thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang 'thob thabs kyi rgyu bag chags bzang po rgyud la thebs pas/ phan yon yod ces skyes bu dam pa 634

'ga' zhig gi zhal nas thos/ 'o na chos pas srin bu sogs bsad kyang skyon gyis mi gos/ sgyung gnas kyi bsnyen tshad song ba'i chos mdzad gang zag de mthong thos dran reg rnams ngan song du mi ltung bar mtho ris su skye bar sgyung gnas kyi phan yon 'ga' zhig na snang / gzhan yang mdo dang sngags nyams su blangs/ rtogs pa khyad par can skyes pa'i rnal 'byor pa mthong thos dran reg smin cing grol ba'i phan yon mdo sngags kyi gzhung du ma nas gsungs/ tha na gzungs sngags 'ga' re bton nas/ snga mo mchil ma rkang mthil la byugs na/ de'i nyin srin bu gang bsad tshad sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lhar skye zhes sngags 'bum dang nyin zhag phrug gcig gi nyams len bya tshul du ma nas bshad/ gzhan yang rnying ma'i btags grol mthong grol sogs mdo sngags kyi phyogs su gtogs pa'i chos zab mo dang /de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan gzungs sngags kham chen re tshar gcig tsam re bklags na/ mgul du btags na/ mig gis mthong na/ rna bas thos na/ de la reg na/ 'og tu 'dzul na yang sdig pa ri rab tsam yang skad cig de nyid la 'dag cing /bsod nams dpag tu med pa thob ces mdo rgyud bstan bcos na mang po snang / rten 'dus ril bu kham chen/ skye bdun ril bu/635

bdud rtsi chos sman sogs til 'bru tsam khar song yang sdig can yin yang ngan song du mi sgye bar mtho ris thar pa'i go 'phang thob tshul gyi phan yon mang po snang /chos pa rnams kyis de rnams shes pas/ mkhas pa'i sdig pa lci yang yang gsungs pa'i rgyu mtshan de tsho yin/ de rnams lag len la btab na chos pas sdig pa byas rung nyes pa med pa tsam du ma zad/ phan yon kyang 'ga' zhig la brten nas 'byung tshod na 'dug zer na/ 'o de rgyal ba'i gsung rab kyi dgongs pa ma lon pas cal col chen po zhig smras pa yin te/ chos pa bzang bo mthong thos dran reg la phan thogs pa de bden na/ phan btags na legs kyis srin bu sogs bsad na sdig pa byas pas gang yong / mi bsad bzhin du phan 'dogs tshul med dam/bsad na nyes pa med zer ba de glen pa khyod ma gtogs gzhan mkhas pa su zhig gis smra spobs/ chos pa rnam dag cig mi dgos/chos sgor zhugs pa su yin kyang / bsam bzhin du sdig pa byas na/ gzhan skye bo tha mal bas sdig pa byas pa dang yang mi 'dra/sdig pa byas pa'i nyes dmigs kyi steng du so thar dang 'gal ba'i nyes pa/ de'i steng du byang sems kyi sdom pa dang 'gal ba'i nyes pa/ de tsam du ma zad de'i steng du sngags kyi sgor zhugs pa 636

zhig yin na/ gsang sngags kyi dam tshig dang 'gal ba'i nyes pa rnams dus gcig la 'byung bas nyes 'gal gyi khur gyis mnan par 'gyur/ srog gcod sogs sdig pa'i 'bras bus ngan song du skye ba tsam du ma zad/ sdom gsum gye bcas pa gsum gang rung gcig dang 'gal rung / dmyal bar 'gro bar gsungs pas/ nam yang ngan song gsum nas thar pa'i dus mi 'byung /gzungs sngags kyi chu rkang mthil gnyis su byugs nas phan gsungs pa'i dgongs gzhi yang / nyin der 'dzem yang ma mthong / ma go ma shes pa'i dbang gis srin bu chung chung re gnyis re bsad e gtong snyam nas snying rje skyes/ gal te de ring nyin srin bu re rkang pas brdzis nas bsad song na yang sngags 'di'i nus pas sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha gnas su skye bar shog snyam pa'i gzhan phan byang chub sems kyis kun nas bslangs te/de'i don du dmigs nas gzungs sngags bzlas/ sngags chu rkang mthil du byugs na/ chos thams cad bsam pa la rag las pas/ bsam pa bzang na sa dang lam yang bzang gsungs pa dang / bsam pa bzang na ci byas chos su 'gro/ /zhes skyes bu dam pas gsungs pa ltar yin pas/ bsam pa bzang po'i stobs dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung gzungs sngags kyi 637

nus pa sogs kyi mthu la brten nas phan thogs yong / gal te las ngan pa'i dbang gis kho la phan ma thogs rung / bsam pa bzang po'i mthus rang la nyes pa mi 'byung ba la dgongs nas de skad gsungs pa yin gyi/ de ma yin par ngas sngags chu rkang pa la byugs yod pas/ srin bu mang po bsad kyang rung / sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lhar skye bas bzang mod snyam mi 'dzem par mig gis mthong / rna bas thos/ yid kyis shes bzhin du rkang pa gnyis kyis badzis nas ci sod byas na/ de mang bsad dge ba yin zer ba'i rgya nag gi phyogs kyi rgya za lar mu stegs pa'i chos lugs dang / rgya gar bal po'i phyogs kyi phyi rol mu stegs pa kha cig gi chos lugs/ nang pa sangs rgyas kyi lugs dang gtan nas ma 'dres pa de kho na la lag len byas pa yin pas/ phan yon spu tsam med par ma zad/ bla ma'i bka' dang 'gal/skyabs 'gro'i bslab byar 'gal/ so thar byang sems sngags sdom gyi bcas pa dang 'gal/ mdo rgyud bstan bcos thams cad na sdig pa ci yang ma byed gsungs pa sogs dang rgyab 'gal byas pa yin pas/ sdig pa de bas che ba zhig gzhan na med/ gzungs sngags dang de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan brjod pa sogs chos kyi phan yon bshad pa de kun kyang / sngon chad ma 638

rig nyon mongs dug lnga'i dbang gis sdig pa byas pa dang / phyin chad kyang gnyen po stobs chung nyon mongs stobs che bas rang la dbang ma byung bar de'i dbang gis sdig pa re byas song na/ phyis de ma thag de la/ sku gsung thugs rten gye drung ngam/ yang na mdun gyi nam mkhar tshogs zhing bskyed pa rten gyi stobs dang /sngar byas kyi sdig pa dug khong du song ba ltar gnong zhing 'gyod pa sun 'byin pa'i stobs dang / gzungs sngags dang de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan brjod pa sogs gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs dang / phyin chad srog la babs kyang de 'dra'i sdig las mi byed do zhes tshogs zhing gi mdun du dam bca' ba nyes pa las slar log pa'i stobs bzhi tshang ba'i bshag pa byas na 'dag pa la dgongs nas de skad gsungs pa yin gye/ de ltar ma yin par sdig pa gang byas gzungs sngags re dang / ltung bshags kyi lha tshogs lta bu'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan re brjod pa dang /gzungs mchog rgyal po padmo utrī ṣa sogs kyi 'og tu 'dzul ba tsam gyis 'dag pas las sla bar 'dug snyam bsam bzhin du sdig pa byas nas/ phyis 'gyod sdom sogs med par kha nas bshag tshig re dang / gzungs sngags sogs bton pas sdig pa 'dag pa zhig rgyal ba sras bcas kyis ma gsungs te/ mkhas 639

grub rā ga a gye'i zhal nas/ 'gyod pa med na bshags pas mi 'dag pas/ /sngar byas sdig pa khong du dug song ltar/ /ngo tsha 'jigs skrag 'gyod pa chen pos bshags/ /phyin chad sdom sems med na mi 'dag pas/ /phyin chad srog la babs kyang mi dge'i las/ /da ni mi bgyi sems la dam bca' bzung / /gsungs/ sdig pa mi 'dag pa tsam du ma zad/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' yi dgongs pa ma lon par log par go nas log par spyad pa yin pas/ nyes pa dpag tu med pa 'byung ba tshad ldan gye mkhas grub du mas gsungs/ dper na me chen po 'bar nas 'ong ba/ de gsod pa'i gnyen po chu yin kyang / mtsho kho la me 'bar na gzhan gsod thabs ci yang med pa ltar/ sdig pa'i gnyen po chos yin kyang / chos sdig pa'i grogs su shor song ba de/ bshad thabs med pa'i sdig pa mnar med dmyal bar skye ba'i rgyu 'ba' zhig yin pas gzhan ma sems/ mkhas pa'i sdig pa phyi yang yang gsungs pa de/ mkhas pas blang dor gye gnas shes pas sdig pa byed mi srid/ gal te bag med pa'i dbang gis re re tsam byas song yang / phyis de ma thag tu sdig pa ru ngo shes/de'i dbang gis ngan song du skye ba shes nas 'jigs shing skrag ste/ nyes ltung dang zhag gcig tsam yang mi 'grog par stobs 640

bzhi'i bshag pa shes tshad byas te 'dag tu 'jug pa la dgongs nas de skad gsungs pa yin gyi/ de ltar ma yin par dge ba'i phan yon sdig pa'i nyes dmigs shes nas/ dge sdig blang dor mi byed par sdig pa la spyad na yang / yang gsungs snyam nas 'khrul bar mi bya'o/ / deng sang chos shes zer ba 'ga' zhig gis rgyal ba'i gsung rab kyi dgongs pa ma bon par chos kyi phan yon re tsam go tshe/ de'i tshig sgra ji bzhin par bzung nas/ khong tshos sdig pa byas kyang skyon gyes mi gos pa'i blo gdeng yod pa yin zer kha pho nam mkha'i 'brug ltar sgogs/ sdig pa mi dge ba'i las la mi 'dzem pa mang / de skad smras nas lag len la sdig las 'debs pa rnams kyis chos ma shes pa'i rang mtshang phyir bstan nas/chos kyi bdag po rgyal ba sras bcas rnams thugs khrel du bcugarang gzhan kun phung la sbyor ba'i thabs/ chos la brten nas rnyed pa yin pas gzhan ma sems/ des na skyes bu blo gros can rnams kyis sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab kyi dgongs don ji bzhin sdig pa'i las srog la babs kyang shes bzhin ma byed/ gal te ma rig 'khrul ba'i dbang gis sdig pa'i las cung zad re tsam byas song na yang / dug chu khol ma khog tu shor ba ltar 'jigs 641

skrag gnong 'gyod kyi sgo nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan brjod nas phyag 'tshal ba sogs sdig pa 'dag pa'i gnyen po gang shes la 'bad/ phyin chad srog la babs kyang mi byed pa'i dam bca' byas na/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyis ji skad gsungs pa'i phan yon rnams 'byung bar gdon mi za'o/ /'o na sngon ded dpon snying rje can gyis mi nag mdung thung can bsad pas/bskal pa 'bum gyi 'khor ba phyir bsnyil te tshogs rdzogs pa'i lo rgyus dang / sngon bram ze khye'u skar mas bud med cig mo nad kyis 'chi la nye ba snying rje nas khyem thab lo bcu gnyis byas/slar tshangs par spyad pas bskal pa khri'i 'khor ba phyir bsnyil te tshogs rdzogs pa'i gtam rgyud sogs mdo rgyud bstan bcos na de 'dra'i lo rgyus mang po snang bas/ deng sang chos pa rnams kyi bya ba spyod pa 'ga' zhig gis sdom pa 'chor ba ltar snang yang / sdom pa bsrung ba las lhag pa'i rang gzhan la phan pa'i dgos pa che na/ dgag bya ba la dgos pa gtso yin pas/ sdom pa bsrung ba'i phan yon las/ dgos pa chen po yod pa de 'dem dgos/ dgos pa che na rtsa ba bzhi'i sdom pa 'chor ba'i bya ba ma yin pa yang byas chog na/ gzhan phran tshegs rnams byas na chog par sgos ci dgos zer na/ 'o de rang 'dod kyi dri ma gtan 642

nas ma mchis pa/ gzhan la phan na sems can re re'i phyir yang dmyal ba mnar med kyi me nang chen por bskal pa rgya mtshor gnas dgos kyang skyo ngal med pa'i byams snying rje byang chub sems kyi stobs rgyas shing / yang dag pa'i lta ba mngon du gyur nas sdug bsngal ltar snang tsam las/ lus sems kyis sdug bsngal dngos su myong mi dgos pa'i byang chub sems dpa' re re tsam gyi spyod yul yin gyi/ 'o skol rang 'dod kyi dri ma'i sbubs na gnas shing / gzhan phan gyi dgos pa chen po med pa dang / yod kyang byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems kyis mi zin pa rnams kyi spyod yul zhig yin par ma sems/ de yin snyam nas lag len la btab na/ seng ge mchongs sar wa lding na ltag tshigs 'bud pa ltar rang 'phung ba'i lag cha zhig chos nas rnyed pa yin/ 'o skol rnams kyis sngon gyi skyes bu dam pa de rnams kyis byas pa'i sdig pa chen po de 'dra zhig byed pa phar zhog srin bu khab rtse tsam gsod pa dang / gzhan gyi zas nor til 'bru tsam yang len mi rung ste/ sngon ded dpon snying rje can gyis sdig can mdung thung can bsad pas bskal pa mang po'i tshogs rdzogs par bshad kyang / phyis srog bcad pa'i las kyi rnam smin la lcags kyi mdung rnon po zhig rkang mthil nas 643

btab spyi bo'i bar phug nas sdug bsngal myang gsungs/sngon rje mi la sems can thams cad kyi don du tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgya ba'i 'tsho ba'i thebs su zwa bzhes dus zwa nang gi 'bu bsal kyang spyan gyis ma gzigs pa rnams bzhes pas/ tshe gcig la sangs rgyas kyang / phyis rgyal ba lo ras pa'i sku'i skye ba bzhes dus skabs shig shig bre la gzhal chog pa lta bu mang po byung / zos te rnam smin myong ba'i tshul bstan/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis zung 'jug sku brnyes/ dgung lo drug brgya tsam bzhugs kyang / sku tshe snga ma zhig la 'jag ma 'thu dus srin bu zhig gi ske 'jag ma'i bar du bcad nas shi ba'i rnam smin gyes rjes su sdig can gye mi gcig gis dbu gcod snyam gri brgyab nas ma chod tshe khong gis 'jag mas chod gsungs nas bcad pas gshegs pa'i tshul bstan/ lha lcam padma gsal o rgyan dang mjal chos thob kyang / tshe sngon khye gcig bsad pa'i las kyi lhag mas skye ba mang po zhig tu lus ngan pa blangs/ phyi nas las 'brel rtsal dang / padma gling pa/ rin chen gling par gyur kyang / gshe skur byed pa dang / dgra ldang ba mang po byung 'dug las kyi rnam par smin pa skyes bu dam pas kyang zlog tu med par myang ba'i tshul bstan pa mang / byang chub sems dpa' 644

rang 'dod gtan nas zad pa/ gzhan la phan na rang dmyal bar lhung yang bzod snyam pas/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems kyis kun nas bslangs nas las byas pa rnams kyis kyang de 'dra'i rnam smin rtsub po re myong dgos na/ 'o skol rnams kyi rang 'dod kyis kun nas bslangs/ dgos pa chung ngu'i phyir du sdig pa chen po byed pa rnams kyis las de 'dra byas na rnam smin chen po myong dgos pa smos ci dgos/ deng sang 'ga' res/spyang lpags dang / wa lpags/ stag lpags sogs gcan gzan gyi pags pa 'dod nas/ 'di yis sems can la gnod 'tshe byed pas/ 'di bsad na nyes pa med zer/ rang 'dod khong du bcug nas/ wa spyang stag sogs gcan gzan gsod pa dang /gzhan gyis zas nor cung zad re brkus na/ 'dis kun la gnod 'dug zer/ phran tshegs re'i don du mi rkun dang khye rkun bye ba gsod pa dang / rang ngam gzhan gnyen bshes sogs la ster snyam/ phyug po ser sna can gyi zas nor sogs ma byen pa len pa dang / pha ma dang nye 'brel la phan du re nas/ dge slong bande skya sar phab nas khyem 'dzin pa dang / 'dod yon lam gye grogs su mi 'gro bar 'dod yon gye dbang du 'gro yang sngags la 'dod yon thabs med kyis bsten dgos pa yin zer khag 645

ngan sngags la bkal nas sha chang bud med la bag med du spyod pa dang / rang la rnyed bkur grag4pa slogs 'ong du re nas/ lha ma mthong yang yi dam lha'i zhal mthong / mngon shes rdzu 'phrul med rung yod yod lta bu'i rdzu bag byas/ mdo sngags kyi dbang lung khred gsum ma thob rung / gzhan la dbang lung khrid gsum byed pa dang / rang che 'dod grags 'dod bde 'dod kyis kun nas bslangs khang pa chen po phub/ dgon pa btab nas ra lug g.yag gsum brgya stong bsad/ srin bu bye ba ther 'bum gyi rabs rtsa ba dgu rgyud nas gcod pa dang / dgon pa'i spyi thog nas bzho mdzo nyi shu sum cu bzhag lo re bzhin rtol bu gsod pa sogs sdig pa tshabs chen byed pa rnams/ skyon gyi mi gos pa'i skyes bu dam pa 'dra yin na ma gtogs gzhan su yin rung /steng du nyes pa dpag tu med pa 'byung ba yid gnyis the tshom mi dgos par thag chod/ des na rang legs su 'dod pa rnams kyis las rgyu 'bras ltar sdig pa mi dge ba phra zhing phra ba la 'dzem pa gal che/ de ltar mi dge ba chung ngu tsam gyis kyang skyon gyes mi gos par 'dod na/ chags sdang sogs nyon mongs pa srog gcod ma byen len sogs mi dge ba thams cad bskyed pa'i rtsa ba spyir 'dod yon lnga dang / sgos su lto gos bud med 646

gsum/ khyad par lus kyi gces 'dzin 'di yin pas/ dam pa gong ma rnams kyi rnam thar ltar blos btang nas chos bzhin 'dul ba bzhin byed dgos/ mdor na 'dod chags sogs nyon mongs pa lam du 'khyer nus pa'i rnal 'byor pa u dum wā ra'i me tog las kyang dkon pas/ snyigs dus 'dir gsang sngags pa yin rung spong ba gnad che ste/ gsang ba'i bdag po la/las kyi rdo rjes/ gsang sngags pa nyon mongs pa lam du 'khyer ba lags sam zhus pas/ gsang bdag gi zhal nas/ nyon mongs pa lam du 'khyer ba ha cang che ste/ dug gis lto yong ba la rma bya las med/ nyon mongs pa ma spangs par lam du 'khyer nus pa'i gang zag de u dum wā ra'i me tog las kyang dkon/ gang zag dbang po rab la nyon mongs pa grogs su 'char te/ tha mal ba la dug tu 'gyur bas spong ba zab/ dang po spangs pa ji ltar tsam na klong du gyur nas nyon mongs pa dang / 'dod pa'i yon tan thams cad sgyu mar shar nas zhen chags gang yang mi sgye/byung yang dgag mi dgos/ gnod pa med/ ma byung yang sgrub blo mi sgye/ re ba med/ de tsa na lam du longs pa'i tshad yin/ mngon zhen ma log pa'i bar du nyon mongs pa lam du 'khyer bas sbrang bu rtsi'i bcud la 'khor bas 'byar ba dang 'dra gsungs/ lam 647

nyams su len pa la bar chad gang che zhus pas/ gsang bdag gi zhal nas/ dang po lam la 'jug pa'i dus su blo phyin ci log tu byed pa'i rkyen gang byung yang bar chad yin/ khyad par du skyes pa la bud med bdud du che/ bud med la skyes pa bdud du che/ thun mong du lto gos gnyis bdud du che gsungs/ yang zhus pa/ da lta'i gsang sngags pa phal che ba zhig gis/ phyag rgya ma bsten pa bogs che zer bar gda' bas de ji ltar lags zhus pas/gsang bdag gi zhal nas/ lam gyi bogs thon pa'i phyag rgya ma gser las dkon/ bud med ngan ma mos gus bye bo la byed/dag snang snying sdug la byed/ tshogs bsags khyo bo la 'bul/zhen log lha chos la byed/ nyan na khye la yang spyod/ dad pa kha nas skye/ ldog na snying nas ldog ser sna dang mig ser che/ yar 'gro ba'i las mi bsog par mar 'dren pa'i lcags kyu byed/chos 'phel ba'i bogs 'don mi yong bar chags sdang dang /sdug bsngal gye sna sun byed/ chags pas grol du re nas bsten par gda' ste/ nyon mongs pa 'phel ba'i rgyur song / khams rgyas pa'i rten yong du re tsa na/ nyams grib kyi thum por khyer song / dam tshig mi bsrung bud med 'chol ma bdud mo yin gsungs/ bsten du rung tsam de gang lags zhus pas/ gsang 648

bdag gi zhal nas/ gong gi skyon de rnams las log pa zhig dgos/ khyad par du chos la mos pa/ blo che ba/ ngang rgyud ring ba dang / dad pa dang snying rje che ba/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug rgyud la tshang ba/ bla ma'i bka' mi gcog pa/ sgrub pa po la gus pa/sngags kyi dam tshig mig 'bras bzhin bsrung ba/ dbang gi dus min pa g.yem mi shor ba/ gtsang sbra la gnas pa byung na lam gye grogs su 'gro ste/ de lta bu shin tu dkon pas/ de lta bu yang chags pa can drangs pa'i don yin cing / dbang po rab kyi chos skal yin/ tha mal ba rnams la nyon mongs rang gar 'gro bas de las ldog dgos/ sngags kyi sgor zhugs nas/ dam tshig ma bsrungs na/ sangs rgya ba la re ba ma byed gsungs/ yang las kyi rdo rjes zhus pa/ chos byed pa la lto gos dang / lus kyi gces 'dzin 'di gas lan 'dug pas/ 'di gsum blos thongs pa'i gdams pa zhig zhu byas pas/ gsang bdag gi zhal nas/ las kyi rdo rje lus 'di nam yang 'jig pa yin/ tshe tshad kyang sngon nas bskos tshad re yod/ rgan gzhon la nges pa med/ thams cad 'chi ba las ma 'das pas gzugs legs kyang de la chags pas ma shi bar 'dug pa ngas ma mthong / lus kyi gces 'dzin thams cad blos thongs la ri khrod 'grims/ gos ni dug 649

po gyon kyang chog lto ni rdo dang chus kyang yong / mi rnams kyis chos byed ma nus pa yin gsungs/ des na blo gros can rnams kyis lus longs spyod gang la ma chags par tshe blos btang nas ri khrod dben par dam pa'i lha chos nyams su len pa gces so//smras pa/ mtshan ldan bla ma ded dpon chen po rnams kyi drin las legs thob pa'i/ /mthong thos 'gro la phan pa'i yid bzhin nor bu lta bu'i glegs bam 'di/ /lan cig lan gnyis bklags kyang tshe 'di'i chags zhen chung du chung du 'gro/ /ri khrod dben par lha chos byed 'dod ngang gis 'byung ba'i ya mtshan che/ /de phyir lha chos snying nas byed pas glegs bam 'di nyid sngas su zhog /yang dang yang du ltos dang bla ma bzang pos bka' chos gnang ba dang / /khyad par med par tshe 'di'i bya ba dgos med blo sna yang yang skye/ /tshe blos thongs tshe chos kyi phyed grub 'khor ba'i gnas nas 'phags par 'gyur/ /e ma blo ldan grogs po slob ma yon bdag pho mo dad can rnams/ /nam 'chi cha med 'dod yon nyes dmigs soms la gang la ma chags pa/ /mtshan ldan bla ma dam pa bsten la ri khrod dben pa'i dga' tshal du/ /gcig pur dam pa'i lha chos mdzod dang bde skyid nyi ma bzhin du 'char/ /ya mtshan sprul pa'i glegs bam 'di nyid dbus kyi ri 650

bo nam gnas bar/ /sa steng 'di ru yun ring gnas shing yid bzhin nor bu gnas pa bzhin/ /gang du gnas pa'i sa der nad mug 'khrug rtsod ming yang mi grag cing / /rtag tu bkra shis byin rlabs g.yang chags rdzogs ldan dus bzhin skyid par shog /ces ya mtshan sprul pa'i glegs bam zhes bya ba 'di ni bslab gsum rgyan gyis mdzes shing / 'phags nor bdun gyis phyug pa'i rig 'dzin o rgyan rnam rgyal dang / bla ma gangs ri pa/mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzoms pa'i la dwags mkhan po bya btang rin chen dang / phyag mdzod o rgyan/ dad ldan shes rab che ba gnyer ba a mchog dang / gsol dpon mkhas pa/ tshe 'di'i snang shes dor nas phyi ma don du gnyer ba'i slob bu grub chen dang / kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ bstan 'dzin rang grol la sogs dad can gyi slob ma yongs kyis 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes yang yang bskul ngor rgyal khams phyogs med kyi ri khrod 'grims pa'i bya btang rnal 'byor zhabs dkar pas/ rgyal ba yab sras kyi gdan sa/ mkhas grub kun gyi bzhugs sa/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor sa dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing gi lha ldan ra sa 'phrul snang gi thag nye mkhas grub du ma'i gdan sa/ nyams dga' rig pa dwangs pa'i dben gnas mkhar rdo bsam gtan 651

gling gi yang rtse mtshungs med bzod pa rgya mtsho'i sgrub gnas 'od gsal nyi 'od 'khyel ba'i phug mo che nas sbyar ba'o// 'dis kyang bstan pa dang 'gro ba yongs la phan pa dpag tu med pa thogs par gyur cigabaskal bzang 'gro ba'i 'dren mchog pad dkar 'chang / /gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa'i skur shar ba/ /bdag la sangs rgyas las kyang drin che ba'i/ /skyabs mchog dam pa gang der gus pas 'dud/ /sngon byon mkhas grub du ma'i dgongs pa'i bcud/ /kun 'dus ya mtshan sprul pa'i glegs bam 'di/ /'bri brko byed po lha khang dbu mdzad dang / /bstan 'dzin nyi ma sogs kyis par du bsgrubs/ /'dis mtshon dge bas phan bde 'byung ba'i gnas/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa rin chen dar zhing rgyas/ /bstan 'dzin dam pa rnams ni zhabs pad brtan/ /mdzad 'phrin yar ngo'i zla bzhin gong 'phel shog /gzhan yang ljongs 'dir nad nu/ga 'khrug rtsod zhi/ /char chu dus 'bab lo legs 'bri phyugs 'phel/ /rdzogs ldan dus bzhin bde zhing skyid pa yi/ /bkra shis chen pos phyogs kun khyab gyur cig /ces par byang smon tshig nyung bsdus 'di ni/ sngon byon mkhas grub du ma'i lung gis zin pa'i nyams dga' rig pa dwangs pa'i dben gnas bkra shis 652
'khyil nas par du sgrub skabs/ dbu mdzad skal bzang skyabs kyis bskul ngor/ 'dun pa ma log tsam du khyab gdal klong yangs kyis bris pa dza yantu// sarba maṅga lo//653
